`README.md`:

```md
# Ghidra RE Workbench (`ghidra-re`)

A self-contained local headless Ghidra reverse engineering plugin for Antigravity Desktop. It combines a single shared headless Ghidra JVM daemon, an offline `node:sqlite` + FTS5 symbol/string/pseudocode index, 18 token-budgeted MCP tools, and an interactive Aux Pane workbench (`ghidra-re/workbench`).

![Ghidra RE Workbench — Synchronized C | ASM Split View](assets/windivert-split-c-asm.png)

![Ghidra RE Workbench — Sugiyama Orthogonal Control-Flow Graph (CFG)](assets/windivert-cfg.png)

![Ghidra RE Workbench — Offline SQLite Expandable Call Tree](assets/windivert-calltree.png)

---

## Quick Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Yultas/ghidra-re.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/ghidra-re
cd ~/.gemini/config/plugins/ghidra-re
./install.sh
```

---

## Architecture Overview

- **Zero Idle JVM Footprint:** The Ghidra JVM never starts at Antigravity boot. It launches lazily on demand, auto-unloads after the configured idle timeout, and can be stopped at any time (`0 MB` JVM RAM) while offline SQLite browsing stays available.
- **Native Java `GhidraLaunchable` Daemon:** Auto-compiled once via `javac --release 25` against your installed Ghidra JARs and cached by `(ghidraVersion, jdkVersion, sourceSha256)`. Binds strictly to `127.0.0.1` with per-launch 256-bit bearer authentication (`0600` `daemon.json`) and single-JVM `daemon.lock` coordination.
- **Priority `DecompInterface` Pool:** Strict `P0_UI > P1_MCP > P2_BG` scheduling with `/proc/<pid>/status` (`VmRSS`) native worker watchdog recycling.
- **Offline SQLite Index (`node:sqlite` + FTS5):** Per-binary WAL-mode SQLite index (`index.sqlite`) synced from the daemon for instant symbol, string, call-graph, and cached pseudocode search even when the daemon is stopped.
- **Aux Pane Workbench (`sidecar://ghidra-re/workbench/`):** Tokenized C decompilation with collapsible branches, bidirectional `C <-> ASM` sync, lazy SVG CFG renderer, interactive Call Tree, Data/Hex/String Inspector, inline rename/retype/comment, `Follow Agent`, and `Ask Agent`.

---

## Prerequisites & Discovery Paths

Requires **Node.js v26+** (built-in `node:sqlite` with FTS5), **Ghidra 12.2+**, and **JDK 25+**.

### Installing Ghidra & JDK 25+

- **Arch Linux (`extra/ghidra` + JDK):**
  ```bash
  sudo pacman -S ghidra jdk-openjdk
  ```
- **User-Space Installation (no root required):**
  Unpack Ghidra to `~/.local/opt/ghidra` and JDK 25+ to `~/.local/opt/jdk-25`.

### Automatic Discovery Order

1. **Ghidra Installation:**
   1. `ghidraInstallDir` (or `ghidraDir` alias) in `~/.local/share/antigravity-ghidra-re/config.json`
   2. `GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR` environment variable
   3. `/opt/ghidra` (Arch Linux `extra/ghidra`)
   4. `/usr/share/ghidra`
   5. `~/.local/opt/ghidra`
   6. `analyzeHeadless` resolved from `PATH`

2. **JDK 25+ (`java`, `javac`, `jar`):**
   1. `javaHome` in `~/.local/share/antigravity-ghidra-re/config.json`
   2. `JAVA_HOME` environment variable
   3. `~/.local/opt/jdk-25` and other `~/.local/opt/jdk-*` / `java-*` (`>= 25`)
   4. `/usr/lib/jvm/jdk-*` / `java-*` (`>= 25`)
   5. `java` resolved from `PATH`

If either prerequisite is missing, the Aux Pane and MCP tools return a structured `PREREQ_MISSING_GHIDRA` or `PREREQ_MISSING_JDK` diagnostic without crashing.

---

## RAM Tiers & Resource Budgets

Select a tier in the Aux Pane **Engine & RAM** popover or in `config.json`:

| Tier | Daemon RSS Ceiling | JVM `-Xms` / `-Xmx` | Decompiler Workers (`W`) | Multi-Binary | Idle Auto-Unload |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Idle (Stopped)** | `0 MB` | `0` | `0` | Offline SQLite browse all | N/A |
| **Eco** | `1,536 MB` (`1.5 GB`) | `256m` / `768m` | `1` (shared, `P0_UI` preempts) | `1` active binary | `10 min` |
| **Balanced** *(default)* | `3,072 MB` (`3.0 GB`) | `512m` / `1,536m` | `2` (`1` UI-reserved + `1` MCP/BG) | `1` active binary | `20 min` |
| **Power** | `6,144 MB` (`6.0 GB`) | `1024m` / `3,200m` | `4` (`1` UI-reserved + `2` MCP + `1` BG) | Up to `3` binaries + batch FTS5 | `45 min` |
| **Custom** | `1,536..10,240 MB` (clamped `<= 70%` host RAM) | Formula-scaled | `1..6` (scaled to RAM & CPU threads) | `>= 4,608 MB` (`1..4` binaries) | `5..120 min` or `0` (Never) |

---

## MCP Tools (`ghidra-re` — 18 Tools)

All MCP responses obey a deterministic `24 KiB` ceiling to keep agent context clean.

| Tool | Mode | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ghidra_status` | Offline + Live | Daemon state, RAM tier, live RSS, loaded binaries, and offline cached projects |
| `ghidra_open_binary` | Live (or Offline) | Compute SHA-256, reuse existing `.gpr` or import & analyze, sync `index.sqlite` |
| `ghidra_unload_binary` | Live | Save and unload a binary from the JVM (optionally `stopDaemonIfEmpty=true`) |
| `ghidra_stop_daemon` | Live | Checkpoint all `.gpr` projects and shut down the JVM to `0 MB` |
| `ghidra_list_binaries` | Offline + Live | List loaded binaries and offline indexed projects |
| `ghidra_search_symbols` | Offline-First | Search functions, imports, and exports via `index.sqlite` |
| `ghidra_search_strings` | Offline-First | Full-text and literal string search via `strings_fts` |
| `ghidra_decompile` | Live (or SQLite cache) | Paginated plain-C decompilation with optional gutter and caller/callee summaries |
| `ghidra_disasm` | Live | Compact disassembly window with references and comments |
| `ghidra_xrefs` | Live | Incoming/outgoing cross-references grouped with instruction previews |
| `ghidra_callgraph` | Offline-First | Caller/callee graph (`depth <= 3`, `maxNodes <= 120`) |
| `ghidra_cfg` | Live | Basic-block control-flow graph (`COND_TRUE`, `COND_FALSE`, `LOOP_BACK`) |
| `ghidra_inspect_data` | Live | String decoding, pointer/vtable resolution, and hex/ASCII dump |
| `ghidra_search_pseudocode` | Offline-First | Search cached decompiled C via `decompile_fts` with coverage stats |
| `ghidra_rename` | Live | Rename function, variable, label, or global symbol with live UI sync |
| `ghidra_retype` | Live | Apply C function signature, variable type, or data type |
| `ghidra_set_comment` | Live | Set or clear `EOL`, `PRE`, `POST`, or `PLATE` comments |
| `ghidra_batch_annotate` | Live | Apply up to 25 rename/retype/comment ops in one atomic Ghidra transaction |

---

## Aux Pane Workbench (`ghidra-re/workbench`)

Open the workbench via `[Ghidra RE](sidecar://ghidra-re/workbench/)`.

- **Views:** `Decompile`, `Split C|ASM`, `Disasm`, `CFG` (lazy layered SVG + minimap), `Call Tree`, and `Data` inspector.
- **Shortcuts:** `G` (Go To address/symbol), `X` (Xrefs), `N` (Rename), `;` (Comment), `Tab` (toggle Decompile/Disasm), `Ctrl+F` / `Cmd+F` (find in function), `Alt+ArrowLeft` / `Alt+ArrowRight` (history Back/Forward), `Esc` (close drawer/modal or Back).
- **Agent Collaboration:** `Follow Agent` tracks agent decompile/disasm focus live; `Ask Agent` sends compact function context straight to the active Antigravity chat.

---

## Persistent Data & Cache Paths

Plugin updates never overwrite your analyzed projects or build cache:

- **Persistent Data Root** (`GHIDRA_RE_DATA_DIR`, default `~/.local/share/antigravity-ghidra-re/`):
  - `config.json` — persisted RAM tier, `customRamMb`, `idleTimeoutMin`, `ghidraInstallDir`, `javaHome`
  - `daemon.json` (`0600`) & `daemon.lock` — active daemon discovery and single-JVM launch lock
  - `daemon.log` & `runtime-events.jsonl` — rolling daemon log and live sync ring
  - `projects/<sha256>/` — `ghidra.gpr`, `ghidra.rep/`, `index.sqlite`, `meta.json`, `owner.pid`
- **Build Cache Root** (`GHIDRA_RE_CACHE_DIR`, default `~/.cache/antigravity-ghidra-re/`):
  - `build/<cacheKey>/daemon.jar` — auto-compiled Java 25 daemon JAR

`daemon/src/com/antigravity/ghidrare/ApiException.java`:

```java
package com.antigravity.ghidrare;

import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Structured runtime exception mapped directly to the HTTP JSON error contract.
 */
public class ApiException extends RuntimeException {
    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;

    private final int httpStatus;
    private final String errorCode;
    private final boolean retryable;
    @SuppressWarnings("serial")
    private final Map<String, Object> details;

    public ApiException(int httpStatus, String errorCode, String message) {
        this(httpStatus, errorCode, message, false, Collections.emptyMap(), null);
    }

    public ApiException(int httpStatus, String errorCode, String message, boolean retryable) {
        this(httpStatus, errorCode, message, retryable, Collections.emptyMap(), null);
    }

    public ApiException(
            int httpStatus,
            String errorCode,
            String message,
            boolean retryable,
            Map<String, Object> details) {
        this(httpStatus, errorCode, message, retryable, details, null);
    }

    public ApiException(
            int httpStatus,
            String errorCode,
            String message,
            boolean retryable,
            Map<String, Object> details,
            Throwable cause) {
        super(message, cause);
        this.httpStatus = httpStatus;
        this.errorCode = errorCode != null ? errorCode : "INTERNAL_ERROR";
        this.retryable = retryable;
        this.details = details != null
                ? Collections.unmodifiableMap(new LinkedHashMap<>(details))
                : Collections.emptyMap();
    }

    public int getHttpStatus() {
        return httpStatus;
    }

    public String getErrorCode() {
        return errorCode;
    }

    public boolean isRetryable() {
        return retryable;
    }

    public Map<String, Object> getDetails() {
        return details;
    }

    public Map<String, Object> toErrorBody() {
        Map<String, Object> error = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        error.put("code", errorCode);
        error.put("message", getMessage() != null ? getMessage() : errorCode);
        error.put("retryable", retryable);
        error.put("details", details);

        Map<String, Object> root = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        root.put("error", error);
        return root;
    }
}

```

package com.antigravity.ghidrare;

import ghidra.app.decompiler.ClangBreak;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.ClangCaseToken;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.ClangCommentToken;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.ClangFieldToken;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.ClangFuncNameToken;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.ClangFuncProto;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.ClangLabelToken;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.ClangLine;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.ClangNode;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.ClangOpToken;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.ClangSyntaxToken;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.ClangToken;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.ClangTokenGroup;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.ClangTypeToken;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.ClangVariableToken;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.DecompileResults;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.component.DecompilerUtils;
import ghidra.program.model.address.Address;
import ghidra.program.model.address.AddressOutOfBoundsException;
import ghidra.program.model.address.AddressSetView;
import ghidra.program.model.data.Array;
import ghidra.program.model.data.DataType;
import ghidra.program.model.data.Pointer;
import ghidra.program.model.data.StringDataInstance;
import ghidra.program.model.data.TypeDef;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.CommentType;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.Data;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.Function;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.Instruction;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.Listing;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.Program;
import ghidra.program.model.pcode.HighConstant;
import ghidra.program.model.pcode.HighFunction;
import ghidra.program.model.pcode.HighGlobal;
import ghidra.program.model.pcode.HighLocal;
import ghidra.program.model.pcode.HighParam;
import ghidra.program.model.pcode.HighSymbol;
import ghidra.program.model.pcode.HighVariable;
import ghidra.program.model.pcode.LocalSymbolMap;
import ghidra.program.model.pcode.PcodeOp;
import ghidra.program.model.pcode.Varnode;
import ghidra.program.model.scalar.Scalar;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.Namespace;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.Reference;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.Symbol;

import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.Deque;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Iterator;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Extracts structured tokenized C, variable tables, control-flow fold regions,
 * labels, and bidirectional address-to-line maps from Ghidra DecompileResults.
 */
public final class ClangTokenExtractor {

    private static final int STRING_PREVIEW_MAX_CHARS = 120;
    private static final int FOLD_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS = 120;
    private static final Set<String> FOLD_KEYWORDS = Set.of("if", "else", "switch", "while", "for", "do");

    private ClangTokenExtractor() {
    }

    /**
     * Immutable cached decompilation payload for a single function revision.
     */
    public static final class DecompileArtifact {
        private final String binaryId;
        private final long revision;
        private final int pointerSize;
        private final Map<String, Object> function;
        private final List<Map<String, Object>> variables;
        private final List<Map<String, Object>> lines;
        private final List<Map<String, Object>> folds;
        private final Map<String, Map<String, Object>> labels;
        private final Map<String, List<Integer>> addrToLines;
        private final Set<String> usedTypes;
        private final List<String> plainLines;

        public DecompileArtifact(
                String binaryId,
                long revision,
                int pointerSize,
                Map<String, Object> function,
                List<Map<String, Object>> variables,
                List<Map<String, Object>> lines,
                List<Map<String, Object>> folds,
                Map<String, Map<String, Object>> labels,
                Map<String, List<Integer>> addrToLines,
                Set<String> usedTypes,
                List<String> plainLines) {
            this.binaryId = binaryId;
            this.revision = revision;
            this.pointerSize = pointerSize;
            this.function = function;
            this.variables = variables;
            this.lines = lines;
            this.folds = folds;
            this.labels = labels;
            this.addrToLines = addrToLines;
            this.usedTypes = usedTypes;
            this.plainLines = plainLines;
        }

        public String getBinaryId() {
            return binaryId;
        }

        public long getRevision() {
            return revision;
        }

        public Map<String, Object> getFunction() {
            return function;
        }

        public List<Map<String, Object>> getVariables() {
            return variables;
        }

        public List<Map<String, Object>> getLines() {
            return lines;
        }

        public List<Map<String, Object>> getFolds() {
            return folds;
        }

        public Map<String, Map<String, Object>> getLabels() {
            return labels;
        }

        public Map<String, List<Integer>> getAddrToLines() {
            return addrToLines;
        }

        public Set<String> getUsedTypes() {
            return usedTypes;
        }

        public List<String> getPlainLines() {
            return plainLines;
        }

        public Map<String, Object> toTokensResponse(
                String binaryId,
                long revision,
                boolean cached,
                long decompileMs,
                int startLine,
                int maxLines,
                boolean includePlainText) {
            int totalLines = lines.size();
            LineSlice slice = computeLineSlice(totalLines, startLine, maxLines);

            List<Map<String, Object>> slicedLines = slice.hasRows()
                    ? new ArrayList<>(lines.subList(slice.fromIdx(), slice.toIdx()))
                    : Collections.emptyList();

            Map<String, Object> resp = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            resp.put("binaryId", binaryId);
            resp.put("revision", revision);
            resp.put("cached", cached);
            resp.put("decompileMs", decompileMs);
            resp.put("function", function);
            resp.put("variables", variables);
            resp.put("totalLines", totalLines);
            resp.put("startLine", slice.startLine());
            resp.put("endLine", slice.endLine());
            resp.put("truncated", slice.truncated());
            resp.put("lines", slicedLines);
            resp.put("folds", folds);
            resp.put("labels", labels);
            resp.put("addrToLines", addrToLines);
            if (includePlainText) {
                resp.put("plainText", String.join("\n", plainLines));
            }
            return resp;
        }

        public Map<String, Object> toTextResponse(
                String binaryId,
                long revision,
                boolean cached,
                long decompileMs,
                int startLine,
                int maxLines,
                boolean includeGutter) {
            int totalLines = plainLines.size();
            LineSlice slice = computeLineSlice(totalLines, startLine, maxLines);

            int addrWidth = 2 + Math.max(8, pointerSize * 2);
            String blankAddr = " ".repeat(addrWidth);
            StringBuilder code = new StringBuilder();
            if (slice.hasRows()) {
                for (int i = slice.fromIdx(); i < slice.toIdx(); i++) {
                    if (i > slice.fromIdx()) {
                        code.append('\n');
                    }
                    String textLine = plainLines.get(i);
                    if (includeGutter) {
                        Object rawAddr = i < lines.size() ? lines.get(i).get("addr") : null;
                        String gutterAddr = rawAddr != null ? rawAddr.toString() : blankAddr;
                        code.append(gutterAddr).append(" | ").append(textLine);
                    } else {
                        code.append(textLine);
                    }
                }
            }

            Map<String, Object> resp = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            resp.put("binaryId", binaryId);
            resp.put("revision", revision);
            resp.put("cached", cached);
            resp.put("decompileMs", decompileMs);
            resp.put("function", function);
            resp.put("totalLines", totalLines);
            resp.put("startLine", slice.startLine());
            resp.put("endLine", slice.endLine());
            resp.put("truncated", slice.truncated());
            resp.put("code", code.toString());
            return resp;
        }

        private static LineSlice computeLineSlice(int totalLines, int startLine, int maxLines) {
            int effectiveStart = Math.max(1, startLine);
            int effectiveMax = maxLines > 0 ? maxLines : Math.max(1, totalLines);
            if (totalLines == 0 || effectiveStart > totalLines) {
                return new LineSlice(0, 0, effectiveStart, totalLines == 0 ? 0 : effectiveStart - 1, false, false);
            }
            int fromIdx = effectiveStart - 1;
            int toIdx = Math.min(totalLines, fromIdx + effectiveMax);
            boolean truncated = toIdx < totalLines;
            return new LineSlice(fromIdx, toIdx, effectiveStart, toIdx, truncated, true);
        }

        private record LineSlice(
                int fromIdx,
                int toIdx,
                int startLine,
                int endLine,
                boolean truncated,
                boolean hasRows) {
        }
    }

    public static DecompileArtifact extract(
            String binaryId,
            Program program,
            Function function,
            DecompileResults results,
            long revision) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(program, "program");
        Objects.requireNonNull(function, "function");
        Objects.requireNonNull(results, "results");

        int pointerSize = program.getDefaultPointerSize();
        Listing listing = program.getListing();
        HighFunction highFunction = results.getHighFunction();

        Set<String> usedTypes = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        recordDataType(function.getReturnType(), usedTypes);

        Map<String, Object> functionMeta = buildFunctionMeta(program, function, listing, pointerSize);

        Map<Long, String> symbolIdToVarId = new HashMap<>();
        Map<String, String> nameToVarId = new HashMap<>();
        List<Map<String, Object>> variables = extractVariables(
                highFunction, symbolIdToVarId, nameToVarId, usedTypes);

        ClangTokenGroup markup = results.getCCodeMarkup();
        List<ClangLine> clangLines = markup != null
                ? DecompilerUtils.toLines(markup)
                : Collections.emptyList();

        List<Map<String, Object>> lines = new ArrayList<>(clangLines.size());
        List<String> plainLines = new ArrayList<>(clangLines.size());
        Map<String, Map<String, Object>> labels = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        Map<String, List<Integer>> addrToLines = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < clangLines.size(); i++) {
            ClangLine clangLine = clangLines.get(i);
            int lineNum = i + 1;
            int indent = clangLine.getIndent();
            StringBuilder plainBuilder = new StringBuilder(clangLine.getIndentString());

            List<ClangToken> rawTokens = clangLine.getAllTokens();
            List<Map<String, Object>> extractedTokens = new ArrayList<>(rawTokens.size());
            Set<String> lineAsmAddrs = new LinkedHashSet<>();
            Address lowestAddr = null;

            for (ClangToken tok : rawTokens) {
                if (tok instanceof ClangBreak) {
                    continue;
                }
                String text = tok.getText();
                if (text == null || text.isEmpty()) {
                    continue;
                }
                plainBuilder.append(text);

                TokenExtractionResult tokenRes = extractToken(
                        program,
                        listing,
                        function,
                        highFunction,
                        tok,
                        text,
                        lineNum,
                        pointerSize,
                        symbolIdToVarId,
                        nameToVarId,
                        labels,
                        usedTypes);

                extractedTokens.add(tokenRes.tokenMap());

                if (tokenRes.instructionAddr() != null) {
                    Address insnAddr = tokenRes.instructionAddr();
                    String insnHex = LoadedBinary.formatAddress(insnAddr, pointerSize);
                    lineAsmAddrs.add(insnHex);
                    if (lowestAddr == null || insnAddr.compareTo(lowestAddr) < 0) {
                        lowestAddr = insnAddr;
                    }
                }
            }

            List<String> asmAddrsList = new ArrayList<>(lineAsmAddrs);
            for (String hex : asmAddrsList) {
                addrToLines.computeIfAbsent(hex, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(lineNum);
            }

            Map<String, Object> lineObj = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            lineObj.put("line", lineNum);
            lineObj.put("indent", indent);
            lineObj.put("addr", lowestAddr != null ? LoadedBinary.formatAddress(lowestAddr, pointerSize) : null);
            lineObj.put("asmAddrs", asmAddrsList);
            lineObj.put("tokens", extractedTokens);
            lines.add(lineObj);
            plainLines.add(plainBuilder.toString());
        }

        List<Map<String, Object>> folds = extractFolds(lines, plainLines);

        return new DecompileArtifact(
                binaryId,
                revision,
                pointerSize,
                Collections.unmodifiableMap(functionMeta),
                Collections.unmodifiableList(variables),
                Collections.unmodifiableList(lines),
                Collections.unmodifiableList(folds),
                Collections.unmodifiableMap(labels),
                Collections.unmodifiableMap(addrToLines),
                Collections.unmodifiableSet(usedTypes),
                Collections.unmodifiableList(plainLines));
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> buildFunctionMeta(
            Program program,
            Function function,
            Listing listing,
            int pointerSize) {
        Address entry = function.getEntryPoint();
        AddressSetView body = function.getBody();
        Address end = (body != null && !body.isEmpty() && body.getMaxAddress() != null)
                ? body.getMaxAddress()
                : entry;
        Namespace ns = function.getParentNamespace();
        String namespace = (ns == null || ns.isGlobal()) ? "Global" : ns.getName(true);
        String signature = function.getPrototypeString(false, false);
        String cc = function.getCallingConventionName();
        long sizeBytes = body != null ? body.getNumAddresses() : 0L;
        String plateComment = listing.getComment(CommentType.PLATE, entry);

        Map<String, Object> fnMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        fnMap.put("entry", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(entry, pointerSize));
        fnMap.put("end", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(end, pointerSize));
        fnMap.put("name", function.getName());
        fnMap.put("namespace", namespace);
        fnMap.put("signature", signature != null ? signature : function.getName() + "()");
        fnMap.put("callingConvention", cc != null && !cc.isBlank() ? cc : "unknown");
        fnMap.put("sizeBytes", sizeBytes);
        fnMap.put("isThunk", function.isThunk());
        fnMap.put("isExternal", function.isExternal());
        fnMap.put("plateComment", plateComment);
        return fnMap;
    }

    private static List<Map<String, Object>> extractVariables(
            HighFunction highFunction,
            Map<Long, String> symbolIdToVarId,
            Map<String, String> nameToVarId,
            Set<String> usedTypes) {
        if (highFunction == null) {
            return Collections.emptyList();
        }
        LocalSymbolMap symbolMap = highFunction.getLocalSymbolMap();
        if (symbolMap == null) {
            return Collections.emptyList();
        }

        List<HighSymbol> params = new ArrayList<>();
        List<HighSymbol> locals = new ArrayList<>();
        Iterator<HighSymbol> it = symbolMap.getSymbols();
        while (it.hasNext()) {
            HighSymbol sym = it.next();
            if (sym == null || sym.isGlobal()) {
                continue;
            }
            if (sym.isParameter()) {
                params.add(sym);
            } else {
                locals.add(sym);
            }
        }

        params.sort(Comparator.comparingInt(HighSymbol::getCategoryIndex));
        locals.sort(Comparator.comparingLong(HighSymbol::getId));

        List<Map<String, Object>> variables = new ArrayList<>(params.size() + locals.size());
        Set<String> seenVarIds = new LinkedHashSet<>();

        int fallbackParamIdx = 0;
        for (HighSymbol sym : params) {
            int catIdx = sym.getCategoryIndex() >= 0 ? sym.getCategoryIndex() : fallbackParamIdx;
            fallbackParamIdx++;
            String varId = "param_" + catIdx;
            if (!seenVarIds.add(varId)) {
                varId = "param_" + catIdx + "_" + Long.toUnsignedString(sym.getId());
                seenVarIds.add(varId);
            }
            variables.add(buildVariableEntry(sym, varId, "param", symbolIdToVarId, nameToVarId, usedTypes));
        }

        for (HighSymbol sym : locals) {
            String varId = "local_" + Long.toUnsignedString(sym.getId());
            if (!seenVarIds.add(varId)) {
                varId = "local_" + Long.toUnsignedString(sym.getId()) + "_" + variables.size();
                seenVarIds.add(varId);
            }
            variables.add(buildVariableEntry(sym, varId, "local", symbolIdToVarId, nameToVarId, usedTypes));
        }

        return variables;
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> buildVariableEntry(
            HighSymbol sym,
            String varId,
            String kind,
            Map<Long, String> symbolIdToVarId,
            Map<String, String> nameToVarId,
            Set<String> usedTypes) {
        symbolIdToVarId.put(sym.getId(), varId);
        String name = sym.getName();
        if (name != null && !name.isEmpty()) {
            nameToVarId.putIfAbsent(name, varId);
        }

        DataType dt = sym.getDataType();
        recordDataType(dt, usedTypes);
        String typeName = dt != null ? dt.getDisplayName() : "undefined";
        String storage = sym.getStorage() != null ? sym.getStorage().toString() : "unknown";
        boolean renameable = name != null && !name.isEmpty() && !sym.isHiddenReturn();

        Map<String, Object> varMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        varMap.put("varId", varId);
        varMap.put("name", name != null ? name : varId);
        varMap.put("kind", kind);
        varMap.put("type", typeName);
        varMap.put("storage", storage);
        varMap.put("renameable", renameable);
        return varMap;
    }

    private record TokenExtractionResult(Map<String, Object> tokenMap, Address instructionAddr) {
    }

    private static TokenExtractionResult extractToken(
            Program program,
            Listing listing,
            Function currentFunction,
            HighFunction highFunction,
            ClangToken tok,
            String text,
            int lineNum,
            int pointerSize,
            Map<Long, String> symbolIdToVarId,
            Map<String, String> nameToVarId,
            Map<String, Map<String, Object>> labels,
            Set<String> usedTypes) {

        Map<String, Object> tokenMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        tokenMap.put("t", text);

        // 1. Whitespace
        if (text.isBlank()) {
            tokenMap.put("k", "ws");
            return new TokenExtractionResult(tokenMap, null);
        }

        // 2. Comments
        if (tok instanceof ClangCommentToken || tok.getSyntaxType() == ClangToken.COMMENT_COLOR) {
            tokenMap.put("k", "comment");
            Address addr = normalizeInstructionAddr(program, listing, tok.getMinAddress());
            if (addr != null) {
                tokenMap.put("addr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(addr, pointerSize));
            }
            return new TokenExtractionResult(tokenMap, addr);
        }

        // 3. Function names: func_def / func_call / import_call
        if (tok instanceof ClangFuncNameToken funcTok) {
            if (funcTok.Parent() instanceof ClangFuncProto) {
                tokenMap.put("k", "func_def");
                Address entryAddr = currentFunction.getEntryPoint();
                Address insnAddr = normalizeInstructionAddr(program, listing, funcTok.getMinAddress());
                Address effectiveAddr = insnAddr != null ? insnAddr : entryAddr;
                if (effectiveAddr != null && effectiveAddr.isMemoryAddress()) {
                    tokenMap.put("addr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(effectiveAddr, pointerSize));
                }
                return new TokenExtractionResult(tokenMap, insnAddr != null ? insnAddr : entryAddr);
            }

            Address callAddr = resolveTokenInstructionAddress(program, listing, funcTok);
            Function targetFn = DecompilerUtils.getFunction(program, funcTok);
            Address targetAddr = null;
            if (targetFn == null && funcTok.getPcodeOp() != null) {
                PcodeOp op = funcTok.getPcodeOp();
                if (op.getNumInputs() > 0 && op.getInput(0) != null) {
                    Address rawTarget = op.getInput(0).getAddress();
                    if (rawTarget != null) {
                        targetFn = program.getFunctionManager().getReferencedFunction(rawTarget);
                        if (targetFn == null && rawTarget.isMemoryAddress()) {
                            targetAddr = rawTarget;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            boolean isImport = false;
            if (targetFn != null) {
                isImport = isImportFunction(targetFn);
                if (targetFn.getEntryPoint() != null) {
                    targetAddr = targetFn.getEntryPoint();
                }
            }

            String kind = isImport ? "import_call" : "func_call";
            tokenMap.put("k", kind);
            if (callAddr != null) {
                tokenMap.put("addr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(callAddr, pointerSize));
            }
            if (targetAddr != null) {
                tokenMap.put("target", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(targetAddr, pointerSize));
            }
            tokenMap.put("isImport", isImport);
            return new TokenExtractionResult(tokenMap, callAddr);
        }

        // 4. Labels: label_def / label_ref
        if (tok instanceof ClangLabelToken labelTok) {
            Address labelTargetAddr = labelTok.getMinAddress();
            boolean isRef = DecompilerUtils.isGoToStatement(labelTok);
            if (isRef) {
                tokenMap.put("k", "label_ref");
                Address gotoInsnAddr = resolveSiblingInstructionAddress(program, listing, labelTok);
                if (gotoInsnAddr != null) {
                    tokenMap.put("addr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(gotoInsnAddr, pointerSize));
                }
                if (labelTargetAddr != null) {
                    tokenMap.put("target", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(labelTargetAddr, pointerSize));
                }
                return new TokenExtractionResult(tokenMap, gotoInsnAddr);
            } else {
                tokenMap.put("k", "label_def");
                Address defAddr = normalizeInstructionAddr(program, listing, labelTargetAddr);
                if (defAddr != null) {
                    String hex = LoadedBinary.formatAddress(defAddr, pointerSize);
                    tokenMap.put("addr", hex);
                    Map<String, Object> labelMeta = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    labelMeta.put("name", text);
                    labelMeta.put("line", lineNum);
                    labels.putIfAbsent(hex, labelMeta);
                } else if (labelTargetAddr != null) {
                    String hex = LoadedBinary.formatAddress(labelTargetAddr, pointerSize);
                    tokenMap.put("addr", hex);
                    Map<String, Object> labelMeta = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    labelMeta.put("name", text);
                    labelMeta.put("line", lineNum);
                    labels.putIfAbsent(hex, labelMeta);
                }
                return new TokenExtractionResult(tokenMap, defAddr);
            }
        }

        // 5. Keywords (check syntaxType before ClangOpToken/ClangSyntaxToken!)
        if (tok.getSyntaxType() == ClangToken.KEYWORD_COLOR) {
            tokenMap.put("k", "keyword");
            Address addr = resolveTokenInstructionAddress(program, listing, tok);
            if (addr != null) {
                tokenMap.put("addr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(addr, pointerSize));
            }
            return new TokenExtractionResult(tokenMap, addr);
        }

        // 6. Fields
        if (tok instanceof ClangFieldToken fieldTok) {
            tokenMap.put("k", "field");
            recordDataType(fieldTok.getDataType(), usedTypes);
            Address addr = resolveTokenInstructionAddress(program, listing, fieldTok);
            if (addr != null) {
                tokenMap.put("addr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(addr, pointerSize));
            }
            return new TokenExtractionResult(tokenMap, addr);
        }

        // 7. Types
        if (tok instanceof ClangTypeToken || tok.getSyntaxType() == ClangToken.TYPE_COLOR) {
            tokenMap.put("k", "type");
            if (tok instanceof ClangTypeToken typeTok) {
                recordDataType(typeTok.getDataType(), usedTypes);
            }
            Address addr = normalizeInstructionAddr(program, listing, tok.getMinAddress());
            if (addr != null) {
                tokenMap.put("addr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(addr, pointerSize));
            }
            return new TokenExtractionResult(tokenMap, addr);
        }

        // 8. Switch case constants
        if (tok instanceof ClangCaseToken caseTok) {
            tokenMap.put("k", "const");
            Address addr = normalizeInstructionAddr(program, listing, caseTok.getMinAddress());
            if (addr != null) {
                tokenMap.put("addr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(addr, pointerSize));
            }
            return new TokenExtractionResult(tokenMap, addr);
        }

        // 9. Variables, parameters, globals, strings, data refs, constants
        if (tok instanceof ClangVariableToken varTok) {
            return extractVariableOrConstToken(
                    program,
                    listing,
                    highFunction,
                    varTok,
                    text,
                    pointerSize,
                    symbolIdToVarId,
                    nameToVarId,
                    tokenMap);
        }

        // 10. Operators
        if (tok instanceof ClangOpToken) {
            tokenMap.put("k", "op");
            Address addr = normalizeInstructionAddr(program, listing, tok.getMinAddress());
            if (addr != null) {
                tokenMap.put("addr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(addr, pointerSize));
            }
            return new TokenExtractionResult(tokenMap, addr);
        }

        // 11. Syntax tokens
        if (tok instanceof ClangSyntaxToken) {
            tokenMap.put("k", "syntax");
            Address addr = normalizeInstructionAddr(program, listing, tok.getMinAddress());
            if (addr != null) {
                tokenMap.put("addr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(addr, pointerSize));
            }
            return new TokenExtractionResult(tokenMap, addr);
        }

        // 12. Fallback by syntaxType
        String fallbackKind = switch (tok.getSyntaxType()) {
            case ClangToken.COMMENT_COLOR -> "comment";
            case ClangToken.KEYWORD_COLOR -> "keyword";
            case ClangToken.TYPE_COLOR -> "type";
            case ClangToken.FUNCTION_COLOR -> "func_call";
            case ClangToken.PARAMETER_COLOR -> "param";
            case ClangToken.VARIABLE_COLOR -> "local";
            case ClangToken.GLOBAL_COLOR -> "global";
            case ClangToken.CONST_COLOR -> "const";
            default -> "syntax";
        };
        tokenMap.put("k", fallbackKind);
        Address addr = normalizeInstructionAddr(program, listing, tok.getMinAddress());
        if (addr != null) {
            tokenMap.put("addr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(addr, pointerSize));
        }
        return new TokenExtractionResult(tokenMap, addr);
    }

    private static TokenExtractionResult extractVariableOrConstToken(
            Program program,
            Listing listing,
            HighFunction highFunction,
            ClangVariableToken varTok,
            String text,
            int pointerSize,
            Map<Long, String> symbolIdToVarId,
            Map<String, String> nameToVarId,
            Map<String, Object> tokenMap) {

        Address insnAddr = resolveTokenInstructionAddress(program, listing, varTok);
        HighVariable hv = varTok.getHighVariable();
        HighSymbol hsym = highFunction != null ? varTok.getHighSymbol(highFunction) : null;
        if (hsym == null && hv != null) {
            hsym = hv.getSymbol();
        }
        int syntaxType = varTok.getSyntaxType();

        // Parameter
        if (hv instanceof HighParam
                || (hsym != null && hsym.isParameter())
                || syntaxType == ClangToken.PARAMETER_COLOR) {
            tokenMap.put("k", "param");
            if (insnAddr != null) {
                tokenMap.put("addr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(insnAddr, pointerSize));
            }
            String varId = resolveVarId(hsym, text, symbolIdToVarId, nameToVarId);
            if (varId != null) {
                tokenMap.put("varId", varId);
            }
            return new TokenExtractionResult(tokenMap, insnAddr);
        }

        // Local variable
        if (hv instanceof HighLocal
                || (hsym != null && !hsym.isGlobal() && !hsym.isParameter())
                || syntaxType == ClangToken.VARIABLE_COLOR) {
            tokenMap.put("k", "local");
            if (insnAddr != null) {
                tokenMap.put("addr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(insnAddr, pointerSize));
            }
            String varId = resolveVarId(hsym, text, symbolIdToVarId, nameToVarId);
            if (varId != null) {
                tokenMap.put("varId", varId);
            }
            return new TokenExtractionResult(tokenMap, insnAddr);
        }

        // Resolve potential target address for global / string_ref / data_ref
        Address targetAddr = resolveDataOrGlobalTarget(program, varTok, hv, hsym, insnAddr);
        Data targetData = targetAddr != null ? listing.getDefinedDataAt(targetAddr) : null;
        if (targetData == null && targetAddr != null) {
            Data containing = listing.getDefinedDataContaining(targetAddr);
            if (containing != null && StringDataInstance.isString(containing)) {
                targetData = containing;
            }
        }

        // String literal or string symbol reference
        if (targetData != null && StringDataInstance.isString(targetData)) {
            tokenMap.put("k", "string_ref");
            if (insnAddr != null) {
                tokenMap.put("addr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(insnAddr, pointerSize));
            }
            tokenMap.put("target", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(targetAddr, pointerSize));
            String preview = extractStringPreview(targetData);
            if (preview != null) {
                tokenMap.put("preview", preview);
            }
            return new TokenExtractionResult(tokenMap, insnAddr);
        }

        if (isQuotedStringLiteral(text)) {
            if (targetAddr == null && insnAddr != null) {
                targetAddr = findReferencedStringTarget(program, listing, insnAddr, text);
            }
            tokenMap.put("k", "string_ref");
            if (insnAddr != null) {
                tokenMap.put("addr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(insnAddr, pointerSize));
            }
            if (targetAddr != null) {
                tokenMap.put("target", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(targetAddr, pointerSize));
            }
            tokenMap.put("preview", truncateString(text, STRING_PREVIEW_MAX_CHARS));
            return new TokenExtractionResult(tokenMap, insnAddr);
        }

        // Global vs data_ref
        boolean isGlobal = hv instanceof HighGlobal
                || syntaxType == ClangToken.GLOBAL_COLOR
                || (hsym != null && hsym.isGlobal());

        if (isGlobal) {
            boolean looksLikeRawDataRef = targetData != null
                    && (text.startsWith("DAT_") || text.startsWith("_DAT_") || text.startsWith("PTR_"));
            tokenMap.put("k", looksLikeRawDataRef ? "data_ref" : "global");
            if (insnAddr != null) {
                tokenMap.put("addr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(insnAddr, pointerSize));
            }
            if (targetAddr != null) {
                tokenMap.put("target", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(targetAddr, pointerSize));
            }
            return new TokenExtractionResult(tokenMap, insnAddr);
        }

        // Constant or constant pointer to data
        if (hv instanceof HighConstant || syntaxType == ClangToken.CONST_COLOR) {
            if (targetAddr != null && (targetData != null || hasMemorySymbolOrRef(program, insnAddr, targetAddr))) {
                tokenMap.put("k", "data_ref");
                if (insnAddr != null) {
                    tokenMap.put("addr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(insnAddr, pointerSize));
                }
                tokenMap.put("target", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(targetAddr, pointerSize));
                return new TokenExtractionResult(tokenMap, insnAddr);
            }
            tokenMap.put("k", "const");
            if (insnAddr != null) {
                tokenMap.put("addr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(insnAddr, pointerSize));
            }
            return new TokenExtractionResult(tokenMap, insnAddr);
        }

        // Default variable fallback
        tokenMap.put("k", "local");
        if (insnAddr != null) {
            tokenMap.put("addr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(insnAddr, pointerSize));
        }
        String varId = resolveVarId(hsym, text, symbolIdToVarId, nameToVarId);
        if (varId != null) {
            tokenMap.put("varId", varId);
        }
        return new TokenExtractionResult(tokenMap, insnAddr);
    }

    private static String resolveVarId(
            HighSymbol hsym,
            String text,
            Map<Long, String> symbolIdToVarId,
            Map<String, String> nameToVarId) {
        if (hsym != null) {
            String byId = symbolIdToVarId.get(hsym.getId());
            if (byId != null) {
                return byId;
            }
            if (hsym.getName() != null) {
                String bySymName = nameToVarId.get(hsym.getName());
                if (bySymName != null) {
                    return bySymName;
                }
            }
        }
        return nameToVarId.get(text);
    }

    private static Address resolveDataOrGlobalTarget(
            Program program,
            ClangVariableToken varTok,
            HighVariable hv,
            HighSymbol hsym,
            Address insnAddr) {
        Varnode vn = varTok.getVarnode();
        if (vn != null && vn.isAddress() && vn.getAddress() != null && vn.getAddress().isMemoryAddress()) {
            return vn.getAddress();
        }
        if (hsym != null && hsym.getStorage() != null && hsym.getStorage().isValid()) {
            Address storageMin = hsym.getStorage().getMinAddress();
            if (storageMin != null && storageMin.isMemoryAddress()) {
                return storageMin;
            }
        }
        if (hv != null && hv.getRepresentative() != null) {
            Varnode rep = hv.getRepresentative();
            if (rep.isAddress() && rep.getAddress() != null && rep.getAddress().isMemoryAddress()) {
                return rep.getAddress();
            }
        }
        // Check scalar / constant value if backed by a memory reference from insnAddr
        Scalar scalar = varTok.getScalar();
        if (scalar != null && insnAddr != null) {
            long val = scalar.getUnsignedValue();
            for (Reference ref : program.getReferenceManager().getReferencesFrom(insnAddr)) {
                Address to = ref.getToAddress();
                if (to != null && to.isMemoryAddress() && to.getOffset() == val) {
                    return to;
                }
            }
        }
        // Handle PIE / constant-folded addresses (e.g. LEA RDI, [RIP + disp] folded into a constant Varnode / HighConstant)
        if (vn != null && vn.isConstant()) {
            Address cand = resolveConstantMemoryCandidate(program, insnAddr, vn.getOffset());
            if (cand != null) {
                return cand;
            }
        }
        if (hv instanceof HighConstant hc && hc.getScalar() != null) {
            Address cand = resolveConstantMemoryCandidate(program, insnAddr, hc.getScalar().getUnsignedValue());
            if (cand != null) {
                return cand;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static Address resolveConstantMemoryCandidate(Program program, Address insnAddr, long offset) {
        try {
            Address cand = program.getAddressFactory().getDefaultAddressSpace().getAddress(offset);
            if (cand != null && cand.isMemoryAddress() && program.getMemory().contains(cand)
                    && (hasMemorySymbolOrRef(program, insnAddr, cand)
                            || program.getListing().getDefinedDataContaining(cand) != null)) {
                return cand;
            }
        } catch (AddressOutOfBoundsException ignored) {
            // Offset does not represent a valid address in the default address space.
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static Address findReferencedStringTarget(
            Program program,
            Listing listing,
            Address insnAddr,
            String literalText) {
        if (insnAddr == null) {
            return null;
        }
        String unquoted = unquoteAndUnescapeStringLiteral(literalText);

        List<Address> directCandidates = new ArrayList<>();
        Address directMatch = scanStringRefsFromAddress(program, listing, insnAddr, literalText, unquoted, directCandidates);
        if (directMatch != null) {
            return directMatch;
        }
        if (directCandidates.size() == 1) {
            return directCandidates.get(0);
        }

        Instruction startInsn = listing.getInstructionContaining(insnAddr);
        if (startInsn == null) {
            return null;
        }
        Function fn = program.getFunctionManager().getFunctionContaining(startInsn.getAddress());

        Instruction prev = startInsn.getPrevious();
        for (int step = 0; step < 4 && prev != null; step++) {
            if (fn != null && !fn.getBody().contains(prev.getAddress())) {
                break;
            }
            Address match = scanStringRefsFromAddress(program, listing, prev.getAddress(), literalText, unquoted, null);
            if (match != null) {
                return match;
            }
            prev = prev.getPrevious();
        }

        Instruction next = startInsn.getNext();
        for (int step = 0; step < 2 && next != null; step++) {
            if (fn != null && !fn.getBody().contains(next.getAddress())) {
                break;
            }
            Address match = scanStringRefsFromAddress(program, listing, next.getAddress(), literalText, unquoted, null);
            if (match != null) {
                return match;
            }
            next = next.getNext();
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static Address scanStringRefsFromAddress(
            Program program,
            Listing listing,
            Address fromAddr,
            String literalText,
            String unquoted,
            List<Address> outCandidates) {
        Address prefixOrInteriorMatch = null;
        for (Reference ref : program.getReferenceManager().getReferencesFrom(fromAddr)) {
            Address toAddr = ref.getToAddress();
            if (toAddr == null || !toAddr.isMemoryAddress() || !program.getMemory().contains(toAddr)) {
                continue;
            }
            Data data = listing.getDefinedDataContaining(toAddr);
            if (data == null || !StringDataInstance.isString(data)) {
                continue;
            }
            if (outCandidates != null) {
                outCandidates.add(toAddr);
            }
            StringDataInstance sdi = StringDataInstance.getStringDataInstance(data);
            if (sdi == null || sdi == StringDataInstance.NULL_INSTANCE) {
                continue;
            }
            String sdiVal = sdi.getStringValue();
            String sdiRepr = sdi.getStringRepresentation();
            if ((sdiRepr != null && sdiRepr.equals(literalText))
                    || (sdiVal != null && sdiVal.equals(unquoted))) {
                return toAddr;
            }
            if (prefixOrInteriorMatch == null && sdiVal != null && !unquoted.isEmpty() && !sdiVal.isEmpty()) {
                if (sdiVal.startsWith(unquoted) || unquoted.startsWith(sdiVal)
                        || (toAddr.compareTo(data.getAddress()) > 0 && sdiVal.contains(unquoted))) {
                    prefixOrInteriorMatch = toAddr;
                }
            }
        }
        return prefixOrInteriorMatch;
    }

    private static String unquoteAndUnescapeStringLiteral(String text) {
        if (text == null || text.isEmpty()) {
            return "";
        }
        int start = 0;
        if (text.startsWith("u8\"")) {
            start = 3;
        } else if (text.startsWith("L\"") || text.startsWith("u\"") || text.startsWith("U\"")) {
            start = 2;
        } else if (text.startsWith("\"")) {
            start = 1;
        }
        int end = text.length();
        if (end > start && text.charAt(end - 1) == '"') {
            end--;
        }
        String inner = text.substring(start, end);
        if (inner.indexOf('\\') < 0) {
            return inner;
        }
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(inner.length());
        for (int i = 0; i < inner.length(); i++) {
            char c = inner.charAt(i);
            if (c != '\\' || i + 1 >= inner.length()) {
                sb.append(c);
                continue;
            }
            char next = inner.charAt(++i);
            switch (next) {
                case 'n' -> sb.append('\n');
                case 'r' -> sb.append('\r');
                case 't' -> sb.append('\t');
                case 'b' -> sb.append('\b');
                case 'f' -> sb.append('\f');
                case 'a' -> sb.append('\u0007');
                case 'v' -> sb.append('\u000b');
                case '\\' -> sb.append('\\');
                case '"' -> sb.append('"');
                case '\'' -> sb.append('\'');
                case '?' -> sb.append('?');
                case 'x' -> {
                    int hexStart = i + 1;
                    int hexEnd = Math.min(inner.length(), hexStart + 2);
                    int parsed = 0;
                    int digits = 0;
                    while (hexStart + digits < hexEnd) {
                        int d = Character.digit(inner.charAt(hexStart + digits), 16);
                        if (d < 0) {
                            break;
                        }
                        parsed = (parsed << 4) | d;
                        digits++;
                    }
                    if (digits > 0) {
                        sb.append((char) parsed);
                        i += digits;
                    } else {
                        sb.append('x');
                    }
                }
                default -> {
                    if (next >= '0' && next <= '7') {
                        int oct = next - '0';
                        int count = 1;
                        while (count < 3 && i + 1 < inner.length()) {
                            char oc = inner.charAt(i + 1);
                            if (oc < '0' || oc > '7') {
                                break;
                            }
                            oct = (oct << 3) | (oc - '0');
                            i++;
                            count++;
                        }
                        sb.append((char) oct);
                    } else {
                        sb.append(next);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private static boolean hasMemorySymbolOrRef(Program program, Address insnAddr, Address targetAddr) {
        if (insnAddr != null) {
            for (Reference ref : program.getReferenceManager().getReferencesFrom(insnAddr)) {
                if (targetAddr.equals(ref.getToAddress())) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        Symbol primary = program.getSymbolTable().getPrimarySymbol(targetAddr);
        return primary != null && program.getMemory().contains(targetAddr);
    }

    private static String extractStringPreview(Data data) {
        StringDataInstance sdi = StringDataInstance.getStringDataInstance(data);
        if (sdi == null || sdi == StringDataInstance.NULL_INSTANCE) {
            return null;
        }
        String repr = sdi.getStringRepresentation();
        if (repr == null) {
            String val = sdi.getStringValue();
            repr = val != null ? "\"" + val + "\"" : null;
        }
        return repr != null ? truncateString(repr, STRING_PREVIEW_MAX_CHARS) : null;
    }

    private static boolean isQuotedStringLiteral(String text) {
        if (text.length() < 2) {
            return false;
        }
        return text.startsWith("\"")
                || text.startsWith("L\"")
                || text.startsWith("u\"")
                || text.startsWith("U\"")
                || text.startsWith("u8\"");
    }

    private static String truncateString(String s, int maxLen) {
        if (s.length() <= maxLen) {
            return s;
        }
        return s.substring(0, Math.max(0, maxLen - 3)) + "...";
    }

    private static boolean isImportFunction(Function fn) {
        if (fn.isExternal()) {
            return true;
        }
        Program prog = fn.getProgram();
        if (prog != null && fn.getEntryPoint() != null) {
            var block = prog.getMemory().getBlock(fn.getEntryPoint());
            if (block != null && block.getName() != null) {
                String bName = block.getName();
                if ("EXTERNAL".equalsIgnoreCase(bName) || bName.startsWith(".plt")) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        if (fn.isThunk()) {
            Function thunked = fn.getThunkedFunction(true);
            if (thunked != null) {
                if (thunked.isExternal()) {
                    return true;
                }
                if (prog != null && thunked.getEntryPoint() != null) {
                    var tBlock = prog.getMemory().getBlock(thunked.getEntryPoint());
                    if (tBlock != null && "EXTERNAL".equalsIgnoreCase(tBlock.getName())) {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static Address resolveTokenInstructionAddress(Program program, Listing listing, ClangToken tok) {
        Address min = tok.getMinAddress();
        if (min != null) {
            return normalizeInstructionAddr(program, listing, min);
        }
        Address closest = DecompilerUtils.getClosestAddress(program, tok);
        return normalizeInstructionAddr(program, listing, closest);
    }

    private static Address resolveSiblingInstructionAddress(Program program, Listing listing, ClangLabelToken labelTok) {
        ClangNode parent = labelTok.Parent();
        if (parent != null) {
            for (int i = 0; i < parent.numChildren(); i++) {
                ClangNode child = parent.Child(i);
                if (child != labelTok && !(child instanceof ClangLabelToken) && child instanceof ClangToken sibling) {
                    Address siblingAddr = normalizeInstructionAddr(program, listing, sibling.getMinAddress());
                    if (siblingAddr != null) {
                        return siblingAddr;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static Address normalizeInstructionAddr(Program program, Listing listing, Address rawAddr) {
        if (rawAddr == null || !rawAddr.isMemoryAddress()) {
            return null;
        }
        Instruction insn = listing.getInstructionContaining(rawAddr);
        if (insn != null) {
            return insn.getAddress();
        }
        return program.getMemory().contains(rawAddr) ? rawAddr : null;
    }

    private static void recordDataType(DataType dt, Set<String> usedTypes) {
        DataType cur = dt;
        int guard = 0;
        while (cur != null && guard < 16) {
            guard++;
            String name = cur.getName();
            if (name != null && !name.isBlank()) {
                usedTypes.add(name);
            }
            if (cur instanceof Pointer ptr) {
                cur = ptr.getDataType();
            } else if (cur instanceof Array arr) {
                cur = arr.getDataType();
            } else if (cur instanceof TypeDef td) {
                cur = td.getBaseDataType();
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Single-pass O(L) brace matcher producing collapsible control-flow blocks.
     */
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private static List<Map<String, Object>> extractFolds(
            List<Map<String, Object>> lines,
            List<String> plainLines) {
        int lineCount = lines.size();
        if (lineCount == 0) {
            return Collections.emptyList();
        }

        record HeaderInfo(int lineNum, String kind, String branchAddr, String summary) {
        }
        record OpenBrace(int slotIndex, boolean emittable, HeaderInfo header) {
        }

        List<Map<String, Object>> orderedSlots = new ArrayList<>();
        Deque<OpenBrace> stack = new ArrayDeque<>();
        HeaderInfo pendingHeader = null;

        for (int i = 0; i < lineCount; i++) {
            Map<String, Object> lineObj = lines.get(i);
            int lineNum = (Integer) lineObj.get("line");
            String plainLine = plainLines.get(i);
            List<Map<String, Object>> tokens = (List<Map<String, Object>>) lineObj.get("tokens");

            // Track control-flow keyword appearing before/after braces on this line.
            String preBraceKind = null;
            String preBraceAddr = null;
            String postBraceKind = null;
            String postBraceAddr = null;
            boolean sawCloseBrace = false;
            boolean sawOpenBrace = false;
            boolean sawSemicolonAfterHeader = false;

            for (Map<String, Object> tok : tokens) {
                String k = (String) tok.get("k");
                String t = (String) tok.get("t");
                if (k == null || t == null || "comment".equals(k) || "string_ref".equals(k) || "ws".equals(k)) {
                    continue;
                }

                if ("keyword".equals(k) && FOLD_KEYWORDS.contains(t)) {
                    String kwAddr = tok.get("addr") != null
                            ? (String) tok.get("addr")
                            : (String) lineObj.get("addr");
                    if (!sawCloseBrace && !sawOpenBrace) {
                        if (preBraceKind == null || "else".equals(preBraceKind)) {
                            preBraceKind = t;
                            preBraceAddr = kwAddr;
                        }
                    } else {
                        if (postBraceKind == null || "else".equals(postBraceKind)) {
                            postBraceKind = t;
                            postBraceAddr = kwAddr;
                        }
                    }
                    sawSemicolonAfterHeader = false;
                    continue;
                }

                if ("syntax".equals(k)) {
                    for (int c = 0; c < t.length(); c++) {
                        char ch = t.charAt(c);
                        if (ch == '}') {
                            sawCloseBrace = true;
                            if (!stack.isEmpty()) {
                                OpenBrace popped = stack.pop();
                                if (popped.emittable() && popped.header() != null
                                        && lineNum > popped.header().lineNum()) {
                                    HeaderInfo h = popped.header();
                                    Map<String, Object> fold = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                                    fold.put("id", "f_" + h.lineNum());
                                    fold.put("kind", h.kind());
                                    fold.put("startLine", h.lineNum());
                                    fold.put("endLine", lineNum);
                                    fold.put("branchAddr", h.branchAddr());
                                    fold.put("summary", h.summary());
                                    orderedSlots.set(popped.slotIndex(), fold);
                                }
                            }
                            pendingHeader = null;
                        } else if (ch == '{') {
                            sawOpenBrace = true;
                            String activeKind = sawCloseBrace ? postBraceKind : preBraceKind;
                            String activeAddr = sawCloseBrace ? postBraceAddr : preBraceAddr;

                            HeaderInfo header = null;
                            if (activeKind != null) {
                                header = new HeaderInfo(
                                        lineNum,
                                        activeKind,
                                        activeAddr,
                                        buildFoldSummary(plainLine, sawCloseBrace));
                            } else if (!sawCloseBrace && pendingHeader != null && !stack.isEmpty()) {
                                header = pendingHeader;
                            }

                            pendingHeader = null;

                            // Skip outer function braces (empty stack and not a control-flow keyword).
                            boolean emittable = !stack.isEmpty() && header != null;
                            int slotIdx = -1;
                            if (emittable) {
                                slotIdx = orderedSlots.size();
                                orderedSlots.add(null);
                            }
                            stack.push(new OpenBrace(slotIdx, emittable, header));
                        } else if (ch == ';') {
                            sawSemicolonAfterHeader = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (!sawOpenBrace) {
                String tailKind = sawCloseBrace ? postBraceKind : preBraceKind;
                String tailAddr = sawCloseBrace ? postBraceAddr : preBraceAddr;
                if (tailKind != null && !sawSemicolonAfterHeader) {
                    pendingHeader = new HeaderInfo(
                            lineNum,
                            tailKind,
                            tailAddr,
                            buildFoldSummary(plainLine, sawCloseBrace));
                } else if (sawSemicolonAfterHeader) {
                    pendingHeader = null;
                }
            }
        }

        List<Map<String, Object>> folds = new ArrayList<>(orderedSlots.size());
        for (Map<String, Object> slot : orderedSlots) {
            if (slot != null) {
                folds.add(slot);
            }
        }
        return folds;
    }

    private static String buildFoldSummary(String plainLine, boolean afterCloseBrace) {
        String s = plainLine.trim();
        if (afterCloseBrace && s.startsWith("}")) {
            s = s.substring(1).trim();
        }
        if (s.endsWith("{")) {
            s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 1).trim();
        }
        if (s.length() > FOLD_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS) {
            s = s.substring(0, FOLD_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS - 3) + "...";
        }
        return s;
    }
}

```java
package com.antigravity.ghidrare;

import ghidra.GhidraApplicationLayout;
import ghidra.GhidraClassLoader;
import ghidra.GhidraLaunchable;

import java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException;
import java.lang.reflect.Method;
import java.net.URI;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;

/**
 * Bootstrap entrypoint loaded from daemon-boot.jar on the AppClassLoader classpath.
 * Keeps zero direct imports from Ghidra feature modules or Gson so GhidraClassLoader
 * can load daemon.jar alongside all Ghidra module JARs.
 */
public class DaemonMain implements GhidraLaunchable {

    public DaemonMain() {
    }

    @Override
    public void launch(GhidraApplicationLayout layout, String[] args) throws Exception {
        URI locationUri = DaemonMain.class.getProtectionDomain().getCodeSource().getLocation().toURI();
        Path codePath = Path.of(locationUri);
        Path parentDir = Files.isRegularFile(codePath) ? codePath.getParent() : codePath;
        Path daemonJar = parentDir.resolve("daemon.jar");

        ClassLoader systemLoader = ClassLoader.getSystemClassLoader();
        if (Files.isRegularFile(daemonJar)) {
            if (!(systemLoader instanceof GhidraClassLoader ghidraLoader)) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Expected GhidraClassLoader as system class loader, got: " + systemLoader);
            }
            ghidraLoader.addPath(daemonJar.toAbsolutePath().toString());
        }

        Class<?> runtimeClass = Class.forName("com.antigravity.ghidrare.DaemonRuntime", true, systemLoader);
        Method startMethod = runtimeClass.getMethod("start", GhidraApplicationLayout.class, String[].class);
        try {
            startMethod.invoke(null, layout, args);
        } catch (InvocationTargetException ex) {
            Throwable cause = ex.getCause();
            if (cause instanceof Exception exception) {
                throw exception;
            }
            if (cause instanceof Error error) {
                throw error;
            }
            throw ex;
        }
    }
}

package com.antigravity.ghidrare;

import com.google.gson.Gson;
import com.google.gson.GsonBuilder;

import ghidra.GhidraApplicationLayout;
import ghidra.framework.Application;
import ghidra.framework.HeadlessGhidraApplicationConfiguration;
import ghidra.program.model.address.Address;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.Function;

import java.io.BufferedReader;

import java.nio.file.attribute.PosixFilePermissions;
import java.security.MessageDigest;

import java.util.ArrayList;

import java.util.HexFormat;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;

import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

/**
 * Headless Ghidra HTTP daemon runtime bound to loopback 127.0.0.1 with
 * Bearer auth, Origin defense, atomic 0600 discovery file, and lifecycle timers.
 */
public final class DaemonRuntime {

    private static final int MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES = 1024 * 1024;
    private static final Pattern ETAG_REV_PATTERN = Pattern.compile(":r:(\\d+):");
    private static final Type BATCH_OPS_TYPE = new TypeToken<List<Map<String, Object>>>() {}.getType();
    private static final Gson GSON = new GsonBuilder()
            .disableHtmlEscaping()
            .serializeNulls()
            .create();

    private final Path dataDir;
    private final Path daemonJsonPath;
    private final TierConfig tierConfig;
    private final EventBus eventBus;
    private final ProjectManager projectManager;
    private final DecompilerPool decompilerPool;
    private final InspectionService inspectionService;
    private final MutationService mutationService;
    private final byte[] bearerTokenBytes;
    private final long startedAt;
    private final HttpServer server;
    private final ScheduledExecutorService maintenanceExecutor;
    private final CountDownLatch shutdownLatch = new CountDownLatch(1);
    private final AtomicBoolean shuttingDown = new AtomicBoolean(false);
    private final AtomicLong lastActivityMs = new AtomicLong(System.currentTimeMillis());
    private final AtomicLong batchJobSeq = new AtomicLong(0L);
    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, BatchJobState> batchJobsByBinary = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, BatchJobState> batchJobsById = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    private DaemonRuntime(
            Path dataDir,
            TierConfig tierConfig,
            EventBus eventBus,
            ProjectManager projectManager,
            DecompilerPool decompilerPool,
            InspectionService inspectionService,
            MutationService mutationService,
            String bearerToken,
            HttpServer server) {
        this.dataDir = dataDir;
        this.daemonJsonPath = dataDir.resolve("daemon.json");
        this.tierConfig = tierConfig;
        this.eventBus = eventBus;
        this.projectManager = projectManager;
        this.decompilerPool = decompilerPool;
        this.inspectionService = inspectionService;
        this.mutationService = mutationService;
        this.bearerTokenBytes = bearerToken.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        this.startedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        this.server = server;
        this.maintenanceExecutor = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(r -> {
            Thread t = new Thread(r, "ghidra-re-maintenance");
            t.setDaemon(true);
            return t;
        });
    }

    public static void start(GhidraApplicationLayout layout, String[] args) throws Exception {
        if (!Application.isInitialized()) {
            HeadlessGhidraApplicationConfiguration appConfig = new HeadlessGhidraApplicationConfiguration();
            Application.initializeApplication(layout, appConfig);
        }

        ParsedArgs parsed = parseArgs(args);
        ensureSecureDir(parsed.dataDir);

        TierConfig tierConfig = TierConfig.resolve(
                parsed.tier, parsed.ramLimitMb, parsed.idleTimeoutMin);

        byte[] tokenRaw = new byte[32];
        new SecureRandom().nextBytes(tokenRaw);
        String bearerToken = HexFormat.of().formatHex(tokenRaw);

        EventBus eventBus = new EventBus(parsed.dataDir);
        ProjectManager projectManager = new ProjectManager(parsed.dataDir, tierConfig, eventBus);
        DecompilerPool decompilerPool = new DecompilerPool(tierConfig);
        InspectionService inspectionService = new InspectionService(
                tierConfig, projectManager::getLoadedBinaries);
        MutationService mutationService = new MutationService(
                decompilerPool, inspectionService, eventBus);

        HttpServer server = HttpServer.create(
                new InetSocketAddress(InetAddress.getLoopbackAddress(), 0), 64);
        server.setExecutor(Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor());

        DaemonRuntime runtime = new DaemonRuntime(
                parsed.dataDir, tierConfig, eventBus, projectManager,
                decompilerPool, inspectionService, mutationService, bearerToken, server);

        projectManager.setLifecycleHooks(
                binaryId -> {
                    runtime.cancelBatchJobForBinary(binaryId);
                    decompilerPool.unbindBinary(binaryId);
                    inspectionService.invalidateCfgForBinary(binaryId);
                },
                () -> {
                    runtime.cancelAllBatchJobs();
                    decompilerPool.shutdown();
                });

        eventBus.publish(
                "daemon_tier_changed",
                "daemon",
                null,
                0L,
                Map.of(
                        "tier", tierConfig.getTier(),
                        "ramLimitMb", tierConfig.getRamLimitMb(),
                        "workers", tierConfig.getWorkers()));

        server.createContext("/", runtime::handleExchange);
        server.start();

        int port = server.getAddress().getPort();
        runtime.writeDiscoveryFile(port, bearerToken);
        runtime.startMaintenanceLoop();

        Thread shutdownHook = new Thread(() -> runtime.performShutdown("jvm_shutdown_hook", false), "ghidra-re-shutdown");
        Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(shutdownHook);

        runtime.shutdownLatch.await();
    }

    private void startMaintenanceLoop() {
        maintenanceExecutor.scheduleAtFixedRate(() -> {
            if (shuttingDown.get()) {
                return;
            }
            try {
                projectManager.checkpointDirtyBinaries();
                projectManager.evictIdleBinaries(tierConfig.getIdleTimeoutMin());

                int activeJobs = projectManager.getActiveJobCount();
                List<String> loaded = projectManager.getLoadedBinaryIds();
                long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
                if (activeJobs > 0 || !loaded.isEmpty()) {
                    lastActivityMs.set(now);
                } else if (tierConfig.getIdleTimeoutMin() > 0
                        && (now - lastActivityMs.get()) >= 30_000L) {
                    Thread.startVirtualThread(() -> {
                        performShutdown("idle_grace_30s", false);
                        System.exit(0);
                    });
                }
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                System.err.println("[ghidra-re] Maintenance tick error: " + ex.getMessage());
            }
        }, 5L, 5L, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
    }

    private void writeDiscoveryFile(int port, String token) throws IOException {
        Map<String, Object> discovery = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        discovery.put("pid", ProcessHandle.current().pid());
        discovery.put("host", "127.0.0.1");
        discovery.put("port", port);
        discovery.put("token", token);
        discovery.put("dataDir", dataDir.toString());
        discovery.put("tier", tierConfig.getTier());
        discovery.put("ramLimitMb", tierConfig.getRamLimitMb());
        discovery.put("startedAt", startedAt);
        discovery.put("ghidraVersion", Application.getApplicationVersion());

        Path tmp = dataDir.resolve("daemon.json.tmp");
        Files.deleteIfExists(tmp);

        Set<PosixFilePermission> mode0600 = PosixFilePermissions.fromString("rw-------");
        byte[] bytes = (GSON.toJson(discovery) + "\n").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

        try (FileChannel channel = FileChannel.open(
                tmp,
                EnumSet.of(StandardOpenOption.CREATE, StandardOpenOption.WRITE, StandardOpenOption.TRUNCATE_EXISTING),
                PosixFilePermissions.asFileAttribute(mode0600))) {
            ByteBuffer buf = ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes);
            while (buf.hasRemaining()) {
                channel.write(buf);
            }
            channel.force(true);
        }
        Files.setPosixFilePermissions(tmp, mode0600);
        Files.move(tmp, daemonJsonPath, StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
    }

    private void handleExchange(HttpExchange exchange) {
        try {
            Headers reqHeaders = exchange.getRequestHeaders();
            if (reqHeaders.containsKey("Origin")) {
                throw new ApiException(403, "ORIGIN_FORBIDDEN", "Browser Origin header is forbidden");
            }

            if (!isAuthorized(reqHeaders.getFirst("Authorization"))) {
                throw new ApiException(401, "UNAUTHORIZED", "Missing or invalid Bearer token");
            }
            lastActivityMs.set(System.currentTimeMillis());

            String method = exchange.getRequestMethod().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
            String rawPath = exchange.getRequestURI().getRawPath();
            String path = rawPath != null ? rawPath : "/";
            String rawQuery = exchange.getRequestURI().getRawQuery();
            Map<String, String> query = parseQuery(rawQuery);
            String actor = headerOrDefault(reqHeaders, "X-RE-Actor", "agent");
            DecompilerPool.Priority priority = DecompilerPool.parsePriority(reqHeaders.getFirst("X-RE-Priority"));

            if ("/v1/health".equals(path)) {
                requireMethod(method, "GET");
                handleHealth(exchange);
                return;
            }
            if ("/v1/shutdown".equals(path)) {
                requireMethod(method, "POST");
                handleShutdown(exchange);
                return;
            }
            if ("/v1/binaries".equals(path)) {
                requireMethod(method, "GET");
                handleListBinaries(exchange);
