```java
                return;
            }
            if ("/v1/binaries/open".equals(path)) {
                requireMethod(method, "POST");
                handleOpenBinary(exchange, actor);
                return;
            }
            if ("/v1/events/wait".equals(path)) {
                requireMethod(method, "GET");
                handleWaitEvents(exchange, query);
                return;
            }

            if (path.startsWith("/v1/binaries/")) {
                String rest = path.substring("/v1/binaries/".length());
                int slash = rest.indexOf('/');
                if (slash > 0) {
                    String binaryId = percentDecode(rest.substring(0, slash));
                    String subPath = rest.substring(slash);
                    if (handleBinaryRoute(exchange, reqHeaders, method, path, rawQuery, query, actor, priority, binaryId, subPath)) {
                        return;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (path.startsWith("/v1/jobs/")) {
                String rest = path.substring("/v1/jobs/".length());
                if (rest.endsWith("/cancel")) {
                    requireMethod(method, "POST");
                    String jobId = percentDecode(rest.substring(0, rest.length() - "/cancel".length()));
                    BatchJobState batchJob = batchJobsById.get(jobId);
                    if (batchJob != null) {
                        batchJob.cancel();
                        sendJson(exchange, 200, batchJob.toStatusMap(0, false), null);
                        return;
                    }
                    Map<String, Object> result = projectManager.cancelJob(jobId);
                    sendJson(exchange, 200, result, null);
                    return;
                } else if (!rest.isEmpty() && !rest.contains("/")) {
                    requireMethod(method, "GET");
                    String jobId = percentDecode(rest);
                    BatchJobState batchJob = batchJobsById.get(jobId);
                    if (batchJob != null) {
                        int sinceCursor = (int) parseLongParam(query.get("sinceCursor"), 0L);
                        boolean includeItems = parseBooleanParam(query.get("includeItems"), false);
                        sendJson(exchange, 200, batchJob.toStatusMap(sinceCursor, includeItems), null);
                        return;
                    }
                    Map<String, Object> result = projectManager.getJobStatus(jobId);
                    sendJson(exchange, 200, result, null);
                    return;
                }
            }

            throw new ApiException(404, "NOT_FOUND", "Unknown endpoint: " + method + " " + path);
        } catch (ApiException ex) {
            sendError(exchange, ex);
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            ApiException wrapped = new ApiException(
                    500,
                    "INTERNAL_ERROR",
                    ex.getMessage() != null ? ex.getMessage() : ex.getClass().getSimpleName(),
                    false,
                    Collections.emptyMap(),
                    ex);
            sendError(exchange, wrapped);
        } finally {
            exchange.close();
        }
    }

    private void handleHealth(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        TierConfig.RssSnapshot rss = TierConfig.readRssSnapshot();
        int activeJobs = projectManager.getActiveJobCount();
        List<String> loadedIds = projectManager.getLoadedBinaryIds();
        String state = shuttingDown.get()
                ? "stopping"
                : (activeJobs > 0 ? "analyzing" : (!loadedIds.isEmpty() ? "active" : "ready"));

        Map<String, Object> poolStats = decompilerPool.getWorkerStats();
        int totalInitialized = 0;
        int idleCount = 0;
        int busyCount = 0;
        Object workersListObj = poolStats.get("workers");
        if (workersListObj instanceof List<?> list) {
            for (Object item : list) {
                if (item instanceof Map<?, ?> w) {
                    Object wState = w.get("state");
                    if ("idle".equals(wState)) {
                        totalInitialized++;
                        idleCount++;
                    } else if ("busy".equals(wState)) {
                        totalInitialized++;
                        busyCount++;
                    } else if ("pending_recycle".equals(wState)) {
                        totalInitialized++;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Map<String, Object> workers = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        workers.put("total", totalInitialized);
        workers.put("idle", idleCount);
        workers.put("busy", busyCount);
        workers.put("uiReserved", tierConfig.getWorkers() >= 2 ? 1 : 0);
        workers.put("configured", tierConfig.getWorkers());
        workers.put("queues", poolStats.get("queues"));
        workers.put("workers", workersListObj != null ? workersListObj : Collections.emptyList());

        Map<String, Object> body = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        body.put("status", "ok");
        body.put("state", state);
        body.put("pid", rss.jvmPid());
        body.put("uptimeMs", System.currentTimeMillis() - startedAt);
        body.put("startedAt", startedAt);
        body.put("ghidraVersion", Application.getApplicationVersion());
        body.put("tier", tierConfig.getTier());
        body.put("ramLimitMb", tierConfig.getRamLimitMb());
        body.put("tierSpec", tierConfig.toMap());
        body.put("jvmRssMb", rss.jvmRssMb());
        body.put("decompilerRssMb", rss.decompilerRssMb());
        body.put("decompilerPids", rss.decompilerPids());
        body.put("totalDaemonRssMb", rss.totalDaemonRssMb());
        body.put("workersConfigured", tierConfig.getWorkers());
        body.put("workers", workers);
        body.put("activeJobs", activeJobs);
        body.put("loadedBinaries", loadedIds);
        body.put("latestSeq", eventBus.getLatestSeq());
        sendJson(exchange, 200, body, null);
    }

    private boolean handleBinaryRoute(
            HttpExchange exchange,
            Headers reqHeaders,
            String method,
            String path,
            String rawQuery,
            Map<String, String> query,
            String actor,
            DecompilerPool.Priority priority,
            String binaryId,
            String subPath) throws IOException {
        switch (subPath) {
            case "/unload" -> {
                requireMethod(method, "POST");
                Map<String, Object> result = projectManager.unloadBinary(binaryId, actor);
                sendJson(exchange, 200, result, null);
                return true;
            }
            case "/save" -> {
                requireMethod(method, "POST");
                JsonObject body = readOptionalJsonBody(exchange);
                String reason = getString(body, "reason", "manual");
                Map<String, Object> result = projectManager.saveBinary(binaryId, reason);
                sendJson(exchange, 200, result, null);
                return true;
            }
            case "/focus" -> {
                requireMethod(method, "POST");
                handleFocus(exchange, binaryId, actor);
                return true;
            }
            case "/export-index" -> {
                requireMethod(method, "GET");
                LoadedBinary lb = projectManager.resolveLoadedBinary(binaryId);
                long sinceRevision = parseLongParam(query.get("sinceRevision"), 0L);
                Headers respHeaders = exchange.getResponseHeaders();
                LazyNdjsonStream lazyOut = new LazyNdjsonStream(exchange, respHeaders, lb.getRevision());
                boolean succeeded = false;
                try {
                    IndexExporter.exportNdjson(lb, sinceRevision, lazyOut);
                    lazyOut.commitIfNeeded();
                    succeeded = true;
                } finally {
                    if (succeeded || lazyOut.isCommitted()) {
                        lazyOut.closeDelegate();
                    }
                }
                return true;
            }
            case "/resolve" -> {
                requireMethod(method, "GET");
                LoadedBinary lb = projectManager.resolveLoadedBinary(binaryId);
                String etag = computeBinaryReadEtag(lb, path, rawQuery);
                if (sendNotModifiedIfMatched(exchange, reqHeaders, etag, lb.getRevision())) {
                    return true;
                }
                Map<String, Object> result = inspectionService.resolveTarget(lb, query.get("q"));
                sendBinaryJson(exchange, 200, result, lb.getRevision(), etag);
                return true;
            }
            case "/functions" -> {
                requireMethod(method, "GET");
                LoadedBinary lb = projectManager.resolveLoadedBinary(binaryId);
                String etag = computeBinaryReadEtag(lb, path, rawQuery);
                if (sendNotModifiedIfMatched(exchange, reqHeaders, etag, lb.getRevision())) {
                    return true;
                }
                String q = query.get("q");
                String kind = query.getOrDefault("kind", "all");
                String sort = query.getOrDefault("sort", "addr");
                int limit = (int) parseLongParam(query.get("limit"), 50L);
                String cursor = query.get("cursor");
                Map<String, Object> result = inspectionService.listFunctions(lb, q, kind, sort, limit, cursor);
                sendBinaryJson(exchange, 200, result, lb.getRevision(), etag);
                return true;
            }
            case "/disasm" -> {
                requireMethod(method, "GET");
                LoadedBinary lb = projectManager.resolveLoadedBinary(binaryId);
                String etag = computeBinaryReadEtag(lb, path, rawQuery);
                if (sendNotModifiedIfMatched(exchange, reqHeaders, etag, lb.getRevision())) {
                    return true;
                }
                String addr = query.get("addr");
                int before = (int) parseLongParam(query.get("before"), 20L);
                int after = (int) parseLongParam(query.get("after"), 80L);
                boolean includeBytes = parseBooleanParam(query.get("includeBytes"), true);
                Map<String, Object> result = inspectionService.disassemble(lb, addr, before, after, includeBytes);
                sendBinaryJson(exchange, 200, result, lb.getRevision(), etag);
                return true;
            }
            case "/xrefs" -> {
                requireMethod(method, "GET");
                LoadedBinary lb = projectManager.resolveLoadedBinary(binaryId);
                String etag = computeBinaryReadEtag(lb, path, rawQuery);
                if (sendNotModifiedIfMatched(exchange, reqHeaders, etag, lb.getRevision())) {
                    return true;
                }
                String addr = query.get("addr");
                String direction = query.getOrDefault("direction", "to");
                Set<String> types = parseCommaSet(query.get("types"));
                int limit = (int) parseLongParam(query.get("limit"), 50L);
                String cursor = query.get("cursor");
                Map<String, Object> result = inspectionService.getXrefs(lb, addr, direction, types, limit, cursor);
                sendBinaryJson(exchange, 200, result, lb.getRevision(), etag);
                return true;
            }
            case "/data" -> {
                requireMethod(method, "GET");
                LoadedBinary lb = projectManager.resolveLoadedBinary(binaryId);
                String etag = computeBinaryReadEtag(lb, path, rawQuery);
                if (sendNotModifiedIfMatched(exchange, reqHeaders, etag, lb.getRevision())) {
                    return true;
                }
                String addr = query.get("addr");
                int length = (int) parseLongParam(query.get("length"), 128L);
                boolean detectPointers = parseBooleanParam(query.get("detectPointers"), true);
                Map<String, Object> result = inspectionService.inspectData(lb, addr, length, detectPointers);
                sendBinaryJson(exchange, 200, result, lb.getRevision(), etag);
                return true;
            }
            case "/mutate/rename" -> {
                requireMethod(method, "POST");
                LoadedBinary lb = projectManager.resolveLoadedBinary(binaryId);
                JsonObject body = readRequiredJsonBody(exchange);
                Long expectedRev = extractExpectedRevision(body, reqHeaders.getFirst("If-Match"));
                Map<String, Object> result = mutationService.rename(
                        lb,
                        getString(body, "targetKind", null),
                        getString(body, "address", null),
                        getString(body, "functionAddress", null),
                        getString(body, "oldName", null),
                        getString(body, "newName", null),
                        expectedRev,
                        actor);
                sendBinaryJson(exchange, 200, result, revisionFromResult(result, lb), null);
                return true;
            }
            case "/mutate/retype" -> {
                requireMethod(method, "POST");
                LoadedBinary lb = projectManager.resolveLoadedBinary(binaryId);
                JsonObject body = readRequiredJsonBody(exchange);
                Long expectedRev = extractExpectedRevision(body, reqHeaders.getFirst("If-Match"));
                Map<String, Object> result = mutationService.retype(
                        lb,
                        getString(body, "targetKind", null),
                        getString(body, "address", null),
                        getString(body, "functionAddress", null),
                        getString(body, "varName", null),
                        getString(body, "declaration", null),
                        expectedRev,
                        actor);
                sendBinaryJson(exchange, 200, result, revisionFromResult(result, lb), null);
                return true;
            }
            case "/mutate/comment" -> {
                requireMethod(method, "POST");
                LoadedBinary lb = projectManager.resolveLoadedBinary(binaryId);
                JsonObject body = readRequiredJsonBody(exchange);
                Long expectedRev = extractExpectedRevision(body, reqHeaders.getFirst("If-Match"));
                Map<String, Object> result = mutationService.setComment(
                        lb,
                        getString(body, "address", null),
                        getString(body, "kind", "EOL"),
                        getString(body, "text", null),
                        expectedRev,
                        actor);
                sendBinaryJson(exchange, 200, result, revisionFromResult(result, lb), null);
                return true;
            }
            case "/mutate/batch" -> {
                requireMethod(method, "POST");
                LoadedBinary lb = projectManager.resolveLoadedBinary(binaryId);
                JsonObject body = readRequiredJsonBody(exchange);
                Long expectedRev = extractExpectedRevision(body, reqHeaders.getFirst("If-Match"));
                if (!body.has("ops") || !body.get("ops").isJsonArray()) {
                    throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Field 'ops' must be a JSON array");
                }
                JsonArray opsArray = body.getAsJsonArray("ops");
                List<Map<String, Object>> ops = GSON.fromJson(opsArray, BATCH_OPS_TYPE);
                Map<String, Object> result = mutationService.batch(lb, ops, expectedRev, actor);
                sendBinaryJson(exchange, 200, result, revisionFromResult(result, lb), null);
                return true;
            }
            case "/batch-decompile" -> {
                requireMethod(method, "POST");
                handleBatchDecompile(exchange, binaryId, actor);
                return true;
            }
            default -> {
                if (subPath.startsWith("/functions/")) {
                    String fnRest = subPath.substring("/functions/".length());
                    int fnSlash = fnRest.indexOf('/');
                    if (fnSlash > 0) {
                        String addrTarget = percentDecode(fnRest.substring(0, fnSlash));
                        String fnAction = fnRest.substring(fnSlash);
                        switch (fnAction) {
                            case "/decompile" -> {
                                requireMethod(method, "GET");
                                LoadedBinary lb = projectManager.resolveLoadedBinary(binaryId);
                                boolean refresh = parseBooleanParam(query.get("refresh"), false);
                                String etag = computeBinaryReadEtag(lb, path, rawQuery);
                                if (!refresh && sendNotModifiedIfMatched(exchange, reqHeaders, etag, lb.getRevision())) {
                                    return true;
                                }
                                String format = query.getOrDefault("format", "tokens")
                                        .trim()
                                        .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
                                if (!"tokens".equals(format) && !"text".equals(format)) {
                                    throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS",
                                            "Invalid decompile format: " + format);
                                }
                                int startLine = (int) parseLongParam(query.get("startLine"), 1L);
                                int maxLines = (int) parseLongParam(query.get("maxLines"), 400L);
                                boolean includeGutter = parseBooleanParam(query.get("includeGutter"), true);
                                boolean includePlainText = parseBooleanParam(query.get("includePlainText"), false);
                                String rawTimeout = query.get("timeoutSec");
                                Integer timeoutSecOverride = (rawTimeout != null && !rawTimeout.isBlank())
                                        ? (int) parseLongParam(rawTimeout, tierConfig.getDecompileTimeoutSec())
                                        : null;

                                Function fn = inspectionService.resolveFunction(lb, addrTarget);
                                DecompilerPool.DecompileOutcome outcome = decompilerPool.decompile(
                                        lb, fn, priority, refresh, timeoutSecOverride);
                                long artRev = outcome.artifact().getRevision();
                                Map<String, Object> result = "text".equals(format)
                                        ? outcome.artifact().toTextResponse(
                                                lb.getBinaryId(), artRev, outcome.cached(),
                                                outcome.decompileMs(), startLine, maxLines, includeGutter)
                                        : outcome.artifact().toTokensResponse(
                                                lb.getBinaryId(), artRev, outcome.cached(),
                                                outcome.decompileMs(), startLine, maxLines, includePlainText);
                                sendBinaryJson(exchange, 200, result, artRev, etag);
                                return true;
                            }
                            case "/cfg" -> {
                                requireMethod(method, "GET");
                                LoadedBinary lb = projectManager.resolveLoadedBinary(binaryId);
                                String etag = computeBinaryReadEtag(lb, path, rawQuery);
                                if (sendNotModifiedIfMatched(exchange, reqHeaders, etag, lb.getRevision())) {
                                    return true;
                                }
                                String rawMaxBlocks = query.get("maxBlocks");
                                Integer requestedMaxBlocks = (rawMaxBlocks != null && !rawMaxBlocks.isBlank())
                                        ? (int) parseLongParam(rawMaxBlocks, tierConfig.getCfgMaxBlocks())
                                        : null;
                                String focusAddr = query.get("focusAddr");
                                boolean includeInsns = parseBooleanParam(query.get("includeInsns"), true);
                                Map<String, Object> result = inspectionService.getCfg(
                                        lb, addrTarget, requestedMaxBlocks, focusAddr, includeInsns);
                                sendBinaryJson(exchange, 200, result, lb.getRevision(), etag);
                                return true;
                            }
                            case "/callgraph" -> {
                                requireMethod(method, "GET");
                                LoadedBinary lb = projectManager.resolveLoadedBinary(binaryId);
                                String etag = computeBinaryReadEtag(lb, path, rawQuery);
                                if (sendNotModifiedIfMatched(exchange, reqHeaders, etag, lb.getRevision())) {
                                    return true;
                                }
                                String direction = query.getOrDefault("direction", "both");
                                int depth = (int) parseLongParam(query.get("depth"), 2L);
                                int maxNodes = (int) parseLongParam(query.get("maxNodes"), 100L);
                                Map<String, Object> result = inspectionService.getCallGraph(
                                        lb, addrTarget, direction, depth, maxNodes);
                                sendBinaryJson(exchange, 200, result, lb.getRevision(), etag);
                                return true;
                            }
                            default -> {
                                return false;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                return false;
            }
        }
    }

    private void handleShutdown(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        JsonObject body = readOptionalJsonBody(exchange);
        String reason = getString(body, "reason", "api_shutdown");
        performShutdown(reason, true);

        Map<String, Object> resp = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        resp.put("status", "stopped");
        resp.put("reason", reason);
        sendJson(exchange, 200, resp, null);

        Thread.startVirtualThread(() -> {
            try {
                Thread.sleep(50L);
            } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            }
            try {
                server.stop(0);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
                // Ignore server stop error on exit.
            }
            shutdownLatch.countDown();
            System.exit(0);
        });
    }

    private void handleListBinaries(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        String etag = projectManager.computeBinariesEtag();
        String ifNoneMatch = exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("If-None-Match");
        if (ifNoneMatch != null && etagMatches(ifNoneMatch, etag)) {
            exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("ETag", etag);
            exchange.sendResponseHeaders(304, -1);
            return;
        }
        Map<String, Object> body = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        body.put("binaries", projectManager.listLoadedBinaries());
        sendJson(exchange, 200, body, Map.of("ETag", etag));
    }

    private void handleOpenBinary(HttpExchange exchange, String actor) throws IOException {
        JsonObject body = readRequiredJsonBody(exchange);
        String path = getString(body, "path", null);
        String sha256 = getString(body, "sha256", null);
        boolean analyze = getBoolean(body, "analyze", true);
        boolean forceReimport = getBoolean(body, "forceReimport", false);
        String analysisProfile = getString(body, "analysisProfile", "default");
        boolean replaceIfFull = getBoolean(body, "replaceIfFull", false);

        Map<String, Object> result = projectManager.openBinary(
                path, sha256, analyze, forceReimport, analysisProfile, replaceIfFull, actor);
        Object statusObj = result.remove("httpStatus");
        int httpStatus = statusObj instanceof Number n ? n.intValue() : 200;
        sendJson(exchange, httpStatus, result, null);
    }

    private void handleFocus(HttpExchange exchange, String binaryId, String actor) throws IOException {
        LoadedBinary lb = projectManager.resolveLoadedBinary(binaryId);
        lb.touchAccess();

        JsonObject body = readRequiredJsonBody(exchange);
        String address = getString(body, "address", null);
        if (address == null || address.isBlank()) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "address is required for focus");
        }
        String symbolName = getString(body, "symbolName", null);
        String viewHint = getString(body, "viewHint", "decompile");

        Map<String, Object> detail = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        detail.put("address", address);
        if (symbolName != null) {
            detail.put("symbolName", symbolName);
        }
        detail.put("viewHint", viewHint);

        EventBus.EventEntry event = eventBus.publish(
                "focus", actor, lb.getBinaryId(), lb.getRevision(), detail);

        Map<String, Object> resp = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        resp.put("status", "ok");
        resp.put("seq", event.seq());
        resp.put("binaryId", lb.getBinaryId());
        resp.put("revision", lb.getRevision());
        sendJson(exchange, 200, resp, null);
    }

    private void handleWaitEvents(HttpExchange exchange, Map<String, String> query) throws IOException {
        long since = parseLongParam(query.get("since"), 0L);
        long timeoutMs = parseLongParam(query.get("timeoutMs"), 15_000L);
        int limit = (int) parseLongParam(query.get("limit"), 50L);

        List<EventBus.EventEntry> events = eventBus.waitEvents(since, timeoutMs, limit);
        List<Map<String, Object>> eventMaps = new ArrayList<>(events.size());
        for (EventBus.EventEntry ev : events) {
            eventMaps.add(ev.toMap());
        }

        Map<String, Object> resp = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        resp.put("events", eventMaps);
        resp.put("latestSeq", eventBus.getLatestSeq());
        resp.put("unchanged", eventMaps.isEmpty());
        sendJson(exchange, 200, resp, null);
    }

    private void handleBatchDecompile(HttpExchange exchange, String binaryId, String actor) throws IOException {
        LoadedBinary lb = projectManager.resolveLoadedBinary(binaryId);
        lb.touchAccess();

        JsonObject body = readOptionalJsonBody(exchange);
        String action = getString(body, "action", "start").trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        int maxFunctions = body != null && body.has("maxFunctions") && body.get("maxFunctions").isJsonPrimitive()
                ? Math.max(1, Math.min(50_000, body.get("maxFunctions").getAsInt()))
                : 10_000;
        int sinceCursor = body != null && body.has("sinceCursor") && body.get("sinceCursor").isJsonPrimitive()
                ? Math.max(0, body.get("sinceCursor").getAsInt())
                : 0;
        boolean includeItems = body == null || !body.has("includeItems") || getBoolean(body, "includeItems", true);

        String resolvedId = lb.getBinaryId();
        BatchJobState existing = batchJobsByBinary.get(resolvedId);

        switch (action) {
            case "status" -> {
                if (existing == null) {
                    Map<String, Object> idle = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    idle.put("binaryId", resolvedId);
                    idle.put("state", "idle");
                    idle.put("percent", 0);
                    idle.put("totalFunctions", 0);
                    idle.put("processedFunctions", 0);
                    idle.put("indexedFunctions", 0);
                    idle.put("skippedFunctions", 0);
                    idle.put("failedFunctions", 0);
                    idle.put("nextCursor", 0);
                    idle.put("items", Collections.emptyList());
                    sendJson(exchange, 200, idle, null);
                    return;
                }
                sendJson(exchange, 200, existing.toStatusMap(sinceCursor, includeItems), null);
            }
            case "pause" -> {
                if (existing == null || !existing.isActive()) {
                    throw new ApiException(404, "JOB_NOT_FOUND", "No active batch decompile job for binary " + resolvedId);
                }
                existing.pause();
                sendJson(exchange, 200, existing.toStatusMap(sinceCursor, includeItems), null);
            }
            case "resume" -> {
                ensureBatchTierAllowed();
                if (existing == null) {
                    BatchJobState started = startNewBatchJob(lb, maxFunctions, actor);
                    sendJson(exchange, 202, started.toStatusMap(sinceCursor, includeItems), null);
                    return;
                }
                existing.resume();
                sendJson(exchange, 200, existing.toStatusMap(sinceCursor, includeItems), null);
            }
            case "cancel" -> {
                if (existing != null) {
                    existing.cancel();
                    sendJson(exchange, 200, existing.toStatusMap(sinceCursor, includeItems), null);
                    return;
                }
                Map<String, Object> cancelled = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                cancelled.put("binaryId", resolvedId);
                cancelled.put("state", "cancelled");
                cancelled.put("percent", 0);
                sendJson(exchange, 200, cancelled, null);
            }
            case "start" -> {
                ensureBatchTierAllowed();
                if (existing != null) {
                    if ("paused".equals(existing.getState())) {
                        existing.resume();
                        sendJson(exchange, 200, existing.toStatusMap(sinceCursor, includeItems), null);
                        return;
                    }
                    if ("running".equals(existing.getState())) {
                        sendJson(exchange, 200, existing.toStatusMap(sinceCursor, includeItems), null);
                        return;
                    }
                }
                BatchJobState started = startNewBatchJob(lb, maxFunctions, actor);
                sendJson(exchange, 202, started.toStatusMap(sinceCursor, includeItems), null);
            }
            default -> throw new ApiException(
                    400,
                    "INVALID_PARAMS",
                    "Invalid batch-decompile action '" + action + "': expected start, pause, resume, cancel, or status");
        }
    }

    private void ensureBatchTierAllowed() {
        if (!tierConfig.isBatchFtsEnabled()) {
            throw new ApiException(
                    409,
                    "BATCH_DECOMPILE_TIER_RESTRICTED",
                    "Background batch decompilation requires Power (6 GB) or Custom (>= 5 GB) RAM tier",
                    false,
                    Map.of(
                            "tier", tierConfig.getTier(),
                            "ramLimitMb", tierConfig.getRamLimitMb(),
                            "batchFtsEnabled", false));
        }
    }

    private BatchJobState startNewBatchJob(LoadedBinary lb, int maxFunctions, String actor) {
        String binaryId = lb.getBinaryId();
        cancelBatchJobForBinary(binaryId);

        List<Function> targets = new ArrayList<>();
        lb.getRwLock().readLock().lock();
        try {
            if (lb.isClosed()) {
                throw new ApiException(404, "BINARY_NOT_LOADED", "Binary is not loaded: " + binaryId);
            }
            Program program = lb.getProgram();
            FunctionManager fm = program.getFunctionManager();
            Memory memory = program.getMemory();
            FunctionIterator it = fm.getFunctions(true);
            while (it.hasNext() && targets.size() < maxFunctions) {
                Function fn = it.next();
                if (fn == null || fn.isExternal() || fn.isThunk()) {
                    continue;
                }
                Address entry = fn.getEntryPoint();
                MemoryBlock block = entry != null ? memory.getBlock(entry) : null;
                String bName = (block != null && block.getName() != null) ? block.getName() : "";
                if ("EXTERNAL".equalsIgnoreCase(bName) || bName.startsWith(".plt")) {
                    continue;
                }
                targets.add(fn);
            }
        } finally {
            lb.getRwLock().readLock().unlock();
        }

        String jobId = "batch-" + batchJobSeq.incrementAndGet() + "-" + binaryId.substring(0, 8);
        BatchJobState job = new BatchJobState(jobId, lb, targets, actor);
        batchJobsByBinary.put(binaryId, job);
        batchJobsById.put(jobId, job);
        job.start();
        return job;
    }

    private void cancelBatchJobForBinary(String binaryId) {
        if (binaryId == null) {
            return;
        }
        BatchJobState job = batchJobsByBinary.remove(binaryId);
        if (job != null) {
            job.cancel();
        }
    }

    private void cancelAllBatchJobs() {
        for (BatchJobState job : batchJobsByBinary.values()) {
            job.cancel();
        }
        batchJobsByBinary.clear();
    }

    private final class BatchJobState {
        private static final String INDEX_STORE_MJS =
                "/home/yulta/.gemini/config/plugins/ghidra-re/shared/index-store.mjs";
        private static final int SQLITE_FLUSH_BATCH_SIZE = 40;

        final String jobId;
        final LoadedBinary lb;
        final String binaryId;
        final List<Function> functions;
        final String actor;
        final long createdAt;
        final AtomicInteger nextIndex = new AtomicInteger(0);
        final AtomicInteger processedCount = new AtomicInteger(0);
        final AtomicInteger indexedCount = new AtomicInteger(0);
        final AtomicInteger skippedCount = new AtomicInteger(0);
        final AtomicInteger failedCount = new AtomicInteger(0);
        final AtomicBoolean paused = new AtomicBoolean(false);
        final AtomicBoolean cancelled = new AtomicBoolean(false);
        volatile String state = "running";
        volatile int percent = 0;
        volatile String currentFunction = "";
        final List<Map<String, Object>> completedItems = Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>());
        final List<Map<String, Object>> pendingSqliteBuffer = new ArrayList<>();
        final Object sqliteFlushLock = new Object();

        BatchJobState(String jobId, LoadedBinary lb, List<Function> functions, String actor) {
            this.jobId = jobId;
            this.lb = lb;
            this.binaryId = lb.getBinaryId();
            this.functions = functions;
            this.actor = actor != null ? actor : "agent";
            this.createdAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        }

        String getState() {
            return state;
        }

        boolean isActive() {
            return "running".equals(state) || "paused".equals(state);
        }

        void pause() {
            if ("running".equals(state)) {
                paused.set(true);
                state = "paused";
                flushPendingSqlite(true);
            }
        }

        void resume() {
            if ("paused".equals(state) && !cancelled.get()) {
                paused.set(false);
                state = "running";
            }
        }

        void cancel() {
            cancelled.set(true);
            paused.set(false);
            if ("running".equals(state) || "paused".equals(state)) {
                state = "cancelled";
            }
            flushPendingSqlite(true);
        }

        void start() {
            if (functions.isEmpty()) {
                percent = 100;
                state = "completed";
                return;
            }

            int concurrency = Math.max(1, decompilerPool.getMaxBgConcurrent());
            AtomicInteger activeWorkers = new AtomicInteger(concurrency);

            Thread.startVirtualThread(() -> {
                ensureSqliteBaseIndexPresent();
                decompilerPool.warmUiWorker(lb);

                for (int w = 0; w < concurrency; w++) {
                    Thread.startVirtualThread(() -> {
                        try {
                            runWorkerLoop();
                        } finally {
                            if (activeWorkers.decrementAndGet() == 0) {
                                flushPendingSqlite(true);
                                if (!cancelled.get() && !"cancelled".equals(state)) {
                                    percent = 100;
                                    currentFunction = "";
                                    state = "completed";
                                    eventBus.publish(
                                            "job_progress",
                                            actor,
                                            binaryId,
                                            lb.getRevision(),
                                            Map.of(
                                                    "jobId", jobId,
                                                    "phase", "batch_decompile_completed",
                                                    "state", "completed",
                                                    "percent", 100,
                                                    "indexedFunctions", indexedCount.get(),
                                                    "totalFunctions", functions.size()));
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }
            });
        }

        private void runWorkerLoop() {
            int total = functions.size();
            while (!cancelled.get() && !shuttingDown.get() && !lb.isClosed()) {
                while (paused.get() && !cancelled.get() && !shuttingDown.get() && !lb.isClosed()) {
                    try {
                        Thread.sleep(40L);
                    } catch (InterruptedException ie) {
                        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                        return;
                    }
                }
                while (decompilerPool.hasHighPriorityWork()
                        && !cancelled.get()
                        && !shuttingDown.get()
                        && !lb.isClosed()) {
                    try {
                        Thread.sleep(25L);
                    } catch (InterruptedException ie) {
                        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                        return;
                    }
                }
                if (cancelled.get() || shuttingDown.get() || lb.isClosed()) {
                    return;
                }

                int idx = nextIndex.getAndIncrement();
                if (idx >= total) {
                    return;
                }

                Function fn = functions.get(idx);
                String fnName = fn.getName();
                currentFunction = fnName;

                boolean doneFn = false;
                int cancelRetries = 0;
                while (!doneFn && !cancelled.get() && !shuttingDown.get() && !lb.isClosed()) {
                    try {
                        DecompilerPool.DecompileOutcome outcome = decompilerPool.decompile(
                                lb, fn, DecompilerPool.Priority.P2_BG, false, null);
                        ClangTokenExtractor.DecompileArtifact art = outcome.artifact();
                        Map<String, Object> fnMeta = art.getFunction();
                        String entryHex = fnMeta != null && fnMeta.get("entry") != null
                                ? fnMeta.get("entry").toString()
                                : LoadedBinary.formatAddress(fn.getEntryPoint(), lb.getProgram().getDefaultPointerSize());
                        String plainC = String.join("\n", art.getPlainLines());

                        Map<String, Object> item = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                        item.put("entryHex", entryHex);
                        item.put("funcName", fnName);
                        item.put("revision", art.getRevision());
                        item.put("plainC", plainC);

                        completedItems.add(item);
                        synchronized (sqliteFlushLock) {
                            pendingSqliteBuffer.add(item);
                        }
                        indexedCount.incrementAndGet();
                        doneFn = true;
                    } catch (ApiException apiEx) {
                        if ("DECOMPILE_CANCELLED".equals(apiEx.getErrorCode())
                                && !cancelled.get()
                                && !shuttingDown.get()
                                && !lb.isClosed()
                                && cancelRetries < 3) {
                            cancelRetries++;
                            try {
                                Thread.sleep(35L);
                            } catch (InterruptedException ie) {
                                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                                return;
                            }
                            continue;
                        }
                        failedCount.incrementAndGet();
                        doneFn = true;
                    } catch (Exception ex) {
                        failedCount.incrementAndGet();
                        doneFn = true;
                    }
                }

                int proc = processedCount.incrementAndGet();
                percent = Math.min(99, (int) Math.floor((proc * 100.0) / Math.max(1, total)));
                flushPendingSqlite(false);
            }
        }

        private void ensureSqliteBaseIndexPresent() {
            try {
                ByteArrayOutputStream ndjsonBuf = new ByteArrayOutputStream(65536);
                IndexExporter.exportNdjson(lb, 0L, ndjsonBuf);
                byte[] payload = ndjsonBuf.toByteArray();
                ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder(
                        "node",
                        "--input-type=module",
                        "-e",
                        "import fs from 'node:fs'; import { getBinaryMeta, syncFromNdjson, closeAllIndexes } from '"
                                + INDEX_STORE_MJS
                                + "'; const id = process.argv[1]; let hasBase = false; try { const m = getBinaryMeta(id); hasBase = Boolean(m?.meta?.revision && m.functionCount > 0); } catch {} if (!hasBase) { const raw = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8'); syncFromNdjson(id, raw); } closeAllIndexes();",
                        binaryId);
                pb.environment().put("GHIDRA_RE_DATA_DIR", dataDir.toString());
                Process p = pb.start();
                try (OutputStream stdin = p.getOutputStream()) {
                    stdin.write(payload);
                }
                p.waitFor(15L, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
                if (p.isAlive()) {
                    p.destroyForcibly();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
                // Best-effort base index bootstrap.
            }
        }

        private void flushPendingSqlite(boolean force) {
            if (!force && decompilerPool.hasHighPriorityWork()) {
                return;
            }
            List<Map<String, Object>> chunk;
            synchronized (sqliteFlushLock) {
                if (pendingSqliteBuffer.isEmpty()
                        || (!force && pendingSqliteBuffer.size() < SQLITE_FLUSH_BATCH_SIZE)) {
                    return;
                }
                chunk = new ArrayList<>(pendingSqliteBuffer);
                pendingSqliteBuffer.clear();
            }

            if (!force) {
                while (decompilerPool.hasHighPriorityWork() && !cancelled.get() && !shuttingDown.get()) {
                    try {
                        Thread.sleep(25L);
                    } catch (InterruptedException ie) {
                        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            try {
                byte[] jsonBytes = GSON.toJson(chunk).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder(
                        "node",
                        "--input-type=module",
                        "-e",
                        "import fs from 'node:fs'; import { batchUpsertDecompileCache, closeAllIndexes } from '"
                                + INDEX_STORE_MJS
                                + "'; const items = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8')); batchUpsertDecompileCache(process.argv[1], items, { maxCached: Number(process.argv[2]) || 25000 }); closeAllIndexes();",
                        binaryId,
                        Integer.toString(tierConfig.getSqliteCacheMax()));
                pb.environment().put("GHIDRA_RE_DATA_DIR", dataDir.toString());
                Process p = pb.start();
                try (OutputStream stdin = p.getOutputStream()) {
                    stdin.write(jsonBytes);
                }
                p.waitFor(15L, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
                if (p.isAlive()) {
                    p.destroyForcibly();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
                // Best-effort SQLite batch flush.
            }
        }

        Map<String, Object> toStatusMap(int sinceCursor, boolean includeItems) {
            int totalCompleted;
            List<Map<String, Object>> slice = Collections.emptyList();
            synchronized (completedItems) {
                totalCompleted = completedItems.size();
                if (includeItems && sinceCursor < totalCompleted) {
                    int from = Math.max(0, sinceCursor);
                    int to = Math.min(totalCompleted, from + 500);
                    slice = new ArrayList<>(completedItems.subList(from, to));
                }
            }
            int nextCursor = includeItems ? Math.min(totalCompleted, Math.max(0, sinceCursor) + slice.size()) : totalCompleted;

            Map<String, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            map.put("jobId", jobId);
            map.put("binaryId", binaryId);
            map.put("state", state);
            map.put("phase", "batch_decompile");
            map.put("percent", "completed".equals(state) ? 100 : percent);
            map.put("currentAnalyzer", currentFunction);
            map.put("currentFunction", currentFunction);
            map.put("totalFunctions", functions.size());
            map.put("processedFunctions", processedCount.get());
            map.put("indexedFunctions", indexedCount.get());
            map.put("skippedFunctions", skippedCount.get());
            map.put("failedFunctions", failedCount.get());
            map.put("nextCursor", nextCursor);
            if (includeItems) {
                map.put("items", slice);
            }
            return map;
        }
    }

    private void performShutdown(String reason, boolean deferServerStop) {
        if (!shuttingDown.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
            return;
        }
        maintenanceExecutor.shutdownNow();
        cancelAllBatchJobs();
        try {
            projectManager.shutdownAll();
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            System.err.println("[ghidra-re] Error during ProjectManager shutdown (" + reason + "): " + ex.getMessage());
        }
        try {
            decompilerPool.shutdown();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // Best-effort decompiler pool shutdown.
        }
        try {
            eventBus.shutdown();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // Ignore shutdown errors.
        }
        try {
            Files.deleteIfExists(daemonJsonPath);
            Files.deleteIfExists(dataDir.resolve("daemon.json.tmp"));
        } catch (IOException ignored) {
            // Best-effort discovery file removal.
        }
        if (!deferServerStop) {
            try {
                server.stop(0);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
                // Ignore server stop error.
            }
            shutdownLatch.countDown();
        }
    }

    private boolean isAuthorized(String authHeader) {
        if (authHeader == null || !authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
            return false;
        }
        String token = authHeader.substring("Bearer ".length());
        byte[] provided = token.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        return MessageDigest.isEqual(provided, bearerTokenBytes);
    }

    private static void requireMethod(String actual, String expected) {
        if (!expected.equals(actual)) {
            throw new ApiException(
                    405,
                    "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED",
                    "Expected " + expected + " but got " + actual);
        }
    }

    private static JsonObject readRequiredJsonBody(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        JsonObject obj = readOptionalJsonBody(exchange);
        if (obj == null) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "JSON object request body is required");
        }
        return obj;
    }

    private static JsonObject readOptionalJsonBody(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        byte[] raw;
        try (InputStream in = exchange.getRequestBody()) {
            raw = in.readNBytes(MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES + 1);
        }
        if (raw.length > MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Request body exceeds 1 MiB limit");
        }
        String text = new String(raw, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).trim();
        if (text.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }
        try {
            JsonElement parsed = JsonParser.parseString(text);
            if (!parsed.isJsonObject()) {
                throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Request body must be a JSON object");
            }
            return parsed.getAsJsonObject();
        } catch (JsonSyntaxException ex) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Malformed JSON request body: " + ex.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private static void sendJson(
            HttpExchange exchange,
            int status,
            Object payload,
            Map<String, String> extraHeaders) throws IOException {
        byte[] bytes = GSON.toJson(payload).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        Headers headers = exchange.getResponseHeaders();
        headers.set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8");
        headers.set("Cache-Control", "no-store");
        if (extraHeaders != null) {
            for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : extraHeaders.entrySet()) {
                headers.set(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
            }
        }
        exchange.sendResponseHeaders(status, bytes.length);
        try (OutputStream out = exchange.getResponseBody()) {
            out.write(bytes);
        }
    }

    private static void sendError(HttpExchange exchange, ApiException ex) {
        try {
            Map<String, String> extraHeaders = null;
            if (ex.getHttpStatus() == 429) {
                Object retryAfter = ex.getDetails().getOrDefault("retryAfterSec", 2);
                extraHeaders = Map.of("Retry-After", String.valueOf(retryAfter));
            }
            sendJson(exchange, ex.getHttpStatus(), ex.toErrorBody(), extraHeaders);
        } catch (IOException ignored) {
            // Client disconnected.
        }
    }

    private static void sendBinaryJson(
            HttpExchange exchange,
            int status,
            Object payload,
            long revision,
            String etag) throws IOException {
        Map<String, String> headers = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        headers.put("X-RE-Revision", Long.toString(revision));
        if (etag != null) {
            headers.put("ETag", etag);
        }
        sendJson(exchange, status, payload, headers);
    }

    private static boolean sendNotModifiedIfMatched(
            HttpExchange exchange,
            Headers reqHeaders,
            String etag,
            long revision) throws IOException {
        String ifNoneMatch = reqHeaders.getFirst("If-None-Match");
        if (ifNoneMatch != null && etagMatches(ifNoneMatch, etag)) {
            Headers respHeaders = exchange.getResponseHeaders();
            respHeaders.set("ETag", etag);
            respHeaders.set("X-RE-Revision", Long.toString(revision));
            exchange.sendResponseHeaders(304, -1);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static boolean etagMatches(String headerValue, String etag) {
        for (String candidate : headerValue.split(",")) {
            String trimmed = candidate.trim();
            if (trimmed.equals(etag) || trimmed.equals("*")) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static String computeBinaryReadEtag(LoadedBinary lb, String path, String rawQuery) {
        String key = path + "?" + (rawQuery != null ? rawQuery : "");
        return "\"b:" + lb.getBinaryId() + ":r:" + lb.getRevision() + ":" + shortHash(key) + "\"";
    }

    private static String shortHash(String input) {
        try {
            MessageDigest md = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
            byte[] digest = md.digest(input.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            return HexFormat.of().formatHex(digest, 0, 6);
        } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException ex) {
            return Integer.toHexString(input.hashCode());
        }
    }

    private static long revisionFromResult(Map<String, Object> result, LoadedBinary lb) {
        Object rev = result != null ? result.get("revision") : null;
        return rev instanceof Number n ? n.longValue() : lb.getRevision();
    }

    private static Long extractExpectedRevision(JsonObject body, String ifMatchHeader) {
        if (body != null && body.has("expectedRevision") && !body.get("expectedRevision").isJsonNull()) {
            JsonElement el = body.get("expectedRevision");
            if (el.isJsonPrimitive()) {
                try {
                    return el.getAsLong();
                } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {
                    // Fall through to 400.
                }
            }
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Field 'expectedRevision' must be an integer");
        }
        if (ifMatchHeader != null && !ifMatchHeader.isBlank()) {
            String trimmed = ifMatchHeader.trim();
            if (trimmed.startsWith("\"") && trimmed.endsWith("\"") && trimmed.length() >= 2) {
                trimmed = trimmed.substring(1, trimmed.length() - 1).trim();
            }
            Matcher m = ETAG_REV_PATTERN.matcher(trimmed);
            if (m.find()) {
                return Long.parseLong(m.group(1));
            }
            try {
                return Long.parseLong(trimmed);
            } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
                throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Invalid If-Match revision header: " + ifMatchHeader);
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static boolean parseBooleanParam(String raw, boolean defaultVal) {
        if (raw == null || raw.isBlank()) {
            return defaultVal;
        }
        return switch (raw.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
            case "1", "true", "yes" -> true;
            case "0", "false", "no" -> false;
            default -> throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Invalid boolean query parameter: " + raw);
        };
    }

    private static Set<String> parseCommaSet(String raw) {
        if (raw == null || raw.isBlank()) {
            return Collections.emptySet();
        }
        Set<String> out = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        for (String part : raw.split(",")) {
            String trimmed = part.trim();
            if (!trimmed.isEmpty()) {
                out.add(trimmed);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static String getString(JsonObject obj, String key, String defaultVal) {
        if (obj == null || !obj.has(key) || obj.get(key).isJsonNull()) {
            return defaultVal;
        }
        JsonElement el = obj.get(key);
        if (!el.isJsonPrimitive()) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Field '" + key + "' must be a string");
        }
        return el.getAsString();
    }

    private static boolean getBoolean(JsonObject obj, String key, boolean defaultVal) {
        if (obj == null || !obj.has(key) || obj.get(key).isJsonNull()) {
            return defaultVal;
        }
        JsonElement el = obj.get(key);
        if (!el.isJsonPrimitive() || !el.getAsJsonPrimitive().isBoolean()) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Field '" + key + "' must be a boolean");
        }
        return el.getAsBoolean();
    }

    private static long parseLongParam(String raw, long defaultVal) {
        if (raw == null || raw.isBlank()) {
            return defaultVal;
        }
        try {
            return Long.parseLong(raw.trim());
        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Invalid integer query parameter: " + raw);
        }
    }

    private static Map<String, String> parseQuery(String rawQuery) {
        if (rawQuery == null || rawQuery.isBlank()) {
            return Collections.emptyMap();
        }
        Map<String, String> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (String pair : rawQuery.split("&")) {
            if (pair.isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }
            int eq = pair.indexOf('=');
            String k = eq >= 0 ? urlDecode(pair.substring(0, eq)) : urlDecode(pair);
            String v = eq >= 0 ? urlDecode(pair.substring(eq + 1)) : "";
            map.put(k, v);
        }
        return map;
    }

    private static String urlDecode(String value) {
        return URLDecoder.decode(value, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    private static String percentDecode(String value) {
        if (value == null || value.indexOf('%') < 0) {
            return value;
        }
        ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream(value.length());
        for (int i = 0; i < value.length(); i++) {
            char c = value.charAt(i);
            if (c == '%') {
                if (i + 2 >= value.length()) {
                    throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Malformed percent-encoding in path");
                }
                int hi = Character.digit(value.charAt(i + 1), 16);
                int lo = Character.digit(value.charAt(i + 2), 16);
                if (hi < 0 || lo < 0) {
                    throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Malformed percent-encoding in path");
                }
                out.write((hi << 4) | lo);
                i += 2;
            } else {
                byte[] utf8 = String.valueOf(c).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                out.writeBytes(utf8);
            }
        }
        return out.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    private static String headerOrDefault(Headers headers, String name, String defaultVal) {
        String val = headers.getFirst(name);
        return (val != null && !val.isBlank()) ? val.trim() : defaultVal;
    }

    private static void ensureSecureDir(Path dir) throws IOException {
        if (!Files.exists(dir)) {
            Set<PosixFilePermission> mode0700 = PosixFilePermissions.fromString("rwx------");
            Files.createDirectories(dir, PosixFilePermissions.asFileAttribute(mode0700));
        }
    }

    private static final class ParsedArgs {
        Path dataDir;
        Integer ramLimitMb;
        String tier = "balanced";
        Integer idleTimeoutMin;
    }

    private static ParsedArgs parseArgs(String[] args) {
        ParsedArgs parsed = new ParsedArgs();
        if (args != null) {
            for (int i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
                String arg = args[i];
                switch (arg) {
                    case "--data-dir" -> {
                        if (i + 1 < args.length) {
                            parsed.dataDir = Path.of(args[++i]);
                        }
                    }
                    case "--ram-limit-mb" -> {
                        if (i + 1 < args.length) {
                            parsed.ramLimitMb = Integer.parseInt(args[++i]);
                        }
                    }
                    case "--tier" -> {
                        if (i + 1 < args.length) {
                            parsed.tier = args[++i];
                        }
                    }
                    case "--idle-timeout-min" -> {
                        if (i + 1 < args.length) {
                            parsed.idleTimeoutMin = Integer.parseInt(args[++i]);
                        }
                    }
                    default -> {
                        // Ignore unknown flags passed by launcher.
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (parsed.dataDir == null) {
            String envDataDir = System.getenv("GHIDRA_RE_DATA_DIR");
            if (envDataDir != null && !envDataDir.isBlank()) {
                parsed.dataDir = Path.of(envDataDir);
            } else {
                String xdgData = System.getenv("XDG_DATA_HOME");
                Path base = (xdgData != null && !xdgData.isBlank())
                        ? Path.of(xdgData)
                        : Path.of(System.getProperty("user.home"), ".local", "share");
                parsed.dataDir = base.resolve("antigravity-ghidra-re");
            }
        }
        return parsed;
    }

    private static final class LazyNdjsonStream extends OutputStream {
        private final HttpExchange exchange;
        private final Headers respHeaders;
        private final long revision;
        private boolean committed = false;
        private OutputStream delegate;

        private LazyNdjsonStream(HttpExchange exchange, Headers respHeaders, long revision) {
            this.exchange = exchange;
            this.respHeaders = respHeaders;
            this.revision = revision;
        }

        private void ensureCommitted() throws IOException {
            if (!committed) {
                respHeaders.set("Content-Type", "application/x-ndjson; charset=utf-8");
                respHeaders.set("Cache-Control", "no-store");
                respHeaders.set("X-RE-Revision", Long.toString(revision));
                exchange.sendResponseHeaders(200, 0);
                delegate = exchange.getResponseBody();
                committed = true;
            }
        }

        private void commitIfNeeded() throws IOException {
            ensureCommitted();
        }

        private boolean isCommitted() {
            return committed;
        }

        private void closeDelegate() throws IOException {
            if (delegate != null) {
                delegate.close();
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void write(int b) throws IOException {
            ensureCommitted();
            delegate.write(b);
        }

        @Override
        public void write(byte[] b, int off, int len) throws IOException {
            if (len <= 0) {
                return;
            }
            ensureCommitted();
            delegate.write(b, off, len);
        }

        @Override
        public void flush() throws IOException {
            if (committed && delegate != null) {
                delegate.flush();
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void close() throws IOException {
            if (committed && delegate != null) {
                delegate.close();
            }
        }
    }
}

```

`daemon/src/com/antigravity/ghidrare/DecompilerPool.java`:

```java
package com.antigravity.ghidrare;

import ghidra.app.decompiler.DecompInterface;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.DecompileOptions;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.DecompileResults;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.Function;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.Program;
import ghidra.program.model.pcode.HighFunction;
import ghidra.util.task.TaskMonitorAdapter;

import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Deque;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Iterator;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;
import java.util.concurrent.locks.Condition;
import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantLock;

/**
 * Priority-scheduled, single-flight coalescing DecompInterface worker pool
 * with lazy native process creation, /proc RSS recycling, hard timeout watchdogs,
 * and crash recovery.
 */
public final class DecompilerPool {

    public enum Priority {
        P0_UI,
        P1_MCP,
        P2_BG
    }

    public record DecompileOutcome(
            ClangTokenExtractor.DecompileArtifact artifact,
            boolean cached,
            long decompileMs,
            int workerIndex) {
    }

    private static final int MCP_MAX_WAITING_QUEUE = 32;
    private static final int WORKER_RECYCLE_MAX_JOBS = 250;
    private static final int PROBLEM_RING_CAPACITY = 256;
    private static final long PID_POLL_TIMEOUT_MS = 500L;
    private static final long PID_POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 25L;

    private final TierConfig tierConfig;
    private final int workerCount;
    private final int maxBgConcurrent;
    private final WorkerSlot[] workers;

    private final ReentrantLock schedulerLock = new ReentrantLock();
    private final Deque<QueuedWaiter> uiQueue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private final Deque<QueuedWaiter> mcpQueue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private final Deque<QueuedWaiter> bgQueue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private final Set<ActiveJob> activeJobs = new HashSet<>();
    private int activeBgCount = 0;
    private volatile boolean shuttingDown = false;
    private final AtomicLong lastHighPriorityActivityMs = new AtomicLong(0L);

    private final Object spawnLock = new Object();
    private final ScheduledExecutorService watchdogExecutor;

    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, InFlightEntry> inFlightRegistry = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, Map<String, ClangTokenExtractor.DecompileArtifact>> binaryCaches =
            new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, Boolean> problemFunctions = Collections.synchronizedMap(
            new LinkedHashMap<>(64, 0.75f, false) {
                @Override
                protected boolean removeEldestEntry(Map.Entry<String, Boolean> eldest) {
                    return size() > PROBLEM_RING_CAPACITY;
                }
            });

    private static final class WorkerSlot {
        final int index;
        DecompInterface decomp;
        String boundBinaryId;
        volatile long childPid = -1L;
        int jobCount = 0;
        boolean needsRecycle = false;
        boolean busy = false;
        long lastUsedAt = 0L;

        WorkerSlot(int index) {
            this.index = index;
        }
    }

    private static final class QueuedWaiter {
        final String binaryId;
        final Condition cond;
        final TaskMonitorAdapter monitor;
        final InFlightEntry inFlightEntry;
        Priority priority;
        ActiveJob assignedJob;
        boolean cancelled = false;
        ApiException failure;

        QueuedWaiter(
                String binaryId,
                Priority priority,
                Condition cond,
                TaskMonitorAdapter monitor,
                InFlightEntry inFlightEntry) {
            this.binaryId = binaryId;
            this.priority = priority;
            this.cond = cond;
            this.monitor = monitor;
            this.inFlightEntry = inFlightEntry;
        }
    }

    private static final class ActiveJob {
        final String binaryId;
        final WorkerSlot slot;
        final TaskMonitorAdapter monitor;
        final boolean countedAsBg;
        volatile Priority effectivePriority;

        ActiveJob(
                String binaryId,
                WorkerSlot slot,
                TaskMonitorAdapter monitor,
                Priority priority,
                boolean countedAsBg) {
            this.binaryId = binaryId;
            this.slot = slot;
            this.monitor = monitor;
            this.effectivePriority = priority;
            this.countedAsBg = countedAsBg;
        }
    }

    private static final class InFlightEntry {
        final CompletableFuture<DecompileOutcome> future = new CompletableFuture<>();
        volatile Priority effectivePriority;
        volatile QueuedWaiter waiter;
        volatile ActiveJob activeJob;

        InFlightEntry(Priority initialPriority) {
            this.effectivePriority = initialPriority;
        }
    }

    public DecompilerPool(TierConfig tierConfig) {
        this.tierConfig = Objects.requireNonNull(tierConfig, "tierConfig");
        this.workerCount = Math.max(1, tierConfig.getWorkers());
        this.maxBgConcurrent = this.workerCount >= 3 ? Math.max(1, this.workerCount - 2) : 1;
        this.workers = new WorkerSlot[this.workerCount];
        for (int i = 0; i < this.workerCount; i++) {
            this.workers[i] = new WorkerSlot(i);
        }
        this.watchdogExecutor = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(r -> {
            Thread t = new Thread(r, "ghidra-re-decomp-watchdog");
            t.setDaemon(true);
            return t;
        });
    }

    public static Priority parsePriority(String raw) {
        if (raw == null || raw.isBlank()) {
            return Priority.P1_MCP;
        }
        return switch (raw.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
            case "ui", "p0", "p0_ui" -> Priority.P0_UI;
            case "bg", "p2", "p2_bg" -> Priority.P2_BG;
            case "mcp", "p1", "p1_mcp" -> Priority.P1_MCP;
            default -> Priority.P1_MCP;
        };
    }

    public DecompileOutcome decompile(
            LoadedBinary lb,
            Function fn,
            Priority priority,
            boolean refresh,
            Integer timeoutSecOverride) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(lb, "lb");
        Objects.requireNonNull(fn, "fn");
        if (lb.isClosed()) {
            throw new ApiException(404, "BINARY_NOT_LOADED", "Binary is not loaded: " + lb.getBinaryId());
        }

        Priority effectiveReqPriority = priority != null ? priority : Priority.P1_MCP;
        if (effectiveReqPriority == Priority.P0_UI || effectiveReqPriority == Priority.P1_MCP) {
            lastHighPriorityActivityMs.set(System.currentTimeMillis());
        }
        String binaryId = lb.getBinaryId();
        Program program = lb.getProgram();
        int pointerSize = program.getDefaultPointerSize();
        String entryHex = LoadedBinary.formatAddress(fn.getEntryPoint(), pointerSize);
        String cacheKey = normalizeAddrKey(entryHex);
        long revision = lb.getRevision();

        lb.touchAccess();

        if (!refresh) {
            ClangTokenExtractor.DecompileArtifact cached = getCachedArtifact(binaryId, cacheKey);
            if (cached != null) {
                return new DecompileOutcome(cached, true, 0L, -1);
            }
        }

        if (effectiveReqPriority == Priority.P2_BG && isProblemFunction(binaryId, entryHex, revision)) {
            throw new ApiException(
                    502,
                    "DECOMPILER_CRASHED",
                    "Skipping background decompilation of known problem function " + entryHex,
                    false,
                    Map.of("address", entryHex));
        }

        String flightKey = binaryId + ":" + cacheKey + ":" + revision;
        while (true) {
            InFlightEntry newEntry = new InFlightEntry(effectiveReqPriority);
            InFlightEntry existing = inFlightRegistry.putIfAbsent(flightKey, newEntry);
            if (existing == null) {
                try {
                    DecompileOutcome outcome = runArtifactDecompile(
                            lb, fn, entryHex, cacheKey, revision, effectiveReqPriority, timeoutSecOverride, newEntry);
                    newEntry.future.complete(outcome);
                    return outcome;
                } catch (Throwable t) {
                    newEntry.future.completeExceptionally(t);
                    throw rethrowApi(t);
                } finally {
                    inFlightRegistry.remove(flightKey, newEntry);
                }
            }

            promoteInFlight(existing, effectiveReqPriority);
            try {
                return existing.future.get();
            } catch (InterruptedException ie) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                throw new ApiException(503, "DECOMPILE_CANCELLED", "Interrupted while waiting for decompilation", true);
            } catch (ExecutionException ee) {
                Throwable cause = ee.getCause() != null ? ee.getCause() : ee;
                if (effectiveReqPriority != Priority.P2_BG
                        && cause instanceof ApiException apiEx
                        && "DECOMPILE_CANCELLED".equals(apiEx.getErrorCode())) {
                    continue;
                }
                throw rethrowApi(cause);
            }
        }
    }

    public int getMaxBgConcurrent() {
        return maxBgConcurrent;
    }

    public boolean hasHighPriorityWork() {
        if (System.currentTimeMillis() - lastHighPriorityActivityMs.get() < 180L) {
            return true;
        }
        schedulerLock.lock();
        try {
            if (!uiQueue.isEmpty() || !mcpQueue.isEmpty()) {
                return true;
            }
            for (ActiveJob job : activeJobs) {
                if (job.effectivePriority != Priority.P2_BG) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        } finally {
            schedulerLock.unlock();
        }
    }

    public void warmUiWorker(LoadedBinary lb) {
        if (lb == null || lb.isClosed() || shuttingDown) {
            return;
        }
        TaskMonitorAdapter dummyMonitor = new TaskMonitorAdapter(true);
        ActiveJob job = null;
        schedulerLock.lock();
        try {
            if (shuttingDown || !workers[0].busy) {
                if (!shuttingDown && !workers[0].busy) {
                    job = assignWorkerLocked(workers[0], lb.getBinaryId(), Priority.P0_UI, dummyMonitor, null);
                }
            }
        } finally {
            schedulerLock.unlock();
        }
        if (job == null) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            prepareWorker(job.slot, lb, tierConfig.getDecompileTimeoutSec());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // Best-effort UI worker warm-up.
        } finally {
            releaseWorker(job);
        }
    }

    public HighFunction decompileForHighFunction(LoadedBinary lb, Function fn, Priority priority) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(lb, "lb");
        Objects.requireNonNull(fn, "fn");
        if (lb.isClosed()) {
            throw new ApiException(404, "BINARY_NOT_LOADED", "Binary is not loaded: " + lb.getBinaryId());
        }
        Priority effectivePriority = priority != null ? priority : Priority.P1_MCP;
        Program program = lb.getProgram();
        String entryHex = LoadedBinary.formatAddress(fn.getEntryPoint(), program.getDefaultPointerSize());
        lb.touchAccess();

        DecompileJobResult result = executeOnWorkerPool(
                lb, fn, entryHex, null, lb.getRevision(), effectivePriority, null, null, false);
        HighFunction hf = result.results().getHighFunction();
        if (hf == null) {
            throw new ApiException(
                    502,
                    "DECOMPILER_CRASHED",
                    "HighFunction unavailable after decompiling " + entryHex,
                    true,
                    Map.of("address", entryHex));
        }
        return hf;
    }

    public void invalidateFunction(String binaryId, String funcEntryHex) {
        if (binaryId == null || funcEntryHex == null) {
            return;
        }
        Map<String, ClangTokenExtractor.DecompileArtifact> cache = binaryCaches.get(binaryId);
        if (cache != null) {
            cache.remove(normalizeAddrKey(funcEntryHex));
        }
    }

    public void invalidateFunctions(String binaryId, Collection<String> funcEntryHexes) {
        if (binaryId == null || funcEntryHexes == null || funcEntryHexes.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }
        Map<String, ClangTokenExtractor.DecompileArtifact> cache = binaryCaches.get(binaryId);
        if (cache == null) {
            return;
        }
        synchronized (cache) {
            for (String hex : funcEntryHexes) {
                if (hex != null) {
                    cache.remove(normalizeAddrKey(hex));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public int invalidateByType(String binaryId, String typeName) {
        if (binaryId == null || typeName == null || typeName.isBlank()) {
            return 0;
        }
        Map<String, ClangTokenExtractor.DecompileArtifact> cache = binaryCaches.get(binaryId);
        if (cache == null) {
            return 0;
        }
        String target = typeName.trim();
        int removed = 0;
        synchronized (cache) {
            Iterator<Map.Entry<String, ClangTokenExtractor.DecompileArtifact>> it = cache.entrySet().iterator();
            while (it.hasNext()) {
                Map.Entry<String, ClangTokenExtractor.DecompileArtifact> entry = it.next();
                Set<String> used = entry.getValue().getUsedTypes();
                if (used != null && containsTypeMatch(used, target)) {
                    it.remove();
                    removed++;
                }
            }
        }
        return removed;
    }

    public void invalidateBinary(String binaryId) {
        if (binaryId != null) {
            binaryCaches.remove(binaryId);
        }
    }

    public void unbindBinary(String binaryId) {
        if (binaryId == null) {
            return;
        }
        invalidateBinary(binaryId);
        clearProblemFunctionsForBinary(binaryId);

        schedulerLock.lock();
        try {
            cancelWaitersForBinary(uiQueue, binaryId);
            cancelWaitersForBinary(mcpQueue, binaryId);
            cancelWaitersForBinary(bgQueue, binaryId);

            for (ActiveJob job : activeJobs) {
                if (binaryId.equals(job.binaryId)) {
                    job.monitor.cancel();
                }
            }
```
