```java
            for (WorkerSlot slot : workers) {
                if (!slot.busy && binaryId.equals(slot.boundBinaryId) && slot.decomp != null) {
                    try {
                        slot.decomp.closeProgram();
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {
                        // Best-effort close on idle worker.
                    }
                    slot.boundBinaryId = null;
                } else if (slot.busy && binaryId.equals(slot.boundBinaryId)) {
                    slot.needsRecycle = true;
                }
            }
        } finally {
            schedulerLock.unlock();
        }
    }

    public boolean isProblemFunction(String binaryId, String funcEntryHex, long revision) {
        if (binaryId == null || funcEntryHex == null) {
            return false;
        }
        String key = problemKey(binaryId, normalizeAddrKey(funcEntryHex), revision);
        return Boolean.TRUE.equals(problemFunctions.get(key));
    }

    public Map<String, Object> getWorkerStats() {
        schedulerLock.lock();
        try {
            List<Map<String, Object>> workerList = new ArrayList<>(workerCount);
            for (WorkerSlot slot : workers) {
                String state;
                if (slot.decomp == null) {
                    state = "uninitialized";
                } else if (slot.busy) {
                    state = "busy";
                } else if (slot.needsRecycle) {
                    state = "pending_recycle";
                } else {
                    state = "idle";
                }
                long rssMb = slot.childPid > 0 ? TierConfig.readProcVmRssMb(slot.childPid) : -1L;

                Map<String, Object> w = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                w.put("index", slot.index);
                w.put("uiReserved", workerCount >= 2 && slot.index == 0);
                w.put("state", state);
                w.put("boundBinaryId", slot.boundBinaryId);
                w.put("childPid", slot.childPid > 0 ? slot.childPid : null);
                w.put("rssMb", rssMb >= 0 ? rssMb : null);
                w.put("jobCount", slot.jobCount);
                workerList.add(w);
            }

            Map<String, Integer> queues = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            queues.put("ui", uiQueue.size());
            queues.put("mcp", mcpQueue.size());
            queues.put("bg", bgQueue.size());

            Map<String, Integer> cacheCounts = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            for (Map.Entry<String, Map<String, ClangTokenExtractor.DecompileArtifact>> e : binaryCaches.entrySet()) {
                Map<String, ClangTokenExtractor.DecompileArtifact> m = e.getValue();
                synchronized (m) {
                    cacheCounts.put(e.getKey(), m.size());
                }
            }

            Map<String, Object> stats = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            stats.put("workerCount", workerCount);
            stats.put("maxBgConcurrent", maxBgConcurrent);
            stats.put("activeBgCount", activeBgCount);
            stats.put("workers", workerList);
            stats.put("queues", queues);
            stats.put("inFlightCount", inFlightRegistry.size());
            stats.put("cacheEntriesByBinary", cacheCounts);
            stats.put("problemFunctionCount", problemFunctions.size());
            return stats;
        } finally {
            schedulerLock.unlock();
        }
    }

    public void shutdown() {
        shuttingDown = true;

        schedulerLock.lock();
        try {
            failAllWaiters(uiQueue);
            failAllWaiters(mcpQueue);
            failAllWaiters(bgQueue);
            for (ActiveJob job : activeJobs) {
                job.monitor.cancel();
            }
            for (WorkerSlot slot : workers) {
                if (!slot.busy) {
                    disposeWorker(slot);
                } else {
                    slot.needsRecycle = true;
                    if (slot.decomp != null) {
                        try {
                            slot.decomp.stopProcess();
                        } catch (Exception ignored) {
                            // Best-effort process stop during shutdown.
                        }
                    }
                    if (slot.childPid > 0) {
                        ProcessHandle.of(slot.childPid).ifPresent(ProcessHandle::destroyForcibly);
                    }
                }
            }
        } finally {
            schedulerLock.unlock();
        }

        watchdogExecutor.shutdownNow();
        binaryCaches.clear();
        inFlightRegistry.clear();
    }

    private DecompileOutcome runArtifactDecompile(
            LoadedBinary lb,
            Function fn,
            String entryHex,
            String cacheKey,
            long revision,
            Priority priority,
            Integer timeoutSecOverride,
            InFlightEntry inFlightEntry) {
        DecompileJobResult jobRes = executeOnWorkerPool(
                lb, fn, entryHex, cacheKey, revision, priority, timeoutSecOverride, inFlightEntry, true);

        return new DecompileOutcome(jobRes.artifact(), false, jobRes.decompileMs(), jobRes.workerIndex());
    }

    private record DecompileJobResult(
            DecompileResults results,
            ClangTokenExtractor.DecompileArtifact artifact,
            long decompileMs,
            int workerIndex) {
    }

    private DecompileJobResult executeOnWorkerPool(
            LoadedBinary lb,
            Function fn,
            String entryHex,
            String cacheKey,
            long revision,
            Priority priority,
            Integer timeoutSecOverride,
            InFlightEntry inFlightEntry,
            boolean extractAndCache) {

        String binaryId = lb.getBinaryId();
        int effectiveTimeoutSec = (timeoutSecOverride != null && timeoutSecOverride > 0)
                ? timeoutSecOverride
                : tierConfig.getDecompileTimeoutSec();

        TaskMonitorAdapter monitor = new TaskMonitorAdapter(true);
        ActiveJob activeJob = acquireWorker(binaryId, priority, monitor, inFlightEntry);
        WorkerSlot slot = activeJob.slot;

        long startNs = System.nanoTime();
        ScheduledFuture<?> watchdog = null;
        AtomicBoolean attemptDone = new AtomicBoolean(false);
        AtomicBoolean timedOut = new AtomicBoolean(false);
        boolean workerFailed = false;

        try {
            if (shuttingDown || lb.isClosed()) {
                throw new ApiException(404, "BINARY_NOT_LOADED", "Binary is no longer loaded: " + binaryId);
            }

            prepareWorker(slot, lb, effectiveTimeoutSec);
            DecompInterface decomp = slot.decomp;
            long childPid = slot.childPid;

            watchdog = watchdogExecutor.schedule(() -> {
                if (!attemptDone.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
                    return;
                }
                timedOut.set(true);
                monitor.cancel();
                try {
                    decomp.stopProcess();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {
                    // Best-effort process stop on timeout.
                }
                if (childPid > 0) {
                    ProcessHandle.of(childPid).ifPresent(ProcessHandle::destroyForcibly);
                }
            }, effectiveTimeoutSec + 3L, TimeUnit.SECONDS);

            DecompileResults res;
            ClangTokenExtractor.DecompileArtifact artifact = null;
            lb.getRwLock().readLock().lock();
            try {
                if (lb.isClosed()) {
                    throw new ApiException(404, "BINARY_NOT_LOADED", "Binary is already closed: " + binaryId);
                }
                res = decomp.decompileFunction(fn, effectiveTimeoutSec, monitor);

                boolean completedBeforeWatchdog = attemptDone.compareAndSet(false, true);
                if (watchdog != null) {
                    watchdog.cancel(false);
                }

                if (!completedBeforeWatchdog || timedOut.get() || (res != null && res.isTimedOut())) {
                    workerFailed = true;
                    throw buildTimeoutException(binaryId, entryHex, effectiveTimeoutSec);
                }

                if (monitor.isCancelled() || (res != null && res.isCancelled())) {
                    throw new ApiException(503, "DECOMPILE_CANCELLED", "Decompilation cancelled for " + entryHex, true);
                }

                if (res == null || res.failedToStart() || !res.decompileCompleted()) {
                    workerFailed = true;
                    recordProblemFunction(binaryId, normalizeAddrKey(entryHex), revision);
                    String errMsg = (res != null && res.getErrorMessage() != null && !res.getErrorMessage().isBlank())
                            ? res.getErrorMessage()
                            : "Decompiler process failed to complete";
                    throw new ApiException(
                            502,
                            "DECOMPILER_CRASHED",
                            "Decompiler crashed for " + entryHex + ": " + errMsg,
                            true,
                            Map.of("address", entryHex));
                }

                if (extractAndCache) {
                    artifact = ClangTokenExtractor.extract(binaryId, lb.getProgram(), fn, res, revision);
                    if (!lb.isClosed() && lb.getRevision() == revision) {
                        putCachedArtifact(binaryId, cacheKey, artifact);
                    }
                }
            } finally {
                lb.getRwLock().readLock().unlock();
            }

            if (slot.childPid <= 0) {
                synchronized (spawnLock) {
                    if (slot.childPid <= 0) {
                        long latePid = findUnassignedChildPid(Collections.emptySet());
                        if (latePid > 0) {
                            slot.childPid = latePid;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            slot.jobCount++;
            long rssMb = slot.childPid > 0 ? TierConfig.readProcVmRssMb(slot.childPid) : -1L;
            if ((rssMb > 0 && rssMb > tierConfig.getWorkerRecycleRssMb())
                    || slot.jobCount >= WORKER_RECYCLE_MAX_JOBS) {
                slot.needsRecycle = true;
            }

            long decompileMs = TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS.toMillis(System.nanoTime() - startNs);
            return new DecompileJobResult(res, artifact, decompileMs, slot.index);
        } catch (ApiException apiEx) {
            if (timedOut.get() && apiEx.getHttpStatus() != 504) {
                workerFailed = true;
                throw buildTimeoutException(binaryId, entryHex, effectiveTimeoutSec);
            }
            throw apiEx;
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            if (timedOut.get()) {
                workerFailed = true;
                throw buildTimeoutException(binaryId, entryHex, effectiveTimeoutSec);
            }
            workerFailed = true;
            recordProblemFunction(binaryId, normalizeAddrKey(entryHex), revision);
            throw new ApiException(
                    502,
                    "DECOMPILER_CRASHED",
                    "Decompiler crashed for " + entryHex + ": " + t.getMessage(),
                    true,
                    Map.of("address", entryHex),
                    t);
        } finally {
            if (priority == Priority.P0_UI || priority == Priority.P1_MCP) {
                lastHighPriorityActivityMs.set(System.currentTimeMillis());
            }
            attemptDone.set(true);
            if (watchdog != null) {
                watchdog.cancel(false);
            }
            if (workerFailed || slot.needsRecycle || shuttingDown) {
                disposeWorker(slot);
            }
            releaseWorker(activeJob);
        }
    }

    private ActiveJob acquireWorker(
            String binaryId,
            Priority priority,
            TaskMonitorAdapter monitor,
            InFlightEntry inFlightEntry) {
        schedulerLock.lock();
        try {
            if (shuttingDown) {
                throw new ApiException(503, "DAEMON_SHUTTING_DOWN", "Decompiler pool is shutting down", true);
            }

            if (priority == Priority.P0_UI || priority == Priority.P1_MCP) {
                cancelActiveBgJobsLocked();
            }

            WorkerSlot immediate = tryFindIdleWorkerLocked(binaryId, priority);
            if (immediate != null) {
                return assignWorkerLocked(immediate, binaryId, priority, monitor, inFlightEntry);
            }

            if (priority == Priority.P1_MCP && mcpQueue.size() >= MCP_MAX_WAITING_QUEUE) {
                throw new ApiException(
                        429,
                        "QUEUE_SATURATED",
                        "MCP decompiler queue saturated",
                        true,
                        Map.of("retryAfterSec", 2));
            }

            QueuedWaiter waiter = new QueuedWaiter(
                    binaryId, priority, schedulerLock.newCondition(), monitor, inFlightEntry);
            if (inFlightEntry != null) {
                inFlightEntry.waiter = waiter;
            }

            switch (priority) {
                case P0_UI -> uiQueue.addLast(waiter);
                case P1_MCP -> mcpQueue.addLast(waiter);
                case P2_BG -> bgQueue.addLast(waiter);
            }

            while (waiter.assignedJob == null && !waiter.cancelled && waiter.failure == null && !shuttingDown) {
                try {
                    waiter.cond.await();
                } catch (InterruptedException ie) {
                    removeWaiterLocked(waiter);
                    if (inFlightEntry != null && inFlightEntry.waiter == waiter) {
                        inFlightEntry.waiter = null;
                    }
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                    throw new ApiException(503, "DECOMPILE_CANCELLED", "Interrupted in decompiler queue", true);
                }
            }

            if (waiter.failure != null) {
                throw waiter.failure;
            }
            if (waiter.cancelled || shuttingDown || waiter.assignedJob == null) {
                throw new ApiException(503, "DECOMPILE_CANCELLED", "Decompilation request cancelled", true);
            }

            return waiter.assignedJob;
        } finally {
            schedulerLock.unlock();
        }
    }

    private ActiveJob assignWorkerLocked(
            WorkerSlot slot,
            String binaryId,
            Priority priority,
            TaskMonitorAdapter monitor,
            InFlightEntry inFlightEntry) {
        slot.busy = true;
        Priority effectivePriority = inFlightEntry != null ? inFlightEntry.effectivePriority : priority;
        boolean countedAsBg = (priority == Priority.P2_BG);
        if (countedAsBg) {
            activeBgCount++;
        }
        ActiveJob job = new ActiveJob(binaryId, slot, monitor, effectivePriority, countedAsBg);
        activeJobs.add(job);
        if (inFlightEntry != null) {
            inFlightEntry.activeJob = job;
            inFlightEntry.waiter = null;
        }
        return job;
    }

    private WorkerSlot tryFindIdleWorkerLocked(String binaryId, Priority priority) {
        if (priority == Priority.P0_UI) {
            if (workerCount >= 2) {
                if (!workers[0].busy) {
                    return workers[0];
                }
                return pickBestIdleWorkerLocked(binaryId, 1, workerCount - 1);
            }
            return !workers[0].busy ? workers[0] : null;
        }

        if (priority == Priority.P1_MCP) {
            if (!uiQueue.isEmpty() && workerCount == 1) {
                return null;
            }
            int minIdx = workerCount >= 2 ? 1 : 0;
            return pickBestIdleWorkerLocked(binaryId, minIdx, workerCount - 1);
        }

        // P2_BG: only when UI and MCP queues are empty and concurrency cap allows.
        if (!uiQueue.isEmpty() || !mcpQueue.isEmpty() || activeBgCount >= maxBgConcurrent) {
            return null;
        }
        int minIdx = workerCount >= 2 ? 1 : 0;
        return pickBestIdleWorkerLocked(binaryId, minIdx, workerCount - 1);
    }

    private WorkerSlot pickBestIdleWorkerLocked(String binaryId, int startIdx, int endIdx) {
        WorkerSlot boundMatch = null;
        WorkerSlot uninitialized = null;
        WorkerSlot lruOther = null;

        for (int i = startIdx; i <= endIdx; i++) {
            WorkerSlot slot = workers[i];
            if (slot.busy) {
                continue;
            }
            if (binaryId.equals(slot.boundBinaryId) && slot.decomp != null && !slot.needsRecycle) {
                boundMatch = slot;
                break;
            }
            if (slot.decomp == null) {
                if (uninitialized == null) {
                    uninitialized = slot;
                }
            } else if (lruOther == null || slot.lastUsedAt < lruOther.lastUsedAt) {
                lruOther = slot;
            }
        }

        if (boundMatch != null) {
            return boundMatch;
        }
        if (uninitialized != null) {
            return uninitialized;
        }
        return lruOther;
    }

    private void releaseWorker(ActiveJob activeJob) {
        WorkerSlot slot = activeJob.slot;
        schedulerLock.lock();
        try {
            activeJobs.remove(activeJob);
            if (activeJob.countedAsBg && activeBgCount > 0) {
                activeBgCount--;
            }
            slot.busy = false;
            slot.lastUsedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();

            if (shuttingDown) {
                disposeWorker(slot);
                return;
            }

            dispatchSlotLocked(slot);
        } finally {
            schedulerLock.unlock();
        }
    }

    private void dispatchSlotLocked(WorkerSlot slot) {
        if (slot.busy || shuttingDown) {
            return;
        }
        QueuedWaiter next = pollNextWaiterForSlotLocked(slot.index);
        if (next != null) {
            next.assignedJob = assignWorkerLocked(
                    slot, next.binaryId, next.priority, next.monitor, next.inFlightEntry);
            next.cond.signal();
        }
    }

    private void dispatchIdleWaitersLocked() {
        for (WorkerSlot slot : workers) {
            if (!slot.busy) {
                dispatchSlotLocked(slot);
            }
        }
    }

    private QueuedWaiter pollNextWaiterForSlotLocked(int slotIndex) {
        if (workerCount >= 2 && slotIndex == 0) {
            return uiQueue.pollFirst();
        }
        QueuedWaiter ui = uiQueue.pollFirst();
        if (ui != null) {
            return ui;
        }
        QueuedWaiter mcp = mcpQueue.pollFirst();
        if (mcp != null) {
            return mcp;
        }
        if (uiQueue.isEmpty() && mcpQueue.isEmpty() && activeBgCount < maxBgConcurrent) {
            return bgQueue.pollFirst();
        }
        return null;
    }

    private void promoteInFlight(InFlightEntry entry, Priority callerPriority) {
        if (callerPriority.ordinal() >= entry.effectivePriority.ordinal()) {
            return;
        }
        schedulerLock.lock();
        try {
            if (callerPriority.ordinal() < entry.effectivePriority.ordinal()) {
                entry.effectivePriority = callerPriority;
                if (entry.activeJob != null && callerPriority.ordinal() < entry.activeJob.effectivePriority.ordinal()) {
                    entry.activeJob.effectivePriority = callerPriority;
                }
                QueuedWaiter w = entry.waiter;
                if (w != null && w.assignedJob == null && !w.cancelled && callerPriority.ordinal() < w.priority.ordinal()) {
                    removeWaiterLocked(w);
                    w.priority = callerPriority;
                    if (callerPriority == Priority.P0_UI) {
                        uiQueue.addLast(w);
                    } else if (callerPriority == Priority.P1_MCP) {
                        mcpQueue.addLast(w);
                    }
                    cancelActiveBgJobsLocked();
                    dispatchIdleWaitersLocked();
                }
            }
        } finally {
            schedulerLock.unlock();
        }
    }

    private void cancelActiveBgJobsLocked() {
        for (ActiveJob job : activeJobs) {
            if (job.effectivePriority == Priority.P2_BG) {
                job.monitor.cancel();
            }
        }
    }

    private void removeWaiterLocked(QueuedWaiter waiter) {
        uiQueue.remove(waiter);
        mcpQueue.remove(waiter);
        bgQueue.remove(waiter);
    }

    private static void cancelWaitersForBinary(Deque<QueuedWaiter> queue, String binaryId) {
        Iterator<QueuedWaiter> it = queue.iterator();
        while (it.hasNext()) {
            QueuedWaiter w = it.next();
            if (binaryId.equals(w.binaryId)) {
                it.remove();
                w.cancelled = true;
                w.failure = new ApiException(404, "BINARY_NOT_LOADED", "Binary unloaded: " + binaryId);
                w.cond.signal();
            }
        }
    }

    private static void failAllWaiters(Deque<QueuedWaiter> queue) {
        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            QueuedWaiter w = queue.pollFirst();
            w.cancelled = true;
            w.failure = new ApiException(503, "DAEMON_SHUTTING_DOWN", "Decompiler pool is shutting down", true);
            w.cond.signal();
        }
    }

    private void prepareWorker(WorkerSlot slot, LoadedBinary lb, int timeoutSec) {
        Program program = lb.getProgram();
        String binaryId = lb.getBinaryId();

        if (slot.needsRecycle || (slot.decomp != null && slot.childPid > 0 && !isProcessAlive(slot.childPid))) {
            disposeWorker(slot);
        }

        if (slot.decomp == null) {
            DecompInterface decomp = new DecompInterface();
            DecompileOptions options = buildOptions(program, timeoutSec);
            decomp.setOptions(options);
            decomp.toggleCCode(true);
            decomp.toggleSyntaxTree(true);

            synchronized (spawnLock) {
                long jvmPid = ProcessHandle.current().pid();
                Set<Long> beforePids = new HashSet<>(TierConfig.listChildDecompilePids(jvmPid));
                boolean opened = decomp.openProgram(program);
                if (!opened) {
                    String err = decomp.getLastMessage();
                    safeDispose(decomp);
                    throw new ApiException(
                            502,
                            "DECOMPILER_CRASHED",
                            "Failed to open program in decompiler: " + (err != null ? err : "unknown error"),
                            true);
                }
                long detectedPid = awaitNewChildPid(jvmPid, beforePids);
                slot.decomp = decomp;
                slot.boundBinaryId = binaryId;
                slot.childPid = detectedPid;
                slot.jobCount = 0;
                slot.needsRecycle = false;
            }
            return;
        }

        if (!binaryId.equals(slot.boundBinaryId)) {
            try {
                slot.decomp.closeProgram();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
                // Ignore closeProgram errors before re-opening.
            }
            DecompileOptions options = buildOptions(program, timeoutSec);
            slot.decomp.setOptions(options);
            boolean opened = slot.decomp.openProgram(program);
            if (!opened) {
                disposeWorker(slot);
                prepareWorker(slot, lb, timeoutSec);
                return;
            }
            slot.boundBinaryId = binaryId;
            return;
        }

        DecompileOptions currentOpts = slot.decomp.getOptions();
        if (currentOpts == null || currentOpts.getDefaultTimeout() != timeoutSec
                || currentOpts.getMaxPayloadMBytes() != tierConfig.getMaxPayloadMb()) {
            DecompileOptions updated = buildOptions(program, timeoutSec);
            slot.decomp.setOptions(updated);
        }
    }

    private DecompileOptions buildOptions(Program program, int timeoutSec) {
        DecompileOptions options = new DecompileOptions();
        options.grabFromProgram(program);
        options.setDefaultTimeout(timeoutSec);
        options.setMaxPayloadMBytes(tierConfig.getMaxPayloadMb());
        return options;
    }

    private long awaitNewChildPid(long jvmPid, Set<Long> beforePids) {
        long deadline = System.currentTimeMillis() + PID_POLL_TIMEOUT_MS;
        while (true) {
            long pid = findUnassignedChildPid(beforePids);
            if (pid > 0) {
                return pid;
            }
            if (System.currentTimeMillis() >= deadline) {
                return -1L;
            }
            try {
                Thread.sleep(PID_POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
            } catch (InterruptedException ie) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                return -1L;
            }
        }
    }

    private long findUnassignedChildPid(Set<Long> beforePids) {
        long jvmPid = ProcessHandle.current().pid();
        List<Long> currentPids = TierConfig.listChildDecompilePids(jvmPid);
        Set<Long> claimedPids = new HashSet<>();
        for (WorkerSlot slot : workers) {
            if (slot.childPid > 0) {
                claimedPids.add(slot.childPid);
            }
        }
        for (long pid : currentPids) {
            if (!beforePids.contains(pid) && !claimedPids.contains(pid)) {
                return pid;
            }
        }
        for (long pid : currentPids) {
            if (!claimedPids.contains(pid)) {
                return pid;
            }
        }
        return -1L;
    }

    private void disposeWorker(WorkerSlot slot) {
        DecompInterface decomp = slot.decomp;
        long pid = slot.childPid;
        slot.decomp = null;
        slot.boundBinaryId = null;
        slot.childPid = -1L;
        slot.jobCount = 0;
        slot.needsRecycle = false;

        if (decomp != null) {
            safeDispose(decomp);
        }
        if (pid > 0) {
            ProcessHandle.of(pid).ifPresent(ph -> {
                if (ph.isAlive()) {
                    ph.destroyForcibly();
                }
            });
        }
    }

    private static void safeDispose(DecompInterface decomp) {
        try {
            decomp.stopProcess();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // Best-effort process stop.
        }
        try {
            decomp.dispose();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // Best-effort decompiler dispose.
        }
    }

    private static boolean isProcessAlive(long pid) {
        return pid > 0 && ProcessHandle.of(pid).map(ProcessHandle::isAlive).orElse(false);
    }

    private ClangTokenExtractor.DecompileArtifact getCachedArtifact(String binaryId, String cacheKey) {
        Map<String, ClangTokenExtractor.DecompileArtifact> cache = binaryCaches.get(binaryId);
        if (cache == null) {
            return null;
        }
        synchronized (cache) {
            return cache.get(cacheKey);
        }
    }

    private void putCachedArtifact(String binaryId, String cacheKey, ClangTokenExtractor.DecompileArtifact artifact) {
        int maxEntries = Math.max(16, tierConfig.getDecompileLru());
        Map<String, ClangTokenExtractor.DecompileArtifact> cache = binaryCaches.computeIfAbsent(binaryId, id ->
                Collections.synchronizedMap(new LinkedHashMap<>(64, 0.75f, true) {
                    @Override
                    protected boolean removeEldestEntry(
                            Map.Entry<String, ClangTokenExtractor.DecompileArtifact> eldest) {
                        return size() > maxEntries;
                    }
                }));
        synchronized (cache) {
            cache.put(cacheKey, artifact);
        }
    }

    private void recordProblemFunction(String binaryId, String cacheKey, long revision) {
        problemFunctions.put(problemKey(binaryId, cacheKey, revision), Boolean.TRUE);
    }

    private void clearProblemFunctionsForBinary(String binaryId) {
        String prefix = binaryId + ":";
        synchronized (problemFunctions) {
            problemFunctions.keySet().removeIf(k -> k.startsWith(prefix));
        }
    }

    private static String problemKey(String binaryId, String cacheKey, long revision) {
        return binaryId + ":" + cacheKey + ":" + revision;
    }

    private static boolean containsTypeMatch(Set<String> usedTypes, String target) {
        if (usedTypes.contains(target)) {
            return true;
        }
        for (String used : usedTypes) {
            if (used.equalsIgnoreCase(target)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static String normalizeAddrKey(String addrHex) {
        String s = addrHex.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (s.startsWith("0x")) {
            s = s.substring(2);
        }
        try {
            long val = Long.parseUnsignedLong(s, 16);
            return "0x" + Long.toHexString(val);
        } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {
            return addrHex.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        }
    }

    private static ApiException buildTimeoutException(String binaryId, String entryHex, int timeoutSec) {
        return new ApiException(
                504,
                "DECOMPILE_TIMEOUT",
                "Decompilation of " + entryHex + " exceeded timeout (" + timeoutSec + "s).",
                true,
                Map.of(
                        "address", entryHex,
                        "timeoutSec", timeoutSec,
                        "fallbackEndpoint", "/v1/binaries/" + binaryId + "/disasm?addr=" + entryHex + "&after=80"));
    }

    private static ApiException rethrowApi(Throwable t) {
        if (t instanceof ApiException apiEx) {
            return apiEx;
        }
        return new ApiException(
                500,
                "INTERNAL_ERROR",
                t.getMessage() != null ? t.getMessage() : t.getClass().getSimpleName(),
                false,
                Collections.emptyMap(),
                t);
    }
}
```

`daemon/src/com/antigravity/ghidrare/EventBus.java`:

```java
package com.antigravity.ghidrare;

import com.google.gson.Gson;
import com.google.gson.GsonBuilder;
import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import com.google.gson.JsonSyntaxException;

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
import java.nio.file.StandardOpenOption;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Deque;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;
import java.util.concurrent.locks.Condition;
import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantLock;

/**
 * Monotonic event stream persisted to runtime-events.jsonl (and per-binary events.jsonl)
 * with a 2048-entry in-memory ring buffer and Condition-based virtual-thread long-poll wakeup.
 */
public final class EventBus {

    private static final int RING_CAPACITY = 2048;
    private static final long ROTATE_MAX_BYTES = 2L * 1024L * 1024L;

    public record EventEntry(
            long seq,
            long ts,
            String type,
            String actor,
            String binaryId,
            long revision,
            Map<String, Object> detail) {
        public Map<String, Object> toMap() {
            Map<String, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            map.put("seq", seq);
            map.put("ts", ts);
            map.put("type", type);
            map.put("actor", actor);
            map.put("binaryId", binaryId);
            map.put("revision", revision);
            map.put("detail", detail != null ? detail : Collections.emptyMap());
            return map;
        }
    }

    private final Path runtimeEventsPath;
    private final Gson compactGson;
    private final AtomicLong seq = new AtomicLong(0);
    private volatile long committedSeq = 0L;
    private final ReentrantLock lock = new ReentrantLock();
    private final Condition newEventCondition = lock.newCondition();
    private final Object fileWriteLock = new Object();
    private final Deque<EventEntry> ring = new ArrayDeque<>(RING_CAPACITY);
    private final Map<String, Path> binaryProjectDirs = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private volatile boolean closed = false;

    public EventBus(Path dataDir) {
        this.runtimeEventsPath = dataDir.resolve("runtime-events.jsonl");
        this.compactGson = new GsonBuilder()
                .disableHtmlEscaping()
                .serializeNulls()
                .create();
        seedFromExistingLog();
    }

    private void seedFromExistingLog() {
        long maxSeq = 0L;
        if (!Files.isRegularFile(runtimeEventsPath)) {
            Path rotated = runtimeEventsPath.resolveSibling(runtimeEventsPath.getFileName() + ".1");
            if (Files.isRegularFile(rotated)) {
                maxSeq = Math.max(maxSeq, scanMaxSeq(rotated, false));
            }
            seq.set(maxSeq);
            committedSeq = maxSeq;
            return;
        }
        maxSeq = scanMaxSeq(runtimeEventsPath, true);
        if (maxSeq == 0L) {
            Path rotated = runtimeEventsPath.resolveSibling(runtimeEventsPath.getFileName() + ".1");
            if (Files.isRegularFile(rotated)) {
                maxSeq = Math.max(maxSeq, scanMaxSeq(rotated, false));
            }
        }
        seq.set(maxSeq);
        committedSeq = maxSeq;
    }

    private long scanMaxSeq(Path path, boolean populateRing) {
        long maxSeq = 0L;
        Deque<EventEntry> recent = populateRing ? new ArrayDeque<>(RING_CAPACITY) : null;
        try (BufferedReader reader = Files.newBufferedReader(path, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            String line;
            while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
                String trimmed = line.trim();
                if (trimmed.isEmpty()) {
                    continue;
                }
                try {
                    JsonElement parsed = JsonParser.parseString(trimmed);
                    if (!parsed.isJsonObject()) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    JsonObject obj = parsed.getAsJsonObject();
                    if (!obj.has("seq") || !obj.get("seq").isJsonPrimitive()) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    long entrySeq = obj.get("seq").getAsLong();
                    if (entrySeq > maxSeq) {
                        maxSeq = entrySeq;
                    }
                    if (recent != null) {
                        long ts = obj.has("ts") && obj.get("ts").isJsonPrimitive() ? obj.get("ts").getAsLong() : 0L;
                        String type = obj.has("type") && !obj.get("type").isJsonNull() ? obj.get("type").getAsString() : "unknown";
                        String actor = obj.has("actor") && !obj.get("actor").isJsonNull() ? obj.get("actor").getAsString() : "system";
                        String binaryId = obj.has("binaryId") && !obj.get("binaryId").isJsonNull() ? obj.get("binaryId").getAsString() : null;
                        long revision = obj.has("revision") && obj.get("revision").isJsonPrimitive() ? obj.get("revision").getAsLong() : 0L;
                        Map<String, Object> detail = Collections.emptyMap();
                        if (obj.has("detail") && obj.get("detail").isJsonObject()) {
                            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
                            Map<String, Object> parsedDetail = compactGson.fromJson(obj.get("detail"), Map.class);
                            if (parsedDetail != null) {
                                detail = parsedDetail;
                            }
                        }
                        if (recent.size() >= RING_CAPACITY) {
                            recent.removeFirst();
                        }
                        recent.addLast(new EventEntry(entrySeq, ts, type, actor, binaryId, revision, detail));
                    }
                } catch (JsonSyntaxException | IllegalStateException ignored) {
                    // Ignore partial or corrupt trailing lines from a previous crash.
                }
            }
        } catch (IOException ignored) {
            return maxSeq;
        }
        if (recent != null && !recent.isEmpty()) {
            lock.lock();
            try {
                ring.clear();
                ring.addAll(recent);
            } finally {
                lock.unlock();
            }
        }
        return maxSeq;
    }

    public void registerBinaryProjectDir(String binaryId, Path projectDir) {
        if (binaryId != null && projectDir != null) {
            binaryProjectDirs.put(binaryId, projectDir);
        }
    }

    public void unregisterBinaryProjectDir(String binaryId) {
        if (binaryId != null) {
            binaryProjectDirs.remove(binaryId);
        }
    }

    public EventEntry publish(
            String type,
            String actor,
            String binaryId,
            long revision,
            Map<String, Object> detail) {
        Map<String, Object> safeDetail = detail != null
                ? Collections.unmodifiableMap(new LinkedHashMap<>(detail))
                : Collections.emptyMap();

        synchronized (fileWriteLock) {
            long nextSeq = seq.incrementAndGet();
            long ts = System.currentTimeMillis();
            EventEntry entry = new EventEntry(
                    nextSeq,
                    ts,
                    type != null ? type : "event",
                    actor != null ? actor : "system",
                    binaryId,
                    revision,
                    safeDetail);

            String jsonLine = compactGson.toJson(entry.toMap()) + "\n";
            appendJsonLine(runtimeEventsPath, jsonLine);
            if (binaryId != null) {
                Path projectDir = binaryProjectDirs.get(binaryId);
                if (projectDir != null && Files.isDirectory(projectDir)) {
                    appendJsonLine(projectDir.resolve("events.jsonl"), jsonLine);
                }
            }

            lock.lock();
            try {
                if (ring.size() >= RING_CAPACITY) {
                    ring.removeFirst();
                }
                ring.addLast(entry);
                committedSeq = nextSeq;
                newEventCondition.signalAll();
            } finally {
                lock.unlock();
            }
            return entry;
        }
    }

    private static void appendJsonLine(Path target, String line) {
        try {
            Path parent = target.getParent();
            if (parent != null) {
                Files.createDirectories(parent);
            }
            if (Files.isRegularFile(target) && Files.size(target) >= ROTATE_MAX_BYTES) {
                Path rotated = target.resolveSibling(target.getFileName() + ".1");
                Files.move(target, rotated, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
            }
            Files.writeString(
                    target,
                    line,
                    StandardCharsets.UTF_8,
                    StandardOpenOption.CREATE,
                    StandardOpenOption.WRITE,
                    StandardOpenOption.APPEND);
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            System.err.println("[ghidra-re] Failed to append event log " + target + ": " + ex.getMessage());
        }
    }

    public List<EventEntry> waitEvents(long sinceSeq, long timeoutMs, int limit) {
        long boundedTimeoutMs = Math.max(0L, Math.min(60_000L, timeoutMs));
        int boundedLimit = Math.max(1, Math.min(500, limit));
        long remainingNanos = TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toNanos(boundedTimeoutMs);

        lock.lock();
        try {
            while (true) {
                List<EventEntry> matching = collectSince(sinceSeq, boundedLimit);
                if (!matching.isEmpty() || closed || remainingNanos <= 0L) {
                    return matching;
                }
                try {
                    remainingNanos = newEventCondition.awaitNanos(remainingNanos);
                } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                    return collectSince(sinceSeq, boundedLimit);
                }
            }
        } finally {
            lock.unlock();
        }
    }

    private List<EventEntry> collectSince(long sinceSeq, int limit) {
        List<EventEntry> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (EventEntry entry : ring) {
            if (entry.seq() > sinceSeq) {
                result.add(entry);
                if (result.size() >= limit) {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public long getLatestSeq() {
        return committedSeq;
    }

    public void shutdown() {
        lock.lock();
        try {
            closed = true;
            newEventCondition.signalAll();
        } finally {
            lock.unlock();
        }
    }
}
```

`daemon/src/com/antigravity/ghidrare/IndexExporter.java`:

```java
package com.antigravity.ghidrare;

import com.google.gson.Gson;
import com.google.gson.GsonBuilder;
import ghidra.program.model.address.Address;
import ghidra.program.model.address.AddressIterator;
import ghidra.program.model.address.AddressSetView;
import ghidra.program.model.data.StringDataInstance;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.CommentType;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.Data;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.Function;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.FunctionIterator;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.FunctionManager;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.Listing;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.Program;
import ghidra.program.model.mem.Memory;
import ghidra.program.model.mem.MemoryBlock;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.ExternalLocation;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.Namespace;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.Reference;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.ReferenceManager;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.SymbolIterator;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.SymbolTable;
import ghidra.program.util.DefinedDataIterator;

import java.io.BufferedWriter;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Streams bulk UTF-8 NDJSON index records (meta, section, function, string, call_edge)
 * for Node.js SQLite ingestion under the binary's read lock.
 */
public final class IndexExporter {

    private static final int STRING_VALUE_MAX_CHARS = 4096;
    private static final Gson NDJSON_GSON = new GsonBuilder()
            .disableHtmlEscaping()
            .serializeNulls()
            .create();

    private IndexExporter() {
    }

    public static void exportNdjson(LoadedBinary lb, long sinceRevision, OutputStream out) throws IOException {
        Objects.requireNonNull(lb, "lb");
        Objects.requireNonNull(out, "out");

        lb.getRwLock().readLock().lock();
        try {
            if (lb.isClosed()) {
                throw new ApiException(404, "BINARY_NOT_LOADED", "Binary is not loaded: " + lb.getBinaryId());
            }
            lb.touchAccess();

            Program program = lb.getProgram();
            long currentRevision = lb.getRevision();
            int pointerSize = program.getDefaultPointerSize();

            SymbolTable symbolTable = program.getSymbolTable();
            FunctionManager functionManager = program.getFunctionManager();
            Memory memory = program.getMemory();
            Listing listing = program.getListing();
            ReferenceManager refMgr = program.getReferenceManager();

            BufferedWriter writer = new BufferedWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(out, StandardCharsets.UTF_8), 65536);

            if (sinceRevision > 0 && currentRevision <= sinceRevision) {
                Map<String, Object> unchanged = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                unchanged.put("record", "unchanged");
                unchanged.put("binaryId", lb.getBinaryId());
                unchanged.put("revision", currentRevision);
                writeRecord(writer, unchanged);
                writer.flush();
                return;
            }

            // 1. Meta record
            int importCount = countExternalSymbols(symbolTable);
            int exportCount = countExternalEntryPoints(symbolTable);

            Map<String, Object> meta = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            meta.put("record", "meta");
            meta.put("binaryId", lb.getBinaryId());
            meta.put("revision", currentRevision);
            meta.put("sha256", lb.getBinaryId());
            meta.put("arch", program.getLanguage().getProcessor().toString());
            meta.put("format", program.getExecutableFormat() != null ? program.getExecutableFormat() : "unknown");
            meta.put("endianness", program.getLanguage().isBigEndian() ? "big" : "little");
            meta.put("imageBase", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(program.getImageBase(), pointerSize));
            meta.put("pointerSize", pointerSize);
            meta.put("programName", program.getDomainFile() != null
                    ? program.getDomainFile().getName()
                    : program.getName());
            meta.put("analyzed", lb.isAnalyzed());
            meta.put("functionCount", functionManager.getFunctionCount());
            meta.put("importCount", importCount);
            meta.put("exportCount", exportCount);
            writeRecord(writer, meta);

            // 2. Section records
            for (MemoryBlock block : memory.getBlocks()) {
                Map<String, Object> sec = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                sec.put("record", "section");
                sec.put("name", block.getName() != null ? block.getName() : "");
                sec.put("startAddr", block.getStart().getOffset());
                sec.put("endAddr", block.getEnd().getOffset());
                sec.put("startHex", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(block.getStart(), pointerSize));
                sec.put("endHex", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(block.getEnd(), pointerSize));
                sec.put("sizeBytes", block.getSize());
                sec.put("perms",
                        (block.isRead() ? "r" : "-")
                                + (block.isWrite() ? "w" : "-")
                                + (block.isExecute() ? "x" : "-"));
                writeRecord(writer, sec);
            }

            // 3. Aggregate direct call edges and caller/callee counts across functions
            Map<Address, Map<Address, Integer>> callEdgesByCaller = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            Map<Address, Integer> callerCounts = new HashMap<>();
            Map<Address, Integer> calleeCounts = new HashMap<>();

            FunctionIterator edgeFnIt = functionManager.getFunctions(true);
            while (edgeFnIt.hasNext()) {
                Function caller = edgeFnIt.next();
                Address callerEntry = caller.getEntryPoint();
                AddressSetView body = caller.getBody();
                if (body == null || body.isEmpty()) {
                    continue;
                }
                Map<Address, Integer> callees = null;
                AddressIterator srcIt = refMgr.getReferenceSourceIterator(body, true);
                while (srcIt.hasNext()) {
                    Address fromAddr = srcIt.next();
                    for (Reference ref : refMgr.getReferencesFrom(fromAddr)) {
                        if (ref.getReferenceType() == null || !ref.getReferenceType().isCall()) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        Function callee = functionManager.getReferencedFunction(ref.getToAddress());
                        if (callee == null) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        Address calleeEntry = callee.getEntryPoint();
                        if (callees == null) {
                            callees = callEdgesByCaller.computeIfAbsent(callerEntry, k -> new LinkedHashMap<>());
                        }
                        boolean isNewEdge = !callees.containsKey(calleeEntry);
                        callees.merge(calleeEntry, 1, Integer::sum);
                        if (isNewEdge) {
                            calleeCounts.merge(callerEntry, 1, Integer::sum);
                            callerCounts.merge(calleeEntry, 1, Integer::sum);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // 4. Function records (internal/thunk functions first, then external functions without Address collision)
            Set<Address> emittedFunctionAddrs = new HashSet<>();
            FunctionIterator fnIt = functionManager.getFunctions(true);
            while (fnIt.hasNext()) {
                Function fn = fnIt.next();
                if (emittedFunctionAddrs.add(fn.getEntryPoint())) {
                    writeFunctionRecord(
                            writer, fn, listing, symbolTable, pointerSize, callerCounts, calleeCounts);
                }
            }

            FunctionIterator extFnIt = functionManager.getExternalFunctions();
            while (extFnIt.hasNext()) {
                Function fn = extFnIt.next();
                if (emittedFunctionAddrs.add(fn.getEntryPoint())) {
                    writeFunctionRecord(
                            writer, fn, listing, symbolTable, pointerSize, callerCounts, calleeCounts);
                }
            }

            // 5. String records
            DefinedDataIterator strIt = DefinedDataIterator.byDataInstance(program, StringDataInstance::isString);
            while (strIt.hasNext()) {
                Data data = strIt.next();
                Address addr = data.getAddress();
                StringDataInstance sdi = StringDataInstance.getStringDataInstance(data);
                if (sdi == null || sdi == StringDataInstance.NULL_INSTANCE) {
                    continue;
                }
                String value = sdi.getStringValue();
                if (value == null) {
                    value = sdi.getStringRepresentation();
                }
                if (value == null) {
                    value = "";
                }
                if (value.length() > STRING_VALUE_MAX_CHARS) {
                    value = value.substring(0, STRING_VALUE_MAX_CHARS);
                }
                String charset = sdi.getCharsetName();
                int byteLen = Math.max(0, sdi.getDataLength());
                MemoryBlock block = memory.getBlock(addr);
                String sectionName = (block != null && block.getName() != null) ? block.getName() : "";
                int xrefCount = refMgr.getReferenceCountTo(addr);

                Map<String, Object> strRec = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                strRec.put("record", "string");
                strRec.put("addr", addr.getOffset());
                strRec.put("addrHex", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(addr, pointerSize));
                strRec.put("value", value);
                strRec.put("encoding", charset != null && !charset.isBlank() ? charset : "UTF-8");
                strRec.put("byteLen", byteLen);
                strRec.put("section", sectionName);
                strRec.put("xrefCount", xrefCount);
                writeRecord(writer, strRec);
            }

            // 6. Call edge records
            for (Map.Entry<Address, Map<Address, Integer>> callerEntry : callEdgesByCaller.entrySet()) {
                Address callerAddr = callerEntry.getKey();
                String callerHex = LoadedBinary.formatAddress(callerAddr, pointerSize);
                long callerOffset = callerAddr.getOffset();

                for (Map.Entry<Address, Integer> edge : callerEntry.getValue().entrySet()) {
                    Address calleeAddr = edge.getKey();
                    Map<String, Object> edgeRec = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    edgeRec.put("record", "call_edge");
                    edgeRec.put("callerAddr", callerOffset);
                    edgeRec.put("calleeAddr", calleeAddr.getOffset());
                    edgeRec.put("callerHex", callerHex);
                    edgeRec.put("calleeHex", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(calleeAddr, pointerSize));
                    edgeRec.put("callCount", edge.getValue());
                    writeRecord(writer, edgeRec);
                }
            }

            writer.flush();
        } finally {
            lb.getRwLock().readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    private static void writeFunctionRecord(
            BufferedWriter writer,
            Function fn,
            Listing listing,
            SymbolTable symbolTable,
            int pointerSize,
            Map<Address, Integer> callerCounts,
            Map<Address, Integer> calleeCounts) throws IOException {

        Address entry = fn.getEntryPoint();
        AddressSetView body = fn.getBody();
        Address end = (body != null && !body.isEmpty() && body.getMaxAddress() != null)
                ? body.getMaxAddress()
                : entry;

        Namespace ns = fn.getParentNamespace();
        String namespace = (ns == null || ns.isGlobal()) ? "Global" : ns.getName(true);
        String signature = fn.getPrototypeString(false, false);
        long sizeBytes = body != null ? body.getNumAddresses() : 0L;

        boolean isThunk = fn.isThunk();
        Function thunked = isThunk ? fn.getThunkedFunction(true) : null;
        Memory mem = fn.getProgram() != null ? fn.getProgram().getMemory() : null;
        MemoryBlock fnBlock = (mem != null && entry != null) ? mem.getBlock(entry) : null;
        MemoryBlock thunkBlock = (mem != null && thunked != null && thunked.getEntryPoint() != null)
                ? mem.getBlock(thunked.getEntryPoint())
                : null;
        String fnBlockName = (fnBlock != null && fnBlock.getName() != null) ? fnBlock.getName() : "";
        String thunkBlockName = (thunkBlock != null && thunkBlock.getName() != null) ? thunkBlock.getName() : "";
        boolean isImport = fn.isExternal()
                || (thunked != null && thunked.isExternal())
                || "EXTERNAL".equalsIgnoreCase(fnBlockName)
                || fnBlockName.startsWith(".plt")
                || "EXTERNAL".equalsIgnoreCase(thunkBlockName);
        boolean isExport = !isImport && symbolTable.isExternalEntryPoint(entry);

        String externalLib = null;
        if (isImport) {
            ExternalLocation extLoc = fn.isExternal()
                    ? fn.getExternalLocation()
                    : (thunked != null ? thunked.getExternalLocation() : null);
            if (extLoc != null) {
                externalLib = extLoc.getLibraryName();
            }
        }

        String plateComment = listing.getComment(CommentType.PLATE, entry);
        boolean hasComment = plateComment != null && !plateComment.isEmpty();

        Map<String, Object> fnRec = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        fnRec.put("record", "function");
        fnRec.put("entryAddr", entry.getOffset());
        fnRec.put("entryHex", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(entry, pointerSize));
        fnRec.put("endHex", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(end, pointerSize));
        fnRec.put("name", fn.getName());
        fnRec.put("namespace", namespace);
        fnRec.put("signature", signature != null ? signature : fn.getName() + "()");
        fnRec.put("sizeBytes", sizeBytes);
        fnRec.put("isImport", isImport);
        fnRec.put("isExport", isExport);
        fnRec.put("isThunk", isThunk);
        fnRec.put("externalLib", externalLib);
        fnRec.put("callerCount", callerCounts.getOrDefault(entry, 0));
        fnRec.put("calleeCount", calleeCounts.getOrDefault(entry, 0));
        fnRec.put("hasComment", hasComment);
        writeRecord(writer, fnRec);
    }

    private static int countExternalSymbols(SymbolTable symbolTable) {
        int count = 0;
        SymbolIterator it = symbolTable.getExternalSymbols();
        while (it.hasNext()) {
            it.next();
            count++;
        }
        return count;
    }

    private static int countExternalEntryPoints(SymbolTable symbolTable) {
        int count = 0;
        AddressIterator it = symbolTable.getExternalEntryPointIterator();
        while (it.hasNext()) {
            it.next();
            count++;
        }
        return count;
    }

    private static void writeRecord(BufferedWriter writer, Map<String, Object> record) throws IOException {
        NDJSON_GSON.toJson(record, writer);
        writer.write('\n');
    }
}
```

```java
package com.antigravity.ghidrare;

import ghidra.program.model.address.Address;
import ghidra.program.model.address.AddressFactory;
import ghidra.program.model.address.AddressIterator;
import ghidra.program.model.address.AddressOutOfBoundsException;

import ghidra.util.exception.CancelledException;
import ghidra.util.task.TaskMonitor;

import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;

import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.Deque;

/**
 * Thread-safe Ghidra Program inspection service implementing address/symbol resolution,
 * function listing, disassembly, BasicBlockModel CFG extraction with LRU caching and DFS
 * back-edge detection, call graphs, cross-references, and data/pointer-table inspection.
 */
public final class InspectionService {

    private static final Pattern HEX_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("^[0-9a-fA-F]+$");
    private static final int MAX_DISASM_WINDOW = 400;
    private static final int MAX_LIST_LIMIT = 200;
    private static final int MAX_CALLGRAPH_DEPTH = 8;
    private static final int MAX_CALLGRAPH_NODES = 200;
    private static final int MAX_DATA_LENGTH = 4096;
    private static final int EGO_SUBGRAPH_HOPS = 3;

    private record CfgCacheEntry(long revision, Map<String, Object> payload) {
    }

    private record ExternalCandidate(String libraryName, String symbolName, String thunkAddrHex) {
    }

    private final TierConfig tierConfig;
    private final Supplier<Collection<LoadedBinary>> loadedBinariesSupplier;
    private final Map<String, CfgCacheEntry> cfgCache;

    public InspectionService(
            TierConfig tierConfig,
            Supplier<Collection<LoadedBinary>> loadedBinariesSupplier) {
        this.tierConfig = tierConfig;
        this.loadedBinariesSupplier = loadedBinariesSupplier != null
                ? loadedBinariesSupplier
                : Collections::emptyList;
        int cfgCapacity = Math.max(16, tierConfig != null ? tierConfig.getCfgLru() : 128);
        this.cfgCache = Collections.synchronizedMap(new LinkedHashMap<>(32, 0.75f, true) {
            @Override
            protected boolean removeEldestEntry(Map.Entry<String, CfgCacheEntry> eldest) {
                return size() > cfgCapacity;
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * Parses a hex address (e.g. {@code 0x4012a0}, {@code 4012a0}, or {@code ram:004012a0})
     * against the program's AddressFactory.
     */
    public Address parseAddress(Program program, String addrStr) {
        if (addrStr == null || addrStr.isBlank()) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_ADDRESS", "Address parameter is required");
        }
        String trimmed = addrStr.trim();
        AddressFactory factory = program.getAddressFactory();

        if (trimmed.indexOf(':') >= 0) {
            Address spaced = factory.getAddress(trimmed);
            if (spaced != null) {
                return spaced;
            }
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_ADDRESS", "Invalid address: " + addrStr);
        }

        String hex = trimmed;
        if (hex.startsWith("0x") || hex.startsWith("0X")) {
            hex = hex.substring(2);
        }
        if (hex.isEmpty() || !HEX_PATTERN.matcher(hex).matches()) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_ADDRESS", "Invalid hex address: " + addrStr);
        }
        try {
            long offset = Long.parseUnsignedLong(hex, 16);
            return factory.getDefaultAddressSpace().getAddress(offset);
        } catch (NumberFormatException | AddressOutOfBoundsException ex) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_ADDRESS", "Invalid address: " + addrStr, false,
                    Collections.emptyMap(), ex);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Resolves a function by hex address (entry or interior) or by function name / prefix.
     */
    public Function resolveFunction(LoadedBinary lb, String target) {
        ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
        if (target == null || target.isBlank()) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Function target is required");
        }
        String trimmed = target.trim();

        lb.getRwLock().readLock().lock();
        try {
            ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
            Program program = lb.getProgram();
            FunctionManager fm = program.getFunctionManager();

            boolean explicitAddress = trimmed.startsWith("0x") || trimmed.startsWith("0X")
                    || trimmed.indexOf(':') >= 0;
            if (explicitAddress) {
                Address addr = parseAddress(program, trimmed);
                Function fn = fm.getFunctionAt(addr);
                if (fn == null) {
                    fn = fm.getFunctionContaining(addr);
                }
                if (fn == null) {
                    throw new ApiException(404, "FUNCTION_NOT_FOUND", "No function at address: " + target);
                }
                return fn;
            }

            // Try exact symbol/function name match first (case-sensitive, then case-insensitive).
            Function exactCiMatch = null;
            FunctionIterator it = fm.getFunctions(true);
            while (it.hasNext()) {
                Function fn = it.next();
                String name = fn.getName();
                if (name.equals(trimmed)) {
                    return fn;
                }
                if (exactCiMatch == null && name.equalsIgnoreCase(trimmed)) {
                    exactCiMatch = fn;
                }
            }
            if (exactCiMatch != null) {
                return exactCiMatch;
            }

            // Check external functions for exact name match.
            FunctionIterator extIt = fm.getExternalFunctions();
            while (extIt.hasNext()) {
                Function fn = extIt.next();
                if (fn.getName().equals(trimmed)) {
                    return fn;
                }
                if (exactCiMatch == null && fn.getName().equalsIgnoreCase(trimmed)) {
                    exactCiMatch = fn;
                }
            }
            if (exactCiMatch != null) {
                return exactCiMatch;
            }

            // If pure hex without 0x prefix, try parsing as address.
            if (HEX_PATTERN.matcher(trimmed).matches()) {
                Address addr = tryParseAddress(program, trimmed);
                if (addr != null) {
                    Function fn = fm.getFunctionAt(addr);
                    if (fn == null) {
                        fn = fm.getFunctionContaining(addr);
                    }
                    if (fn != null) {
                        return fn;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Prefix fallback (case-sensitive preferred, then case-insensitive, shortest name wins).
            Function prefixCs = null;
            Function prefixCi = null;
            FunctionIterator prefixIt = fm.getFunctions(true);
            while (prefixIt.hasNext()) {
                Function fn = prefixIt.next();
                String name = fn.getName();
                if (name.startsWith(trimmed)) {
                    if (prefixCs == null || name.length() < prefixCs.getName().length()) {
                        prefixCs = fn;
                    }
                } else if (name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).startsWith(trimmed.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))) {
                    if (prefixCi == null || name.length() < prefixCi.getName().length()) {
                        prefixCi = fn;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (prefixCs != null) {
                return prefixCs;
            }
            if (prefixCi != null) {
                return prefixCi;
            }

            throw new ApiException(404, "FUNCTION_NOT_FOUND", "Function not found: " + target);
        } finally {
            lb.getRwLock().readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Universal address and symbol resolver (Section 4.4.7).
     */
    public Map<String, Object> resolveTarget(LoadedBinary lb, String query) {
        ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
        if (query == null || query.isBlank()) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Query parameter 'q' is required");
        }
        lb.touchAccess();
        String trimmed = query.trim();

        Map<String, Object> result;
        ExternalCandidate extCandidate = null;
        String primaryBinaryPath = null;

        lb.getRwLock().readLock().lock();
        try {
            ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
            Program program = lb.getProgram();
            int ptrSize = program.getDefaultPointerSize();
            Memory memory = program.getMemory();
            Listing listing = program.getListing();
            FunctionManager fm = program.getFunctionManager();
            SymbolTable symbolTable = program.getSymbolTable();

            Object pathObj = lb.toSummaryMap().get("primaryPath");
            if (pathObj instanceof String p) {
                primaryBinaryPath = p;
            }

            Address addr = null;
            Symbol matchedSymbol = null;

            boolean explicitAddress = trimmed.startsWith("0x") || trimmed.startsWith("0X")
                    || trimmed.indexOf(':') >= 0;
            if (explicitAddress) {
                addr = parseAddress(program, trimmed);
                matchedSymbol = symbolTable.getPrimarySymbol(addr);
            } else {
                matchedSymbol = findBestSymbolByName(program, trimmed);
                if (matchedSymbol != null) {
                    addr = matchedSymbol.getAddress();
                } else if (HEX_PATTERN.matcher(trimmed).matches()) {
                    addr = tryParseAddress(program, trimmed);
                    if (addr != null) {
                        matchedSymbol = symbolTable.getPrimarySymbol(addr);
                    }
                }
            }

            result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            result.put("binaryId", lb.getBinaryId());
            result.put("query", trimmed);

            if (addr == null) {
                result.put("resolved", false);
                result.put("address", null);
                result.put("kind", "unmapped");
                result.put("section", null);
                result.put("perms", null);
                result.put("symbol", null);
                result.put("containingFunction", null);
                result.put("externalTarget", null);
                result.put("recommendedView", "disasm");
                return result;
            }

            // External space symbol / external function
            if (addr.isExternalAddress() || (matchedSymbol != null && matchedSymbol.isExternal())) {
                ExternalLocation extLoc = resolveExternalLocation(program, matchedSymbol, addr);
                String libName = extLoc != null ? emptyToNull(extLoc.getLibraryName()) : null;
                String symName = extLoc != null && extLoc.getLabel() != null
                        ? extLoc.getLabel()
                        : (matchedSymbol != null ? matchedSymbol.getName() : trimmed);
                extCandidate = new ExternalCandidate(libName, symName, null);

                result.put("resolved", true);
                result.put("address", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(addr, ptrSize));
                result.put("kind", "external_unloaded");
                result.put("section", "EXTERNAL");
                result.put("perms", "---");
                result.put("symbol", symName);
                result.put("containingFunction", null);
                result.put("externalTarget", null);
                result.put("libraryName", libName);
                result.put("symbolName", symName);
                result.put("candidatePaths", findCandidateLibraryPaths(program, libName, primaryBinaryPath));
                result.put("recommendedView", "import_popover");
            } else if (!memory.contains(addr)) {
                result.put("resolved", false);
                result.put("address", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(addr, ptrSize));
                result.put("kind", "unmapped");
                result.put("section", null);
                result.put("perms", null);
                result.put("symbol", matchedSymbol != null ? matchedSymbol.getName() : null);
                result.put("containingFunction", null);
                result.put("externalTarget", null);
                result.put("recommendedView", "disasm");
                return result;
            } else {
                MemoryBlock block = memory.getBlock(addr);
                String sectionName = block != null ? block.getName() : null;
                String perms = formatPermissions(block);
                String symName = matchedSymbol != null ? matchedSymbol.getName() : null;
                Function containingFn = fm.getFunctionContaining(addr);

                result.put("resolved", true);
                result.put("address", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(addr, ptrSize));
                result.put("section", sectionName);
                result.put("perms", perms);
                result.put("symbol", symName);

                if (containingFn != null) {
                    Map<String, Object> fnInfo = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    fnInfo.put("addr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(containingFn.getEntryPoint(), ptrSize));
                    fnInfo.put("name", containingFn.getName());
                    result.put("containingFunction", fnInfo);
                    result.put("externalTarget", null);

                    boolean isPltOrExternalSection = sectionName != null
                            && ("EXTERNAL".equalsIgnoreCase(sectionName) || sectionName.startsWith(".plt"));
                    if (containingFn.isThunk() || isPltOrExternalSection) {
                        Function thunked = containingFn.isThunk() ? containingFn.getThunkedFunction(true) : null;
                        boolean isExtImport = isPltOrExternalSection
                                || isImportFunction(containingFn)
                                || containingFn.getEntryPoint().equals(addr);
                        if (isExtImport) {
                            ExternalLocation extLoc = (thunked != null && thunked.isExternal())
                                    ? thunked.getExternalLocation()
                                    : (containingFn.isExternal() ? containingFn.getExternalLocation() : null);
                            String libName = extLoc != null ? emptyToNull(extLoc.getLibraryName()) : resolveExternalLibName(containingFn);
                            String extSymName = extLoc != null && extLoc.getLabel() != null
                                    ? extLoc.getLabel()
                                    : (thunked != null ? thunked.getName() : containingFn.getName());
                            extCandidate = new ExternalCandidate(
                                    libName,
                                    extSymName,
                                    LoadedBinary.formatAddress(containingFn.getEntryPoint(), ptrSize));
                            result.put("kind", "import_thunk");
                            result.put("libraryName", libName);
                            result.put("symbolName", extSymName);
                            result.put("candidatePaths",
                                    findCandidateLibraryPaths(program, libName, primaryBinaryPath));
                            result.put("recommendedView", "import_popover");
                        } else {
                            result.put("kind", "function_interior");
                            result.put("recommendedView", "disasm");
                        }
                    } else if (containingFn.getEntryPoint().equals(addr)) {
                        result.put("kind", "function_entry");
                        result.put("recommendedView", "decompile");
                    } else {
                        result.put("kind", "function_interior");
                        result.put("recommendedView", "disasm");
                    }
                } else {
                    result.put("containingFunction", null);
                    result.put("externalTarget", null);

                    Instruction insn = listing.getInstructionContaining(addr);
                    Data data = listing.getDataContaining(addr);
                    if (insn != null) {
                        result.put("kind", "code_unmapped_func");
                        result.put("recommendedView", "disasm");
                    } else if (data != null && data.isDefined()) {
                        if (StringDataInstance.isString(data)) {
                            result.put("kind", "string");
                        } else if (isPointerTable(program, addr, data)) {
                            result.put("kind", "pointer_table");
                        } else {
                            result.put("kind", "data_defined");
                        }
                        result.put("recommendedView", "data_inspector");
                    } else if (isPointerTable(program, addr, null)) {
                        result.put("kind", "pointer_table");
                        result.put("recommendedView", "data_inspector");
                    } else if (block != null && block.isExecute() && hasExecutableBytes(block, addr)) {
                        result.put("kind", "code_unmapped_func");
                        result.put("recommendedView", "disasm");
                    } else {
                        result.put("kind", "data_raw");
                        result.put("recommendedView", "data_inspector");
                    }
                }
            }
        } finally {
            lb.getRwLock().readLock().unlock();
        }

        // Cross-binary external_resolved lookup outside lb's readLock to preserve lock independence.
        if (extCandidate != null) {
            Map<String, Object> resolvedExt = findExternalTargetInLoadedBinaries(
                    lb.getBinaryId(), extCandidate.libraryName(), extCandidate.symbolName());
            if (resolvedExt != null) {
                result.put("kind", "external_resolved");
                result.put("externalTarget", resolvedExt);
                result.put("recommendedView", "import_popover");
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    /**
     * Lists functions with search, kind filtering, sorting, and cursor pagination.
     */
    public Map<String, Object> listFunctions(
            LoadedBinary lb,
            String q,
            String kind,
            String sort,
            int limit,
            String cursor) {
        ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
        lb.touchAccess();

        String normalizedKind = (kind == null || kind.isBlank())
                ? "all"
                : kind.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (!Set.of("all", "user", "import", "export").contains(normalizedKind)) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Invalid kind: " + kind);
        }

        String normalizedSort = (sort == null || sort.isBlank())
                ? "addr"
                : sort.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (!Set.of("addr", "name", "size").contains(normalizedSort)) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Invalid sort: " + sort);
        }

        int effectiveLimit = limit <= 0 ? 50 : Math.min(MAX_LIST_LIMIT, limit);
        int offset = decodeOffsetCursor(cursor);
        String filterLower = (q != null && !q.isBlank()) ? q.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT) : null;

        lb.getRwLock().readLock().lock();
        try {
            ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
            Program program = lb.getProgram();
            FunctionManager fm = program.getFunctionManager();
            SymbolTable symbolTable = program.getSymbolTable();
            int ptrSize = program.getDefaultPointerSize();

            List<Map<String, Object>> matching = new ArrayList<>();
            Set<String> seenExternalLocations = new HashSet<>();

            FunctionIterator it = fm.getFunctions(true);
            while (it.hasNext()) {
                Function fn = it.next();
                FunctionSummaryRow row = buildFunctionRow(fn, symbolTable, ptrSize);
                if (row.externalKey != null) {
                    seenExternalLocations.add(row.externalKey);
                }
                if (matchesFunctionFilter(row, normalizedKind, filterLower)) {
                    matching.add(row.map);
                }
            }

            if ("all".equals(normalizedKind) || "import".equals(normalizedKind)) {
                FunctionIterator extIt = fm.getExternalFunctions();
                while (extIt.hasNext()) {
                    Function fn = extIt.next();
                    FunctionSummaryRow row = buildFunctionRow(fn, symbolTable, ptrSize);
                    if (row.externalKey != null && seenExternalLocations.contains(row.externalKey)) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (matchesFunctionFilter(row, normalizedKind, filterLower)) {
                        matching.add(row.map);
                    }
                }
            }

            Comparator<Map<String, Object>> addrCmp = (a, b) -> Long.compareUnsigned(
                    ((Number) a.get("_sortAddr")).longValue(),
                    ((Number) b.get("_sortAddr")).longValue());
            Comparator<Map<String, Object>> cmp = switch (normalizedSort) {
                case "name" -> Comparator
                        .comparing((Map<String, Object> m) -> ((String) m.get("name")).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))
                        .thenComparing(addrCmp);
                case "size" -> Comparator
                        .comparingLong((Map<String, Object> m) -> -((Number) m.get("sizeBytes")).longValue())
                        .thenComparing(addrCmp);
                default -> addrCmp;
            };
            matching.sort(cmp);

            int total = matching.size();
            int startIdx = Math.min(offset, total);
            int endIdx = Math.min(startIdx + effectiveLimit, total);
            List<Map<String, Object>> items = new ArrayList<>(endIdx - startIdx);
            for (int i = startIdx; i < endIdx; i++) {
                Map<String, Object> item = new LinkedHashMap<>(matching.get(i));
                item.remove("_sortAddr");
```
