                items.add(item);
            }
            String nextCursor = endIdx < total ? encodeOffsetCursor(endIdx) : null;

            Map<String, Object> response = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            response.put("binaryId", lb.getBinaryId());
            response.put("revision", lb.getRevision());
            response.put("total", total);
            response.put("nextCursor", nextCursor);
            response.put("items", items);
            return response;
        } finally {
            lb.getRwLock().readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Disassembles a bounded window of instructions around an address (Section 4.4.2).
     */
    public Map<String, Object> disassemble(
            LoadedBinary lb,
            String addrStr,
            int before,
            int after,
            boolean includeBytes) {
        ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
        lb.touchAccess();

        int safeBefore = Math.max(0, before);
        int safeAfter = Math.max(0, after);
        if (safeBefore + safeAfter > MAX_DISASM_WINDOW) {
            safeBefore = Math.min(safeBefore, MAX_DISASM_WINDOW);
            safeAfter = Math.min(safeAfter, MAX_DISASM_WINDOW - safeBefore);
        }

        lb.getRwLock().readLock().lock();
        try {
            ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
            Program program = lb.getProgram();
            Memory memory = program.getMemory();
            Listing listing = program.getListing();
            FunctionManager fm = program.getFunctionManager();
            SymbolTable symbolTable = program.getSymbolTable();
            ReferenceManager refMgr = program.getReferenceManager();
            int ptrSize = program.getDefaultPointerSize();

            Address addr = parseAddress(program, addrStr);
            if (!memory.contains(addr)) {
                throw new ApiException(404, "UNMAPPED_ADDRESS", "Address is not mapped in memory: " + addrStr);
            }

            Instruction anchor = listing.getInstructionContaining(addr);
            if (anchor == null) {
                Instruction nextInsn = listing.getInstructionAfter(addr);
                MemoryBlock addrBlock = memory.getBlock(addr);
                if (nextInsn != null && addrBlock != null && addrBlock.contains(nextInsn.getMinAddress())) {
                    anchor = nextInsn;
                }
            }

            List<Instruction> collected = new ArrayList<>();
            boolean hasMoreBefore = false;
            boolean hasMoreAfter = false;

            if (anchor != null) {
                List<Instruction> beforeList = new ArrayList<>(safeBefore);
                Instruction cur = anchor;
                for (int i = 0; i < safeBefore; i++) {
                    Instruction prev = listing.getInstructionBefore(cur.getMinAddress());
                    if (prev == null) {
                        break;
                    }
                    beforeList.add(prev);
                    cur = prev;
                }
                if (listing.getInstructionBefore(cur.getMinAddress()) != null) {
                    hasMoreBefore = true;
                }
                Collections.reverse(beforeList);
                collected.addAll(beforeList);
                collected.add(anchor);

                cur = anchor;
                for (int i = 0; i < safeAfter; i++) {
                    Instruction next = listing.getInstructionAfter(cur.getMinAddress());
                    if (next == null) {
                        break;
                    }
                    collected.add(next);
                    cur = next;
                }
                if (listing.getInstructionAfter(cur.getMinAddress()) != null) {
                    hasMoreAfter = true;
                }
            }

            List<Map<String, Object>> insnMaps = new ArrayList<>(collected.size());
            for (Instruction insn : collected) {
                insnMaps.add(formatInstruction(program, insn, listing, fm, symbolTable, refMgr, ptrSize, includeBytes));
            }

            Function containingFn = fm.getFunctionContaining(anchor != null ? anchor.getMinAddress() : addr);
            String startAddrHex = !collected.isEmpty()
                    ? LoadedBinary.formatAddress(collected.get(0).getMinAddress(), ptrSize)
                    : LoadedBinary.formatAddress(addr, ptrSize);
            String endAddrHex = !collected.isEmpty()
                    ? LoadedBinary.formatAddress(collected.get(collected.size() - 1).getMaxAddress(), ptrSize)
                    : LoadedBinary.formatAddress(addr, ptrSize);

            Map<String, Object> response = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            response.put("binaryId", lb.getBinaryId());
            response.put("revision", lb.getRevision());
            response.put("startAddr", startAddrHex);
            response.put("endAddr", endAddrHex);
            response.put("functionEntry", containingFn != null
                    ? LoadedBinary.formatAddress(containingFn.getEntryPoint(), ptrSize)
                    : null);
            response.put("hasMoreBefore", hasMoreBefore);
            response.put("hasMoreAfter", hasMoreAfter);
            response.put("instructions", insnMaps);
            return response;
        } finally {
            lb.getRwLock().readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Builds the BasicBlockModel Control Flow Graph for a function with LRU caching,
     * ego-subgraph truncation around {@code focusAddrStr}, and DFS back-edge tagging (Section 4.4.3).
     */
    public Map<String, Object> getCfg(
            LoadedBinary lb,
            String funcTarget,
            Integer requestedMaxBlocks,
            String focusAddrStr,
            boolean includeInsns) {
        ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
        lb.touchAccess();

        Function fn = resolveFunction(lb, funcTarget);
        int hardCap = tierConfig != null ? tierConfig.getCfgMaxBlocks() : 350;
        int blockLimit = requestedMaxBlocks != null
                ? Math.max(1, Math.min(hardCap, requestedMaxBlocks))
                : hardCap;

        lb.getRwLock().readLock().lock();
        try {
            ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
            Program program = lb.getProgram();
            int ptrSize = program.getDefaultPointerSize();
            String funcEntryHex = LoadedBinary.formatAddress(fn.getEntryPoint(), ptrSize);
            Address focusAddr = (focusAddrStr != null && !focusAddrStr.isBlank())
                    ? parseAddress(program, focusAddrStr)
                    : null;
            String focusHex = focusAddr != null ? LoadedBinary.formatAddress(focusAddr, ptrSize) : "";
            long rev = lb.getRevision();

            String cacheKey = cfgCacheKey(lb.getBinaryId(), funcEntryHex, blockLimit, focusHex, includeInsns);
            CfgCacheEntry cached = cfgCache.get(cacheKey);
            if (cached != null && cached.revision() == rev) {
                return cached.payload();
            }

            Map<String, Object> computed = buildCfgLocked(
                    lb, program, fn, funcEntryHex, blockLimit, focusAddr, includeInsns, ptrSize, rev);
            cfgCache.put(cacheKey, new CfgCacheEntry(rev, computed));
            return computed;
        } finally {
            lb.getRwLock().readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Invalidates cached CFGs for specific function entry addresses in a binary.
     */
    public void invalidateCfg(String binaryId, Collection<String> funcEntryHexes) {
        if (binaryId == null || funcEntryHexes == null || funcEntryHexes.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }
        Set<String> normalized = new HashSet<>();
        for (String hex : funcEntryHexes) {
            if (hex != null) {
                normalized.add(hex.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
            }
        }
        String prefix = binaryId + "|";
        synchronized (cfgCache) {
            Iterator<String> it = cfgCache.keySet().iterator();
            while (it.hasNext()) {
                String key = it.next();
                if (!key.startsWith(prefix)) {
                    continue;
                }
                int firstSep = key.indexOf('|');
                int secondSep = key.indexOf('|', firstSep + 1);
                if (secondSep > firstSep) {
                    String fnHex = key.substring(firstSep + 1, secondSep).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
                    if (normalized.contains(fnHex)) {
                        it.remove();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Invalidates all cached CFGs for an unloaded or closed binary.
     */
    public void invalidateCfgForBinary(String binaryId) {
        if (binaryId == null) {
            return;
        }
        String prefix = binaryId + "|";
        synchronized (cfgCache) {
            cfgCache.keySet().removeIf(k -> k.startsWith(prefix));
        }
    }

    /**
     * Builds a bounded live call graph around a target function (Section 4.4.4).
     */
    public Map<String, Object> getCallGraph(
            LoadedBinary lb,
            String funcTarget,
            String direction,
            int depth,
            int maxNodes) {
        ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
        lb.touchAccess();

        String normalizedDir = (direction == null || direction.isBlank())
                ? "both"
                : direction.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (!Set.of("both", "callers", "callees").contains(normalizedDir)) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Invalid callgraph direction: " + direction);
        }

        int boundedDepth = Math.max(1, Math.min(MAX_CALLGRAPH_DEPTH, depth <= 0 ? 2 : depth));
        int boundedMaxNodes = Math.max(1, Math.min(MAX_CALLGRAPH_NODES, maxNodes <= 0 ? 100 : maxNodes));
        Function root = resolveFunction(lb, funcTarget);

        lb.getRwLock().readLock().lock();
        try {
            ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
            Program program = lb.getProgram();
            int ptrSize = program.getDefaultPointerSize();

            Map<String, Function> visitedByHex = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            Deque<FunctionDepth> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
            String rootHex = LoadedBinary.formatAddress(root.getEntryPoint(), ptrSize);
            visitedByHex.put(rootHex, root);
            queue.add(new FunctionDepth(root, 0));

            boolean truncated = false;
            boolean wantCallers = "both".equals(normalizedDir) || "callers".equals(normalizedDir);
            boolean wantCallees = "both".equals(normalizedDir) || "callees".equals(normalizedDir);

            while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                FunctionDepth current = queue.poll();
                if (current.depth >= boundedDepth) {
                    if (hasMoreNeighbors(current.fn, wantCallers, wantCallees, visitedByHex, ptrSize)) {
                        truncated = true;
                    }
                    continue;
                }
                List<Function> neighbors = new ArrayList<>();
                if (wantCallers) {
                    neighbors.addAll(current.fn.getCallingFunctions(TaskMonitor.DUMMY));
                }
                if (wantCallees) {
                    neighbors.addAll(current.fn.getCalledFunctions(TaskMonitor.DUMMY));
                }
                neighbors.sort(Comparator.comparing(f -> f.getEntryPoint()));

                for (Function neighbor : neighbors) {
                    String nHex = LoadedBinary.formatAddress(neighbor.getEntryPoint(), ptrSize);
                    if (visitedByHex.containsKey(nHex)) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (visitedByHex.size() >= boundedMaxNodes) {
                        truncated = true;
                        break;
                    }
                    visitedByHex.put(nHex, neighbor);
                    queue.add(new FunctionDepth(neighbor, current.depth + 1));
                }
            }

            List<Map<String, Object>> nodes = new ArrayList<>(visitedByHex.size());
            List<Map<String, Object>> edges = new ArrayList<>();
            Set<String> seenEdges = new HashSet<>();

            for (Map.Entry<String, Function> entry : visitedByHex.entrySet()) {
                String fnHex = entry.getKey();
                Function fn = entry.getValue();
                Set<Function> callers = fn.getCallingFunctions(TaskMonitor.DUMMY);
                Set<Function> callees = fn.getCalledFunctions(TaskMonitor.DUMMY);

                boolean isImport = isImportFunction(fn);
                String externalLib = resolveExternalLibName(fn);

                Map<String, Object> node = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                node.put("addr", fnHex);
                node.put("name", fn.getName());
                node.put("sizeBytes", fn.getBody() != null ? fn.getBody().getNumAddresses() : 0L);
                node.put("isImport", isImport);
                node.put("isThunk", fn.isThunk());
                node.put("externalLib", externalLib);
                node.put("callerCount", callers.size());
                node.put("calleeCount", callees.size());
                nodes.add(node);

                for (Function callee : callees) {
                    String calleeHex = LoadedBinary.formatAddress(callee.getEntryPoint(), ptrSize);
                    if (!visitedByHex.containsKey(calleeHex)) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    String edgeKey = fnHex + "->" + calleeHex;
                    if (seenEdges.add(edgeKey)) {
                        Map<String, Object> edge = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                        edge.put("from", fnHex);
                        edge.put("to", calleeHex);
                        edge.put("callSites", collectCallSites(program, fn, callee, ptrSize));
                        edge.put("kind", "CALL");
                        edges.add(edge);
                    }
                }
            }

            Map<String, Object> response = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            response.put("binaryId", lb.getBinaryId());
            response.put("revision", lb.getRevision());
            response.put("root", rootHex);
            response.put("direction", normalizedDir);
            response.put("depth", boundedDepth);
            response.put("truncated", truncated);
            response.put("nodes", nodes);
            response.put("edges", edges);
            return response;
        } finally {
            lb.getRwLock().readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Queries cross-references to/from an address with normalized types and cursor pagination (Section 4.4.5).
     */
    public Map<String, Object> getXrefs(
            LoadedBinary lb,
            String addrStr,
            String direction,
            Set<String> typesFilter,
            int limit,
            String cursor) {
        ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
        lb.touchAccess();

        String normalizedDir = (direction == null || direction.isBlank())
                ? "to"
                : direction.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (!Set.of("to", "from", "both").contains(normalizedDir)) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Invalid xrefs direction: " + direction);
        }

        int effectiveLimit = limit <= 0 ? 50 : Math.min(MAX_LIST_LIMIT, limit);
        int offset = decodeOffsetCursor(cursor);

        Set<String> normalizedFilter = null;
        if (typesFilter != null && !typesFilter.isEmpty()) {
            normalizedFilter = new HashSet<>();
            for (String t : typesFilter) {
                if (t != null && !t.isBlank()) {
                    normalizedFilter.add(t.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT));
                }
            }
            if (normalizedFilter.isEmpty()) {
                normalizedFilter = null;
            }
        }

        lb.getRwLock().readLock().lock();
        try {
            ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
            Program program = lb.getProgram();
            Memory memory = program.getMemory();
            Listing listing = program.getListing();
            FunctionManager fm = program.getFunctionManager();
            SymbolTable symbolTable = program.getSymbolTable();
            ReferenceManager refMgr = program.getReferenceManager();
            int ptrSize = program.getDefaultPointerSize();

            Address addr = parseAddress(program, addrStr);
            if (!memory.contains(addr) && !addr.isExternalAddress()) {
                throw new ApiException(404, "UNMAPPED_ADDRESS", "Address is not mapped: " + addrStr);
            }

            List<Map<String, Object>> allItems = new ArrayList<>();
            Set<String> seenRefs = new HashSet<>();

            if ("to".equals(normalizedDir) || "both".equals(normalizedDir)) {
                ReferenceIterator toIt = refMgr.getReferencesTo(addr);
                while (toIt.hasNext()) {
                    Reference ref = toIt.next();
                    addXrefItem(ref, listing, fm, ptrSize, normalizedFilter, seenRefs, allItems);
                }
            }

            if ("from".equals(normalizedDir) || "both".equals(normalizedDir)) {
                for (Reference ref : refMgr.getReferencesFrom(addr)) {
                    addXrefItem(ref, listing, fm, ptrSize, normalizedFilter, seenRefs, allItems);
                }
            }

            int total = allItems.size();
            int startIdx = Math.min(offset, total);
            int endIdx = Math.min(startIdx + effectiveLimit, total);
            List<Map<String, Object>> page = new ArrayList<>(allItems.subList(startIdx, endIdx));
            String nextCursor = endIdx < total ? encodeOffsetCursor(endIdx) : null;

            Symbol primarySym = symbolTable.getPrimarySymbol(addr);

            Map<String, Object> response = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            response.put("binaryId", lb.getBinaryId());
            response.put("revision", lb.getRevision());
            response.put("address", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(addr, ptrSize));
            response.put("symbol", primarySym != null ? primarySym.getName() : null);
            response.put("direction", normalizedDir);
            response.put("total", total);
            response.put("nextCursor", nextCursor);
            response.put("cursor", nextCursor);
            response.put("items", page);
            return response;
        } finally {
            lb.getRwLock().readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Inspects raw/defined data, strings, aligned pointer tables, hex dump, and xref summary (Section 4.4.6).
     */
    public Map<String, Object> inspectData(
            LoadedBinary lb,
            String addrStr,
            int length,
            boolean detectPointers) {
        ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
        lb.touchAccess();

        int clampedLen = Math.max(1, Math.min(MAX_DATA_LENGTH, length <= 0 ? 128 : length));

        lb.getRwLock().readLock().lock();
        try {
            ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
            Program program = lb.getProgram();
            Memory memory = program.getMemory();
            Listing listing = program.getListing();
            FunctionManager fm = program.getFunctionManager();
            SymbolTable symbolTable = program.getSymbolTable();
            ReferenceManager refMgr = program.getReferenceManager();
            int ptrSize = program.getDefaultPointerSize();

            Address addr = parseAddress(program, addrStr);
            MemoryBlock block = memory.getBlock(addr);
            if (block == null) {
                throw new ApiException(404, "UNMAPPED_ADDRESS", "Address is not mapped in memory: " + addrStr);
            }

            Map<String, Object> sectionMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            sectionMap.put("name", block.getName());
            sectionMap.put("start", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(block.getStart(), ptrSize));
            sectionMap.put("end", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(block.getEnd(), ptrSize));
            sectionMap.put("perms", formatPermissions(block));

            Symbol sym = symbolTable.getPrimarySymbol(addr);
            Map<String, Object> symbolMap = null;
            if (sym != null) {
                symbolMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                symbolMap.put("name", sym.getName());
                symbolMap.put("renameable", !sym.isExternal() && !SymbolType.LIBRARY.equals(sym.getSymbolType()));
            }

            Data data = listing.getDataAt(addr);
            if (data == null) {
                data = listing.getDataContaining(addr);
            }
            String definedDataType = (data != null && data.isDefined())
                    ? data.getDataType().getDisplayName()
                    : null;

            long availableInBlock = block.getEnd().subtract(addr) + 1L;
            int readLen = (int) Math.min(clampedLen, Math.max(0L, availableInBlock));
            byte[] bytes = readMemoryBytes(block, addr, readLen);

            int sizeBytes = (data != null && data.isDefined()) ? data.getLength() : bytes.length;
            Map<String, Object> decoded = decodeDataValue(data, bytes);

            Map<String, Object> pointerAnalysis = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            List<Map<String, Object>> ptrEntries = detectPointers
                    ? scanPointerTable(program, memory, listing, fm, symbolTable, addr, bytes, ptrSize)
                    : Collections.emptyList();
            pointerAnalysis.put("isPointerTable", ptrEntries.size() >= 2);
            pointerAnalysis.put("entries", ptrEntries);

            Map<String, Object> hexDump = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            hexDump.put("baseAddr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(addr, ptrSize));
            hexDump.put("length", bytes.length);
            hexDump.put("bytesHex", HexFormat.of().formatHex(bytes));

            Map<String, Object> xrefSummary = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            xrefSummary.put("toCount", refMgr.getReferenceCountTo(addr));
            xrefSummary.put("fromCount", refMgr.getReferenceCountFrom(addr));

            Map<String, Object> response = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            response.put("binaryId", lb.getBinaryId());
            response.put("revision", lb.getRevision());
            response.put("address", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(addr, ptrSize));
            response.put("section", sectionMap);
            response.put("symbol", symbolMap);
            response.put("definedDataType", definedDataType);
            response.put("sizeBytes", sizeBytes);
            response.put("decoded", decoded);
            response.put("pointerAnalysis", pointerAnalysis);
            response.put("hexDump", hexDump);
            response.put("xrefSummary", xrefSummary);
            return response;
        } finally {
            lb.getRwLock().readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Internal helpers
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private static void ensureBinaryOpen(LoadedBinary lb) {
        if (lb == null || lb.isClosed()) {
            throw new ApiException(404, "BINARY_NOT_LOADED", "Binary is not loaded");
        }
    }

    private static Address tryParseAddress(Program program, String raw) {
        try {
            String hex = (raw.startsWith("0x") || raw.startsWith("0X")) ? raw.substring(2) : raw;
            long offset = Long.parseUnsignedLong(hex, 16);
            return program.getAddressFactory().getDefaultAddressSpace().getAddress(offset);
        } catch (NumberFormatException | AddressOutOfBoundsException ex) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static Symbol findBestSymbolByName(Program program, String name) {
        SymbolTable symbolTable = program.getSymbolTable();
        SymbolIterator it = symbolTable.getSymbols(name);
        Symbol fallbackExternal = null;
        Symbol fallbackDynamic = null;
        while (it.hasNext()) {
            Symbol sym = it.next();
            if (!sym.isExternal()) {
                if (sym.getSymbolType() == SymbolType.FUNCTION) {
                    return sym;
                }
                if (!sym.isDynamic()) {
                    return sym;
                }
                if (fallbackDynamic == null) {
                    fallbackDynamic = sym;
                }
            } else if (fallbackExternal == null) {
                fallbackExternal = sym;
            }
        }
        if (fallbackDynamic != null) {
            return fallbackDynamic;
        }
        if (fallbackExternal != null) {
            return fallbackExternal;
        }

        // Case-insensitive scan if exact lookup missed.
        SymbolIterator all = symbolTable.getPrimarySymbolIterator(true);
        while (all.hasNext()) {
            Symbol sym = all.next();
            if (sym.getName().equalsIgnoreCase(name)) {
                return sym;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static ExternalLocation resolveExternalLocation(Program program, Symbol sym, Address addr) {
        ExternalManager extMgr = program.getExternalManager();
        if (sym != null && sym.getObject() instanceof Function extFn && extFn.isExternal()) {
            return extFn.getExternalLocation();
        }
        if (sym != null && sym.getObject() instanceof ExternalLocation loc) {
            return loc;
        }
        Function fn = program.getFunctionManager().getFunctionAt(addr);
        if (fn != null && fn.isExternal()) {
            return fn.getExternalLocation();
        }
        var locs = extMgr.getExternalLocations(addr);
        return locs.hasNext() ? locs.next() : null;
    }

    private static List<String> findCandidateLibraryPaths(
            Program program,
            String libraryName,
            String primaryBinaryPath) {
        if (libraryName == null || libraryName.isBlank()) {
            return Collections.emptyList();
        }
        Set<String> candidates = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        String recordedPath = program.getExternalManager().getExternalLibraryPath(libraryName);
        if (recordedPath != null && !recordedPath.isBlank()) {
            candidates.add(recordedPath);
        }

        List<Path> searchDirs = new ArrayList<>();
        if (primaryBinaryPath != null && !primaryBinaryPath.isBlank()) {
            Path parent = Path.of(primaryBinaryPath).getParent();
            if (parent != null) {
                searchDirs.add(parent);
                searchDirs.add(parent.resolve("lib"));
            }
        }
        searchDirs.add(Path.of("/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu"));
        searchDirs.add(Path.of("/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu"));
        searchDirs.add(Path.of("/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu"));
        searchDirs.add(Path.of("/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu"));
        searchDirs.add(Path.of("/lib"));
        searchDirs.add(Path.of("/usr/lib"));
        searchDirs.add(Path.of("/usr/local/lib"));

        for (Path dir : searchDirs) {
            Path candidate = dir.resolve(libraryName);
            if (Files.isRegularFile(candidate)) {
                candidates.add(candidate.toString());
            }
        }
        return new ArrayList<>(candidates);
    }

    private Map<String, Object> findExternalTargetInLoadedBinaries(
            String sourceBinaryId,
            String libraryName,
            String symbolName) {
        if (symbolName == null || symbolName.isBlank()) {
            return null;
        }
        String cleanSym = stripImportSuffix(symbolName);
        Collection<LoadedBinary> binaries = loadedBinariesSupplier.get();
        if (binaries == null || binaries.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }

        Map<String, Object> fallbackMatch = null;
        for (LoadedBinary other : binaries) {
            if (other == null || other.isClosed() || sourceBinaryId.equals(other.getBinaryId())) {
                continue;
            }
            Map<String, Object> match = matchExportInBinary(other, libraryName, cleanSym);
            if (match != null) {
                if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(match.remove("_libMatched"))) {
                    return match;
                }
                if (fallbackMatch == null) {
                    fallbackMatch = match;
                }
            }
        }
        return fallbackMatch;
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> matchExportInBinary(
            LoadedBinary other,
            String expectedLibName,
            String symbolName) {
        other.getRwLock().readLock().lock();
        try {
            if (other.isClosed()) {
                return null;
            }
            Program program = other.getProgram();
            SymbolTable symbolTable = program.getSymbolTable();
            FunctionManager fm = program.getFunctionManager();
            Memory memory = program.getMemory();
            int ptrSize = program.getDefaultPointerSize();

            boolean libMatched = false;
            if (expectedLibName != null && !expectedLibName.isBlank()) {
                String progName = program.getName();
                Object primaryObj = other.toSummaryMap().get("primaryPath");
                String primaryName = primaryObj instanceof String p ? Path.of(p).getFileName().toString() : "";
                String expStem = stripLibraryStem(expectedLibName);
                libMatched = progName.equalsIgnoreCase(expectedLibName)
                        || primaryName.equalsIgnoreCase(expectedLibName)
                        || (!expStem.isEmpty() && stripLibraryStem(progName).equalsIgnoreCase(expStem))
                        || (!expStem.isEmpty() && stripLibraryStem(primaryName).equalsIgnoreCase(expStem));
            }

            AddressIterator entryIt = symbolTable.getExternalEntryPointIterator();
            while (entryIt.hasNext()) {
                Address entryAddr = entryIt.next();
                if (!isRealExportCandidate(program, fm, memory, entryAddr)) {
                    continue;
                }
                for (Symbol s : symbolTable.getSymbols(entryAddr)) {
                    if (s.getName().equals(symbolName)) {
                        Map<String, Object> target = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                        target.put("binaryId", other.getBinaryId());
                        target.put("address", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(entryAddr, ptrSize));
                        target.put("symbolName", s.getName());
                        target.put("libraryName", program.getName());
                        target.put("_libMatched", libMatched);
                        return target;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Fallback: check exported/global function symbol
            SymbolIterator syms = symbolTable.getSymbols(symbolName);
            while (syms.hasNext()) {
                Symbol s = syms.next();
                if (!s.isExternal()
                        && s.getAddress().isMemoryAddress()
                        && isRealExportCandidate(program, fm, memory, s.getAddress())) {
                    Map<String, Object> target = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    target.put("binaryId", other.getBinaryId());
                    target.put("address", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(s.getAddress(), ptrSize));
                    target.put("symbolName", s.getName());
                    target.put("libraryName", program.getName());
                    target.put("_libMatched", libMatched);
                    return target;
                }
            }
            return null;
        } finally {
            other.getRwLock().readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    private static boolean isRealExportCandidate(
            Program program,
            FunctionManager fm,
            Memory memory,
            Address addr) {
        if (addr == null || !addr.isMemoryAddress()) {
            return false;
        }
        MemoryBlock block = memory.getBlock(addr);
        if (block == null) {
            return false;
        }
        String bName = block.getName() != null ? block.getName() : "";
        if ("EXTERNAL".equalsIgnoreCase(bName) || bName.startsWith(".plt")) {
            return false;
        }
        Function fn = fm.getFunctionAt(addr);
        if (fn != null && (fn.isExternal() || fn.isThunk() || isImportFunction(fn))) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    private static String stripLibraryStem(String name) {
        if (name == null) {
            return "";
        }
        String file = Path.of(name).getFileName().toString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        int soIdx = file.indexOf(".so");
        if (soIdx > 0) {
            return file.substring(0, soIdx);
        }
        int dylibIdx = file.indexOf(".dylib");
        if (dylibIdx > 0) {
            return file.substring(0, dylibIdx);
        }
        int dllIdx = file.indexOf(".dll");
        if (dllIdx > 0) {
            return file.substring(0, dllIdx);
        }
        return file;
    }

    private static String stripImportSuffix(String sym) {
        int atIdx = sym.indexOf("@@");
        if (atIdx > 0) {
            sym = sym.substring(0, atIdx);
        }
        int pltIdx = sym.indexOf("@plt");
        if (pltIdx > 0) {
            sym = sym.substring(0, pltIdx);
        }
        return sym;
    }

    private static boolean isPointerTable(Program program, Address addr, Data definedData) {
        if (definedData != null && definedData.isDefined()) {
            DataType dt = definedData.getDataType();
            if (dt instanceof Pointer) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        Memory memory = program.getMemory();
        MemoryBlock block = memory.getBlock(addr);
        if (block == null || !block.isInitialized()) {
            return false;
        }
        int ptrSize = program.getDefaultPointerSize();
        if (ptrSize != 4 && ptrSize != 8) {
            return false;
        }
        long remaining = block.getEnd().subtract(addr) + 1L;
        if (remaining < ptrSize * 2L) {
            return false;
        }
        byte[] buf = readMemoryBytes(block, addr, ptrSize * 2);
        if (buf.length < ptrSize * 2) {
            return false;
        }
        ByteOrder order = program.getLanguage().isBigEndian() ? ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN : ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN;
        AddressSpace defaultSpace = program.getAddressFactory().getDefaultAddressSpace();
        int validCount = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            long val = readPointerValue(buf, i * ptrSize, ptrSize, order);
            if (val != 0L) {
                try {
                    Address target = defaultSpace.getAddress(val);
                    if (memory.contains(target)) {
                        validCount++;
                    }
                } catch (AddressOutOfBoundsException ignored) {
                    // Not a valid pointer.
                }
            }
        }
        return validCount == 2;
    }

    private static boolean hasExecutableBytes(MemoryBlock block, Address addr) {
        if (!block.isInitialized() || !block.isExecute()) {
            return false;
        }
        try {
            byte b = block.getByte(addr);
            return b != 0;
        } catch (MemoryAccessException ex) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private static String formatPermissions(MemoryBlock block) {
        if (block == null) {
            return null;
        }
        return (block.isRead() ? "r" : "-")
                + (block.isWrite() ? "w" : "-")
                + (block.isExecute() ? "x" : "-");
    }

    private record FunctionSummaryRow(Map<String, Object> map, boolean isImport, boolean isExport,
            boolean isThunk, String externalKey, String lowerName, String lowerSig, String lowerAddr) {
    }

    private static FunctionSummaryRow buildFunctionRow(
            Function fn,
            SymbolTable symbolTable,
            int ptrSize) {
        Address entry = fn.getEntryPoint();
        String addrHex = LoadedBinary.formatAddress(entry, ptrSize);
        String name = fn.getName();
        String signature = fn.getPrototypeString(false, false);
        boolean isThunk = fn.isThunk();
        boolean isImport = isImportFunction(fn);
        boolean isExport = !fn.isExternal() && symbolTable.isExternalEntryPoint(entry);
        String externalLib = resolveExternalLibName(fn);
        String externalKey = null;
        if (isImport) {
            Function extTarget = fn.isExternal() ? fn : fn.getThunkedFunction(true);
            if (extTarget != null && extTarget.getExternalLocation() != null) {
                ExternalLocation loc = extTarget.getExternalLocation();
                externalKey = (loc.getLibraryName() != null ? loc.getLibraryName() : "")
                        + "::" + (loc.getLabel() != null ? loc.getLabel() : extTarget.getName());
            } else {
                externalKey = "::" + name;
            }
        }

        Map<String, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        map.put("addr", addrHex);
        map.put("name", name);
        map.put("sizeBytes", fn.getBody() != null ? fn.getBody().getNumAddresses() : 0L);
        map.put("signature", signature);
        map.put("callingConvention", fn.getCallingConventionName());
        map.put("isThunk", isThunk);
        map.put("isExternal", fn.isExternal());
        map.put("isImport", isImport);
        map.put("isExport", isExport);
        map.put("externalLib", externalLib);
        map.put("paramCount", fn.getParameterCount());
        map.put("_sortAddr", entry.getOffset());

        return new FunctionSummaryRow(
                map,
                isImport,
                isExport,
                isThunk,
                externalKey,
                name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT),
                signature != null ? signature.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT) : "",
                addrHex.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
    }

    private static boolean matchesFunctionFilter(
            FunctionSummaryRow row,
            String kind,
            String filterLower) {
        boolean kindMatch = switch (kind) {
            case "user" -> !row.isImport && !row.isThunk;
            case "import" -> row.isImport;
            case "export" -> row.isExport;
            default -> true;
        };
        if (!kindMatch) {
            return false;
        }
        if (filterLower == null) {
            return true;
        }
        return row.lowerName.contains(filterLower)
                || row.lowerSig.contains(filterLower)
                || row.lowerAddr.contains(filterLower);
    }

    private static boolean isImportFunction(Function fn) {
        if (fn.isExternal()) {
            return true;
        }
        Program prog = fn.getProgram();
        if (prog != null && fn.getEntryPoint() != null) {
            MemoryBlock block = prog.getMemory().getBlock(fn.getEntryPoint());
            if (block != null && block.getName() != null) {
                String bName = block.getName();
                if ("EXTERNAL".equalsIgnoreCase(bName) || bName.startsWith(".plt")) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        if (fn.isThunk()) {
            Function thunked = fn.getThunkedFunction(true);
            if (thunked != null) {
                if (thunked.isExternal()) {
                    return true;
                }
                if (prog != null && thunked.getEntryPoint() != null) {
                    MemoryBlock tBlock = prog.getMemory().getBlock(thunked.getEntryPoint());
                    if (tBlock != null && "EXTERNAL".equalsIgnoreCase(tBlock.getName())) {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static String resolveExternalLibName(Function fn) {
        Function ext = fn.isExternal() ? fn : (fn.isThunk() ? fn.getThunkedFunction(true) : null);
        if (ext != null && ext.isExternal() && ext.getExternalLocation() != null) {
            return emptyToNull(ext.getExternalLocation().getLibraryName());
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> formatInstruction(
            Program program,
            Instruction insn,
            Listing listing,
            FunctionManager fm,
            SymbolTable symbolTable,
            ReferenceManager refMgr,
            int ptrSize,
            boolean includeBytes) {
        Address minAddr = insn.getMinAddress();
        String bytesStr = null;
        if (includeBytes) {
            try {
                byte[] raw = insn.getBytes();
                StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(raw.length * 3);
                for (int i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
                    if (i > 0) {
                        sb.append(' ');
                    }
                    sb.append(String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%02x", raw[i] & 0xFF));
                }
                bytesStr = sb.toString();
            } catch (MemoryAccessException ignored) {
                bytesStr = "";
            }
        }

        int numOps = insn.getNumOperands();
        StringBuilder operands = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < numOps; i++) {
            if (i > 0) {
                operands.append(", ");
            }
            operands.append(insn.getDefaultOperandRepresentation(i));
        }

        Symbol primary = symbolTable.getPrimarySymbol(minAddr);
        String label = primary != null ? primary.getName() : null;

        List<Map<String, Object>> refs = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Reference ref : insn.getReferencesFrom()) {
            if (!ref.isMemoryReference() && !ref.isExternalReference()) {
                continue;
            }
            Address toAddr = ref.getToAddress();
            Symbol toSym = symbolTable.getPrimarySymbol(toAddr);
            Map<String, Object> refMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            refMap.put("to", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(toAddr, ptrSize));
            refMap.put("type", normalizeRefType(ref.getReferenceType(), true));
            refMap.put("symbol", toSym != null ? toSym.getName() : null);
            refMap.put("targetKind", classifyRefTarget(program, listing, fm, toAddr, toSym));
            refs.add(refMap);
        }

        Map<String, Object> item = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        item.put("addr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(minAddr, ptrSize));
        item.put("bytes", bytesStr);
        item.put("mnemonic", insn.getMnemonicString());
        item.put("operands", operands.toString());
        item.put("label", label);
        item.put("commentEol", insn.getComment(CommentType.EOL));
        item.put("commentPre", insn.getComment(CommentType.PRE));
        item.put("flow", classifyFlowType(insn.getFlowType()));
        item.put("refs", refs);
        item.put("xrefInCount", refMgr.getReferenceCountTo(minAddr));
        return item;
    }

    private static String classifyFlowType(FlowType ft) {
        if (ft == null) {
            return "FALLTHROUGH";
        }
        if (ft.isCall()) {
            return ft.isTerminal() ? "CALL_TERMINATOR" : "CALL";
        }
        if (ft.isJump()) {
            return ft.isConditional() ? "CONDITIONAL_JUMP" : "UNCONDITIONAL_JUMP";
        }
        if (ft.isTerminal()) {
            return "TERMINATOR";
        }
        if (ft.isFallthrough() || ft.hasFallthrough()) {
            return "FALLTHROUGH";
        }
        return ft.getName();
    }

    private static String normalizeRefType(RefType rt, boolean fromInstruction) {
        if (rt == null) {
            return "OTHER";
        }
        if (rt.isCall()) {
            return "CALL";
        }
        if (rt.isJump()) {
            return "JMP";
        }
        if (rt.isWrite()) {
            return "DATA_WRITE";
        }
        if (rt.isRead()) {
            return "DATA_READ";
        }
        if (rt.isData() || rt == RefType.EXTERNAL_REF) {
            return fromInstruction ? "DATA_READ" : "DATA_PTR";
        }
        return "OTHER";
    }

    private static String classifyRefTarget(
            Program program,
            Listing listing,
            FunctionManager fm,
            Address toAddr,
            Symbol toSym) {
        if (toAddr.isExternalAddress() || (toSym != null && toSym.isExternal())) {
            return "external";
        }
        Function fn = fm.getFunctionAt(toAddr);
        if (fn != null) {
            return fn.isThunk() ? "thunk" : "function";
        }
        Data data = listing.getDataContaining(toAddr);
        if (data != null && data.isDefined()) {
            if (StringDataInstance.isString(data)) {
                return "string";
            }
            return "data";
        }
        if (toSym != null && toSym.getSymbolType() == SymbolType.LABEL) {
            return "label";
        }
        if (program.getMemory().contains(toAddr)) {
            return listing.getInstructionContaining(toAddr) != null ? "code" : "data";
        }
        return "unknown";
    }

    private Map<String, Object> buildCfgLocked(
            LoadedBinary lb,
            Program program,
            Function fn,
            String funcEntryHex,
            int blockLimit,
            Address focusAddr,
            boolean includeInsns,
            int ptrSize,
            long rev) {
        BasicBlockModel bbm = new BasicBlockModel(program);
        Listing listing = program.getListing();
        SymbolTable symbolTable = program.getSymbolTable();

        Map<String, CodeBlock> blocksById = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        try {
            CodeBlockIterator it = bbm.getCodeBlocksContaining(fn.getBody(), TaskMonitor.DUMMY);
            while (it.hasNext()) {
                CodeBlock block = it.next();
                String id = LoadedBinary.formatAddress(block.getFirstStartAddress(), ptrSize);
                blocksById.put(id, block);
            }
        } catch (CancelledException ex) {
            throw new ApiException(500, "INTERNAL_ERROR", "CFG extraction cancelled", false,
                    Collections.emptyMap(), ex);
        }

        int totalBlocks = blocksById.size();
        String entryBlockId = null;
        for (Map.Entry<String, CodeBlock> e : blocksById.entrySet()) {
            if (e.getValue().contains(fn.getEntryPoint())) {
                entryBlockId = e.getKey();
                break;
            }
        }
        if (entryBlockId == null && !blocksById.isEmpty()) {
            entryBlockId = blocksById.keySet().iterator().next();
        }

        // Build intra-procedural outgoing edge list & reverse adjacency.
        Map<String, List<CfgEdgeRaw>> outEdges = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        Map<String, List<String>> revAdj = new HashMap<>();
        for (String id : blocksById.keySet()) {
            outEdges.put(id, new ArrayList<>());
            revAdj.put(id, new ArrayList<>());
        }

        for (Map.Entry<String, CodeBlock> e : blocksById.entrySet()) {
            String fromId = e.getKey();
            CodeBlock block = e.getValue();
            try {
                CodeBlockReferenceIterator destIt = block.getDestinations(TaskMonitor.DUMMY);
                while (destIt.hasNext()) {
                    CodeBlockReference ref = destIt.next();
                    FlowType ft = ref.getFlowType();
                    if (ft != null && ft.isCall()) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    CodeBlock destBlock = ref.getDestinationBlock();
                    if (destBlock == null) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    String toId = LoadedBinary.formatAddress(destBlock.getFirstStartAddress(), ptrSize);
                    if (!blocksById.containsKey(toId)) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    outEdges.get(fromId).add(new CfgEdgeRaw(fromId, toId, ft));
                    revAdj.get(toId).add(fromId);
                }
            } catch (CancelledException ignored) {
                // TaskMonitor.DUMMY will not cancel.
            }
        }

        boolean truncated = totalBlocks > blockLimit;
        String resolvedFocusBlockId = null;
        if (focusAddr != null) {
            for (Map.Entry<String, CodeBlock> e : blocksById.entrySet()) {
                if (e.getValue().contains(focusAddr)) {
                    resolvedFocusBlockId = e.getKey();
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (resolvedFocusBlockId == null) {
                resolvedFocusBlockId = entryBlockId;
            }
        }

        Set<String> selectedIds = new LinkedHashSet<>();

        if (!truncated) {
            selectedIds.addAll(blocksById.keySet());
        } else if (focusAddr != null) {
            if (resolvedFocusBlockId != null) {
                selectedIds = collectEgoSubgraph(resolvedFocusBlockId, outEdges, revAdj, EGO_SUBGRAPH_HOPS, blockLimit);
            }
        } else if (entryBlockId != null) {
            // BFS from entry block up to blockLimit
            Deque<String> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
            selectedIds.add(entryBlockId);
            q.add(entryBlockId);
            while (!q.isEmpty() && selectedIds.size() < blockLimit) {
                String cur = q.poll();
                for (CfgEdgeRaw edge : outEdges.getOrDefault(cur, Collections.emptyList())) {
                    if (selectedIds.size() >= blockLimit) {
                        break;
                    }
                    if (selectedIds.add(edge.toId)) {
                        q.add(edge.toId);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (selectedIds.size() < blockLimit) {
                for (String id : blocksById.keySet()) {
                    if (selectedIds.size() >= blockLimit) {
                        break;
                    }
                    selectedIds.add(id);
                }
            }
        }

        // DFS back-edge detection on the selected subgraph
        Set<String> backEdges = detectDfsBackEdges(selectedIds, outEdges, entryBlockId);

        List<Map<String, Object>> blockMaps = new ArrayList<>(selectedIds.size());
        List<Map<String, Object>> edgeMaps = new ArrayList<>();

        for (String id : selectedIds) {
            CodeBlock block = blocksById.get(id);
            List<CfgEdgeRaw> blockOut = outEdges.getOrDefault(id, Collections.emptyList());

            int insnCount = 0;
            List<Map<String, Object>> insns = includeInsns ? new ArrayList<>() : Collections.emptyList();
            InstructionIterator insnIt = listing.getInstructions(block, true);
            while (insnIt.hasNext()) {
                Instruction insn = insnIt.next();
                insnCount++;
                if (includeInsns) {
                    int numOps = insn.getNumOperands();
                    StringBuilder ops = new StringBuilder();
                    for (int i = 0; i < numOps; i++) {
                        if (i > 0) {
                            ops.append(", ");
                        }
                        ops.append(insn.getDefaultOperandRepresentation(i));
                    }
                    Map<String, Object> im = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    im.put("addr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(insn.getMinAddress(), ptrSize));
                    im.put("mnemonic", insn.getMnemonicString());
                    im.put("operands", ops.toString());
                    insns.add(im);
                }
            }

            Symbol sym = symbolTable.getPrimarySymbol(block.getFirstStartAddress());
            Map<String, Object> bm = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            bm.put("id", id);
            bm.put("start", id);
            bm.put("end", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(block.getMaxAddress(), ptrSize));
            bm.put("label", sym != null ? sym.getName() : null);
            bm.put("insnCount", insnCount);
            bm.put("isEntry", id.equals(entryBlockId));
            bm.put("isExit", blockOut.isEmpty());
            bm.put("insns", insns);
            blockMaps.add(bm);

            int intraOutCount = 0;
            for (CfgEdgeRaw er : blockOut) {
                if (selectedIds.contains(er.toId)) {
                    intraOutCount++;
                }
            }
            for (CfgEdgeRaw er : blockOut) {
                if (!selectedIds.contains(er.toId)) {
                    continue;
                }
                String kind;
                String edgeKey = er.fromId + "->" + er.toId;
                if (backEdges.contains(edgeKey)) {
                    kind = "LOOP_BACK";
                } else if (intraOutCount > 2 || (er.flowType != null && er.flowType.isComputed())) {
                    kind = "SWITCH_CASE";
                } else if (intraOutCount == 2) {
                    kind = (er.flowType != null && er.flowType.isJump()) ? "COND_TRUE" : "COND_FALSE";
                } else {
                    kind = "UNCONDITIONAL";
                }
                Map<String, Object> em = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                em.put("from", er.fromId);
                em.put("to", er.toId);
                em.put("kind", kind);
                edgeMaps.add(em);
            }
        }

        Map<String, Object> response = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        response.put("binaryId", lb.getBinaryId());
        response.put("revision", rev);
        response.put("functionEntry", funcEntryHex);
        response.put("functionName", fn.getName());
        response.put("totalBlocks", totalBlocks);
        response.put("truncated", truncated);
        response.put("blockLimit", blockLimit);
        response.put("egoSubgraph", truncated && focusAddr != null);
        if (resolvedFocusBlockId != null) {
            response.put("focusBlockId", resolvedFocusBlockId);
        }
        if (truncated && focusAddr != null) {
            response.put("egoHops", EGO_SUBGRAPH_HOPS);
        }
        response.put("blocks", blockMaps);
        response.put("edges", edgeMaps);
        return response;
    }

    private record CfgEdgeRaw(String fromId, String toId, FlowType flowType) {
    }

    private static Set<String> collectEgoSubgraph(
            String focusBlockId,
            Map<String, List<CfgEdgeRaw>> outEdges,
            Map<String, List<String>> revAdj,
            int maxHops,
            int blockLimit) {
        Set<String> selected = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        Deque<String> nodeQueue = new ArrayDeque<>();
        Deque<Integer> distQueue = new ArrayDeque<>();

        selected.add(focusBlockId);
        nodeQueue.add(focusBlockId);
        distQueue.add(0);

        while (!nodeQueue.isEmpty() && selected.size() < blockLimit) {
            String cur = nodeQueue.poll();
            int dist = distQueue.poll();
            if (dist >= maxHops) {
                continue;
            }
            for (CfgEdgeRaw out : outEdges.getOrDefault(cur, Collections.emptyList())) {
                if (selected.size() >= blockLimit) {
                    break;
                }
                if (selected.add(out.toId)) {
                    nodeQueue.add(out.toId);
                    distQueue.add(dist + 1);
                }
            }
            for (String prev : revAdj.getOrDefault(cur, Collections.emptyList())) {
                if (selected.size() >= blockLimit) {
                    break;
                }
                if (selected.add(prev)) {
                    nodeQueue.add(prev);
                    distQueue.add(dist + 1);
                }
            }
        }
        return selected;
    }

    private static Set<String> detectDfsBackEdges(
            Set<String> selectedIds,
            Map<String, List<CfgEdgeRaw>> outEdges,
            String entryBlockId) {
        Set<String> backEdges = new HashSet<>();
        if (selectedIds.isEmpty()) {
            return backEdges;
        }

        // 0 = unvisited, 1 = on stack (GRAY), 2 = finished (BLACK)
        Map<String, Integer> state = new HashMap<>(selectedIds.size() * 2);
        List<String> roots = new ArrayList<>();
        if (entryBlockId != null && selectedIds.contains(entryBlockId)) {
            roots.add(entryBlockId);
        }
        for (String id : selectedIds) {
            if (!id.equals(entryBlockId)) {
                roots.add(id);
            }
        }

        record DfsFrame(String node, int nextIdx) {
        }

        for (String root : roots) {
            if (state.getOrDefault(root, 0) != 0) {
                continue;
            }
            Deque<DfsFrame> stack = new ArrayDeque<>();
            state.put(root, 1);
            stack.push(new DfsFrame(root, 0));

            while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
                DfsFrame top = stack.pop();
                List<CfgEdgeRaw> edges = outEdges.getOrDefault(top.node, Collections.emptyList());
                if (top.nextIdx < edges.size()) {
                    stack.push(new DfsFrame(top.node, top.nextIdx + 1));
                    String target = edges.get(top.nextIdx).toId;
                    if (!selectedIds.contains(target)) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    int targetState = state.getOrDefault(target, 0);
                    if (targetState == 1) {
                        backEdges.add(top.node + "->" + target);
                    } else if (targetState == 0) {
                        state.put(target, 1);
                        stack.push(new DfsFrame(target, 0));
                    }
                } else {
                    state.put(top.node, 2);
                }
            }
        }
        return backEdges;
    }

    private static String cfgCacheKey(
            String binaryId,
            String funcEntryHex,
            int blockLimit,
            String focusHex,
            boolean includeInsns) {
        return binaryId + "|" + funcEntryHex + "|" + blockLimit + "|" + focusHex + "|" + includeInsns;
    }

    private record FunctionDepth(Function fn, int depth) {
    }

    private static boolean hasMoreNeighbors(
            Function fn,
            boolean wantCallers,
            boolean wantCallees,
            Map<String, Function> visitedByHex,
            int ptrSize) {
        if (wantCallers) {
            for (Function caller : fn.getCallingFunctions(TaskMonitor.DUMMY)) {
                if (!visitedByHex.containsKey(LoadedBinary.formatAddress(caller.getEntryPoint(), ptrSize))) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        if (wantCallees) {
            for (Function callee : fn.getCalledFunctions(TaskMonitor.DUMMY)) {
                if (!visitedByHex.containsKey(LoadedBinary.formatAddress(callee.getEntryPoint(), ptrSize))) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static List<String> collectCallSites(
            Program program,
            Function caller,
            Function callee,
            int ptrSize) {
        List<String> sites = new ArrayList<>();
        Address calleeEntry = callee.getEntryPoint();
        ReferenceManager refMgr = program.getReferenceManager();
        ReferenceIterator refIt = refMgr.getReferencesTo(calleeEntry);
        while (refIt.hasNext()) {
            Reference ref = refIt.next();
            if (ref.getReferenceType().isCall() && caller.getBody() != null
                    && caller.getBody().contains(ref.getFromAddress())) {
                sites.add(LoadedBinary.formatAddress(ref.getFromAddress(), ptrSize));
                if (sites.size() >= 64) {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        Collections.sort(sites);
        return sites;
    }

    private static void addXrefItem(
            Reference ref,
            Listing listing,
            FunctionManager fm,
            int ptrSize,
            Set<String> normalizedFilter,
            Set<String> seenRefs,
            List<Map<String, Object>> out) {
        Address fromAddr = ref.getFromAddress();
        Address toAddr = ref.getToAddress();
        if (!fromAddr.isMemoryAddress() && !fromAddr.isExternalAddress()) {
            return;
        }

        Instruction insn = listing.getInstructionContaining(fromAddr);
        String normType = normalizeRefType(ref.getReferenceType(), insn != null);
        if (normalizedFilter != null && !normalizedFilter.contains(normType)) {
            return;
        }

        String fromHex = LoadedBinary.formatAddress(fromAddr, ptrSize);
        String toHex = LoadedBinary.formatAddress(toAddr, ptrSize);
        String dedupKey = fromHex + "->" + toHex + ":" + normType;
        if (!seenRefs.add(dedupKey)) {
            return;
        }

        Function fromFn = fm.getFunctionContaining(fromAddr);
        String preview = null;
        if (insn != null) {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(insn.getMnemonicString());
            int nOps = insn.getNumOperands();
            for (int i = 0; i < nOps; i++) {
                sb.append(i == 0 ? " " : ", ");
                sb.append(insn.getDefaultOperandRepresentation(i));
            }
            preview = sb.toString();
        } else {
            Data d = listing.getDataContaining(fromAddr);
            if (d != null && d.isDefined()) {
                preview = d.getDefaultValueRepresentation();
            }
        }

        Map<String, Object> item = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        item.put("fromAddr", fromHex);
        item.put("toAddr", toHex);
        item.put("fromFuncAddr", fromFn != null ? LoadedBinary.formatAddress(fromFn.getEntryPoint(), ptrSize) : null);
        item.put("fromFuncName", fromFn != null ? fromFn.getName() : null);
        item.put("type", normType);
        item.put("rawGhidraRefType", ref.getReferenceType().getName());
        item.put("insnPreview", preview);
        out.add(item);
    }

    private static byte[] readMemoryBytes(MemoryBlock block, Address addr, int maxLen) {
        if (block == null || !block.isInitialized() || maxLen <= 0) {
            return new byte[0];
        }
        byte[] buf = new byte[maxLen];
        try {
            int n = block.getBytes(addr, buf);
            if (n <= 0) {
                return new byte[0];
            }
            if (n == maxLen) {
                return buf;
            }
            byte[] sliced = new byte[n];
            System.arraycopy(buf, 0, sliced, 0, n);
            return sliced;
        } catch (MemoryAccessException ex) {
            return new byte[0];
        }
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> decodeDataValue(Data data, byte[] bytes) {
        Map<String, Object> decoded = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        if (data != null && data.isDefined() && StringDataInstance.isString(data)) {
            StringDataInstance sdi = StringDataInstance.getStringDataInstance(data);
            String val = sdi.getStringValue();
            String charset = sdi.getCharsetName();
            decoded.put("kind", "string");
            decoded.put("encoding", charset != null ? charset.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT) : "utf-8");
            decoded.put("value", val != null ? val : "");
            return decoded;
        }

        // Heuristic UTF-8 null-terminated / printable string decode
        String utf8Guess = tryDecodeAsciiOrUtf8(bytes);
        if (utf8Guess != null) {
            decoded.put("kind", "string");
            decoded.put("encoding", "utf-8");
            decoded.put("value", utf8Guess);
            return decoded;
        }

        // Heuristic UTF-16LE decode
        String utf16Guess = tryDecodeUtf16Le(bytes);
        if (utf16Guess != null) {
            decoded.put("kind", "string");
            decoded.put("encoding", "utf-16le");
            decoded.put("value", utf16Guess);
            return decoded;
        }

        if (data != null && data.isDefined()) {
            decoded.put("kind", "defined");
            decoded.put("encoding", data.getDataType().getDisplayName());
            decoded.put("value", data.getDefaultValueRepresentation());
            return decoded;
        }

        decoded.put("kind", "raw");
        decoded.put("encoding", "bytes");
        decoded.put("value", null);
        return decoded;
    }

    private static String tryDecodeAsciiOrUtf8(byte[] bytes) {
        if (bytes.length < 4) {
            return null;
        }
        int end = 0;
        int printable = 0;
        while (end < bytes.length && bytes[end] != 0) {
            int b = bytes[end] & 0xFF;
            if ((b >= 0x20 && b <= 0x7E) || b == '\n' || b == '\r' || b == '\t') {
                printable++;
            } else if (b < 0x80) {
                return null;
            }
            end++;
        }
        if (end < 4 || printable < 4) {
            return null;
        }
        String text = new String(bytes, 0, end, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        return text.indexOf('\uFFFD') >= 0 ? null : text;
    }

    private static String tryDecodeUtf16Le(byte[] bytes) {
        if (bytes.length < 8) {
            return null;
        }
        int end = 0;
        int chars = 0;
        while (end + 1 < bytes.length) {
            int lo = bytes[end] & 0xFF;
            int hi = bytes[end + 1] & 0xFF;
            if (lo == 0 && hi == 0) {
                break;
            }
            if (hi != 0 || !((lo >= 0x20 && lo <= 0x7E) || lo == '\n' || lo == '\r' || lo == '\t')) {
                return null;
            }
            chars++;
            end += 2;
        }
        if (chars < 4) {
            return null;
        }
        return new String(bytes, 0, end, StandardCharsets.UTF_16LE);
    }

    private static List<Map<String, Object>> scanPointerTable(
            Program program,
            Memory memory,
            Listing listing,
            FunctionManager fm,
            SymbolTable symbolTable,
            Address baseAddr,
            byte[] bytes,
            int ptrSize) {
        if ((ptrSize != 4 && ptrSize != 8) || bytes.length < ptrSize) {
            return Collections.emptyList();
        }
        ByteOrder order = program.getLanguage().isBigEndian() ? ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN : ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN;
        AddressSpace defaultSpace = program.getAddressFactory().getDefaultAddressSpace();
        List<Map<String, Object>> entries = new ArrayList<>();

        int maxSlots = Math.min(64, bytes.length / ptrSize);
        for (int slot = 0; slot < maxSlots; slot++) {
            int offset = slot * ptrSize;
            long val = readPointerValue(bytes, offset, ptrSize, order);
            if (val == 0L) {
                continue;
            }
            Address target;
            try {
                target = defaultSpace.getAddress(val);
            } catch (AddressOutOfBoundsException ex) {
                continue;
            }
            if (!memory.contains(target)) {
                continue;
            }
            MemoryBlock targetBlock = memory.getBlock(target);
            Symbol targetSym = symbolTable.getPrimarySymbol(target);
            Function fn = fm.getFunctionAt(target);
            String targetKind;
            if (fn != null) {
                targetKind = fn.isThunk() ? "thunk" : "function";
            } else {
                Data d = listing.getDataContaining(target);
                if (d != null && d.isDefined() && StringDataInstance.isString(d)) {
                    targetKind = "string";
                } else if (listing.getInstructionContaining(target) != null
                        || (targetBlock != null && targetBlock.isExecute())) {
                    targetKind = "code";
                } else {
                    targetKind = "data";
                }
            }

            Map<String, Object> entry = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            entry.put("slotAddr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(baseAddr.add(offset), ptrSize));
            entry.put("targetAddr", LoadedBinary.formatAddress(target, ptrSize));
            entry.put("targetKind", targetKind);
            entry.put("targetSymbol", targetSym != null ? targetSym.getName()
                    : (fn != null ? fn.getName() : null));
            entry.put("targetSection", targetBlock != null ? targetBlock.getName() : null);
            entries.add(entry);
        }
        return entries;
    }

    private static long readPointerValue(byte[] buf, int offset, int ptrSize, ByteOrder order) {
        ByteBuffer bb = ByteBuffer.wrap(buf, offset, ptrSize).order(order);
        return ptrSize == 8 ? bb.getLong() : Integer.toUnsignedLong(bb.getInt());
    }

    private static int decodeOffsetCursor(String cursor) {
        if (cursor == null || cursor.isBlank()) {
            return 0;
        }
        String trimmed = cursor.trim();
        try {
            return Math.max(0, Integer.parseInt(trimmed));
        } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {
            try {
                byte[] decoded = java.util.Base64.getUrlDecoder().decode(trimmed);
                String str = new String(decoded, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                if (str.startsWith("offset:")) {
                    return Math.max(0, Integer.parseInt(str.substring("offset:".length())));
                }
            } catch (IllegalArgumentException ignored2) {
                // Fall through to error.
            }
        }
        throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Invalid pagination cursor: " + cursor);
    }

    private static String encodeOffsetCursor(int offset) {
        byte[] raw = ("offset:" + offset).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        return java.util.Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(raw);
    }

    private static String emptyToNull(String value) {
        return (value == null || value.isBlank()) ? null : value;
    }
}

/**
 * Wraps an open Ghidra Program + GhidraProject with per-binary read/write locking,
 * revision tracking, checkpoint persistence, and binary metadata / entropy analysis.
 */
public final class LoadedBinary {

    private static final Set<String> PACKER_SECTION_NAMES = Set.of(
            "upx0", "upx1", ".packed", ".aspack", ".vmp");

    private static final Gson PRETTY_GSON = new GsonBuilder()
            .setPrettyPrinting()
            .disableHtmlEscaping()
            .create();

    private final String binaryId;
    private final Path projectDir;
    private final GhidraProject project;
    private final Program program;
    private final ReentrantReadWriteLock rwLock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();
    private final AtomicLong revision;
    private final AtomicBoolean dirty = new AtomicBoolean(false);
    private final AtomicInteger uncheckpointedMutations = new AtomicInteger(0);
    private final AtomicLong lastMutationAt = new AtomicLong(0L);
    private final AtomicLong lastAccessedAt = new AtomicLong(System.currentTimeMillis());
    private final AtomicBoolean closed = new AtomicBoolean(false);

    private final boolean analyzed;
    private final String analysisProfile;
    private final long fileSizeBytes;
    private final long loadedAt;
    private final Set<String> originalPaths = Collections.synchronizedSet(new LinkedHashSet<>());
    private volatile String primaryPath;
    private volatile long lastSavedAt;
    private volatile Map<String, Object> cachedMetadata;

    public LoadedBinary(
            String binaryId,
            Path projectDir,
            GhidraProject project,
            Program program,
            long initialRevision,
            boolean analyzed,
            String analysisProfile,
            String primaryPath,
            Collection<String> existingPaths,
            long fileSizeBytes) {
        this.binaryId = binaryId;
        this.projectDir = projectDir;
        this.project = project;
        this.program = program;
        this.revision = new AtomicLong(Math.max(1L, initialRevision));
        this.analyzed = analyzed;
        this.analysisProfile = analysisProfile != null ? analysisProfile : "default";
        this.fileSizeBytes = fileSizeBytes;
        this.loadedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        this.lastSavedAt = this.loadedAt;
        if (existingPaths != null) {
            for (String p : existingPaths) {
                if (p != null && !p.isBlank()) {
                    this.originalPaths.add(p);
                }
            }
        }
        if (primaryPath != null && !primaryPath.isBlank()) {
            this.primaryPath = primaryPath;
            this.originalPaths.add(primaryPath);
        } else if (!this.originalPaths.isEmpty()) {
            this.primaryPath = this.originalPaths.iterator().next();
        }
        this.cachedMetadata = extractMetadataLocked();
    }

    public String getBinaryId() {
        return binaryId;
    }

    public GhidraProject getProject() {
