    public void recordPath(String path) {
        if (path != null && !path.isBlank()) {
            originalPaths.add(path);
            if (primaryPath == null) {
                primaryPath = path;
            }
        }
    }

    public long markMutated() {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        long rev = revision.incrementAndGet();
        dirty.set(true);
        uncheckpointedMutations.incrementAndGet();
        lastMutationAt.set(now);
        lastAccessedAt.set(now);
        return rev;
    }

    public void refreshMetadata() {
        rwLock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            if (!closed.get()) {
                this.cachedMetadata = extractMetadataLocked();
            }
        } finally {
            rwLock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public Map<String, Object> saveCheckpoint(String reason) throws IOException {
        rwLock.writeLock().lock();
        try {
            if (closed.get()) {
                throw new ApiException(404, "BINARY_NOT_LOADED", "Binary is already closed: " + binaryId);
            }
            if (program.canSave()) {
                try {
                    program.getDomainFile().save(TaskMonitor.DUMMY);
                } catch (CancelledException ex) {
                    throw new IOException("Checkpoint save cancelled", ex);
                }
            }
            this.cachedMetadata = extractMetadataLocked();
            long savedTs = System.currentTimeMillis();
            this.lastSavedAt = savedTs;
            writeMetaJsonLocked(savedTs);
            dirty.set(false);
            uncheckpointedMutations.set(0);

            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            res.put("binaryId", binaryId);
            res.put("revision", revision.get());
            res.put("savedAt", savedTs);
            res.put("reason", reason != null ? reason : "manual");
            return res;
        } finally {
            rwLock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public void writeMetaJson() throws IOException {
        rwLock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            writeMetaJsonLocked(System.currentTimeMillis());
        } finally {
            rwLock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    private void writeMetaJsonLocked(long timestampMs) throws IOException {
        Map<String, Object> meta = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        meta.put("binaryId", binaryId);
        meta.put("sha256", binaryId);
        meta.put("programName", program.getDomainFile() != null ? program.getDomainFile().getName() : program.getName());
        String basename = primaryPath != null
                ? Path.of(primaryPath).getFileName().toString()
                : program.getName();
        meta.put("basename", basename);
        meta.put("primaryPath", primaryPath);
        synchronized (originalPaths) {
            meta.put("originalPaths", new ArrayList<>(originalPaths));
        }
        meta.put("fileSizeBytes", fileSizeBytes);
        meta.put("ghidraVersion", Application.getApplicationVersion());
        meta.put("analyzed", analyzed);
        meta.put("analysisProfile", analysisProfile);
        meta.put("revision", revision.get());
        meta.put("lastOpenedAt", timestampMs);
        meta.put("lastSavedAt", lastSavedAt);

        Map<String, Object> details = cachedMetadata != null ? cachedMetadata : extractMetadataLocked();
        meta.putAll(details);

        writeAtomicJson(projectDir.resolve("meta.json"), meta);
    }

    public static void writeAtomicJson(Path target, Object payload) throws IOException {
        Path parent = target.getParent();
        if (parent != null) {
            Files.createDirectories(parent);
        }
        Path tmp = target.resolveSibling(
                target.getFileName() + ".tmp." + Thread.currentThread().threadId());
        byte[] bytes = (PRETTY_GSON.toJson(payload) + "\n").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        try {
            try (FileChannel ch = FileChannel.open(
                    tmp,
                    StandardOpenOption.CREATE,
                    StandardOpenOption.WRITE,
                    StandardOpenOption.TRUNCATE_EXISTING)) {
                ByteBuffer buf = ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes);
                while (buf.hasRemaining()) {
                    ch.write(buf);
                }
                ch.force(true);
            }
            Files.move(tmp, target, StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException ex) {
            try {
                Files.deleteIfExists(tmp);
            } catch (IOException ignored) {
                // Best-effort cleanup of temp file.
            }
            throw ex;
        }
    }

    public void closeAndRelease() {
        if (!closed.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
            return;
        }
        rwLock.writeLock().lock();
        try {
            if (dirty.get() || program.isChanged()) {
                try {
                    if (program.canSave()) {
                        program.getDomainFile().save(TaskMonitor.DUMMY);
                    }
                    this.lastSavedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
                    writeMetaJsonLocked(this.lastSavedAt);
                } catch (Exception ex) {
                    System.err.println("[ghidra-re] Failed to flush binary " + binaryId + " on close: " + ex.getMessage());
                }
            }
            try {
                if (AutoAnalysisManager.hasAutoAnalysisManager(program)) {
                    AutoAnalysisManager.getAnalysisManager(program).dispose();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
                // Best-effort cleanup of analysis manager.
            }
            try {
                if (program.isUsedBy(project)) {
                    program.release(project);
                }
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                System.err.println("[ghidra-re] Failed releasing program " + binaryId + ": " + ex.getMessage());
            }
            try {
                project.close();
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                System.err.println("[ghidra-re] Failed closing project " + binaryId + ": " + ex.getMessage());
            }
            try {
                Files.deleteIfExists(projectDir.resolve("owner.pid"));
            } catch (IOException ignored) {
                // Best-effort PID cleanup.
            }
        } finally {
            rwLock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public Map<String, Object> toSummaryMap() {
        Map<String, Object> details = cachedMetadata != null ? cachedMetadata : Collections.emptyMap();
        Map<String, Object> summary = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        summary.put("binaryId", binaryId);
        summary.put("shortId", binaryId.substring(0, Math.min(12, binaryId.length())));
        summary.put("programName", program.getName());
        summary.put("primaryPath", primaryPath);
        synchronized (originalPaths) {
            summary.put("originalPaths", new ArrayList<>(originalPaths));
        }
        summary.put("fileSizeBytes", fileSizeBytes);
        summary.put("analyzed", analyzed);
        summary.put("analysisProfile", analysisProfile);
        summary.put("revision", revision.get());
        summary.put("dirty", dirty.get());
        summary.put("uncheckpointedMutations", uncheckpointedMutations.get());
        summary.put("loadedAt", loadedAt);
        summary.put("lastAccessedAt", lastAccessedAt.get());
        summary.put("lastSavedAt", lastSavedAt);
        summary.putAll(details);
        return summary;
    }

    private Map<String, Object> extractMetadataLocked() {
        int pointerSize = program.getDefaultPointerSize();
        SymbolTable symbolTable = program.getSymbolTable();

        int importCount = 0;
        SymbolIterator extIt = symbolTable.getExternalSymbols();
        while (extIt.hasNext()) {
            extIt.next();
            importCount++;
        }

        int exportCount = 0;
        List<Map<String, Object>> entrypoints = new ArrayList<>();
        AddressIterator entryIt = symbolTable.getExternalEntryPointIterator();
        while (entryIt.hasNext()) {
            Address addr = entryIt.next();
            exportCount++;
            if (entrypoints.size() < 10) {
                Symbol primarySym = symbolTable.getPrimarySymbol(addr);
                Map<String, Object> ep = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                ep.put("address", formatAddress(addr, pointerSize));
                ep.put("name", primarySym != null ? primarySym.getName() : formatAddress(addr, pointerSize));
                entrypoints.add(ep);
            }
        }

        List<Map<String, Object>> sections = new ArrayList<>();
        Set<String> warnings = new LinkedHashSet<>();

        for (MemoryBlock block : program.getMemory().getBlocks()) {
            String blockName = block.getName() != null ? block.getName() : "";
            String lowerName = blockName.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            if (PACKER_SECTION_NAMES.contains(lowerName)) {
                warnings.add("PACKER_SECTION_DETECTED");
            }

            boolean initialized = block.isInitialized();
            boolean executable = block.isExecute();
            Double entropyVal = null;
            if (initialized && executable && block.getSize() > 0) {
                double rawEntropy = computeBlockShannonEntropy(block);
                entropyVal = Math.round(rawEntropy * 1000.0) / 1000.0;
                if (rawEntropy > 7.2 && importCount < 5) {
                    warnings.add("HIGH_ENTROPY_POSSIBLY_PACKED");
                }
            }

            Map<String, Object> sec = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            sec.put("name", blockName);
            sec.put("start", formatAddress(block.getStart(), pointerSize));
            sec.put("end", formatAddress(block.getEnd(), pointerSize));
            sec.put("size", block.getSize());
            sec.put("permissions",
                    (block.isRead() ? "r" : "-")
                            + (block.isWrite() ? "w" : "-")
                            + (executable ? "x" : "-"));
            sec.put("read", block.isRead());
            sec.put("write", block.isWrite());
            sec.put("execute", executable);
            sec.put("initialized", initialized);
            if (entropyVal != null) {
                sec.put("entropy", entropyVal);
            }
            sections.add(sec);
        }

        Map<String, Object> meta = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        meta.put("format", program.getExecutableFormat() != null ? program.getExecutableFormat() : "unknown");
        meta.put("arch", program.getLanguage().getProcessor().toString());
        meta.put("languageId", program.getLanguageID().getIdAsString());
        meta.put("endianness", program.getLanguage().isBigEndian() ? "big" : "little");
        meta.put("compilerSpec", program.getCompilerSpec().getCompilerSpecID().getIdAsString());
        meta.put("imageBase", formatAddress(program.getImageBase(), pointerSize));
        meta.put("pointerSize", pointerSize);
        meta.put("entrypoints", entrypoints);
        meta.put("sections", sections);
        meta.put("functionCount", program.getFunctionManager().getFunctionCount());
        meta.put("importCount", importCount);
        meta.put("exportCount", exportCount);
        meta.put("definedDataCount", program.getListing().getNumDefinedData());
        meta.put("warnings", new ArrayList<>(warnings));
        return meta;
    }

    private static double computeBlockShannonEntropy(MemoryBlock block) {
        long[] counts = new long[256];
        long total = 0L;
        byte[] buffer = new byte[65536];
        try (InputStream in = block.getData()) {
            if (in == null) {
                return 0.0;
            }
            int read;
            while ((read = in.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                for (int i = 0; i < read; i++) {
                    counts[buffer[i] & 0xFF]++;
                }
                total += read;
            }
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            return 0.0;
        }
        if (total <= 0L) {
            return 0.0;
        }
        double invTotal = 1.0 / (double) total;
        double invLog2 = 1.0 / Math.log(2.0);
        double entropy = 0.0;
        for (long count : counts) {
            if (count > 0L) {
                double p = count * invTotal;
                entropy -= p * Math.log(p) * invLog2;
            }
        }
        return entropy;
    }

    public static String formatAddress(Address addr, int pointerSizeBytes) {
        if (addr == null) {
            return "0x00000000";
        }
        int hexDigits = Math.max(8, pointerSizeBytes * 2);
        return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "0x%0" + hexDigits + "x", addr.getOffset());
    }
}

/**
 * Transactional Ghidra Program mutation service supporting rename, retype, comment, and
 * atomic multi-op batches with optimistic revision checks, fine-grained cache invalidation,
 * and live EventBus mutation publishing.
 */
public final class MutationService {

    private static final int MAX_BATCH_OPS = 25;
    private static final Pattern STDINT_WORD_PATTERN = Pattern.compile(
            "\\b(uint8_t|uint16_t|uint32_t|uint64_t|int8_t|int16_t|int32_t|int64_t|size_t|ssize_t|uintptr_t|intptr_t|bool)\\b");

    private final DecompilerPool decompilerPool;
    private final InspectionService inspectionService;
    private final EventBus eventBus;

    public MutationService(
            DecompilerPool decompilerPool,
            InspectionService inspectionService,
            EventBus eventBus) {
        this.decompilerPool = decompilerPool;
        this.inspectionService = inspectionService;
        this.eventBus = eventBus;
    }

    /**
     * Renames a function, local/param variable, label, or global symbol.
     */
    public Map<String, Object> rename(
            LoadedBinary lb,
            String targetKind,
            String address,
            String functionAddress,
            String oldName,
            String newName,
            Long expectedRevision,
            String actor) {
        ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
        String kind = normalizeRenameKind(targetKind);
        String cleanNewName = requireNonBlank(newName, "newName");

        HighFunction prefetchedHighFn = null;
        if ("variable".equals(kind)) {
            checkRevisionOptimistic(lb, expectedRevision);
            String fnTarget = nonBlankOrNull(functionAddress) != null ? functionAddress : address;
            if (fnTarget == null) {
                throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "functionAddress or address is required for variable rename");
            }
            Function fn = inspectionService.resolveFunction(lb, fnTarget);
            prefetchedHighFn = tryDecompileForHighFunction(lb, fn);
        }

        lb.getRwLock().writeLock().lock();
        try {
            ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
            checkRevisionLocked(lb, expectedRevision);

            Program program = lb.getProgram();
            Set<String> invalidatedFuncs = new LinkedHashSet<>();
            Map<String, HighSymbol> varAliases = new HashMap<>();
            Map<String, String> renamedVarNames = new HashMap<>();

            int tx = program.startTransaction("Rename " + kind + " -> " + cleanNewName);
            boolean commit = false;
            MutationOutcome outcome;
            try {
                outcome = executeRenameLocked(
                        lb, program, kind, address, functionAddress, oldName, cleanNewName,
                        prefetchedHighFn, varAliases, renamedVarNames, invalidatedFuncs);
                commit = true;
            } finally {
                program.endTransaction(tx, commit);
            }

            long newRevision = lb.markMutated();
            if (outcome.structuralChange()) {
                lb.refreshMetadata();
            }
            invalidateCaches(lb.getBinaryId(), invalidatedFuncs);

            List<String> invalidatedList = new ArrayList<>(invalidatedFuncs);
            Map<String, Object> detail = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            detail.put("op", "rename_" + kind);
            detail.put("targetKind", kind);
            detail.put("address", outcome.addressHex());
            detail.put("oldName", outcome.oldValue());
            detail.put("newName", cleanNewName);
            detail.put("invalidatedFuncs", invalidatedList);
            publishMutationEvent(actor, lb.getBinaryId(), newRevision, detail);

            Map<String, Object> response = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            response.put("binaryId", lb.getBinaryId());
            response.put("revision", newRevision);
            response.put("targetKind", kind);
            response.put("address", outcome.addressHex());
            response.put("oldName", outcome.oldValue());
            response.put("newName", cleanNewName);
            response.put("invalidatedFuncs", invalidatedList);
            return response;
        } finally {
            lb.getRwLock().writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Retypes a function signature, local/param variable, or data item at an address.
     */
    public Map<String, Object> retype(
            LoadedBinary lb,
            String targetKind,
            String address,
            String functionAddress,
            String varName,
            String declaration,
            Long expectedRevision,
            String actor) {
        ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
        String kind = normalizeRetypeKind(targetKind);
        String cleanDecl = requireNonBlankDeclaration(declaration);

        HighFunction prefetchedHighFn = null;
        if ("variable".equals(kind)) {
            checkRevisionOptimistic(lb, expectedRevision);
            String fnTarget = nonBlankOrNull(functionAddress) != null ? functionAddress : address;
            if (fnTarget == null) {
                throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "functionAddress or address is required for variable retype");
            }
            Function fn = inspectionService.resolveFunction(lb, fnTarget);
            prefetchedHighFn = tryDecompileForHighFunction(lb, fn);
        }

        lb.getRwLock().writeLock().lock();
        try {
            ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
            checkRevisionLocked(lb, expectedRevision);

            Program program = lb.getProgram();
            Set<String> invalidatedFuncs = new LinkedHashSet<>();
            Map<String, HighSymbol> varAliases = new HashMap<>();
            Map<String, String> renamedVarNames = new HashMap<>();

            int tx = program.startTransaction("Retype " + kind);
            boolean commit = false;
            MutationOutcome outcome;
            try {
                outcome = executeRetypeLocked(
                        lb, program, kind, address, functionAddress, varName, cleanDecl,
                        prefetchedHighFn, varAliases, renamedVarNames, invalidatedFuncs);
                commit = true;
            } finally {
                program.endTransaction(tx, commit);
            }

            long newRevision = lb.markMutated();
            if (outcome.structuralChange()) {
                lb.refreshMetadata();
            }
            invalidateCaches(lb.getBinaryId(), invalidatedFuncs);

            List<String> invalidatedList = new ArrayList<>(invalidatedFuncs);
            Map<String, Object> detail = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            detail.put("op", "retype_" + kind);
            detail.put("targetKind", kind);
            detail.put("address", outcome.addressHex());
            detail.put("declaration", cleanDecl);
            detail.put("appliedType", outcome.newValue());
            if ("function_signature".equals(kind)) {
                detail.put("signature", outcome.newValue());
            }
            detail.put("invalidatedFuncs", invalidatedList);
            detail.put("invalidatedCount", invalidatedList.size());
            publishMutationEvent(actor, lb.getBinaryId(), newRevision, detail);

            Map<String, Object> response = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            response.put("binaryId", lb.getBinaryId());
            response.put("revision", newRevision);
            response.put("targetKind", kind);
            response.put("address", outcome.addressHex());
            response.put("declaration", cleanDecl);
            response.put("appliedType", outcome.newValue());
            if ("function_signature".equals(kind)) {
                response.put("signature", outcome.newValue());
            }
            response.put("invalidatedFuncs", invalidatedList);
            response.put("invalidatedCount", invalidatedList.size());
            return response;
        } finally {
            lb.getRwLock().writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Sets or clears a listing comment ({@code EOL|PRE|POST|PLATE|REPEATABLE}) at an address.
     */
    public Map<String, Object> setComment(
            LoadedBinary lb,
            String address,
            String kind,
            String text,
            Long expectedRevision,
            String actor) {
        ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
        String cleanAddr = requireNonBlank(address, "address");
        CommentType commentType = parseCommentType(kind);
        String normalizedText = (text == null || text.isBlank()) ? null : text;

        lb.getRwLock().writeLock().lock();
        try {
            ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
            checkRevisionLocked(lb, expectedRevision);

            Program program = lb.getProgram();
            Set<String> invalidatedFuncs = new LinkedHashSet<>();

            int tx = program.startTransaction("Set " + commentType.name() + " comment");
            boolean commit = false;
            MutationOutcome outcome;
            try {
                outcome = executeCommentLocked(program, cleanAddr, commentType, normalizedText, invalidatedFuncs);
                commit = true;
            } finally {
                program.endTransaction(tx, commit);
            }

            long newRevision = lb.markMutated();
            invalidateCaches(lb.getBinaryId(), invalidatedFuncs);

            List<String> invalidatedList = new ArrayList<>(invalidatedFuncs);
            Map<String, Object> detail = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            detail.put("op", "set_comment");
            detail.put("address", outcome.addressHex());
            detail.put("kind", commentType.name());
            detail.put("text", normalizedText);
            detail.put("invalidatedFuncs", invalidatedList);
            publishMutationEvent(actor, lb.getBinaryId(), newRevision, detail);

            Map<String, Object> response = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            response.put("binaryId", lb.getBinaryId());
            response.put("revision", newRevision);
            response.put("address", outcome.addressHex());
            response.put("kind", commentType.name());
            response.put("text", normalizedText);
            response.put("invalidatedFuncs", invalidatedList);
            return response;
        } finally {
            lb.getRwLock().writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Executes up to 25 rename/retype/comment operations atomically inside one ProgramDB transaction.
     */
    public Map<String, Object> batch(
            LoadedBinary lb,
            List<Map<String, Object>> ops,
            Long expectedRevision,
            String actor) {
        ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
        if (ops == null || ops.isEmpty()) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Batch 'ops' array must not be empty");
        }
        if (ops.size() > MAX_BATCH_OPS) {
            throw new ApiException(
                    400,
                    "INVALID_PARAMS",
                    "Batch exceeds maximum of " + MAX_BATCH_OPS + " operations (got " + ops.size() + ")");
        }

        List<ParsedBatchOp> parsedOps = new ArrayList<>(ops.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < ops.size(); i++) {
            parsedOps.add(parseBatchOp(ops.get(i), i));
        }

        // Pre-fetch HighFunctions for any variable mutations before acquiring the write lock.
        Map<String, HighFunction> prefetchedHighFunctions = new HashMap<>();
        boolean needsDecompile = parsedOps.stream().anyMatch(
                op -> ("rename".equals(op.opType()) || "retype".equals(op.opType()))
                        && "variable".equals(op.targetKind()));
        if (needsDecompile) {
            checkRevisionOptimistic(lb, expectedRevision);
            for (ParsedBatchOp op : parsedOps) {
                if (("rename".equals(op.opType()) || "retype".equals(op.opType()))
                        && "variable".equals(op.targetKind())) {
                    String fnTarget = op.functionAddress() != null ? op.functionAddress() : op.address();
                    if (fnTarget != null) {
                        Function fn = inspectionService.resolveFunction(lb, fnTarget);
                        String fnKey = fn.getEntryPoint().toString();
                        if (!prefetchedHighFunctions.containsKey(fnKey)) {
                            HighFunction hf = tryDecompileForHighFunction(lb, fn);
                            if (hf != null) {
                                prefetchedHighFunctions.put(fnKey, hf);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        lb.getRwLock().writeLock().lock();
        try {
            ensureBinaryOpen(lb);
            checkRevisionLocked(lb, expectedRevision);

            Program program = lb.getProgram();
            Set<String> invalidatedFuncs = new LinkedHashSet<>();
            Map<String, Map<String, HighSymbol>> perFuncAliases = new HashMap<>();
            Map<String, Map<String, String>> perFuncRenamedNames = new HashMap<>();
            List<Map<String, Object>> appliedResults = new ArrayList<>(parsedOps.size());
            boolean structuralChange = false;

            int tx = program.startTransaction("Batch mutation (" + parsedOps.size() + " ops)");
            boolean commit = false;
            try {
                for (ParsedBatchOp op : parsedOps) {
                    MutationOutcome outcome;
                    switch (op.opType()) {
                        case "rename" -> {
                            HighFunction hf = resolvePrefetchedForOp(lb, op, prefetchedHighFunctions);
                            Map<String, HighSymbol> aliases = funcScopedMap(lb, op, perFuncAliases);
                            Map<String, String> renamedNames = funcScopedMap(lb, op, perFuncRenamedNames);
                            outcome = executeRenameLocked(
                                    lb, program, op.targetKind(), op.address(), op.functionAddress(),
                                    op.oldName(), op.newName(), hf, aliases, renamedNames, invalidatedFuncs);
                        }
                        case "retype" -> {
                            HighFunction hf = resolvePrefetchedForOp(lb, op, prefetchedHighFunctions);
                            Map<String, HighSymbol> aliases = funcScopedMap(lb, op, perFuncAliases);
                            Map<String, String> renamedNames = funcScopedMap(lb, op, perFuncRenamedNames);
                            outcome = executeRetypeLocked(
                                    lb, program, op.targetKind(), op.address(), op.functionAddress(),
                                    op.varName(), op.declaration(), hf, aliases, renamedNames, invalidatedFuncs);
                        }
                        case "comment" -> outcome = executeCommentLocked(
                                program, op.address(), op.commentType(), op.text(), invalidatedFuncs);
                        default -> throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Unsupported batch op: " + op.opType());
                    }
                    if (outcome.structuralChange()) {
                        structuralChange = true;
                    }
                    Map<String, Object> itemResult = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    itemResult.put("op", op.opType());
                    if (op.targetKind() != null) {
                        itemResult.put("targetKind", op.targetKind());
                    }
                    itemResult.put("address", outcome.addressHex());
                    if (outcome.oldValue() != null) {
                        itemResult.put("oldValue", outcome.oldValue());
                    }
                    if (outcome.newValue() != null) {
                        itemResult.put("newValue", outcome.newValue());
                    }
                    appliedResults.add(itemResult);
                }
                commit = true;
            } finally {
                program.endTransaction(tx, commit);
            }

            long newRevision = lb.markMutated();
            if (structuralChange) {
                lb.refreshMetadata();
            }
            invalidateCaches(lb.getBinaryId(), invalidatedFuncs);

            List<String> invalidatedList = new ArrayList<>(invalidatedFuncs);
            Map<String, Object> detail = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            detail.put("op", "batch");
            detail.put("appliedCount", appliedResults.size());
            detail.put("ops", appliedResults);
            detail.put("invalidatedFuncs", invalidatedList);
            publishMutationEvent(actor, lb.getBinaryId(), newRevision, detail);

            Map<String, Object> response = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            response.put("binaryId", lb.getBinaryId());
            response.put("revision", newRevision);
            response.put("appliedCount", appliedResults.size());
            response.put("results", appliedResults);
            response.put("invalidatedFuncs", invalidatedList);
            return response;
        } finally {
            lb.getRwLock().writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Core mutation execution helpers (called under writeLock + transaction)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private record MutationOutcome(String addressHex, String oldValue, String newValue, boolean structuralChange) {
    }

    private record ParsedBatchOp(
            String opType,
            String targetKind,
            String address,
            String functionAddress,
            String oldName,
            String newName,
            String varName,
            String declaration,
            CommentType commentType,
            String text) {
    }

    private MutationOutcome executeRenameLocked(
            LoadedBinary lb,
            Program program,
            String kind,
            String address,
            String functionAddress,
            String oldName,
            String newName,
            HighFunction prefetchedHighFn,
            Map<String, HighSymbol> varAliases,
            Map<String, String> renamedVarNames,
            Set<String> invalidatedFuncs) {
        FunctionManager fm = program.getFunctionManager();
        SymbolTable symbolTable = program.getSymbolTable();
        ReferenceManager refMgr = program.getReferenceManager();
        int ptrSize = program.getDefaultPointerSize();

        switch (kind) {
            case "function" -> {
                String target = nonBlankOrNull(address) != null ? address : nonBlankOrNull(oldName);
                if (target == null) {
                    throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "address or oldName is required for function rename");
                }
                Function fn = inspectionService.resolveFunction(lb, target);
                String prevName = fn.getName();
                String entryHex = LoadedBinary.formatAddress(fn.getEntryPoint(), ptrSize);
                try {
                    fn.setName(newName, SourceType.USER_DEFINED);
                } catch (DuplicateNameException | InvalidInputException ex) {
                    throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Failed to rename function: " + ex.getMessage(),
                            false, Collections.emptyMap(), ex);
                }
                invalidatedFuncs.add(entryHex);
                addCallerFunctions(fn, ptrSize, invalidatedFuncs);
                return new MutationOutcome(entryHex, prevName, newName, true);
            }
            case "variable" -> {
                String fnTarget = nonBlankOrNull(functionAddress) != null
                        ? functionAddress
                        : nonBlankOrNull(address);
                if (fnTarget == null) {
                    throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS",
                            "functionAddress or address is required for variable rename");
                }
                String cleanOldName = requireNonBlank(oldName, "oldName");
                Function fn = inspectionService.resolveFunction(lb, fnTarget);
                String entryHex = LoadedBinary.formatAddress(fn.getEntryPoint(), ptrSize);

                HighSymbol highSym = findHighSymbol(prefetchedHighFn, varAliases, renamedVarNames, cleanOldName);
                if (highSym != null) {
                    String origName = highSym.getName();
                    String prevName = renamedVarNames.getOrDefault(origName, origName);
                    try {
                        HighFunctionDBUtil.updateDBVariable(highSym, newName, null, SourceType.USER_DEFINED);
                    } catch (DuplicateNameException | InvalidInputException ex) {
                        throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS",
                                "Failed to rename variable: " + ex.getMessage(), false, Collections.emptyMap(), ex);
                    }
                    varAliases.remove(cleanOldName);
                    varAliases.put(newName, highSym);
                    renamedVarNames.put(origName, newName);
                    invalidatedFuncs.add(entryHex);
                    return new MutationOutcome(entryHex, prevName, newName, false);
                }

                Variable dbVar = findDbVariable(fn, cleanOldName);
                if (dbVar == null) {
                    throw new ApiException(404, "SYMBOL_NOT_FOUND",
                            "Variable '" + cleanOldName + "' not found in function " + fn.getName());
                }
                String prevName = dbVar.getName();
                try {
                    dbVar.setName(newName, SourceType.USER_DEFINED);
                } catch (DuplicateNameException | InvalidInputException ex) {
                    throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS",
                            "Failed to rename variable: " + ex.getMessage(), false, Collections.emptyMap(), ex);
                }
                invalidatedFuncs.add(entryHex);
                return new MutationOutcome(entryHex, prevName, newName, false);
            }
            case "label" -> {
                String addrInput = requireNonBlank(address, "address");
                Address addr = inspectionService.parseAddress(program, addrInput);
                if (!program.getMemory().contains(addr)) {
                    throw new ApiException(404, "UNMAPPED_ADDRESS", "Address is not mapped: " + addrInput);
                }
                String addrHex = LoadedBinary.formatAddress(addr, ptrSize);
                Symbol sym = findSymbolAtAddress(symbolTable, addr, oldName);
                String prevName = sym != null ? sym.getName() : null;
                try {
                    if (sym != null) {
                        sym.setName(newName, SourceType.USER_DEFINED);
                    } else {
                        symbolTable.createLabel(addr, newName, SourceType.USER_DEFINED);
                    }
                } catch (DuplicateNameException | InvalidInputException ex) {
                    throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS",
                            "Failed to rename label: " + ex.getMessage(), false, Collections.emptyMap(), ex);
                }
                Function containingFn = fm.getFunctionContaining(addr);
                boolean structural = false;
                if (containingFn != null) {
                    invalidatedFuncs.add(LoadedBinary.formatAddress(containingFn.getEntryPoint(), ptrSize));
                    if (containingFn.getEntryPoint().equals(addr)) {
                        addCallerFunctions(containingFn, ptrSize, invalidatedFuncs);
                        structural = true;
                    }
                }
                return new MutationOutcome(addrHex, prevName, newName, structural);
            }
            case "global" -> {
                Symbol sym = null;
                Address addr = null;
                if (nonBlankOrNull(address) != null) {
                    addr = inspectionService.parseAddress(program, address);
                    if (!program.getMemory().contains(addr)) {
                        throw new ApiException(404, "UNMAPPED_ADDRESS", "Address is not mapped: " + address);
                    }
                    sym = findSymbolAtAddress(symbolTable, addr, oldName);
                } else if (nonBlankOrNull(oldName) != null) {
                    sym = findGlobalSymbolByName(symbolTable, oldName.trim());
                    if (sym == null) {
                        throw new ApiException(404, "SYMBOL_NOT_FOUND", "Global symbol not found: " + oldName);
                    }
                    addr = sym.getAddress();
                } else {
                    throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "address or oldName is required for global rename");
                }

                String addrHex = LoadedBinary.formatAddress(addr, ptrSize);
                String prevName = sym != null ? sym.getName() : null;
                try {
                    if (sym != null) {
                        sym.setName(newName, SourceType.USER_DEFINED);
                    } else {
                        symbolTable.createLabel(addr, newName, SourceType.USER_DEFINED);
                    }
                } catch (DuplicateNameException | InvalidInputException ex) {
                    throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS",
                            "Failed to rename global symbol: " + ex.getMessage(), false, Collections.emptyMap(), ex);
                }
                addReferencingFunctions(fm, refMgr, addr, ptrSize, invalidatedFuncs);
                Function containingFn = fm.getFunctionContaining(addr);
                if (containingFn != null) {
                    invalidatedFuncs.add(LoadedBinary.formatAddress(containingFn.getEntryPoint(), ptrSize));
                }
                return new MutationOutcome(addrHex, prevName, newName, true);
            }
            default -> throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Unsupported rename targetKind: " + kind);
        }
    }

    private MutationOutcome executeRetypeLocked(
            LoadedBinary lb,
            Program program,
            String kind,
            String address,
            String functionAddress,
            String varName,
            String declaration,
            HighFunction prefetchedHighFn,
            Map<String, HighSymbol> varAliases,
            Map<String, String> renamedVarNames,
            Set<String> invalidatedFuncs) {
        DataTypeManager dtm = program.getDataTypeManager();
        FunctionManager fm = program.getFunctionManager();
        Listing listing = program.getListing();
        ReferenceManager refMgr = program.getReferenceManager();
        int ptrSize = program.getDefaultPointerSize();

        switch (kind) {
            case "function_signature" -> {
                String fnTarget = nonBlankOrNull(address) != null
                        ? address
                        : nonBlankOrNull(functionAddress);
                if (fnTarget == null) {
                    throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS",
                            "address or functionAddress is required for function_signature retype");
                }
                Function fn = inspectionService.resolveFunction(lb, fnTarget);
                String entryHex = LoadedBinary.formatAddress(fn.getEntryPoint(), ptrSize);
                FunctionDefinitionDataType parsedSig = parseFunctionSignature(dtm, fn, declaration, ptrSize);

                ApplyFunctionSignatureCmd cmd = new ApplyFunctionSignatureCmd(
                        fn.getEntryPoint(),
                        parsedSig,
                        SourceType.USER_DEFINED,
                        false,
                        true,
                        DataTypeConflictHandler.DEFAULT_HANDLER,
                        FunctionRenameOption.NO_CHANGE);
                if (!cmd.applyTo(program, TaskMonitor.DUMMY)) {
                    throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_C_DECLARATION",
                            "Failed to apply function signature: " + cmd.getStatusMsg());
                }
                invalidatedFuncs.add(entryHex);
                addCallerFunctions(fn, ptrSize, invalidatedFuncs);
                String appliedSignature = fn.getPrototypeString(false, false);
                return new MutationOutcome(entryHex, null, appliedSignature, true);
            }
            case "variable" -> {
                String fnTarget = nonBlankOrNull(functionAddress) != null
                        ? functionAddress
                        : nonBlankOrNull(address);
                if (fnTarget == null) {
                    throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS",
                            "functionAddress or address is required for variable retype");
                }
                String cleanVarName = requireNonBlank(varName, "varName");
                Function fn = inspectionService.resolveFunction(lb, fnTarget);
                String entryHex = LoadedBinary.formatAddress(fn.getEntryPoint(), ptrSize);
                DataType dt = parseDataType(dtm, declaration, ptrSize);

                HighSymbol highSym = findHighSymbol(prefetchedHighFn, varAliases, renamedVarNames, cleanVarName);
                if (highSym != null) {
                    String effectiveName = renamedVarNames.getOrDefault(highSym.getName(), highSym.getName());
                    try {
                        HighFunctionDBUtil.updateDBVariable(highSym, effectiveName, dt, SourceType.USER_DEFINED);
                    } catch (DuplicateNameException | InvalidInputException ex) {
                        throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_C_DECLARATION",
                                "Failed to retype variable: " + ex.getMessage(), false, Collections.emptyMap(), ex);
                    }
                    invalidatedFuncs.add(entryHex);
                    return new MutationOutcome(entryHex, null, dt.getDisplayName(), false);
                }

                Variable dbVar = findDbVariable(fn, cleanVarName);
                if (dbVar == null) {
                    throw new ApiException(404, "SYMBOL_NOT_FOUND",
                            "Variable '" + cleanVarName + "' not found in function " + fn.getName());
                }
                try {
                    dbVar.setDataType(dt, SourceType.USER_DEFINED);
                } catch (InvalidInputException ex) {
                    throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_C_DECLARATION",
                            "Failed to retype variable: " + ex.getMessage(), false, Collections.emptyMap(), ex);
                }
                invalidatedFuncs.add(entryHex);
                return new MutationOutcome(entryHex, null, dt.getDisplayName(), false);
            }
            case "data" -> {
                String addrInput = requireNonBlank(address, "address");
                Address addr = inspectionService.parseAddress(program, addrInput);
                if (!program.getMemory().contains(addr)) {
                    throw new ApiException(404, "UNMAPPED_ADDRESS", "Address is not mapped: " + addrInput);
                }
                String addrHex = LoadedBinary.formatAddress(addr, ptrSize);
                DataType dt = parseDataType(dtm, declaration, ptrSize);

                CreateDataCmd cmd = new CreateDataCmd(
                        addr, dt, false, DataUtilities.ClearDataMode.CLEAR_ALL_CONFLICT_DATA);
                if (!cmd.applyTo(program)) {
                    if (listing.getInstructionContaining(addr) != null) {
                        throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS",
                                "Cannot apply data type over instruction at " + addrHex + ": " + cmd.getStatusMsg());
                    }
                    if (dt.getLength() > 0) {
                        try {
                            listing.clearCodeUnits(addr, addr.add(dt.getLength() - 1L), false);
                            listing.createData(addr, dt);
                        } catch (CodeUnitInsertionException ex) {
                            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS",
                                    "Failed to create data at " + addrHex + ": " + ex.getMessage(),
                                    false, Collections.emptyMap(), ex);
                        }
                    } else {
                        throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS",
                                "Failed to create data at " + addrHex + ": " + cmd.getStatusMsg());
                    }
                }

                addReferencingFunctions(fm, refMgr, addr, ptrSize, invalidatedFuncs);
                Function containingFn = fm.getFunctionContaining(addr);
                if (containingFn != null) {
                    invalidatedFuncs.add(LoadedBinary.formatAddress(containingFn.getEntryPoint(), ptrSize));
                }
                return new MutationOutcome(addrHex, null, dt.getDisplayName(), true);
            }
            default -> throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Unsupported retype targetKind: " + kind);
        }
    }

    private MutationOutcome executeCommentLocked(
            Program program,
            String address,
            CommentType commentType,
            String normalizedText,
            Set<String> invalidatedFuncs) {
        Listing listing = program.getListing();
        FunctionManager fm = program.getFunctionManager();
        int ptrSize = program.getDefaultPointerSize();

        Address addr = inspectionService.parseAddress(program, address);
        if (!program.getMemory().contains(addr)) {
            throw new ApiException(404, "UNMAPPED_ADDRESS", "Address is not mapped: " + address);
        }
        String addrHex = LoadedBinary.formatAddress(addr, ptrSize);
        String oldComment = listing.getComment(commentType, addr);
        listing.setComment(addr, commentType, normalizedText);

        Function fn = fm.getFunctionContaining(addr);
        if (fn != null) {
            invalidatedFuncs.add(LoadedBinary.formatAddress(fn.getEntryPoint(), ptrSize));
        }
        return new MutationOutcome(addrHex, oldComment, normalizedText, false);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Parsing, lookup, and validation helpers
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private static void ensureBinaryOpen(LoadedBinary lb) {
        if (lb == null || lb.isClosed()) {
            throw new ApiException(404, "BINARY_NOT_LOADED", "Binary is not loaded");
        }
    }

    private static void checkRevisionOptimistic(LoadedBinary lb, Long expectedRevision) {
        if (expectedRevision == null) {
            return;
        }
        lb.getRwLock().readLock().lock();
        try {
            checkRevisionLocked(lb, expectedRevision);
        } finally {
            lb.getRwLock().readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    private static void checkRevisionLocked(LoadedBinary lb, Long expectedRevision) {
        if (expectedRevision == null) {
            return;
        }
        long current = lb.getRevision();
        if (expectedRevision.longValue() != current) {
            Map<String, Object> details = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            details.put("currentRevision", current);
            details.put("expectedRevision", expectedRevision);
            throw new ApiException(
                    409,
                    "REVISION_CONFLICT",
                    "Revision conflict: expected " + expectedRevision + ", current is " + current,
                    false,
                    details);
        }
    }

    private HighFunction tryDecompileForHighFunction(LoadedBinary lb, Function fn) {
        if (decompilerPool == null) {
            return null;
        }
        try {
            return decompilerPool.decompileForHighFunction(lb, fn, DecompilerPool.Priority.P0_UI);
        } catch (ApiException ex) {
            // Fall back to DB Variable lookup if decompilation fails or times out.
            return null;
        }
    }

    private HighFunction resolvePrefetchedForOp(
            LoadedBinary lb,
            ParsedBatchOp op,
            Map<String, HighFunction> prefetched) {
        if (!"variable".equals(op.targetKind())) {
            return null;
        }
        String fnTarget = op.functionAddress() != null ? op.functionAddress() : op.address();
        if (fnTarget == null) {
            return null;
        }
        Function fn = inspectionService.resolveFunction(lb, fnTarget);
        return prefetched.get(fn.getEntryPoint().toString());
    }

    private <V> Map<String, V> funcScopedMap(
            LoadedBinary lb,
            ParsedBatchOp op,
            Map<String, Map<String, V>> perFuncMaps) {
        if (!"variable".equals(op.targetKind())) {
            return Collections.emptyMap();
        }
        String fnTarget = op.functionAddress() != null ? op.functionAddress() : op.address();
        if (fnTarget == null) {
            return Collections.emptyMap();
        }
        Function fn = inspectionService.resolveFunction(lb, fnTarget);
        return perFuncMaps.computeIfAbsent(fn.getEntryPoint().toString(), k -> new HashMap<>());
    }

    private static HighSymbol findHighSymbol(
            HighFunction highFn,
            Map<String, HighSymbol> aliases,
            Map<String, String> renamedVarNames,
            String name) {
        if (aliases != null && aliases.containsKey(name)) {
            return aliases.get(name);
        }
        if (highFn == null || highFn.getLocalSymbolMap() == null) {
            return null;
        }
        Iterator<HighSymbol> it = highFn.getLocalSymbolMap().getSymbols();
        while (it.hasNext()) {
            HighSymbol sym = it.next();
            if (renamedVarNames != null && renamedVarNames.containsKey(sym.getName())) {
                continue;
            }
            if (name.equals(sym.getName())) {
                return sym;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static Variable findDbVariable(Function fn, String name) {
        for (Variable p : fn.getParameters()) {
            if (name.equals(p.getName())) {
                return p;
            }
        }
        for (Variable local : fn.getLocalVariables()) {
            if (name.equals(local.getName())) {
                return local;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static Symbol findSymbolAtAddress(SymbolTable symbolTable, Address addr, String preferredName) {
        String cleanPreferred = nonBlankOrNull(preferredName);
        if (cleanPreferred != null) {
            for (Symbol s : symbolTable.getSymbols(addr)) {
                if (cleanPreferred.equals(s.getName())) {
                    return s;
                }
            }
        }
        return symbolTable.getPrimarySymbol(addr);
    }

    private static Symbol findGlobalSymbolByName(SymbolTable symbolTable, String name) {
        SymbolIterator it = symbolTable.getSymbols(name);
        while (it.hasNext()) {
            Symbol s = it.next();
            if (!s.isExternal()
                    && (s.getSymbolType() == SymbolType.LABEL
                            || s.getSymbolType() == SymbolType.GLOBAL
                            || s.getSymbolType() == SymbolType.GLOBAL_VAR
                            || s.getSymbolType() == SymbolType.FUNCTION)) {
                return s;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static void addCallerFunctions(Function fn, int ptrSize, Set<String> out) {
        for (Function caller : fn.getCallingFunctions(TaskMonitor.DUMMY)) {
            out.add(LoadedBinary.formatAddress(caller.getEntryPoint(), ptrSize));
        }
    }

    private static void addReferencingFunctions(
            FunctionManager fm,
            ReferenceManager refMgr,
            Address targetAddr,
            int ptrSize,
            Set<String> out) {
        ReferenceIterator it = refMgr.getReferencesTo(targetAddr);
        while (it.hasNext()) {
            Reference ref = it.next();
            Function refFn = fm.getFunctionContaining(ref.getFromAddress());
            if (refFn != null) {
                out.add(LoadedBinary.formatAddress(refFn.getEntryPoint(), ptrSize));
            }
        }
    }

    private static FunctionDefinitionDataType parseFunctionSignature(
            DataTypeManager dtm,
            Function fn,
            String declaration,
            int ptrSize) {
        FunctionSignatureParser parser = new FunctionSignatureParser(dtm, null);
        try {
            return parser.parse(fn.getSignature(), declaration);
        } catch (ParseException | CancelledException | RuntimeException firstEx) {
            String rewritten = rewriteStdintAliases(declaration, ptrSize, true);
            if (!rewritten.equals(declaration)) {
                try {
                    return parser.parse(fn.getSignature(), rewritten);
                } catch (ParseException | CancelledException | RuntimeException retryEx) {
                    throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_C_DECLARATION",
                            "Invalid C function signature: " + retryEx.getMessage(),
                            false, Collections.emptyMap(), retryEx);
                }
            }
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_C_DECLARATION",
                    "Invalid C function signature: " + firstEx.getMessage(),
                    false, Collections.emptyMap(), firstEx);
        }
    }

    private static DataType parseDataType(DataTypeManager dtm, String declaration, int ptrSize) {
        DataTypeParser parser = new DataTypeParser(dtm, dtm, null, DataTypeParser.AllowedDataTypes.ALL);
        try {
            DataType dt = parser.parse(declaration);
            if (dt != null) {
                return dt;
            }
        } catch (InvalidDataTypeException | CancelledException | RuntimeException firstEx) {
            String rewritten = rewriteStdintAliases(declaration, ptrSize, false);
            if (!rewritten.equals(declaration)) {
                try {
                    DataType retryDt = parser.parse(rewritten);
                    if (retryDt != null) {
                        return retryDt;
                    }
                } catch (InvalidDataTypeException | CancelledException | RuntimeException retryEx) {
                    throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_C_DECLARATION",
                            "Invalid C data type declaration '" + declaration + "': " + retryEx.getMessage(),
                            false, Collections.emptyMap(), retryEx);
                }
            }
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_C_DECLARATION",
                    "Invalid C data type declaration '" + declaration + "': " + firstEx.getMessage(),
                    false, Collections.emptyMap(), firstEx);
        }
        throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_C_DECLARATION",
                "Could not resolve data type: " + declaration);
    }

    private static String rewriteStdintAliases(String decl, int ptrSize, boolean forSignatureParser) {
        Matcher m = STDINT_WORD_PATTERN.matcher(decl);
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        boolean pointerIs64 = ptrSize >= 8;
        while (m.find()) {
            String token = m.group(1);
            String replacement = switch (token) {
                case "uint8_t" -> forSignatureParser ? "unsigned char" : "uchar";
                case "uint16_t" -> forSignatureParser ? "unsigned short" : "ushort";
                case "uint32_t" -> forSignatureParser ? "unsigned int" : "uint";
                case "uint64_t" -> forSignatureParser ? "unsigned long long" : "ulonglong";
                case "int8_t" -> forSignatureParser ? "signed char" : "schar";
                case "int16_t" -> "short";
                case "int32_t" -> "int";
                case "int64_t" -> forSignatureParser ? "long long" : "longlong";
                case "size_t", "uintptr_t" -> pointerIs64
                        ? (forSignatureParser ? "unsigned long long" : "ulonglong")
                        : (forSignatureParser ? "unsigned int" : "uint");
                case "ssize_t", "intptr_t" -> pointerIs64
                        ? (forSignatureParser ? "long long" : "longlong")
                        : "int";
                case "bool" -> "uchar";
                default -> token;
            };
            m.appendReplacement(sb, Matcher.quoteReplacement(replacement));
        }
        m.appendTail(sb);
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private ParsedBatchOp parseBatchOp(Map<String, Object> raw, int index) {
        if (raw == null) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Batch op at index " + index + " must be an object");
        }
        String rawOp = nonBlankOrNull(stringField(raw, "op"));
        if (rawOp == null) {
            rawOp = nonBlankOrNull(stringField(raw, "type"));
        }
        if (rawOp == null) {
            rawOp = nonBlankOrNull(stringField(raw, "action"));
        }
        if (rawOp == null) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Batch op at index " + index + " is missing 'op'");
        }

        String opLower = rawOp.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        String targetKind = nonBlankOrNull(stringField(raw, "targetKind"));
        String address = nonBlankOrNull(stringField(raw, "address"));
        String functionAddress = nonBlankOrNull(stringField(raw, "functionAddress"));
        String oldName = nonBlankOrNull(stringField(raw, "oldName"));
        String newName = nonBlankOrNull(stringField(raw, "newName"));
        String varName = nonBlankOrNull(stringField(raw, "varName"));
        if (varName == null) {
            varName = oldName;
        }
        String declaration = nonBlankOrNull(stringField(raw, "declaration"));
        String kindStr = nonBlankOrNull(stringField(raw, "kind"));
        String text = stringField(raw, "text");

        if (opLower.startsWith("rename")) {
            String resolvedTargetKind = targetKind != null
                    ? normalizeRenameKind(targetKind)
                    : inferTargetKindFromOp(opLower, "rename_");
            requireNonBlank(newName, "ops[" + index + "].newName");
            return new ParsedBatchOp("rename", resolvedTargetKind, address, functionAddress,
                    oldName, newName.trim(), null, null, null, null);
        }
        if (opLower.startsWith("retype")) {
            String resolvedTargetKind = targetKind != null
                    ? normalizeRetypeKind(targetKind)
                    : inferTargetKindFromOp(opLower, "retype_");
            requireNonBlankDeclaration(declaration);
            return new ParsedBatchOp("retype", resolvedTargetKind, address, functionAddress,
                    null, null, varName, declaration.trim(), null, null);
        }
        if ("comment".equals(opLower) || "set_comment".equals(opLower)) {
            requireNonBlank(address, "ops[" + index + "].address");
            CommentType ct = parseCommentType(kindStr);
            String normalizedText = (text == null || text.isBlank()) ? null : text;
            return new ParsedBatchOp("comment", null, address, null,
                    null, null, null, null, ct, normalizedText);
        }
        throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Unsupported batch op at index " + index + ": " + rawOp);
    }

    private static String inferTargetKindFromOp(String opLower, String prefix) {
        if (!opLower.startsWith(prefix)) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Missing targetKind for op: " + opLower);
        }
        String suffix = opLower.substring(prefix.length());
        return switch (suffix) {
            case "function" -> "rename_".equals(prefix) ? "function" : "function_signature";
            case "function_signature", "variable", "label", "global", "data" -> suffix;
            default -> throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Unsupported op: " + opLower);
        };
    }

    private static String normalizeRenameKind(String targetKind) {
        String k = requireNonBlank(targetKind, "targetKind").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (!Set.of("function", "variable", "label", "global").contains(k)) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Invalid rename targetKind: " + targetKind);
        }
        return k;
    }

    private static String normalizeRetypeKind(String targetKind) {
        String k = requireNonBlank(targetKind, "targetKind").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if ("function".equals(k)) {
            return "function_signature";
        }
        if (!Set.of("function_signature", "variable", "data").contains(k)) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Invalid retype targetKind: " + targetKind);
        }
        return k;
    }

    private static CommentType parseCommentType(String kind) {
        if (kind == null || kind.isBlank()) {
            return CommentType.EOL;
        }
        return switch (kind.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
            case "EOL" -> CommentType.EOL;
            case "PRE" -> CommentType.PRE;
            case "POST" -> CommentType.POST;
            case "PLATE" -> CommentType.PLATE;
            case "REPEATABLE" -> CommentType.REPEATABLE;
            default -> throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Invalid comment kind: " + kind);
        };
    }

    private void invalidateCaches(String binaryId, Collection<String> funcEntryHexes) {
        if (funcEntryHexes == null || funcEntryHexes.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }
        if (decompilerPool != null) {
            decompilerPool.invalidateFunctions(binaryId, funcEntryHexes);
        }
        inspectionService.invalidateCfg(binaryId, funcEntryHexes);
    }

    private void publishMutationEvent(String actor, String binaryId, long revision, Map<String, Object> detail) {
        if (eventBus != null) {
            String safeActor = (actor != null && !actor.isBlank()) ? actor : "agent";
            eventBus.publish("mutation", safeActor, binaryId, revision, detail);
        }
    }

    private static String requireNonBlank(String val, String field) {
        if (val == null || val.isBlank()) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Missing required parameter: " + field);
        }
        return val.trim();
    }

    private static String requireNonBlankDeclaration(String decl) {
        if (decl == null || decl.isBlank()) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_C_DECLARATION", "C declaration must not be empty");
        }
        return decl.trim();
    }

    private static String nonBlankOrNull(String val) {
        return (val == null || val.isBlank()) ? null : val.trim();
    }

    private static String stringField(Map<String, Object> map, String key) {
        Object val = map.get(key);
        return val instanceof String s ? s : null;
    }
}
