```java
/**
 * Manages SHA-256-keyed Ghidra projects, stale .gpr lock recovery,
 * async import + auto-analysis jobs with progress monitoring, and checkpoint/idle lifecycle.
 */
public final class ProjectManager {

    private static final Pattern SHA256_HEX = Pattern.compile("^[0-9a-f]{64}$");
    private static final Pattern PREFIX_HEX = Pattern.compile("^[0-9a-f]{8,64}$");
    private static final long CHECKPOINT_IDLE_MS = 15_000L;
    private static final int CHECKPOINT_MUTATION_THRESHOLD = 20;
    private static final int MAX_RETAINED_FINISHED_JOBS = 256;

    public static final class JobState {
        final String jobId;
        final String binaryId;
        final String actor;
        final long createdAt;
        volatile String state = "queued";
        volatile int percent = 0;
        volatile String phase = "queued";
        volatile String currentAnalyzer = "";
        volatile String error = null;
        volatile Map<String, Object> result = null;
        final AtomicBoolean cancelled = new AtomicBoolean(false);
        volatile ProgressTaskMonitor monitor;
        volatile AutoAnalysisManager activeAnalysisManager;

        JobState(String jobId, String binaryId, String actor) {
            this.jobId = jobId;
            this.binaryId = binaryId;
            this.actor = actor;
            this.createdAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        }

        synchronized boolean isActive() {
            return "queued".equals(state) || "running".equals(state);
        }

        synchronized boolean markRunning() {
            if (cancelled.get() || !"queued".equals(state)) {
                return false;
            }
            state = "running";
            phase = "importing";
            percent = 5;
            return true;
        }

        synchronized void setPhase(String phase, int minPercent) {
            if (cancelled.get() || !isActive()) {
                return;
            }
            this.phase = phase;
            if (minPercent > this.percent) {
                this.percent = minPercent;
            }
        }

        synchronized boolean markCompleted(Map<String, Object> summary) {
            if (cancelled.get() || "cancelled".equals(state)) {
                return false;
            }
            this.result = summary;
            this.percent = 100;
            this.phase = "completed";
            this.currentAnalyzer = "";
            this.state = "completed";
            return true;
        }

        synchronized void markCancelled() {
            this.cancelled.set(true);
            this.phase = "cancelled";
            this.currentAnalyzer = "";
            this.state = "cancelled";
        }

        synchronized void markFailed(String errorMsg) {
            if (cancelled.get() || "cancelled".equals(state)) {
                this.phase = "cancelled";
                this.currentAnalyzer = "";
                this.state = "cancelled";
                return;
            }
            this.error = errorMsg;
            this.phase = "failed";
            this.state = "failed";
        }

        synchronized Map<String, Object> toMap() {
            Map<String, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            map.put("jobId", jobId);
            map.put("binaryId", binaryId);
            map.put("state", state);
            map.put("percent", percent);
            map.put("phase", phase);
            map.put("currentAnalyzer", currentAnalyzer);
            if (error != null) {
                map.put("error", error);
            }
            if (result != null) {
                map.put("result", result);
            }
            return map;
        }
    }

    private final class ProgressTaskMonitor extends TaskMonitorAdapter {
        private final JobState job;
        private volatile int basePercent;
        private volatile int spanPercent;
        private final AtomicLong maximum = new AtomicLong(100L);
        private final AtomicLong progress = new AtomicLong(0L);
        private final AtomicLong lastEventMs = new AtomicLong(0L);
        private final AtomicInteger lastReportedPercent = new AtomicInteger(-1);
        private volatile String lastMessage = "";

        ProgressTaskMonitor(JobState job, int basePercent, int spanPercent) {
            super(true);
            this.job = job;
            this.basePercent = basePercent;
            this.spanPercent = spanPercent;
        }

        void setWindow(int basePercent, int spanPercent) {
            this.basePercent = basePercent;
            this.spanPercent = spanPercent;
        }

        @Override
        public void initialize(long max) {
            super.initialize(max);
            this.maximum.set(Math.max(1L, max));
            this.progress.set(0L);
            updateProgress(false);
        }

        @Override
        public void setMaximum(long max) {
            super.setMaximum(max);
            this.maximum.set(Math.max(1L, max));
            updateProgress(false);
        }

        @Override
        public void setProgress(long value) {
            super.setProgress(value);
            this.progress.set(Math.max(0L, value));
            updateProgress(false);
        }

        @Override
        public void incrementProgress(long incrementAmount) {
            super.incrementProgress(incrementAmount);
            this.progress.updateAndGet(cur -> Math.max(0L, cur + incrementAmount));
            updateProgress(false);
        }

        @Override
        public void setMessage(String message) {
            super.setMessage(message);
            String msg = message != null ? message.trim() : "";
            if (!msg.isEmpty() && !msg.equals(lastMessage)) {
                lastMessage = msg;
                job.currentAnalyzer = msg;
                updateProgress(true);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void cancel() {
            job.cancelled.set(true);
            super.cancel();
            AutoAnalysisManager mgr = job.activeAnalysisManager;
            if (mgr != null) {
                try {
                    mgr.cancelQueuedTasks();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {
                    // Best-effort cancellation of queued analyzers.
                }
            }
        }

        private void updateProgress(boolean messageChanged) {
            if (job.cancelled.get() || !job.isActive()) {
                return;
            }
            long max = Math.max(1L, this.maximum.get());
            long prog = this.progress.get();
            double ratio = Math.min(1.0, Math.max(0.0, (double) prog / (double) max));
            int pct = Math.min(99, basePercent + (int) Math.floor(ratio * spanPercent));
            synchronized (job) {
                if (pct > job.percent) {
                    job.percent = pct;
                }
            }
            int currentPct = job.percent;
            long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
            boolean pctStep = Math.abs(currentPct - lastReportedPercent.get()) >= 5;
            long prevEvent = lastEventMs.get();
            if ((messageChanged && now - prevEvent >= 400L) || (pctStep && now - prevEvent >= 300L)) {
                if (lastEventMs.compareAndSet(prevEvent, now)) {
                    lastReportedPercent.set(currentPct);
                    emitJobProgress(job);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private final Path projectsDir;
    private final Path ghidraSafeProjectsDir;
    private final TierConfig tierConfig;
    private final EventBus eventBus;
    private final ReentrantLock registryLock = new ReentrantLock();
    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, LoadedBinary> loadedBinaries = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, JobState> jobs = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, ReentrantLock> shaLocks = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final AtomicLong jobSeq = new AtomicLong(0L);
    private final ExecutorService jobExecutor = Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor();
    private final Gson gson = new Gson();
    private final AtomicBoolean shuttingDown = new AtomicBoolean(false);
    private volatile Consumer<String> onBeforeBinaryUnload;
    private volatile Runnable onBeforeShutdown;

    public ProjectManager(Path dataDir, TierConfig tierConfig, EventBus eventBus) throws IOException {
        this.projectsDir = dataDir.resolve("projects");
        this.tierConfig = tierConfig;
        this.eventBus = eventBus;
        Files.createDirectories(this.projectsDir);
        this.ghidraSafeProjectsDir = resolveGhidraSafeProjectsDir(this.projectsDir);
    }

    public void setLifecycleHooks(Consumer<String> onBeforeBinaryUnload, Runnable onBeforeShutdown) {
        this.onBeforeBinaryUnload = onBeforeBinaryUnload;
        this.onBeforeShutdown = onBeforeShutdown;
    }

    public Collection<LoadedBinary> getLoadedBinaries() {
        return Collections.unmodifiableCollection(loadedBinaries.values());
    }

    public Map<String, Object> openBinary(
            String path,
            String sha256Arg,
            boolean analyze,
            boolean forceReimport,
            String analysisProfile,
            boolean replaceIfFull,
            String actor) {
        if (shuttingDown.get()) {
            throw new ApiException(503, "DAEMON_SHUTTING_DOWN", "Daemon is shutting down", true);
        }

        String normalizedActor = (actor != null && !actor.isBlank()) ? actor : "agent";
        String profile = (analysisProfile != null && !analysisProfile.isBlank())
                ? analysisProfile.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)
                : "default";

        Path inputFile = null;
        if (path != null && !path.isBlank()) {
            inputFile = Path.of(path).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        }

        String sha256;
        if (sha256Arg != null && !sha256Arg.isBlank()) {
            sha256 = sha256Arg.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            if (!SHA256_HEX.matcher(sha256).matches()) {
                throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "sha256 must be 64 lowercase hex characters");
            }
        } else if (inputFile != null && Files.isRegularFile(inputFile)) {
            sha256 = computeSha256(inputFile);
        } else {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Either sha256 or an existing file path is required");
        }

        ReentrantLock lock = shaLocks.computeIfAbsent(sha256, k -> new ReentrantLock());
        lock.lock();
        try {
            LoadedBinary existing = loadedBinaries.get(sha256);
            if (existing != null) {
                if (!forceReimport) {
                    existing.touchAccess();
                    if (inputFile != null) {
                        existing.recordPath(inputFile.toString());
                    }
                    Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    res.put("httpStatus", 200);
                    res.put("status", "loaded");
                    res.put("cachedProject", true);
                    res.put("binary", existing.toSummaryMap());
                    return res;
                }
                unloadBinary(sha256, normalizedActor);
            }

            if (!forceReimport) {
                for (JobState job : jobs.values()) {
                    if (sha256.equals(job.binaryId) && job.isActive()) {
                        Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                        res.put("httpStatus", 202);
                        res.put("status", "analyzing");
                        res.put("jobId", job.jobId);
                        res.put("binaryId", sha256);
                        res.put("state", job.state);
                        return res;
                    }
                }
            }

            ensureCapacityForNewBinary(sha256, replaceIfFull, normalizedActor);

            Path projectDir = projectsDir.resolve(sha256);
            Path gprPath = projectDir.resolve("ghidra.gpr");
            Path metaPath = projectDir.resolve("meta.json");
            JsonObject metaJson = readMetaJson(metaPath);
            boolean alreadyAnalyzed = metaJson != null
                    && metaJson.has("analyzed")
                    && metaJson.get("analyzed").isJsonPrimitive()
                    && metaJson.get("analyzed").getAsBoolean();

            if (!forceReimport && Files.isRegularFile(gprPath) && alreadyAnalyzed) {
                LoadedBinary reopened = openExistingProject(
                        sha256, projectDir, metaJson, inputFile, profile, replaceIfFull, normalizedActor);
                if (reopened != null) {
                    Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    res.put("httpStatus", 200);
                    res.put("status", "loaded");
                    res.put("cachedProject", true);
                    res.put("binary", reopened.toSummaryMap());
                    return res;
                }
            }

            if (inputFile == null || !Files.isRegularFile(inputFile)) {
                throw new ApiException(
                        400,
                        "INVALID_PARAMS",
                        "Binary file path does not exist for new import: " + path);
            }

            // Ensure no active daemon holds this directory before cleaning partial artifacts.
            checkOwnerPidNotActive(projectDir);
            deleteRecursively(projectDir);
            Files.createDirectories(projectDir);
            writeOwnerPid(projectDir);

            pruneFinishedJobs();
            String jobId = "job-" + jobSeq.incrementAndGet() + "-" + sha256.substring(0, 8);
            JobState job = new JobState(jobId, sha256, normalizedActor);
            ProgressTaskMonitor monitor = new ProgressTaskMonitor(job, 5, 15);
            job.monitor = monitor;
            jobs.put(jobId, job);
            eventBus.registerBinaryProjectDir(sha256, projectDir);

            final Path fileToImport = inputFile;
            jobExecutor.submit(() -> runImportAndAnalysisJob(
                    job, monitor, fileToImport, projectDir, analyze, profile, replaceIfFull));

            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            res.put("httpStatus", 202);
            res.put("status", "analyzing");
            res.put("jobId", jobId);
            res.put("binaryId", sha256);
            res.put("state", job.state);
            return res;
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            throw new ApiException(500, "IO_ERROR", "Failed to open binary project: " + ex.getMessage(), false, Map.of("binaryId", sha256), ex);
        } finally {
            lock.unlock();
        }
    }

    private LoadedBinary openExistingProject(
            String sha256,
            Path projectDir,
            JsonObject metaJson,
            Path inputFile,
            String profile,
            boolean replaceIfFull,
            String actor) throws IOException {
        recoverStaleGprLock(projectDir);

        GhidraProject project = null;
        Program program = null;
        try {
            project = GhidraProject.openProject(ghidraSafeProjectsDir.resolve(sha256).toString(), "ghidra", false);
            String preferredName = metaJson.has("programName") && !metaJson.get("programName").isJsonNull()
                    ? metaJson.get("programName").getAsString()
                    : null;
            DomainFile df = findProgramFile(project.getRootFolder(), preferredName);
            if (df == null) {
                project.close();
                return null;
            }
            try {
                program = (Program) df.getDomainObject(project, true, false, TaskMonitor.DUMMY);
            } catch (VersionException | CancelledException ex) {
                throw new IOException("Failed to open program domain object: " + ex.getMessage(), ex);
            }

            long initialRevision = metaJson.has("revision") && metaJson.get("revision").isJsonPrimitive()
                    ? metaJson.get("revision").getAsLong()
                    : 1L;
            long fileSize = metaJson.has("fileSizeBytes") && metaJson.get("fileSizeBytes").isJsonPrimitive()
                    ? metaJson.get("fileSizeBytes").getAsLong()
                    : (inputFile != null && Files.isRegularFile(inputFile) ? Files.size(inputFile) : 0L);
            String storedProfile = metaJson.has("analysisProfile") && !metaJson.get("analysisProfile").isJsonNull()
                    ? metaJson.get("analysisProfile").getAsString()
                    : profile;
            String primaryPath = metaJson.has("primaryPath") && !metaJson.get("primaryPath").isJsonNull()
                    ? metaJson.get("primaryPath").getAsString()
                    : (inputFile != null ? inputFile.toString() : null);

            List<String> existingPaths = new ArrayList<>();
            if (metaJson.has("originalPaths") && metaJson.get("originalPaths").isJsonArray()) {
                JsonArray arr = metaJson.getAsJsonArray("originalPaths");
                for (JsonElement el : arr) {
                    if (el.isJsonPrimitive()) {
                        existingPaths.add(el.getAsString());
                    }
                }
            }
            if (inputFile != null) {
                existingPaths.add(inputFile.toString());
            }

            LoadedBinary lb = new LoadedBinary(
                    sha256,
                    projectDir,
                    project,
                    program,
                    initialRevision,
                    true,
                    storedProfile,
                    primaryPath,
                    existingPaths,
                    fileSize);
            lb.writeMetaJson();
            placeLoadedBinaryWithCapacityCheck(sha256, lb, replaceIfFull, actor, null);
            eventBus.registerBinaryProjectDir(sha256, projectDir);
            eventBus.publish(
                    "binary_loaded",
                    actor,
                    sha256,
                    lb.getRevision(),
                    Map.of(
                            "cachedProject", true,
                            "programName", program.getName(),
                            "functionCount", lb.toSummaryMap().get("functionCount")));
            return lb;
        } catch (ApiException ex) {
            closeQuietly(project, program);
            throw ex;
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            closeQuietly(project, program);
            throw new ApiException(
                    500,
                    "PROJECT_OPEN_FAILED",
                    "Failed to open existing Ghidra project: " + ex.getMessage(),
                    false,
                    Map.of("binaryId", sha256),
                    ex);
        }
    }

    private void runImportAndAnalysisJob(
            JobState job,
            ProgressTaskMonitor monitor,
            Path fileToImport,
            Path projectDir,
            boolean analyze,
            String analysisProfile,
            boolean replaceIfFull) {
        GhidraProject project = null;
        Program program = null;
        boolean projectPersisted = false;
        try {
            if (!job.markRunning() || job.cancelled.get() || monitor.isCancelled()) {
                markJobCancelled(job, projectDir, null, null);
                return;
            }
            emitJobProgress(job);

            String safeProjectPath = ghidraSafeProjectsDir.resolve(job.binaryId).toString();
            project = GhidraProject.createProject(safeProjectPath, "ghidra", false);
            MessageLog log = new MessageLog();
            String safeProgramName = sanitizeProgramName(fileToImport.getFileName().toString());
            DomainFile saved = null;
            try (LoadResults<Program> loadResults = ProgramLoader.builder()
                    .source(fileToImport.toFile())
                    .project(project.getProject())
                    .projectFolderPath("/")
                    .name(safeProgramName)
                    .log(log)
                    .monitor(monitor)
                    .load()) {
                if (!job.cancelled.get() && !monitor.isCancelled()) {
                    Loaded<Program> primary = loadResults.getPrimary();
                    if (primary == null) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("ProgramLoader produced no primary program: " + log);
                    }
                    saved = primary.save(monitor);
                }
            }

            if (job.cancelled.get() || monitor.isCancelled() || saved == null) {
                markJobCancelled(job, projectDir, project, null);
                return;
            }

            try {
                program = (Program) saved.getDomainObject(project, true, false, TaskMonitor.DUMMY);
            } catch (VersionException | CancelledException ex) {
                throw new IOException("Failed to open imported program domain object: " + ex.getMessage(), ex);
            }

            if (analyze) {
                job.setPhase("analyzing", 20);
                monitor.setWindow(20, 75);
                emitJobProgress(job);

                int tx = program.startTransaction("AutoAnalysis");
                boolean commit = false;
                try {
                    AutoAnalysisManager mgr = AutoAnalysisManager.getAnalysisManager(program);
                    job.activeAnalysisManager = mgr;
                    if ("fast".equals(analysisProfile)) {
                        mgr.registerAnalyzerOptions();
                        Options opts = program.getOptions(Program.ANALYSIS_PROPERTIES);
                        disableAnalyzerOption(opts, "Decompiler Parameter ID");
                        disableAnalyzerOption(opts, "Aggressive Instruction Finder");
                    }
                    mgr.initializeOptions();
                    mgr.reAnalyzeAll(null);
                    mgr.startAnalysis(monitor);

                    if (!job.cancelled.get() && !monitor.isCancelled()) {
                        GhidraProgramUtilities.markProgramAnalyzed(program);
                        commit = true;
                    }
                } finally {
                    job.activeAnalysisManager = null;
                    program.endTransaction(tx, commit);
                }
            }

            if (job.cancelled.get() || monitor.isCancelled()) {
                markJobCancelled(job, projectDir, project, program);
                return;
            }

            job.setPhase("finalizing", 96);
            job.currentAnalyzer = "";
            emitJobProgress(job);

            if (program.canSave()) {
                try {
                    program.getDomainFile().save(TaskMonitor.DUMMY);
                } catch (CancelledException ex) {
                    throw new IOException("Program save cancelled", ex);
                }
            }

            long fileSize = Files.isRegularFile(fileToImport) ? Files.size(fileToImport) : 0L;
            LoadedBinary lb = new LoadedBinary(
                    job.binaryId,
                    projectDir,
                    project,
                    program,
                    1L,
                    analyze,
                    analysisProfile,
                    fileToImport.toString(),
                    Collections.singletonList(fileToImport.toString()),
                    fileSize);
            lb.writeMetaJson();
            projectPersisted = true;

            ReentrantLock shaLock = shaLocks.computeIfAbsent(job.binaryId, k -> new ReentrantLock());
            shaLock.lock();
            try {
                if (job.cancelled.get() || monitor.isCancelled()) {
                    markJobCancelled(job, projectDir, project, program);
                    return;
                }
                Map<String, Object> summary = lb.toSummaryMap();
                try {
                    placeLoadedBinaryWithCapacityCheck(
                            job.binaryId, lb, replaceIfFull, job.actor, () -> job.markCompleted(summary));
                } catch (ApiException capEx) {
                    closeQuietly(project, program);
                    try {
                        Files.deleteIfExists(projectDir.resolve("owner.pid"));
                    } catch (IOException ignored) {
                        // Best-effort PID cleanup.
                    }
                    job.markFailed(capEx.getMessage());
                    emitJobProgress(job);
                    return;
                }

                if (job.cancelled.get() || !"completed".equals(job.state)) {
                    loadedBinaries.remove(job.binaryId, lb);
                    markJobCancelled(job, projectDir, project, program);
                    return;
                }

                eventBus.publish(
                        "binary_loaded",
                        job.actor,
                        job.binaryId,
                        lb.getRevision(),
                        Map.of(
                                "cachedProject", false,
                                "jobId", job.jobId,
                                "programName", program.getName(),
                                "functionCount", summary.get("functionCount")));
            } finally {
                shaLock.unlock();
            }
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            if (job.cancelled.get() || monitor.isCancelled()) {
                markJobCancelled(job, projectDir, project, program);
            } else {
                t.printStackTrace(System.err);
                closeQuietly(project, program);
                if (!projectPersisted) {
                    deleteRecursively(projectDir);
                    eventBus.unregisterBinaryProjectDir(job.binaryId);
                } else {
                    try {
                        Files.deleteIfExists(projectDir.resolve("owner.pid"));
                    } catch (IOException ignored) {
                        // Best-effort PID cleanup.
                    }
                }
                job.markFailed(t.getMessage() != null ? t.getMessage() : t.getClass().getSimpleName());
                emitJobProgress(job);
            }
        }
    }

    private static void disableAnalyzerOption(Options opts, String analyzerName) {
        if (opts == null) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            opts.setBoolean(analyzerName, false);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // Analyzer option may not exist for every architecture/format.
        }
    }

    private void markJobCancelled(JobState job, Path projectDir, GhidraProject project, Program program) {
        closeQuietly(project, program);
        deleteRecursively(projectDir);
        eventBus.unregisterBinaryProjectDir(job.binaryId);
        job.markCancelled();
        emitJobProgress(job);
    }

    private static void closeQuietly(GhidraProject project, Program program) {
        if (program != null) {
            try {
                if (AutoAnalysisManager.hasAutoAnalysisManager(program)) {
                    AutoAnalysisManager.getAnalysisManager(program).dispose();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
                // Ignore cleanup error.
            }
        }
        if (project != null) {
            if (program != null) {
                try {
                    if (program.isUsedBy(project)) {
                        program.release(project);
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) {
                    // Ignore cleanup error.
                }
            }
            try {
                project.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
                // Ignore cleanup error.
            }
        }
    }

    private void emitJobProgress(JobState job) {
        Map<String, Object> detail = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        synchronized (job) {
            detail.put("jobId", job.jobId);
            detail.put("state", job.state);
            detail.put("percent", job.percent);
            detail.put("phase", job.phase);
            detail.put("currentAnalyzer", job.currentAnalyzer);
            if (job.error != null) {
                detail.put("error", job.error);
            }
        }
        eventBus.publish("analysis_progress", job.actor, job.binaryId, 0L, detail);
    }

    private void ensureCapacityForNewBinary(String selfSha256, boolean replaceIfFull, String actor) {
        int limit = tierConfig.getMaxLoadedBinaries();
        while (true) {
            String lruId = null;
            registryLock.lock();
            try {
                if (loadedBinaries.containsKey(selfSha256) || loadedBinaries.size() < limit) {
                    return;
                }
                if (!replaceIfFull) {
                    throw new ApiException(
                            409,
                            "MULTI_BINARY_LIMIT_REACHED",
                            "Maximum loaded binaries limit (" + limit + ") reached for tier " + tierConfig.getTier(),
                            false,
                            Map.of(
                                    "maxLoadedBinaries", limit,
                                    "loadedBinaryIds", new ArrayList<>(loadedBinaries.keySet())));
                }
                lruId = loadedBinaries.values().stream()
                        .min(Comparator.comparingLong(LoadedBinary::getLastAccessedAt))
                        .map(LoadedBinary::getBinaryId)
                        .orElse(null);
            } finally {
                registryLock.unlock();
            }
            if (lruId == null) {
                return;
            }
            try {
                unloadBinary(lruId, actor);
            } catch (ApiException ex) {
                if (!"BINARY_NOT_LOADED".equals(ex.getErrorCode())) {
                    throw ex;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void placeLoadedBinaryWithCapacityCheck(
            String sha256,
            LoadedBinary lb,
            boolean replaceIfFull,
            String actor,
            BooleanSupplier onPlacedUnderRegistryLock) {
        int limit = tierConfig.getMaxLoadedBinaries();
        while (true) {
            String lruId = null;
            registryLock.lock();
            try {
                if (loadedBinaries.containsKey(sha256) || loadedBinaries.size() < limit) {
                    if (onPlacedUnderRegistryLock == null || onPlacedUnderRegistryLock.getAsBoolean()) {
                        loadedBinaries.put(sha256, lb);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                if (!replaceIfFull) {
                    throw new ApiException(
                            409,
                            "MULTI_BINARY_LIMIT_REACHED",
                            "Maximum loaded binaries limit (" + limit + ") reached for tier " + tierConfig.getTier(),
                            false,
                            Map.of(
                                    "maxLoadedBinaries", limit,
                                    "loadedBinaryIds", new ArrayList<>(loadedBinaries.keySet())));
                }
                lruId = loadedBinaries.values().stream()
                        .min(Comparator.comparingLong(LoadedBinary::getLastAccessedAt))
                        .map(LoadedBinary::getBinaryId)
                        .orElse(null);
            } finally {
                registryLock.unlock();
            }
            if (lruId == null) {
                throw new ApiException(
                        409,
                        "MULTI_BINARY_LIMIT_REACHED",
                        "Maximum loaded binaries limit (" + limit + ") reached for tier " + tierConfig.getTier());
            }
            try {
                unloadBinary(lruId, actor);
            } catch (ApiException ex) {
                if (!"BINARY_NOT_LOADED".equals(ex.getErrorCode())) {
                    throw ex;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public LoadedBinary resolveLoadedBinary(String idOrPrefix) {
        if (idOrPrefix == null || idOrPrefix.isBlank()) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Missing binaryId");
        }
        String normalized = idOrPrefix.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        LoadedBinary exact = loadedBinaries.get(normalized);
        if (exact != null) {
            return exact;
        }
        if (!PREFIX_HEX.matcher(normalized).matches()) {
            throw new ApiException(404, "BINARY_NOT_LOADED", "Binary is not loaded: " + idOrPrefix);
        }
        List<LoadedBinary> matches = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Map.Entry<String, LoadedBinary> entry : loadedBinaries.entrySet()) {
            if (entry.getKey().startsWith(normalized)) {
                matches.add(entry.getValue());
            }
        }
        if (matches.isEmpty()) {
            throw new ApiException(404, "BINARY_NOT_LOADED", "Binary is not loaded: " + idOrPrefix);
        }
        if (matches.size() > 1) {
            throw new ApiException(
                    400,
                    "INVALID_PARAMS",
                    "Ambiguous binaryId prefix: " + idOrPrefix,
                    false,
                    Map.of("matches", matches.stream().map(LoadedBinary::getBinaryId).toList()));
        }
        return matches.getFirst();
    }

    public Map<String, Object> unloadBinary(String idOrPrefix, String actor) {
        LoadedBinary lb = resolveLoadedBinary(idOrPrefix);
        String binaryId = lb.getBinaryId();
        ReentrantLock shaLock = shaLocks.computeIfAbsent(binaryId, k -> new ReentrantLock());
        shaLock.lock();
        try {
            LoadedBinary removed;
            int remaining;
            registryLock.lock();
            try {
                removed = loadedBinaries.remove(binaryId);
                remaining = loadedBinaries.size();
            } finally {
                registryLock.unlock();
            }
            if (removed == null) {
                throw new ApiException(404, "BINARY_NOT_LOADED", "Binary is not loaded: " + binaryId);
            }
            Consumer<String> unloadHook = this.onBeforeBinaryUnload;
            if (unloadHook != null) {
                try {
                    unloadHook.accept(binaryId);
                } catch (Exception ex) {
                    System.err.println("[ghidra-re] Pre-unload hook error for " + binaryId + ": " + ex.getMessage());
                }
            }
            removed.closeAndRelease();
            eventBus.publish(
                    "binary_unloaded",
                    actor != null && !actor.isBlank() ? actor : "system",
                    binaryId,
                    removed.getRevision(),
                    Map.of("reason", "unload"));
            eventBus.unregisterBinaryProjectDir(binaryId);

            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            res.put("status", "unloaded");
            res.put("binaryId", binaryId);
            res.put("revision", removed.getRevision());
            res.put("remainingLoaded", remaining);
            return res;
        } finally {
            shaLock.unlock();
        }
    }

    public Map<String, Object> saveBinary(String idOrPrefix, String reason) {
        LoadedBinary lb = resolveLoadedBinary(idOrPrefix);
        try {
            return lb.saveCheckpoint(reason);
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            throw new ApiException(
                    500,
                    "SAVE_FAILED",
                    "Failed to save binary " + lb.getBinaryId() + ": " + ex.getMessage(),
                    false,
                    Map.of("binaryId", lb.getBinaryId()),
                    ex);
        }
    }

    public Map<String, Object> getJobStatus(String jobId) {
        if (jobId == null || jobId.isBlank()) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Missing jobId");
        }
        JobState job = jobs.get(jobId.trim());
        if (job == null) {
            throw new ApiException(404, "JOB_NOT_FOUND", "Unknown jobId: " + jobId);
        }
        return job.toMap();
    }

    public Map<String, Object> cancelJob(String jobId) {
        if (jobId == null || jobId.isBlank()) {
            throw new ApiException(400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Missing jobId");
        }
        JobState job = jobs.get(jobId.trim());
        if (job == null) {
            throw new ApiException(404, "JOB_NOT_FOUND", "Unknown jobId: " + jobId);
        }
        boolean emitQueuedCancel = false;
        synchronized (job) {
            if (job.isActive()) {
                job.cancelled.set(true);
                ProgressTaskMonitor mon = job.monitor;
                if (mon != null) {
                    mon.cancel();
                }
                if ("queued".equals(job.state)) {
                    job.markCancelled();
                    emitQueuedCancel = true;
                }
            }
        }
        if (emitQueuedCancel) {
            emitJobProgress(job);
        }
        return job.toMap();
    }

    private void pruneFinishedJobs() {
        List<JobState> finished = new ArrayList<>();
        for (JobState job : jobs.values()) {
            if (!job.isActive()) {
                finished.add(job);
            }
        }
        if (finished.size() <= MAX_RETAINED_FINISHED_JOBS) {
            return;
        }
        finished.sort(Comparator.comparingLong(j -> j.createdAt));
        int toRemove = finished.size() - MAX_RETAINED_FINISHED_JOBS;
        for (int i = 0; i < toRemove; i++) {
            jobs.remove(finished.get(i).jobId, finished.get(i));
        }
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> listLoadedBinaries() {
        List<LoadedBinary> sorted = new ArrayList<>(loadedBinaries.values());
        sorted.sort(Comparator.comparing(LoadedBinary::getBinaryId));
        List<Map<String, Object>> result = new ArrayList<>(sorted.size());
        for (LoadedBinary lb : sorted) {
            result.add(lb.toSummaryMap());
        }
        return result;
    }

    public List<String> getLoadedBinaryIds() {
        List<String> ids = new ArrayList<>(loadedBinaries.keySet());
        Collections.sort(ids);
        return ids;
    }

    public String computeBinariesEtag() {
        List<LoadedBinary> sorted = new ArrayList<>(loadedBinaries.values());
        sorted.sort(Comparator.comparing(LoadedBinary::getBinaryId));
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (LoadedBinary lb : sorted) {
            sb.append(lb.getBinaryId())
                    .append(':')
                    .append(lb.getRevision())
                    .append(':')
                    .append(lb.isDirty())
                    .append(';');
        }
        try {
            MessageDigest md = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
            byte[] digest = md.digest(sb.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            return "\"binaries:" + HexFormat.of().formatHex(digest).substring(0, 16) + "\"";
        } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException ex) {
            return "\"binaries:" + sb.length() + "\"";
        }
    }

    public int getActiveJobCount() {
        int count = 0;
        for (JobState job : jobs.values()) {
            if (job.isActive()) {
                count++;
            }
        }
        return count;
    }

    public void checkpointDirtyBinaries() {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        for (LoadedBinary lb : loadedBinaries.values()) {
            if (!lb.isDirty()) {
                continue;
            }
            long lastMut = lb.getLastMutationAt();
            int muts = lb.getUncheckpointedMutations();
            if (muts >= CHECKPOINT_MUTATION_THRESHOLD
                    || (lastMut > 0L && (now - lastMut) >= CHECKPOINT_IDLE_MS)) {
                try {
                    lb.saveCheckpoint("auto_checkpoint");
                } catch (Exception ex) {
                    System.err.println("[ghidra-re] Checkpoint save failed for "
                            + lb.getBinaryId() + ": " + ex.getMessage());
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public void evictIdleBinaries(int idleTimeoutMin) {
        if (idleTimeoutMin <= 0) {
            return;
        }
        long cutoffMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - (idleTimeoutMin * 60_000L);
        for (LoadedBinary lb : new ArrayList<>(loadedBinaries.values())) {
            if (lb.getLastAccessedAt() < cutoffMs) {
                try {
                    unloadBinary(lb.getBinaryId(), "idle_timer");
                } catch (ApiException ex) {
                    if (!"BINARY_NOT_LOADED".equals(ex.getErrorCode())) {
                        throw ex;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public void shutdownAll() {
        if (!shuttingDown.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
            return;
        }
        for (JobState job : jobs.values()) {
            if (job.isActive()) {
                job.cancelled.set(true);
                ProgressTaskMonitor mon = job.monitor;
                if (mon != null) {
                    mon.cancel();
                }
            }
        }
        Runnable shutdownHook = this.onBeforeShutdown;
        if (shutdownHook != null) {
            try {
                shutdownHook.run();
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                System.err.println("[ghidra-re] Pre-shutdown hook error: " + ex.getMessage());
            }
        }
        for (String binaryId : new ArrayList<>(loadedBinaries.keySet())) {
            ReentrantLock shaLock = shaLocks.computeIfAbsent(binaryId, k -> new ReentrantLock());
            shaLock.lock();
            try {
                LoadedBinary lb;
                registryLock.lock();
                try {
                    lb = loadedBinaries.remove(binaryId);
                } finally {
                    registryLock.unlock();
                }
                if (lb != null) {
                    lb.closeAndRelease();
                    eventBus.unregisterBinaryProjectDir(binaryId);
                }
            } finally {
                shaLock.unlock();
            }
        }
        jobExecutor.shutdownNow();
        try {
            jobExecutor.awaitTermination(2L, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
        }
    }

    private static DomainFile findProgramFile(DomainFolder folder, String preferredName) {
        if (folder == null) {
            return null;
        }
        if (preferredName != null && !preferredName.isBlank()) {
            DomainFile direct = folder.getFile(preferredName);
            if (direct != null && Program.class.isAssignableFrom(direct.getDomainObjectClass())) {
                return direct;
            }
        }
        for (DomainFile df : folder.getFiles()) {
            if (Program.class.isAssignableFrom(df.getDomainObjectClass())) {
                return df;
            }
        }
        for (DomainFolder sub : folder.getFolders()) {
            DomainFile nested = findProgramFile(sub, preferredName);
            if (nested != null) {
                return nested;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static void recoverStaleGprLock(Path projectDir) throws IOException {
        checkOwnerPidNotActive(projectDir);

        Path lockFile = projectDir.resolve("ghidra.lock");
        if (Files.exists(lockFile)) {
            try (FileChannel ch = FileChannel.open(
                    lockFile, StandardOpenOption.READ, StandardOpenOption.WRITE)) {
                try (FileLock lock = ch.tryLock()) {
                    if (lock == null) {
                        throw new ApiException(
                                409,
                                "PROJECT_LOCKED_BY_OTHER_INSTANCE",
                                "Ghidra project lock is actively held by another process",
                                false,
                                Map.of("projectDir", projectDir.toString()));
                    }
                }
            } catch (OverlappingFileLockException ex) {
                throw new ApiException(
                        409,
                        "PROJECT_LOCKED_BY_OTHER_INSTANCE",
                        "Ghidra project lock is held within this process",
                        false,
                        Map.of("projectDir", projectDir.toString()));
            }
            Files.deleteIfExists(lockFile);
        }
        Files.deleteIfExists(projectDir.resolve("ghidra.lock~"));
        writeOwnerPid(projectDir);
    }

    private static void checkOwnerPidNotActive(Path projectDir) throws IOException {
        Path ownerPidPath = projectDir.resolve("owner.pid");
        if (!Files.isRegularFile(ownerPidPath)) {
            return;
        }
        String raw = Files.readString(ownerPidPath, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).trim();
        if (raw.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }
        long ownerPid;
        try {
            ownerPid = Long.parseLong(raw);
        } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {
            return;
        }
        long selfPid = ProcessHandle.current().pid();
        if (ownerPid > 0 && ownerPid != selfPid && isPidRunningDaemon(ownerPid)) {
            throw new ApiException(
                    409,
                    "PROJECT_LOCKED_BY_OTHER_INSTANCE",
                    "Project is locked by active daemon PID " + ownerPid,
                    false,
                    Map.of("ownerPid", ownerPid, "projectDir", projectDir.toString()));
        }
    }

    private static boolean isPidRunningDaemon(long pid) {
        Path cmdlinePath = Path.of("/proc", Long.toString(pid), "cmdline");
        if (!Files.isReadable(cmdlinePath)) {
            return false;
        }
        try {
            byte[] bytes = Files.readAllBytes(cmdlinePath);
            String cmdline = new String(bytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).replace('\0', ' ');
            return cmdline.contains("com.antigravity.ghidrare.DaemonMain");
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private static void writeOwnerPid(Path projectDir) throws IOException {
        Files.writeString(
                projectDir.resolve("owner.pid"),
                Long.toString(ProcessHandle.current().pid()),
                StandardCharsets.UTF_8,
                StandardOpenOption.CREATE,
                StandardOpenOption.WRITE,
                StandardOpenOption.TRUNCATE_EXISTING);
    }

    private static JsonObject readMetaJson(Path metaPath) {
        if (!Files.isRegularFile(metaPath)) {
            return null;
        }
        try {
            String raw = Files.readString(metaPath, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            JsonElement parsed = JsonParser.parseString(raw);
            return parsed.isJsonObject() ? parsed.getAsJsonObject() : null;
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static String computeSha256(Path file) {
        try {
            MessageDigest md = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
            byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
            try (InputStream in = Files.newInputStream(file)) {
                int read;
                while ((read = in.read(buf)) != -1) {
                    md.update(buf, 0, read);
                }
            }
            return HexFormat.of().formatHex(md.digest());
        } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException | IOException ex) {
            throw new ApiException(500, "IO_ERROR", "Failed to hash file: " + ex.getMessage(), false, Map.of("path", file.toString()), ex);
        }
    }

    private static Path resolveGhidraSafeProjectsDir(Path projectsDir) throws IOException {
        Path normalizedTarget = projectsDir.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        if (isGhidraValidLocalPath(normalizedTarget)) {
            return normalizedTarget;
        }

        Path bridgeBase = resolveBridgeBaseDir(normalizedTarget);
        pruneDanglingBridgeLinks(bridgeBase);
        String hash12 = sha256Hex12(normalizedTarget.toString());
        Path link = bridgeBase.resolve("p-" + hash12);

        for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
            if (Files.exists(link, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
                if (Files.isSymbolicLink(link)) {
                    Path existingTarget = Files.readSymbolicLink(link);
                    Path resolvedExisting = existingTarget.isAbsolute()
                            ? existingTarget.normalize()
                            : link.getParent().resolve(existingTarget).normalize();
                    if (resolvedExisting.equals(normalizedTarget)) {
                        return link;
                    }
                }
                Files.deleteIfExists(link);
            }
            try {
                Files.createSymbolicLink(link, normalizedTarget);
                return link;
            } catch (FileAlreadyExistsException race) {
                // Another thread/process created the symlink concurrently; re-verify on next loop.
            }
        }
        throw new IOException("Failed to create Ghidra-safe projects bridge symlink at " + link);
    }

    private static void pruneDanglingBridgeLinks(Path bridgeBase) {
        try (DirectoryStream<Path> entries = Files.newDirectoryStream(bridgeBase, "p-*")) {
            for (Path entry : entries) {
                if (Files.isSymbolicLink(entry) && !Files.exists(entry)) {
                    Files.deleteIfExists(entry);
                }
            }
        } catch (IOException ignored) {
            // Best-effort bridge cleanup.
        }
    }

    private static boolean isGhidraValidLocalPath(Path path) {
        try {
            GhidraURL.checkLocalAbsolutePath(path.toAbsolutePath().normalize().toString(), true);
            return true;
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private static Path resolveBridgeBaseDir(Path referenceDir) throws IOException {
        Set<PosixFilePermission> mode0700 = PosixFilePermissions.fromString("rwx------");
        long uid = resolveUid(referenceDir);

        String xdgRuntime = System.getenv("XDG_RUNTIME_DIR");
        if (xdgRuntime != null && !xdgRuntime.isBlank()) {
            Path runtimePath = Path.of(xdgRuntime).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
            if (Files.isDirectory(runtimePath) && Files.isWritable(runtimePath) && isGhidraValidLocalPath(runtimePath)) {
                Path candidate = runtimePath.resolve("antigravity-ghidra-re").resolve("projects-links");
                if (isGhidraValidLocalPath(candidate)) {
                    ensurePrivateBridgeDir(candidate, mode0700);
                    return candidate;
                }
            }
        }

        Path runUser = Path.of("/run/user", Long.toString(uid));
        if (Files.isDirectory(runUser) && Files.isWritable(runUser) && isGhidraValidLocalPath(runUser)) {
            Path candidate = runUser.resolve("antigravity-ghidra-re").resolve("projects-links");
            ensurePrivateBridgeDir(candidate, mode0700);
            return candidate;
        }

        Path tmpAppDir = Path.of("/tmp", "antigravity-ghidra-re-u" + uid);
        Path tmpCandidate = tmpAppDir.resolve("projects-links");
        verifyNotSymlinkAndOwnedByUid(tmpAppDir, uid);
        verifyNotSymlinkAndOwnedByUid(tmpCandidate, uid);
        ensurePrivateBridgeDir(tmpCandidate, mode0700);
        verifyNotSymlinkAndOwnedByUid(tmpAppDir, uid);
        verifyNotSymlinkAndOwnedByUid(tmpCandidate, uid);
        return tmpCandidate;
    }

    private static void verifyNotSymlinkAndOwnedByUid(Path dir, long expectedUid) throws IOException {
        if (!Files.exists(dir, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
            return;
        }
        if (Files.isSymbolicLink(dir) || !Files.isDirectory(dir, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
            throw new IOException("Refusing unsafe bridge path (symlink or non-directory): " + dir);
        }
        try {
            Object uidAttr = Files.getAttribute(dir, "unix:uid", LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS);
            if (uidAttr instanceof Number n && n.longValue() != expectedUid) {
                throw new IOException("Refusing bridge path owned by uid " + n.longValue() + " (expected " + expectedUid + "): " + dir);
            }
        } catch (UnsupportedOperationException ignored) {
            // Non-POSIX filesystem fallback.
        }
    }

    private static void ensurePrivateBridgeDir(Path bridgeLinksDir, Set<PosixFilePermission> mode0700) throws IOException {
        Path appDir = bridgeLinksDir.getParent();
        if (appDir != null && !Files.exists(appDir)) {
            Files.createDirectories(appDir, PosixFilePermissions.asFileAttribute(mode0700));
        }
        if (appDir != null && Files.isDirectory(appDir)) {
            try {
                Files.setPosixFilePermissions(appDir, mode0700);
            } catch (UnsupportedOperationException ignored) {
                // Non-POSIX filesystem fallback.
            }
        }
        if (!Files.exists(bridgeLinksDir)) {
            Files.createDirectories(bridgeLinksDir, PosixFilePermissions.asFileAttribute(mode0700));
        }
        try {
            Files.setPosixFilePermissions(bridgeLinksDir, mode0700);
        } catch (UnsupportedOperationException ignored) {
            // Non-POSIX filesystem fallback.
        }
    }

    private static long resolveUid(Path fallbackPath) {
        Path status = Path.of("/proc/self/status");
        if (Files.isReadable(status)) {
            try {
                for (String line : Files.readAllLines(status, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
                    if (line.startsWith("Uid:")) {
                        String[] parts = line.substring(4).trim().split("\\s+");
                        if (parts.length > 0 && !parts[0].isEmpty()) {
                            return Long.parseLong(parts[0]);
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (IOException | NumberFormatException ignored) {
                // Fall through to unix:uid attribute.
            }
        }
        try {
            Object uidAttr = Files.getAttribute(fallbackPath, "unix:uid");
            if (uidAttr instanceof Number n) {
                return n.longValue();
            }
        } catch (IOException | UnsupportedOperationException ignored) {
            // Fall through.
        }
        return 0L;
    }

    private static String sha256Hex12(String input) {
        try {
            MessageDigest md = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
            byte[] digest = md.digest(input.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            return HexFormat.of().formatHex(digest).substring(0, 12);
        } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException ex) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("SHA-256 unavailable", ex);
        }
    }

    private static String sanitizeProgramName(String rawName) {
        if (rawName == null || rawName.isBlank()) {
            return "program";
        }
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(rawName.length());
        for (int i = 0; i < rawName.length(); i++) {
            char c = rawName.charAt(i);
            if (Character.isLetterOrDigit(c) || NamingUtilities.VALID_NAME_CHARSET.contains(c)) {
                sb.append(c);
            } else {
                sb.append('_');
            }
        }
        String candidate = sb.toString().trim();
        if (candidate.isEmpty()) {
            candidate = "program";
        } else if (candidate.startsWith(".")) {
            candidate = "program_" + candidate.substring(1);
            if (candidate.equals("program_")) {
                candidate = "program";
            }
        }
        try {
            NamingUtilities.checkName(candidate, "Program name");
            return candidate;
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            return "program";
        }
    }

    private static void deleteRecursively(Path dir) {
        if (!Files.exists(dir)) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            Files.walkFileTree(dir, new SimpleFileVisitor<>() {
                @Override
                public FileVisitResult visitFile(Path file, BasicFileAttributes attrs) throws IOException {
                    Files.deleteIfExists(file);
                    return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
                }

                @Override
                public FileVisitResult postVisitDirectory(Path d, IOException exc) throws IOException {
                    Files.deleteIfExists(d);
                    return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
                }
            });
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            System.err.println("[ghidra-re] Failed deleting directory " + dir + ": " + ex.getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```

`daemon/src/com/antigravity/ghidrare/TierConfig.java`:

```java
package com.antigravity.ghidrare;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.DirectoryStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * RAM-tier capability matrix and /proc RSS telemetry reader.
 */
public final class TierConfig {

    public record RssSnapshot(
            long jvmPid,
            long jvmRssMb,
            List<Long> decompilerPids,
            List<Long> decompilerRssMb,
            long totalDaemonRssMb) {
        public Map<String, Object> toMap() {
            Map<String, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            map.put("jvmPid", jvmPid);
            map.put("jvmRssMb", jvmRssMb);
            map.put("decompilerPids", decompilerPids);
            map.put("decompilerRssMb", decompilerRssMb);
            map.put("totalDaemonRssMb", totalDaemonRssMb);
            return map;
        }
    }

    private final String tier;
    private final int ramLimitMb;
    private final int xmsMb;
    private final int xmxMb;
    private final int workers;
    private final int workerRecycleRssMb;
    private final int decompileLru;
    private final int cfgLru;
    private final int sqliteCacheMax;
    private final String prefetchMode;
    private final int prefetchMax;
    private final int callTreeMaxDepth;
    private final int cfgMaxBlocks;
    private final int decompileTimeoutSec;
    private final int maxPayloadMb;
    private final int maxLoadedBinaries;
    private final boolean batchFtsEnabled;
    private final int idleTimeoutMin;

    private TierConfig(
            String tier,
            int ramLimitMb,
            int xmsMb,
            int xmxMb,
            int workers,
            int workerRecycleRssMb,
            int decompileLru,
            int cfgLru,
            int sqliteCacheMax,
            String prefetchMode,
            int prefetchMax,
            int callTreeMaxDepth,
            int cfgMaxBlocks,
            int decompileTimeoutSec,
            int maxPayloadMb,
            int maxLoadedBinaries,
            boolean batchFtsEnabled,
            int idleTimeoutMin) {
        this.tier = tier;
        this.ramLimitMb = ramLimitMb;
        this.xmsMb = xmsMb;
        this.xmxMb = xmxMb;
        this.workers = workers;
        this.workerRecycleRssMb = workerRecycleRssMb;
        this.decompileLru = decompileLru;
        this.cfgLru = cfgLru;
        this.sqliteCacheMax = sqliteCacheMax;
        this.prefetchMode = prefetchMode;
        this.prefetchMax = prefetchMax;
        this.callTreeMaxDepth = callTreeMaxDepth;
        this.cfgMaxBlocks = cfgMaxBlocks;
        this.decompileTimeoutSec = decompileTimeoutSec;
        this.maxPayloadMb = maxPayloadMb;
        this.maxLoadedBinaries = maxLoadedBinaries;
        this.batchFtsEnabled = batchFtsEnabled;
        this.idleTimeoutMin = idleTimeoutMin;
    }

    public static TierConfig resolve(String requestedTier, Integer requestedRamLimitMb, Integer requestedIdleTimeoutMin) {
        String normalizedTier = requestedTier == null ? "balanced" : requestedTier.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        TierConfig base = switch (normalizedTier) {
            case "eco" -> new TierConfig(
                    "eco", 1536, 256, 768, 1, 300,
                    128, 32, 1000, "off", 0,
                    3, 150, 15, 32, 1, false, 10);
            case "balanced" -> new TierConfig(
                    "balanced", 3072, 512, 1536, 2, 450,
                    512, 128, 5000, "1-hop", 8,
                    5, 350, 30, 50, 1, false, 20);
            case "power" -> new TierConfig(
                    "power", 6144, 1024, 3200, 4, 600,
                    2048, 512, 25000, "2-hop", 24,
                    8, 800, 60, 100, 3, true, 45);
            case "custom" -> resolveCustom(requestedRamLimitMb != null ? requestedRamLimitMb : 3072);
            default -> throw new ApiException(
                    400, "INVALID_PARAMS", "Unsupported tier: " + requestedTier, false);
        };

        if (requestedIdleTimeoutMin != null) {
            int idle = requestedIdleTimeoutMin <= 0 ? 0 : clamp(requestedIdleTimeoutMin, 5, 120);
            return base.withIdleTimeoutMin(idle);
        }
        return base;
    }

    private static TierConfig resolveCustom(int customRamMb) {
        long hostTotalMb = readHostMemTotalMb();
        int maxHostSafe = (int) Math.floor(hostTotalMb * 0.70);
        int maxAllowed = Math.max(1536, Math.min(10240, maxHostSafe));
        int r = clamp(customRamMb, 1536, maxAllowed);

        int cpuThreads = Math.max(1, Runtime.getRuntime().availableProcessors());
        int maxWorkersByCpu = Math.max(1, Math.min(6, cpuThreads / 4));
        int workers = clamp((int) Math.floor((r - 800.0) / 1200.0), 1, maxWorkersByCpu);

        int workerAvgMb = 240;
        int xmxMb = Math.max(768, (int) Math.floor((r - 260.0 - (workers * workerAvgMb)) * 0.92));
        int xmsMb = Math.max(256, Math.min(xmxMb, (int) Math.floor(xmxMb / 3.0)));
        int workerRecycleRssMb = clamp((int) Math.floor(r * 0.14), 300, 650);

        int decompileLru = Math.max(128, (int) Math.floor(xmxMb / 1.5));
        int cfgLru = Math.max(32, (int) Math.floor(xmxMb / 6.0));
        int sqliteCacheMax = clamp(r * 4, 1000, 50000);

        String prefetchMode;
        int prefetchMax;
        if (r < 2560) {
            prefetchMode = "off";
            prefetchMax = 0;
        } else if (r < 4608) {
            prefetchMode = "1-hop";
            prefetchMax = 8;
        } else {
            prefetchMode = "2-hop";
            prefetchMax = 24;
        }

        int callTreeMaxDepth = clamp((int) Math.floor(r / 750.0), 3, 10);
        int cfgMaxBlocks = clamp((int) Math.floor(r / 8.0), 150, 1200);
        int decompileTimeoutSec = clamp((int) Math.floor(r / 100.0), 15, 90);
        int maxPayloadMb = r < 2560 ? 32 : (r < 4608 ? 50 : 100);
        int maxLoadedBinaries = r >= 4608
                ? Math.min(4, 1 + (int) Math.floor((r - 3072.0) / 1536.0))
                : 1;
        boolean batchFtsEnabled = r >= 5120;

        return new TierConfig(
                "custom", r, xmsMb, xmxMb, workers, workerRecycleRssMb,
                decompileLru, cfgLru, sqliteCacheMax, prefetchMode, prefetchMax,
                callTreeMaxDepth, cfgMaxBlocks, decompileTimeoutSec, maxPayloadMb,
                maxLoadedBinaries, batchFtsEnabled, 20);
    }

    private TierConfig withIdleTimeoutMin(int idleMin) {
        return new TierConfig(
                tier, ramLimitMb, xmsMb, xmxMb, workers, workerRecycleRssMb,
                decompileLru, cfgLru, sqliteCacheMax, prefetchMode, prefetchMax,
                callTreeMaxDepth, cfgMaxBlocks, decompileTimeoutSec, maxPayloadMb,
                maxLoadedBinaries, batchFtsEnabled, idleMin);
    }

    private static int clamp(int value, int min, int max) {
        return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
    }

    public static long readHostMemTotalMb() {
        Path meminfo = Path.of("/proc/meminfo");
        try {
            for (String line : Files.readAllLines(meminfo, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
                if (line.startsWith("MemTotal:")) {
                    long kb = parseProcKbValue(line);
                    if (kb > 0) {
                        return kb / 1024L;
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (IOException ignored) {
            // Fall through to safe default when /proc/meminfo is unavailable.
        }
        return 16384L;
    }

    /**
     * Reads VmRSS in MiB from /proc/&lt;pid&gt;/status, or -1 if unavailable.
     */
    public static long readProcVmRssMb(long pid) {
        if (pid <= 0) {
            return -1L;
        }
        Path statusPath = Path.of("/proc", Long.toString(pid), "status");
        if (!Files.isReadable(statusPath)) {
            return -1L;
        }
        try {
            for (String line : Files.readAllLines(statusPath, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
                if (line.startsWith("VmRSS:")) {
                    long kb = parseProcKbValue(line);
                    return kb >= 0 ? Math.round(kb / 1024.0) : -1L;
                }
            }
        } catch (IOException ignored) {
            return -1L;
        }
        return -1L;
    }

    /**
     * Scans /proc/&lt;jvmPid&gt;/task/&#42;/children and filters child processes whose
     * comm or cmdline references "decompile".
     */
    public static List<Long> listChildDecompilePids(long jvmPid) {
        if (jvmPid <= 0) {
            return Collections.emptyList();
        }
        Path taskDir = Path.of("/proc", Long.toString(jvmPid), "task");
        if (!Files.isDirectory(taskDir)) {
            return Collections.emptyList();
        }

        List<Long> decompilePids = new ArrayList<>();
        try (DirectoryStream<Path> threads = Files.newDirectoryStream(taskDir)) {
            for (Path threadDir : threads) {
                Path childrenFile = threadDir.resolve("children");
                if (!Files.isReadable(childrenFile)) {
                    continue;
                }
                String content;
                try {
                    content = Files.readString(childrenFile, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).trim();
                } catch (IOException ignored) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (content.isEmpty()) {
                    continue;
                }
                for (String token : content.split("\\s+")) {
                    if (token.isEmpty()) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    long childPid;
                    try {
                        childPid = Long.parseLong(token);
                    } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (!decompilePids.contains(childPid) && isDecompileProcess(childPid)) {
                        decompilePids.add(childPid);
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (IOException ignored) {
            return Collections.emptyList();
        }

        Collections.sort(decompilePids);
        return decompilePids;
    }

    private static boolean isDecompileProcess(long pid) {
        Path commPath = Path.of("/proc", Long.toString(pid), "comm");
        try {
            if (Files.isReadable(commPath)) {
                String comm = Files.readString(commPath, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
                if (comm.contains("decompile")) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        } catch (IOException ignored) {
            // Fall through to cmdline check.
        }

        Path cmdlinePath = Path.of("/proc", Long.toString(pid), "cmdline");
        try {
            if (Files.isReadable(cmdlinePath)) {
                byte[] bytes = Files.readAllBytes(cmdlinePath);
                String cmdline = new String(bytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).replace('\0', ' ').toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
                return cmdline.contains("decompile");
            }
        } catch (IOException ignored) {
            return false;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static long parseProcKbValue(String line) {
        int colon = line.indexOf(':');
        if (colon < 0) {
            return -1L;
        }
        String rest = line.substring(colon + 1).trim();
        int space = rest.indexOf(' ');
        String numPart = space >= 0 ? rest.substring(0, space) : rest;
        try {
            return Long.parseLong(numPart.trim());
        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
            return -1L;
        }
    }

    public static RssSnapshot readRssSnapshot() {
        long jvmPid = ProcessHandle.current().pid();
        long jvmRss = Math.max(0L, readProcVmRssMb(jvmPid));
        List<Long> childPids = listChildDecompilePids(jvmPid);
        List<Long> validPids = new ArrayList<>(childPids.size());
        List<Long> childRss = new ArrayList<>(childPids.size());
        long total = jvmRss;
        for (long childPid : childPids) {
            long rss = readProcVmRssMb(childPid);
            if (rss >= 0) {
                validPids.add(childPid);
                childRss.add(rss);
                total += rss;
            }
        }
        return new RssSnapshot(jvmPid, jvmRss, validPids, childRss, total);
    }

    public Map<String, Object> toMap() {
        Map<String, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        map.put("tier", tier);
        map.put("ramLimitMb", ramLimitMb);
        map.put("xmsMb", xmsMb);
        map.put("xmxMb", xmxMb);
        map.put("workers", workers);
        map.put("workerRecycleRssMb", workerRecycleRssMb);
        map.put("decompileLru", decompileLru);
        map.put("cfgLru", cfgLru);
        map.put("sqliteCacheMax", sqliteCacheMax);
        map.put("prefetchMode", prefetchMode);
        map.put("prefetchMax", prefetchMax);
        map.put("callTreeMaxDepth", callTreeMaxDepth);
        map.put("cfgMaxBlocks", cfgMaxBlocks);
        map.put("decompileTimeoutSec", decompileTimeoutSec);
        map.put("maxPayloadMb", maxPayloadMb);
        map.put("maxLoadedBinaries", maxLoadedBinaries);
        map.put("batchFtsEnabled", batchFtsEnabled);
        map.put("idleTimeoutMin", idleTimeoutMin);
        return map;
    }

    public String getTier() {
        return tier;
    }

    public int getRamLimitMb() {
        return ramLimitMb;
    }

    public int getXmsMb() {
        return xmsMb;
    }

        return xmxMb;

        return sqliteCacheMax;
```

`install.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

SRC_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
TARGET_DIR="${ANTIGRAVITY_PLUGINS_DIR:-$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins}/ghidra-re"
DATA_DIR="${GHIDRA_RE_DATA_DIR:-$HOME/.local/share/antigravity-ghidra-re}"
CACHE_DIR="${GHIDRA_RE_CACHE_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/antigravity-ghidra-re}"

mkdir -p "$(dirname "$TARGET_DIR")" "$DATA_DIR" "$CACHE_DIR"

if [[ "$SRC_DIR" != "$TARGET_DIR" ]]; then
  rm -rf "$TARGET_DIR"
  cp -a "$SRC_DIR" "$TARGET_DIR"
fi

cat > "$TARGET_DIR/mcp_config.json" <<EOF
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "ghidra-re": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": [
        "$TARGET_DIR/mcp/server.mjs"
      ],
      "env": {
        "GHIDRA_RE_DATA_DIR": "$DATA_DIR",
        "GHIDRA_RE_CACHE_DIR": "$CACHE_DIR"
      }
    }
  }
}
EOF

echo "Installed ghidra-re plugin to: $TARGET_DIR"
echo "Data directory:  $DATA_DIR"
echo "Cache directory: $CACHE_DIR"
```
