`mcp/server.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node

import fs from 'node:fs';
import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { loadConfig, resolveTierSpec } from '../shared/config.mjs';
import {
  DaemonError,
  decompileFunction,
  disassemble,
  getCallGraph,
  getCfg,
  getHealth,
  getXrefs,
  inspectData,
  listBinaries,
  listFunctions,
  mutateBatch,
  mutateComment,
  mutateRename,
  mutateRetype,
  openBinary,
  sendFocus,
  stopDaemon,
  syncBinaryIndex,
  unloadBinary,
} from '../shared/daemon-client.mjs';
import {
  closeAllIndexes,
  getBinaryMeta,
  getCachedDecompile,
  getCallGraphOffline,
  listOfflineProjects,
  patchFunctionCommentFlag,
  patchFunctionRename,
  searchFunctions,
  searchPseudocode,
  searchStrings,
  syncMutationCacheState,
  upsertDecompileCache,
} from '../shared/index-store.mjs';
import {
  computeFileSha256,
  discoverEnvironment,
  getProjectDir,
  getProjectsDir,
} from '../shared/paths.mjs';

const SERVER_NAME = 'ghidra-re';
const SERVER_VERSION = '1.0.0';
const SUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_VERSIONS = ['2025-06-18', '2025-03-26', '2024-11-05'];
const MAX_FRAME_BYTES = 24576; // 24 KiB hard JSON-RPC frame ceiling
const MAX_LSP_BODY_BYTES = 32 * 1024 * 1024;
const MCP_CALL_OPTS = Object.freeze({ priority: 'mcp', actor: 'agent' });

const HEX_ID_RE = /^[a-fA-F0-9]{8,64}$/;
const FULL_SHA256_RE = /^[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$/;

class ToolInputError extends Error {
  constructor(message, { code = 'INVALID_PARAMS', details = null } = {}) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ToolInputError';
    this.code = code;
    this.retryable = false;
    this.details = details;
  }
}

function clampInt(val, min, max, fallback) {
  if (val === undefined || val === null || val === '') return fallback;
  const num = Number(val);
  if (!Number.isFinite(num)) return fallback;
  return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, Math.trunc(num)));
}

function requireString(val, fieldName) {
  if (typeof val !== 'string' || val.trim().length === 0) {
    throw new ToolInputError(`Parameter '${fieldName}' must be a non-empty string`);
  }
  return val.trim();
}

function optionalString(val, fallback = '') {
  if (val === undefined || val === null) return fallback;
  return String(val);
}

function resolveProjectBinaryId(binaryId) {
  const raw = requireString(binaryId, 'binaryId').toLowerCase();
  if (!HEX_ID_RE.test(raw)) {
    throw new ToolInputError(`Invalid binaryId '${binaryId}': expected 8-64 hex characters`);
  }
  if (FULL_SHA256_RE.test(raw)) {
    return raw;
  }
  const projectsDir = getProjectsDir();
  try {
    const entries = fs.readdirSync(projectsDir, { withFileTypes: true });
    const matches = [];
    for (const entry of entries) {
      if (!entry.isDirectory()) continue;
      const name = entry.name.toLowerCase();
      if (FULL_SHA256_RE.test(name) && name.startsWith(raw)) {
        matches.push(name);
      }
    }
    if (matches.length === 1) {
      return matches[0];
    }
    if (matches.length > 1) {
      throw new ToolInputError(`Ambiguous binaryId prefix '${binaryId}'`, {
        code: 'INVALID_PARAMS',
        details: { matches },
      });
    }
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof ToolInputError) throw err;
  }
  return raw;
}

function hasOfflineIndex(binaryId) {
  try {
    const projectDir = getProjectDir(binaryId);
    if (!fs.statSync(join(projectDir, 'index.sqlite')).isFile()) {
      return false;
    }
    const meta = getBinaryMeta(binaryId)?.meta;
    return Boolean(meta && meta.revision !== undefined && meta.revision !== null);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function readJsonFileSafe(filePath) {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8'));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function readSelfRssMb() {
  try {
    const status = fs.readFileSync('/proc/self/status', 'utf8');
    const m = status.match(/^VmRSS:\s+(\d+)\s+kB/m);
    if (!m) return null;
    const kb = Number.parseInt(m[1], 10);
    return Number.isFinite(kb) ? Math.round((kb / 1024) * 10) / 10 : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function stripGutterPrefix(line) {
  return line.replace(/^(?:0x[0-9a-fA-F]+| +) \| /, '');
}

function encodeSqliteCursor(offset) {
  return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ offset }), 'utf8').toString('base64url');
}

function encodeDaemonCursor(offset) {
  return Buffer.from(`offset:${offset}`, 'utf8').toString('base64url');
}

function decodeAnyOffsetCursor(cursor) {
  if (cursor === undefined || cursor === null || cursor === '') return 0;
  const raw = String(cursor).trim();
  if (!raw) return 0;
  if (/^\d+$/.test(raw)) {
    return Math.max(0, Number.parseInt(raw, 10));
  }
  try {
    const decoded = Buffer.from(raw, 'base64url').toString('utf8');
    if (decoded.startsWith('offset:')) {
      const n = Number.parseInt(decoded.slice('offset:'.length), 10);
      if (Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 0) return n;
    }
    const parsed = JSON.parse(decoded);
    if (parsed && Number.isInteger(parsed.offset) && parsed.offset >= 0) {
      return parsed.offset;
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore malformed cursor.
  }
  return 0;
}

async function withLiveBinary(binaryId, fn) {
  const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(binaryId);
  try {
    return await fn(id);
  } catch (err) {
    if (!(err instanceof DaemonError) || err.code !== 'BINARY_NOT_LOADED') {
      throw err;
    }
    const projectDir = getProjectDir(id);
    const metaPath = join(projectDir, 'meta.json');
    const gprPath = join(projectDir, 'ghidra.gpr');
    if (!fs.existsSync(metaPath) || !fs.existsSync(gprPath)) {
      throw err;
    }
    const meta = readJsonFileSafe(metaPath);
    if (!meta || typeof meta !== 'object') {
      throw err;
    }

    const candidatePath =
      (typeof meta.primaryPath === 'string' && meta.primaryPath.trim() && fs.existsSync(meta.primaryPath.trim())
        ? meta.primaryPath.trim()
        : null) ||
      (Array.isArray(meta.originalPaths)
        ? meta.originalPaths.find((p) => typeof p === 'string' && p.trim() && fs.existsSync(p.trim()))?.trim()
        : null) ||
      '';

    const openRes = await openBinary(candidatePath, {
      sha256: id,
      analyze: !meta.analyzed,
      replaceIfFull: true,
      waitForAnalysis: true,
      ...MCP_CALL_OPTS,
      autoStart: true,
    });
    const summary = openRes?.job?.result ?? openRes?.binary ?? openRes;
    const daemonRev = Number(summary?.revision ?? meta.revision ?? 1);

    let localRev = -1;
    if (hasOfflineIndex(id)) {
      try {
        localRev = Number(getBinaryMeta(id).meta?.revision ?? 0);
      } catch {
        localRev = -1;
      }
    }
    if (localRev < daemonRev) {
      try {
        await syncBinaryIndex(id, {
          sinceRevision: Math.max(0, localRev),
          ...MCP_CALL_OPTS,
          autoStart: true,
        });
      } catch {
        // Non-fatal; proceed with live retry.
      }
    }

    return await fn(id);
  }
}

function formatErrorPayload(err) {
  if (err instanceof DaemonError) {
    return {
      error: {
        code: err.code || 'DAEMON_ERROR',
        message: err.message || 'Daemon request failed',
        retryable: Boolean(err.retryable),
        details: err.details ?? null,
      },
    };
  }
  if (err instanceof ToolInputError) {
    return {
      error: {
        code: err.code,
        message: err.message,
        retryable: false,
        details: err.details ?? null,
      },
    };
  }
  return {
    error: {
      code: typeof err?.code === 'string' ? err.code : 'TOOL_ERROR',
      message: err?.message ? String(err.message) : String(err),
      retryable: Boolean(err?.retryable),
      details: err?.details ?? null,
    },
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 24 KiB (24576 UTF-8 bytes) Hard Frame Budget Enforcer
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function measureRpcFrameBytes(text, isError, idVal) {
  const frame = JSON.stringify({
    jsonrpc: '2.0',
    id: idVal,
    result: {
      content: [{ type: 'text', text }],
      isError: Boolean(isError),
    },
  });
  return Buffer.byteLength(frame, 'utf8') + 1;
}

function frameFits(text, isError, requestId) {
  const actualId = requestId === undefined ? 'max' : requestId;
  if (measureRpcFrameBytes(text, isError, 'max') > MAX_FRAME_BYTES) {
    return false;
  }
  if (actualId !== 'max' && measureRpcFrameBytes(text, isError, actualId) > MAX_FRAME_BYTES) {
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function sliceStringCodePointSafe(str, maxChars) {
  if (str.length <= maxChars) return str;
  let end = Math.max(0, maxChars);
  if (end > 0 && end < str.length) {
    const code = str.charCodeAt(end - 1);
    if (code >= 0xd800 && code <= 0xdbff) {
      end--;
    }
  }
  return str.slice(0, end);
}

function clampStringToFit(str, maxBytes) {
  if (Buffer.byteLength(str, 'utf8') <= maxBytes) return str;
  let lo = 0;
  let hi = str.length;
  while (lo < hi) {
    const mid = (lo + hi + 1) >> 1;
    const candidate = sliceStringCodePointSafe(str, mid);
    if (Buffer.byteLength(candidate, 'utf8') <= maxBytes) {
      lo = mid;
    } else {
      hi = mid - 1;
    }
  }
  return sliceStringCodePointSafe(str, lo);
}

function fitWithinBudget(
  payload,
  { isError = false, id = 'max', pageOffset = 0, cursorMode = 'sqlite', customFit = null } = {},
) {
  const encodeCursor = cursorMode === 'daemon' ? encodeDaemonCursor : encodeSqliteCursor;

  if (typeof payload === 'string') {
    if (frameFits(payload, isError, id)) return payload;
    let lo = 0;
    let hi = payload.length;
    while (lo < hi) {
      const mid = (lo + hi + 1) >> 1;
      const cand = sliceStringCodePointSafe(payload, mid);
      if (frameFits(cand, isError, id)) {
        lo = mid;
      } else {
        hi = mid - 1;
      }
    }
    return sliceStringCodePointSafe(payload, lo);
  }

  const obj = structuredClone(payload);
  const serialize = (val) => JSON.stringify(val);
  const fits = (val) => frameFits(serialize(val), isError, id);

  if (fits(obj)) {
    return serialize(obj);
  }

  if (typeof customFit === 'function') {
    const customObj = customFit(fits);
    if (customObj !== null && customObj !== undefined) {
      if (typeof customObj === 'string') return customObj;
      if (fits(customObj)) return serialize(customObj);
      return fitWithinBudget(customObj, { isError, id, pageOffset, cursorMode });
    }
  }

  const markTruncated = () => {
    obj.truncated = true;
    obj.truncationReason = 'payload_budget_24kib';
  };

  // 1. For ghidra_decompile, trim callersSummary / calleesSummary before cutting code lines aggressively
  if (Array.isArray(obj.calleesSummary) || Array.isArray(obj.callersSummary)) {
    while (!fits(obj) && ((obj.calleesSummary?.length || 0) > 0 || (obj.callersSummary?.length || 0) > 0)) {
      if ((obj.calleesSummary?.length || 0) >= (obj.callersSummary?.length || 0)) {
        obj.calleesSummary.pop();
      } else {
        obj.callersSummary.pop();
      }
      obj.callsSummaryTruncated = true;
    }
    if (fits(obj)) {
      return serialize(obj);
    }
  }

  // 2. Text / code payloads (code, listing)
  for (const field of ['code', 'listing']) {
    if (typeof obj[field] === 'string') {
      let lines = obj[field].split('\n');
      let anyLineClamped = false;
      lines = lines.map((line) => {
        if (line.length > 1000) {
          anyLineClamped = true;
          return `${sliceStringCodePointSafe(line, 1000)}...[clamped]`;
        }
        return line;
      });
      if (anyLineClamped) {
        obj[field] = lines.join('\n');
        markTruncated();
        if (fits(obj)) return serialize(obj);
      }

      if (lines.length > 1) {
        const origCount = lines.length;
        const origStartLine = Number.isInteger(obj.startLine) ? obj.startLine : 1;
        let lo = 1;
        let hi = origCount;
        let best = 1;
        while (lo <= hi) {
          const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;
          obj[field] = lines.slice(0, mid).join('\n');
          markTruncated();
          if (field === 'code') {
            obj.endLine = origStartLine + mid - 1;
            obj.nextStartLine = obj.endLine + 1;
          } else {
            obj.count = mid;
            obj.hasMoreAfter = true;
          }
          if (fits(obj)) {
            best = mid;
            lo = mid + 1;
          } else {
            hi = mid - 1;
          }
        }
        obj[field] = lines.slice(0, best).join('\n');
        markTruncated();
        if (field === 'code') {
          obj.endLine = origStartLine + best - 1;
          obj.nextStartLine = obj.endLine + 1;
        } else {
          obj.count = best;
          obj.hasMoreAfter = true;
          const lastLine = lines[best - 1] || '';
          const mAddr = lastLine.match(/^(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)/);
          if (mAddr) obj.endAddr = mAddr[1];
        }
        if (fits(obj)) return serialize(obj);
      }

      // Single-line clamp if a 1-line code/listing still overflows
      if (!fits(obj)) {
        const raw = obj[field];
        let lo = 0;
        let hi = raw.length;
        while (lo < hi) {
          const mid = (lo + hi + 1) >> 1;
          obj[field] = `${sliceStringCodePointSafe(raw, mid)}...[clamped]`;
          markTruncated();
          if (field === 'code') {
            obj.endLine = Number.isInteger(obj.startLine) ? obj.startLine : 1;
            obj.nextStartLine = obj.endLine + 1;
          }
          if (fits(obj)) {
            lo = mid;
          } else {
            hi = mid - 1;
          }
        }
        obj[field] = `${sliceStringCodePointSafe(raw, lo)}...[clamped]`;
        if (fits(obj)) return serialize(obj);
      }
    }
  }

  // 3. ghidra_inspect_data specific structured trimming
  if (obj.pointerAnalysis && Array.isArray(obj.pointerAnalysis.entries)) {
    while (!fits(obj) && obj.pointerAnalysis.entries.length > 0) {
      obj.pointerAnalysis.entries.pop();
      obj.pointerAnalysis.truncated = true;
      markTruncated();
    }
    if (fits(obj)) return serialize(obj);
  }
  if (obj.decoded && typeof obj.decoded === 'object') {
    for (const key of ['value', 'text']) {
      if (typeof obj.decoded[key] === 'string' && !fits(obj)) {
        const s = obj.decoded[key];
        let lo = 0;
        let hi = s.length;
        while (lo < hi) {
          const mid = (lo + hi + 1) >> 1;
          obj.decoded[key] = sliceStringCodePointSafe(s, mid);
          obj.decoded.truncated = true;
          markTruncated();
          if (fits(obj)) lo = mid;
          else hi = mid - 1;
        }
        obj.decoded[key] = sliceStringCodePointSafe(s, lo);
        if (fits(obj)) return serialize(obj);
      }
    }
  }
  if (obj.hexDump && typeof obj.hexDump === 'object') {
    if (Array.isArray(obj.hexDump.lines)) {
      while (!fits(obj) && obj.hexDump.lines.length > 0) {
        obj.hexDump.lines.pop();
        obj.hexDump.truncated = true;
        markTruncated();
      }
      obj.hexDump.length = Math.min(obj.hexDump.length || 0, obj.hexDump.lines.length * 16);
    }
    if (typeof obj.hexDump.bytesHex === 'string' && !fits(obj)) {
      let hexLen = obj.hexDump.bytesHex.length;
      while (!fits(obj) && hexLen > 0) {
        hexLen = Math.max(0, Math.floor(hexLen / 2) & ~1);
        obj.hexDump.bytesHex = obj.hexDump.bytesHex.slice(0, hexLen);
        obj.hexDump.length = hexLen / 2;
        obj.hexDump.truncated = true;
        markTruncated();
      }
    }
    if (fits(obj)) return serialize(obj);
  }

  // 4. CFG blocks: strip insns first before popping blocks
  if (Array.isArray(obj.blocks)) {
    let strippedInsns = false;
    for (const b of obj.blocks) {
      if (b && Array.isArray(b.insns) && b.insns.length > 0) {
        b.insns = [];
        strippedInsns = true;
      }
    }
    if (strippedInsns) {
      markTruncated();
      if (fits(obj)) return serialize(obj);
    }
  }

  // 5. xrefs groups fallback: pop refs inside the last group before removing an empty group
  if (Array.isArray(obj.groups) && obj.groups.length > 0) {
    while (!fits(obj) && obj.groups.length > 0) {
      const lastGrp = obj.groups[obj.groups.length - 1];
      if (Array.isArray(lastGrp?.refs) && lastGrp.refs.length > 1) {
        lastGrp.refs.pop();
        lastGrp.count = lastGrp.refs.length;
        lastGrp.truncated = true;
      } else if (obj.groups.length > 1) {
        if (Array.isArray(lastGrp?.refs) && lastGrp.refs.length === 1) {
          lastGrp.refs.pop();
          lastGrp.count = 0;
        }
        obj.groups.pop();
      } else {
        break;
      }
      markTruncated();
      const keptRefs = obj.groups.reduce((acc, g) => acc + (Array.isArray(g?.refs) ? g.refs.length : 0), 0);
      obj.nextCursor = encodeCursor(pageOffset + keptRefs);
    }
    if (fits(obj)) return serialize(obj);
  }

  // 6. Paginated / list / graph arrays
  const arrayFields = [
    'items',
    'matches',
    'results',
    'blocks',
    'nodes',
    'edges',
    'activeBinaries',
    'offlineProjects',
    'sections',
    'entrypoints',
    'invalidatedFuncs',
    'warnings',
  ];

  for (const field of arrayFields) {
    if (!Array.isArray(obj[field]) || obj[field].length === 0) continue;
    const isOffsetList = field === 'items' || field === 'matches';

    while (!fits(obj) && obj[field].length > 0) {
      if (obj[field].length > 16) {
        obj[field].length = Math.ceil(obj[field].length * 0.75);
      } else {
        obj[field].pop();
      }
      markTruncated();

      if (field === 'nodes' && Array.isArray(obj.edges)) {
        const keep = new Set(obj.nodes.map((n) => n?.addr).filter(Boolean));
        obj.edges = obj.edges.filter((e) => keep.has(e?.from) && keep.has(e?.to));
      } else if (field === 'blocks' && Array.isArray(obj.edges)) {
        const keep = new Set(obj.blocks.map((b) => b?.id).filter(Boolean));
        obj.edges = obj.edges.filter((e) => keep.has(e?.from) && keep.has(e?.to));
      } else if (isOffsetList) {
        obj.nextCursor = encodeCursor(pageOffset + obj[field].length);
      }
    }
    if (fits(obj)) return serialize(obj);
  }

  // 7. Final structural safety fallback (mathematically guaranteed <= 24576 bytes)
  const shrinkStringsDeep = (node, maxLen) => {
    if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') return;
    if (Array.isArray(node)) {
      if (node.length > 8) node.length = 8;
      for (const item of node) shrinkStringsDeep(item, maxLen);
      return;
    }
    for (const key of Object.keys(node)) {
      const val = node[key];
      if (typeof val === 'string' && val.length > maxLen) {
        node[key] = `${sliceStringCodePointSafe(val, maxLen)}...`;
      } else if (val && typeof val === 'object') {
        shrinkStringsDeep(val, maxLen);
      }
    }
  };

  for (const cap of [512, 128, 32]) {
    shrinkStringsDeep(obj, cap);
    markTruncated();
    if (fits(obj)) return serialize(obj);
  }

  const minimal = isError
    ? {
        error: {
          code: String(obj?.error?.code || 'ERROR').slice(0, 64),
          message: clampStringToFit(String(obj?.error?.message || 'Error payload truncated'), 4096),
          retryable: Boolean(obj?.error?.retryable),
          truncated: true,
        },
      }
    : {
        binaryId: obj?.binaryId ?? null,
        truncated: true,
        truncationReason: 'payload_budget_24kib',
        message: 'Response exceeded 24 KiB payload ceiling and was structurally compacted.',
      };

  if (fits(minimal)) return serialize(minimal);
  return JSON.stringify({ truncated: true, truncationReason: 'payload_budget_24kib' });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Tool Implementations (18 Tools)

async function handleStatus() {
  const cfg = loadConfig();
  const tierSpec = resolveTierSpec(cfg.tier, cfg.customRamMb);
  const env = discoverEnvironment(cfg);
  const health = await getHealth({ autoStart: false });
  const offlineProjects = listOfflineProjects({ limit: 30 });
  const mcpProcessRssMb = readSelfRssMb();

  let loadedBinaries = [];
  if (health) {
    try {
      const listRes = await listBinaries({ ...MCP_CALL_OPTS, autoStart: false });
      const rawBins = Array.isArray(listRes?.binaries) ? listRes.binaries : [];
      loadedBinaries = rawBins.map((b) => ({
        binaryId: b.binaryId,
        programName: b.programName,
        primaryPath: b.primaryPath,
        arch: b.arch,
        format: b.format,
        revision: b.revision,
        dirty: Boolean(b.dirty),
        functionCount: b.functionCount,
      }));
    } catch {
      loadedBinaries = (health.loadedBinaries || []).map((id) => ({ binaryId: id }));
    }
  }

  return {
    data: {
      daemonState: health ? (health.state || 'active') : 'stopped',
      environment: env.ok
        ? {
            ok: true,
            ghidraVersion: env.ghidraVersion,
            jdkMajor: env.jdkMajor,
            jdkVersion: env.jdkVersion,
          }
        : {
            ok: false,
            code: env.code,
            message: env.message,
            details: env.details ?? null,
          },
      tier: tierSpec.tier,
      ramLimitMb: tierSpec.ramLimitMb,
      lowMemoryWarning: Boolean(tierSpec.lowMemoryWarning),
      lowMemoryMessage: tierSpec.lowMemoryMessage ?? null,
      daemon: health
        ? {
            pid: health.pid,
            uptimeMs: health.uptimeMs,
            ghidraVersion: health.ghidraVersion,
            jvmRssMb: health.jvmRssMb,
            decompilerRssMb: health.decompilerRssMb,
            totalDaemonRssMb: health.totalDaemonRssMb,
            workers: health.workers,
            activeJobs: health.activeJobs,
            loadedBinaries,
          }
        : {
            jvmRssMb: 0,
            decompilerRssMb: 0,
            totalDaemonRssMb: 0,
            loadedBinaries: [],
          },
      mcpProcessRssMb,
      offlineProjectsCount: offlineProjects.length,
      offlineProjects: offlineProjects.map((p) => ({
        binaryId: p.binaryId,
        basename: p.basename,
        primaryPath: p.primaryPath,
        arch: p.arch,
        format: p.format,
        revision: p.revision,
        functionCount: p.functionCount,
        stringCount: p.stringCount,
        cachedDecompileCount: p.cachedDecompileCount,
        hasIndex: p.hasIndex,
        lastOpenedAt: p.lastOpenedAt,
      })),
    },
  };
}

function buildCompactSections(sections) {
  if (!Array.isArray(sections)) return [];
  return sections.map((s) => ({
    name: s.name,
    start: s.start ?? s.startHex,
    end: s.end ?? s.endHex,
    size: s.size ?? s.sizeBytes ?? 0,
    permissions: s.permissions ?? s.perms ?? '---',
    ...(s.entropy !== undefined && s.entropy !== null ? { entropy: s.entropy } : {}),
  }));
}

async function handleOpenBinary(args) {
  const rawPath = requireString(args.path, 'path');
  const absPath = resolve(rawPath);
  let stat;
  try {
    stat = fs.statSync(absPath);
  } catch (err) {
    throw new ToolInputError(`File not found: ${absPath}`, {
      code: 'FILE_NOT_FOUND',
      details: { path: absPath, errno: err.code },
    });
  }
  if (!stat.isFile()) {
    throw new ToolInputError(`Path is not a regular file: ${absPath}`, {
      code: 'INVALID_PARAMS',
      details: { path: absPath },
    });
  }

  const waitForAnalysis = args.waitForAnalysis !== undefined ? Boolean(args.waitForAnalysis) : true;
  const analysisProfile = args.analysisProfile === 'fast' ? 'fast' : 'default';
  const offlineOnly = Boolean(args.offlineOnly);
  const forceReimport = Boolean(args.forceReimport);
  const replaceIfFull = Boolean(args.replaceIfFull);

  const sha256 = await computeFileSha256(absPath);

  if (offlineOnly) {
    if (!hasOfflineIndex(sha256)) {
      throw new ToolInputError(`Binary ${sha256} is not indexed offline; open with offlineOnly=false to import`, {
        code: 'BINARY_NOT_INDEXED_OFFLINE',
        details: { binaryId: sha256, path: absPath },
      });
    }
    const metaJson = readJsonFileSafe(join(getProjectDir(sha256), 'meta.json')) || {};
    const sqliteInfo = getBinaryMeta(sha256);
    const sqlMeta = sqliteInfo.meta || {};
    const rawSections = Array.isArray(metaJson.sections) && metaJson.sections.length > 0
      ? metaJson.sections
      : sqliteInfo.sections;

    return {
      data: {
        binaryId: sha256,
        mode: 'offline',
        cached: true,
        programName: metaJson.programName ?? sqlMeta.programName ?? null,
        format: metaJson.format ?? sqlMeta.format ?? null,
        arch: metaJson.arch ?? sqlMeta.arch ?? null,
        endianness: metaJson.endianness ?? sqlMeta.endianness ?? null,
        pointerSize: metaJson.pointerSize ?? (sqlMeta.pointerSize != null ? Number(sqlMeta.pointerSize) : null),
        imageBase: metaJson.imageBase ?? sqlMeta.imageBase ?? null,
        fileSizeBytes: metaJson.fileSizeBytes ?? stat.size,
        revision: Number(sqlMeta.revision ?? metaJson.revision ?? 0),
        entrypoints: Array.isArray(metaJson.entrypoints) ? metaJson.entrypoints.slice(0, 10) : [],
        sections: buildCompactSections(rawSections),
        functionCount: sqliteInfo.functionCount ?? metaJson.functionCount ?? 0,
        stringCount: sqliteInfo.stringCount ?? 0,
        importCount: metaJson.importCount ?? 0,
        exportCount: metaJson.exportCount ?? 0,
        cachedDecompileCount: sqliteInfo.cachedDecompileCount ?? 0,
        warnings: Array.isArray(metaJson.warnings) ? metaJson.warnings : [],
      },
    };
  }

  const openRes = await openBinary(absPath, {
    sha256,
    analyze: true,
    waitForAnalysis,
    analysisProfile,
    forceReimport,
    replaceIfFull,
    ...MCP_CALL_OPTS,
    autoStart: true,
  });

  if (!waitForAnalysis && openRes?.jobId && !openRes?.job?.result) {
    return {
      data: {
        binaryId: sha256,
        mode: 'live',
        status: openRes.state || openRes.status || 'analyzing',
        jobId: openRes.jobId,
      },
    };
  }

  const summary = openRes?.job?.result ?? openRes?.binary ?? openRes;
  const daemonRev = Number(summary?.revision ?? 1);

  let localRev = 0;
  let hasLocal = hasOfflineIndex(sha256);
  if (hasLocal) {
    try {
      localRev = Number(getBinaryMeta(sha256).meta?.revision ?? 0);
    } catch {
      hasLocal = false;
    }
  }

  let indexSync = { synced: false, unchanged: true, revision: localRev };
  if (!hasLocal || forceReimport || localRev < daemonRev) {
    const syncRes = await syncBinaryIndex(sha256, {
      sinceRevision: hasLocal && !forceReimport ? localRev : 0,
      ...MCP_CALL_OPTS,
      autoStart: true,
    });
    indexSync = {
      synced: !syncRes.unchanged,
      unchanged: Boolean(syncRes.unchanged),
      revision: syncRes.revision ?? daemonRev,
      counts: syncRes.counts,
    };
  }

  let stringCount = 0;
  if (hasOfflineIndex(sha256)) {
    try {
      stringCount = getBinaryMeta(sha256).stringCount ?? 0;
    } catch {
      stringCount = 0;
    }
  }

  return {
    data: {
      binaryId: sha256,
      mode: 'live',
      cached: Boolean(openRes?.cachedProject),
      programName: summary?.programName ?? null,
      format: summary?.format ?? null,
      arch: summary?.arch ?? null,
      endianness: summary?.endianness ?? null,
      pointerSize: summary?.pointerSize ?? null,
      imageBase: summary?.imageBase ?? null,
      fileSizeBytes: summary?.fileSizeBytes ?? stat.size,
      revision: daemonRev,
      entrypoints: Array.isArray(summary?.entrypoints) ? summary.entrypoints.slice(0, 10) : [],
      sections: buildCompactSections(summary?.sections),
      functionCount: summary?.functionCount ?? 0,
      stringCount,
      importCount: summary?.importCount ?? 0,
      exportCount: summary?.exportCount ?? 0,
      warnings: Array.isArray(summary?.warnings) ? summary.warnings : [],
      indexSync,
    },
  };
}

async function handleUnloadBinary(args) {
  const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(args.binaryId);
  const stopDaemonIfEmpty = Boolean(args.stopDaemonIfEmpty);
  const health = await getHealth({ autoStart: false });

  if (!health) {
    return {
      data: {
        ok: true,
        binaryId: id,
        unloaded: false,
        alreadyUnloaded: true,
        daemonRunning: false,
        remainingLoaded: 0,
        daemonStopped: false,
      },
    };
  }

  let unloaded = false;
  let alreadyUnloaded = false;
  let revision = null;
  let remainingLoaded = null;

  try {
    const res = await unloadBinary(id, { ...MCP_CALL_OPTS, autoStart: false });
    unloaded = true;
    revision = res?.revision ?? null;
    remainingLoaded = res?.remainingLoaded ?? null;
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof DaemonError && err.code === 'BINARY_NOT_LOADED') {
      alreadyUnloaded = true;
      try {
        const listRes = await listBinaries({ ...MCP_CALL_OPTS, autoStart: false });
        remainingLoaded = Array.isArray(listRes?.binaries) ? listRes.binaries.length : 0;
      } catch {
        remainingLoaded = 0;
      }
    } else {
      throw err;
    }
  }

  let daemonStopped = false;
  if (stopDaemonIfEmpty && remainingLoaded === 0) {
    const stopRes = await stopDaemon('mcp_unload_empty');
    daemonStopped = Boolean(stopRes?.stopped);
  }

  return {
    data: {
      ok: true,
      binaryId: id,
      unloaded,
      alreadyUnloaded,
      revision,
      remainingLoaded,
      daemonStopped,
    },
  };
}

async function handleStopDaemon() {
  const res = await stopDaemon('mcp_stop_daemon');
  return {
    data: {
      ok: true,
      stopped: Boolean(res?.stopped),
      alreadyStopped: !res?.stopped,
      pid: res?.pid ?? null,
      forced: Boolean(res?.forced),
      jvmRssMb: 0,
    },
  };
}

async function handleListBinaries(args) {
  const includeOffline = args.includeOffline !== undefined ? Boolean(args.includeOffline) : true;
  const limit = clampInt(args.limit, 1, 200, 30);
  const health = await getHealth({ autoStart: false });

  let activeBinaries = [];
  if (health) {
    try {
      const listRes = await listBinaries({ ...MCP_CALL_OPTS, autoStart: false });
      const rawBins = Array.isArray(listRes?.binaries) ? listRes.binaries : [];
      activeBinaries = rawBins.map((b) => ({
        binaryId: b.binaryId,
        programName: b.programName,
        primaryPath: b.primaryPath,
        arch: b.arch,
        format: b.format,
        revision: b.revision,
        dirty: Boolean(b.dirty),
        functionCount: b.functionCount,
        lastAccessedAt: b.lastAccessedAt,
      }));
    } catch {
      activeBinaries = [];
    }
  }

  let offlineProjects = [];
  if (includeOffline) {
    offlineProjects = listOfflineProjects({ limit }).map((p) => ({
      binaryId: p.binaryId,
      basename: p.basename,
      primaryPath: p.primaryPath,
      arch: p.arch,
      format: p.format,
      revision: p.revision,
      functionCount: p.functionCount,
      stringCount: p.stringCount,
      cachedDecompileCount: p.cachedDecompileCount,
      hasIndex: p.hasIndex,
      lastOpenedAt: p.lastOpenedAt,
    }));
  }

  return {
    data: {
      daemonState: health ? (health.state || 'active') : 'stopped',
      activeBinaries,
      offlineProjects,
    },
  };
}

async function handleSearchSymbols(args) {
  const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(args.binaryId);
  const query = optionalString(args.query, '');
  const kind = ['all', 'function', 'import', 'export'].includes(args.kind) ? args.kind : 'all';
  const regex = Boolean(args.regex);
  const minSize = Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(Number(args.minSize)) ? Math.trunc(Number(args.minSize)) : 0);
  const sort = ['addr', 'name', 'size'].includes(args.sort) ? args.sort : 'addr';
  const limit = clampInt(args.limit, 1, 200, 50);
  const cursor = optionalString(args.cursor, '');
  const pageOffset = decodeAnyOffsetCursor(cursor);

  if (hasOfflineIndex(id)) {
    const res = searchFunctions(id, { query, kind, regex, minSize, sort, limit, cursor });
    return {
      data: {
        binaryId: id,
        source: 'sqlite',
        total: res.total,
        nextCursor: res.nextCursor,
        items: res.items.map((item) => ({
          addr: item.addr,
          name: item.name,
          size: item.size,
          kind: item.kind,
          callers: item.callers,
          callees: item.callees,
          externalLib: item.externalLib,
        })),
      },
      budgetOpts: { pageOffset, cursorMode: 'sqlite' },
    };
  }

  const daemonKind = kind === 'function' ? 'user' : kind;
  const res = await withLiveBinary(id, (liveId) =>
    listFunctions(liveId, { q: query, kind: daemonKind, sort, limit, cursor }, MCP_CALL_OPTS),
  );
  const items = (res.items || []).map((item) => ({
    addr: item.addr,
    name: item.name,
    size: item.sizeBytes ?? 0,
    kind: item.isImport ? 'import' : (item.isExport ? 'export' : 'function'),
    callers: null,
    callees: null,
    externalLib: item.externalLib ?? null,
  }));

  return {
    data: {
      binaryId: id,
      source: 'live',
      total: res.total,
      nextCursor: res.nextCursor ?? null,
      items,
    },
    budgetOpts: { pageOffset, cursorMode: 'daemon' },
  };
}

async function handleSearchStrings(args) {
  const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(args.binaryId);
  const query = optionalString(args.query, '');
  const minLen = Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(Number(args.minLen)) ? Math.trunc(Number(args.minLen)) : 4);
  const section = optionalString(args.section, '');
  const limit = clampInt(args.limit, 1, 200, 50);
  const cursor = optionalString(args.cursor, '');
  const pageOffset = decodeAnyOffsetCursor(cursor);

  if (!hasOfflineIndex(id)) {
    await withLiveBinary(id, async (liveId) => {
      await syncBinaryIndex(liveId, { sinceRevision: 0, ...MCP_CALL_OPTS });
    });
  }

  const res = searchStrings(id, { query, minLen, section, limit, cursor, maxPreviewLen: 160 });
  return {
    data: {
      binaryId: id,
      source: 'sqlite',
      total: res.total,
      nextCursor: res.nextCursor,
      items: res.items,
    },
    budgetOpts: { pageOffset, cursorMode: 'sqlite' },
  };
}

function formatCallsSummaryFromGraph(graph, rootHex) {
  const nodesByAddr = new Map();
  for (const n of graph?.nodes || []) {
    if (n?.addr) nodesByAddr.set(n.addr.toLowerCase(), n);
  }
  const rootLower = (rootHex || graph?.root || '').toLowerCase();
  const callersSummary = [];
  const calleesSummary = [];
  const seenCallers = new Set();
  const seenCallees = new Set();

  for (const edge of graph?.edges || []) {
    const fromLower = String(edge?.from || '').toLowerCase();
    const toLower = String(edge?.to || '').toLowerCase();
    if (toLower === rootLower && fromLower && !seenCallers.has(fromLower)) {
      seenCallers.add(fromLower);
      if (callersSummary.length < 15) {
        const node = nodesByAddr.get(fromLower);
        callersSummary.push({
          addr: node?.addr || edge.from,
          name: node?.name || edge.from,
        });
      }
    }
    if (fromLower === rootLower && toLower && !seenCallees.has(toLower)) {
      seenCallees.add(toLower);
      if (calleesSummary.length < 20) {
        const node = nodesByAddr.get(toLower);
        calleesSummary.push({
          addr: node?.addr || edge.to,
          name: node?.name || edge.to,
          isImport: Boolean(node?.isImport),
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return { callersSummary, calleesSummary };
}

function tryResolveCachedDecompileOffline(binaryId, target, currentRev) {
  const trimmed = String(target).trim();
  if (/^0x[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(trimmed) || /^[0-9a-f]{4,}$/i.test(trimmed)) {
    const direct = getCachedDecompile(binaryId, trimmed, currentRev);
    if (direct) return direct;
  }
  const searchRes = searchFunctions(binaryId, { query: trimmed, limit: 25 });
  const items = searchRes?.items || [];
  const lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();
  const exact = items.find((it) => String(it.name || '').toLowerCase() === lower);
  const chosen = exact || items[0];
  if (!chosen?.entryHex) return null;
  return getCachedDecompile(binaryId, chosen.entryHex, currentRev);
}

async function handleDecompile(args) {
  const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(args.binaryId);
  const target = requireString(args.target, 'target');
  const startLine = clampInt(args.startLine, 1, 1000000, 1);
  const maxLines = clampInt(args.maxLines, 1, 400, 200);
  const includeGutter = args.includeGutter !== undefined ? Boolean(args.includeGutter) : true;
  const includeCallsSummary = args.includeCallsSummary !== undefined ? Boolean(args.includeCallsSummary) : true;
  const refresh = Boolean(args.refresh);

  if (!refresh) {
    const health = await getHealth({ autoStart: false });
    if (!health && hasOfflineIndex(id)) {
      try {
        const metaInfo = getBinaryMeta(id);
        const currentRev = Number(metaInfo.meta?.revision ?? 0);
        const cached = tryResolveCachedDecompileOffline(id, target, currentRev);
        if (cached) {
          const plainLines = String(cached.plainC || '').split('\n');
          const totalLines = plainLines.length;
          const fromIdx = Math.max(0, startLine - 1);
          const toIdx = fromIdx >= totalLines ? fromIdx : Math.min(totalLines, fromIdx + maxLines);
          const sliced = fromIdx < toIdx ? plainLines.slice(fromIdx, toIdx) : [];
          const truncated = toIdx < totalLines;
          const endLine = sliced.length > 0 ? startLine + sliced.length - 1 : Math.max(0, startLine - 1);

          let code;
          if (includeGutter && Array.isArray(cached.tokens)) {
            const ptrSize = Number(metaInfo.meta?.pointerSize ?? 8);
            const blankAddr = ' '.repeat(2 + Math.max(8, ptrSize * 2));
            code = sliced
              .map((line, idx) => {
                const tokLine = cached.tokens[fromIdx + idx];
                const addr = tokLine?.addr || blankAddr;
                return `${addr} | ${line}`;
              })
              .join('\n');
          } else {
            code = sliced.join('\n');
          }

          let callersSummary;
          let calleesSummary;
          if (includeCallsSummary) {
            try {
              const graph = getCallGraphOffline(id, cached.entryHex, { direction: 'both', depth: 1, maxNodes: 40 });
              const summaries = formatCallsSummaryFromGraph(graph, cached.entryHex);
              callersSummary = summaries.callersSummary;
              calleesSummary = summaries.calleesSummary;
            } catch {
              callersSummary = [];
              calleesSummary = [];
            }
          }

          return {
            data: {
              binaryId: id,
              source: 'sqlite_cache',
              revision: cached.revision,
              function: {
                entry: cached.entryHex,
                name: cached.funcName,
              },
              totalLines,
              startLine,
              endLine,
              truncated,
              ...(truncated ? { nextStartLine: endLine + 1 } : {}),
              code,
              ...(includeCallsSummary ? { callersSummary, calleesSummary } : {}),
            },
          };
        }
      } catch {
        // Fall through to live daemon decompile.
      }
    }
  }

  const res = await withLiveBinary(id, (liveId) =>
    decompileFunction(
      liveId,
      target,
      { format: 'text', startLine, maxLines, includeGutter, refresh },
      MCP_CALL_OPTS,
    ),
  );

  const entryAddr = res.function?.entry || target;
  const etagMatch = typeof res._httpMeta?.etag === 'string' ? res._httpMeta.etag.match(/:r:(\d+):/) : null;
  const etagRev = etagMatch ? Number(etagMatch[1]) : 0;
  const effectiveRev = Math.max(
    Number.isFinite(Number(res.revision)) ? Number(res.revision) : 0,
    Number.isFinite(etagRev) ? etagRev : 0,
  );
  if (startLine === 1 && !res.truncated && typeof res.code === 'string' && hasOfflineIndex(id)) {
    try {
      const plainC = includeGutter
        ? res.code.split('\n').map(stripGutterPrefix).join('\n')
        : res.code;
      upsertDecompileCache(id, {
        entryHex: entryAddr,
        funcName: res.function?.name || entryAddr,
        revision: effectiveRev,
        plainC,
        tokens: null,
      });
    } catch {
      // Best-effort write-through cache.
    }
  }

  let callersSummary;
  let calleesSummary;
  if (includeCallsSummary) {
    let resolvedGraph = null;
    if (hasOfflineIndex(id)) {
      try {
        const metaInfo = getBinaryMeta(id);
        if (Number(metaInfo.meta?.revision ?? -1) === effectiveRev) {
          resolvedGraph = getCallGraphOffline(id, entryAddr, { direction: 'both', depth: 1, maxNodes: 40 });
        }
      } catch {
        resolvedGraph = null;
      }
    }
    if (!resolvedGraph) {
      try {
        resolvedGraph = await getCallGraph(
          id,
          entryAddr,
          { direction: 'both', depth: 1, maxNodes: 40 },
          { ...MCP_CALL_OPTS, autoStart: false },
        );
      } catch {
        resolvedGraph = null;
      }
    }
    const summaries = formatCallsSummaryFromGraph(resolvedGraph, entryAddr);
    callersSummary = summaries.callersSummary;
    calleesSummary = summaries.calleesSummary;
  }

  sendFocus(
    id,
    {
      address: entryAddr,
      symbolName: res.function?.name,
      viewHint: 'decompile',
    },
    { ...MCP_CALL_OPTS, autoStart: false },
  ).catch(() => {});

  return {
    data: {
      binaryId: id,
      source: res.cached ? 'daemon_cache' : 'decompiler',
      revision: res.revision,
      decompileMs: res.decompileMs,
      function: res.function,
      totalLines: res.totalLines,
      startLine: res.startLine,
      endLine: res.endLine,
      truncated: Boolean(res.truncated),
      ...(res.truncated ? { nextStartLine: res.endLine + 1 } : {}),
      code: res.code,
      ...(includeCallsSummary ? { callersSummary, calleesSummary } : {}),
    },
  };
}

async function handleDisasm(args) {
  const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(args.binaryId);
  const address = requireString(args.address, 'address');
  const count = clampInt(args.count, 1, 200, 60);
  const before = clampInt(args.before, 0, 100, 0);
  const includeBytes = Boolean(args.includeBytes);
  const after = Math.max(0, count - 1);

  const res = await withLiveBinary(id, (liveId) =>
    disassemble(liveId, { addr: address, before, after, includeBytes }, MCP_CALL_OPTS),
  );

  const lines = (res.instructions || []).map((insn) => {
    const bytesPart = includeBytes && insn.bytes ? `${insn.bytes.padEnd(24, ' ')}  ` : '';
    const opPart = insn.operands ? ` ${insn.operands}` : '';
    const comments = [insn.commentPre, insn.commentEol].filter(Boolean).join(' | ');
    const refs = Array.isArray(insn.refs) && insn.refs.length > 0
      ? insn.refs.map((r) => `${r.type}:${r.symbol || r.to}`).join(', ')
      : '';
    let suffix = '';
    if (comments || refs) {
      const parts = [];
      if (comments) parts.push(comments);
      if (refs) parts.push(`[${refs}]`);
      suffix = `  ; ${parts.join(' ')}`;
    }
    return `${insn.addr}  ${bytesPart}${insn.mnemonic}${opPart}${suffix}`;
  });

  sendFocus(
    id,
    { address: res.startAddr || address, viewHint: 'disasm' },
    { ...MCP_CALL_OPTS, autoStart: false },
  ).catch(() => {});

  return {
    data: {
      binaryId: id,
      revision: res.revision,
      startAddr: res.startAddr,
      endAddr: res.endAddr,
      functionEntry: res.functionEntry,
      hasMoreBefore: Boolean(res.hasMoreBefore),
      hasMoreAfter: Boolean(res.hasMoreAfter),
      count: lines.length,
      listing: lines.join('\n'),
    },
  };
}

async function handleXrefs(args) {
  const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(args.binaryId);
  const address = requireString(args.address, 'address');
  const direction = ['to', 'from', 'both'].includes(args.direction) ? args.direction : 'to';
  const defaultTypes = ['CALL', 'DATA_READ', 'DATA_WRITE', 'JMP'];
  const types = Array.isArray(args.types) && args.types.length > 0
    ? args.types.map((t) => String(t).trim()).filter(Boolean)
    : defaultTypes;
  const limit = clampInt(args.limit, 1, 200, 50);
  const cursor = optionalString(args.cursor, '');
  const pageOffset = decodeAnyOffsetCursor(cursor);

  const res = await withLiveBinary(id, (liveId) =>
    getXrefs(liveId, { addr: address, direction, types, limit, cursor }, MCP_CALL_OPTS),
  );

  const allRawItems = Array.isArray(res.items) ? res.items : [];
  const hasMoreDaemon = Boolean(res.nextCursor);
  const total = Number(res.total ?? pageOffset + allRawItems.length);

  const buildXrefResponseFromItems = (
    rawItemsPrefix,
    { forceTruncated = false, maxPreviewLen = null } = {},
  ) => {
    const groupMap = new Map();
    for (const item of rawItemsPrefix) {
      const key = item.fromFuncAddr || '(no_function)';
      let grp = groupMap.get(key);
      if (!grp) {
        grp = {
          functionAddr: item.fromFuncAddr ?? null,
          functionName: item.fromFuncName ?? null,
          count: 0,
          refs: [],
        };
        groupMap.set(key, grp);
      }
      grp.count++;
      let preview = item.insnPreview ?? null;
      if (preview !== null && maxPreviewLen !== null) {
        const s = String(preview);
        if (maxPreviewLen <= 0) {
          preview = null;
        } else if (s.length > maxPreviewLen) {
          preview = `${sliceStringCodePointSafe(s, maxPreviewLen)}...`;
        }
      }
      grp.refs.push({
        fromAddr: item.fromAddr,
        toAddr: item.toAddr,
        type: item.type,
        insnPreview: preview,
      });
    }

    const keptCount = rawItemsPrefix.length;
    const budgetTruncated = forceTruncated || keptCount < allRawItems.length;
    const truncated = Boolean(budgetTruncated || hasMoreDaemon);
    const hasMore = keptCount < allRawItems.length || hasMoreDaemon || pageOffset + keptCount < total;
    const nextCursor = hasMore ? encodeDaemonCursor(pageOffset + keptCount) : null;

    return {
      binaryId: id,
      revision: res.revision,
      address: res.address,
      symbol: res.symbol,
      direction: res.direction,
      total,
      truncated,
      ...(budgetTruncated ? { truncationReason: 'payload_budget_24kib' } : {}),
      nextCursor,
      groups: [...groupMap.values()],
    };
  };

  const customFit = (fits) => {
    if (allRawItems.length === 0) {
      return null;
    }

    let lo = 1;
    let hi = allRawItems.length;
    let bestCandidate = null;
    while (lo <= hi) {
      const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;
      const cand = buildXrefResponseFromItems(allRawItems.slice(0, mid), { forceTruncated: true });
      if (fits(cand)) {
        bestCandidate = cand;
        lo = mid + 1;
      } else {
        hi = mid - 1;
      }
    }
    if (bestCandidate) {
      return bestCandidate;
    }

    const prefix1 = allRawItems.slice(0, 1);
    for (const cap of [128, 48, 16, 0]) {
      const cand = buildXrefResponseFromItems(prefix1, {
        forceTruncated: true,
        maxPreviewLen: cap,
      });
      if (fits(cand)) {
        return cand;
      }
    }

    return buildXrefResponseFromItems(prefix1, {
      forceTruncated: true,
      maxPreviewLen: 0,
    });
  };

  return {
    data: buildXrefResponseFromItems(allRawItems),
    budgetOpts: { pageOffset, cursorMode: 'daemon', customFit },
  };
}

async function handleCallgraph(args) {
  const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(args.binaryId);
  const target = requireString(args.target, 'target');
  const direction = ['both', 'callers', 'callees'].includes(args.direction) ? args.direction : 'both';
  const depth = clampInt(args.depth, 1, 3, 2);
  const maxNodes = clampInt(args.maxNodes, 1, 120, 60);

  if (hasOfflineIndex(id)) {
    const res = getCallGraphOffline(id, target, { direction, depth, maxNodes });
    return {
      data: {
        ...res,
        source: 'sqlite',
      },
    };
  }

  const res = await withLiveBinary(id, (liveId) =>
    getCallGraph(liveId, target, { direction, depth, maxNodes }, MCP_CALL_OPTS),
  );
  return {
    data: {
      ...res,
      source: 'live',
    },
  };
}

async function handleCfg(args) {
  const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(args.binaryId);
  const target = requireString(args.target, 'target');
  const maxBlocks = clampInt(args.maxBlocks, 1, 150, 80);
  const includeInsns = Boolean(args.includeInsns);
  const focusAddr = optionalString(args.focusAddr, '');

  const res = await withLiveBinary(id, (liveId) =>
    getCfg(liveId, target, { maxBlocks, includeInsns, focusAddr }, MCP_CALL_OPTS),
  );

  const blocks = (res.blocks || []).map((b) => {
    const out = {
      id: b.id,
      start: b.start,
      end: b.end,
      label: b.label ?? null,
      insnCount: b.insnCount ?? 0,
      isEntry: Boolean(b.isEntry),
      isExit: Boolean(b.isExit),
    };
    if (includeInsns) {
      out.insns = b.insns ?? [];
    }
    return out;
  });

  return {
    data: {
      binaryId: id,
      revision: res.revision,
      functionEntry: res.functionEntry,
      functionName: res.functionName,
      totalBlocks: res.totalBlocks,
      truncated: Boolean(res.truncated),
      blockLimit: res.blockLimit,
      blocks,
      edges: res.edges || [],
    },
  };
}

function formatHexAsciiLines(baseAddrHex, bytesHex) {
  if (!bytesHex) return [];
  let addrNum;
  try {
    addrNum = BigInt(baseAddrHex);
  } catch {
    addrNum = 0n;
  }
  const buf = Buffer.from(bytesHex, 'hex');
  const lines = [];
  for (let off = 0; off < buf.length; off += 16) {
    const slice = buf.subarray(off, off + 16);
    const hexParts = [];
    let ascii = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
      if (i < slice.length) {
        const b = slice[i];
        hexParts.push(b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'));
        ascii += b >= 0x20 && b <= 0x7e ? String.fromCharCode(b) : '.';
      } else {
        hexParts.push('  ');
      }
    }
    const addrLabel = `0x${(addrNum + BigInt(off)).toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}`;
    lines.push(`${addrLabel}: ${hexParts.slice(0, 8).join(' ')}  ${hexParts.slice(8).join(' ')}  |${ascii}|`);
  }
  return lines;
}

async function handleInspectData(args) {
  const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(args.binaryId);
  const address = requireString(args.address, 'address');
  const length = clampInt(args.length, 1, 512, 64);
  const format = ['auto', 'hex', 'string', 'pointers'].includes(args.format) ? args.format : 'auto';
  const detectPointers = format === 'auto' || format === 'pointers';

  const res = await withLiveBinary(id, (liveId) =>
    inspectData(liveId, { addr: address, length, detectPointers }, MCP_CALL_OPTS),
  );

  const out = {
    binaryId: id,
    revision: res.revision,
    address: res.address,
    format,
    section: res.section,
    symbol: res.symbol,
    definedDataType: res.definedDataType,
    sizeBytes: res.sizeBytes,
    xrefSummary: res.xrefSummary,
  };

  if (format !== 'hex' && res.decoded) {
    out.decoded = res.decoded;
  }
  if (detectPointers && res.pointerAnalysis) {
    out.pointerAnalysis = res.pointerAnalysis;
  }
  if (format !== 'string' && res.hexDump) {
    out.hexDump = {
      baseAddr: res.hexDump.baseAddr,
      length: res.hexDump.length,
      bytesHex: res.hexDump.bytesHex,
      lines: formatHexAsciiLines(res.hexDump.baseAddr, res.hexDump.bytesHex),
    };
  }

  return { data: out };
}

async function handleSearchPseudocode(args) {
  const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(args.binaryId);
  const query = requireString(args.query, 'query');
  const limit = clampInt(args.limit, 1, 100, 25);

  if (!hasOfflineIndex(id)) {
    await withLiveBinary(id, async (liveId) => {
      await syncBinaryIndex(liveId, { sinceRevision: 0, ...MCP_CALL_OPTS });
    });
  }

  const res = searchPseudocode(id, { query, limit });
  return {
    data: {
      binaryId: id,
      source: 'sqlite',
      indexedFunctions: res.indexedFunctions,
      totalFunctions: res.totalFunctions,
      coveragePct: res.coveragePct,
      matches: res.matches,
    },
  };
}

function syncMutationEffectsToSqlite(binaryId, revision, invalidatedFuncs) {
  if (!hasOfflineIndex(binaryId)) return;
  try {
    syncMutationCacheState(binaryId, { revision, invalidatedFuncs });
  } catch {
    // Best-effort SQLite synchronization.
  }
}

async function handleRename(args) {
  const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(args.binaryId);
  const targetKind = requireString(args.targetKind, 'targetKind');
  const newName = requireString(args.newName, 'newName');
  const address = optionalString(args.address, '');
  const oldName = optionalString(args.oldName, '');
  const functionAddress = optionalString(args.functionAddress, '');
  const expectedRevision = args.expectedRevision !== undefined && args.expectedRevision !== null
    ? Number(args.expectedRevision)
    : undefined;

  const res = await withLiveBinary(id, (liveId) =>
    mutateRename(
      liveId,
      {
        targetKind,
        address: address || undefined,
        newName,
        oldName: oldName || undefined,
        functionAddress: functionAddress || undefined,
        ...(expectedRevision !== undefined ? { expectedRevision } : {}),
      },
      MCP_CALL_OPTS,
    ),
  );

  if (hasOfflineIndex(id)) {
    try {
      if (res.targetKind === 'function' && res.address) {
        patchFunctionRename(id, res.address, res.newName, null, null);
      }
      syncMutationEffectsToSqlite(id, res.revision, res.invalidatedFuncs);
    } catch {
      // Best-effort SQLite synchronization.
    }
  }

  return { data: res };
}

async function handleRetype(args) {
  const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(args.binaryId);
  const targetKind = requireString(args.targetKind, 'targetKind');
  const declaration = requireString(args.declaration, 'declaration');
  const address = optionalString(args.address, '');
  const varName = optionalString(args.varName, '');
  const functionAddress = optionalString(args.functionAddress, '');
  const expectedRevision = args.expectedRevision !== undefined && args.expectedRevision !== null
    ? Number(args.expectedRevision)
    : undefined;

  const res = await withLiveBinary(id, (liveId) =>
    mutateRetype(
      liveId,
      {
        targetKind,
        address: address || undefined,
        declaration,
        varName: varName || undefined,
        functionAddress: functionAddress || undefined,
        ...(expectedRevision !== undefined ? { expectedRevision } : {}),
      },
      MCP_CALL_OPTS,
    ),
  );

  if (hasOfflineIndex(id)) {
    try {
      if (res.targetKind === 'function_signature' && res.address) {
        patchFunctionRename(id, res.address, null, res.signature || res.appliedType, null);
      }
      syncMutationEffectsToSqlite(id, res.revision, res.invalidatedFuncs);
    } catch {
      // Best-effort SQLite synchronization.
    }
  }

  return { data: res };
}

async function handleSetComment(args) {
  const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(args.binaryId);
  const address = requireString(args.address, 'address');
  const kind = optionalString(args.kind, 'EOL') || 'EOL';
  const text = args.text !== undefined && args.text !== null ? String(args.text) : '';
  const expectedRevision = args.expectedRevision !== undefined && args.expectedRevision !== null
    ? Number(args.expectedRevision)
    : undefined;

  const res = await withLiveBinary(id, (liveId) =>
    mutateComment(
      liveId,
      {
        address,
        kind,
        text,
        ...(expectedRevision !== undefined ? { expectedRevision } : {}),
      },
      MCP_CALL_OPTS,
    ),
  );

  if (hasOfflineIndex(id)) {
    try {
      const commentKind = String(res.kind || kind).toUpperCase();
      if (res.address && commentKind === 'PLATE') {
        patchFunctionCommentFlag(id, res.address, Boolean(res.text && res.text.length > 0), null);
      }
      syncMutationEffectsToSqlite(id, res.revision, res.invalidatedFuncs);
    } catch {
      // Best-effort SQLite synchronization.
    }
  }

  return { data: res };
}

async function handleBatchAnnotate(args) {
  const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(args.binaryId);
  if (!Array.isArray(args.ops) || args.ops.length < 1 || args.ops.length > 25) {
    throw new ToolInputError("Parameter 'ops' must be an array of 1 to 25 annotation operations");
  }
  const expectedRevision = args.expectedRevision !== undefined && args.expectedRevision !== null
    ? Number(args.expectedRevision)
    : undefined;

  const res = await withLiveBinary(id, (liveId) =>
    mutateBatch(
      liveId,
      {
        ops: args.ops,
        ...(expectedRevision !== undefined ? { expectedRevision } : {}),
      },
      MCP_CALL_OPTS,
    ),
  );

  if (hasOfflineIndex(id)) {
    try {
      const results = Array.isArray(res.results) ? res.results : [];
      for (let idx = 0; idx < results.length; idx++) {
        const item = results[idx];
        if (!item || !item.address) continue;
        const origOp = args.ops[idx];
        if (item.op === 'rename' && item.targetKind === 'function' && item.newValue) {
          patchFunctionRename(id, item.address, item.newValue, null, null);
        } else if (item.op === 'retype' && item.targetKind === 'function_signature' && item.newValue) {
          patchFunctionRename(id, item.address, null, item.newValue, null);
        } else if (item.op === 'comment') {
          const cKind = String(origOp?.kind || 'EOL').toUpperCase();
          if (cKind === 'PLATE') {
            patchFunctionCommentFlag(id, item.address, Boolean(item.newValue), null);
          }
        }
      }
      syncMutationEffectsToSqlite(id, res.revision, res.invalidatedFuncs);
    } catch {
      // Best-effort SQLite synchronization.
    }
  }

  return { data: res };
}

const TOOL_BY_NAME = new Map(TOOL_CATALOG.map((t) => [t.name, t]));

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 Transport (Raw Buffer Framing, NDJSON + LSP Content-Length)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function writeFrame(obj, framing = 'ndjson') {
  const json = JSON.stringify(obj);
  if (framing === 'lsp') {
    const bodyBuf = Buffer.from(json, 'utf8');
    const headerBuf = Buffer.from(`Content-Length: ${bodyBuf.length}\r\n\r\n`, 'ascii');
    process.stdout.write(Buffer.concat([headerBuf, bodyBuf]));
  } else {
    process.stdout.write(`${json}\n`, 'utf8');
  }
}

function sendRpcResult(id, result, framing) {
  writeFrame({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id, result }, framing);
}

function sendRpcError(id, code, message, framing, data = undefined) {
  const error = { code, message };
  if (data !== undefined) error.data = data;
  writeFrame({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: id ?? null, error }, framing);
}

async function dispatchJsonRpcMessage(rawText, framing) {
  let msg;
  try {
    msg = JSON.parse(rawText);
  } catch (err) {
    sendRpcError(null, -32700, `Parse error: ${err.message}`, framing);
    return;
  }

  if (!msg || typeof msg !== 'object' || Array.isArray(msg) || msg.jsonrpc !== '2.0' || typeof msg.method !== 'string') {
    const errId = (msg && typeof msg === 'object' && !Array.isArray(msg) && (typeof msg.id === 'string' || typeof msg.id === 'number' || msg.id === null))
      ? msg.id
      : null;
    sendRpcError(errId, -32600, 'Invalid Request', framing);
    return;
  }

  const hasId = Object.hasOwn(msg, 'id') && msg.id !== undefined;
  const id = msg.id;
  if (hasId && id !== null && typeof id !== 'string' && typeof id !== 'number') {
    sendRpcError(null, -32600, 'Invalid Request: invalid id type', framing);
    return;
  }

  // Notifications (any message without id) never produce a response.
  if (!hasId) {
    return;
  }

  const method = msg.method;
  const params = msg.params;

  if (method === 'initialize') {
    const reqVersion = params && typeof params === 'object' ? params.protocolVersion : undefined;
    const protocolVersion = SUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_VERSIONS.includes(reqVersion) ? reqVersion : '2024-11-05';
    sendRpcResult(
      id,
      {
        protocolVersion,
        capabilities: {
          tools: { listChanged: false },
        },
        serverInfo: {
          name: SERVER_NAME,
          version: SERVER_VERSION,
        },
        instructions:
          'Headless Ghidra RE workbench. Call ghidra_status or ghidra_list_binaries first. Prefer offline-first SQLite tools (ghidra_search_symbols, ghidra_search_strings, ghidra_callgraph, ghidra_search_pseudocode) before live decompilation, and prefer ghidra_batch_annotate for multiple annotations.',
      },
      framing,
    );
    return;
  }

  if (method === 'ping') {
    sendRpcResult(id, {}, framing);
    return;
  }

  if (method === 'tools/list') {
    sendRpcResult(
      id,
      {
        tools: TOOL_CATALOG.map(({ name, description, inputSchema }) => ({
          name,
          description,
          inputSchema,
        })),
      },
      framing,
    );
    return;
  }

  if (method === 'tools/call') {
    if (!params || typeof params !== 'object' || Array.isArray(params) || typeof params.name !== 'string') {
      sendRpcError(id, -32602, 'Invalid params: expected { name, arguments? }', framing);
      return;
    }
    const tool = TOOL_BY_NAME.get(params.name);
    if (!tool) {
      sendRpcError(id, -32602, `Unknown tool: ${params.name}`, framing);
      return;
    }
    const toolArgs = params.arguments === undefined ? {} : params.arguments;
    if (!toolArgs || typeof toolArgs !== 'object' || Array.isArray(toolArgs)) {
      sendRpcError(id, -32602, 'Invalid params: tool arguments must be an object', framing);
      return;
    }

    try {
      const outcome = await tool.handler(toolArgs);
      const text = fitWithinBudget(outcome.data, {
        isError: false,
        id,
        ...(outcome.budgetOpts || {}),
      });
      sendRpcResult(id, { content: [{ type: 'text', text }], isError: false }, framing);
    } catch (err) {
      const errPayload = formatErrorPayload(err);
      const text = fitWithinBudget(errPayload, { isError: true, id });
      sendRpcResult(id, { content: [{ type: 'text', text }], isError: true }, framing);
    }
    return;
  }

  sendRpcError(id, -32601, `Method not found: ${method}`, framing);
}

function skipLeadingLineBreaksAndSpaces(buf) {
  let idx = 0;
  while (idx < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[idx];
    if (b === 0x0d || b === 0x0a || b === 0x20 || b === 0x09) {
      idx++;
    } else {
      break;
    }
  }
  return idx === 0 ? buf : buf.subarray(idx);
}

function findHeaderTerminator(buf) {
  const crlfIdx = buf.indexOf('\r\n\r\n');
  const lfIdx = buf.indexOf('\n\n');
  if (crlfIdx === -1 && lfIdx === -1) return null;
  if (crlfIdx !== -1 && (lfIdx === -1 || crlfIdx < lfIdx)) {
    return { index: crlfIdx, sepLen: 4 };
  }
  return { index: lfIdx, sepLen: 2 };
}

function startsLikeLspHeaders(buf) {
  const nlIdx = buf.indexOf(0x0a);
  if (nlIdx === -1) {
    // Partial first line: if it doesn't start with JSON '{' or '[', wait unless buffer is huge without headers
    const head = buf.subarray(0, Math.min(buf.length, 64)).toString('ascii');
    if (/^[A-Za-z0-9-]+(?::.*)?$/i.test(head.replace(/\r$/, ''))) {
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  const firstLine = buf.subarray(0, nlIdx).toString('ascii').replace(/\r$/, '');
  return /^[A-Za-z0-9-]+:\s*/.test(firstLine);
}

function startTransport() {
  let rxBuf = Buffer.alloc(0);
  let stdinClosed = false;
  let pendingRequests = 0;
  let shuttingDown = false;

  const maybeExitAfterStdinClose = () => {
    if (shuttingDown) return;
    if (stdinClosed && pendingRequests === 0) {
      shuttingDown = true;
      try {
        closeAllIndexes();
      } catch (err) {
        process.stderr.write(`[ghidra-re-mcp] Failed closing indexes: ${err.message}\n`);
      }
      process.exit(0);
    }
  };

  const enqueueDispatch = (rawText, framing) => {
    pendingRequests++;
    Promise.resolve()
      .then(() => dispatchJsonRpcMessage(rawText, framing))
      .catch((err) => {
        process.stderr.write(`[ghidra-re-mcp] Unhandled dispatch error: ${err?.stack || err}\n`);
      })
      .finally(() => {
        pendingRequests--;
        maybeExitAfterStdinClose();
      });
  };

  const drainFrames = (flushFinal = false) => {
    while (rxBuf.length > 0) {
      rxBuf = skipLeadingLineBreaksAndSpaces(rxBuf);
      if (rxBuf.length === 0) break;

      const firstByte = rxBuf[0];
      if (firstByte !== 0x7b && firstByte !== 0x5b && startsLikeLspHeaders(rxBuf)) {
        const term = findHeaderTerminator(rxBuf);
        if (!term) {
          if (flushFinal) {
            const leftover = rxBuf.toString('utf8').trim();
            rxBuf = Buffer.alloc(0);
            if (leftover) enqueueDispatch(leftover, 'ndjson');
          }
          break;
        }

        const headerText = rxBuf.subarray(0, term.index).toString('ascii');
        const bodyStart = term.index + term.sepLen;
        const clMatch = headerText.match(/(?:^|\r?\n)content-length:\s*(\d+)\s*(?:\r?\n|$)/i);
        if (!clMatch) {
          rxBuf = rxBuf.subarray(bodyStart);
          sendRpcError(null, -32600, 'Missing Content-Length header', 'lsp');
          continue;
        }
        const contentLength = Number.parseInt(clMatch[1], 10);
        if (!Number.isFinite(contentLength) || contentLength < 0 || contentLength > MAX_LSP_BODY_BYTES) {
          rxBuf = rxBuf.subarray(bodyStart);
          sendRpcError(null, -32600, `Invalid Content-Length: ${clMatch[1]}`, 'lsp');
          continue;
        }
        if (rxBuf.length < bodyStart + contentLength) {
          if (flushFinal) {
            rxBuf = Buffer.alloc(0);
            sendRpcError(null, -32700, 'Truncated LSP frame body at EOF', 'lsp');
          }
          break;
        }

        const bodyBuf = rxBuf.subarray(bodyStart, bodyStart + contentLength);
        rxBuf = rxBuf.subarray(bodyStart + contentLength);
        const bodyText = bodyBuf.toString('utf8');
        enqueueDispatch(bodyText, 'lsp');
        continue;
      }

      const nlIdx = rxBuf.indexOf(0x0a);
      if (nlIdx === -1) {
        if (flushFinal) {
          const lineText = rxBuf.toString('utf8').trim();
          rxBuf = Buffer.alloc(0);
          if (lineText) {
            enqueueDispatch(lineText, 'ndjson');
          }
        }
        break;
      }

      const lineBuf = rxBuf.subarray(0, nlIdx);
      rxBuf = rxBuf.subarray(nlIdx + 1);
      const lineText = lineBuf.toString('utf8').trim();
      if (lineText.length > 0) {
        enqueueDispatch(lineText, 'ndjson');
      }
    }
  };

  process.stdin.on('data', (chunk) => {
    const buf = Buffer.isBuffer(chunk) ? chunk : Buffer.from(chunk);
    if (buf.length === 0) return;
    rxBuf = rxBuf.length === 0 ? buf : Buffer.concat([rxBuf, buf]);
    drainFrames(false);
  });

  const onStdinEnd = () => {
    if (stdinClosed) return;
    stdinClosed = true;
    drainFrames(true);
    maybeExitAfterStdinClose();
  };

  process.stdin.on('end', onStdinEnd);
  process.stdin.on('close', onStdinEnd);
  process.stdin.resume();

  const onSignal = () => {
    if (shuttingDown) return;
    shuttingDown = true;
    try {
      closeAllIndexes();
    } catch {
      // Ignore cleanup errors on exit.
    }
    process.exit(0);
  };

  process.on('SIGINT', onSignal);
  process.on('SIGTERM', onSignal);
}

startTransport();
```

```mjs
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import { ensureDir, getConfigPath, getDataDir } from './paths.mjs';

export const DEFAULT_CONFIG = Object.freeze({
  tier: 'balanced',
  customRamMb: 3072,
  idleTimeoutMin: 20,
  ghidraInstallDir: null,
  javaHome: null,
});

export const TIER_PRESETS = Object.freeze({
  eco: Object.freeze({
    tier: 'eco',
    ramLimitMb: 1536,
    xmsMb: 256,
    xmxMb: 768,
    workers: 1,
    workerRecycleRssMb: 300,
    decompileLru: 128,
    cfgLru: 32,
    sqliteCacheMax: 1000,
    prefetchMode: 'off',
    prefetchMax: 0,
    callTreeMaxDepth: 3,
    cfgMaxBlocks: 150,
    decompileTimeoutSec: 15,
    maxPayloadMb: 32,
    maxLoadedBinaries: 1,
    batchFtsEnabled: false,
    idleTimeoutMin: 10,
  }),
  balanced: Object.freeze({
    tier: 'balanced',
    ramLimitMb: 3072,
    xmsMb: 512,
    xmxMb: 1536,
    workers: 2,
    workerRecycleRssMb: 450,
    decompileLru: 512,
    cfgLru: 128,
    sqliteCacheMax: 5000,
    prefetchMode: '1-hop',
    prefetchMax: 8,
    callTreeMaxDepth: 5,
    cfgMaxBlocks: 350,
    decompileTimeoutSec: 30,
    maxPayloadMb: 50,
    maxLoadedBinaries: 1,
    batchFtsEnabled: false,
    idleTimeoutMin: 20,
  }),
  power: Object.freeze({
    tier: 'power',
    ramLimitMb: 6144,
    xmsMb: 1024,
    xmxMb: 3200,
    workers: 4,
    workerRecycleRssMb: 600,
    decompileLru: 2048,
    cfgLru: 512,
    sqliteCacheMax: 25000,
    prefetchMode: '2-hop',
    prefetchMax: 24,
    callTreeMaxDepth: 8,
    cfgMaxBlocks: 800,
    decompileTimeoutSec: 60,
    maxPayloadMb: 100,
    maxLoadedBinaries: 3,
    batchFtsEnabled: true,
    idleTimeoutMin: 45,
  }),
});

function clamp(value, min, max) {
  return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
}

export function normalizeIdleTimeoutMin(val, fallback = 20) {
  if (val === undefined || val === null || val === '') {
    return fallback;
  }
  const num = Number(val);
  if (!Number.isFinite(num) || num < 0) {
    return fallback;
  }
  if (num === 0) {
    return 0;
  }
  return clamp(Math.round(num), 5, 120);
}

export function readHostMemoryInfo() {
  let memTotalMb = 0;
  let memAvailableMb = 0;
  let memFreeMb = 0;
  let swapTotalMb = 0;
  let swapFreeMb = 0;

  try {
    const content = fs.readFileSync('/proc/meminfo', 'utf8');
    for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
      const m = line.match(/^([A-Za-z0-9_]+):\s+(\d+)\s+kB/);
      if (!m) continue;
      const mb = Math.floor(Number.parseInt(m[2], 10) / 1024);
      switch (m[1]) {
        case 'MemTotal':
          memTotalMb = mb;
          break;
        case 'MemAvailable':
          memAvailableMb = mb;
          break;
        case 'MemFree':
          memFreeMb = mb;
          break;
        case 'SwapTotal':
          swapTotalMb = mb;
          break;
        case 'SwapFree':
          swapFreeMb = mb;
          break;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    const totalMb = Math.floor(os.totalmem() / (1024 * 1024));
    const freeMb = Math.floor(os.freemem() / (1024 * 1024));
    memTotalMb = totalMb;
    memAvailableMb = freeMb;
  }

  if (memAvailableMb === 0 && memFreeMb > 0) {
    memAvailableMb = memFreeMb;
  }

  return {
    memTotalMb,
    memAvailableMb,
    swapTotalMb,
    swapFreeMb,
    cpuThreads: Math.max(1, os.cpus().length),
  };
}

export function resolveTierSpec(tier = 'balanced', customRamMb = 3072, hostMem = readHostMemoryInfo()) {
  const mem = hostMem || readHostMemoryInfo();
  const normalizedTier = Object.hasOwn(TIER_PRESETS, tier) || tier === 'custom' ? tier : 'balanced';

  let spec;
  if (normalizedTier !== 'custom') {
    spec = { ...TIER_PRESETS[normalizedTier] };
  } else {
    const hostTotalMb = Number.isFinite(mem.memTotalMb) && mem.memTotalMb > 0 ? mem.memTotalMb : 16384;
    const maxHostAllowed = Math.max(1536, Math.min(10240, Math.floor(hostTotalMb * 0.70)));
    const requestedRam = Number.isFinite(Number(customRamMb)) ? Number(customRamMb) : 3072;
    const R = clamp(Math.round(requestedRam), 1536, maxHostAllowed);

    const cpuThreads = Number.isFinite(mem.cpuThreads) && mem.cpuThreads > 0 ? mem.cpuThreads : os.cpus().length;
    const maxWorkersByCpu = Math.min(6, Math.max(1, Math.floor(cpuThreads / 4)));
    const workers = clamp(Math.floor((R - 800) / 1200), 1, maxWorkersByCpu);

    const workerAvgMb = 240;
    const xmxMb = Math.max(768, Math.floor((R - 260 - workers * workerAvgMb) * 0.92));
    const xmsMb = Math.max(256, Math.min(xmxMb, Math.floor(xmxMb / 3)));
    const workerRecycleRssMb = clamp(Math.floor(R * 0.14), 300, 650);

    const decompileLru = Math.floor(xmxMb / 1.5);
    const cfgLru = Math.floor(xmxMb / 6);
    const sqliteCacheMax = clamp(R * 4, 1000, 50000);

    let prefetchMode = 'off';
    let prefetchMax = 0;
    if (R >= 4608) {
      prefetchMode = '2-hop';
      prefetchMax = 24;
    } else if (R >= 2560) {
      prefetchMode = '1-hop';
      prefetchMax = 8;
    }

    const callTreeMaxDepth = clamp(Math.floor(R / 750), 3, 10);
    const cfgMaxBlocks = clamp(Math.floor(R / 8), 150, 1200);
    const decompileTimeoutSec = clamp(Math.floor(R / 100), 15, 90);
    const maxPayloadMb = R < 2560 ? 32 : (R < 4608 ? 50 : 100);
    const maxLoadedBinaries = R >= 4608 ? Math.min(4, 1 + Math.floor((R - 3072) / 1536)) : 1;
    const batchFtsEnabled = R >= 5120;

    spec = {
      tier: 'custom',
      ramLimitMb: R,
      xmsMb,
      xmxMb,
      workers,
      workerRecycleRssMb,
      decompileLru,
      cfgLru,
      sqliteCacheMax,
      prefetchMode,
      prefetchMax,
      callTreeMaxDepth,
      cfgMaxBlocks,
      decompileTimeoutSec,
      maxPayloadMb,
      maxLoadedBinaries,
      batchFtsEnabled,
      idleTimeoutMin: normalizeIdleTimeoutMin(20, 20),
    };
  }

  const memAvailableMb = Number.isFinite(mem.memAvailableMb) ? mem.memAvailableMb : 0;
  const lowMemoryWarning = memAvailableMb > 0 && spec.ramLimitMb > memAvailableMb * 0.85;
  const availGb = (memAvailableMb / 1024).toFixed(1);

  return {
    ...spec,
    memAvailableMb,
    memTotalMb: mem.memTotalMb ?? 0,
    lowMemoryWarning,
    lowMemoryMessage: lowMemoryWarning
      ? `Only ${availGb} GB currently available; consider Eco 1.5 GB or Balanced 3 GB to avoid swap pressure.`
      : null,
  };
}

export function loadConfig() {
  const configPath = getConfigPath();
  try {
    const raw = fs.readFileSync(configPath, 'utf8');
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object' || Array.isArray(parsed)) {
      return { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG };
    }
    const merged = { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG, ...parsed };
    if (merged.ghidraDir && !merged.ghidraInstallDir) {
      merged.ghidraInstallDir = merged.ghidraDir;
    }
    delete merged.ghidraDir;
    const defaultIdle = TIER_PRESETS[merged.tier]?.idleTimeoutMin ?? DEFAULT_CONFIG.idleTimeoutMin;
    merged.idleTimeoutMin = normalizeIdleTimeoutMin(merged.idleTimeoutMin, defaultIdle);
    return merged;
  } catch {
    return { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG };
  }
}

export function saveConfig(patch = {}) {
  const current = loadConfig();
  const next = { ...current, ...(patch && typeof patch === 'object' ? patch : {}) };
  if (next.ghidraDir && !next.ghidraInstallDir) {
    next.ghidraInstallDir = next.ghidraDir;
  }
  delete next.ghidraDir;
  const defaultIdle = TIER_PRESETS[next.tier]?.idleTimeoutMin ?? DEFAULT_CONFIG.idleTimeoutMin;
  next.idleTimeoutMin = normalizeIdleTimeoutMin(next.idleTimeoutMin, defaultIdle);

  ensureDir(getDataDir(), 0o700);
  const configPath = getConfigPath();
  const tmpPath = `${configPath}.tmp.${process.pid}.${Date.now()}`;
  try {
    const fd = fs.openSync(tmpPath, 'w', 0o600);
    try {
      fs.writeFileSync(fd, `${JSON.stringify(next, null, 2)}\n`, 'utf8');
      fs.fsyncSync(fd);
    } finally {
      fs.closeSync(fd);
    }
    fs.renameSync(tmpPath, configPath);
  } catch (err) {
    try {
      fs.unlinkSync(tmpPath);
    } catch {
      // ignore cleanup error
    }
    throw err;
  }
  return next;
}
```
