`shared/daemon-builder.mjs`:

```mjs
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { basename, dirname, join, relative, sep } from 'node:path';
import { DAEMON_SRC_DIR, ensureDir, getCacheDir, isPidAlive } from './paths.mjs';

function walkFiles(dir, filterFn, results = []) {
  let entries;
  try {
    entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
  } catch {
    return results;
  }
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const fullPath = join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      walkFiles(fullPath, filterFn, results);
    } else if (entry.isFile() && filterFn(fullPath, entry.name)) {
      results.push(fullPath);
    }
  }
  return results;
}

function toPosixRel(baseDir, filePath) {
  return relative(baseDir, filePath).split(sep).join('/');
}

function sleepSync(ms) {
  const sab = new SharedArrayBuffer(4);
  const ia = new Int32Array(sab);
  Atomics.wait(ia, 0, 0, ms);
}

function makeBuildError(message, details = {}) {
  const err = new Error(message);
  err.code = 'DAEMON_BUILD_FAILED';
  err.details = details;
  return err;
}

const BUILD_LOCK_STALE_MS = 150000;

function acquireBuildLock(lockPath, bootJarPath, jarPath, forceRebuild, timeoutMs = BUILD_LOCK_STALE_MS) {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (true) {
    try {
      const fd = fs.openSync(lockPath, 'wx', 0o600);
      try {
        fs.writeFileSync(fd, JSON.stringify({ pid: process.pid, startedAt: Date.now() }) + '\n', 'utf8');
      } finally {
        fs.closeSync(fd);
      }
      return { acquired: true };
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.code !== 'EEXIST') throw err;

      if (!forceRebuild && fs.existsSync(bootJarPath) && fs.existsSync(jarPath)) {
        return { acquired: false, cacheHit: true };
      }

      let stale = false;
      try {
        const stat = fs.statSync(lockPath);
        let lockPid = null;
        let startedAt = stat.mtimeMs;
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(lockPath, 'utf8'));
          if (parsed && Number.isInteger(parsed.pid)) lockPid = parsed.pid;
          if (parsed && Number.isFinite(parsed.startedAt)) startedAt = parsed.startedAt;
        } catch {
          // Corrupt or partially written lock file; fall back to mtime age check.
        }
        if (lockPid !== null && !isPidAlive(lockPid)) {
          stale = true;
        } else if (Date.now() - startedAt > BUILD_LOCK_STALE_MS) {
          stale = true;
        }
      } catch (statErr) {
        if (statErr.code === 'ENOENT') continue;
      }

      if (stale) {
        try {
          fs.unlinkSync(lockPath);
        } catch {
          // Another waiter may have already removed it.
        }
        continue;
      }

      if (Date.now() >= deadline) {
        throw makeBuildError(`Timed out waiting for daemon build lock: ${lockPath}`);
      }
      sleepSync(100);
    }
  }
}

function discoverGhidraJars(ghidraDir) {
  const ghidraSubdir = join(ghidraDir, 'Ghidra');
  const jars = walkFiles(ghidraSubdir, (fullPath, name) => {
    return name.endsWith('.jar') && basename(dirname(fullPath)) === 'lib';
  });
  jars.sort((a, b) => (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0));
  return jars;
}

function quoteArgfileEntry(arg) {
  const escaped = arg.replace(/\\/g, '\\\\').replace(/"/g, '\\"');
  return `"${escaped}"`;
}

function copyTreeFiltered(srcRoot, dstRoot, predicate) {
  const files = walkFiles(srcRoot, () => true);
  let count = 0;
  for (const file of files) {
    const rel = toPosixRel(srcRoot, file);
    if (!predicate(rel)) continue;
    const target = join(dstRoot, rel);
    fs.mkdirSync(dirname(target), { recursive: true });
    fs.copyFileSync(file, target);
    count++;
  }
  return count;
}

function pruneOldBuildDirs(buildRoot, currentCacheKey, keepCount = 2) {
  let entries;
  try {
    entries = fs.readdirSync(buildRoot, { withFileTypes: true });
  } catch {
    return;
  }

  const dirs = [];
  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (!entry.isDirectory()) continue;
    if (!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(entry.name)) continue;
    if (entry.name === currentCacheKey) continue;
    try {
      const stat = fs.statSync(join(buildRoot, entry.name));
      dirs.push({ name: entry.name, mtimeMs: stat.mtimeMs });
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }

  dirs.sort((a, b) => b.mtimeMs - a.mtimeMs);
  const maxOthers = Math.max(0, keepCount - 1);
  for (const oldDir of dirs.slice(maxOthers)) {
    try {
      fs.rmSync(join(buildRoot, oldDir.name), { recursive: true, force: true });
    } catch {
      // ignore cleanup failures
    }
  }
}

export function ensureDaemonJar(env, { forceRebuild = false } = {}) {
  if (!env || !env.ok) {
    throw makeBuildError(env?.message || 'Invalid Ghidra/JDK environment', { env });
  }

  const javaFiles = walkFiles(DAEMON_SRC_DIR, (_full, name) => name.endsWith('.java'));
  if (javaFiles.length === 0) {
    throw makeBuildError(`No Java source files found in ${DAEMON_SRC_DIR}`);
  }

  const sources = javaFiles
    .map((absPath) => ({
      absPath,
      relPath: toPosixRel(DAEMON_SRC_DIR, absPath),
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => (a.relPath < b.relPath ? -1 : a.relPath > b.relPath ? 1 : 0));

  const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256');
  hash.update(String(env.ghidraVersion));
  hash.update('\0');
  hash.update(String(env.jdkVersion));
  hash.update('\0');
  for (const src of sources) {
    const content = fs.readFileSync(src.absPath);
    hash.update(src.relPath);
    hash.update('\0');
    hash.update(content);
    hash.update('\0');
  }
  const cacheKey = hash.digest('hex');

  const cacheDir = getCacheDir();
  const buildRoot = join(cacheDir, 'build');
  const buildDir = join(buildRoot, cacheKey);
  const bootJarPath = join(buildDir, 'daemon-boot.jar');
  const jarPath = join(buildDir, 'daemon.jar');

  if (!forceRebuild && fs.existsSync(bootJarPath) && fs.existsSync(jarPath)) {
    return { ok: true, cacheKey, buildDir, bootJarPath, jarPath, cached: true };
  }

  ensureDir(cacheDir, 0o700);
  ensureDir(buildRoot, 0o700);

  const lockPath = join(buildRoot, `${cacheKey}.lock`);
  const lockState = acquireBuildLock(lockPath, bootJarPath, jarPath, forceRebuild);
  if (lockState.cacheHit) {
    return { ok: true, cacheKey, buildDir, bootJarPath, jarPath, cached: true };
  }

  const tmpRoot = join(buildRoot, `.tmp-${cacheKey}-${process.pid}-${Date.now()}`);
  try {
    if (!forceRebuild && fs.existsSync(bootJarPath) && fs.existsSync(jarPath)) {
      return { ok: true, cacheKey, buildDir, bootJarPath, jarPath, cached: true };
    }

    const classesDir = join(tmpRoot, 'classes');
    const bootStage = join(tmpRoot, 'boot');
    const appStage = join(tmpRoot, 'app');
    const outTmpDir = join(tmpRoot, 'out');
    fs.mkdirSync(classesDir, { recursive: true });
    fs.mkdirSync(bootStage, { recursive: true });
    fs.mkdirSync(appStage, { recursive: true });
    fs.mkdirSync(outTmpDir, { recursive: true });

    const jars = discoverGhidraJars(env.ghidraDir);
    if (jars.length === 0) {
      throw makeBuildError(`No Ghidra library JARs discovered under ${join(env.ghidraDir, 'Ghidra')}`);
    }

    const argfilePath = join(tmpRoot, 'javac.args');
    const argLines = [
      '-cp',
      quoteArgfileEntry(jars.join(':')),
      ...sources.map((s) => quoteArgfileEntry(s.absPath)),
    ];
    fs.writeFileSync(argfilePath, `${argLines.join('\n')}\n`, 'utf8');

    const compileRes = spawnSync(
      env.javacBin,
      ['--release', '25', '-encoding', 'UTF-8', '-d', classesDir, `@${argfilePath}`],
      { encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 120000, maxBuffer: 10 * 1024 * 1024 },
    );

    if (compileRes.error || compileRes.status !== 0) {
      const stderr = compileRes.stderr || compileRes.error?.message || '';
      const stdout = compileRes.stdout || '';
      throw makeBuildError(
        `Daemon Java compilation failed (exit ${compileRes.status ?? 'error'}):\n${stderr || stdout}`.trim(),
        { exitCode: compileRes.status, stderr, stdout },
      );
    }

    const isBootClass = (rel) =>
      rel === 'com/antigravity/ghidrare/DaemonMain.class' ||
      rel.startsWith('com/antigravity/ghidrare/DaemonMain$');

    const bootCount = copyTreeFiltered(classesDir, bootStage, isBootClass);
    if (bootCount === 0) {
      throw makeBuildError('Compiled classes did not produce com/antigravity/ghidrare/DaemonMain.class');
    }
    const appCount = copyTreeFiltered(classesDir, appStage, (rel) => !isBootClass(rel));
    if (appCount === 0) {
      throw makeBuildError('Compiled classes did not produce any daemon runtime classes besides DaemonMain');
    }

    const tmpBootJar = join(outTmpDir, 'daemon-boot.jar');
    const tmpAppJar = join(outTmpDir, 'daemon.jar');

    const bootJarRes = spawnSync(env.jarBin, ['cf', tmpBootJar, '-C', bootStage, '.'], {
      encoding: 'utf8',
      timeout: 30000,
    });
    if (bootJarRes.error || bootJarRes.status !== 0) {
      throw makeBuildError(`Failed to package daemon-boot.jar: ${bootJarRes.stderr || bootJarRes.error?.message}`, {
        stderr: bootJarRes.stderr,
        stdout: bootJarRes.stdout,
      });
    }

    const appJarRes = spawnSync(env.jarBin, ['cf', tmpAppJar, '-C', appStage, '.'], {
      encoding: 'utf8',
      timeout: 30000,
    });
    if (appJarRes.error || appJarRes.status !== 0) {
      throw makeBuildError(`Failed to package daemon.jar: ${appJarRes.stderr || appJarRes.error?.message}`, {
        stderr: appJarRes.stderr,
        stdout: appJarRes.stdout,
      });
    }

    if (fs.existsSync(buildDir)) {
      const staleDir = join(buildRoot, `.stale-${cacheKey}-${process.pid}-${Date.now()}`);
      fs.renameSync(buildDir, staleDir);
      fs.rmSync(staleDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
    }
    fs.renameSync(outTmpDir, buildDir);
    pruneOldBuildDirs(buildRoot, cacheKey, 2);

    return { ok: true, cacheKey, buildDir, bootJarPath, jarPath, cached: false };
  } finally {
    try {
      fs.rmSync(tmpRoot, { recursive: true, force: true });
    } catch {
      // ignore temp cleanup errors
    }
    try {
      fs.unlinkSync(lockPath);
    } catch {
      // ignore lock cleanup errors
    }
  }
}
```

`shared/daemon-client.mjs`:

```mjs
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import http from 'node:http';
import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { loadConfig, normalizeIdleTimeoutMin, resolveTierSpec } from './config.mjs';
import { ensureDaemonJar } from './daemon-builder.mjs';
import { syncFromNdjson } from './index-store.mjs';
import {
  computeFileSha256,
  discoverEnvironment,
  ensureDir,
  getCacheDir,
  getDaemonJsonPath,
  getDaemonLockPath,
  getDaemonLogPath,
  getDataDir,
  getProjectsDir,
  isPidAlive,
  parseLaunchProperties,
  readProcCmdline,
} from './paths.mjs';

const DAEMON_MAIN_CLASS = 'com.antigravity.ghidrare.DaemonMain';
const LOG_ROTATE_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
const STALE_LOCK_MS = 35000;

export class DaemonError extends Error {
  constructor(message, { code = 'DAEMON_ERROR', status = 500, retryable = false, details = null, cause = undefined } = {}) {
    super(message, cause !== undefined ? { cause } : undefined);
    this.name = 'DaemonError';
    this.code = code;
    this.status = status;
    this.retryable = Boolean(retryable);
    this.details = details ?? null;
  }
}

function sleep(ms) {
  return new Promise((resolvePromise) => setTimeout(resolvePromise, ms));
}

function safeUnlink(filePath) {
  try {
    fs.unlinkSync(filePath);
  } catch {
    // ignore missing or unremovable file
  }
}

function readLogTail(logPath, maxBytes = 4096) {
  try {
    const stat = fs.statSync(logPath);
    const size = stat.size;
    if (size === 0) return '';
    const start = Math.max(0, size - maxBytes);
    const length = size - start;
    const fd = fs.openSync(logPath, 'r');
    try {
      const buf = Buffer.alloc(length);
      fs.readSync(fd, buf, 0, length, start);
      return buf.toString('utf8').trim();
    } finally {
      fs.closeSync(fd);
    }
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
}

function parseRawDiscovery() {
  const daemonJsonPath = getDaemonJsonPath();
  try {
    const raw = fs.readFileSync(daemonJsonPath, 'utf8');
    const disc = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (
      !disc ||
      typeof disc !== 'object' ||
      !Number.isInteger(disc.pid) ||
      disc.pid <= 0 ||
      !Number.isInteger(disc.port) ||
      disc.port <= 0 ||
      typeof disc.token !== 'string' ||
      disc.token.length === 0
    ) {
      return null;
    }
    return disc;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function readDaemonDiscovery() {
  const disc = parseRawDiscovery();
  if (!disc) return null;
  if (!isPidAlive(disc.pid)) return null;
  const cmdline = readProcCmdline(disc.pid);
  if (!cmdline || !cmdline.includes(DAEMON_MAIN_CLASS)) return null;
  return disc;
}

export function probeHealth(disc, timeoutMs = 1500) {
  if (!disc || !disc.port || !disc.token) {
    return Promise.resolve(null);
  }

  return new Promise((resolvePromise) => {
    let settled = false;
    const finish = (val) => {
      if (!settled) {
        settled = true;
        resolvePromise(val);
      }
    };

    const req = http.request(
      {
        hostname: '127.0.0.1',
        port: disc.port,
        path: '/v1/health',
        method: 'GET',
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${disc.token}`,
          'X-RE-Priority': 'mcp',
          Accept: 'application/json',
        },
      },
      (res) => {
        const chunks = [];
        res.on('data', (chunk) => chunks.push(chunk));
        res.on('end', () => {
          if (res.statusCode !== 200) {
            finish(null);
            return;
          }
          try {
            const text = Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8');
            finish(JSON.parse(text));
          } catch {
            finish(null);
          }
        });
        res.on('error', () => finish(null));
      },
    );

    req.setTimeout(timeoutMs, () => {
      req.destroy();
      finish(null);
    });
    req.on('error', () => finish(null));
    req.end();
  });
}

function rotateDaemonLog(logPath) {
  try {
    const stat = fs.statSync(logPath);
    if (stat.size >= LOG_ROTATE_BYTES) {
      fs.renameSync(logPath, `${logPath}.1`);
    }
  } catch {
    // Log file does not exist yet.
  }
}

async function acquireDaemonLock(lockPath, allowExisting, deadlineMs) {
  while (true) {
    try {
      const fd = fs.openSync(lockPath, 'wx', 0o600);
      try {
        fs.writeFileSync(fd, JSON.stringify({ pid: process.pid, startedAt: Date.now() }) + '\n', 'utf8');
      } finally {
        fs.closeSync(fd);
      }
      return { acquired: true };
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.code !== 'EEXIST') {
        throw new DaemonError(`Failed to create daemon lockfile: ${err.message}`, {
          code: 'DAEMON_LOCK_ERROR',
          status: 500,
          cause: err,
        });
      }

      let stale = false;
      try {
        const stat = fs.statSync(lockPath);
        let lockPid = null;
        let startedAt = stat.mtimeMs;
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(lockPath, 'utf8'));
          if (parsed && Number.isInteger(parsed.pid)) lockPid = parsed.pid;
          if (parsed && Number.isFinite(parsed.startedAt)) startedAt = parsed.startedAt;
        } catch {
          // Ignore partial lockfile JSON; fall back to mtime check.
        }
        if (lockPid !== null && !isPidAlive(lockPid)) {
          stale = true;
        } else if (Date.now() - startedAt > STALE_LOCK_MS) {
          stale = true;
        }
      } catch (statErr) {
        if (statErr.code === 'ENOENT') continue;
      }

      if (stale) {
        safeUnlink(lockPath);
        continue;
      }

      if (allowExisting) {
        const disc = readDaemonDiscovery();
        if (disc) {
          const health = await probeHealth(disc, 1000);
          if (health) {
            return { acquired: false, discovery: disc, health };
          }
        }
      }

      if (Date.now() >= deadlineMs) {
        throw new DaemonError('Timed out waiting for another process to start the Ghidra daemon', {
          code: 'DAEMON_STARTING',
          status: 503,
          retryable: true,
        });
      }
      await sleep(150);
    }
  }
}

function hasConfigMismatch(health, effectiveConfig, spec, desiredIdleTimeoutMin, configOverride) {
  if (!configOverride || typeof configOverride !== 'object') return false;
  const checksTierOrRam = configOverride.tier !== undefined || configOverride.customRamMb !== undefined;
  const checksIdle = configOverride.idleTimeoutMin !== undefined;

  if (checksTierOrRam) {
    if (health.tier !== spec.tier) return true;
    if (spec.tier === 'custom' && health.ramLimitMb !== spec.ramLimitMb) return true;
  }
  const runningIdle = health.idleTimeoutMin ?? health.tierSpec?.idleTimeoutMin;
  if (checksIdle && runningIdle !== undefined && runningIdle !== desiredIdleTimeoutMin) {
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export async function ensureDaemonRunning({ configOverride, forceRestart = false, timeoutMs = 25000 } = {}) {
  const baseConfig = loadConfig();
  const effectiveConfig = configOverride && typeof configOverride === 'object'
    ? { ...baseConfig, ...configOverride }
    : baseConfig;
  const desiredSpec = resolveTierSpec(effectiveConfig.tier, effectiveConfig.customRamMb);
  const tierOverridden = Boolean(configOverride?.tier && configOverride.tier !== baseConfig.tier);
  const rawIdle =
    configOverride?.idleTimeoutMin ??
    (tierOverridden ? desiredSpec.idleTimeoutMin : (effectiveConfig.idleTimeoutMin ?? desiredSpec.idleTimeoutMin));
  const desiredIdleTimeoutMin = normalizeIdleTimeoutMin(rawIdle, desiredSpec.idleTimeoutMin);

  let tierMismatch = false;
  if (!forceRestart) {
    const existing = readDaemonDiscovery();
    if (existing) {
      const health = await probeHealth(existing, 1500);
      if (health) {
        tierMismatch = hasConfigMismatch(health, effectiveConfig, desiredSpec, desiredIdleTimeoutMin, configOverride);
        if (!tierMismatch) {
          return { discovery: existing, health, started: false };
        }
      }
    }
  }

  const dataDir = getDataDir();
  const cacheDir = getCacheDir();
  ensureDir(dataDir, 0o700);
  ensureDir(cacheDir, 0o700);
  ensureDir(getProjectsDir(), 0o700);

  const lockPath = getDaemonLockPath();
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  const lockState = await acquireDaemonLock(lockPath, !forceRestart && !tierMismatch, deadline);
  if (!lockState.acquired) {
    return { discovery: lockState.discovery, health: lockState.health, started: false };
  }

  try {
    const current = readDaemonDiscovery();
    if (current) {
      const health = await probeHealth(current, 1500);
      if (health) {
        const mismatchNow = hasConfigMismatch(health, effectiveConfig, desiredSpec, desiredIdleTimeoutMin, configOverride);
        if (!forceRestart && !mismatchNow) {
          return { discovery: current, health, started: false };
        }
        await stopDaemon(mismatchNow && !forceRestart ? 'config_override' : 'config_restart');
      }
    }

    const env = discoverEnvironment(effectiveConfig);
    if (!env.ok) {
      throw new DaemonError(env.message, {
        code: env.code,
        status: 503,
        retryable: false,
        details: env.details,
      });
    }

    let build;
    try {
      build = ensureDaemonJar(env);
    } catch (err) {
      throw new DaemonError(err.message, {
        code: err.code || 'DAEMON_BUILD_FAILED',
        status: 503,
        retryable: false,
        details: err.details || null,
        cause: err,
      });
    }

    const spec = desiredSpec;
    const idleTimeoutMin = desiredIdleTimeoutMin;

    const ghidraSettingsDir = ensureDir(join(dataDir, 'ghidra-settings'), 0o700);
    const ghidraCacheDir = ensureDir(join(cacheDir, 'ghidra-cache'), 0o700);
    const ghidraTmpDir = ensureDir(join(cacheDir, 'ghidra-tmp'), 0o700);

    const launchVmArgs = parseLaunchProperties(env.launchPropertiesPath);
    const jvmArgs = [
      ...launchVmArgs,
      '-Djava.awt.headless=true',
      '-Dapplication.name=Ghidra',
      `-Dapplication.settingsdir=${ghidraSettingsDir}`,
      `-Dapplication.cachedir=${ghidraCacheDir}`,
      `-Dapplication.tempdir=${ghidraTmpDir}`,
      `-Xms${spec.xmsMb}m`,
      `-Xmx${spec.xmxMb}m`,
      '-XX:+UseG1GC',
      '-XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=100',
      '-XX:G1PeriodicGCInterval=30000',
      '-XX:+G1PeriodicGCInvokesConcurrent',
      '-XX:SoftRefLRUPolicyMSPerMB=250',
      '-XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError',
      '-cp',
      `${env.utilityJar}:${build.bootJarPath}`,
      'ghidra.Ghidra',
      DAEMON_MAIN_CLASS,
      '--data-dir',
      dataDir,
      '--ram-limit-mb',
      String(spec.ramLimitMb),
      '--tier',
      spec.tier,
      '--idle-timeout-min',
      String(idleTimeoutMin),
    ];

    const logPath = getDaemonLogPath();
    rotateDaemonLog(logPath);
    const logFd = fs.openSync(logPath, 'a', 0o600);

    let childExited = false;
    let exitCode = null;
    let exitSignal = null;
    let spawnError = null;
    let child;

    try {
      child = spawn(env.javaBin, jvmArgs, {
        cwd: dataDir,
        detached: true,
        stdio: ['ignore', logFd, logFd],
        env: {
          ...process.env,
          JAVA_HOME: env.javaHome,
          GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR: env.ghidraDir,
        },
      });
      child.on('exit', (code, signal) => {
        childExited = true;
        exitCode = code;
        exitSignal = signal;
      });
      child.on('error', (err) => {
        childExited = true;
        spawnError = err;
      });
      child.unref();
    } finally {
      fs.closeSync(logFd);
    }

    const startupDeadline = Math.max(deadline, Date.now() + Math.min(timeoutMs, 15000));
    while (Date.now() < startupDeadline) {
      const disc = parseRawDiscovery();
      if (disc && disc.pid === child.pid && isPidAlive(disc.pid)) {
        const health = await probeHealth(disc, 1500);
        if (health) {
          return { discovery: disc, health, started: true };
        }
      }

      if (childExited) {
        const logTail = readLogTail(logPath);
        throw new DaemonError(
          `Ghidra daemon exited during startup (code=${exitCode}, signal=${exitSignal})${spawnError ? `: ${spawnError.message}` : ''}`,
          {
            code: 'DAEMON_UNREACHABLE',
            status: 502,
            retryable: true,
            details: { pid: child.pid, exitCode, exitSignal, logTail },
          },
        );
      }

      await sleep(120);
    }

    const logTail = readLogTail(logPath);
    throw new DaemonError(`Timed out waiting for Ghidra daemon startup after ${timeoutMs}ms`, {
      code: 'DAEMON_STARTING',
      status: 503,
      retryable: true,
      details: { pid: child.pid, timeoutMs, logTail },
    });
  } finally {
    safeUnlink(lockPath);
  }
}

function sendHttpRequest(disc, method, path, { body, priority = 'mcp', actor = 'agent', headers = {}, timeoutMs = 60000, etag } = {}) {
  return new Promise((resolvePromise, rejectPromise) => {
    const reqHeaders = {
      ...headers,
      Authorization: `Bearer ${disc.token}`,
      'X-RE-Priority': priority,
      'X-RE-Actor': actor,
      Accept: headers.Accept || headers.accept || 'application/json',
    };

    if (etag) {
      reqHeaders['If-None-Match'] = etag;
    }

    let payload = null;
    if (body !== undefined) {
      payload = typeof body === 'string' || Buffer.isBuffer(body) ? body : JSON.stringify(body);
      if (!reqHeaders['Content-Type'] && !reqHeaders['content-type']) {
        reqHeaders['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
      }
      reqHeaders['Content-Length'] = String(Buffer.byteLength(payload));
    }

    const req = http.request(
      {
        hostname: '127.0.0.1',
        port: disc.port,
        path,
        method,
        headers: reqHeaders,
      },
      (res) => {
        const chunks = [];
        res.on('data', (chunk) => chunks.push(chunk));
        res.on('end', () => {
          const status = res.statusCode ?? 500;
          const rawText = Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8');

          if (status === 304) {
            const revHeader = res.headers['x-re-revision'];
            resolvePromise({
              notModified: true,
              status: 304,
              etag: res.headers.etag ?? null,
              revision: revHeader !== undefined ? Number(revHeader) : null,
            });
            return;
          }

          const contentType = String(res.headers['content-type'] || '').toLowerCase();
          const parseJsonSafe = () => {
            if (!rawText) return null;
            try {
              return JSON.parse(rawText);
            } catch {
              return null;
            }
          };

          if (status >= 200 && status < 300) {
            if (contentType.includes('application/x-ndjson') || contentType.startsWith('text/')) {
              resolvePromise(rawText);
              return;
            }
            const revHeader = res.headers['x-re-revision'];
            const parsedRev = revHeader !== undefined && revHeader !== '' ? Number(revHeader) : null;
            const httpMeta = {
              status,
              etag: res.headers.etag ?? null,
              revision: Number.isFinite(parsedRev) ? parsedRev : null,
            };
            const attachHttpMeta = (obj) => {
              if (obj && typeof obj === 'object') {
                Object.defineProperty(obj, '_httpMeta', {
                  value: httpMeta,
                  enumerable: false,
                  configurable: true,
                });
              }
              return obj;
            };
            if (!rawText) {
              resolvePromise(attachHttpMeta({ ok: true, status }));
              return;
            }
            const parsed = parseJsonSafe();
            resolvePromise(parsed !== null ? attachHttpMeta(parsed) : rawText);
            return;
          }

          const parsedErr = parseJsonSafe();
          const errBody = parsedErr?.error && typeof parsedErr.error === 'object' ? parsedErr.error : parsedErr;
          rejectPromise(
            new DaemonError(errBody?.message || `Daemon request ${method} ${path} failed with HTTP ${status}`, {
              code: errBody?.code || `HTTP_${status}`,
              status,
              retryable: Boolean(errBody?.retryable),
              details: errBody?.details ?? (parsedErr ? null : { body: rawText.slice(0, 1024) }),
            }),
          );
        });
        res.on('error', (err) => {
          rejectPromise(
            new DaemonError(`Daemon response stream error: ${err.message}`, {
              code: 'DAEMON_UNREACHABLE',
              status: 502,
              retryable: true,
              cause: err,
            }),
          );
        });
      },
    );

    req.setTimeout(timeoutMs, () => {
      req.destroy(
        new DaemonError(`Daemon request ${method} ${path} timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms`, {
          code: 'DAEMON_TIMEOUT',
          status: 504,
          retryable: true,
        }),
      );
    });

    req.on('error', (err) => {
      if (err instanceof DaemonError) {
        rejectPromise(err);
        return;
      }
      const connErr = new DaemonError(`Failed to reach Ghidra daemon: ${err.message}`, {
        code: 'DAEMON_UNREACHABLE',
        status: 502,
        retryable: true,
        details: { syscall: err.syscall, errno: err.code },
        cause: err,
      });
      connErr.isNetworkError = true;
      rejectPromise(connErr);
    });

    if (payload !== null) {
      req.write(payload);
    }
    req.end();
  });
}

export async function daemonRequest(
  method,
  path,
  { body, priority = 'mcp', actor = 'agent', headers = {}, timeoutMs = 60000, autoStart = true, etag } = {},
) {
  let disc = readDaemonDiscovery();
  if (!disc) {
    if (!autoStart) {
      throw new DaemonError('Ghidra daemon is not running', {
        code: 'DAEMON_UNREACHABLE',
        status: 502,
        retryable: true,
      });
    }
    const started = await ensureDaemonRunning();
    disc = started.discovery;
  }

  try {
    return await sendHttpRequest(disc, method, path, { body, priority, actor, headers, timeoutMs, etag });
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof DaemonError && err.isNetworkError && autoStart) {
      const restarted = await ensureDaemonRunning();
      return await sendHttpRequest(restarted.discovery, method, path, {
        body,
        priority,
        actor,
        headers,
        timeoutMs,
        etag,
      });
    }
    throw err;
  }
}

export async function stopDaemon(reason = 'user_request') {
  const disc = readDaemonDiscovery();
  const daemonJsonPath = getDaemonJsonPath();

  if (!disc) {
    const stale = parseRawDiscovery();
    if (!stale || !isPidAlive(stale.pid)) {
      safeUnlink(daemonJsonPath);
    }
    return { ok: true, stopped: false, reason: 'not_running' };
  }

  try {
    await sendHttpRequest(disc, 'POST', '/v1/shutdown', {
      body: { reason },
      priority: 'ui',
      actor: 'agent',
      timeoutMs: 5000,
    });
  } catch {
    // Daemon may close connection during shutdown.
  }

  const deadline = Date.now() + 8000;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    if (!isPidAlive(disc.pid)) {
      safeUnlink(daemonJsonPath);
      return { ok: true, stopped: true, pid: disc.pid, forced: false };
    }
    await sleep(100);
  }

  let forced = false;
  try {
    process.kill(disc.pid, 'SIGKILL');
    forced = true;
  } catch {
    // Process may have exited right before SIGKILL.
  }

  const killDeadline = Date.now() + 1000;
  while (Date.now() < killDeadline && isPidAlive(disc.pid)) {
    await sleep(50);
  }

  safeUnlink(daemonJsonPath);
  return { ok: true, stopped: true, pid: disc.pid, forced };
}

export async function getHealth({ autoStart = false, timeoutMs = 2000 } = {}) {
  if (autoStart) {
    return daemonRequest('GET', '/v1/health', { autoStart: true, timeoutMs });
  }
  const disc = readDaemonDiscovery();
  if (!disc) return null;
  return probeHealth(disc, timeoutMs);
}

export async function listBinaries(opts = {}) {
  return daemonRequest('GET', '/v1/binaries', {
    priority: opts.priority || 'mcp',
    actor: opts.actor || 'agent',
    autoStart: opts.autoStart ?? true,
    etag: opts.etag,
    timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs ?? 15000,
  });
}

export async function openBinary(filePath, opts = {}) {
  const rawPath = filePath !== undefined && filePath !== null ? String(filePath).trim() : '';
  const absPath = rawPath ? resolve(rawPath) : null;
  const sha256 = opts.sha256 || (absPath ? await computeFileSha256(absPath) : null);
  const body = {
    sha256,
    analyze: opts.analyze ?? true,
    forceReimport: opts.forceReimport ?? false,
    analysisProfile: opts.analysisProfile || 'default',
    replaceIfFull: opts.replaceIfFull ?? false,
  };
  if (absPath !== null) {
    body.path = absPath;
  }
  const res = await daemonRequest('POST', '/v1/binaries/open', {
    body,
    priority: opts.priority || 'mcp',
    actor: opts.actor || 'agent',
    autoStart: opts.autoStart ?? true,
    timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs ?? 60000,
  });

  if (opts.waitForAnalysis === true && res && res.jobId) {
    const job = await waitForJob(res.jobId, opts);
    return { ...res, job };
  }
  return res;
}

export async function getJob(jobId, opts = {}) {
  return daemonRequest('GET', `/v1/jobs/${encodeURIComponent(jobId)}`, {
    priority: opts.priority || 'mcp',
    actor: opts.actor || 'agent',
    autoStart: opts.autoStart ?? false,
    timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs ?? 15000,
  });
}

export async function cancelJob(jobId, opts = {}) {
  return daemonRequest('POST', `/v1/jobs/${encodeURIComponent(jobId)}/cancel`, {
    priority: opts.priority || 'mcp',
    actor: opts.actor || 'agent',
    autoStart: opts.autoStart ?? false,
    timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs ?? 15000,
  });
}

export async function waitForJob(jobId, opts = {}) {
  const pollIntervalMs = opts.pollIntervalMs ?? 500;
  const timeoutMs = opts.jobTimeoutMs ?? opts.timeoutMs ?? 600000;
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;

  while (true) {
    const job = await getJob(jobId, {
      priority: opts.priority || 'mcp',
      actor: opts.actor || 'agent',
      autoStart: false,
    });
    if (typeof opts.onProgress === 'function') {
      opts.onProgress(job);
    }

    const state = String(job?.state || '').toLowerCase();
    if (state === 'completed' || state === 'succeeded' || state === 'done') {
      return job;
    }
    if (state === 'failed' || state === 'error') {
      const errInfo = job.error && typeof job.error === 'object' ? job.error : {};
      throw new DaemonError(errInfo.message || job.message || `Job ${jobId} failed`, {
        code: errInfo.code || 'JOB_FAILED',
        status: 500,
        retryable: Boolean(errInfo.retryable),
        details: job,
      });
    }
    if (state === 'cancelled' || state === 'canceled') {
      throw new DaemonError(`Job ${jobId} was cancelled`, {
        code: 'JOB_CANCELLED',
        status: 499,
        retryable: false,
        details: job,
      });
    }

    if (Date.now() >= deadline) {
      throw new DaemonError(`Timed out waiting for job ${jobId}`, {
        code: 'JOB_TIMEOUT',
        status: 504,
        retryable: true,
        details: { jobId, timeoutMs, lastJob: job },
      });
    }
    await sleep(pollIntervalMs);
  }
}

export async function waitEvents(sinceSeq = 0, timeoutMs = 15000, limit = 50, opts = {}) {
  const qs = `since=${encodeURIComponent(String(sinceSeq))}&timeoutMs=${encodeURIComponent(String(timeoutMs))}&limit=${encodeURIComponent(String(limit))}`;
  return daemonRequest('GET', `/v1/events/wait?${qs}`, {
    priority: opts.priority || 'ui',
    actor: opts.actor || 'ui',
    autoStart: opts.autoStart ?? false,
    timeoutMs: timeoutMs + 5000,
  });
}

function buildQueryString(params = {}) {
  if (!params || typeof params !== 'object') return '';
  const search = new URLSearchParams();
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(params)) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') continue;
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
      if (value.length === 0) continue;
      search.set(key, value.join(','));
    } else if (typeof value === 'boolean') {
      search.set(key, value ? '1' : '0');
    } else {
      search.set(key, String(value));
    }
  }
  const qs = search.toString();
  return qs ? `?${qs}` : '';
}

function daemonGet(path, params, opts = {}, defaultTimeoutMs = 30000) {
  const qs = buildQueryString(params);
  return daemonRequest('GET', `${path}${qs}`, {
    priority: opts.priority || 'mcp',
    actor: opts.actor || 'agent',
    headers: opts.headers || {},
    autoStart: opts.autoStart ?? true,
    etag: opts.etag,
    timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs ?? defaultTimeoutMs,
  });
}

function daemonPost(path, payload = {}, opts = {}, defaultTimeoutMs = 60000) {
  return daemonRequest('POST', path, {
    body: payload,
    priority: opts.priority || 'mcp',
    actor: opts.actor || 'agent',
    headers: opts.headers || {},
    autoStart: opts.autoStart ?? true,
    timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs ?? defaultTimeoutMs,
  });
}

export async function exportIndexNdjson(
  binaryId,
  { sinceRevision = 0, priority = 'mcp', actor = 'agent', timeoutMs = 120000, autoStart = true } = {},
) {
  const qs = buildQueryString({ sinceRevision });
  return daemonRequest('GET', `/v1/binaries/${encodeURIComponent(binaryId)}/export-index${qs}`, {
    priority,
    actor,
    autoStart,
    headers: { Accept: 'application/x-ndjson' },
    timeoutMs,
  });
}

export async function syncBinaryIndex(binaryId, opts = {}) {
  const ndjson = await exportIndexNdjson(binaryId, opts);
  if (ndjson && typeof ndjson === 'object' && !Buffer.isBuffer(ndjson)) {
    if (ndjson.unchanged || ndjson.record === 'unchanged' || ndjson.notModified || ndjson.status === 204) {
      return {
        ok: true,
        binaryId: String(binaryId).toLowerCase(),
        unchanged: true,
        revision: ndjson.revision ?? ndjson._httpMeta?.revision ?? null,
        counts: { sections: 0, functions: 0, strings: 0, callEdges: 0 },
      };
    }
    return syncFromNdjson(binaryId, [ndjson]);
  }
  return syncFromNdjson(binaryId, ndjson);
}
```
