`shared/index-store.mjs`:

```mjs
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite';
import { ensureDir, getProjectDir, getProjectsDir } from './paths.mjs';

const HEX_ID_RE = /^[a-fA-F0-9]{8,64}$/;
const MAX_REGEX_LEN = 256;
const MAX_OPEN_DBS = 2;

/** @type {Map<string, { db: DatabaseSync, dbPath: string, readOnly: boolean }>} */
const openDatabases = new Map();

function evictLruDatabases() {
  while (openDatabases.size >= MAX_OPEN_DBS) {
    const oldestKey = openDatabases.keys().next().value;
    if (oldestKey === undefined) break;
    const entry = openDatabases.get(oldestKey);
    openDatabases.delete(oldestKey);
    if (entry?.db) {
      try {
        entry.db.close();
      } catch {
        // Ignore close error during LRU eviction.
      }
    }
  }
}

function normalizeBinaryId(binaryId) {
  if (!binaryId || typeof binaryId !== 'string' || !HEX_ID_RE.test(binaryId)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid binaryId: ${String(binaryId)}`);
  }
  return binaryId.toLowerCase();
}

function clampInt(val, min, max, fallback) {
  if (val === undefined || val === null || val === '') return fallback;
  const num = Number(val);
  if (!Number.isFinite(num)) return fallback;
  return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, Math.trunc(num)));
}

function parseAddressToBigInt(addrOrHex) {
  if (typeof addrOrHex === 'bigint') return addrOrHex;
  if (typeof addrOrHex === 'number') {
    if (!Number.isFinite(addrOrHex)) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid numeric address: ${addrOrHex}`);
    }
    return BigInt(Math.trunc(addrOrHex));
  }
  if (typeof addrOrHex === 'string') {
    const trimmed = addrOrHex.trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
      throw new Error('Empty address string');
    }
    if (/^0x[0-9a-fA-F]+$/i.test(trimmed)) {
      return BigInt(trimmed.toLowerCase());
    }
    if (/^[0-9a-fA-F]+$/i.test(trimmed)) {
      return BigInt(`0x${trimmed.toLowerCase()}`);
    }
    if (/^-?\d+$/.test(trimmed)) {
      return BigInt(trimmed);
    }
  }
  throw new Error(`Invalid address: ${String(addrOrHex)}`);
}

function toSqlInt64(addrOrHex) {
  return BigInt.asIntN(64, parseAddressToBigInt(addrOrHex));
}

function preferHexInt64(hexVal, numVal) {
  if (typeof hexVal === 'string' && hexVal.trim().length > 0) {
    return toSqlInt64(hexVal);
  }
  if (numVal !== undefined && numVal !== null) {
    return toSqlInt64(numVal);
  }
  throw new Error('Missing address value');
}

function normalizeHex(hexVal, fallbackNum) {
  if (typeof hexVal === 'string' && hexVal.trim().length > 0) {
    const s = hexVal.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (s.startsWith('0x')) return s;
    if (/^[0-9a-f]+$/.test(s)) return `0x${s}`;
    return s;
  }
  if (fallbackNum !== undefined && fallbackNum !== null) {
    const unsigned = BigInt.asUintN(64, parseAddressToBigInt(fallbackNum));
    return `0x${unsigned.toString(16)}`;
  }
  return '0x0';
}

function escapeLike(str) {
  return String(str).replace(/[\\%_]/g, '\\$&');
}

function analyzeTextSearchQuery(rawQuery) {
  const trimmed = String(rawQuery || '').trim();
  if (!trimmed) {
    return { mode: 'empty', ftsExpr: null, requireLike: false, likePattern: null };
  }

  const hasPunctuation = /[^\p{L}\p{N}_\s]/u.test(trimmed);
  const whitespaceTokens = trimmed.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const alnumTokens = trimmed.match(/[\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu) || [];
  const multiCharAlnum = alnumTokens.filter((t) => t.length >= 2);
  const hasShortToken = whitespaceTokens.some((t) => t.length < 2) || alnumTokens.some((t) => t.length < 2);
  const likePattern = `%${escapeLike(trimmed)}%`;

  if (multiCharAlnum.length === 0) {
    return { mode: 'like', ftsExpr: null, requireLike: true, likePattern };
  }

  if (hasPunctuation || hasShortToken) {
    const ftsExpr = multiCharAlnum.map((tok) => `"${tok.replace(/"/g, '""')}"*`).join(' ');
    return { mode: 'fts', ftsExpr, requireLike: true, likePattern };
  }

  const ftsExpr = whitespaceTokens.map((tok) => `"${tok.replace(/"/g, '""')}"*`).join(' ');
  return { mode: 'fts', ftsExpr, requireLike: false, likePattern };
}

function encodeCursor(offset) {
  return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ offset }), 'utf8').toString('base64url');
}

function decodeCursor(cursor) {
  if (cursor === undefined || cursor === null || cursor === '') return 0;
  const raw = String(cursor).trim();
  if (!raw) return 0;
  if (/^\d+$/.test(raw)) {
    return Math.max(0, Number.parseInt(raw, 10));
  }
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(raw, 'base64url').toString('utf8'));
    if (parsed && Number.isInteger(parsed.offset) && parsed.offset >= 0) {
      return parsed.offset;
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore malformed cursor and start from 0.
  }
  return 0;
}

function prepWrite(db, sql) {
  const stmt = db.prepare(sql);
  stmt.setReadBigInts(true);
  return stmt;
}

function runInTransaction(db, fn) {
  db.exec('BEGIN IMMEDIATE');
  try {
    const result = fn();
    db.exec('COMMIT');
    return result;
  } catch (err) {
    try {
      db.exec('ROLLBACK');
    } catch {
      // Ignore rollback errors if connection is no longer in transaction.
    }
    throw err;
  }
}

function configurePragmas(db, readOnly) {
  if (!readOnly) {
    db.exec(`
      PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;
      PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL;
    `);
  }
  db.exec(`
    PRAGMA cache_size = -16000;
    PRAGMA mmap_size = 0;
    PRAGMA temp_store = MEMORY;
    PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000;
  `);
}

function initSchema(db) {
  db.exec(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta (
      key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      value TEXT NOT NULL
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sections (
      name       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      start_addr INTEGER NOT NULL,
      end_addr   INTEGER NOT NULL,
      start_hex  TEXT NOT NULL,
      end_hex    TEXT NOT NULL,
      size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
      perms      TEXT NOT NULL
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS functions (
      entry_addr   INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      entry_hex    TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      end_hex      TEXT NOT NULL,
      name         TEXT NOT NULL,
      namespace    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Global',
      signature    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      size_bytes   INTEGER NOT NULL,
      is_import    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      is_export    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      is_thunk     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      external_lib TEXT,
      caller_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      callee_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      has_comment  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_functions_name ON functions(name COLLATE NOCASE);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_functions_import ON functions(is_import, name);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_functions_export ON functions(is_export, name);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_functions_size ON functions(size_bytes DESC);

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS strings (
      id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      addr       INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      addr_hex   TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      value      TEXT NOT NULL,
      encoding   TEXT NOT NULL,
      byte_len   INTEGER NOT NULL,
      section    TEXT NOT NULL,
      xref_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    );
    CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS strings_fts USING fts5(
      value,
      addr_hex UNINDEXED,
      content='strings',
      content_rowid='id',
      tokenize='unicode61'
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS call_edges (
      caller_addr INTEGER NOT NULL,
      callee_addr INTEGER NOT NULL,
      caller_hex  TEXT NOT NULL,
      callee_hex  TEXT NOT NULL,
      call_count  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      PRIMARY KEY (caller_addr, callee_addr)
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_call_edges_callee ON call_edges(callee_addr, caller_addr);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_call_edges_hex ON call_edges(caller_hex, callee_hex);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_call_edges_callee_hex ON call_edges(callee_hex, caller_hex);

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS decompile_cache (
      id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      entry_addr  INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      entry_hex   TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      revision    INTEGER NOT NULL,
      func_name   TEXT NOT NULL,
      plain_c     TEXT NOT NULL,
      tokens_json TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at  INTEGER NOT NULL
    );
    CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS decompile_fts USING fts5(
      func_name,
      plain_c,
      entry_hex UNINDEXED,
      content='decompile_cache',
      content_rowid='id',
      tokenize='unicode61'
    );

    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS decompile_cache_ai AFTER INSERT ON decompile_cache BEGIN
      INSERT INTO decompile_fts(rowid, func_name, plain_c, entry_hex)
      VALUES (new.id, new.func_name, new.plain_c, new.entry_hex);
    END;

    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS decompile_cache_ad AFTER DELETE ON decompile_cache BEGIN
      INSERT INTO decompile_fts(decompile_fts, rowid, func_name, plain_c, entry_hex)
      VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.func_name, old.plain_c, old.entry_hex);
    END;

    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS decompile_cache_au AFTER UPDATE ON decompile_cache BEGIN
      INSERT INTO decompile_fts(decompile_fts, rowid, func_name, plain_c, entry_hex)
      VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.func_name, old.plain_c, old.entry_hex);
      INSERT INTO decompile_fts(rowid, func_name, plain_c, entry_hex)
      VALUES (new.id, new.func_name, new.plain_c, new.entry_hex);
    END;
  `);
}

export function openIndex(binaryId, { readOnly = false } = {}) {
  const id = normalizeBinaryId(binaryId);
  const projectDir = getProjectDir(id);
  const dbPath = join(projectDir, 'index.sqlite');

  const cached = openDatabases.get(id);
  if (cached) {
    if (cached.dbPath === dbPath && (!cached.readOnly || readOnly)) {
      openDatabases.delete(id);
      openDatabases.set(id, cached);
      return cached.db;
    }
    try {
      cached.db.close();
    } catch {
      // Ignore close error on stale handle.
    }
    openDatabases.delete(id);
  }

  if (readOnly) {
    if (!fs.existsSync(dbPath)) {
      throw new Error(`Offline index not found for binary ${id}`);
    }
    const db = new DatabaseSync(dbPath, { readOnly: true });
    try {
      configurePragmas(db, true);
    } catch (err) {
      db.close();
      throw err;
    }
    evictLruDatabases();
    openDatabases.set(id, { db, dbPath, readOnly: true });
    return db;
  }

  ensureDir(projectDir, 0o700);
  const db = new DatabaseSync(dbPath);
  try {
    configurePragmas(db, false);
    initSchema(db);
  } catch (err) {
    db.close();
    throw err;
  }
  evictLruDatabases();
  openDatabases.set(id, { db, dbPath, readOnly: false });
  return db;
}

export function closeIndex(binaryId) {
  if (!binaryId || typeof binaryId !== 'string' || !HEX_ID_RE.test(binaryId)) {
    return false;
  }
  const id = binaryId.toLowerCase();
  const cached = openDatabases.get(id);
  if (!cached) return false;
  openDatabases.delete(id);
  try {
    cached.db.close();
  } catch {
    // Ignore close error.
  }
  return true;
}

export function closeAllIndexes() {
  for (const [, entry] of openDatabases) {
    try {
      entry.db.close();
    } catch {
      // Ignore close error.
    }
  }
  openDatabases.clear();
}

function parseNdjsonRecords(ndjsonTextOrLines) {
  if (ndjsonTextOrLines == null) return [];
  const lines = Buffer.isBuffer(ndjsonTextOrLines)
    ? ndjsonTextOrLines.toString('utf8').split(/\r?\n/)
    : typeof ndjsonTextOrLines === 'string'
      ? ndjsonTextOrLines.split(/\r?\n/)
      : ndjsonTextOrLines;

  const records = [];
  for (const item of lines) {
    if (item == null) continue;
    if (typeof item === 'object' && !Buffer.isBuffer(item)) {
      records.push(item);
      continue;
    }
    const line = String(item).trim();
    if (!line) continue;
    records.push(JSON.parse(line));
  }
  return records;
}

export function syncFromNdjson(binaryId, ndjsonTextOrLines) {
  const id = normalizeBinaryId(binaryId);
  const records = parseNdjsonRecords(ndjsonTextOrLines);

  if (records.length === 0 || (records.length === 1 && records[0].record === 'unchanged')) {
    return {
      ok: true,
      binaryId: id,
      unchanged: true,
      revision: records[0]?.revision !== undefined ? Number(records[0].revision) : null,
      counts: { sections: 0, functions: 0, strings: 0, callEdges: 0 },
    };
  }

  if (records.length === 1 && records[0].record === 'meta') {
    const incomingRev = records[0].revision !== undefined ? String(records[0].revision) : null;
    if (records[0].unchanged === true) {
      return {
        ok: true,
        binaryId: id,
        unchanged: true,
        revision: incomingRev !== null ? Number(incomingRev) : null,
        counts: { sections: 0, functions: 0, strings: 0, callEdges: 0 },
      };
    }
    const existingDbPath = join(getProjectDir(id), 'index.sqlite');
    if (fs.existsSync(existingDbPath)) {
      const existingDb = openIndex(id, { readOnly: true });
      const existingMeta = readMetaTable(existingDb);
      const existingCounts = readCounts(existingDb);
      const hasExistingData =
        existingCounts.functionCount > 0 ||
        existingCounts.stringCount > 0 ||
        existingCounts.sectionCount > 0;
      if (hasExistingData && (incomingRev === null || existingMeta.revision === incomingRev)) {
        return {
          ok: true,
          binaryId: id,
          unchanged: true,
          revision: Number(existingMeta.revision ?? incomingRev ?? 0),
          counts: { sections: 0, functions: 0, strings: 0, callEdges: 0 },
        };
      }
    }
  }

  const db = openIndex(id, { readOnly: false });

  let metaRecord = null;
  const counts = { sections: 0, functions: 0, strings: 0, callEdges: 0 };

  runInTransaction(db, () => {
    const prevRevRow = db.prepare("SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key = 'revision'").get();
    const prevRevision =
      prevRevRow && prevRevRow.value !== undefined && prevRevRow.value !== null && Number.isFinite(Number(prevRevRow.value))
        ? Number(prevRevRow.value)
        : null;

    db.exec(`
      DELETE FROM sections;
      DELETE FROM functions;
      DELETE FROM strings;
      DELETE FROM call_edges;
      DELETE FROM meta;
    `);

    const insertSection = prepWrite(db, `
      INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sections(name, start_addr, end_addr, start_hex, end_hex, size_bytes, perms)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `);
    const insertFunction = prepWrite(db, `
      INSERT OR REPLACE INTO functions(
        entry_addr, entry_hex, end_hex, name, namespace, signature,
        size_bytes, is_import, is_export, is_thunk, external_lib,
        caller_count, callee_count, has_comment
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `);
    const insertString = prepWrite(db, `
      INSERT OR REPLACE INTO strings(addr, addr_hex, value, encoding, byte_len, section, xref_count)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `);
    const insertCallEdge = prepWrite(db, `
      INSERT OR REPLACE INTO call_edges(caller_addr, callee_addr, caller_hex, callee_hex, call_count)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `);
    const insertMeta = prepWrite(db, `
      INSERT OR REPLACE INTO meta(key, value) VALUES (?, ?)
    `);

    for (const rec of records) {
      switch (rec.record) {
        case 'meta': {
          metaRecord = rec;
          break;
        }
        case 'section': {
          const startHex = normalizeHex(rec.startHex, rec.startAddr);
          const endHex = normalizeHex(rec.endHex, rec.endAddr);
          insertSection.run(
            String(rec.name ?? ''),
            preferHexInt64(rec.startHex, rec.startAddr),
            preferHexInt64(rec.endHex, rec.endAddr),
            startHex,
            endHex,
            Number(rec.sizeBytes ?? 0),
            String(rec.perms ?? '---'),
          );
          counts.sections++;
          break;
        }
        case 'function': {
          const entryHex = normalizeHex(rec.entryHex, rec.entryAddr);
          const endHex = normalizeHex(rec.endHex, rec.entryAddr);
          insertFunction.run(
            preferHexInt64(rec.entryHex, rec.entryAddr),
            entryHex,
            endHex,
            String(rec.name ?? entryHex),
            String(rec.namespace ?? 'Global'),
            String(rec.signature ?? ''),
            Number(rec.sizeBytes ?? 0),
            rec.isImport ? 1 : 0,
            rec.isExport ? 1 : 0,
            rec.isThunk ? 1 : 0,
            rec.externalLib != null ? String(rec.externalLib) : null,
            Number(rec.callerCount ?? 0),
            Number(rec.calleeCount ?? 0),
            rec.hasComment ? 1 : 0,
          );
          counts.functions++;
          break;
        }
        case 'string': {
          const addrHex = normalizeHex(rec.addrHex, rec.addr);
          insertString.run(
            preferHexInt64(rec.addrHex, rec.addr),
            addrHex,
            String(rec.value ?? ''),
            String(rec.encoding ?? 'utf8'),
            Number(rec.byteLen ?? 0),
            String(rec.section ?? ''),
            Number(rec.xrefCount ?? 0),
          );
          counts.strings++;
          break;
        }
        case 'call_edge': {
          const callerHex = normalizeHex(rec.callerHex, rec.callerAddr);
          const calleeHex = normalizeHex(rec.calleeHex, rec.calleeAddr);
          insertCallEdge.run(
            preferHexInt64(rec.callerHex, rec.callerAddr),
            preferHexInt64(rec.calleeHex, rec.calleeAddr),
            callerHex,
            calleeHex,
            Math.max(1, Number(rec.callCount ?? 1)),
          );
          counts.callEdges++;
          break;
        }
        default:
          break;
      }
    }

    db.exec("INSERT INTO strings_fts(strings_fts) VALUES('rebuild')");

    let revisionValue = '0';
    if (metaRecord && typeof metaRecord === 'object') {
      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(metaRecord)) {
        if (key === 'record' || value === undefined || value === null) continue;
        if (key === 'revision') {
          revisionValue = String(value);
          continue;
        }
        insertMeta.run(key, typeof value === 'string' ? value : String(value));
      }
    } else {
      insertMeta.run('binaryId', id);
      insertMeta.run('sha256', id);
    }
    insertMeta.run('indexedAt', String(Date.now()));
    // Write revision last inside the same transaction so partial state is never observable.
    insertMeta.run('revision', revisionValue);

    const newRevision = Number.isFinite(Number(revisionValue)) ? Number(revisionValue) : 0;
    if (prevRevision !== null && newRevision !== prevRevision) {
      prepWrite(db, 'DELETE FROM decompile_cache WHERE revision < ?').run(newRevision);
    }
  });

  try {
    db.exec('PRAGMA shrink_memory');
  } catch {
    // Ignore shrink_memory errors on older SQLite builds.
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    binaryId: id,
    unchanged: false,
    revision: metaRecord?.revision !== undefined ? Number(metaRecord.revision) : 0,
    counts,
  };
}

function readMetaTable(db) {
  const rows = db.prepare('SELECT key, value FROM meta').all();
  const meta = {};
  for (const row of rows) {
    meta[row.key] = row.value;
  }
  return meta;
}

function readCounts(db) {
  const functionCount = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM functions').get().cnt;
  const stringCount = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM strings').get().cnt;
  const cachedDecompileCount = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM decompile_cache').get().cnt;
  const sectionCount = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sections').get().cnt;
  const callEdgeCount = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM call_edges').get().cnt;
  return {
    functionCount,
    stringCount,
    cachedDecompileCount,
    sectionCount,
    callEdgeCount,
  };
}

export function listOfflineProjects({ limit = 30 } = {}) {
  const maxItems = clampInt(limit, 1, 200, 30);
  const projectsDir = getProjectsDir();
  let entries;
  try {
    entries = fs.readdirSync(projectsDir, { withFileTypes: true });
  } catch {
    return [];
  }

  const projects = [];
  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (!entry.isDirectory() || !HEX_ID_RE.test(entry.name)) continue;
    const id = entry.name.toLowerCase();
    const projectDir = join(projectsDir, entry.name);
    const metaPath = join(projectDir, 'meta.json');
    const dbPath = join(projectDir, 'index.sqlite');

    let metaJson = null;
    try {
      metaJson = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(metaPath, 'utf8'));
    } catch {
      // Project may not have meta.json yet.
    }

    let indexStat = null;
    try {
      indexStat = fs.statSync(dbPath);
    } catch {
      // index.sqlite not yet synced.
    }
    const hasIndex = Boolean(indexStat && indexStat.isFile());

    let dbMeta = {};
    let counts = {
      functionCount: metaJson?.functionCount ?? 0,
      stringCount: metaJson?.stringCount ?? 0,
      cachedDecompileCount: 0,
      sectionCount: 0,
      callEdgeCount: 0,
    };

    if (hasIndex) {
      const existing = openDatabases.get(id);
      if (existing && existing.dbPath === dbPath) {
        try {
          dbMeta = readMetaTable(existing.db);
          counts = readCounts(existing.db);
        } catch {
          // Ignore transient read failure.
        }
      } else {
        let transientDb = null;
        try {
          transientDb = new DatabaseSync(dbPath, { readOnly: true });
          configurePragmas(transientDb, true);
          dbMeta = readMetaTable(transientDb);
          counts = readCounts(transientDb);
        } catch {
          // Ignore corrupt or partially created database.
        } finally {
          if (transientDb) {
            try {
              transientDb.close();
            } catch {
              // Ignore close error.
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if (!metaJson && !hasIndex) continue;

    const lastOpenedAt = Number(
      metaJson?.lastOpenedAt ?? dbMeta.indexedAt ?? indexStat?.mtimeMs ?? 0,
    );
    const revision = Number(
      dbMeta.revision ?? metaJson?.revision ?? 0,
    );

    projects.push({
      binaryId: id,
      sha256: id,
      programName: metaJson?.programName ?? dbMeta.programName ?? null,
      basename: metaJson?.basename ?? dbMeta.programName ?? null,
      primaryPath: metaJson?.primaryPath ?? null,
      arch: metaJson?.arch ?? dbMeta.arch ?? null,
      format: metaJson?.format ?? dbMeta.format ?? null,
      endianness: metaJson?.endianness ?? dbMeta.endianness ?? null,
      imageBase: metaJson?.imageBase ?? dbMeta.imageBase ?? null,
      pointerSize: metaJson?.pointerSize != null
        ? Number(metaJson.pointerSize)
        : (dbMeta.pointerSize != null ? Number(dbMeta.pointerSize) : null),
      fileSizeBytes: metaJson?.fileSizeBytes != null ? Number(metaJson.fileSizeBytes) : null,
      analyzed: Boolean(metaJson?.analyzed ?? (dbMeta.analyzed === 'true')),
      analysisProfile: metaJson?.analysisProfile ?? null,
      revision,
      lastOpenedAt,
      lastSavedAt: metaJson?.lastSavedAt != null ? Number(metaJson.lastSavedAt) : null,
      indexedAt: dbMeta.indexedAt != null ? Number(dbMeta.indexedAt) : null,
      hasIndex,
      indexSizeBytes: hasIndex ? indexStat.size : 0,
      functionCount: counts.functionCount,
      stringCount: counts.stringCount,
      sectionCount: counts.sectionCount,
      callEdgeCount: counts.callEdgeCount,
      cachedDecompileCount: counts.cachedDecompileCount,
    });
  }

  projects.sort((a, b) => (b.lastOpenedAt || 0) - (a.lastOpenedAt || 0) || a.binaryId.localeCompare(b.binaryId));
  return projects.slice(0, maxItems);
}

export function getBinaryMeta(binaryId) {
  const db = openIndex(binaryId, { readOnly: true });
  const meta = readMetaTable(db);
  const sections = db
    .prepare(
      'SELECT name, start_hex, end_hex, size_bytes, perms FROM sections ORDER BY (start_addr < 0), start_addr ASC',
    )
    .all()
    .map((row) => ({
      name: row.name,
      startHex: row.start_hex,
      endHex: row.end_hex,
      sizeBytes: row.size_bytes,
      perms: row.perms,
    }));
  const counts = readCounts(db);
  return {
    meta,
    sections,
    functionCount: counts.functionCount,
    stringCount: counts.stringCount,
    cachedDecompileCount: counts.cachedDecompileCount,
  };
}

function formatFunctionRow(row) {
  const kind = row.is_import ? 'import' : (row.is_export ? 'export' : 'function');
  return {
    addr: row.entry_hex,
    entryHex: row.entry_hex,
    endHex: row.end_hex,
    name: row.name,
    namespace: row.namespace,
    signature: row.signature,
    size: row.size_bytes,
    sizeBytes: row.size_bytes,
    kind,
    isImport: Boolean(row.is_import),
    isExport: Boolean(row.is_export),
    isThunk: Boolean(row.is_thunk),
    externalLib: row.external_lib ?? null,
    callers: row.caller_count,
    callerCount: row.caller_count,
    callees: row.callee_count,
    calleeCount: row.callee_count,
    hasComment: Boolean(row.has_comment),
  };
}

function buildOrderByClause(sort) {
  switch (sort) {
    case 'name':
      return 'ORDER BY name COLLATE NOCASE ASC, (entry_addr < 0), entry_addr ASC';
    case 'size':
      return 'ORDER BY size_bytes DESC, (entry_addr < 0), entry_addr ASC';
    case 'addr':
    default:
      return 'ORDER BY (entry_addr < 0), entry_addr ASC';
  }
}

export function searchFunctions(
  binaryId,
  { query = '', kind = 'all', regex = false, minSize = 0, sort = 'addr', limit = 50, cursor = '' } = {},
) {
  const db = openIndex(binaryId, { readOnly: true });
  const clampedLimit = clampInt(limit, 1, 200, 50);
  const offset = decodeCursor(cursor);
  const minSizeNum = Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(Number(minSize)) ? Math.trunc(Number(minSize)) : 0);

  const whereClauses = [];
  const params = [];

  if (kind === 'user' || kind === 'function') {
    whereClauses.push('is_import = 0');
  } else if (kind === 'import') {
    whereClauses.push('is_import = 1');
  } else if (kind === 'export') {
    whereClauses.push('is_export = 1');
  }

  if (minSizeNum > 0) {
    whereClauses.push('size_bytes >= ?');
    params.push(minSizeNum);
  }

  const trimmedQuery = String(query || '').trim();
  const orderBy = buildOrderByClause(sort);

  if (regex && trimmedQuery) {
    if (trimmedQuery.length > MAX_REGEX_LEN) {
      const err = new Error(`Regex query exceeds maximum length of ${MAX_REGEX_LEN} characters`);
      err.code = 'INVALID_PARAMS';
      throw err;
    }
    let re;
    try {
      re = new RegExp(trimmedQuery, 'i');
    } catch (syntaxErr) {
      const err = new Error(`Invalid regex pattern: ${syntaxErr.message}`);
      err.code = 'INVALID_PARAMS';
      throw err;
    }

    const whereSql = whereClauses.length > 0 ? `WHERE ${whereClauses.join(' AND ')}` : '';
    const stmt = db.prepare(`
      SELECT entry_hex, end_hex, name, namespace, signature, size_bytes,
             is_import, is_export, is_thunk, external_lib,
             caller_count, callee_count, has_comment
      FROM functions
      ${whereSql}
      ${orderBy}
    `);

    let total = 0;
    const items = [];
    for (const row of stmt.iterate(...params)) {
      if (!re.test(row.name) && !re.test(row.entry_hex)) continue;
      if (total >= offset && items.length < clampedLimit) {
        items.push(formatFunctionRow(row));
      }
      total++;
    }

    const nextOffset = offset + items.length;
    return {
      total,
      nextCursor: nextOffset < total ? encodeCursor(nextOffset) : null,
      items,
    };
  }

  if (trimmedQuery) {
    const escaped = `%${escapeLike(trimmedQuery)}%`;
    if (/^0x[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(trimmedQuery)) {
      whereClauses.push("(name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\' COLLATE NOCASE OR LOWER(entry_hex) LIKE LOWER(?) ESCAPE '\\')");
      params.push(escaped, escaped);
    } else {
      whereClauses.push("name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\' COLLATE NOCASE");
      params.push(escaped);
    }
  }

  const whereSql = whereClauses.length > 0 ? `WHERE ${whereClauses.join(' AND ')}` : '';
  const total = db.prepare(`SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM functions ${whereSql}`).get(...params).cnt;
  const rows = db
    .prepare(`
      SELECT entry_hex, end_hex, name, namespace, signature, size_bytes,
             is_import, is_export, is_thunk, external_lib,
             caller_count, callee_count, has_comment
      FROM functions
      ${whereSql}
      ${orderBy}
      LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
    `)
    .all(...params, clampedLimit, offset);

  const items = rows.map(formatFunctionRow);
  const nextOffset = offset + items.length;
  return {
    total,
    nextCursor: nextOffset < total ? encodeCursor(nextOffset) : null,
    items,
  };
}

function sliceCodePointSafe(str, maxChars) {
  if (str.length <= maxChars) return str;
  let end = Math.max(0, maxChars);
  if (end > 0 && end < str.length) {
    const code = str.charCodeAt(end - 1);
    if (code >= 0xd800 && code <= 0xdbff) {
      end--;
    }
  }
  return str.slice(0, end);
}

function formatStringRow(row, maxPreviewLen = 160) {
  const val = row.value ?? '';
  const truncated = maxPreviewLen > 0 && val.length > maxPreviewLen;
  return {
    addr: row.addr_hex,
    addrHex: row.addr_hex,
    value: truncated ? sliceCodePointSafe(val, maxPreviewLen) : val,
    truncated,
    encoding: row.encoding,
    byteLen: row.byte_len,
    section: row.section,
    xrefCount: row.xref_count,
  };
}

export function searchStrings(
  binaryId,
  { query = '', minLen = 4, section = '', limit = 50, cursor = '', maxPreviewLen = 160 } = {},
) {
  const db = openIndex(binaryId, { readOnly: true });
  const clampedLimit = clampInt(limit, 1, 200, 50);
  const offset = decodeCursor(cursor);
  const minLenNum = Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(Number(minLen)) ? Math.trunc(Number(minLen)) : 4);
  const sectionFilter = String(section || '').trim();
  const trimmedQuery = String(query || '').trim();

  const commonWhere = [];
  const commonParams = [];
  if (minLenNum > 0) {
    commonWhere.push('LENGTH(s.value) >= ?');
    commonParams.push(minLenNum);
  }
  if (sectionFilter) {
    commonWhere.push('s.section = ?');
    commonParams.push(sectionFilter);
  }

  const runLikeSearch = () => {
    const where = [...commonWhere];
    const params = [...commonParams];
    if (trimmedQuery) {
      where.push("s.value LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\' COLLATE NOCASE");
      params.push(`%${escapeLike(trimmedQuery)}%`);
    }
    const whereSql = where.length > 0 ? `WHERE ${where.join(' AND ')}` : '';
    const total = db.prepare(`SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM strings s ${whereSql}`).get(...params).cnt;
    const rows = db
      .prepare(`
        SELECT s.addr_hex, s.value, s.encoding, s.byte_len, s.section, s.xref_count
        FROM strings s
        ${whereSql}
        ORDER BY (s.addr < 0), s.addr ASC
        LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
      `)
      .all(...params, clampedLimit, offset);

    const items = rows.map((r) => formatStringRow(r, maxPreviewLen));
    const nextOffset = offset + items.length;
    return {
      total,
      nextCursor: nextOffset < total ? encodeCursor(nextOffset) : null,
      items,
    };
  };

  if (!trimmedQuery) {
    return runLikeSearch();
  }

  const queryPlan = analyzeTextSearchQuery(trimmedQuery);
  if (queryPlan.mode !== 'fts') {
    return runLikeSearch();
  }

  try {
    const where = ['strings_fts MATCH ?', ...commonWhere];
    const params = [queryPlan.ftsExpr, ...commonParams];
    if (queryPlan.requireLike) {
      where.push("s.value LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\' COLLATE NOCASE");
      params.push(queryPlan.likePattern);
    }
    const whereSql = `WHERE ${where.join(' AND ')}`;

    const total = db
      .prepare(`
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM strings_fts
        JOIN strings s ON s.id = strings_fts.rowid
        ${whereSql}
      `)
      .get(...params).cnt;

    const rows = db
      .prepare(`
        SELECT s.addr_hex, s.value, s.encoding, s.byte_len, s.section, s.xref_count
        FROM strings_fts
        JOIN strings s ON s.id = strings_fts.rowid
        ${whereSql}
        ORDER BY rank, (s.addr < 0), s.addr ASC
        LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
      `)
      .all(...params, clampedLimit, offset);

    const items = rows.map((r) => formatStringRow(r, maxPreviewLen));
    const nextOffset = offset + items.length;
    return {
      total,
      nextCursor: nextOffset < total ? encodeCursor(nextOffset) : null,
      items,
    };
  } catch {
    return runLikeSearch();
  }
}

function resolveFunctionRow(db, target) {
  const raw = String(target ?? '').trim();
  if (!raw) {
    const err = new Error('Target function address or name is required');
    err.code = 'INVALID_PARAMS';
    err.status = 400;
    throw err;
  }

  const selectCols = `
    SELECT entry_hex, name, size_bytes, is_import, is_thunk, external_lib, caller_count, callee_count
    FROM functions
  `;

  if (/^0x[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(raw)) {
    const row = db.prepare(`${selectCols} WHERE entry_addr = ? LIMIT 1`).get(toSqlInt64(raw));
    if (row) return row;
  }

  const exactByName = db
    .prepare(`${selectCols} WHERE name = ? COLLATE NOCASE ORDER BY is_import ASC, (entry_addr < 0), entry_addr ASC LIMIT 1`)
    .get(raw);
  if (exactByName) return exactByName;

  if (/^[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(raw)) {
    const row = db.prepare(`${selectCols} WHERE entry_addr = ? LIMIT 1`).get(toSqlInt64(raw));
    if (row) return row;
  }

  const prefixByName = db
    .prepare(`${selectCols} WHERE name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\' COLLATE NOCASE ORDER BY LENGTH(name) ASC, is_import ASC, (entry_addr < 0), entry_addr ASC LIMIT 1`)
    .get(`${escapeLike(raw)}%`);
  if (prefixByName) return prefixByName;

  const err = new Error(`Function not found: ${raw}`);
  err.code = 'FUNCTION_NOT_FOUND';
  err.status = 404;
  throw err;
}

export function getCallGraphOffline(
  binaryId,
  target,
  { direction = 'both', depth = 2, maxNodes = 60 } = {},
) {
  const id = normalizeBinaryId(binaryId);
  const db = openIndex(id, { readOnly: true });
  const normalizedDir = direction === 'callers' || direction === 'callees' ? direction : 'both';
  const maxDepth = clampInt(depth, 0, 8, 2);
  const nodeLimit = clampInt(maxNodes, 1, 200, 60);

  const rootFn = resolveFunctionRow(db, target);
  const rootHex = rootFn.entry_hex;
  const meta = readMetaTable(db);
  const revision = Number(meta.revision ?? 0);

  const depthMap = new Map([[rootHex, 0]]);
  let truncated = false;

  if (maxDepth > 0 && nodeLimit > 1) {
    if (normalizedDir === 'callees' || normalizedDir === 'both') {
      const calleeRows = db
        .prepare(`
          WITH RECURSIVE walk(addr_hex, depth, path) AS (
            SELECT ?, 0, ',' || ? || ','
            UNION ALL
            SELECT e.callee_hex, w.depth + 1, w.path || e.callee_hex || ','
            FROM walk w
            JOIN call_edges e ON e.caller_hex = w.addr_hex
            WHERE w.depth < ?
              AND instr(w.path, ',' || e.callee_hex || ',') = 0
          )
          SELECT addr_hex, MIN(depth) AS min_depth
          FROM walk
          GROUP BY addr_hex
          ORDER BY min_depth ASC, addr_hex ASC
          LIMIT ?
        `)
        .all(rootHex, rootHex, maxDepth, nodeLimit + 1);

      if (calleeRows.length > nodeLimit) truncated = true;
      for (const r of calleeRows) {
        const prev = depthMap.get(r.addr_hex);
        if (prev === undefined || r.min_depth < prev) {
          depthMap.set(r.addr_hex, r.min_depth);
        }
      }
    }

    if (normalizedDir === 'callers' || normalizedDir === 'both') {
      const callerRows = db
        .prepare(`
          WITH RECURSIVE walk(addr_hex, depth, path) AS (
            SELECT ?, 0, ',' || ? || ','
            UNION ALL
            SELECT e.caller_hex, w.depth + 1, w.path || e.caller_hex || ','
            FROM walk w
            JOIN call_edges e ON e.callee_hex = w.addr_hex
            WHERE w.depth < ?
              AND instr(w.path, ',' || e.caller_hex || ',') = 0
          )
          SELECT addr_hex, MIN(depth) AS min_depth
          FROM walk
          GROUP BY addr_hex
          ORDER BY min_depth ASC, addr_hex ASC
          LIMIT ?
        `)
        .all(rootHex, rootHex, maxDepth, nodeLimit + 1);

      if (callerRows.length > nodeLimit) truncated = true;
      for (const r of callerRows) {
        const prev = depthMap.get(r.addr_hex);
        if (prev === undefined || r.min_depth < prev) {
          depthMap.set(r.addr_hex, r.min_depth);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  const orderedAddrs = [...depthMap.entries()]
    .sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1] || a[0].localeCompare(b[0]))
    .map(([addrHex]) => addrHex);

  if (orderedAddrs.length > nodeLimit) {
    truncated = true;
    orderedAddrs.length = nodeLimit;
  }

  const placeholders = orderedAddrs.map(() => '?').join(', ');
  const fnRows = db
    .prepare(`
      SELECT entry_hex, name, size_bytes, is_import, is_thunk, external_lib, caller_count, callee_count
      FROM functions
      WHERE entry_hex IN (${placeholders})
    `)
    .all(...orderedAddrs);

  const fnByHex = new Map();
  for (const r of fnRows) {
    fnByHex.set(r.entry_hex, {
      addr: r.entry_hex,
      name: r.name,
      sizeBytes: r.size_bytes,
      isImport: Boolean(r.is_import),
      isThunk: Boolean(r.is_thunk),
      externalLib: r.external_lib ?? null,
      callerCount: r.caller_count,
      calleeCount: r.callee_count,
    });
  }

  const nodes = orderedAddrs.map((addrHex) => {
    return (
      fnByHex.get(addrHex) || {
        addr: addrHex,
        name: addrHex,
        sizeBytes: 0,
        isImport: false,
        isThunk: false,
        externalLib: null,
        callerCount: 0,
        calleeCount: 0,
      }
    );
  });

  const edgeRows = db
    .prepare(`
      SELECT caller_hex, callee_hex, call_count
      FROM call_edges
      WHERE caller_hex IN (${placeholders})
        AND callee_hex IN (${placeholders})
      ORDER BY caller_hex ASC, callee_hex ASC
    `)
    .all(...orderedAddrs, ...orderedAddrs);

  const edges = edgeRows.map((e) => ({
    from: e.caller_hex,
    to: e.callee_hex,
    callSites: [],
    kind: 'CALL',
    callCount: e.call_count,
  }));

  return {
    binaryId: id,
    revision,
    root: rootHex,
    direction: normalizedDir,
    depth: maxDepth,
    truncated,
    nodes,
    edges,
  };
}

export function getCachedDecompile(binaryId, entryHex, expectedRevision = null) {
  const db = openIndex(binaryId, { readOnly: true });
  const row = db
    .prepare(`
      SELECT entry_hex, revision, func_name, plain_c, tokens_json, updated_at
      FROM decompile_cache
      WHERE entry_addr = ?
      LIMIT 1
    `)
    .get(toSqlInt64(entryHex));

  if (!row) return null;
  if (expectedRevision !== null && expectedRevision !== undefined && Number(row.revision) !== Number(expectedRevision)) {
    return null;
  }

  let tokens = null;
  try {
    tokens = row.tokens_json ? JSON.parse(row.tokens_json) : null;
  } catch {
    tokens = null;
  }

  return {
    entryHex: row.entry_hex,
    revision: row.revision,
    funcName: row.func_name,
    plainC: row.plain_c,
    tokens,
    tokensJson: row.tokens_json,
    updatedAt: row.updated_at,
  };
}

export function upsertDecompileCache(binaryId, payload, { maxCached = 5000 } = {}) {
  const db = openIndex(binaryId, { readOnly: false });
  const rawEntryHex = payload?.entryHex ?? payload?.entry ?? payload?.function?.entry;
  const entryAddr = preferHexInt64(rawEntryHex, payload?.entryAddr);
  const entryHex = normalizeHex(rawEntryHex, payload?.entryAddr);
  const revision = Number(payload?.revision ?? 0);
  const funcName = String(payload?.funcName ?? payload?.function?.name ?? entryHex);
  const plainC = String(
    payload?.plainC ?? payload?.plainText ?? payload?.code ?? (Array.isArray(payload?.plainLines) ? payload.plainLines.join('\n') : ''),
  );
  const tokensJson =
    typeof payload?.tokensJson === 'string'
      ? payload.tokensJson
      : JSON.stringify(payload?.tokens ?? payload?.lines ?? null);
  const updatedAt = Number(payload?.updatedAt ?? Date.now());
  const cap = Number.isFinite(Number(maxCached)) && Number(maxCached) > 0 ? Math.trunc(Number(maxCached)) : 0;

  runInTransaction(db, () => {
    prepWrite(db, `
      INSERT INTO decompile_cache(entry_addr, entry_hex, revision, func_name, plain_c, tokens_json, updated_at)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      ON CONFLICT(entry_addr) DO UPDATE SET
        entry_hex = excluded.entry_hex,
        revision = excluded.revision,
        func_name = excluded.func_name,
        plain_c = excluded.plain_c,
        tokens_json = excluded.tokens_json,
        updated_at = excluded.updated_at
    `).run(entryAddr, entryHex, revision, funcName, plainC, tokensJson, updatedAt);

    if (cap > 0) {
      prepWrite(db, `
        DELETE FROM decompile_cache
        WHERE id IN (
          SELECT id FROM decompile_cache
          ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
          LIMIT -1 OFFSET ?
        )
      `).run(cap);
    }
  });

  try {
    db.exec('PRAGMA shrink_memory');
  } catch {
    // Ignore shrink_memory errors on older SQLite builds.
  }

  return { ok: true, entryHex, revision, updatedAt };
}

export function batchUpsertDecompileCache(binaryId, items = [], { maxCached = 25000 } = {}) {
  const list = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
  if (list.length === 0) {
    return { ok: true, upserted: 0 };
  }
  const db = openIndex(binaryId, { readOnly: false });
  const now = Date.now();
  const cap = Number.isFinite(Number(maxCached)) && Number(maxCached) > 0 ? Math.trunc(Number(maxCached)) : 0;
  let upserted = 0;

  runInTransaction(db, () => {
    const stmt = prepWrite(db, `
      INSERT INTO decompile_cache(entry_addr, entry_hex, revision, func_name, plain_c, tokens_json, updated_at)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      ON CONFLICT(entry_addr) DO UPDATE SET
        entry_hex = excluded.entry_hex,
        revision = excluded.revision,
        func_name = excluded.func_name,
        plain_c = excluded.plain_c,
        tokens_json = CASE
          WHEN excluded.tokens_json IS NOT NULL AND excluded.tokens_json != 'null' THEN excluded.tokens_json
          ELSE decompile_cache.tokens_json
        END,
        updated_at = excluded.updated_at
    `);

    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      const payload = list[i];
      if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') continue;
      const rawEntryHex = payload.entryHex ?? payload.entry ?? payload.function?.entry;
      if (!rawEntryHex && payload.entryAddr === undefined) continue;
      const entryAddr = preferHexInt64(rawEntryHex, payload.entryAddr);
      const entryHex = normalizeHex(rawEntryHex, payload.entryAddr);
      const revision = Number(payload.revision ?? 0);
      const funcName = String(payload.funcName ?? payload.function?.name ?? entryHex);
      const plainC = String(
        payload.plainC ?? payload.plainText ?? payload.code ?? (Array.isArray(payload.plainLines) ? payload.plainLines.join('\n') : ''),
      );
      const tokensJson =
        typeof payload.tokensJson === 'string'
          ? payload.tokensJson
          : JSON.stringify(payload.tokens ?? payload.lines ?? null);
      const updatedAt = Number(payload.updatedAt ?? (now + i));
      stmt.run(entryAddr, entryHex, revision, funcName, plainC, tokensJson, updatedAt);
      upserted++;
    }

    if (cap > 0) {
      prepWrite(db, `
        DELETE FROM decompile_cache
        WHERE id IN (
          SELECT id FROM decompile_cache
          ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
          LIMIT -1 OFFSET ?
        )
      `).run(cap);
    }
  });

  try {
    db.exec('PRAGMA shrink_memory');
  } catch {
    // Ignore shrink_memory errors on older SQLite builds.
  }

  return { ok: true, upserted };
}

export function invalidateDecompileCache(binaryId, entryHexes = []) {
  const db = openIndex(binaryId, { readOnly: false });

  if (entryHexes === null) {
    const info = runInTransaction(db, () => prepWrite(db, 'DELETE FROM decompile_cache').run());
    return { deleted: Number(info.changes) };
  }

  const list = Array.isArray(entryHexes) ? entryHexes : [entryHexes];
  if (list.length === 0) {
    return { deleted: 0 };
  }

  let deleted = 0;
  runInTransaction(db, () => {
    const delStmt = prepWrite(db, 'DELETE FROM decompile_cache WHERE entry_addr = ?');
    for (const hex of list) {
      if (hex == null || hex === '') continue;
      deleted += Number(delStmt.run(toSqlInt64(hex)).changes);
    }
  });
  return { deleted };
}

export function patchFunctionRename(binaryId, entryHex, newName, newSignature = null, revision = null) {
  const db = openIndex(binaryId, { readOnly: false });
  const entryAddr = toSqlInt64(entryHex);

  return runInTransaction(db, () => {
    const changes = Number(
      prepWrite(db, `
        UPDATE functions
        SET name = COALESCE(?, name),
            signature = COALESCE(?, signature)
        WHERE entry_addr = ?
      `).run(
        newName !== undefined && newName !== null ? String(newName) : null,
        newSignature !== undefined && newSignature !== null ? String(newSignature) : null,
        entryAddr,
      ).changes,
    );

    if (revision !== null && revision !== undefined) {
      prepWrite(db, "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO meta(key, value) VALUES ('revision', ?)").run(String(revision));
    }
    return { updated: changes };
  });
}

export function patchFunctionCommentFlag(binaryId, entryHex, hasComment, revision = null) {
  const db = openIndex(binaryId, { readOnly: false });
  const entryAddr = toSqlInt64(entryHex);

  return runInTransaction(db, () => {
    const changes = Number(
      prepWrite(db, 'UPDATE functions SET has_comment = ? WHERE entry_addr = ?').run(
        hasComment ? 1 : 0,
        entryAddr,
      ).changes,
    );

    if (revision !== null && revision !== undefined) {
      prepWrite(db, "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO meta(key, value) VALUES ('revision', ?)").run(String(revision));
    }
    return { updated: changes };
  });
}

export function updateRevision(binaryId, revision) {
  const db = openIndex(binaryId, { readOnly: false });
  prepWrite(db, "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO meta(key, value) VALUES ('revision', ?)").run(String(revision));
  return { revision: Number(revision) };
}

export function syncMutationCacheState(binaryId, { revision = null, invalidatedFuncs = [] } = {}) {
  const db = openIndex(binaryId, { readOnly: false });
  const list = Array.isArray(invalidatedFuncs)
    ? invalidatedFuncs
    : invalidatedFuncs
      ? [invalidatedFuncs]
      : [];

  return runInTransaction(db, () => {
    const oldRevRow = db.prepare("SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key = 'revision'").get();
    const oldRev =
      oldRevRow && oldRevRow.value !== undefined && oldRevRow.value !== null && Number.isFinite(Number(oldRevRow.value))
        ? Number(oldRevRow.value)
        : null;

    let deleted = 0;
    if (list.length > 0) {
      const delStmt = prepWrite(db, 'DELETE FROM decompile_cache WHERE entry_addr = ?');
      for (const hex of list) {
        if (hex == null || hex === '') continue;
        deleted += Number(delStmt.run(toSqlInt64(hex)).changes);
      }
    }

    let promoted = 0;
    const hasRev =
      revision !== null &&
      revision !== undefined &&
      revision !== '' &&
      Number.isFinite(Number(revision));
    if (hasRev) {
      const nextRev = Number(revision);
      if (oldRev !== null && Number.isFinite(oldRev) && nextRev === oldRev + 1) {
        promoted = Number(
          prepWrite(db, 'UPDATE decompile_cache SET revision = ? WHERE revision = ?').run(nextRev, oldRev).changes,
        );
      }
      prepWrite(db, "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO meta(key, value) VALUES ('revision', ?)").run(String(nextRev));
    }

    return {
      deleted,
      promoted,
      oldRevision: oldRev,
      revision: hasRev ? Number(revision) : oldRev,
    };
  });
}

export function searchPseudocode(binaryId, { query, limit = 25 } = {}) {
  const db = openIndex(binaryId, { readOnly: true });
  const clampedLimit = clampInt(limit, 1, 100, 25);
  const indexedFunctions = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM decompile_cache').get().cnt;
  const totalFunctions = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM functions').get().cnt;
  const coveragePct = totalFunctions > 0 ? Math.round((indexedFunctions / totalFunctions) * 1000) / 10 : 0;

  const trimmedQuery = String(query || '').trim();
  if (!trimmedQuery || indexedFunctions === 0) {
    return { indexedFunctions, totalFunctions, coveragePct, matches: [] };
  }

  const runLikeFallback = () => {
    const escaped = `%${escapeLike(trimmedQuery)}%`;
    const rows = db
      .prepare(`
        SELECT entry_hex, func_name, plain_c
        FROM decompile_cache
        WHERE plain_c LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\' COLLATE NOCASE
           OR func_name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\' COLLATE NOCASE
        ORDER BY updated_at DESC
        LIMIT ?
      `)
      .all(escaped, escaped, clampedLimit);

    const lowerQ = trimmedQuery.toLowerCase();
    const matches = rows.map((row) => {
      const idx = row.plain_c.toLowerCase().indexOf(lowerQ);
      let snippet;
      if (idx === -1) {
        snippet = row.plain_c.slice(0, 140);
      } else {
        const start = Math.max(0, idx - 50);
        const end = Math.min(row.plain_c.length, idx + trimmedQuery.length + 70);
        snippet = `${start > 0 ? '...' : ''}${row.plain_c.slice(start, end)}${end < row.plain_c.length ? '...' : ''}`;
      }
      return {
        entry: row.entry_hex,
        name: row.func_name,
        snippet,
      };
    });

    return { indexedFunctions, totalFunctions, coveragePct, matches };
  };

  const queryPlan = analyzeTextSearchQuery(trimmedQuery);
  if (queryPlan.mode !== 'fts') {
    return runLikeFallback();
  }

  try {
    const extraLikeClause = queryPlan.requireLike
      ? "AND (d.plain_c LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\' COLLATE NOCASE OR d.func_name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\' COLLATE NOCASE)"
      : '';
    const params = queryPlan.requireLike
      ? [queryPlan.ftsExpr, queryPlan.likePattern, queryPlan.likePattern, clampedLimit]
      : [queryPlan.ftsExpr, clampedLimit];
    const rows = db
      .prepare(`
        SELECT d.entry_hex, d.func_name,
               snippet(decompile_fts, 1, '[', ']', ' ... ', 20) AS snippet
        FROM decompile_fts
        JOIN decompile_cache d ON d.id = decompile_fts.rowid
        WHERE decompile_fts MATCH ?
        ${extraLikeClause}
        ORDER BY rank
        LIMIT ?
      `)
      .all(...params);

    return {
      indexedFunctions,
      totalFunctions,
      coveragePct,
      matches: rows.map((r) => ({
        entry: r.entry_hex,
        name: r.func_name,
        snippet: r.snippet,
      })),
    };
  } catch {
    return runLikeFallback();
  }
}
```

```mjs
const __dirname = dirname(__filename);

export const PLUGIN_ROOT = resolve(__dirname, '..');
export const DAEMON_SRC_DIR = join(PLUGIN_ROOT, 'daemon', 'src');

export function getDataDir() {
  if (process.env.GHIDRA_RE_DATA_DIR) {
    return resolve(process.env.GHIDRA_RE_DATA_DIR);
  }
  const xdgData = process.env.XDG_DATA_HOME || join(os.homedir(), '.local', 'share');

export function getProjectDir(sha256) {
  if (!sha256 || typeof sha256 !== 'string' || !/^[a-fA-F0-9]{8,64}$/.test(sha256)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid binary SHA-256 identifier: ${String(sha256)}`);
  }
  return join(getProjectsDir(), sha256.toLowerCase());
}

export function ensureDir(dir, mode = 0o700) {
  const existed = fs.existsSync(dir);
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true, mode });
  if (!existed) {
    try {
      fs.chmodSync(dir, mode);
    } catch {
      // Ignore chmod failures on filesystems that disallow it.
    }
  }
  return dir;
}

function isExecutableFile(filePath) {
  try {
    const stat = fs.statSync(filePath);
    if (!stat.isFile()) return false;
    fs.accessSync(filePath, fs.constants.X_OK);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function whichExecutable(cmdName) {
  const pathEnv = process.env.PATH || '';
  for (const dir of pathEnv.split(':')) {
    if (!dir) continue;
    const candidate = join(dir, cmdName);
    if (isExecutableFile(candidate)) {
      return candidate;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function safeRealpath(targetPath) {
  try {
    return fs.realpathSync(targetPath);
  } catch {
    return resolve(targetPath);
  }
}

function parseApplicationProperties(appPropsPath) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(appPropsPath, 'utf8');
  const match = content.match(/^application\.version=(.*)$/m);
  return match ? match[1].trim() : null;
}

function validateGhidraDir(candidateDir) {
  if (!candidateDir) return null;
  const resolved = safeRealpath(candidateDir);
  const utilityJar = join(resolved, 'Ghidra', 'Framework', 'Utility', 'lib', 'Utility.jar');
  const appProps = join(resolved, 'Ghidra', 'application.properties');
  const launchPropertiesPath = join(resolved, 'support', 'launch.properties');

  let ghidraVersion = null;
  try {
    if (!fs.statSync(utilityJar).isFile()) return null;
    if (!fs.statSync(appProps).isFile()) return null;
    ghidraVersion = parseApplicationProperties(appProps);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }

  if (!ghidraVersion) return null;

  return {
    ghidraDir: resolved,
    ghidraVersion,
    utilityJar,
    launchPropertiesPath: fs.existsSync(launchPropertiesPath) ? launchPropertiesPath : null,
  };
}

function discoverGhidraFromPath() {
  const headless = whichExecutable('analyzeHeadless');
  if (!headless) return null;
  const realHeadless = safeRealpath(headless);
  let cur = dirname(realHeadless);
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const valid = validateGhidraDir(cur);
    if (valid) return valid;
    const parent = dirname(cur);
    if (parent === cur) break;
    cur = parent;
  }
  return null;
}

function parseJavaVersionOutput(output) {
  if (!output) return null;
  const quoted = output.match(/version\s+"([^"]+)"/);
  const raw = quoted ? quoted[1] : output.trim().split(/\s+/).pop();
  if (!raw) return null;
  const parts = raw.replace(/^1\./, '').match(/^(\d+)/);
  if (!parts) return null;
  const major = Number.parseInt(parts[1], 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(major)) return null;
  return { version: raw, major };
}

function parseJavacVersionOutput(output) {
  if (!output) return null;
  const match = output.match(/javac\s+([^\s\r\n]+)/);
  if (!match) return null;
  const raw = match[1];
  const parts = raw.replace(/^1\./, '').match(/^(\d+)/);
  if (!parts) return null;
  const major = Number.parseInt(parts[1], 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(major)) return null;
  return { version: raw, major };
}

function listCandidateJdksInDir(baseDir) {
  const results = [];
  try {
    const entries = fs.readdirSync(baseDir, { withFileTypes: true });
    for (const entry of entries) {
      if (!entry.isDirectory() && !entry.isSymbolicLink()) continue;
      const m = entry.name.match(/^(?:jdk-?|java-)(\d+)/i);
      if (!m) continue;
      const major = Number.parseInt(m[1], 10);
      if (major >= 25) {
        results.push({ path: join(baseDir, entry.name), major, name: entry.name });
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Directory may not exist.
  }
  results.sort((a, b) => b.major - a.major || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  return results.map((r) => r.path);
}

function runVersionCmd(binPath, args) {
  const res = spawnSync(binPath, args, { encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 5000 });
  if (res.error || res.status !== 0) {
    return { ok: false, output: `${res.stdout || ''}\n${res.stderr || ''}`.trim(), error: res.error?.message };
  }
  return { ok: true, output: `${res.stdout || ''}\n${res.stderr || ''}`.trim() };
}

function inspectJdkHome(candidateHome, checkedLog) {
  if (!candidateHome) return null;
  const javaHome = safeRealpath(candidateHome);
  const javaBin = join(javaHome, 'bin', 'java');
  const javacBin = join(javaHome, 'bin', 'javac');
  const jarBin = join(javaHome, 'bin', 'jar');

  if (!isExecutableFile(javaBin) || !isExecutableFile(javacBin) || !isExecutableFile(jarBin)) {
    checkedLog.push({ path: candidateHome, reason: 'missing java, javac, or jar binary' });
    return null;
  }

  const javaVerRes = runVersionCmd(javaBin, ['-version']);
  if (!javaVerRes.ok) {
    checkedLog.push({ path: javaHome, reason: `java -version failed: ${javaVerRes.error || javaVerRes.output}` });
    return null;
  }
  const parsedJava = parseJavaVersionOutput(javaVerRes.output);
  if (!parsedJava || parsedJava.major < 25) {
    checkedLog.push({ path: javaHome, reason: `java major version ${parsedJava?.major ?? 'unknown'} < 25` });
    return null;
  }

  const javacVerRes = runVersionCmd(javacBin, ['-version']);
  if (!javacVerRes.ok) {
    checkedLog.push({ path: javaHome, reason: `javac -version failed: ${javacVerRes.error || javacVerRes.output}` });
    return null;
  }
  const parsedJavac = parseJavacVersionOutput(javacVerRes.output);
  if (!parsedJavac || parsedJavac.major < 25) {
    checkedLog.push({ path: javaHome, reason: `javac major version ${parsedJavac?.major ?? 'unknown'} < 25` });
    return null;
  }

  return {
    javaHome,
    javaBin,
    javacBin,
    jarBin,
    jdkVersion: parsedJava.version,
    jdkMajor: parsedJava.major,
  };
}

export function discoverEnvironment(config = {}) {
  const checkedGhidra = [];
  const ghidraCandidates = [
    config?.ghidraInstallDir,
    process.env.GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR,
    '/opt/ghidra',
    '/usr/share/ghidra',
    join(os.homedir(), '.local', 'opt', 'ghidra'),
  ].filter(Boolean);

  let ghidra = null;
  for (const candidate of ghidraCandidates) {
    checkedGhidra.push(candidate);
    ghidra = validateGhidraDir(candidate);
    if (ghidra) break;
  }
  if (!ghidra) {
    checkedGhidra.push('PATH:analyzeHeadless');
    ghidra = discoverGhidraFromPath();
  }

  if (!ghidra) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      code: 'PREREQ_MISSING_GHIDRA',
      message: 'Ghidra installation not found. Set GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR or configure ghidraInstallDir.',
      details: { checked: checkedGhidra },
    };
  }

  const checkedJdk = [];
  const seenJdkHomes = new Set();
  const jdkCandidates = [];
  const pushJdkCandidate = (p) => {
    if (!p) return;
    const real = safeRealpath(p);
    if (!seenJdkHomes.has(real)) {
      seenJdkHomes.add(real);
      jdkCandidates.push(p);
    }
  };

  pushJdkCandidate(config?.javaHome);
  pushJdkCandidate(process.env.JAVA_HOME);
  pushJdkCandidate(join(os.homedir(), '.local', 'opt', 'jdk-25'));
  for (const p of listCandidateJdksInDir(join(os.homedir(), '.local', 'opt'))) pushJdkCandidate(p);
  for (const p of listCandidateJdksInDir('/usr/lib/jvm')) pushJdkCandidate(p);

  const whichJava = whichExecutable('java');
  if (whichJava) {
    const realJava = safeRealpath(whichJava);
    pushJdkCandidate(dirname(dirname(realJava)));
  }

  let jdk = null;
  for (const candidate of jdkCandidates) {
    jdk = inspectJdkHome(candidate, checkedJdk);
    if (jdk) break;
  }

  if (!jdk) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      code: 'PREREQ_MISSING_JDK',
      message: 'JDK 25+ with java, javac, and jar not found. Set JAVA_HOME or install JDK 25.',
      details: { checked: checkedJdk },
    };
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    ghidraDir: ghidra.ghidraDir,
    ghidraVersion: ghidra.ghidraVersion,
    utilityJar: ghidra.utilityJar,
    launchPropertiesPath: ghidra.launchPropertiesPath,
    javaHome: jdk.javaHome,
    javaBin: jdk.javaBin,
    javacBin: jdk.javacBin,
    jarBin: jdk.jarBin,
    jdkVersion: jdk.jdkVersion,
    jdkMajor: jdk.jdkMajor,
  };
}

export function parseLaunchProperties(launchPropertiesPath) {
  if (!launchPropertiesPath || !fs.existsSync(launchPropertiesPath)) {
    return [];
  }
  const content = fs.readFileSync(launchPropertiesPath, 'utf8');
  const args = [];
  for (const rawLine of content.split(/\r?\n/)) {
    const line = rawLine.trim();
    if (!line || line.startsWith('#')) continue;

    let value = null;
    if (line.startsWith('VMARGS=')) {
      value = line.slice('VMARGS='.length).trim();
    } else if (line.startsWith('VMARGS_LINUX=')) {
      value = line.slice('VMARGS_LINUX='.length).trim();
    } else {
      continue;
    }

    if (!value) continue;
    if (
      value.startsWith('-Dsun.java2d.') ||
      value.startsWith('-Dawt.') ||
      value.startsWith('-Dfont.size.override')
    ) {
      continue;
    }
    if (/^-D[^=]+=$/.test(value)) {
      continue;
    }
    args.push(value);
  }
  return args;
}

export function computeFileSha256(filePath) {
  return new Promise((resolvePromise, rejectPromise) => {
    const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256');
    const stream = fs.createReadStream(filePath);
    stream.on('data', (chunk) => hash.update(chunk));
    stream.on('error', (err) => rejectPromise(err));
    stream.on('end', () => resolvePromise(hash.digest('hex')));
  });
}

export function isPidAlive(pid) {
  const num = typeof pid === 'number' ? pid : Number.parseInt(String(pid), 10);
  if (!Number.isInteger(num) || num <= 0) return false;
  try {
    process.kill(num, 0);
  } catch (err) {
    if (err.code !== 'EPERM') return false;
  }
  try {
    const stat = fs.readFileSync(`/proc/${num}/stat`, 'utf8');
    const rparen = stat.lastIndexOf(')');
    if (rparen !== -1) {
      const state = stat.slice(rparen + 2, rparen + 3);
      if (state === 'Z' || state === 'X') return false;
    }
  } catch {
    // /proc/<pid>/stat may disappear or be unreadable on non-proc / race.
  }
  return true;
}

export function readProcCmdline(pid) {
  const num = typeof pid === 'number' ? pid : Number.parseInt(String(pid), 10);
  if (!Number.isInteger(num) || num <= 0) return null;
  try {
    const buf = fs.readFileSync(`/proc/${num}/cmdline`);
    return buf.toString('utf8').replace(/\0/g, ' ').trim();
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
```

```mjs
});

function resolveRootPath(uriOrPath) {
  if (typeof uriOrPath !== 'string') return null;
  const raw = uriOrPath.trim();
  if (!raw) return null;

  let fsPath;
  if (raw.startsWith('file://')) {
    try {
      fsPath = fileURLToPath(raw);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  } else if (isAbsolute(raw)) {
    fsPath = raw;
  } else {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    const real = fs.realpathSync(fsPath);
    const stat = fs.statSync(real);
    if (!stat.isDirectory()) return null;
    return real;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function mapMachoFiletype(filetype) {
  switch (filetype) {
    case 2:
      return 'EXEC';
    case 6:
      return 'DYLIB';
    case 8:
      return 'BUNDLE';
    case 1:
      return 'OBJECT';
    default:
      return 'OTHER';
  }
}

function parseElfHeader(buf) {
  const eiClass = buf[4];
  const eiData = buf[5];
  if ((eiClass !== 1 && eiClass !== 2) || (eiData !== 1 && eiData !== 2)) {
    return null;
  }
  const bits = eiClass === 2 ? 64 : 32;
  const endian = eiData === 1 ? 'little' : 'big';
  const eType = endian === 'little' ? buf.readUInt16LE(16) : buf.readUInt16BE(16);
  const eMachine = endian === 'little' ? buf.readUInt16LE(18) : buf.readUInt16BE(18);

  let kind;
  if (eType === 2) kind = 'EXEC';
  else if (eType === 3) kind = 'DYN';
  else if (eType === 1) kind = 'REL';
  else kind = `unknown(0x${eType.toString(16)})`;

  const arch = ELF_ARCH_MAP[eMachine] ?? `unknown(0x${eMachine.toString(16)})`;
  return { format: 'ELF', arch, bits, endian, kind };
}

function parsePeHeader(fd, buf, fileSize) {
  const eLfanew = buf.readUInt32LE(0x3c);
  if (eLfanew < 0x40 || eLfanew + 24 > fileSize) {
    return null;
  }

  const peHdr = Buffer.allocUnsafe(24);
  const bytesRead = fs.readSync(fd, peHdr, 0, 24, eLfanew);
  if (bytesRead < 24) {
    return null;
  }
  if (peHdr[0] !== 0x50 || peHdr[1] !== 0x45 || peHdr[2] !== 0x00 || peHdr[3] !== 0x00) {
    return null;
  }

  const machine = peHdr.readUInt16LE(4);
  const characteristics = peHdr.readUInt16LE(22);
  const known = PE_MACHINE_MAP[machine];
  let bits = known?.bits ?? null;
  if (bits === null && eLfanew + 26 <= fileSize) {
    const optMagicBuf = Buffer.allocUnsafe(2);
    if (fs.readSync(fd, optMagicBuf, 0, 2, eLfanew + 24) === 2) {
      const optMagic = optMagicBuf.readUInt16LE(0);
      if (optMagic === 0x020b) bits = 64;
      else if (optMagic === 0x010b) bits = 32;
    }
  }
  if (bits === null) {
    bits = (characteristics & 0x0100) !== 0 ? 32 : 64;
  }

  return {
    format: 'PE',
    arch: known?.arch ?? `unknown(0x${machine.toString(16)})`,
    bits,
    endian: 'little',
    kind: (characteristics & 0x2000) !== 0 ? 'DLL' : 'EXEC',
  };
}

function parseMachoSingle(buf, magicBe) {
  let endian;
  let bits;
  if (magicBe === 0xfeedface) {
    endian = 'big';
    bits = 32;
  } else if (magicBe === 0xcefaedfe) {
    endian = 'little';
    bits = 32;
  } else if (magicBe === 0xfeedfacf) {
    endian = 'big';
    bits = 64;
  } else if (magicBe === 0xcffaedfe) {
    endian = 'little';
    bits = 64;
  } else {
    return null;
  }

  const cputype = (endian === 'little' ? buf.readUInt32LE(4) : buf.readUInt32BE(4)) >>> 0;
  const filetype = (endian === 'little' ? buf.readUInt32LE(12) : buf.readUInt32BE(12)) >>> 0;
  const arch = MACHO_CPU_MAP[cputype] ?? `unknown(0x${cputype.toString(16)})`;

  return {
    format: 'Mach-O',
    arch,
    bits,
    endian,
    kind: mapMachoFiletype(filetype),
  };
}

function parseMachoFat(fd, buf, fileName, fileSize) {
  if (fileName.toLowerCase().endsWith('.class')) {
    return null;
  }
  const nfatArch = buf.readUInt32BE(4);
  if (nfatArch < 1 || nfatArch >= 20) {
    return null;
  }
  const needed = 8 + nfatArch * 20;
  if (needed > fileSize) {
    return null;
  }

  const archNames = [];
  let has64 = false;
  const maxInspect = Math.min(nfatArch, 19);
  const archBuf = Buffer.allocUnsafe(maxInspect * 20);
  const got = fs.readSync(fd, archBuf, 0, archBuf.length, 8);
  const count = Math.floor(got / 20);
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const cputype = archBuf.readUInt32BE(i * 20) >>> 0;
    if ((cputype & 0x01000000) !== 0) {
      has64 = true;
    }
    const archName = MACHO_CPU_MAP[cputype] ?? `unknown(0x${cputype.toString(16)})`;
    if (!archNames.includes(archName)) {
      archNames.push(archName);
    }
  }

  return {
    format: 'Mach-O',
    arch: archNames.length > 0 ? archNames.join('+') : 'universal',
    bits: has64 ? 64 : 32,
    endian: 'universal',
    kind: 'UNIVERSAL',
  };
}

function inspectBinaryHeader(filePath, fileName, fileSize) {
  if (fileSize < 64) return null;
  const fd = fs.openSync(filePath, 'r');
  try {
    const hdr = Buffer.allocUnsafe(64);
    const bytesRead = fs.readSync(fd, hdr, 0, 64, 0);
    if (bytesRead < 64) return null;

    if (hdr[0] === 0x7f && hdr[1] === 0x45 && hdr[2] === 0x4c && hdr[3] === 0x46) {
      return parseElfHeader(hdr);
    }

    if (hdr[0] === 0x4d && hdr[1] === 0x5a) {
      return parsePeHeader(fd, hdr, fileSize);
    }

    const magicBe = hdr.readUInt32BE(0) >>> 0;
    if (
      magicBe === 0xfeedface ||
      magicBe === 0xcefaedfe ||
      magicBe === 0xfeedfacf ||
      magicBe === 0xcffaedfe
    ) {
      return parseMachoSingle(hdr, magicBe);
    }

    if (magicBe === 0xcafebabe) {
      return parseMachoFat(fd, hdr, fileName, fileSize);
    }

    return null;
  } finally {
    fs.closeSync(fd);
  }
}

/**
 * Scans workspace root URIs/paths via bounded BFS for ELF, PE, and Mach-O binaries.
 */
export function scanWorkspaceBinaries(
  workspaceUris,
  { maxDepth = 4, maxFiles = 200, maxScannedFiles = 5000 } = {},
) {
  const inputs = Array.isArray(workspaceUris) ? workspaceUris : [];
  const depthLimit = Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(Number(maxDepth)) ? Math.trunc(Number(maxDepth)) : 4);
  const fileCap = Math.max(1, Number.isFinite(Number(maxFiles)) ? Math.trunc(Number(maxFiles)) : 200);
  const scanCap = Math.max(1, Number.isFinite(Number(maxScannedFiles)) ? Math.trunc(Number(maxScannedFiles)) : 5000);

  const scannedRoots = [];
  const visitedDirs = new Set();
  const queue = [];

  for (const item of inputs) {
    const realRoot = resolveRootPath(item);
    if (!realRoot || visitedDirs.has(realRoot)) continue;
    visitedDirs.add(realRoot);
    scannedRoots.push(realRoot);
    queue.push({ dirPath: realRoot, rootPath: realRoot, depth: 0 });
  }

  const binaries = [];
  let scannedFiles = 0;
  let truncated = false;

  outer: for (let qIdx = 0; qIdx < queue.length; qIdx++) {
    const { dirPath, rootPath, depth } = queue[qIdx];
    let entries;
    try {
      entries = fs.readdirSync(dirPath, { withFileTypes: true });
    } catch {
      continue;
    }

    for (const entry of entries) {
      if (binaries.length >= fileCap || scannedFiles >= scanCap) {
        truncated = true;
        break outer;
      }

      const fullPath = join(dirPath, entry.name);
      let isDir = entry.isDirectory();
      let isFile = entry.isFile();
      let stat = null;

      if (entry.isSymbolicLink()) {
        try {
          stat = fs.statSync(fullPath);
          isDir = stat.isDirectory();
          isFile = stat.isFile();
        } catch {
          continue;
        }
      }

      if (isDir) {
        if (SKIP_DIRS.has(entry.name)) continue;
        if (depth >= depthLimit) continue;
        let realSub;
        try {
          realSub = fs.realpathSync(fullPath);
        } catch {
          continue;
        }
        if (visitedDirs.has(realSub)) continue;
        visitedDirs.add(realSub);
        queue.push({ dirPath: fullPath, rootPath, depth: depth + 1 });
        continue;
      }

      if (!isFile) continue;

      if (!stat) {
        try {
          stat = fs.statSync(fullPath);
        } catch {
          continue;
        }
      }
      if (!stat.isFile()) continue;

      scannedFiles++;
      let parsed = null;
      try {
        parsed = inspectBinaryHeader(fullPath, entry.name, stat.size);
      } catch {
        parsed = null;
      }

      if (parsed) {
        binaries.push({
          path: fullPath,
          name: basename(fullPath),
          relPath: relative(rootPath, fullPath) || entry.name,
          rootPath,
          sizeBytes: stat.size,
          mtimeMs: stat.mtimeMs,
          format: parsed.format,
          arch: parsed.arch,
          bits: parsed.bits,
          endian: parsed.endian,
          kind: parsed.kind,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  binaries.sort((a, b) => b.mtimeMs - a.mtimeMs || a.path.localeCompare(b.path));

  return {
    scannedRoots,
    truncated,
    scannedFiles,
    binaries,
  };
}
```

```mjs
const UI_OPTS = Object.freeze({ priority: 'ui', actor: 'ui' });

const CSP_HEADER =
  "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; worker-src 'self' blob:; frame-src 'none'; child-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'";

class ApiInputError extends Error {
  constructor(message, { code = 'INVALID_PARAMS', status = 400, retryable = false, details = null } = {}) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ApiInputError';
    this.code = code;
    this.status = status;
    this.retryable = Boolean(retryable);
    this.details = details ?? null;
  }
}

function clampInt(val, min, max, fallback) {
  if (val === undefined || val === null || val === '') return fallback;
  const num = Number(val);
  if (!Number.isFinite(num)) return fallback;
  return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, Math.trunc(num)));
}

function requireString(val, fieldName) {
  if (typeof val !== 'string' || val.trim().length === 0) {
    throw new ApiInputError(`Parameter '${fieldName}' must be a non-empty string`);
  }
  return val.trim();
}

function optionalString(val, fallback = '') {
  if (val === undefined || val === null) return fallback;
  return String(val);
}

function readJsonFileSafe(filePath) {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8'));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function readSelfRssMb() {
  try {
    const status = fs.readFileSync('/proc/self/status', 'utf8');
    const m = status.match(/^VmRSS:\s+(\d+)\s+kB/m);
    if (m) {
      const kb = Number.parseInt(m[1], 10);
      if (Number.isFinite(kb)) {
        return Math.round((kb / 1024) * 10) / 10;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Fallback to process.memoryUsage().rss below.
  }
  return Math.round((process.memoryUsage().rss / (1024 * 1024)) * 10) / 10;
}

function resolveProjectBinaryId(binaryId) {
  const raw = requireString(binaryId, 'binaryId').toLowerCase();
  if (!HEX_ID_RE.test(raw)) {
    throw new ApiInputError(`Invalid binaryId '${binaryId}': expected 8-64 hex characters`);
  }
  if (FULL_SHA256_RE.test(raw)) {
    return raw;
  }
  const projectsDir = getProjectsDir();
  try {
    const entries = fs.readdirSync(projectsDir, { withFileTypes: true });
    const matches = [];
    for (const entry of entries) {
      if (!entry.isDirectory()) continue;
      const name = entry.name.toLowerCase();
      if (FULL_SHA256_RE.test(name) && name.startsWith(raw)) {
        matches.push(name);
      }
    }
    if (matches.length === 1) {
      return matches[0];
    }
    if (matches.length > 1) {
      throw new ApiInputError(`Ambiguous binaryId prefix '${binaryId}'`, {
        code: 'INVALID_PARAMS',
        status: 400,
        details: { matches },
      });
    }
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof ApiInputError) throw err;
  }
  return raw;
}

function hasOfflineIndex(binaryId) {
  try {
    if (!fs.statSync(join(getProjectDir(binaryId), 'index.sqlite')).isFile()) {
      return false;
    }
    const meta = getBinaryMeta(binaryId)?.meta;
    return Boolean(meta && meta.revision !== undefined && meta.revision !== null);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function findCandidatePathFromMeta(meta) {
  if (!meta || typeof meta !== 'object') return '';
  if (typeof meta.primaryPath === 'string' && meta.primaryPath.trim() && fs.existsSync(meta.primaryPath.trim())) {
    return meta.primaryPath.trim();
  }
  if (Array.isArray(meta.originalPaths)) {
    const found = meta.originalPaths.find((p) => typeof p === 'string' && p.trim() && fs.existsSync(p.trim()));
    if (found) return found.trim();
  }
  return '';
}

function getLocalIndexRevision(binaryId) {
  if (!hasOfflineIndex(binaryId)) return -1;
  try {
    const rev = Number(getBinaryMeta(binaryId).meta?.revision ?? 0);
    return Number.isFinite(rev) ? rev : 0;
  } catch {
    return -1;
  }
}

async function syncIndexIfStale(binaryId, daemonRevision, forceSync = false) {
  const localRev = getLocalIndexRevision(binaryId);
  const targetRev = Number.isFinite(Number(daemonRevision)) ? Number(daemonRevision) : 0;
  if (!forceSync && localRev >= 0 && localRev >= targetRev) {
    return { synced: false, unchanged: true, revision: localRev };
  }
  const syncRes = await syncBinaryIndex(binaryId, {
    sinceRevision: localRev >= 0 && !forceSync ? localRev : 0,
    ...UI_OPTS,
    autoStart: true,
  });
  return {
    synced: !syncRes.unchanged,
    unchanged: Boolean(syncRes.unchanged),
    revision: syncRes.revision ?? targetRev,
    counts: syncRes.counts,
  };
}

async function withLiveBinaryUi(binaryId, fn) {
  const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(binaryId);
  const projectDir = getProjectDir(id);
  const gprPath = join(projectDir, 'ghidra.gpr');
  const daemonAlive = Boolean(await getHealth({ autoStart: false }));
  if (!daemonAlive && !fs.existsSync(gprPath)) {
    throw new DaemonError(`Binary ${id} is not loaded or imported yet`, {
      code: 'BINARY_NOT_LOADED',
      status: 404,
      retryable: false,
      details: { binaryId: id },
    });
  }

  try {
    return await fn(id);
  } catch (err) {
    if (!(err instanceof DaemonError) || err.code !== 'BINARY_NOT_LOADED') {
      throw err;
    }

    const metaPath = join(projectDir, 'meta.json');
    if (!fs.existsSync(metaPath) || !fs.existsSync(gprPath)) {
      throw err;
    }
    const meta = readJsonFileSafe(metaPath);
    if (!meta || typeof meta !== 'object') {
      throw err;
    }

    const candidatePath = findCandidatePathFromMeta(meta);
    const openRes = await openBinary(candidatePath, {
      sha256: id,
      analyze: !meta.analyzed,
      replaceIfFull: true,
      waitForAnalysis: true,
      ...UI_OPTS,
      autoStart: true,
    });

    const summary = openRes?.job?.result ?? openRes?.binary ?? openRes;
    const daemonRev = Number(summary?.revision ?? meta.revision ?? 1);
    try {
      await syncIndexIfStale(id, daemonRev, false);
    } catch {
      // Non-fatal; proceed with live retry.
    }

    return await fn(id);
  }
}

function wrapApi(handler) {
  return async (data) => {
    try {
      const result = await handler(data && typeof data === 'object' ? data : {});
      if (result instanceof Response || (result && typeof result === 'object' && result.contentType && result.body !== undefined)) {
        return result;
      }
      return new Response(JSON.stringify(result), {
        status: 200,
        contentType: 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
        headers: STATIC_SECURITY_HEADERS,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      let status = 500;
      let code = 'INTERNAL_ERROR';
      let message = 'Internal server error';
      let retryable = false;
      let details = null;

      if (err instanceof DaemonError) {
        status = err.status || 500;
        code = err.code || 'DAEMON_ERROR';
        message = err.message || 'Daemon request failed';
        retryable = Boolean(err.retryable);
        details = err.details ?? null;
      } else if (err instanceof ApiInputError) {
        status = err.status || 400;
        code = err.code || 'INVALID_PARAMS';
        message = err.message;
        retryable = Boolean(err.retryable);
        details = err.details ?? null;
      } else {
        if (Number.isInteger(err?.status) && err.status >= 400 && err.status < 600) {
          status = err.status;
        } else if (err?.code === 'INVALID_PARAMS' || err?.code === 'INVALID_ADDRESS') {
          status = 400;
        } else if (err?.code === 'FUNCTION_NOT_FOUND') {
          status = 404;
        }
        code = typeof err?.code === 'string' ? err.code : 'INTERNAL_ERROR';
        message = err?.message ? String(err.message) : String(err);
        retryable = Boolean(err?.retryable);
        details = err?.details ?? null;
      }

      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({ error: { code, message, retryable, details } }),
        {
          status,
          contentType: 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
          headers: STATIC_SECURITY_HEADERS,
        },
      );
    }
  };
}

function detectHostLocale() {
  try {
    if (process.env.VSCODE_NLS_CONFIG) {
      const nls = JSON.parse(process.env.VSCODE_NLS_CONFIG);
      const cand = nls?.userLocale || nls?.locale || '';
      if (cand) {
        return /^ru\b/i.test(String(cand).trim()) ? 'ru' : 'en';
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore malformed VSCODE_NLS_CONFIG
  }
  const envCand =
    process.env.ANTIGRAVITY_LOCALE ||
    process.env.ANTIGRAVITY_LANG ||
    process.env.LANGUAGE ||
    process.env.LC_ALL ||
    process.env.LANG ||
    'en';
  return /^ru(?:[_-]|$)/i.test(String(envCand).trim()) ? 'ru' : 'en';
}

function servePublicAsset(relFile, contentType, extraHeaders = {}, fallback404Body = null) {
  return () => {
    const fullPath = join(PUBLIC_DIR, relFile);
    if (!fs.existsSync(fullPath)) {
      return new Response(
        fallback404Body ?? `/* ${relFile} not found */\n`,
        {
          status: 404,
          contentType,
          headers: { ...STATIC_SECURITY_HEADERS, ...extraHeaders },
        },
      );
    }
    let body = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf8');
    if (relFile === 'index.html') {
      const hostLocale = detectHostLocale();
      body = body.replace(
        /<html\b([^>]*)>/i,
        `<html lang="${hostLocale}" data-host-lang="${hostLocale}">`,
      );
    }
    return new Response(body, {
      status: 200,
      contentType,
      headers: { ...STATIC_SECURITY_HEADERS, ...extraHeaders },
    });
  };
}
```
