```mjs
  if (env.ok) {
    return {
      ok: true,
      ghidraDir: env.ghidraDir,
      ghidraVersion: env.ghidraVersion,
      javaHome: env.javaHome,
      jdkVersion: env.jdkVersion,
      jdkMajor: env.jdkMajor,
    };
  }
  return {
    ok: false,
    code: env.code,
    message: env.message,
    details: env.details ?? null,
  };
}

async function buildStatusPayload() {
  const config = loadConfig();
  const hostMemory = readHostMemoryInfo();
  const tierSpec = resolveTierSpec(config.tier, config.customRamMb, hostMemory);
  const prerequisites = formatPrerequisites(discoverEnvironment(config));
  const health = await getHealth({ autoStart: false });
  const offlineProjects = listOfflineProjects({ limit: 50 });
  const sidecarNodeMb = readSelfRssMb();

  let loadedBinaries = [];
  if (health) {
    try {
      const listRes = await listBinaries({ ...UI_OPTS, autoStart: false });
      loadedBinaries = Array.isArray(listRes?.binaries) ? listRes.binaries : [];
    } catch {
      loadedBinaries = Array.isArray(health.loadedBinaries)
        ? health.loadedBinaries.map((id) => ({ binaryId: id }))
        : [];
    }
  }

  return {
    daemonState: health ? (health.state || 'active') : 'stopped',
    daemonRunning: Boolean(health),
    daemonPid: health?.pid ?? null,
    uptimeMs: health?.uptimeMs ?? 0,
    startedAt: health?.startedAt ?? null,
    tier: health?.tier ?? tierSpec.tier,
    ramLimitMb: health?.ramLimitMb ?? tierSpec.ramLimitMb,
    config,
    tierSpec,
    hostMemory,
    rss: {
      jvmMb: health?.jvmRssMb ?? 0,
      decompilerMb: health?.decompilerRssMb ?? 0,
      totalDaemonMb: health?.totalDaemonRssMb ?? 0,
      sidecarNodeMb,
    },
    workers: health?.workers ?? {
      total: 0,
      idle: 0,
      busy: 0,
      uiReserved: 0,
      configured: tierSpec.workers,
      queues: null,
      workers: [],
    },
    loadedBinaries,
    offlineProjects,
    latestSeq: health?.latestSeq ?? 0,
    prerequisites,
    hostLocale: detectHostLocale(),
  };
}

function parseHexBigInt(raw) {
  const s = String(raw || '').trim();
  if (/^0x[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(s)) return BigInt(s.toLowerCase());
  if (/^[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(s)) return BigInt(`0x${s.toLowerCase()}`);
  return null;
}

function formatHexAddress(addrBig, pointerSize = 8) {
  const hexDigits = Math.max(8, (Number(pointerSize) || 8) * 2);
  return `0x${BigInt.asUintN(64, addrBig).toString(16).padStart(hexDigits, '0')}`;
}

function resolveOfflineTarget(binaryId, query) {
  if (!hasOfflineIndex(binaryId)) {
    throw new ApiInputError(`Binary ${binaryId} is not indexed offline`, {
      code: 'BINARY_NOT_INDEXED_OFFLINE',
      status: 404,
      details: { binaryId },
    });
  }

  const trimmed = requireString(query, 'query');
  const db = openIndex(binaryId, { readOnly: true });
  const metaInfo = getBinaryMeta(binaryId);
  const pointerSize = Number(metaInfo.meta?.pointerSize ?? 8);
  const sections = metaInfo.sections || [];

  const findSectionForAddr = (addrBig) => {
    for (const sec of sections) {
      const start = parseHexBigInt(sec.startHex);
      const end = parseHexBigInt(sec.endHex);
      if (start !== null && end !== null && addrBig >= start && addrBig <= end) {
        return sec;
      }
    }
    return null;
  };

  const makeResolved = (fields) => ({
    binaryId,
    query: trimmed,
    resolved: true,
    address: null,
    kind: 'unmapped',
    section: null,
    perms: null,
    symbol: null,
    containingFunction: null,
    externalTarget: null,
    recommendedView: 'disasm',
    ...fields,
  });

  const explicitHex = /^0x[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(trimmed);
  const addrBig = explicitHex ? parseHexBigInt(trimmed) : null;

  if (addrBig !== null) {
    const sqlAddr = BigInt.asIntN(64, addrBig);
    const isNeg = sqlAddr < 0n ? 1 : 0;

    const exactFn = db
      .prepare('SELECT entry_hex, end_hex, name, is_import, is_thunk, external_lib FROM functions WHERE entry_addr = ? LIMIT 1')
      .get(sqlAddr);
    if (exactFn) {
      const sec = findSectionForAddr(addrBig);
      const isImport = Boolean(exactFn.is_import);
      return makeResolved({
        address: exactFn.entry_hex,
        kind: isImport ? 'import_thunk' : 'function_entry',
        section: sec?.name ?? null,
        perms: sec?.perms ?? null,
        symbol: exactFn.name,
        containingFunction: { entry: exactFn.entry_hex, name: exactFn.name },
        libraryName: exactFn.external_lib ?? null,
        recommendedView: isImport ? 'import_popover' : 'decompile',
      });
    }

    const candFn = db
      .prepare(
        'SELECT entry_hex, end_hex, name, is_import FROM functions WHERE (entry_addr < 0) = ? AND entry_addr <= ? ORDER BY entry_addr DESC LIMIT 1',
      )
      .get(isNeg, sqlAddr);
    if (candFn) {
      const fnStart = parseHexBigInt(candFn.entry_hex);
      const fnEnd = parseHexBigInt(candFn.end_hex);
      if (fnStart !== null && fnEnd !== null && addrBig >= fnStart && addrBig <= fnEnd) {
        const sec = findSectionForAddr(addrBig);
        return makeResolved({
          address: formatHexAddress(addrBig, pointerSize),
          kind: 'function_interior',
          section: sec?.name ?? null,
          perms: sec?.perms ?? null,
          symbol: null,
          containingFunction: { entry: candFn.entry_hex, name: candFn.name },
          recommendedView: 'decompile',
        });
      }
    }

    const strRow = db
      .prepare('SELECT addr_hex, value, section FROM strings WHERE addr = ? LIMIT 1')
      .get(sqlAddr);
    if (strRow) {
      const sec = findSectionForAddr(addrBig);
      return makeResolved({
        address: strRow.addr_hex,
        kind: 'string',
        section: strRow.section || sec?.name || null,
        perms: sec?.perms ?? 'r--',
        symbol: strRow.value,
        recommendedView: 'data_inspector',
      });
    }

    const sec = findSectionForAddr(addrBig);
    if (sec) {
      const isExec = String(sec.perms || '').includes('x');
      return makeResolved({
        address: formatHexAddress(addrBig, pointerSize),
        kind: isExec ? 'code_unmapped_func' : 'data_raw',
        section: sec.name,
        perms: sec.perms,
        recommendedView: isExec ? 'disasm' : 'data_inspector',
      });
    }

    return makeResolved({
      resolved: false,
      address: formatHexAddress(addrBig, pointerSize),
      kind: 'unmapped',
      recommendedView: 'disasm',
    });
  }

  // Symbol name lookup (case-insensitive exact match first, then prefix, then hex fallback)
  const exactByName = db
    .prepare(
      'SELECT entry_hex, name, is_import, external_lib FROM functions WHERE name = ? COLLATE NOCASE ORDER BY is_import ASC, (entry_addr < 0), entry_addr ASC LIMIT 1',
    )
    .get(trimmed);
  if (exactByName) {
    const fnAddrBig = parseHexBigInt(exactByName.entry_hex);
    const sec = fnAddrBig !== null ? findSectionForAddr(fnAddrBig) : null;
    const isImport = Boolean(exactByName.is_import);
    return makeResolved({
      address: exactByName.entry_hex,
      kind: isImport ? 'import_thunk' : 'function_entry',
      section: sec?.name ?? null,
      perms: sec?.perms ?? null,
      symbol: exactByName.name,
      containingFunction: { entry: exactByName.entry_hex, name: exactByName.name },
      libraryName: exactByName.external_lib ?? null,
      recommendedView: isImport ? 'import_popover' : 'decompile',
    });
  }

  if (/^[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(trimmed)) {
    const hexAddrBig = parseHexBigInt(trimmed);
    if (hexAddrBig !== null) {
      const sqlAddr = BigInt.asIntN(64, hexAddrBig);
      const exactFn = db
        .prepare('SELECT entry_hex, name, is_import, external_lib FROM functions WHERE entry_addr = ? LIMIT 1')
        .get(sqlAddr);
      if (exactFn) {
        const sec = findSectionForAddr(hexAddrBig);
        const isImport = Boolean(exactFn.is_import);
        return makeResolved({
          address: exactFn.entry_hex,
          kind: isImport ? 'import_thunk' : 'function_entry',
          section: sec?.name ?? null,
          perms: sec?.perms ?? null,
          symbol: exactFn.name,
          containingFunction: { entry: exactFn.entry_hex, name: exactFn.name },
          libraryName: exactFn.external_lib ?? null,
          recommendedView: isImport ? 'import_popover' : 'decompile',
        });
      }
    }
  }

  const escapedPrefix = `${trimmed.replace(/[\\%_]/g, '\\$&')}%`;
  const prefixMatch = db
    .prepare(
      "SELECT entry_hex, name, is_import, external_lib FROM functions WHERE name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\' COLLATE NOCASE ORDER BY LENGTH(name) ASC, is_import ASC LIMIT 1",
    )
    .get(escapedPrefix);
  if (prefixMatch) {
    const fnAddrBig = parseHexBigInt(prefixMatch.entry_hex);
    const sec = fnAddrBig !== null ? findSectionForAddr(fnAddrBig) : null;
    const isImport = Boolean(prefixMatch.is_import);
    return makeResolved({
      address: prefixMatch.entry_hex,
      kind: isImport ? 'import_thunk' : 'function_entry',
      section: sec?.name ?? null,
      perms: sec?.perms ?? null,
      symbol: prefixMatch.name,
      containingFunction: { entry: prefixMatch.entry_hex, name: prefixMatch.name },
      libraryName: prefixMatch.external_lib ?? null,
      recommendedView: isImport ? 'import_popover' : 'decompile',
    });
  }

  return makeResolved({
    resolved: false,
    kind: 'unmapped',
    recommendedView: 'disasm',
  });
}

function synthesizeLinesFromPlainC(plainC, entryHex) {
  const rawLines = String(plainC || '').split('\n');
  return rawLines.map((lineText, idx) => {
    const leading = lineText.match(/^ */)[0].length;
    return {
      line: idx + 1,
      indent: leading,
      addr: idx === 0 ? entryHex : null,
      asmAddrs: [],
      tokens: lineText.length > 0 ? [{ t: lineText, k: 'syntax' }] : [],
    };
  });
}

function buildAddrToLinesFromLines(lines) {
  const map = {};
  for (const l of lines) {
    if (!l || typeof l !== 'object') continue;
    const lineNum = l.line;
    if (!Number.isInteger(lineNum)) continue;
    const addrs = Array.isArray(l.asmAddrs) && l.asmAddrs.length > 0
      ? l.asmAddrs
      : (l.addr ? [l.addr] : []);
    for (const a of addrs) {
      if (!a) continue;
      if (!map[a]) map[a] = [];
      if (!map[a].includes(lineNum)) map[a].push(lineNum);
    }
  }
  return map;
}

function resolveCachedDecompileOffline(binaryId, target, startLine, maxLines) {
  if (!hasOfflineIndex(binaryId)) return null;

  const metaInfo = getBinaryMeta(binaryId);
  const currentRev = Number(metaInfo.meta?.revision ?? 0);
  const trimmed = String(target).trim();
  const db = openIndex(binaryId, { readOnly: true });

  let fnRow = null;
  if (/^0x[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(trimmed)) {
    fnRow = db
      .prepare('SELECT entry_hex, end_hex, name, namespace, signature, size_bytes, is_thunk, is_import FROM functions WHERE entry_addr = ? LIMIT 1')
      .get(BigInt.asIntN(64, BigInt(trimmed.toLowerCase())));
  }
  if (!fnRow) {
    fnRow = db
      .prepare('SELECT entry_hex, end_hex, name, namespace, signature, size_bytes, is_thunk, is_import FROM functions WHERE name = ? COLLATE NOCASE ORDER BY is_import ASC LIMIT 1')
      .get(trimmed);
  }
  if (!fnRow && /^[0-9a-f]{4,}$/i.test(trimmed)) {
    fnRow = db
      .prepare('SELECT entry_hex, end_hex, name, namespace, signature, size_bytes, is_thunk, is_import FROM functions WHERE entry_addr = ? LIMIT 1')
      .get(BigInt.asIntN(64, BigInt(`0x${trimmed.toLowerCase()}`)));
  }

  const entryLookup = fnRow?.entry_hex || (/^(?:0x)?[0-9a-f]{4,}$/i.test(trimmed) ? trimmed : null);
  let cached = entryLookup ? getCachedDecompile(binaryId, entryLookup, currentRev) : null;

  if (!cached && !fnRow) {
    const searchRes = searchFunctions(binaryId, { query: trimmed, limit: 25 });
    const items = searchRes?.items || [];
    const lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();
    const chosen = items.find((it) => String(it.name || '').toLowerCase() === lower) || items[0];
    if (chosen?.entryHex) {
      cached = getCachedDecompile(binaryId, chosen.entryHex, currentRev);
      if (cached) {
        fnRow = {
          entry_hex: chosen.entryHex,
          end_hex: chosen.endHex,
          name: chosen.name,
          namespace: chosen.namespace,
          signature: chosen.signature,
          size_bytes: chosen.sizeBytes,
          is_thunk: chosen.isThunk ? 1 : 0,
          is_import: chosen.isImport ? 1 : 0,
        };
      }
    }
  }

  if (!cached) return null;

  const defaultFnMeta = {
    entry: cached.entryHex,
    end: fnRow?.end_hex ?? cached.entryHex,
    name: fnRow?.name ?? cached.funcName ?? cached.entryHex,
    namespace: fnRow?.namespace ?? 'Global',
    signature: fnRow?.signature ?? '',
    sizeBytes: fnRow?.size_bytes ?? 0,
    isThunk: Boolean(fnRow?.is_thunk),
    isExternal: Boolean(fnRow?.is_import),
  };

  let allLines;
  let folds = [];
  let labels = {};
  let addrToLines = null;
  let variables = [];
  let fnMeta = defaultFnMeta;

  const tok = cached.tokens;
  if (tok && typeof tok === 'object' && !Array.isArray(tok)) {
    allLines = Array.isArray(tok.lines)
      ? tok.lines
      : synthesizeLinesFromPlainC(cached.plainC, cached.entryHex);
    folds = Array.isArray(tok.folds) ? tok.folds : [];
    labels = tok.labels && typeof tok.labels === 'object' ? tok.labels : {};
    addrToLines = tok.addrToLines && typeof tok.addrToLines === 'object' ? tok.addrToLines : null;
    variables = Array.isArray(tok.variables) ? tok.variables : [];
    if (tok.function && typeof tok.function === 'object') {
      fnMeta = { ...defaultFnMeta, ...tok.function };
    }
  } else if (Array.isArray(tok)) {
    allLines = tok;
  } else {
    allLines = synthesizeLinesFromPlainC(cached.plainC, cached.entryHex);
  }

  if (!addrToLines) {
    addrToLines = buildAddrToLinesFromLines(allLines);
  }

  const totalLines = allLines.length;
  const effStart = Math.max(1, startLine);
  const fromIdx = effStart - 1;
  const toIdx = fromIdx >= totalLines ? fromIdx : Math.min(totalLines, fromIdx + maxLines);
  const slicedLines = fromIdx < toIdx ? allLines.slice(fromIdx, toIdx) : [];
  const truncated = toIdx < totalLines;
  const endLine = slicedLines.length > 0 ? effStart + slicedLines.length - 1 : (totalLines === 0 ? 0 : effStart - 1);

  return {
    binaryId,
    source: 'sqlite_cache',
    revision: cached.revision,
    cached: true,
    decompileMs: 0,
    function: fnMeta,
    variables,
    totalLines,
    startLine: effStart,
    endLine,
    truncated,
    lines: slicedLines,
    folds,
    labels,
    addrToLines,
    plainText: cached.plainC,
  };
}

function syncMutationEffectsToSqlite(binaryId, res, fallbackCommentKind = null) {
  if (!hasOfflineIndex(binaryId) || !res) return;
  try {
    if (res.targetKind === 'function' && res.address && res.newName) {
      patchFunctionRename(binaryId, res.address, res.newName, null, null);
    } else if (res.targetKind === 'function_signature' && res.address) {
      patchFunctionRename(binaryId, res.address, null, res.signature || res.appliedType || null, null);
    } else if (fallbackCommentKind !== null) {
      const commentKind = String(res.kind || fallbackCommentKind || 'EOL').toUpperCase();
      if (res.address && commentKind === 'PLATE') {
        patchFunctionCommentFlag(binaryId, res.address, Boolean(res.text && res.text.length > 0), null);
      }
    }
    syncMutationCacheState(binaryId, {
      revision: res.revision,
      invalidatedFuncs: res.invalidatedFuncs,
    });
  } catch {
    // Best-effort SQLite synchronization.
  }
}

function syncAgentMutationEventToSqlite(ev) {
  const binaryId = ev?.binaryId;
  const detail = ev?.detail;
  if (!binaryId || !detail || !hasOfflineIndex(binaryId)) return;

  try {
    const op = detail.op;
    if ((op === 'rename_function' || (op === 'rename' && detail.targetKind === 'function')) && detail.address && detail.newName) {
      patchFunctionRename(binaryId, detail.address, detail.newName, null, null);
    } else if (
      (op === 'retype_function_signature' || (op === 'retype' && detail.targetKind === 'function_signature')) &&
      detail.address
    ) {
      const sig = detail.signature || detail.appliedType || null;
      if (sig) {
        patchFunctionRename(binaryId, detail.address, null, sig, null);
      }
    } else if (op === 'set_comment' && detail.address && String(detail.kind || '').toUpperCase() === 'PLATE') {
      patchFunctionCommentFlag(binaryId, detail.address, Boolean(detail.text && String(detail.text).length > 0), null);
    } else if (op === 'batch' && Array.isArray(detail.ops)) {
      for (const item of detail.ops) {
        if (!item || !item.address) continue;
        if (item.op === 'rename' && item.targetKind === 'function' && item.newValue) {
          patchFunctionRename(binaryId, item.address, item.newValue, null, null);
        } else if (item.op === 'retype' && item.targetKind === 'function_signature' && item.newValue) {
          patchFunctionRename(binaryId, item.address, null, item.newValue, null);
        } else if (item.op === 'comment' && String(item.kind || '').toUpperCase() === 'PLATE') {
          patchFunctionCommentFlag(binaryId, item.address, Boolean(item.newValue), null);
        }
      }
    }

    syncMutationCacheState(binaryId, {
      revision: ev.revision,
      invalidatedFuncs: detail.invalidatedFuncs,
    });
  } catch {
    // Best-effort SQLite synchronization.
  }
}

export function createWorkbenchApp() {
  const app = new SidecarApp();

  // Static assets ONLY via app.page(...) (GET)
  app.page(
    '/',
    servePublicAsset('index.html', 'text/html; charset=utf-8', {
      'Content-Security-Policy': CSP_HEADER,
    }),
  );
  app.page('/styles.css', servePublicAsset('styles.css', 'text/css; charset=utf-8'));
  app.page('/i18n.js', servePublicAsset('i18n.js', 'application/javascript; charset=utf-8'));
  app.page('/app.js', servePublicAsset('app.js', 'application/javascript; charset=utf-8'));
  app.page(
    '/cfg.js',
    servePublicAsset(
      'cfg.js',
      'application/javascript; charset=utf-8',
      {},
      '// CFG Stage 5 module not loaded\n',
    ),
  );

  // All /api/* routes strictly as POST (protected by sidecar_sdk X-Sidecar-Token check)
  app.api('/api/status', wrapApi(() => buildStatusPayload()), 'POST');

  app.api(
    '/api/workspace/scan',
    wrapApi(async (data) => {
      const workspaceUris = Array.isArray(data.workspaceUris) ? data.workspaceUris : [];
      return scanWorkspaceBinaries(workspaceUris);
    }),
    'POST',
  );

  app.api(
    '/api/engine/config',
    wrapApi(async (data) => {
      const prevHealth = await getHealth({ autoStart: false });
      const patch = {};
      if (data.tier !== undefined) patch.tier = data.tier;
      if (data.customRamMb !== undefined) patch.customRamMb = Number(data.customRamMb);
      if (data.idleTimeoutMin !== undefined) patch.idleTimeoutMin = data.idleTimeoutMin;
      if (data.ghidraDir !== undefined) patch.ghidraInstallDir = data.ghidraDir;
      if (data.ghidraInstallDir !== undefined) patch.ghidraInstallDir = data.ghidraInstallDir;
      if (data.javaHome !== undefined) patch.javaHome = data.javaHome;

      const config = saveConfig(patch);
      const hostMemory = readHostMemoryInfo();
      const tierSpec = resolveTierSpec(config.tier, config.customRamMb, hostMemory);

      let restarted = false;
      const reopenedBinaries = [];

      const needsRestart =
        Boolean(prevHealth) &&
        (prevHealth.tier !== tierSpec.tier || Number(prevHealth.ramLimitMb) !== Number(tierSpec.ramLimitMb));

      if (needsRestart) {
        let activeList = [];
        try {
          const listRes = await listBinaries({ ...UI_OPTS, autoStart: false });
          activeList = Array.isArray(listRes?.binaries) ? listRes.binaries : [];
        } catch {
          activeList = [];
        }

        for (const b of activeList) {
          if (!b?.binaryId) continue;
          try {
            await saveBinary(b.binaryId, { ...UI_OPTS, autoStart: false });
          } catch {
            // Best-effort checkpoint before tier switch.
          }
        }

        await stopDaemon('tier_switch');
        await ensureDaemonRunning();
        restarted = true;

        const maxBinaries = Math.max(1, Number(tierSpec.maxLoadedBinaries || 1));
        const toReopen = [...activeList]
          .sort((a, b) => Number(a?.lastAccessedAt || 0) - Number(b?.lastAccessedAt || 0))
          .slice(-maxBinaries);

        for (const b of toReopen) {
          if (!b?.binaryId) continue;
          const meta = readJsonFileSafe(join(getProjectDir(b.binaryId), 'meta.json'));
          const candidatePath =
            (typeof b.primaryPath === 'string' && b.primaryPath.trim() && fs.existsSync(b.primaryPath.trim())
              ? b.primaryPath.trim()
              : '') || findCandidatePathFromMeta(meta);

          try {
            const reopenRes = await openBinary(candidatePath, {
              sha256: b.binaryId,
              analyze: b.analyzed === false,
              analysisProfile: b.analysisProfile || 'default',
              replaceIfFull: true,
              waitForAnalysis: true,
              ...UI_OPTS,
              autoStart: true,
            });
            const summary = reopenRes?.job?.result ?? reopenRes?.binary ?? reopenRes;
            reopenedBinaries.push({
              binaryId: b.binaryId,
              programName: summary?.programName ?? b.programName ?? null,
              revision: summary?.revision ?? b.revision ?? 1,
            });
          } catch (reopenErr) {
            reopenedBinaries.push({
              binaryId: b.binaryId,
              error: reopenErr?.message || String(reopenErr),
            });
          }
        }
      }

      return {
        ok: true,
        restarted,
        reopenedBinaries,
        config,
        tierSpec,
        hostMemory,
      };
    }),
    'POST',
  );

  app.api(
    '/api/engine/stop',
    wrapApi(async (data) => {
      const reason = optionalString(data.reason, 'ui_stop') || 'ui_stop';
      const res = await stopDaemon(reason);
      return {
        ok: true,
        stopped: Boolean(res?.stopped),
        alreadyStopped: !res?.stopped,
        pid: res?.pid ?? null,
        forced: Boolean(res?.forced),
        reason,
      };
    }),
    'POST',
  );

  app.api(
    '/api/engine/start',
    wrapApi(async () => {
      const startRes = await ensureDaemonRunning();
      const status = await buildStatusPayload();
      return {
        ok: true,
        started: Boolean(startRes?.started),
        ...status,
      };
    }),
    'POST',
  );

  app.api(
    '/api/binary/open',
    wrapApi(async (data) => {
      const rawPath = optionalString(data.path, '').trim();
      const rawId = optionalString(data.sha256 || data.binaryId, '').trim();
      const analyze = data.analyze !== undefined ? Boolean(data.analyze) : true;
      const forceReimport = Boolean(data.forceReimport);
      const analysisProfile = data.analysisProfile === 'fast' ? 'fast' : 'default';
      const offlineOnly = Boolean(data.offlineOnly);
      const replaceIfFull = data.replaceIfFull !== undefined ? Boolean(data.replaceIfFull) : true;

      let absPath = '';
      let sha256 = '';
      let useOffline = offlineOnly;

      if (rawId) {
        sha256 = resolveProjectBinaryId(rawId);
        const projectDir = getProjectDir(sha256);
        const meta = readJsonFileSafe(join(projectDir, 'meta.json'));

        if (offlineOnly) {
          absPath = rawPath ? resolve(rawPath) : findCandidatePathFromMeta(meta);
        } else {
          const hasGpr = fs.existsSync(join(projectDir, 'ghidra.gpr'));
          if (rawPath) {
            const candidate = resolve(rawPath);
            let stat = null;
            try {
              stat = fs.statSync(candidate);
            } catch (err) {
              if (err?.code !== 'ENOENT') {
                throw new ApiInputError(`Cannot access file: ${candidate}`, {
                  code: 'FILE_NOT_FOUND',
                  status: 404,
                  details: { path: candidate, errno: err?.code },
                });
              }
            }
            if (stat) {
              if (!stat.isFile()) {
                throw new ApiInputError(`Path is not a regular file: ${candidate}`, {
                  code: 'INVALID_PARAMS',
                  status: 400,
                  details: { path: candidate },
                });
              }
              absPath = candidate;
            } else if (hasGpr) {
              absPath = '';
            } else if (hasOfflineIndex(sha256)) {
              useOffline = true;
            } else {
              throw new ApiInputError(`File not found: ${candidate}`, {
                code: 'FILE_NOT_FOUND',
                status: 404,
                details: { path: candidate, errno: 'ENOENT' },
              });
            }
          } else {
            absPath = findCandidatePathFromMeta(meta);
            if (!absPath && !hasGpr) {
              if (hasOfflineIndex(sha256)) {
                useOffline = true;
              } else {
                throw new ApiInputError(`Binary ${sha256} has no cached Ghidra project or file on disk`, {
                  code: 'FILE_NOT_FOUND',
                  status: 404,
                  details: { binaryId: sha256 },
                });
              }
            }
          }
        }
      } else if (rawPath) {
        absPath = resolve(rawPath);
        let stat;
        try {
          stat = fs.statSync(absPath);
        } catch (err) {
          throw new ApiInputError(`File not found: ${absPath}`, {
            code: 'FILE_NOT_FOUND',
            status: 404,
            details: { path: absPath, errno: err.code },
          });
        }
        if (!stat.isFile()) {
          throw new ApiInputError(`Path is not a regular file: ${absPath}`, {
            code: 'INVALID_PARAMS',
            status: 400,
            details: { path: absPath },
          });
        }
        sha256 = await computeFileSha256(absPath);
      } else {
        throw new ApiInputError("Parameter 'path', 'sha256', or 'binaryId' is required");
      }

      if (useOffline) {
        if (!hasOfflineIndex(sha256)) {
          throw new ApiInputError(
            `Binary ${sha256} is not indexed offline; open with offlineOnly=false to import`,
            {
              code: 'BINARY_NOT_INDEXED_OFFLINE',
              status: 404,
              details: { binaryId: sha256, path: absPath || null },
            },
          );
        }
        const metaJson = readJsonFileSafe(join(getProjectDir(sha256), 'meta.json')) || {};
        const sqliteInfo = getBinaryMeta(sha256);
        const sqlMeta = sqliteInfo.meta || {};
        const sections = Array.isArray(metaJson.sections) && metaJson.sections.length > 0
          ? metaJson.sections
          : sqliteInfo.sections;
        const revision = Number(sqlMeta.revision ?? metaJson.revision ?? 0);
        let firstCachedEntry = null;
        if ((sqliteInfo.cachedDecompileCount ?? 0) > 0) {
          try {
            const db = openIndex(sha256, { readOnly: true });
            const row = db
              .prepare('SELECT entry_hex FROM decompile_cache ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1')
              .get();
            firstCachedEntry = row?.entry_hex ?? null;
          } catch {
            firstCachedEntry = null;
          }
        }

        return {
          mode: 'offline',
          status: 'ready',
          binaryId: sha256,
          cached: true,
          binary: {
            binaryId: sha256,
            shortId: sha256.slice(0, 12),
            programName: metaJson.programName ?? sqlMeta.programName ?? null,
            basename: metaJson.basename ?? sqlMeta.programName ?? null,
            primaryPath: metaJson.primaryPath ?? (absPath || null),
            format: metaJson.format ?? sqlMeta.format ?? null,
            arch: metaJson.arch ?? sqlMeta.arch ?? null,
            endianness: metaJson.endianness ?? sqlMeta.endianness ?? null,
            pointerSize: metaJson.pointerSize ?? (sqlMeta.pointerSize != null ? Number(sqlMeta.pointerSize) : null),
            imageBase: metaJson.imageBase ?? sqlMeta.imageBase ?? null,
            fileSizeBytes: metaJson.fileSizeBytes ?? null,
            revision,
            analyzed: Boolean(metaJson.analyzed ?? true),
            entrypoints: Array.isArray(metaJson.entrypoints) ? metaJson.entrypoints : [],
            sections,
            functionCount: sqliteInfo.functionCount ?? metaJson.functionCount ?? 0,
            stringCount: sqliteInfo.stringCount ?? 0,
            importCount: metaJson.importCount ?? 0,
            exportCount: metaJson.exportCount ?? 0,
            cachedDecompileCount: sqliteInfo.cachedDecompileCount ?? 0,
            firstCachedEntry,
            warnings: Array.isArray(metaJson.warnings) ? metaJson.warnings : [],
          },
          sections,
          indexSync: { synced: false, unchanged: true, revision },
        };
      }

      const res = await openBinary(absPath, {
        sha256,
        analyze,
        forceReimport,
        analysisProfile,
        replaceIfFull,
        waitForAnalysis: false,
        ...UI_OPTS,
        autoStart: true,
      });

      if (res?.jobId && !res?.binary && !res?.result) {
        return {
          mode: 'live',
          status: 'analyzing',
          binaryId: res.binaryId || sha256,
          jobId: res.jobId,
        };
      }

      const summary = res?.binary ?? res?.result ?? res;
      const daemonRev = Number(summary?.revision ?? 1);
      const indexSync = await syncIndexIfStale(sha256, daemonRev, forceReimport);
      const sections = Array.isArray(summary?.sections)
        ? summary.sections
        : (hasOfflineIndex(sha256) ? getBinaryMeta(sha256).sections : []);

      return {
        mode: 'live',
        status: 'ready',
        binaryId: sha256,
        cached: Boolean(res?.cachedProject ?? res?.cached),
        binary: summary,
        sections,
        indexSync,
      };
    }),
    'POST',
  );

  app.api(
    '/api/binary/job',
    wrapApi(async (data) => {
      const jobId = requireString(data.jobId, 'jobId');
      const cancel = Boolean(data.cancel);

      if (cancel) {
        return await cancelJob(jobId, { ...UI_OPTS, autoStart: false });
      }

      const job = await getJob(jobId, { ...UI_OPTS, autoStart: false });
      if (String(job?.state || '').toLowerCase() === 'completed') {
        const binaryId = job.binaryId || job.result?.binaryId;
        if (binaryId) {
          const daemonRev = Number(job.result?.revision ?? 1);
          try {
            job.indexSync = await syncIndexIfStale(binaryId, daemonRev, false);
          } catch (syncErr) {
            job.indexSync = { synced: false, error: syncErr?.message || String(syncErr) };
          }
          job.sections = Array.isArray(job.result?.sections)
            ? job.result.sections
            : (hasOfflineIndex(binaryId) ? getBinaryMeta(binaryId).sections : []);
        }
      }
      return job;
    }),
    'POST',
  );

  app.api(
    '/api/binary/unload',
    wrapApi(async (data) => {
      const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(data.binaryId);
      const stopDaemonIfEmpty = Boolean(data.stopDaemonIfEmpty);
      const health = await getHealth({ autoStart: false });

      if (!health) {
        return {
          ok: true,
          binaryId: id,
          unloaded: false,
          alreadyUnloaded: true,
          daemonRunning: false,
          remainingLoaded: 0,
          daemonStopped: false,
        };
      }

      let unloaded = false;
      let alreadyUnloaded = false;
      let revision = null;
      let remainingLoaded = 0;

      try {
        const res = await unloadBinary(id, { ...UI_OPTS, autoStart: false });
        unloaded = true;
        revision = res?.revision ?? null;
        remainingLoaded = res?.remainingLoaded ?? 0;
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof DaemonError && err.code === 'BINARY_NOT_LOADED') {
          alreadyUnloaded = true;
          try {
            const listRes = await listBinaries({ ...UI_OPTS, autoStart: false });
            remainingLoaded = Array.isArray(listRes?.binaries) ? listRes.binaries.length : 0;
          } catch {
            remainingLoaded = 0;
          }
        } else {
          throw err;
        }
      }

      let daemonStopped = false;
      if (stopDaemonIfEmpty && remainingLoaded === 0) {
        const stopRes = await stopDaemon('ui_unload_empty');
        daemonStopped = Boolean(stopRes?.stopped);
      }

      return {
        ok: true,
        binaryId: id,
        unloaded,
        alreadyUnloaded,
        daemonRunning: !daemonStopped,
        revision,
        remainingLoaded,
        daemonStopped,
      };
    }),
    'POST',
  );

  app.api(
    '/api/search/functions',
    wrapApi(async (data) => {
      const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(data.binaryId);
      const query = optionalString(data.query, '');
      const kind = ['all', 'function', 'user', 'import', 'export'].includes(data.kind) ? data.kind : 'all';
      const regex = Boolean(data.regex);
      const minSize = Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(Number(data.minSize)) ? Math.trunc(Number(data.minSize)) : 0);
      const sort = ['addr', 'name', 'size'].includes(data.sort) ? data.sort : 'addr';
      const limit = clampInt(data.limit, 1, 200, 200);
      const cursor = optionalString(data.cursor, '');

      if (!hasOfflineIndex(id)) {
        await withLiveBinaryUi(id, async (liveId) => {
          await syncBinaryIndex(liveId, { sinceRevision: 0, ...UI_OPTS });
        });

      const res = searchFunctions(id, { query, kind, regex, minSize, sort, limit, cursor });
      return {
        binaryId: id,
        source: 'sqlite',
        ...res,

    'POST',

  app.api(

  app.api(
    '/api/view/resolve',
    wrapApi(async (data) => {
      const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(data.binaryId);
      const query = requireString(data.query, 'query');
      const offlineOnly = Boolean(data.offlineOnly);

      if (offlineOnly) {

    }),
    'POST',

  app.api(
    '/api/view/decompile',
    wrapApi(async (data) => {
      const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(data.binaryId);
      const target = requireString(data.target, 'target');
      const startLine = clampInt(data.startLine, 1, 1000000, 1);
      const maxLines = clampInt(data.maxLines, 1, 10000, 4000);
      const refresh = Boolean(data.refresh);
      const offlineOnly = Boolean(data.offlineOnly);

      if (!refresh) {
        const daemonAlive = offlineOnly ? false : Boolean(await getHealth({ autoStart: false }));
        if (offlineOnly || !daemonAlive) {
          const cachedPayload = resolveCachedDecompileOffline(id, target, startLine, maxLines);
          if (cachedPayload) {
            return cachedPayload;
          }
          if (offlineOnly) {
            throw new ApiInputError(`Function '${target}' is not cached in offline SQLite index`, {
              code: 'DECOMPILE_NOT_CACHED_OFFLINE',
              status: 404,
              details: { binaryId: id, target },
            });
          }
        }
      }

      const res = await withLiveBinaryUi(id, (liveId) =>
        decompileFunction(
          liveId,
          target,
          { format: 'tokens', startLine, maxLines, includePlainText: true, refresh },
          UI_OPTS,
        ),
      );

      if (!res.truncated && startLine === 1) {
        try {
          if (hasOfflineIndex(id) || fs.existsSync(getProjectDir(id))) {
            const cfg = loadConfig();
            const tierSpec = resolveTierSpec(cfg.tier, cfg.customRamMb);
            const etagMatch = typeof res._httpMeta?.etag === 'string'
              ? res._httpMeta.etag.match(/:r:(\d+):/)
              : null;
            const etagRev = etagMatch ? Number(etagMatch[1]) : 0;
            const effectiveRev = Math.max(
              Number.isFinite(Number(res.revision)) ? Number(res.revision) : 0,
              Number.isFinite(etagRev) ? etagRev : 0,
            );
            const entryHex = res.function?.entry || target;
            const plainC = typeof res.plainText === 'string'
              ? res.plainText
              : (Array.isArray(res.lines)
                  ? res.lines.map((l) => (l.tokens || []).map((t) => t.t || '').join('')).join('\n')
                  : '');

            upsertDecompileCache(
              id,
              {
                entryHex,
                funcName: res.function?.name || entryHex,
                revision: effectiveRev,
                plainC,
                tokens: {
                  version: 1,
                  lines: res.lines ?? [],
                  folds: res.folds ?? [],
                  labels: res.labels ?? {},
                  addrToLines: res.addrToLines ?? {},
                  variables: res.variables ?? [],
                  function: res.function ?? null,
                },
              },
              { maxCached: tierSpec.sqliteCacheMax },
            );
          }
        } catch {
          // Best-effort write-through cache.
        }
      }

      return {
        ...res,
        source: res.cached ? 'daemon_cache' : 'decompiler',
      };
    }),
    'POST',
  );

  app.api(
    '/api/view/disasm',
    wrapApi(async (data) => {
      const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(data.binaryId);
      const addr = requireString(data.addr, 'addr');
      const before = clampInt(data.before, 0, 200, 20);
      const after = clampInt(data.after, 0, 300, 80);
      const includeBytes = data.includeBytes !== undefined ? Boolean(data.includeBytes) : true;

      return await withLiveBinaryUi(id, (liveId) =>
        disassemble(liveId, { addr, before, after, includeBytes }, UI_OPTS),
      );
    }),
    'POST',
  );

  app.api(
    '/api/view/cfg',
    wrapApi(async (data) => {
      const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(data.binaryId);
      const target = requireString(data.target, 'target');
      const includeInsns = data.includeInsns !== undefined ? Boolean(data.includeInsns) : true;
      const params = { includeInsns };

  app.api(

      const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(data.binaryId);

      const depth = clampInt(data.depth, 0, 8, 2);

  app.api(

      const text = data.text !== undefined && data.text !== null ? String(data.text) : '';
      const payload = {
        address,
        kind,
        text,
        ...(data.expectedRevision !== undefined && data.expectedRevision !== null
          ? { expectedRevision: Number(data.expectedRevision) }
          : {}),

  app.api(
    '/api/binary/batch-decompile',
    wrapApi(async (data) => {
      const id = resolveProjectBinaryId(data.binaryId);
      const action = ['start', 'pause', 'resume', 'cancel', 'status'].includes(String(data.action || 'start').toLowerCase())
        ? String(data.action || 'start').toLowerCase()
        : 'start';
      const maxFunctions = clampInt(data.maxFunctions, 1, 50000, 10000);
      const sinceCursor = clampInt(data.sinceCursor, 0, 1000000, 0);
      const includeItems = data.includeItems !== undefined ? Boolean(data.includeItems) : true;

      const res = await withLiveBinaryUi(id, (liveId) =>
        batchDecompile(liveId, { action, maxFunctions, sinceCursor, includeItems }, UI_OPTS),
      );

      if (Array.isArray(res?.items) && res.items.length > 0) {
        try {
          if (!hasOfflineIndex(id)) {
            await syncBinaryIndex(id, { sinceRevision: 0, ...UI_OPTS });
          }
          const cfg = loadConfig();
          const tierSpec = resolveTierSpec(cfg.tier, cfg.customRamMb);
          batchUpsertDecompileCache(id, res.items, { maxCached: tierSpec.sqliteCacheMax });
        } catch {
          // Best-effort SQLite batch sync.
        }
      }
      return res;
    }),
    'POST',
  );

  app.api(
    '/api/events/wait',
    wrapApi(async (data) => {
      const since = Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(Number(data.since)) ? Math.trunc(Number(data.since)) : 0);
      const timeoutMs = clampInt(data.timeoutMs, 100, 30000, 15000);
      const limit = clampInt(data.limit, 1, 200, 50);

      const health = await getHealth({ autoStart: false });
      if (!health) {
        return {
          daemonRunning: false,
          unchanged: true,
          seq: since,
          latestSeq: since,
          events: [],
        };
      }

      let res;
      try {
        res = await waitEvents(since, timeoutMs, limit, { ...UI_OPTS, autoStart: false });
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof DaemonError && err.code === 'DAEMON_UNREACHABLE') {
          return {
            daemonRunning: false,
            unchanged: true,
            seq: since,
            latestSeq: since,
            events: [],
          };
        }
        throw err;
      }

      const events = Array.isArray(res?.events) ? res.events : [];
      for (const ev of events) {
        if (ev?.type === 'mutation' && ev?.actor === 'agent') {
          syncAgentMutationEventToSqlite(ev);
        }
      }

      const latestSeq = Number(res?.latestSeq ?? since);
      return {
        daemonRunning: true,
        unchanged: Boolean(res?.unchanged ?? events.length === 0),
        seq: latestSeq,
        latestSeq,
        events,
      };
    }),
    'POST',
  );

  return app;
}

function isMainEntry() {
  if (!process.argv[1]) {
    return false;
  }
  try {
    return pathToFileURL(fs.realpathSync(resolve(process.argv[1]))).href === import.meta.url;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

if (isMainEntry() && process.env.ANTIGRAVITY_SIDECAR_WEB_PORT) {
  const app = createWorkbenchApp();
  let closing = false;
  const shutdown = async () => {
    if (closing) return;
    closing = true;
    try {
      closeAllIndexes();
    } catch {
      // Ignore SQLite close errors during exit.
    }
    try {
      await app.close();
    } catch {
      // Ignore HTTP server close errors during exit.
    }
    process.exit(0);
  };
  process.on('SIGINT', shutdown);
  process.on('SIGTERM', shutdown);
  app.run();
}
```

`sidecars/workbench/public/app.js`:

```js
(() => {
  'use strict';

  const SIDEBAR_ROW_HEIGHT = 26;
  const SIDEBAR_OVERSCAN = 6;
  const SIDEBAR_PAGE_SIZE = 200;
  const SIDEBAR_MAX_PAGES = 20;
  const DECOMPILE_LINE_HEIGHT = 20;
  const DECOMPILE_VIRT_THRESHOLD = 1500;
  const DECOMPILE_OVERSCAN = 16;
  const HISTORY_MAX = 200;
  const FOLLOW_IDLE_MS = 3000;

  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  // ---------- i18n & Theme Helpers ----------
  function t(key, vars, fallback) {
    const i18n = window.GhidraI18n;
    if (i18n && typeof i18n.t === 'function') {
      const val = i18n.t(key, vars);
      if (val !== key || fallback === undefined) return val;
    }
    if (fallback !== undefined) {
      if (!vars) return fallback;
      return String(fallback).replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, k) =>
        Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(vars, k) && vars[k] != null ? String(vars[k]) : ''
      );
    }
    return String(key);
  }

  function plural(unit, n) {
    const i18n = window.GhidraI18n;
    if (i18n && typeof i18n.formatCount === 'function') {
      return i18n.formatCount(unit, n);
    }
    const num = Number(n) || 0;
    return `${num} ${unit}${num === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
  }

  function parseCssColorRgb(raw) {
    if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'string') return null;
    const s = raw.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!s || s === 'transparent' || s === 'none') return null;

    if (s.startsWith('#')) {
      const hex = s.slice(1);
      if (hex.length === 3 || hex.length === 4) {
        const r = parseInt(hex[0] + hex[0], 16);
        const g = parseInt(hex[1] + hex[1], 16);
        const b = parseInt(hex[2] + hex[2], 16);
        if (Number.isFinite(r) && Number.isFinite(g) && Number.isFinite(b)) {
          return [r / 255, g / 255, b / 255];
        }
      } else if (hex.length === 6 || hex.length === 8) {
        const r = parseInt(hex.slice(0, 2), 16);
        const g = parseInt(hex.slice(2, 4), 16);
        const b = parseInt(hex.slice(4, 6), 16);
        if (Number.isFinite(r) && Number.isFinite(g) && Number.isFinite(b)) {
          return [r / 255, g / 255, b / 255];
        }
      }
      return null;
    }

    const m = s.match(/^rgba?\(\s*([0-9.]+%?)\s*[,\s]\s*([0-9.]+%?)\s*[,\s]\s*([0-9.]+%?)(?:\s*[,/]\s*([0-9.]+%?))?\s*\)$/);
    if (m) {
      if (m[4] !== undefined) {
        const alpha = m[4].endsWith('%') ? parseFloat(m[4]) / 100 : parseFloat(m[4]);
        if (Number.isFinite(alpha) && alpha === 0) return null;
      }
      const norm = (v) => (v.endsWith('%') ? parseFloat(v) / 100 : parseFloat(v) / 255);
      const r = norm(m[1]);
      const g = norm(m[2]);
      const b = norm(m[3]);
      if (Number.isFinite(r) && Number.isFinite(g) && Number.isFinite(b)) {
        return [Math.max(0, Math.min(1, r)), Math.max(0, Math.min(1, g)), Math.max(0, Math.min(1, b))];
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function syncTheme() {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const inlineBg = root.style.getPropertyValue('--background');
    const compBg = getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue('--background');
    const bodyBg = document.body ? getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor : '';
    const rgb = parseCssColorRgb(inlineBg) || parseCssColorRgb(compBg) || parseCssColorRgb(bodyBg);
    if (!rgb) {
      root.dataset.theme = 'light';
      return;
    }
    const lum = 0.2126 * rgb[0] + 0.7152 * rgb[1] + 0.0722 * rgb[2];
    root.dataset.theme = lum < 0.5 ? 'dark' : 'light';
  }

  // ---------- Utility Helpers ----------
  function normHex(addr) {
    if (addr === undefined || addr === null) return '';
    const s = String(addr).trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!s) return '';
    if (s.startsWith('0x')) return s;
    if (/^[0-9a-f]+$/.test(s)) return `0x${s}`;
    return s;
  }

  function shortHex(addr) {
    const h = normHex(addr);
    if (!h) return '';
    if (h.startsWith('0x') && h.length > 10) {
      return '0x' + h.slice(2).replace(/^0+(?=[0-9a-f]{6,}$)/, '');
    }
    return h;
  }

  function formatBytes(n) {
    const num = Number(n) || 0;
    if (num < 1024) return `${num} B`;
    if (num < 1024 * 1024) return `${(num / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
    return `${(num / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
  }

  function getBinaryDisplayName(bin) {
    if (!bin) return '';
    return bin.basename || bin.programName || (bin.primaryPath ? bin.primaryPath.split('/').pop() : '') || (bin.binaryId ? bin.binaryId.slice(0, 12) : '');
  }

  function findKnownBinary(binaryId) {
    if (!binaryId) return null;
    const id = String(binaryId).toLowerCase();
    return (
      state.loadedBinaries.find((b) => String(b.binaryId).toLowerCase() === id) ||
      state.offlineProjects.find((p) => String(p.binaryId).toLowerCase() === id) ||
      null
    );
  }

  function addrInList(addrs, targetAddr) {
    const tHex = normHex(targetAddr);
    if (!tHex || !Array.isArray(addrs)) return false;
    return addrs.some((a) => normHex(a) === tHex);
  }

  function lookupAddrToLines(addrToLines, addr) {
    if (!addrToLines || !addr) return null;
    const target = normHex(addr);
    if (Array.isArray(addrToLines[target])) return addrToLines[target];
    if (Array.isArray(addrToLines[addr])) return addrToLines[addr];
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(addrToLines)) {
      if (normHex(k) === target && Array.isArray(v)) return v;
    }
    return null;
  }

  function lookupLabel(labels, addr) {
    if (!labels || !addr) return null;
    const target = normHex(addr);
    if (labels[target]) return labels[target];
    if (labels[addr]) return labels[addr];
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(labels)) {
      if (normHex(k) === target) return v;
    }
    return null;
  }

  let cfgScriptPromise = null;

  function ensureCfgModuleLoaded() {
    if (window.GhidraCfg && typeof window.GhidraCfg.render === 'function') {
      return Promise.resolve(window.GhidraCfg);
    }
    if (cfgScriptPromise) {
      return cfgScriptPromise;
    }
    cfgScriptPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const existing = document.querySelector('script[data-cfg-module="true"]');
      if (existing) {
        existing.remove();
      }
      const script = document.createElement('script');
      script.src = '/cfg.js';
      script.async = true;
      script.dataset.cfgModule = 'true';
      script.addEventListener('load', () => {
        if (window.GhidraCfg && typeof window.GhidraCfg.render === 'function') {
          resolve(window.GhidraCfg);
        } else {
          cfgScriptPromise = null;
          reject(new Error('CFG renderer module loaded without window.GhidraCfg.render'));
        }
      }, { once: true });
      script.addEventListener('error', () => {
        cfgScriptPromise = null;
        script.remove();
        reject(new Error('Failed to load /cfg.js'));
      }, { once: true });
      document.head.appendChild(script);
    });
    return cfgScriptPromise;
  }

  // ---------- BFF Fetch Wrapper ----------
  class ApiError extends Error {
    constructor(message, { code = 'API_ERROR', status = 500, retryable = false, details = null } = {}) {
      super(message);
      this.name = 'ApiError';
      this.code = code;
      this.status = status;
      this.retryable = retryable;
      this.details = details;
    }
  }

  async function apiPost(route, payload = {}) {
    const fetcher = window.sidecar && typeof window.sidecar.fetch === 'function'
      ? window.sidecar.fetch.bind(window.sidecar)
      : fetch;
    const res = await fetcher(route, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload ?? {}),
    });
    const text = await res.text();
    let data = null;
    if (text) {
      try {
        data = JSON.parse(text);
      } catch {
        data = null;
      }
    }
    if (!res.ok) {
      const errObj = data && data.error && typeof data.error === 'object' ? data.error : data;
      const err = new ApiError(errObj?.message || `HTTP ${res.status} on ${route}`, {
        code: errObj?.code || `HTTP_${res.status}`,
        status: res.status,
        retryable: Boolean(errObj?.retryable),
        details: errObj?.details || null,
      });
      if (err.code === 'PREREQ_MISSING_GHIDRA' || err.code === 'PREREQ_MISSING_JDK') {
        renderPrereqError(err);
      }
      throw err;
    }
    return data ?? {};
  }

  // ---------- Toast & Banner ----------
  function showToast(message, kind = 'info', durationMs = 3600) {
    const stack = $('toast-stack');
    if (!stack || !message) return;
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = `toast${kind === 'error' ? ' error' : kind === 'success' ? ' success' : ''}`;
    el.textContent = String(message);
    stack.appendChild(el);
    while (stack.children.length > 5) {
      stack.firstElementChild.remove();
    }
    setTimeout(() => {
      el.remove();
    }, durationMs);
  }

  function showErrorToast(err) {
    const msg = err && err.message ? err.message : String(err || 'Unknown error');
    showToast(t('toastErrorPrefix', { msg }, `Error: ${msg}`), 'error', 5000);
  }

  function showBanner(text, { progressPct = null, actionLabel = null, onAction = null, cancellable = false, onCancel = null } = {}) {
    const banner = $('inline-banner');
    const textEl = $('banner-text');
    const track = $('banner-progress-track');
    const fill = $('banner-progress-fill');
    const actionBtn = $('btn-banner-action');
    const cancelBtn = $('btn-banner-cancel');
    if (!banner) return;

    textEl.textContent = text || '';
    if (progressPct === null || progressPct === undefined) {
      track.classList.add('hidden');
      fill.style.width = '0%';
    } else {
      track.classList.remove('hidden');
      const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(progressPct) || 0));
      fill.style.width = `${clamped}%`;
    }

    if (actionLabel && typeof onAction === 'function') {
      actionBtn.textContent = actionLabel;
      actionBtn.onclick = onAction;
      actionBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
    } else {
      actionBtn.onclick = null;
      actionBtn.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    if (cancellable && typeof onCancel === 'function') {
      cancelBtn.onclick = onCancel;
      cancelBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
    } else {
      cancelBtn.onclick = null;
      cancelBtn.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    banner.classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  function hideBanner() {
    const banner = $('inline-banner');
    if (banner) banner.classList.add('hidden');
  }

  function renderPrereqError(err) {
    const card = $('prereq-card');
    const details = $('prereq-details');
    if (!card || !details) return;
    const lines = [err?.message || 'Missing prerequisites'];
    if (err?.details?.hint) lines.push(String(err.details.hint));
    if (err?.details?.installCommand) lines.push(String(err.details.installCommand));
    details.textContent = lines.join('\n');
    card.classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  function renderPrereqStatus(prereq) {
    const card = $('prereq-card');
    const details = $('prereq-details');
    if (!card || !details) return;
    if (!prereq || prereq.ok !== false) {
      card.classList.add('hidden');
      details.textContent = '';
      return;
    }
    const parts = [];
    if (prereq.code) parts.push(`[${prereq.code}]`);
    if (prereq.message) parts.push(prereq.message);
    if (Array.isArray(prereq.missing)) parts.push(`Missing: ${prereq.missing.join(', ')}`);
    const hint = prereq.hint || prereq.details?.hint;
    const installCmd = prereq.details?.installCommand;
    if (hint) parts.push(String(hint));
    if (installCmd) parts.push(String(installCmd));
    if (parts.length === 0) parts.push('Install ghidra and jdk-openjdk (>= 25).');
    details.textContent = parts.join('\n');
    card.classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  // ---------- Status & Engine Popover ----------
  async function refreshStatus() {
    try {
      const s = await apiPost('/api/status', {});
      const wasRunning = state.daemonRunning;
      state.daemonState = s.daemonState || (s.daemonRunning ? 'ready' : 'stopped');
      state.daemonRunning = Boolean(s.daemonRunning);
      state.daemonPid = s.daemonPid || null;
      state.tier = s.tier || s.config?.tier || 'balanced';
      state.ramLimitMb = Number(s.ramLimitMb || s.tierSpec?.ramLimitMb || 3072);
      state.config = s.config || state.config;
      state.tierSpec = s.tierSpec || state.tierSpec;
      state.hostMemory = s.hostMemory || state.hostMemory;
      state.rss = s.rss || state.rss;
      state.workers = s.workers || null;
      state.loadedBinaries = Array.isArray(s.loadedBinaries) ? s.loadedBinaries : [];
      state.offlineProjects = Array.isArray(s.offlineProjects) ? s.offlineProjects : [];
      state.prerequisites = s.prerequisites || null;
      if (Number.isFinite(Number(s.latestSeq)) && Number(s.latestSeq) > state.latestSeq) {
        state.latestSeq = Number(s.latestSeq);
      }

      if (s.hostLocale && window.GhidraI18n && !window.GhidraI18n.hasExplicitUrlLang?.()) {
        if (window.GhidraI18n.getLang?.() !== s.hostLocale) {
          window.GhidraI18n.setLang?.(s.hostLocale);
        }
      }

      renderPrereqStatus(state.prerequisites);
      renderHeaderState();
      renderBinarySelect();
      renderEnginePopover();
      renderOpenModalLists();

      if (state.daemonRunning && !wasRunning) {
        startEventLoop();
      }
      return s;
    } catch (err) {
      // Status should not crash boot; show toast only if interactive
      return null;
    }
  }

  function renderHeaderState() {
    const dot = $('engine-dot');
    const pillText = $('engine-pill-text');
    const offlineBadge = $('offline-cache-badge');

    if (dot) {
      dot.className = 'status-dot';
      if (state.daemonState === 'analyzing') {
        dot.classList.add('analyzing');
      } else if (state.daemonState === 'starting') {
        dot.classList.add('starting');
      } else if (state.daemonRunning) {
        dot.classList.add('live');
      } else {
        dot.classList.add('offline');
      }
    }

    if (pillText) {
      if (!state.daemonRunning) {
        pillText.textContent = t('enginePillOffline', null, 'OFFLINE · 0 MB JVM');
      } else if (state.daemonState === 'starting') {
        pillText.textContent = t('engineStartingPill', null, 'STARTING…');
      } else {
        const usedMb = Math.round(Number(state.rss?.totalDaemonMb) || 0);
        const limitMb = Math.round(Number(state.ramLimitMb) || 3072);
        const tierCap = state.tier ? state.tier.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + state.tier.slice(1) : 'Balanced';
        pillText.textContent = t(
          'enginePillLive',
          { used: usedMb, limit: limitMb, tier: tierCap },
          `LIVE · ${usedMb} / ${limitMb} MB (${tierCap})`,
        );
      }
    }

    if (offlineBadge) {
      const showOffline = Boolean(state.activeBinaryId) && (!state.daemonRunning || state.decompileSource === 'sqlite_cache');
      offlineBadge.classList.toggle('hidden', !showOffline);
    }

    const bin = findKnownBinary(state.activeBinaryId);
    const loc = $('hdr-location');
    if (loc) {
      if (!state.activeBinaryId) {
        loc.textContent = '';
        loc.title = '';
      } else {
        const fnName = state.decompile?.function?.name || state.disasm?.functionEntry || '';
        const addr = state.selectedAsmAddr || state.decompile?.function?.entry || state.disasm?.startAddr || '';
        const text = fnName && addr && fnName !== addr
          ? `${fnName} @ ${addr}`
          : (addr || fnName || getBinaryDisplayName(bin));
        loc.textContent = text;
        loc.title = text;
      }
    }

    updateHistoryButtons();
  }

  function renderBinarySelect() {
    const sel = $('binary-select');
    if (!sel) return;
    const seen = new Set();
    const options = [];

    for (const b of state.loadedBinaries) {
      const id = String(b.binaryId).toLowerCase();
      if (seen.has(id)) continue;
      seen.add(id);
      options.push({ id, label: `${getBinaryDisplayName(b)} [LIVE]` });
    }
    for (const p of state.offlineProjects) {
      const id = String(p.binaryId).toLowerCase();
      if (seen.has(id)) continue;
      seen.add(id);
      options.push({ id, label: `${getBinaryDisplayName(p)} (${p.arch || p.format || 'offline'})` });
    }

    sel.replaceChildren();
    if (options.length === 0) {
      const opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = '';
      opt.textContent = t('noBinarySelected', null, 'No binary selected');
      sel.appendChild(opt);
      sel.disabled = true;
      return;
    }

    sel.disabled = false;
    for (const o of options) {
      const opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = o.id;
      opt.textContent = o.label;
      if (state.activeBinaryId && state.activeBinaryId.toLowerCase() === o.id) {
        opt.selected = true;
      }
      sel.appendChild(opt);
    }
    if (state.activeBinaryId) {
      sel.value = state.activeBinaryId.toLowerCase();
    }
  }

  function renderEnginePopover() {
    const stateLine = $('engine-state-line');
    const barJvm = $('ram-bar-jvm');
    const barDecomp = $('ram-bar-decomp');
    const barFree = $('ram-bar-free');
    const ramSummary = $('ram-summary-text');
    const workersList = $('engine-workers-list');
    const customRow = $('custom-ram-row');
    const slider = $('custom-ram-slider');
    const customVal = $('custom-ram-value');
    const idleSelect = $('idle-timeout-select');
    const stopBtn = $('btn-stop-jvm');
    const startBtn = $('btn-start-jvm');
    const unloadBtn = $('btn-unload-active');

    if (stateLine) {
      if (!state.daemonRunning) {
        stateLine.textContent = t('engineStateOffline', null, 'Stopped (0 MB JVM)');
      } else if (state.daemonState === 'starting') {
        stateLine.textContent = t('engineStateStarting', null, 'Starting Ghidra Daemon…');
      } else {
        stateLine.textContent = t(
          'engineStateSummary',
          { state: state.daemonState || 'live', pid: state.daemonPid || '?' },
          `${state.daemonState || 'live'} · PID ${state.daemonPid || '?'}`,
        );
      }
    }

    const limit = Math.max(1, Number(state.ramLimitMb) || 3072);
    const jvmMb = Number(state.rss?.jvmMb) || 0;
    const decompMb = Number(state.rss?.decompilerMb) || 0;
    const totalMb = Number(state.rss?.totalDaemonMb) || (jvmMb + decompMb);
    const jvmPct = Math.min(100, (jvmMb / limit) * 100);
    const decompPct = Math.min(100 - jvmPct, (decompMb / limit) * 100);
    const freePct = Math.max(0, 100 - jvmPct - decompPct);

    if (barJvm) barJvm.style.width = `${jvmPct.toFixed(1)}%`;
    if (barDecomp) barDecomp.style.width = `${decompPct.toFixed(1)}%`;
    if (barFree) barFree.style.width = `${freePct.toFixed(1)}%`;

    if (ramSummary) {
      const sidecarMb = Number(state.rss?.sidecarNodeMb) || 0;
      ramSummary.textContent = t(
        'engineRamBreakdown',
        { jvm: jvmMb, decomp: decompMb, limit, sidecar: sidecarMb, total: totalMb },
        `JVM ${jvmMb} MB + Decompiler ${decompMb} MB / Limit ${limit} MB (Sidecar ${sidecarMb} MB)`,
      );
    }

    if (workersList) {
      workersList.replaceChildren();
      const workerItems = Array.isArray(state.workers?.workers) ? state.workers.workers : [];
      const configuredCount = state.workers?.configured ?? state.tierSpec?.workers ?? 0;
      const busyCount = Number(state.workers?.busy ?? workerItems.filter((w) => w.state === 'busy').length) || 0;
      const uiSlotLabel = configuredCount >= 2
        ? t('uiSlotReserved', null, 'reserved')
        : t('uiSlotShared', null, 'shared');
      const summaryLine = document.createElement('div');
      summaryLine.textContent = t(
        'workerLineStatus',
        { busy: busyCount, total: configuredCount, uiSlot: uiSlotLabel },
        `Workers: ${busyCount}/${configuredCount} busy (UI slot: ${uiSlotLabel})`,
      );
      workersList.appendChild(summaryLine);

      for (const w of workerItems) {
        const line = document.createElement('div');
        const lane = w.uiReserved || w.id === 0 ? 'UI' : 'Pool';
        const wState = w.state === 'busy' ? t('workerBusy', null, 'busy') : t('workerIdle', null, 'idle');
        line.textContent = `#${w.id ?? '?'} [${lane}]: ${wState} · ${w.rssMb ?? 0} MB`;
        workersList.appendChild(line);
      }
    }

    for (const btn of document.querySelectorAll('.tier-btn[data-tier]')) {
      btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.tier === state.tier);
    }

    const customMb = Number(state.config?.customRamMb || state.ramLimitMb || 3072);
    if (customRow) {
      customRow.classList.toggle('hidden', state.tier !== 'custom');
    }
    if (slider) {
      const maxAllowed = state.hostMemory?.memTotalMb
        ? Math.max(1536, Math.min(10240, Math.floor(state.hostMemory.memTotalMb * 0.70)))
        : 10240;
      slider.min = '1536';
      slider.max = String(maxAllowed);
      slider.value = String(Math.max(1536, Math.min(maxAllowed, customMb)));
    }
    if (customVal) {
      customVal.textContent = `${customMb} MB`;
    }

    if (idleSelect) {
      const idleMin = String(state.config?.idleTimeoutMin ?? state.tierSpec?.idleTimeoutMin ?? 20);
      let hasOpt = false;
      for (const opt of idleSelect.options) {
        if (opt.value === idleMin) {
          hasOpt = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (!hasOpt) {
        const opt = document.createElement('option');
        opt.value = idleMin;
        opt.textContent = `${idleMin} min`;
        idleSelect.appendChild(opt);
      }
      idleSelect.value = idleMin;
    }

    if (stopBtn) stopBtn.disabled = !state.daemonRunning;
    if (startBtn) startBtn.disabled = state.daemonRunning;
    if (unloadBtn) {
      const activeIsLoaded = Boolean(
        state.activeBinaryId &&
          state.loadedBinaries.some((b) => String(b.binaryId).toLowerCase() === state.activeBinaryId.toLowerCase()),
      );
      unloadBtn.disabled = !state.daemonRunning || !activeIsLoaded;
    }
  }

  // ---------- Workspace Scan & Open Binary ----------
  async function scanWorkspace(uris) {
    state.workspaceUris = Array.isArray(uris) ? uris : [];
    try {
      const res = await apiPost('/api/workspace/scan', { workspaceUris: state.workspaceUris });
      state.workspaceBinaries = Array.isArray(res.binaries) ? res.binaries : [];
    } catch {
      state.workspaceBinaries = [];
    }
    renderWorkspaceQuickList();
    renderOpenModalLists();
  }

  function renderWorkspaceQuickList() {
    const mount = $('empty-workspace-quick');
    if (!mount) return;
    mount.replaceChildren();
    if (state.workspaceBinaries.length === 0) {
      const msg = document.createElement('div');
      msg.className = 'inspector-meta';
      msg.textContent = t('emptyNoBinaries', null, 'No binaries detected in workspace yet.');
      mount.appendChild(msg);
      return;
    }
    for (const bin of state.workspaceBinaries.slice(0, 6)) {
      mount.appendChild(buildWorkspaceBinaryRow(bin));
    }
  }

  function buildWorkspaceBinaryRow(bin) {
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'modal-list-row';
    const left = document.createElement('div');
    left.className = 'vrow-main';
    const name = document.createElement('span');
    name.className = 'vrow-name';
    name.textContent = bin.name || bin.relPath || bin.path;
    const sub = document.createElement('span');
    sub.className = 'vrow-meta';
    sub.textContent = bin.relPath && bin.relPath !== bin.name ? bin.relPath : '';
    left.append(name, sub);

    const right = document.createElement('span');
    right.className = 'vrow-meta';
    right.textContent = `${bin.format || '?'} ${bin.arch || ''} ${bin.bits || ''}-bit · ${formatBytes(bin.sizeBytes)}`;
    row.append(left, right);
    row.addEventListener('click', () => {
      closeModal($('open-modal'));
      openBinaryFromUi({
        path: bin.path,
        analysisProfile: $('open-profile-select')?.value || 'default',
      });
    });
    return row;
  }

  function renderOpenModalLists() {
    const wsList = $('open-workspace-list');
    if (wsList) {
      wsList.replaceChildren();
      if (state.workspaceBinaries.length === 0) {
        const empty = document.createElement('div');
        empty.className = 'modal-list-row';
        empty.textContent = t('noWorkspaceBinaries', null, 'No ELF, PE, or Mach-O binaries found in open workspace folders.');
        wsList.appendChild(empty);
      } else {
        for (const bin of state.workspaceBinaries) {
          wsList.appendChild(buildWorkspaceBinaryRow(bin));
        }
      }
    }

    const recentList = $('open-recent-list');
    if (recentList) {
      recentList.replaceChildren();
      if (state.offlineProjects.length === 0) {
        const empty = document.createElement('div');
        empty.className = 'modal-list-row';
        empty.textContent = t('noRecentProjects', null, 'No indexed projects yet.');
        recentList.appendChild(empty);
      } else {
        for (const proj of state.offlineProjects) {
          const row = document.createElement('div');
          row.className = 'modal-list-row';
          const left = document.createElement('div');
          left.className = 'vrow-main';
          const name = document.createElement('span');
          name.className = 'vrow-name';
          name.textContent = getBinaryDisplayName(proj);
          const badge = document.createElement('span');
          badge.className = 'vrow-badge';
          badge.textContent = proj.hasIndex ? t('offlineCacheBadge', null, 'Offline Cache') : (proj.format || 'gpr');
          left.append(name, badge);

          const right = document.createElement('span');
          right.className = 'vrow-meta';
          right.textContent = `${proj.arch || ''} · ${plural('function', proj.functionCount || 0)}`;
          row.append(left, right);

          row.addEventListener('click', () => {
            closeModal($('open-modal'));
            openBinaryFromUi({
              sha256: proj.binaryId,
              path: proj.primaryPath || undefined,
              offlineOnly: !state.daemonRunning && Boolean(proj.hasIndex),
            });
          });
          recentList.appendChild(row);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  async function openBinaryFromUi(opts = {}) {
    try {
      const targetName = opts.path ? opts.path.split('/').pop() : (opts.sha256 ? opts.sha256.slice(0, 12) : 'binary');
      if (!opts.offlineOnly && !state.daemonRunning) {
        showBanner(t('startingEngineBanner', { tier: state.tier }, `Starting Ghidra Engine [${state.tier}]…`), {
          progressPct: 15,
        });
      }

      const res = await apiPost('/api/binary/open', {
        path: opts.path,
        sha256: opts.sha256,
        binaryId: opts.binaryId,
        analyze: opts.analyze ?? true,
        forceReimport: Boolean(opts.forceReimport),
        analysisProfile: opts.analysisProfile || 'default',
        offlineOnly: Boolean(opts.offlineOnly),
        replaceIfFull: true,
      });

      if (res.status === 'analyzing' && res.jobId) {
        state.activeJobId = res.jobId;
        state.pendingJobCancel = false;
        await pollAnalysisJob(res.jobId, res.binaryId, targetName);
      } else {
        hideBanner();
        await activateOpenedBinary(res.binaryId || opts.sha256 || opts.binaryId, {
          ...opts,
          offlineOnly: Boolean(opts.offlineOnly) || res.mode === 'offline',
          openResult: res,
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      hideBanner();
      showErrorToast(err);
      await refreshStatus();
    }
  }

  async function pollAnalysisJob(jobId, binaryId, targetName) {
    state.daemonState = 'analyzing';
    renderHeaderState();

    while (state.activeJobId === jobId) {
      let job;
      try {
        job = await apiPost('/api/binary/job', { jobId });
      } catch (err) {
        hideBanner();
        state.activeJobId = null;
        showErrorToast(err);
        await refreshStatus();
        return;
      }

      const jobState = String(job.state || '').toLowerCase();
      const rawPct = job.percent ?? job.progressPct;
      const pct = rawPct !== undefined && rawPct !== null && Number.isFinite(Number(rawPct))
        ? Number(rawPct)
        : (jobState === 'completed' ? 100 : 35);
      const stepVal = job.currentAnalyzer || job.phase || job.currentStep || '';
      const step = stepVal ? ` (${stepVal})` : '';
      showBanner(
        `${t('analyzingBinaryBanner', { name: targetName, pct: Math.round(pct) }, `Analyzing ${targetName}… ${Math.round(pct)}%`)}${step}`,
        {
          progressPct: pct,
          cancellable: jobState !== 'completed' && jobState !== 'failed' && jobState !== 'cancelled',
          onCancel: async () => {
            try {
              state.pendingJobCancel = true;
              await apiPost('/api/binary/job', { jobId, cancel: true });
            } catch (cancelErr) {
              showErrorToast(cancelErr);
            }
          },
        },
      );

      if (jobState === 'completed' || jobState === 'succeeded' || jobState === 'done') {
        state.activeJobId = null;
        hideBanner();
        await activateOpenedBinary(job.binaryId || binaryId, {});
        return;
      }

      if (jobState === 'failed' || jobState === 'error') {
        state.activeJobId = null;
        hideBanner();
        showToast(job.error?.message || job.message || 'Analysis failed', 'error', 6000);
        await refreshStatus();
        return;
      }

      if (jobState === 'cancelled' || jobState === 'canceled') {
        state.activeJobId = null;
        hideBanner();
        showToast('Analysis cancelled.', 'info');
        await refreshStatus();
        return;
      }

      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400));
    }
  }

  async function activateOpenedBinary(binaryId, opts = {}) {
    if (!binaryId) return;
    const openNavGen = state.navGen;
    state.activeBinaryId = String(binaryId).toLowerCase();
    state.decompile = null;
    state.disasm = null;
    window.GhidraCfg?.destroy?.($('cfg-mount'));
    state.cfgGen++;
    state.callgraphGen++;
    state.inspectorGen++;
    state.cfg = null;
    state.callgraph = null;
    state.highlightedVarId = null;
    highlightedVarEls = [];
    state.collapsedFolds.clear();
    state.selectedLine = null;
    state.selectedAsmAddr = null;
    state.focusedTarget = null;
    closeInspector({ skipRender: true });

    await refreshStatus();

    $('empty-workbench')?.classList.add('hidden');
    updateViewVisibility();
    renderDecompileHeader();
    renderDecompileLinesWindow();

    resetSidebarCache();
    await ensureSidebarPage(0);

    if (opts.skipAutoNav || state.navGen !== openNavGen) {
      renderHeaderState();
      return;
    }

    const openRes = opts.openResult;
    const isOfflineOpen = Boolean(opts.offlineOnly) || openRes?.mode === 'offline';
    if (isOfflineOpen) {
      const binMeta = openRes?.binary || findKnownBinary(state.activeBinaryId);
      const cachedCount = Number(binMeta?.cachedDecompileCount ?? 0);
      if (cachedCount <= 0) {
        const titleEl = $('decompile-fn-title');
        const sigEl = $('decompile-fn-sig');
        if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = getBinaryDisplayName(binMeta) || state.activeBinaryId.slice(0, 12);
        if (sigEl) {
          sigEl.textContent = t(
            'offlineBannerNotice',
            null,
            'Viewing offline SQLite cache (0 MB JVM). Live analysis starts automatically when needed.',
          );
        }
        renderHeaderState();
        return;
      }
    }

    // Pick initial interesting entrypoint (`firstCachedEntry` when offline, else `main` -> `_start` -> first non-import -> first function)
    let initialTarget = opts.initialTarget || (isOfflineOpen ? openRes?.binary?.firstCachedEntry || null : null);
    if (!initialTarget) {
      try {
        const mainSearch = await apiPost('/api/search/functions', {
          binaryId: state.activeBinaryId,
          query: 'main',
          kind: 'user',
          limit: 10,
        });
        const items = mainSearch.items || [];
        const exactMain = items.find((f) => f.name === 'main') || items.find((f) => f.name === '_start');
        if (exactMain) {
          initialTarget = exactMain.addr;
        }
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
    }
    if (state.navGen !== openNavGen) {
      renderHeaderState();
      return;
    }
    if (!initialTarget) {
      const page0 = state.sidebarPages.get(0) || [];
      const firstUser = page0.find((f) => !f.isImport) || page0[0];
      if (firstUser) {
        initialTarget = firstUser.addr || firstUser.entryHex;
      }
    }

    if (initialTarget && state.navGen === openNavGen) {
      await navigateToTarget(state.activeBinaryId, initialTarget, {
        source: 'open_binary',
        preferOffline: isOfflineOpen || !state.daemonRunning,
        offlineNoWake: isOfflineOpen,
        skipHistory: true,
      });
    } else {
      renderHeaderState();
    }
  }

  // ---------- 50,000+ Sidebar Virtualizer ----------
  function resetSidebarCache() {
    state.sidebarPages.clear();
    state.sidebarInflight.clear();
    state.sidebarTotal = 0;
    state.sidebarCoverage = null;
    state.sidebarQueryGen++;
    const vlist = $('sidebar-vlist');
    if (vlist) vlist.scrollTop = 0;
    updateSidebarMetaUi();
    renderSidebarWindow();
  }

  function lruGetPage(pageIdx) {
    if (!state.sidebarPages.has(pageIdx)) return null;
    const val = state.sidebarPages.get(pageIdx);
    state.sidebarPages.delete(pageIdx);
    state.sidebarPages.set(pageIdx, val);
    return val;
  }

  function lruSetPage(pageIdx, items) {
    if (state.sidebarPages.has(pageIdx)) {
      state.sidebarPages.delete(pageIdx);
    }
    state.sidebarPages.set(pageIdx, items);
    while (state.sidebarPages.size > SIDEBAR_MAX_PAGES) {
      const oldestKey = state.sidebarPages.keys().next().value;
      state.sidebarPages.delete(oldestKey);
    }
  }

  function parseRegexQuery(raw) {
    const trimmed = String(raw || '').trim();
    if (trimmed.length >= 2 && trimmed.startsWith('/') && trimmed.endsWith('/')) {
      return { regex: true, query: trimmed.slice(1, -1) };
    }
    return { regex: false, query: trimmed };
  }

  async function ensureSidebarPage(pageIdx) {
    if (!state.activeBinaryId) return;
    const gen = state.sidebarQueryGen;
    const inflightKey = `${gen}:${pageIdx}`;
    if (state.sidebarPages.has(pageIdx) || state.sidebarInflight.has(inflightKey)) return;

    const tab = state.sidebarTab;
    const binaryId = state.activeBinaryId;
    state.sidebarInflight.add(inflightKey);

    try {
      let res;
      if (tab === 'code') {
        if (pageIdx > 0) return;
        const q = String(state.sidebarQuery || '').trim();
        if (!q) {
          state.sidebarTotal = 0;
          state.sidebarCoverage = null;
          lruSetPage(0, []);
          updateSidebarMetaUi();
          renderSidebarWindow();
          return;
        }
        res = await apiPost('/api/search/pseudocode', {
          binaryId,
          query: q,
          limit: 50,
        });
        if (gen !== state.sidebarQueryGen) return;
        const matches = Array.isArray(res.matches) ? res.matches : [];
        state.sidebarTotal = matches.length;
        state.sidebarCoverage = {
          indexedFunctions: res.indexedFunctions ?? 0,
          totalFunctions: res.totalFunctions ?? 0,
          coveragePct: res.coveragePct ?? 0,
        };
        lruSetPage(0, matches);
      } else if (tab === 'strings') {
        const cursor = pageIdx === 0 ? '' : String(pageIdx * SIDEBAR_PAGE_SIZE);
        res = await apiPost('/api/search/strings', {
          binaryId,
          query: state.sidebarQuery,
          limit: SIDEBAR_PAGE_SIZE,
          cursor,
        });
        if (gen !== state.sidebarQueryGen) return;
        state.sidebarTotal = Number(res.total) || 0;
        lruSetPage(pageIdx, Array.isArray(res.items) ? res.items : []);
      } else {
        const kind = tab === 'imports' ? 'import' : tab === 'exports' ? 'export' : 'all';
        const parsed = parseRegexQuery(state.sidebarQuery);
        const cursor = pageIdx === 0 ? '' : String(pageIdx * SIDEBAR_PAGE_SIZE);
        res = await apiPost('/api/search/functions', {
          binaryId,
          query: parsed.query,
          kind,
          regex: parsed.regex,
          sort: state.sidebarSort,
          limit: SIDEBAR_PAGE_SIZE,
          cursor,
        });
        if (gen !== state.sidebarQueryGen) return;
        state.sidebarTotal = Number(res.total) || 0;
        lruSetPage(pageIdx, Array.isArray(res.items) ? res.items : []);
      }

      updateSidebarMetaUi();
      renderSidebarWindow();
    } catch (err) {
      if (gen === state.sidebarQueryGen && err.code !== 'INVALID_PARAMS') {
        // Silent for partial regex while typing; toast on real errors
      } else if (gen === state.sidebarQueryGen && err.code === 'INVALID_PARAMS') {
        showToast(err.message, 'error', 2500);
      }
    } finally {
      state.sidebarInflight.delete(inflightKey);
    }
  }

  function updateSidebarMetaUi() {
    const countEl = $('sidebar-count');
    const covEl = $('sidebar-coverage');
    if (countEl) {
      const unitMap = {
        functions: 'function',
        strings: 'string',
        imports: 'import',
        exports: 'export',
        code: 'function',
      };
      countEl.textContent = plural(unitMap[state.sidebarTab] || 'function', state.sidebarTotal);
    }
    if (covEl) {
      if (state.sidebarTab === 'code' && state.sidebarCoverage) {
        covEl.textContent = t(
          'indexedCoverage',
          {
```
