            pct: state.sidebarCoverage.coveragePct,
            indexed: state.sidebarCoverage.indexedFunctions,
            total: state.sidebarCoverage.totalFunctions,
          },
          `Indexed: ${state.sidebarCoverage.coveragePct}% (${state.sidebarCoverage.indexedFunctions}/${state.sidebarCoverage.totalFunctions})`,
        );
        covEl.classList.remove('hidden');
      } else {
        covEl.classList.add('hidden');
      }
    }
  }

  function renderSidebarWindow() {
    const vlist = $('sidebar-vlist');
    const spacer = $('sidebar-vlist-spacer');
    const rowsEl = $('sidebar-vlist-rows');
    if (!vlist || !spacer || !rowsEl) return;

    const total = state.sidebarTotal;
    spacer.style.height = `${total * SIDEBAR_ROW_HEIGHT}px`;

    if (!state.activeBinaryId || total === 0) {
      rowsEl.style.transform = 'translateY(0px)';
      rowsEl.replaceChildren();
      if (state.activeBinaryId && state.sidebarTab === 'code' && !state.sidebarQuery.trim()) {
        const hint = document.createElement('div');
        hint.className = 'vrow';
        hint.textContent = t('sidebarSearchCodePlaceholder', null, 'Search indexed decompiled C…');
        rowsEl.appendChild(hint);
      }
      return;
    }

    const scrollTop = vlist.scrollTop;
    const viewH = vlist.clientHeight || 480;
    const startIdx = Math.max(0, Math.floor(scrollTop / SIDEBAR_ROW_HEIGHT) - SIDEBAR_OVERSCAN);
    const endIdx = Math.min(total - 1, Math.ceil((scrollTop + viewH) / SIDEBAR_ROW_HEIGHT) + SIDEBAR_OVERSCAN);

    const firstPage = Math.floor(startIdx / SIDEBAR_PAGE_SIZE);
    const lastPage = Math.floor(endIdx / SIDEBAR_PAGE_SIZE);
    for (let p = firstPage; p <= lastPage; p++) {
      if (!state.sidebarPages.has(p)) {
        ensureSidebarPage(p);
      }
    }

    const activeEntryHex = normHex(state.decompile?.function?.entry || state.disasm?.functionEntry || state.inspectorAddr);
    const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();

    for (let idx = startIdx; idx <= endIdx; idx++) {
      const pageIdx = Math.floor(idx / SIDEBAR_PAGE_SIZE);
      const offsetInPage = idx % SIDEBAR_PAGE_SIZE;
      const page = lruGetPage(pageIdx);
      const item = page ? page[offsetInPage] : null;
      frag.appendChild(buildSidebarRow(item, idx, activeEntryHex));
    }

    rowsEl.style.transform = `translateY(${startIdx * SIDEBAR_ROW_HEIGHT}px)`;
    rowsEl.replaceChildren(frag);
  }

  function buildSidebarRow(item, idx, activeEntryHex) {
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'vrow';
    row.setAttribute('role', 'option');
    row.dataset.index = String(idx);

    if (!item) {
      const placeholder = document.createElement('span');
      placeholder.className = 'vrow-meta';
      placeholder.textContent = '…';
      row.appendChild(placeholder);
      return row;
    }

    const addrHex = normHex(item.addr || item.entryHex || item.entry);
    if (addrHex && activeEntryHex && addrHex === activeEntryHex) {
      row.classList.add('active');
    }
    row.dataset.addr = addrHex;

    const main = document.createElement('div');
    main.className = 'vrow-main';

    const nameEl = document.createElement('span');
    nameEl.className = 'vrow-name';

    const metaEl = document.createElement('span');
    metaEl.className = 'vrow-meta';

    if (state.sidebarTab === 'strings') {
      nameEl.textContent = JSON.stringify(String(item.value ?? ''));
      metaEl.textContent = shortHex(addrHex);
      row.title = `${addrHex} (${item.section || ''}) ${item.value ?? ''}`;
    } else if (state.sidebarTab === 'code') {
      nameEl.textContent = `${item.name || addrHex} — ${String(item.snippet || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ')}`;
      metaEl.textContent = shortHex(addrHex);
      row.title = `${item.name || ''} @ ${addrHex}\n${item.snippet || ''}`;
    } else {
      nameEl.textContent = item.name || addrHex;
      if (item.externalLib) {
        const badge = document.createElement('span');
        badge.className = 'vrow-badge';
        badge.textContent = item.externalLib;
        main.append(nameEl, badge);
      } else {
        main.appendChild(nameEl);
      }
      metaEl.textContent = state.sidebarSort === 'size'
        ? `${item.sizeBytes ?? item.size ?? 0}B`
        : shortHex(addrHex);
      row.title = `${item.name || addrHex} @ ${addrHex} (${item.sizeBytes ?? item.size ?? 0} B)`;
    }

    if (!main.contains(nameEl)) {
      main.prepend(nameEl);
    }
    row.append(main, metaEl);
    return row;
  }

  function scheduleSidebarRender() {
    if (sidebarScrollRaf) return;
    sidebarScrollRaf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      sidebarScrollRaf = 0;
      renderSidebarWindow();
    });
  }

  function switchSidebarTab(tab) {
    if (!tab || state.sidebarTab === tab) return;
    state.sidebarTab = tab;
    for (const btn of document.querySelectorAll('.side-tab[data-tab]')) {
      const active = btn.dataset.tab === tab;
      btn.classList.toggle('active', active);
      btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', active ? 'true' : 'false');
    }
    const sortEl = $('sidebar-sort');
    if (sortEl) {
      sortEl.disabled = tab === 'strings' || tab === 'code';
    }
    const input = $('sidebar-search-input');
    if (input) {
      input.placeholder = tab === 'code'
        ? t('sidebarSearchCodePlaceholder', null, 'Search indexed decompiled C…')
        : t('sidebarSearchPlaceholder', null, 'Filter symbols, /regex/…');
    }
    resetSidebarCache();
    ensureSidebarPage(0);
  }

  // ---------- Tokenized C Renderer, Folds & Line Virtualizer ----------
  function setDecompilePayload(data, { preserveFolds = false } = {}) {
    state.decompile = data;
    state.decompileSource = data?.source || (state.daemonRunning ? 'live' : 'sqlite_cache');
    if (!preserveFolds) {
      state.collapsedFolds.clear();
      state.highlightedVarId = null;
      highlightedVarEls = [];
    }

    state.foldByStartLine.clear();
    const folds = Array.isArray(data?.folds) ? data.folds : [];
    for (const fold of folds) {
      if (fold && Number.isInteger(fold.startLine)) {
        state.foldByStartLine.set(fold.startLine, fold);
      }
    }

    recomputeVisibleDecompileLines();
    renderDecompileHeader();
    renderDecompileLinesWindow();
    renderHeaderState();
    renderSidebarWindow();
    if (state.find.open) {
      runFindInFunction();
    }
  }

  function recomputeVisibleDecompileLines() {
    const lines = Array.isArray(state.decompile?.lines) ? state.decompile.lines : [];
    const visible = [];
    let hideUntilLine = -1;

    for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
      const lineObj = lines[i];
      const lineNum = Number(lineObj.line ?? i + 1);
      if (lineNum < hideUntilLine) {
        continue;
      }
      hideUntilLine = -1;
      const fold = state.foldByStartLine.get(lineNum);
      const isCollapsed = Boolean(fold && state.collapsedFolds.has(fold.id) && fold.endLine > fold.startLine + 1);
      visible.push({
        lineObj,
        lineNum,
        fold: fold || null,
        isCollapsed,
      });
      if (isCollapsed) {
        hideUntilLine = fold.endLine;
      }
    }
    state.visibleDecompileLines = visible;
  }

  function renderDecompileHeader() {
    const fn = state.decompile?.function;
    const titleEl = $('decompile-fn-title');
    const sigEl = $('decompile-fn-sig');
    const countEl = $('decompile-line-count');
    const total = Number(state.decompile?.totalLines ?? state.decompile?.lines?.length ?? 0);

    if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = fn ? `${fn.name || fn.entry} @ ${fn.entry || ''}` : '';
    if (sigEl) {
      sigEl.textContent = fn?.signature || '';
      sigEl.title = fn?.signature || '';
    }
    if (countEl) {
      countEl.textContent = fn ? plural('line', total) : '';
    }
  }

  function renderDecompileLinesWindow() {
    const viewport = $('decompile-viewport');
    const spacer = $('decompile-spacer');
    const linesMount = $('decompile-lines');
    if (!viewport || !spacer || !linesMount) return;

    const vis = state.visibleDecompileLines;
    highlightedVarEls = [];

    if (!state.decompile || vis.length === 0) {
      linesMount.classList.remove('virtualized');
      spacer.style.height = '';
      linesMount.style.transform = '';
      linesMount.replaceChildren();
      return;
    }

    const d = state.decompile;
    const hasMoreLines = Boolean(
      d &&
      d.truncated === true &&
      Number(d.endLine) < Number(d.totalLines),
    );
    const useVirtual = vis.length > DECOMPILE_VIRT_THRESHOLD;
    let startIdx = 0;
    let endIdx = vis.length - 1;

    if (useVirtual) {
      linesMount.classList.add('virtualized');
      spacer.style.height = `${vis.length * DECOMPILE_LINE_HEIGHT + (hasMoreLines ? 44 : 0)}px`;
      const scrollTop = viewport.scrollTop;
      const viewH = viewport.clientHeight || 560;
      startIdx = Math.max(0, Math.floor(scrollTop / DECOMPILE_LINE_HEIGHT) - DECOMPILE_OVERSCAN);
      endIdx = Math.min(vis.length - 1, Math.ceil((scrollTop + viewH) / DECOMPILE_LINE_HEIGHT) + DECOMPILE_OVERSCAN);
      linesMount.style.transform = `translateY(${startIdx * DECOMPILE_LINE_HEIGHT}px)`;
    } else {
      linesMount.classList.remove('virtualized');
      spacer.style.height = '';
      linesMount.style.transform = '';
    }

    const syncedLines = computeSyncedCLineSet();
    const activeFindLine = state.find.open && state.find.currentIdx >= 0
      ? state.find.matches[state.find.currentIdx]?.lineNum
      : null;
    const findLineSet = state.find.open ? new Set(state.find.matches.map((m) => m.lineNum)) : null;

    const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
    for (let i = startIdx; i <= endIdx; i++) {
      const entry = vis[i];
      const lineEl = buildCLineElement(entry, syncedLines, findLineSet, activeFindLine);
      frag.appendChild(lineEl);
    }

    if (hasMoreLines && (!useVirtual || endIdx >= vis.length - 1)) {
      const currentEnd = Number(d.endLine || d.lines?.length || 0);
      const totalLines = Number(d.totalLines || currentEnd);
      const nextCount = Math.min(4000, Math.max(1, totalLines - currentEnd));
      const fromLine = currentEnd + 1;
      const toLine = Math.min(totalLines, currentEnd + nextCount);

      const footer = document.createElement('div');
      footer.className = 'c-line load-more-lines-row';
      const btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'mini-btn primary load-more-lines-btn';
      btn.textContent = t(
        'loadMoreDecompileLines',
        { count: nextCount, from: fromLine, to: toLine, total: totalLines },
        `Load next ${nextCount} lines (${fromLine}–${toLine} of ${totalLines})`,
      );
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => loadMoreDecompileLines(btn));
      footer.appendChild(btn);
      frag.appendChild(footer);
    }

    linesMount.replaceChildren(frag);
  }

  async function loadMoreDecompileLines(btn = null) {
    const d = state.decompile;
    if (!d || !d.truncated || !state.activeBinaryId) return null;
    const currentEnd = Number(d.endLine || d.lines?.length || 0);
    const totalLines = Number(d.totalLines || currentEnd);
    if (currentEnd >= totalLines) return null;

    const targetEntry = d.function?.entry;
    if (!targetEntry) return null;

    if (btn) {
      btn.disabled = true;
      btn.textContent = t('loadingMoreLines', null, 'Loading lines…');
    }

    const myGen = ++state.decompileGen;
    const viewport = $('decompile-viewport');
    const savedScrollTop = viewport ? viewport.scrollTop : 0;

    try {
      const nextChunk = await apiPost('/api/view/decompile', {
        binaryId: d.binaryId || state.activeBinaryId,
        target: targetEntry,
        startLine: currentEnd + 1,
        maxLines: 4000,
        refresh: false,
        offlineOnly: !state.daemonRunning,
      });
      if (myGen !== state.decompileGen || state.decompile !== d) return null;

      const existingLines = Array.isArray(d.lines) ? d.lines : [];
      const seenLines = new Set(existingLines.map((l) => Number(l.line)));
      const appended = (Array.isArray(nextChunk.lines) ? nextChunk.lines : []).filter(
        (l) => !seenLines.has(Number(l.line)),
      );
      d.lines = [...existingLines, ...appended];
      d.endLine = Number(nextChunk.endLine ?? (currentEnd + appended.length));
      d.totalLines = Number(nextChunk.totalLines ?? d.totalLines);
      d.truncated = Boolean(nextChunk.truncated) && d.endLine < d.totalLines;

      if (nextChunk.addrToLines && typeof nextChunk.addrToLines === 'object') {
        d.addrToLines = d.addrToLines || {};
        for (const [addr, lineNums] of Object.entries(nextChunk.addrToLines)) {
          if (!Array.isArray(lineNums)) continue;
          const prev = d.addrToLines[addr] || [];
          const merged = new Set([...prev, ...lineNums]);
          d.addrToLines[addr] = [...merged].sort((a, b) => a - b);
        }
      }

      if (Array.isArray(nextChunk.folds)) {
        d.folds = Array.isArray(d.folds) ? d.folds : [];
        const seenFolds = new Set(d.folds.map((f) => f.id));
        for (const fold of nextChunk.folds) {
          if (fold && !seenFolds.has(fold.id)) {
            seenFolds.add(fold.id);
            d.folds.push(fold);
          }
          if (fold && Number.isInteger(fold.startLine)) {
            state.foldByStartLine.set(fold.startLine, fold);
          }
        }
      }

      if (nextChunk.labels && typeof nextChunk.labels === 'object') {
        d.labels = { ...(d.labels || {}), ...nextChunk.labels };
      }

      recomputeVisibleDecompileLines();
      renderDecompileHeader();
      renderDecompileLinesWindow();
      if (viewport) viewport.scrollTop = savedScrollTop;
      if (state.find.open) runFindInFunction();
      return d;
    } catch (err) {
      if (myGen === state.decompileGen) {
        showErrorToast(err);
        renderDecompileLinesWindow();
      }
      return null;
    }
  }

  function computeSyncedCLineSet() {
    const set = new Set();
    if (state.selectedAsmAddr && state.decompile?.addrToLines) {
      const mapped = lookupAddrToLines(state.decompile.addrToLines, state.selectedAsmAddr);
      if (Array.isArray(mapped)) {
        for (const n of mapped) set.add(Number(n));
      }
    }
    return set;
  }

  function buildCLineElement(entry, syncedLines, findLineSet, activeFindLine) {
    const { lineObj, lineNum, fold, isCollapsed } = entry;
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'c-line';
    row.dataset.line = String(lineNum);
    if (lineObj.addr) row.dataset.addr = normHex(lineObj.addr);
    if (syncedLines.has(lineNum) || state.selectedLine === lineNum) {
      row.classList.add('sync-hl');
    }
    if (activeFindLine === lineNum) {
      row.classList.add('find-match-active');
    } else if (findLineSet && findLineSet.has(lineNum)) {
      row.classList.add('find-match');
    }

    const gutter = document.createElement('span');
    gutter.className = 'c-gutter';

    const foldBtn = document.createElement('button');
    foldBtn.type = 'button';
    if (fold && fold.endLine > fold.startLine + 1) {
      foldBtn.className = 'fold-btn';
      foldBtn.dataset.foldId = fold.id;
      foldBtn.textContent = isCollapsed ? '▶' : '▼';
      foldBtn.title = fold.summary || 'Toggle fold';
    } else {
      foldBtn.className = 'fold-btn placeholder-spacer';
      foldBtn.tabIndex = -1;
      foldBtn.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      foldBtn.textContent = ' ';
    }

    const addrSpan = document.createElement('span');
    addrSpan.className = 'gutter-addr';
    if (lineObj.addr) {
      addrSpan.dataset.addr = normHex(lineObj.addr);
      addrSpan.textContent = shortHex(lineObj.addr);
    }

    const numSpan = document.createElement('span');
    numSpan.className = 'line-num';
    numSpan.textContent = String(lineNum);

    gutter.append(foldBtn, addrSpan, numSpan);

    const codeSpan = document.createElement('span');
    codeSpan.className = 'c-code';

    const indentCount = Math.max(0, Number(lineObj.indent) || 0);
    const tokens = Array.isArray(lineObj.tokens) ? lineObj.tokens : [];
    const firstTokText = tokens.length > 0 ? String(tokens[0].t || '') : '';
    if (indentCount > 0 && !(tokens[0]?.k === 'ws' && firstTokText.length >= indentCount)) {
      codeSpan.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' '.repeat(indentCount)));
    }

    for (const tok of tokens) {
      const k = tok.k || 'plain';
      const tokEl = document.createElement('span');
      tokEl.className = `tok tok-${k}`;
      tokEl.textContent = tok.t != null ? String(tok.t) : '';
      if (tok.addr) tokEl.dataset.addr = normHex(tok.addr);
      if (tok.target) tokEl.dataset.target = normHex(tok.target);
      if (tok.varId) {
        tokEl.dataset.varId = String(tok.varId);
        if ((k === 'local' || k === 'param') && state.highlightedVarId === String(tok.varId)) {
          tokEl.classList.add('var-hl');
          highlightedVarEls.push(tokEl);
        }
      }
      if (tok.isImport) tokEl.dataset.isImport = '1';
      if (tok.preview) tokEl.title = String(tok.preview);
      codeSpan.appendChild(tokEl);
    }

    if (isCollapsed && fold) {
      const hiddenCount = Math.max(1, fold.endLine - fold.startLine - 1);
      const countText = plural('line', hiddenCount);
      const badge = document.createElement('button');
      badge.type = 'button';
      badge.className = 'fold-placeholder';
      badge.dataset.foldId = fold.id;
      badge.textContent = fold.branchAddr
        ? t(
            'foldHiddenLinesWithAddr',
            { count: countText, addr: shortHex(fold.branchAddr) },
            `... (${countText} · ${shortHex(fold.branchAddr)})`,
          )
        : t('foldHiddenLines', { count: countText }, `... (${countText})`);
      codeSpan.appendChild(badge);
    }

    if (fold && fold.branchAddr) {
      const chip = document.createElement('span');
      chip.className = 'branch-chip';
      chip.dataset.addr = normHex(fold.branchAddr);
      chip.textContent = shortHex(fold.branchAddr);
      chip.title = `Sync ASM @ ${fold.branchAddr}`;
      codeSpan.appendChild(chip);
    }

    row.append(gutter, codeSpan);
    return row;
  }

  function scheduleDecompileRender() {
    if (decompileScrollRaf) return;
    decompileScrollRaf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      decompileScrollRaf = 0;
      if (state.visibleDecompileLines.length > DECOMPILE_VIRT_THRESHOLD) {
        renderDecompileLinesWindow();
      }
    });
  }

  function expandFoldsCoveringLine(lineNum) {
    if (!state.decompile || !Array.isArray(state.decompile.folds) || state.collapsedFolds.size === 0) {
      return false;
    }
    let changed = false;
    for (const fold of state.decompile.folds) {
      if (state.collapsedFolds.has(fold.id) && lineNum > fold.startLine && lineNum < fold.endLine) {
        state.collapsedFolds.delete(fold.id);
        changed = true;
      }
    }
    if (changed) {
      recomputeVisibleDecompileLines();
      renderDecompileLinesWindow();
    }
    return changed;
  }

  function scrollToCLine(lineNum, { flash = true, sync = true } = {}) {
    if (!state.decompile || !Number.isFinite(Number(lineNum))) return;
    const targetLine = Number(lineNum);
    expandFoldsCoveringLine(targetLine);

    const viewport = $('decompile-viewport');
    const linesMount = $('decompile-lines');
    if (!viewport || !linesMount) return;

    const visIdx = state.visibleDecompileLines.findIndex((e) => e.lineNum === targetLine);
    if (visIdx >= 0 && state.visibleDecompileLines.length > DECOMPILE_VIRT_THRESHOLD) {
      const viewH = viewport.clientHeight || 500;
      viewport.scrollTop = Math.max(0, visIdx * DECOMPILE_LINE_HEIGHT - viewH / 2);
      renderDecompileLinesWindow();
    }

    const lineEl = linesMount.querySelector(`.c-line[data-line="${targetLine}"]`);
    if (lineEl) {
      if (state.visibleDecompileLines.length <= DECOMPILE_VIRT_THRESHOLD) {
        lineEl.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', behavior: 'smooth' });
      }
      if (sync) {
        for (const prev of linesMount.querySelectorAll('.c-line.sync-hl')) {
          prev.classList.remove('sync-hl');
        }
        lineEl.classList.add('sync-hl');
      }
      if (flash) {
        lineEl.classList.remove('flash-hl');
        void lineEl.offsetWidth;
        lineEl.classList.add('flash-hl');
      }
    }
    state.selectedLine = targetLine;
  }

  // ---------- Fast Variable Highlight (< 5 ms, 0 network calls) ----------
  function highlightVariable(varId, varName = '', addr = '') {
    for (const el of highlightedVarEls) {
      el.classList.remove('var-hl');
    }
    highlightedVarEls = [];

    if (!varId) {
      state.highlightedVarId = null;
      return;
    }

    state.highlightedVarId = String(varId);
    const linesMount = $('decompile-lines');
    if (linesMount) {
      const selector = `.tok[data-var-id="${CSS.escape(state.highlightedVarId)}"]`;
      const matches = linesMount.querySelectorAll(selector);
      for (const el of matches) {
        el.classList.add('var-hl');
        highlightedVarEls.push(el);
      }
    }

    const fnEntry = state.decompile?.function?.entry || '';
    const varMeta = Array.isArray(state.decompile?.variables)
      ? state.decompile.variables.find((v) => String(v.varId) === state.highlightedVarId)
      : null;

    state.focusedTarget = {
      kind: 'variable',
      varId: state.highlightedVarId,
      name: varName || varMeta?.name || state.highlightedVarId,
      type: varMeta?.type || '',
      addr: addr ? normHex(addr) : fnEntry,
      functionAddr: fnEntry,
    };
  }

  // ---------- Bidirectional C <-> ASM Sync ----------
  function syncAsmToAddresses(addrs, { scroll = true } = {}) {
    const disasmMount = $('disasm-lines');
    if (!disasmMount) return;
    for (const prev of disasmMount.querySelectorAll('.asm-row.sync-hl')) {
      prev.classList.remove('sync-hl');
    }

    const normList = (Array.isArray(addrs) ? addrs : [addrs]).map(normHex).filter(Boolean);
    if (normList.length === 0) return;

    const targetSet = new Set(normList);
    let firstMatch = null;
    for (const row of disasmMount.querySelectorAll('.asm-row[data-addr]')) {
      if (targetSet.has(normHex(row.dataset.addr))) {
        row.classList.add('sync-hl');
        if (!firstMatch) firstMatch = row;
      }
    }

    state.selectedAsmAddr = normList[0];
    if (firstMatch && scroll) {
      firstMatch.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
    renderHeaderState();
  }

  function syncCToAsmAddress(addr) {
    const norm = normHex(addr);
    if (!norm || !state.decompile) return;
    state.selectedAsmAddr = norm;

    const lineNums = lookupAddrToLines(state.decompile.addrToLines, norm);
    const linesMount = $('decompile-lines');
    if (linesMount) {
      for (const prev of linesMount.querySelectorAll('.c-line.sync-hl')) {
        prev.classList.remove('sync-hl');
      }
    }

    if (Array.isArray(lineNums) && lineNums.length > 0) {
      const firstLine = Number(lineNums[0]);
      scrollToCLine(firstLine, { flash: false, sync: true });
      if (linesMount) {
        for (const num of lineNums) {
          const el = linesMount.querySelector(`.c-line[data-line="${num}"]`);
          if (el) el.classList.add('sync-hl');
        }
      }
    }
    renderHeaderState();
  }

  // ---------- Disassembly Renderer ----------
  function renderDisasm() {
    const titleEl = $('disasm-fn-title');
    const mount = $('disasm-lines');
    if (!mount) return;

    const d = state.disasm;
    if (!d || !Array.isArray(d.instructions)) {
      if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = '';
      mount.replaceChildren();
      return;
    }

    if (titleEl) {
      titleEl.textContent = d.functionEntry
        ? `${d.functionEntry} (${d.instructions.length})`
        : `${d.startAddr || ''} (${d.instructions.length})`;
    }

    const beforeBtn = $('btn-disasm-more-before');
    const afterBtn = $('btn-disasm-more-after');
    if (beforeBtn) beforeBtn.disabled = d.hasMoreBefore === false;
    if (afterBtn) afterBtn.disabled = d.hasMoreAfter === false;

    const activeAddr = normHex(state.selectedAsmAddr);
    const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();

    for (const insn of d.instructions) {
      if (insn.commentPre) {
        const pre = document.createElement('div');
        pre.className = 'asm-row asm-comment';
        pre.textContent = `; ${insn.commentPre}`;
        frag.appendChild(pre);
      }
      if (insn.label) {
        const lbl = document.createElement('div');
        lbl.className = 'asm-row tok-label_def';
        lbl.textContent = `${insn.label}:`;
        frag.appendChild(lbl);
      }

      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'asm-row';
      const insnAddr = normHex(insn.addr);
      row.dataset.addr = insnAddr;
      if (activeAddr && insnAddr === activeAddr) {
        row.classList.add('sync-hl');
      }

      const addrEl = document.createElement('span');
      addrEl.className = 'asm-addr';
      addrEl.textContent = insnAddr;

      const bytesEl = document.createElement('span');
      bytesEl.className = 'asm-bytes';
      bytesEl.textContent = insn.bytes || '';

      const mnemEl = document.createElement('span');
      mnemEl.className = 'asm-mnem';
      mnemEl.textContent = insn.mnemonic || '';

      const opsEl = document.createElement('span');
      opsEl.className = 'asm-ops';
      const refs = Array.isArray(insn.refs) ? insn.refs : [];
      const navRef = refs.find((r) => r && r.to);
      if (navRef) {
        const refSpan = document.createElement('span');
        refSpan.className = 'asm-operand-ref';
        refSpan.dataset.target = normHex(navRef.to);
        refSpan.textContent = insn.operands || navRef.symbol || navRef.to;
        refSpan.title = `${navRef.type || 'REF'} -> ${navRef.to}`;
        opsEl.appendChild(refSpan);
      } else {
        opsEl.textContent = insn.operands || '';
      }

      row.append(addrEl, bytesEl, mnemEl, opsEl);

      if (insn.commentEol) {
        const cmtEl = document.createElement('span');
        cmtEl.className = 'asm-comment';
        cmtEl.textContent = `; ${insn.commentEol}`;
        row.appendChild(cmtEl);
      }

      if (Number(insn.xrefInCount) > 0) {
        const xBadge = document.createElement('button');
        xBadge.type = 'button';
        xBadge.className = 'mini-btn asm-xref-badge';
        xBadge.dataset.addr = insnAddr;
        xBadge.textContent = `${insn.xrefInCount}x`;
        xBadge.title = 'Show incoming xrefs';
        row.appendChild(xBadge);
      }

      frag.appendChild(row);
    }

    mount.replaceChildren(frag);
  }

  async function loadDisasm(binaryId, addr, { before = 20, after = 80, scrollAddr = null } = {}) {
    const myGen = ++state.disasmGen;
    const res = await apiPost('/api/view/disasm', {
      binaryId,
      addr,
      before,
      after,
      includeBytes: true,
    });
    if (myGen !== state.disasmGen) return null;
    state.disasm = res;
    renderDisasm();
    if (scrollAddr || addr) {
      syncAsmToAddresses([scrollAddr || addr], { scroll: true });
    }
    return res;
  }

  // ---------- Load Decompile (Offline-first when daemon stopped) ----------
  async function loadDecompile(binaryId, target, { refresh = false, offlineOnly = false, preserveFolds = false } = {}) {
    const myGen = ++state.decompileGen;
    const res = await apiPost('/api/view/decompile', {
      binaryId,
      target,
      startLine: 1,
      maxLines: 4000,
      refresh,
      offlineOnly,
    });
    if (myGen !== state.decompileGen) return null;
    setDecompilePayload(res, { preserveFolds });
    if (!state.daemonRunning && res.source !== 'sqlite_cache') {
      await refreshStatus();
      if (myGen !== state.decompileGen) return null;
    }
    return res;
  }

  // ---------- Universal Click-to-Navigate State Machine ----------
  async function navigateToTarget(binaryId, rawTarget, sourceContext = {}) {
    const targetBin = (binaryId || state.activeBinaryId || '').toLowerCase();
    const query = String(rawTarget || '').trim();
    if (!targetBin || !query) return null;

    // 1. Intra-function variable highlight (0 network calls)
    if ((sourceContext.kind === 'local' || sourceContext.kind === 'param') && sourceContext.varId) {
      highlightVariable(sourceContext.varId, sourceContext.name || query, sourceContext.sourceAddr);
      if (sourceContext.asmAddrs) {
        syncAsmToAddresses(sourceContext.asmAddrs);
      }
      return { kind: sourceContext.kind, localOnly: true };
    }

    // 2. Intra-function label jump (0 network calls)
    if (
      targetBin === state.activeBinaryId &&
      state.decompile &&
      (sourceContext.kind === 'label_ref' || lookupLabel(state.decompile.labels, query))
    ) {
      const lbl = lookupLabel(state.decompile.labels, query);
      const targetLine = lbl?.line || lookupAddrToLines(state.decompile.addrToLines, query)?.[0];
      if (targetLine) {
        if (!sourceContext.skipHistory) pushHistory();
        scrollToCLine(targetLine, { flash: true, sync: true });
        syncAsmToAddresses([query]);
        state.focusedTarget = {
          kind: 'label',
          addr: normHex(query),
          name: lbl?.name || query,
          functionAddr: state.decompile.function?.entry,
        };
        return { kind: 'label_ref', line: targetLine };
      }
    }

    const myNavGen = ++state.navGen;

    // 3. Offline fast-path when daemon is stopped and browsing from sidebar/offline
    if (!state.daemonRunning && (sourceContext.preferOffline || sourceContext.source === 'sidebar')) {
      if (state.activeView === 'calltree') {
        try {
          if (!sourceContext.skipHistory) pushHistory();
          const cg = await loadCallGraph(targetBin, query);
          if (myNavGen !== state.navGen || !cg) return null;
          state.activeBinaryId = targetBin;
          $('empty-workbench')?.classList.add('hidden');
          updateViewVisibility();
          const rootAddr = normHex(cg.root || query);
          const rootNode = (cg.nodes || []).find((n) => normHex(n.addr) === rootAddr);
          state.focusedTarget = {
            kind: 'function',
            addr: rootAddr,
            name: rootNode?.name || query,
            functionAddr: rootAddr,
          };
          renderHeaderState();
          return { kind: 'callgraph', offline: true };
        } catch {
          if (myNavGen !== state.navGen) return null;
          if (sourceContext.offlineNoWake) {
            renderHeaderState();
            return null;
          }
          // Not indexed offline -> fall through to live resolve (which wakes JVM with banner)
        }
      } else if (state.activeView !== 'cfg') {
        try {
          if (!sourceContext.skipHistory) pushHistory();
          const dec = await loadDecompile(targetBin, query, { offlineOnly: true });
          if (myNavGen !== state.navGen || !dec) return null;
          state.activeBinaryId = targetBin;
          if (state.activeView !== 'decompile' && state.activeView !== 'split') {
            state.activeView = 'decompile';
          }
          updateViewVisibility();
          state.focusedTarget = {
            kind: 'function',
            addr: dec.function?.entry || normHex(query),
            name: dec.function?.name || query,
            functionAddr: dec.function?.entry || normHex(query),
          };
          renderHeaderState();
          return { kind: 'function_entry', offline: true };
        } catch {
          if (myNavGen !== state.navGen) return null;
          if (sourceContext.offlineNoWake) {
            renderHeaderState();
            return null;
          }
          // Not cached offline -> fall through to live resolve (which wakes JVM with banner)
        }
      }
    }

    let showedStartBanner = false;
    if (!state.daemonRunning) {
      showedStartBanner = true;
      showBanner(t('startingEngineBanner', { tier: state.tier }, `Starting Ghidra Engine [${state.tier}]…`), {
        progressPct: 30,
      });
    }

    try {
      const resolved = await apiPost('/api/view/resolve', {
        binaryId: targetBin,
        query,
        offlineOnly: false,
      });
      if (myNavGen !== state.navGen) {
        if (showedStartBanner) hideBanner();
        return null;
      }
      if (showedStartBanner) {
        hideBanner();
        await refreshStatus();
        if (myNavGen !== state.navGen) return null;
      }

      if (!resolved.resolved && resolved.kind === 'unmapped') {
        showToast(t('toastUnmapped', { addr: query }, `Address ${query} is not mapped in memory.`), 'info');
        return resolved;
      }

      const kind = resolved.kind;

      if (kind === 'external_resolved' && resolved.externalTarget) {
        if (!sourceContext.skipHistory) pushHistory();
        const ext = resolved.externalTarget;
        const nextBin = String(ext.binaryId).toLowerCase();
        state.activeBinaryId = nextBin;
        await refreshStatus();
        if (myNavGen !== state.navGen) return null;
        resetSidebarCache();
        await ensureSidebarPage(0);
        if (myNavGen !== state.navGen) return null;
        return await navigateToTarget(nextBin, ext.address || ext.symbolName, {
          source: 'external_resolved',
          skipHistory: true,
        });
      }

      if (kind === 'import_thunk' || kind === 'external_unloaded') {
        await openImportPopover(targetBin, resolved);
        if (myNavGen !== state.navGen) return null;
        return resolved;
      }

      if (kind === 'string' || kind === 'pointer_table' || kind === 'data_defined' || kind === 'data_raw') {
        if (!sourceContext.skipHistory) pushHistory();
        await openDataInspector(targetBin, resolved.address);
        if (myNavGen !== state.navGen) return null;
        state.focusedTarget = {
          kind: 'global',
          addr: normHex(resolved.address),
          name: resolved.symbol || resolved.address,
        };
        return resolved;
      }

      if (kind === 'code_unmapped_func') {
        if (!sourceContext.skipHistory) pushHistory();
        state.activeBinaryId = targetBin;
        state.activeView = 'disasm';
        updateViewVisibility();
        await loadDisasm(targetBin, resolved.address, { before: 20, after: 80, scrollAddr: resolved.address });
        if (myNavGen !== state.navGen) return null;
        state.focusedTarget = { kind: 'address', addr: normHex(resolved.address), name: resolved.symbol || resolved.address };
        renderHeaderState();
        return resolved;
      }

      // function_entry or function_interior
      if (!sourceContext.skipHistory) pushHistory();
      state.activeBinaryId = targetBin;
      $('empty-workbench')?.classList.add('hidden');

      const fnEntry = normHex(
        resolved.containingFunction?.addr ||
        resolved.containingFunction?.entry ||
        resolved.address,
      );
      const targetAddr = normHex(resolved.address);

      if (state.activeView === 'data') {
        state.activeView = 'decompile';
      }
      updateViewVisibility();

      if (state.activeView === 'decompile' || state.activeView === 'split') {
        const sameFn =
          state.decompile &&
          normHex(state.decompile.function?.entry) === fnEntry &&
          state.decompile.binaryId === targetBin;
        if (!sameFn) {
          await loadDecompile(targetBin, fnEntry);
          if (myNavGen !== state.navGen) return null;
        }
        if (kind === 'function_interior') {
          const lineNums = lookupAddrToLines(state.decompile?.addrToLines, targetAddr);
          if (Array.isArray(lineNums) && lineNums.length > 0) {
            scrollToCLine(lineNums[0], { flash: true, sync: true });
          }
          state.selectedAsmAddr = targetAddr;
        } else {
          state.selectedLine = 1;
          state.selectedAsmAddr = fnEntry;
          const vp = $('decompile-viewport');
          if (vp) vp.scrollTop = 0;
        }
      } else {
        if (
          state.decompile &&
          (normHex(state.decompile.function?.entry) !== fnEntry || state.decompile.binaryId !== targetBin)
        ) {
          state.decompile = null;
        }
        state.selectedAsmAddr = kind === 'function_interior' ? targetAddr : fnEntry;
      }

      if (state.activeView === 'split' || state.activeView === 'disasm') {
        await loadDisasm(targetBin, targetAddr, { before: 24, after: 80, scrollAddr: targetAddr });
        if (myNavGen !== state.navGen) return null;
      } else if (state.activeView === 'cfg') {
        await loadCfg(targetBin, fnEntry);
        if (myNavGen !== state.navGen) return null;
      } else if (state.activeView === 'calltree') {
        await loadCallGraph(targetBin, fnEntry);
        if (myNavGen !== state.navGen) return null;
      }

      state.focusedTarget = {
        kind: 'function',
        addr: kind === 'function_interior' ? targetAddr : fnEntry,
        functionAddr: fnEntry,
        name: resolved.containingFunction?.name || resolved.symbol || fnEntry,
      };
      renderHeaderState();
      return resolved;
    } catch (err) {
      if (showedStartBanner) hideBanner();
      if (myNavGen === state.navGen) {
        showErrorToast(err);
      }
      return null;
    }
  }

  // ---------- History Stack (cap 200, coalesced duplicates) ----------
  function captureSnapshot() {
    const vp = $('decompile-viewport');
    const disasmVp = $('disasm-viewport');
    let address = null;
    if (state.activeView === 'calltree') {
      address =
        state.callgraph?.root ||
        state.focusedTarget?.functionAddr ||
        state.selectedAsmAddr ||
        state.decompile?.function?.entry ||
        state.disasm?.startAddr ||
        state.inspectorAddr ||
        null;
    } else if (state.activeView === 'cfg') {
      address =
        state.cfg?.functionEntry ||
        state.selectedAsmAddr ||
        state.decompile?.function?.entry ||
        state.focusedTarget?.functionAddr ||
        state.disasm?.startAddr ||
        state.inspectorAddr ||
        null;
    } else {
      address =
        state.selectedAsmAddr ||
        state.decompile?.function?.entry ||
        state.disasm?.startAddr ||
        state.focusedTarget?.functionAddr ||
        state.callgraph?.root ||
        state.inspectorAddr ||
        null;
    }
    const scrollTop = state.activeView === 'disasm' ? (disasmVp?.scrollTop || 0) : (vp?.scrollTop || 0);
    return {
      binaryId: state.activeBinaryId,
      address,
      viewMode: state.activeView,
      scrollTop,
      selectedLine: state.selectedLine,
      selectedAsmAddr: state.selectedAsmAddr,
      inspectorOpen: state.inspectorOpen,
      inspectorAddr: state.inspectorAddr,
    };
  }

  function sameHistorySpot(a, b) {
    if (!a || !b) return false;
    return (
      a.binaryId === b.binaryId &&
      normHex(a.address) === normHex(b.address) &&
      a.viewMode === b.viewMode &&
      Boolean(a.inspectorOpen) === Boolean(b.inspectorOpen) &&
      normHex(a.inspectorAddr) === normHex(b.inspectorAddr)
    );
  }

  function pushHistory(snap = captureSnapshot()) {
    if (state.history.restoring || !snap || !snap.binaryId) return;
    if (!snap.address && !snap.inspectorOpen) return;
    const back = state.history.backStack;
    if (back.length > 0 && sameHistorySpot(back[back.length - 1], snap)) {
      back[back.length - 1] = snap;
    } else {
      back.push(snap);
      if (back.length > HISTORY_MAX) {
        back.shift();
      }
    }
    state.history.forwardStack = [];
    updateHistoryButtons();
  }

  function updateHistoryButtons() {
    const backBtn = $('btn-nav-back');
    const fwdBtn = $('btn-nav-fwd');
    if (backBtn) backBtn.disabled = state.history.backStack.length === 0;
    if (fwdBtn) fwdBtn.disabled = state.history.forwardStack.length === 0;
  }

  async function restoreSnapshot(snap) {
    if (!snap || !snap.binaryId) return;
    let expectedGen = ++state.navGen;
    state.history.restoring = true;
    try {
      if (state.activeBinaryId !== snap.binaryId) {
        state.activeBinaryId = snap.binaryId;
        renderBinarySelect();
        resetSidebarCache();
        await ensureSidebarPage(0);
        if (state.navGen !== expectedGen) return;
      }

      if (snap.viewMode && snap.viewMode !== state.activeView) {
        if (state.activeView === 'cfg') {
          window.GhidraCfg?.destroy?.($('cfg-mount'));
        }
        state.activeView = snap.viewMode;
      }
      updateViewVisibility();

      if (snap.address) {
        const res = await navigateToTarget(snap.binaryId, snap.address, {
          source: 'history',
          skipHistory: true,
          preferOffline: !state.daemonRunning,
        });
        if (res === null) return;
        expectedGen = state.navGen;
      }

      if (snap.selectedLine) {
        scrollToCLine(snap.selectedLine, { flash: false, sync: true });
      }
      if (snap.selectedAsmAddr) {
        syncAsmToAddresses([snap.selectedAsmAddr], { scroll: false });
      }

      if (snap.inspectorOpen && snap.inspectorAddr) {
        await openDataInspector(snap.binaryId, snap.inspectorAddr);
        if (state.navGen !== expectedGen) return;
      } else if (!snap.inspectorOpen && state.inspectorOpen) {
        closeInspector({ skipRender: true });
      }

      if (state.activeView === 'disasm') {
        const dvp = $('disasm-viewport');
        if (dvp) dvp.scrollTop = snap.scrollTop || 0;
      } else {
        const vp = $('decompile-viewport');
        if (vp) vp.scrollTop = snap.scrollTop || 0;
      }
    } finally {
      state.history.restoring = false;
      updateHistoryButtons();
      renderHeaderState();
    }
  }

  async function navigateBack() {
    if (state.history.backStack.length === 0) return;
    const prev = state.history.backStack.pop();
    const cur = captureSnapshot();
    if (cur.binaryId && (cur.address || cur.inspectorOpen)) {
      state.history.forwardStack.push(cur);
    }
    await restoreSnapshot(prev);
  }

  async function navigateForward() {
    if (state.history.forwardStack.length === 0) return;
    const next = state.history.forwardStack.pop();
    const cur = captureSnapshot();
    if (cur.binaryId && (cur.address || cur.inspectorOpen)) {
      state.history.backStack.push(cur);
    }
    await restoreSnapshot(next);
  }

  // ---------- View Switching, Lazy CFG, Call Tree, Data Tab & Inspector ----------
  function updateViewVisibility() {
    const hasBin = Boolean(state.activeBinaryId);
    const emptyEl = $('empty-workbench');
    const codeArea = $('code-area');
    const cfgPane = $('cfg-pane');
    const calltreePane = $('calltree-pane');
    const dataFullPane = $('data-full-pane');

    if (emptyEl) emptyEl.classList.toggle('hidden', hasBin);
    if (codeArea) {
      const showCode = hasBin && (state.activeView === 'decompile' || state.activeView === 'split' || state.activeView === 'disasm');
      codeArea.classList.toggle('hidden', !showCode);
      codeArea.classList.remove('mode-decompile', 'mode-split', 'mode-disasm');
      if (state.activeView === 'split') codeArea.classList.add('mode-split');
      else if (state.activeView === 'disasm') codeArea.classList.add('mode-disasm');
      else codeArea.classList.add('mode-decompile');
    }
    if (cfgPane) cfgPane.classList.toggle('hidden', !hasBin || state.activeView !== 'cfg');
    if (calltreePane) calltreePane.classList.toggle('hidden', !hasBin || state.activeView !== 'calltree');
    if (dataFullPane) dataFullPane.classList.toggle('hidden', !hasBin || state.activeView !== 'data');

    for (const tab of document.querySelectorAll('.view-tab[data-view]')) {
      const active = tab.dataset.view === state.activeView;
      tab.classList.toggle('active', active);
      tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', active ? 'true' : 'false');
    }
  }

  async function setView(nextView) {
    if (!nextView || state.activeView === nextView) return;
    const prevView = state.activeView;
    if (state.activeBinaryId) {
      pushHistory();
    }
    if (prevView === 'cfg' && nextView !== 'cfg') {
      window.GhidraCfg?.destroy?.($('cfg-mount'));
    }
    state.activeView = nextView;
    updateViewVisibility();

    if (!state.activeBinaryId) return;

    const currentFunc =
      state.decompile?.function?.entry ||
      state.disasm?.functionEntry ||
      state.focusedTarget?.functionAddr ||
      (state.focusedTarget?.kind === 'function' ? state.focusedTarget.addr : null) ||
      state.callgraph?.root ||
      null;
    const currentAddr = state.selectedAsmAddr || currentFunc || state.disasm?.startAddr;

    try {
      if (nextView === 'decompile') {
        if (!state.decompile && currentFunc) {
          await loadDecompile(state.activeBinaryId, currentFunc, { offlineOnly: !state.daemonRunning });
        }
      } else if (nextView === 'split') {
        if (!state.decompile && currentFunc) {
          await loadDecompile(state.activeBinaryId, currentFunc, { offlineOnly: !state.daemonRunning });
        }
        if (currentAddr) {
          await loadDisasm(state.activeBinaryId, currentAddr, { before: 20, after: 80, scrollAddr: currentAddr });
        }
      } else if (nextView === 'disasm') {
        if (currentAddr) {
          await loadDisasm(state.activeBinaryId, currentAddr, { before: 24, after: 80, scrollAddr: currentAddr });
        }
      } else if (nextView === 'cfg') {
        if (currentFunc) {
          await loadCfg(state.activeBinaryId, currentFunc);
        }
      } else if (nextView === 'calltree') {
        let callTreeTarget = currentFunc || state.focusedTarget?.addr || null;
        if (!callTreeTarget && state.sidebarTab !== 'strings') {
          const page0 = state.sidebarPages.get(0) || [];
          const firstFn =
            page0.find((f) => f && !f.isImport && (f.addr || f.entryHex || f.entry)) ||
            page0.find((f) => f && (f.addr || f.entryHex || f.entry));
          if (firstFn) {
            callTreeTarget = firstFn.addr || firstFn.entryHex || firstFn.entry;
          }
        }
        if (!callTreeTarget) {
          const binMeta = findKnownBinary(state.activeBinaryId);
          callTreeTarget = binMeta?.firstCachedEntry || null;
        }
        if (!callTreeTarget) {
          try {
            const fnRes = await apiPost('/api/search/functions', {
              binaryId: state.activeBinaryId,
              kind: 'user',
              sort: 'addr',
              limit: 1,
            });
            if (state.activeView !== 'calltree') return;
            const firstItem = Array.isArray(fnRes.items) ? fnRes.items[0] : null;
            if (firstItem) {
              callTreeTarget = firstItem.addr || firstItem.entryHex || firstItem.entry || null;
            }
          } catch {
            // ignore if no functions are indexed yet
          }
        }
        if (callTreeTarget) {
          await loadCallGraph(state.activeBinaryId, callTreeTarget);
        }
      } else if (nextView === 'data') {
        await renderDataFullTab(currentAddr || state.inspectorAddr);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showErrorToast(err);
    }
  }

  async function toggleDecompileDisasm() {
    if (!state.activeBinaryId) return;
    if (state.activeView === 'decompile') {
      await setView('disasm');
    } else if (state.activeView === 'disasm') {
      await setView('decompile');
    } else if (state.activeView === 'split') {
      const targetVp = document.activeElement === $('disasm-viewport') ? $('decompile-viewport') : $('disasm-viewport');
      targetVp?.focus();
    }
  }

  // Strictly LAZY CFG (ONLY invoked when activeView === 'cfg')
  async function loadCfg(binaryId, target, { focusAddr = null } = {}) {
    if (state.activeView !== 'cfg') return null;
    const mount = $('cfg-mount');
    if (!mount) return null;

    const myGen = ++state.cfgGen;
    const payload = { binaryId, target, includeInsns: true };
    if (focusAddr) payload.focusAddr = focusAddr;

    let cfgModuleError = null;
    const [modRes, cfgData] = await Promise.all([
      ensureCfgModuleLoaded().catch((err) => {
        cfgModuleError = err;
        return null;
      }),
      apiPost('/api/view/cfg', payload),
    ]);
    if (myGen !== state.cfgGen || state.activeView !== 'cfg' || state.activeBinaryId !== String(binaryId).toLowerCase()) return null;
    state.cfg = cfgData;

    const cfgModule = modRes || (window.GhidraCfg && typeof window.GhidraCfg.render === 'function' ? window.GhidraCfg : null);
    if (cfgModule && typeof cfgModule.render === 'function') {
      cfgModule.render(mount, cfgData, {
        focusAddr,
        t,
        plural,
        onBlockDoubleClick: (block) => {
          pushHistory();
          window.GhidraCfg?.destroy?.(mount);
          state.activeView = 'decompile';
          updateViewVisibility();
          navigateToTarget(binaryId, block.start || block.id, { source: 'cfg_block', skipHistory: true });
        },
        onBlockClick: (block) => {
          state.selectedAsmAddr = normHex(block.start || block.id);
          renderHeaderState();
        },
        onViewSubgraph: () => {
          const focus = state.selectedAsmAddr || cfgData.functionEntry;
          loadCfg(binaryId, target, { focusAddr: focus }).catch(showErrorToast);
        },
        onIncreaseTier: () => {
          openPopover($('engine-popover'));
        },
      });
      return cfgData;
    }

    // Fallback when cfg.js failed to load or is unavailable
    mount.replaceChildren();
    const wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className = 'calltree-mount';

    const notice = document.createElement('div');
    notice.className = 'empty-card';
    const h = document.createElement('strong');
    h.textContent = `${cfgData.functionName || cfgData.functionEntry} (${plural('block', cfgData.blocks?.length || 0)}, ${plural('edge', cfgData.edges?.length || 0)})`;
    const p = document.createElement('div');
    p.className = 'inspector-meta';
    p.textContent = cfgModuleError?.message || t('cfgUnavailableNotice', null, 'CFG renderer module (cfg.js) is not loaded yet.');
    notice.append(h, p);

    if (cfgData.truncated) {
      const warn = document.createElement('div');
      warn.className = 'inline-banner';
      const wtxt = document.createElement('span');
      wtxt.textContent = t(
        'cfgTooManyBlocksNotice',
        { total: cfgData.totalBlocks, limit: cfgData.blockLimit },
        `Function has ${cfgData.totalBlocks} blocks (tier limit ${cfgData.blockLimit}).`,
      );
      const btnSub = document.createElement('button');
      btnSub.type = 'button';
      btnSub.className = 'mini-btn';
      btnSub.textContent = t('cfgViewLocalBtn', null, 'View Local Subgraph (±3 hops)');
      btnSub.addEventListener('click', () => {
        loadCfg(binaryId, target, { focusAddr: state.selectedAsmAddr || cfgData.functionEntry }).catch(showErrorToast);
      });
      const btnTier = document.createElement('button');
      btnTier.type = 'button';
      btnTier.className = 'mini-btn primary';
      btnTier.textContent = t('cfgIncreaseTierBtn', null, 'Increase RAM Tier');
      btnTier.addEventListener('click', () => openPopover($('engine-popover')));
      warn.append(wtxt, btnSub, btnTier);
      notice.appendChild(warn);
    }

    const listSec = document.createElement('div');
    listSec.className = 'calltree-section';
    for (const blk of (cfgData.blocks || []).slice(0, 60)) {
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'calltree-node';
      const left = document.createElement('span');
      left.textContent = `${blk.label || blk.start} (${blk.start}..${blk.end})`;
      const right = document.createElement('span');
      right.className = 'vrow-meta';
      right.textContent = `${blk.insnCount ?? blk.insns?.length ?? 0} insns`;
      row.append(left, right);
      row.addEventListener('dblclick', () => {
        pushHistory();
        state.activeView = 'decompile';
        updateViewVisibility();
        navigateToTarget(binaryId, blk.start, { source: 'cfg_fallback', skipHistory: true });
      });
      listSec.appendChild(row);
    }
    wrap.append(notice, listSec);
    mount.appendChild(wrap);
    return cfgData;
  }

  // ---------- Call Tree Tab (Interactive Multi-Level, Offline-First) ----------
  async function loadCallGraph(binaryId, target) {
    const hdr = $('calltree-header');
    const mount = $('calltree-mount');
    if (!mount) return null;

    const myGen = ++state.callgraphGen;
    const requestedDepth = [1, 2, 3].includes(Number(state.callgraphDepth)) ? Number(state.callgraphDepth) : 2;
    state.callgraphDepth = requestedDepth;

    const cg = await apiPost('/api/view/callgraph', {
      binaryId,
      target,
      direction: state.callgraphDir,
      depth: requestedDepth,
      maxNodes: 100,
    });
    if (myGen !== state.callgraphGen || state.activeBinaryId !== String(binaryId).toLowerCase()) return null;
    state.callgraph = cg;

    const rootAddr = normHex(cg.root);
    const nodesByAddr = new Map();
    const calleesByAddr = new Map();
    const callersByAddr = new Map();
    const edgeKeys = new Set();
    const loadedDirs = { callees: new Set(), callers: new Set() };
    const fetchedEmpty = { callees: new Set(), callers: new Set() };
    const expandedKeys = new Set();
    const loadingKeys = new Set();
    let collapseEpoch = 0;

    function mergeGraphData(sub) {
      for (const n of sub?.nodes || []) {
        const addr = normHex(n.addr);
        if (!addr) continue;
        const prev = nodesByAddr.get(addr);
        nodesByAddr.set(addr, { ...(prev || {}), ...n, addr });
      }
      for (const e of sub?.edges || []) {
        const from = normHex(e.from);
        const to = normHex(e.to);
        if (!from || !to) continue;
        edgeKeys.add(`${from}->${to}`);
        if (!calleesByAddr.has(from)) calleesByAddr.set(from, new Set());
        calleesByAddr.get(from).add(to);
        if (!callersByAddr.has(to)) callersByAddr.set(to, new Set());
        callersByAddr.get(to).add(from);
        if (!nodesByAddr.has(from)) nodesByAddr.set(from, { addr: from, name: from, callerCount: 0, calleeCount: 0 });
        if (!nodesByAddr.has(to)) nodesByAddr.set(to, { addr: to, name: to, callerCount: 0, calleeCount: 0 });
      }
    }

    function seedLoadedDir(dir, adjMap, maxDepth) {
      const dist = new Map([[rootAddr, 0]]);
      const queue = [rootAddr];
      for (let i = 0; i < queue.length; i++) {
        const cur = queue[i];
        const d = dist.get(cur);
        if (d < maxDepth) {
          const nexts = adjMap.get(cur);
          const knownCount = nexts ? nexts.size : 0;
          const node = nodesByAddr.get(cur);
          const expectedDeg = dir === 'callees' ? (Number(node?.calleeCount) || 0) : (Number(node?.callerCount) || 0);
          if (!cg.truncated || (expectedDeg > 0 && knownCount >= expectedDeg) || (d === 0 && knownCount > 0 && knownCount >= expectedDeg)) {
            loadedDirs[dir].add(cur);
          }
          if (nexts) {
            for (const nxt of nexts) {
              if (!dist.has(nxt)) {
                dist.set(nxt, d + 1);
                queue.push(nxt);
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    mergeGraphData(cg);
    const initialDepth = Number(cg.depth ?? requestedDepth) || requestedDepth;
    if (state.callgraphDir === 'both' || state.callgraphDir === 'callees') {
      seedLoadedDir('callees', calleesByAddr, initialDepth);
    }
    if (state.callgraphDir === 'both' || state.callgraphDir === 'callers') {
      seedLoadedDir('callers', callersByAddr, initialDepth);
    }

    function getOrderedNeighbors(dir, addr) {
      const set = dir === 'callees' ? calleesByAddr.get(addr) : callersByAddr.get(addr);
      if (!set || set.size === 0) return [];
      return [...set].sort();
    }

    let rootInfoEl = null;
    function updateHeaderSummary() {
      if (!rootInfoEl) return;
      rootInfoEl.textContent = `${shortHex(rootAddr)} · ${plural('node', nodesByAddr.size)}, ${plural('edge', edgeKeys.size)}`;
    }

    if (hdr) {
      hdr.replaceChildren();
      const rootNode = nodesByAddr.get(rootAddr) || { addr: rootAddr, name: rootAddr };

      const titleGroup = document.createElement('div');
      titleGroup.className = 'pane-title-group';
      const title = document.createElement('span');
      title.className = 'pane-fn-title';
      title.textContent = t('callTreeRootLabel', { name: rootNode.name || cg.root }, `Root: ${rootNode.name || cg.root}`);

      rootInfoEl = document.createElement('span');
      rootInfoEl.className = 'calltree-root-info';
      rootInfoEl.title = rootAddr;
      updateHeaderSummary();

      const badgesWrap = document.createElement('div');
      badgesWrap.className = 'calltree-header-badges';
      if (cg.source === 'sqlite') {
        const offlineBadge = document.createElement('span');
        offlineBadge.className = 'pill-badge muted';
        offlineBadge.textContent = t('callTreeOfflineBadge', null, 'SQLite Offline');
        badgesWrap.appendChild(offlineBadge);
      }

      titleGroup.append(title, rootInfoEl, badgesWrap);

      const actions = document.createElement('div');
      actions.className = 'pane-actions';

      const dirSel = document.createElement('select');
      dirSel.className = 'compact-select';
      for (const [val, lbl] of [
        ['both', t('callTreeBoth', null, 'Both')],
        ['callers', t('callTreeCallers', null, 'Callers')],
        ['callees', t('callTreeCallees', null, 'Callees')],
      ]) {
        const opt = document.createElement('option');
        opt.value = val;
        opt.textContent = lbl;
        if (val === state.callgraphDir) opt.selected = true;
        dirSel.appendChild(opt);
      }
      dirSel.addEventListener('change', () => {
        state.callgraphDir = dirSel.value;
        loadCallGraph(binaryId, cg.root).catch(showErrorToast);
      });

      const depthSel = document.createElement('select');
      depthSel.className = 'compact-select';
      depthSel.dataset.calltreeDepth = 'true';
      const depthTitle = t('callTreeDepthLabel', null, 'Depth');
      depthSel.title = depthTitle;
      depthSel.setAttribute('aria-label', depthTitle);
      for (const dVal of [1, 2, 3]) {
        const opt = document.createElement('option');
        opt.value = String(dVal);
        opt.textContent = `${depthTitle}: ${dVal}`;
        if (dVal === state.callgraphDepth) opt.selected = true;
        depthSel.appendChild(opt);
      }
      depthSel.addEventListener('change', () => {
        state.callgraphDepth = Number(depthSel.value) || 2;
        loadCallGraph(binaryId, cg.root).catch(showErrorToast);
      });

      const expandL1Btn = document.createElement('button');
      expandL1Btn.type = 'button';
      expandL1Btn.className = 'mini-btn';
      expandL1Btn.textContent = t('callTreeExpandAll', null, 'Expand Level 1');
      expandL1Btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        const myEpoch = collapseEpoch;
        const dirs = state.callgraphDir === 'both' ? ['callers', 'callees'] : [state.callgraphDir];
        const fetches = [];
        let firstErr = null;
        for (const dir of dirs) {
          for (const cAddr of getOrderedNeighbors(dir, rootAddr)) {
            if (cAddr === rootAddr) continue;
            const pathKey = `${dir}:${rootAddr}>${cAddr}`;
            if (loadingKeys.has(pathKey)) continue;
            const node = nodesByAddr.get(cAddr) || { addr: cAddr, callerCount: 0, calleeCount: 0 };
            const knownChildren = getOrderedNeighbors(dir, cAddr);
            const expectedDegree = dir === 'callees' ? (Number(node.calleeCount) || 0) : (Number(node.callerCount) || 0);
            if (!loadedDirs[dir].has(cAddr) && expectedDegree > 0 && fetches.length < 25) {
              loadingKeys.add(pathKey);
              fetches.push(
                apiPost('/api/view/callgraph', {
                  binaryId,
                  target: cAddr,
                  direction: dir,
                  depth: 1,
                  maxNodes: 80,
                }).then((sub) => {
                  if (myGen !== state.callgraphGen) return;
                  mergeGraphData(sub);
                  loadedDirs[dir].add(cAddr);
                  if (getOrderedNeighbors(dir, cAddr).length === 0) {
                    fetchedEmpty[dir].add(cAddr);
                  }
                  if (myEpoch === collapseEpoch) {
                    expandedKeys.add(pathKey);
                  }
                }).catch((err) => {
                  if (!firstErr) firstErr = err;
                }).finally(() => {
                  loadingKeys.delete(pathKey);
                }),
              );
            } else if (knownChildren.length > 0 || fetchedEmpty[dir].has(cAddr)) {
              expandedKeys.add(pathKey);
            }
          }
        }
        if (fetches.length > 0) {
          renderTree();
          await Promise.allSettled(fetches);
          if (myGen !== state.callgraphGen) return;
          if (firstErr) showErrorToast(firstErr);
          updateHeaderSummary();
        }
        renderTree();
      });

      const collapseAllBtn = document.createElement('button');
      collapseAllBtn.type = 'button';
      collapseAllBtn.className = 'mini-btn';
      collapseAllBtn.textContent = t('callTreeCollapseAll', null, 'Collapse All');
      collapseAllBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        collapseEpoch++;
        expandedKeys.clear();
        renderTree();
      });

      actions.append(dirSel, depthSel, expandL1Btn, collapseAllBtn);
      hdr.append(titleGroup, actions);
    }

    function buildTreeItem(dir, addr, indentDepth, hopDepth, ancestors, parentPath) {
      const node = nodesByAddr.get(addr) || { addr, name: addr, callerCount: 0, calleeCount: 0 };
      const isRecursive = ancestors.has(addr);
      const pathKey = `${dir}:${parentPath}>${addr}`;
      const knownChildren = isRecursive ? [] : getOrderedNeighbors(dir, addr);
      const isConfirmedLoaded = loadedDirs[dir].has(addr);
      const isFetchedEmpty = fetchedEmpty[dir].has(addr);
      const expectedDegree = dir === 'callees' ? (Number(node.calleeCount) || 0) : (Number(node.callerCount) || 0);
      const canExpand = !isRecursive && (knownChildren.length > 0 || isFetchedEmpty || (!isConfirmedLoaded && expectedDegree > 0));
      const isExpanded = canExpand && expandedKeys.has(pathKey);
      const isLoading = loadingKeys.has(pathKey);

      const item = document.createElement('div');
      item.className = 'calltree-item';

      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'calltree-row';
      row.style.setProperty('--tree-depth', String(indentDepth));
      row.dataset.dir = dir;
      row.dataset.addr = addr;
      row.dataset.depth = String(hopDepth);
      if (isRecursive) {
        row.dataset.recursive = 'true';
      }

      if (canExpand) {
        const toggle = document.createElement('button');
        toggle.type = 'button';
        toggle.className = 'calltree-toggle';
        toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isExpanded ? 'true' : 'false');
        toggle.disabled = isLoading;
        toggle.textContent = isExpanded ? '▼' : '▶';
        toggle.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (loadingKeys.has(pathKey)) return;
          if (expandedKeys.has(pathKey)) {
            expandedKeys.delete(pathKey);
            renderTree();
            return;
          }
          if (loadedDirs[dir].has(addr)) {
            expandedKeys.add(pathKey);
            renderTree();
            return;
          }
          const myEpoch = collapseEpoch;
          loadingKeys.add(pathKey);
          renderTree();
          try {
            const sub = await apiPost('/api/view/callgraph', {
              binaryId,
              target: addr,
              direction: dir,
              depth: 1,
              maxNodes: 80,
            });
            if (myGen !== state.callgraphGen) return;
            mergeGraphData(sub);
            loadedDirs[dir].add(addr);
            if (getOrderedNeighbors(dir, addr).length === 0) {
              fetchedEmpty[dir].add(addr);
            }
            if (myEpoch === collapseEpoch) {
              expandedKeys.add(pathKey);
            }
            updateHeaderSummary();
          } catch (err) {
            if (myGen === state.callgraphGen) showErrorToast(err);
          } finally {
            loadingKeys.delete(pathKey);
            if (myGen === state.callgraphGen) renderTree();
          }
        });
        row.appendChild(toggle);
      } else {
        const spacer = document.createElement('span');
        spacer.className = 'calltree-toggle leaf';
        spacer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        spacer.textContent = '·';
        row.appendChild(spacer);
      }

      const labelBtn = document.createElement('button');
      labelBtn.type = 'button';
      labelBtn.className = 'calltree-label';
      labelBtn.textContent = node.name || addr;
      labelBtn.title = `${node.name || addr} @ ${addr}`;
      labelBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        pushHistory();
        state.activeView = 'decompile';
        updateViewVisibility();
        navigateToTarget(binaryId, node.addr, {
          source: 'calltree',
          skipHistory: true,
          preferOffline: !state.daemonRunning,
        });
      });
      row.appendChild(labelBtn);

      const badges = document.createElement('div');
      badges.className = 'calltree-badges';
      if (isLoading) {
        const loadBadge = document.createElement('span');
        loadBadge.className = 'calltree-badge';
        loadBadge.textContent = t('callTreeLoading', null, 'Loading…');
        badges.appendChild(loadBadge);
      }
      if (isRecursive) {
        const recBadge = document.createElement('span');
        recBadge.className = 'calltree-badge recursive';
        recBadge.dataset.recursive = 'true';
        recBadge.textContent = t('callTreeRecursiveBadge', null, 'recursive');
        badges.appendChild(recBadge);
      }
      if (node.externalLib || node.isImport) {
        const impBadge = document.createElement('span');
        impBadge.className = 'calltree-badge import';
        impBadge.textContent = node.externalLib || t('callTreeImportBadge', null, 'import');
        badges.appendChild(impBadge);
      }

      const degBadge = document.createElement('span');
      degBadge.className = 'calltree-badge';
      degBadge.textContent = `↑${Number(node.callerCount) || 0} ↓${Number(node.calleeCount) || 0}`;
      badges.appendChild(degBadge);

      const addrEl = document.createElement('span');
      addrEl.className = 'calltree-addr';
      addrEl.title = addr;
      addrEl.textContent = shortHex(addr);
      badges.appendChild(addrEl);

      const rerootBtn = document.createElement('button');
      rerootBtn.type = 'button';
      rerootBtn.className = 'calltree-reroot-btn mini-btn';
      const rerootTitle = t('callTreeRerootTitle', null, 'Re-root call tree on this function');
      rerootBtn.title = rerootTitle;
      rerootBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', rerootTitle);
      rerootBtn.textContent = '⌖';
      rerootBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        pushHistory();
        state.focusedTarget = {
          kind: 'function',
          addr,
          name: node.name || addr,
          functionAddr: addr,
        };
        loadCallGraph(binaryId, addr).catch(showErrorToast);
      });

      row.append(badges, rerootBtn);
      item.appendChild(row);

      if (isExpanded && !isRecursive) {
        const childrenWrap = document.createElement('div');
        childrenWrap.className = 'calltree-children';
        if (knownChildren.length > 0) {
          const nextAncestors = new Set(ancestors);
          nextAncestors.add(addr);
          const nextParentPath = `${parentPath}>${addr}`;
          for (const childAddr of knownChildren) {
            childrenWrap.appendChild(
              buildTreeItem(dir, childAddr, indentDepth + 1, hopDepth + 1, nextAncestors, nextParentPath),
            );
          }
        } else if (isConfirmedLoaded) {
          const emptyChild = document.createElement('div');
          emptyChild.className = 'calltree-no-children';
          emptyChild.style.setProperty('--tree-depth', String(indentDepth));
          emptyChild.textContent = t('callTreeNoChildren', null, 'No further edges');
          childrenWrap.appendChild(emptyChild);
        }
        item.appendChild(childrenWrap);
      }

      return item;
    }

    function renderSection(dir, titleText, rootChildren) {
      const sec = document.createElement('div');
      sec.className = 'calltree-section';
      const sTitle = document.createElement('div');
      sTitle.className = 'calltree-section-title';
      sTitle.textContent = `${titleText} (${rootChildren.length})`;
      sec.appendChild(sTitle);

      if (rootChildren.length === 0) {
        const empty = document.createElement('div');
        empty.className = 'calltree-row';
        empty.style.setProperty('--tree-depth', '0');
        empty.textContent = '—';
        sec.appendChild(empty);
      } else {
        const tree = document.createElement('div');
        tree.className = 'calltree-tree';
        const rootAncestors = new Set([rootAddr]);
        for (const childAddr of rootChildren) {
          tree.appendChild(buildTreeItem(dir, childAddr, 0, 1, rootAncestors, rootAddr));
        }
        sec.appendChild(tree);
      }
      mount.appendChild(sec);
    }

    function renderTree() {
      mount.replaceChildren();
      const callers = getOrderedNeighbors('callers', rootAddr);
      const callees = getOrderedNeighbors('callees', rootAddr);
      const showCallers = state.callgraphDir === 'both' || state.callgraphDir === 'callers';
      const showCallees = state.callgraphDir === 'both' || state.callgraphDir === 'callees';

      const visibleEmpty =
        (!showCallers || callers.length === 0) &&
        (!showCallees || callees.length === 0);

      if (visibleEmpty) {
        const empty = document.createElement('div');
        empty.className = 'empty-card';
        empty.textContent = t('callTreeEmpty', null, 'No call graph edges recorded for this function.');
        mount.appendChild(empty);
        return;
      }

      if (showCallers) {
        renderSection('callers', t('callTreeCallers', null, 'Callers'), callers);
      }
      if (showCallees) {
        renderSection('callees', t('callTreeCallees', null, 'Callees'), callees);
      }
    }

    renderTree();
    return cg;
  }

  // ---------- Data / Hex / String / Pointer Inspector ----------
  function renderHexDump(hexDump) {
    const box = document.createElement('div');
    box.className = 'hex-dump';
    const rawHex = String(hexDump?.bytesHex || '');
    let base = 0n;
    try {
      base = BigInt(normHex(hexDump?.baseAddr || '0x0'));
    } catch {
      base = 0n;
    }

    const totalBytes = Math.floor(rawHex.length / 2);
    for (let offset = 0; offset < totalBytes; offset += 16) {
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'hex-row';

      const addrEl = document.createElement('span');
      addrEl.className = 'hex-addr';
      addrEl.textContent = `0x${(base + BigInt(offset)).toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}`;

      const hexParts = [];
      let ascii = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        const idx = offset + i;
        if (idx < totalBytes) {
          const byteStr = rawHex.slice(idx * 2, idx * 2 + 2);
          const b = parseInt(byteStr, 16);
          hexParts.push(byteStr);
          ascii += b >= 0x20 && b <= 0x7e ? String.fromCharCode(b) : '.';
        } else {
          hexParts.push('  ');
        }
        if (i === 7) hexParts.push('');
      }

      const bytesEl = document.createElement('span');
      bytesEl.className = 'hex-bytes';
      bytesEl.textContent = hexParts.join(' ');

      const asciiEl = document.createElement('span');
      asciiEl.className = 'hex-ascii';
      asciiEl.textContent = `|${ascii}|`;

      row.append(addrEl, bytesEl, asciiEl);
      box.appendChild(row);
    }
    return box;
  }

  function populateDataViewDom(container, data, binaryId) {
    container.replaceChildren();
    if (!data) {
      const empty = document.createElement('div');
      empty.className = 'inspector-meta';
      empty.textContent = t('dataInspectorEmpty', null, 'Select a string, global, or data address to inspect bytes and pointer targets.');
      container.appendChild(empty);
      return;
    }

    if (data.decoded && data.decoded.value !== undefined && data.decoded.value !== null) {
      const decRow = document.createElement('div');
      const lbl = document.createElement('span');
      lbl.className = 'section-label';
      lbl.textContent = `${t('decodedStringLabel', null, 'Decoded')}${data.decoded.encoding ? ` (${data.decoded.encoding})` : ''}: `;
      const val = document.createElement('span');
      val.className = 'mono';
      val.textContent = typeof data.decoded.value === 'string'
        ? JSON.stringify(data.decoded.value)
        : String(data.decoded.value);
      decRow.append(lbl, val);
      container.appendChild(decRow);
    }

    const entries = Array.isArray(data.pointerAnalysis?.entries) ? data.pointerAnalysis.entries : [];
    if (entries.length > 0) {
      const ptrWrap = document.createElement('div');
      ptrWrap.className = 'calltree-section';
      const pHdr = document.createElement('div');
      pHdr.className = 'calltree-section-title';
      pHdr.textContent = t('pointerTargetsLabel', null, 'Pointer targets');
      ptrWrap.appendChild(pHdr);

      for (const ent of entries) {
        const pRow = document.createElement('div');
        pRow.className = 'modal-list-row';
        const slot = document.createElement('span');
        slot.className = 'vrow-meta';
        slot.textContent = `${ent.slotAddr || ''} -> `;
        const link = document.createElement('span');
        link.className = 'ptr-link';
        link.textContent = `${ent.targetAddr || ''} ${ent.targetSymbol ? `(${ent.targetSymbol})` : ''}`;
        const sec = document.createElement('span');
        sec.className = 'vrow-meta';
        sec.textContent = `${ent.targetKind || ''} ${ent.targetSection || ''}`.trim();
        pRow.append(slot, link, sec);
        pRow.addEventListener('click', () => {
          navigateToTarget(binaryId, ent.targetAddr, { source: 'data_pointer' });
        });
        ptrWrap.appendChild(pRow);
      }
      container.appendChild(ptrWrap);
    }

    if (data.hexDump && data.hexDump.bytesHex) {
      container.appendChild(renderHexDump(data.hexDump));
    }
  }

  function unquoteStringLiteral(raw) {
    let s = String(raw || '').trim();
    s = s.replace(/^(?:u8|u|U|L)?(["'])/, '$1');
    if ((s.startsWith('"') && s.endsWith('"')) || (s.startsWith("'") && s.endsWith("'"))) {
      s = s.slice(1, -1);
    }
    return s
      .replace(/\\n/g, '\n')
      .replace(/\\r/g, '\r')
      .replace(/\\t/g, '\t')
      .replace(/\\"/g, '"')
      .replace(/\\'/g, "'")
      .replace(/\\\\/g, '\\');
  }

  async function resolveAndInspectStringLiteral(rawLiteral) {
    const binaryId = state.activeBinaryId;
    if (!binaryId) return null;
    const unquoted = unquoteStringLiteral(rawLiteral);
    const trimmed = unquoted.trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
      showToast(t('toastUnmapped', { addr: rawLiteral }, 'String literal not found in index.'), 'info');
      return null;
    }

    const myNavGen = ++state.navGen;
    try {
      const res = await apiPost('/api/search/strings', {
        binaryId,
        query: trimmed.slice(0, 80),
        minLen: 1,
        limit: 20,
      });
      if (myNavGen !== state.navGen) return null;
      const items = Array.isArray(res.items) ? res.items : [];
      const exact = items.find((r) => r.value === unquoted || r.value === trimmed);
      const prefix = exact || items.find((r) => String(r.value || '').startsWith(trimmed) || trimmed.startsWith(String(r.value || '')));
      const match = prefix || items[0];
      if (!match || !match.addr) {
        showToast(t('toastUnmapped', { addr: rawLiteral }, `String "${trimmed.slice(0, 32)}" not found in index.`), 'info');
        return null;
      }

      pushHistory();
      await openDataInspector(binaryId, match.addr);
      if (myNavGen !== state.navGen) return null;
      state.focusedTarget = {
        kind: 'global',
        addr: normHex(match.addr),
        name: match.value || match.addr,
      };
      renderHeaderState();
      return match;
    } catch (err) {
      if (myNavGen === state.navGen) {
        showErrorToast(err);
      }
      return null;
    }
  }

  async function openDataInspector(binaryId, addr) {
    const myGen = ++state.inspectorGen;
    const data = await apiPost('/api/view/data', {
      binaryId,
      addr,
      length: 128,
      detectPointers: true,
    });
    if (myGen !== state.inspectorGen) return null;
    state.inspectorOpen = true;
    state.inspectorAddr = normHex(data.address || addr);
    state.inspectorData = data;

    const drawer = $('data-inspector');
    const titleEl = $('inspector-title');
    const metaEl = $('inspector-meta');
    const bodyEl = $('inspector-body');

    if (titleEl) {
      const symName = data.symbol?.name ? `${data.symbol.name} @ ` : '';
      titleEl.textContent = `${symName}${data.address || addr}`;
    }
    if (metaEl) {
      const sec = data.section ? `${data.section.name} (${data.section.perms})` : '';
      const dt = data.definedDataType ? ` · ${data.definedDataType}` : '';
      const xr = data.xrefSummary ? ` · ${plural('xref', data.xrefSummary.toCount || 0)}` : '';
      metaEl.textContent = `${sec}${dt}${xr}`;
    }
    if (bodyEl) {
      populateDataViewDom(bodyEl, data, binaryId);
    }
    if (drawer) drawer.classList.remove('hidden');

    if (state.activeView === 'data') {
      await renderDataFullTab(state.inspectorAddr, data);
      if (myGen !== state.inspectorGen) return null;
    }
    return data;
  }

  function closeInspector({ skipRender = false } = {}) {
    state.inspectorOpen = false;
    state.inspectorAddr = null;
    state.inspectorData = null;
    if (state.focusedTarget?.kind === 'global') {
      if (state.decompile?.function) {
        state.focusedTarget = {
          kind: 'function',
          addr: state.decompile.function.entry,
          functionAddr: state.decompile.function.entry,
          name: state.decompile.function.name,
        };
      } else {
        state.focusedTarget = null;
      }
    }
    const drawer = $('data-inspector');
    if (drawer) drawer.classList.add('hidden');
    if (!skipRender) renderHeaderState();
  }

  async function renderDataFullTab(addr = null, prefetched = null) {
    const mount = $('data-full-mount');
    if (!mount || !state.activeBinaryId) return;
    mount.replaceChildren();

    const wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className = 'calltree-mount';

    const targetAddr = addr || state.inspectorAddr;
    if (targetAddr) {
      try {
        const data = prefetched || await apiPost('/api/view/data', {
          binaryId: state.activeBinaryId,
          addr: targetAddr,
          length: 256,
          detectPointers: true,
        });
        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = 'inspector-body';
        populateDataViewDom(card, data, state.activeBinaryId);
        wrap.appendChild(card);
      } catch (err) {
