```js
        const msg = document.createElement('div');
        msg.className = 'empty-card';
        msg.textContent = err.message;
        wrap.appendChild(msg);
      }
    } else {
      const empty = document.createElement('div');
      empty.className = 'empty-card';
      empty.textContent = t('dataInspectorEmpty', null, 'Select a string, global, or data address to inspect bytes and pointer targets.');
      wrap.appendChild(empty);
    }

    mount.appendChild(wrap);
  }

  // ---------- Modals & Popovers ----------
  function openModal(backdropEl) {
    if (!backdropEl) return;
    backdropEl.classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  function closeModal(backdropEl) {
    if (!backdropEl) return;
    backdropEl.classList.add('hidden');
  }

  function openPopover(el) {
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  function closePopover(el) {
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.add('hidden');
  }

  function isOpen(el) {
    return Boolean(el && !el.classList.contains('hidden'));
  }

  function hasOpenModal() {
    return [
      'ask-agent-bar',
      'comment-modal',
      'retype-modal',
      'rename-modal',
      'xrefs-modal',
      'goto-modal',
      'open-modal',
      'import-popover',
      'engine-popover',
    ].some((id) => isOpen($(id)));
  }

  function closeTopmostOverlay() {
    const order = [
      'ask-agent-bar',
      'comment-modal',
      'retype-modal',
      'rename-modal',
      'xrefs-modal',
      'goto-modal',
      'open-modal',
      'import-popover',
      'engine-popover',
    ];
    for (const id of order) {
      const el = $(id);
      if (isOpen(el)) {
        closeModal(el);
        return true;
      }
    }
    if (state.find.open) {
      closeFindBar();
      return true;
    }
    if (state.inspectorOpen) {
      closeInspector();
      return true;
    }
    const appEl = $('app');
    const sidebar = $('sidebar');
    if (appEl?.classList.contains('narrow') && sidebar?.classList.contains('open')) {
      sidebar.classList.remove('open');
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  // Go-To Modal
  function openGoToModal() {
    if (!state.activeBinaryId) return;
    const modal = $('goto-modal');
    const input = $('goto-input');
    const list = $('goto-suggestions');
    if (list) list.replaceChildren();
    if (input) {
      input.value = '';
    }
    openModal(modal);
    input?.focus();
    updateGotoSuggestions('');
  }

  async function updateGotoSuggestions(q) {
    const list = $('goto-suggestions');
    if (!list || !state.activeBinaryId) return;
    try {
      const res = await apiPost('/api/search/functions', {
        binaryId: state.activeBinaryId,
        query: q,
        limit: 15,
      });
      list.replaceChildren();
      for (const item of res.items || []) {
        const row = document.createElement('div');
        row.className = 'modal-list-row';
        const left = document.createElement('span');
        left.className = 'vrow-name';
        left.textContent = item.name || item.addr;
        const right = document.createElement('span');
        right.className = 'vrow-meta';
        right.textContent = item.addr;
        row.append(left, right);
        row.addEventListener('click', () => {
          closeModal($('goto-modal'));
          navigateToTarget(state.activeBinaryId, item.addr, { source: 'goto' });
        });
        list.appendChild(row);
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore suggestion fetch errors
    }
  }

  // Xrefs Modal
  async function openXrefsModal(addr, label = '') {
    if (!state.activeBinaryId || !addr) return;
    const targetAddr = normHex(addr);
    state.xrefTargetAddr = targetAddr;
    const lbl = $('xrefs-target-label');
    if (lbl) lbl.textContent = label ? `${label} @ ${targetAddr}` : targetAddr;
    openModal($('xrefs-modal'));
    await fetchAndRenderXrefs();
  }

  function openXrefsModalForFocused() {
    const addr =
      state.focusedTarget?.addr ||
      state.selectedAsmAddr ||
      state.inspectorAddr ||
      state.decompile?.function?.entry;
    const label = state.focusedTarget?.name || state.decompile?.function?.name || '';
    if (addr) openXrefsModal(addr, label);
  }

  async function fetchAndRenderXrefs() {
    const listEl = $('xrefs-list');
    if (!listEl || !state.activeBinaryId || !state.xrefTargetAddr) return;
    const dir = $('xrefs-dir-select')?.value || 'to';
    const types = [];
    for (const cb of document.querySelectorAll('#xrefs-type-filters input[type="checkbox"]:checked')) {
      types.push(cb.value);
    }

    listEl.replaceChildren();
    const loading = document.createElement('div');
    loading.className = 'xref-row';
    loading.textContent = '…';
    listEl.appendChild(loading);

    try {
      const res = await apiPost('/api/view/xrefs', {
        binaryId: state.activeBinaryId,
        addr: state.xrefTargetAddr,
        direction: dir,
        types,
        limit: 100,
      });
      listEl.replaceChildren();
      const items = Array.isArray(res.items) ? res.items : [];
      if (items.length === 0) {
        const empty = document.createElement('div');
        empty.className = 'xref-row';
        empty.textContent = t('noXrefsFound', null, 'No cross-references found.');
        listEl.appendChild(empty);
        return;
      }
      for (const item of items) {
        const row = document.createElement('div');
        row.className = 'xref-row';
        const left = document.createElement('div');
        left.className = 'vrow-main';
        const fn = document.createElement('span');
        fn.className = 'vrow-name';
        fn.textContent = `${item.fromFuncName || item.fromAddr || ''} — ${item.insnPreview || ''}`;
        const badge = document.createElement('span');
        badge.className = 'vrow-badge';
        badge.textContent = item.type || '';
        left.append(badge, fn);

        const right = document.createElement('span');
        right.className = 'vrow-meta';
        right.textContent = dir === 'from' ? item.toAddr : item.fromAddr;
        row.append(left, right);
        row.addEventListener('click', () => {
          closeModal($('xrefs-modal'));
          const jumpAddr = dir === 'from' ? item.toAddr : item.fromAddr;
          navigateToTarget(state.activeBinaryId, jumpAddr, { source: 'xref' });
        });
        listEl.appendChild(row);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      listEl.replaceChildren();
      showErrorToast(err);
    }
  }

  // Import / External Thunk Popover
  async function openImportPopover(binaryId, resolved) {
    state.importPopoverData = { binaryId, resolved };
    const libEl = $('import-lib-name');
    const symEl = $('import-sym-name');
    const callersEl = $('import-callers-list');
    const loadBtn = $('btn-import-load-lib');

    if (libEl) libEl.textContent = resolved.libraryName || 'EXTERNAL';
    if (symEl) symEl.textContent = `${resolved.symbolName || resolved.symbol || ''} (${resolved.address || ''})`;

    if (loadBtn) {
      const candidates = Array.isArray(resolved.candidatePaths) ? resolved.candidatePaths : [];
      const canMulti = Number(state.tierSpec?.maxLoadedBinaries || 1) > 1;
      loadBtn.classList.toggle('hidden', candidates.length === 0 || !canMulti);
    }

    if (callersEl) {
      callersEl.replaceChildren();
      try {
        const xr = await apiPost('/api/view/xrefs', {
          binaryId,
          addr: resolved.address,
          direction: 'to',
          types: ['CALL', 'JMP'],
          limit: 25,
        });
        const items = Array.isArray(xr.items) ? xr.items : [];
        if (items.length === 0) {
          const empty = document.createElement('div');
          empty.className = 'modal-list-row';
          empty.textContent = t('noXrefsFound', null, 'No cross-references found.');
          callersEl.appendChild(empty);
        } else {
          for (const item of items) {
            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.className = 'modal-list-row';
            const left = document.createElement('span');
            left.className = 'vrow-name';
            left.textContent = item.fromFuncName || item.fromAddr;
            const right = document.createElement('span');
            right.className = 'vrow-meta';
            right.textContent = item.fromAddr;
            row.append(left, right);
            row.addEventListener('click', () => {
              closeModal($('import-popover'));
              navigateToTarget(binaryId, item.fromAddr, { source: 'import_caller' });
            });
            callersEl.appendChild(row);
          }
        }
      } catch {
        // ignore callers load failure
      }
    }

    openModal($('import-popover'));
  }

  // Rename Modal
  function openRenameModal(ctx = null) {
    if (!state.activeBinaryId) return;
    let target = ctx;
    if (!target) {
      if (state.focusedTarget?.kind === 'variable') {
        target = {
          targetKind: 'variable',
          address: state.focusedTarget.functionAddr || state.decompile?.function?.entry,
          functionAddress: state.focusedTarget.functionAddr || state.decompile?.function?.entry,
          oldName: state.focusedTarget.name,
        };
      } else if (state.focusedTarget?.kind === 'label') {
        target = {
          targetKind: 'label',
          address: state.focusedTarget.addr,
          functionAddress: state.focusedTarget.functionAddr || state.decompile?.function?.entry,
          oldName: state.focusedTarget.name,
        };
      } else if (state.focusedTarget?.kind === 'function') {
        target = {
          targetKind: 'function',
          address: state.focusedTarget.addr || state.decompile?.function?.entry,
          oldName: state.focusedTarget.name || state.decompile?.function?.name,
        };
      } else if (state.focusedTarget?.kind === 'global') {
        target = {
          targetKind: 'global',
          address: state.focusedTarget.addr || state.inspectorAddr,
          oldName: state.focusedTarget.name || state.inspectorData?.symbol?.name || '',
        };
      } else if (state.inspectorOpen && state.inspectorData?.symbol?.name) {
        target = {
          targetKind: 'global',
          address: state.inspectorAddr,
          oldName: state.inspectorData.symbol.name,
        };
      } else if (state.decompile?.function) {
        target = {
          targetKind: 'function',
          address: state.decompile.function.entry,
          oldName: state.decompile.function.name,
        };
      } else if (state.disasm?.functionEntry) {
        target = {
          targetKind: 'function',
          address: state.disasm.functionEntry,
          oldName: state.disasm.functionEntry,
        };
      }
    }
    if (!target || !target.address) return;

    state.renameContext = target;
    const lbl = $('rename-target-label');
    const input = $('rename-input');
    if (lbl) lbl.textContent = `${target.targetKind}: ${target.oldName || target.address} @ ${target.address}`;
    if (input) input.value = target.oldName || '';
    openModal($('rename-modal'));
    input?.focus();
    input?.select();
  }

  function openRenameModalForFocused() {
    openRenameModal(null);
  }

  async function submitRename() {
    const ctx = state.renameContext;
    const newName = $('rename-input')?.value?.trim();
    if (!ctx || !newName || !state.activeBinaryId) return;

    try {
      await apiPost('/api/mutate/rename', {
        binaryId: state.activeBinaryId,
        targetKind: ctx.targetKind,
        address: ctx.address,
        functionAddress: ctx.functionAddress,
        oldName: ctx.oldName,
        newName,
        expectedRevision: state.decompile?.revision ?? undefined,
      });
      closeModal($('rename-modal'));
      showToast(t('toastSaved', null, 'Changes saved.'), 'success');
      await refreshAfterMutation(ctx.functionAddress || ctx.address);
    } catch (err) {
      showErrorToast(err);
    }
  }

  // Retype Modal
  function openRetypeModal(ctx = null) {
    if (!state.activeBinaryId) return;
    let target = ctx;
    if (!target) {
      if (state.focusedTarget?.kind === 'variable') {
        target = {
          targetKind: 'variable',
          address: state.focusedTarget.functionAddr || state.decompile?.function?.entry,
          functionAddress: state.focusedTarget.functionAddr || state.decompile?.function?.entry,
          varName: state.focusedTarget.name,
          currentDecl: state.focusedTarget.type || '',
        };
      } else if (state.decompile?.function) {
        target = {
          targetKind: 'function_signature',
          address: state.decompile.function.entry,
          currentDecl: state.decompile.function.signature || '',
        };
      }
    }
    if (!target || !target.address) return;

    state.retypeContext = target;
    const lbl = $('retype-target-label');
    const input = $('retype-input');
    if (lbl) lbl.textContent = `${target.targetKind}: ${target.varName || target.address}`;
    if (input) input.value = target.currentDecl || '';
    openModal($('retype-modal'));
    input?.focus();
    input?.select();
  }

  async function submitRetype() {
    const ctx = state.retypeContext;
    const declaration = $('retype-input')?.value?.trim();
    if (!ctx || !declaration || !state.activeBinaryId) return;

    try {
      await apiPost('/api/mutate/retype', {
        binaryId: state.activeBinaryId,
        targetKind: ctx.targetKind,
        address: ctx.address,
        functionAddress: ctx.functionAddress,
        varName: ctx.varName,
        declaration,
        expectedRevision: state.decompile?.revision ?? undefined,
      });
      closeModal($('retype-modal'));
      showToast(t('toastSaved', null, 'Changes saved.'), 'success');
      await refreshAfterMutation(ctx.functionAddress || ctx.address);
    } catch (err) {
      showErrorToast(err);
    }
  }

  // Comment Modal
  function openCommentModalForFocused() {
    if (!state.activeBinaryId) return;
    const addr =
      state.selectedAsmAddr ||
      state.focusedTarget?.addr ||
      state.inspectorAddr ||
      state.decompile?.function?.entry ||
      state.disasm?.startAddr;
    if (!addr) return;
    state.commentContext = { address: normHex(addr) };
    const lbl = $('comment-addr-label');
    const input = $('comment-input');
    if (lbl) lbl.textContent = state.commentContext.address;
    if (input) input.value = '';
    openModal($('comment-modal'));
    input?.focus();
  }

  async function submitComment() {
    const ctx = state.commentContext;
    if (!ctx || !state.activeBinaryId) return;
    const kind = $('comment-kind-select')?.value || 'EOL';
    const text = $('comment-input')?.value ?? '';
    try {
      await apiPost('/api/mutate/comment', {
        binaryId: state.activeBinaryId,
        address: ctx.address,
        kind,
        text,
        expectedRevision: state.decompile?.revision ?? undefined,
      });
      closeModal($('comment-modal'));
      showToast(t('toastSaved', null, 'Changes saved.'), 'success');
      await refreshAfterMutation(state.decompile?.function?.entry || ctx.address);
    } catch (err) {
      showErrorToast(err);
    }
  }

  async function refreshAfterMutation(funcAddr) {
    resetSidebarCache();
    await ensureSidebarPage(0);
    if (state.decompile && state.activeBinaryId) {
      const entry = state.decompile.function?.entry || funcAddr;
      if (entry) {
        await loadDecompile(state.activeBinaryId, entry, { preserveFolds: true });
      }
    }
    if ((state.activeView === 'split' || state.activeView === 'disasm') && state.disasm && state.activeBinaryId) {
      await loadDisasm(state.activeBinaryId, state.selectedAsmAddr || state.disasm.startAddr);
    }
    if (state.inspectorOpen && state.inspectorAddr && state.activeBinaryId) {
      await openDataInspector(state.activeBinaryId, state.inspectorAddr);
    }
    await refreshStatus();
  }

  // ---------- Find Bar ----------
  function openFindBar() {
    if (!state.activeBinaryId) return;
    state.find.open = true;
    const bar = $('find-bar');
    const input = $('find-input');
    if (bar) bar.classList.remove('hidden');
    input?.focus();
    input?.select();
    runFindInFunction();
  }

  function closeFindBar() {
    state.find.open = false;
    state.find.matches = [];
    state.find.currentIdx = -1;
    const bar = $('find-bar');
    if (bar) bar.classList.add('hidden');
    renderDecompileLinesWindow();
  }

  function runFindInFunction() {
    const input = $('find-input');
    const countEl = $('find-count');
    const q = String(input?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    state.find.query = q;
    state.find.matches = [];
    state.find.currentIdx = -1;

    if (!q || !state.decompile?.lines) {
      if (countEl) countEl.textContent = '';
      renderDecompileLinesWindow();
      return;
    }

    const lines = state.decompile.lines;
    for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
      const l = lines[i];
      const text = (l.tokens || []).map((tok) => tok.t || '').join('').toLowerCase();
      if (text.includes(q)) {
        state.find.matches.push({ idx: i, lineNum: Number(l.line ?? i + 1) });
      }
    }

    if (state.find.matches.length > 0) {
      state.find.currentIdx = 0;
      if (countEl) countEl.textContent = `1 / ${state.find.matches.length}`;
      scrollToCLine(state.find.matches[0].lineNum, { flash: false, sync: false });
    } else {
      if (countEl) countEl.textContent = t('findNoMatches', null, '0 matches');
    }
    renderDecompileLinesWindow();
  }

  function stepFindMatch(delta) {
    const n = state.find.matches.length;
    const countEl = $('find-count');
    if (n === 0) return;
    state.find.currentIdx = (state.find.currentIdx + delta + n) % n;
    if (countEl) countEl.textContent = `${state.find.currentIdx + 1} / ${n}`;
    scrollToCLine(state.find.matches[state.find.currentIdx].lineNum, { flash: false, sync: false });
    renderDecompileLinesWindow();
  }

  // ---------- Ask Agent ----------
  function openAskAgentBar() {
    if (!state.activeBinaryId) return;
    openModal($('ask-agent-bar'));
    $('ask-agent-input')?.focus();
  }

  function buildSurroundingSnippet() {
    const lines = state.decompile?.lines;
    if (!Array.isArray(lines) || lines.length === 0) return '';
    const centerLine = state.selectedLine || 1;
    const centerIdx = Math.max(0, lines.findIndex((l) => Number(l.line) >= centerLine));
    const start = Math.max(0, centerIdx - 25);
    const end = Math.min(lines.length, start + 60);
    const out = [];
    for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {
      const l = lines[i];
      const addr = l.addr ? `${l.addr} ` : '';
      const indent = ' '.repeat(Math.max(0, Number(l.indent) || 0));
      const code = (l.tokens || []).map((tok) => tok.t || '').join('');
      out.push(`${l.line}: ${addr}| ${indent}${code}`);
    }
    return out.join('\n');
  }

  async function sendAskAgentPrompt(customText = null) {
    const raw = (customText ?? $('ask-agent-input')?.value ?? '').trim();
    if (!raw) return;

    const bin = findKnownBinary(state.activeBinaryId);
    const fileName = getBinaryDisplayName(bin) || state.activeBinaryId || 'unknown';
    const fnName = state.decompile?.function?.name || state.disasm?.functionEntry || 'unknown';
    const fnEntry = state.decompile?.function?.entry || state.disasm?.functionEntry || '';
    const focusAddr = state.selectedAsmAddr || state.focusedTarget?.addr || fnEntry || '';
    const snippet = buildSurroundingSnippet();

    const parts = [
      `[Ghidra RE Workbench Context]`,
      `Binary: ${fileName} (binaryId: ${state.activeBinaryId || 'none'})`,
      `Function: ${fnName}${fnEntry ? ` @ ${fnEntry}` : ''}`,
      focusAddr ? `Focus: ${focusAddr}${state.selectedLine ? ` (line ${state.selectedLine})` : ''}` : null,
      snippet ? `\n\`\`\`c\n${snippet}\n\`\`\`` : null,
      `\nQuestion: ${raw}`,
      `\nUse ghidra-re MCP tools (such as ghidra_decompile, ghidra_xrefs, ghidra_disasm, ghidra_batch_annotate) for deeper analysis or to apply annotations.`,
    ].filter(Boolean);

    const prompt = parts.join('\n');
    try {
      if (window.sidecar?.agent && typeof window.sidecar.agent.sendMessage === 'function') {
        await window.sidecar.agent.sendMessage(prompt);
        closeModal($('ask-agent-bar'));
        showToast(t('toastPromptSent', null, 'Prompt sent to agent.'), 'success');
      } else {
        showToast('Sidecar agent API is unavailable outside host.', 'error');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showErrorToast(err);
    }
  }

  // ---------- Follow Agent & EventBus Long-Poll ----------
  function setFollowAgent(enabled) {
    state.followAgent = Boolean(enabled);
    const btn = $('btn-follow-agent');
    if (btn) {
      btn.classList.toggle('active', state.followAgent);
      btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', state.followAgent ? 'true' : 'false');
      btn.textContent = state.followAgent
        ? t('followingAgentBtn', null, 'Following')
        : t('followAgentBtn', null, 'Follow');
    }
  }

  async function startEventLoop() {
    if (state.longPollActive || !state.daemonRunning) return;
    state.longPollActive = true;
    try {
      while (state.daemonRunning) {
        let res;
        try {
          res = await apiPost('/api/events/wait', {
            since: state.latestSeq,
            timeoutMs: 15000,
            limit: 50,
          });
        } catch {
          if (!state.daemonRunning) break;
          await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500));
          continue;
        }

        if (res.daemonRunning === false) {
          state.daemonRunning = false;
          state.daemonState = 'stopped';
          renderHeaderState();
          renderEnginePopover();
          break;
        }

        if (Number.isFinite(Number(res.latestSeq)) && Number(res.latestSeq) > state.latestSeq) {
          state.latestSeq = Number(res.latestSeq);
        }

        const events = Array.isArray(res.events) ? res.events : [];
        for (const ev of events) {
          if (Number.isFinite(Number(ev.seq)) && Number(ev.seq) > state.latestSeq) {
            state.latestSeq = Number(ev.seq);
          }
          await handleDaemonEvent(ev);
        }
      }
    } finally {
      state.longPollActive = false;
    }
  }

  async function handleDaemonEvent(ev) {
    if (!ev || typeof ev !== 'object') return;
    const type = ev.type;
    const actor = ev.actor || 'agent';
    const evBin = ev.binaryId ? String(ev.binaryId).toLowerCase() : null;

    if (type === 'mutation') {
      if (actor === 'agent') {
        const detail = ev.detail || {};
        const label = detail.newName
          ? `${detail.oldName || detail.address || ''} -> ${detail.newName}`
          : (detail.address || detail.op || 'binary');
        showToast(t('toastAgentMutated', { target: label }, `Agent updated ${label}.`), 'info');
      }
      if (evBin && evBin === state.activeBinaryId) {
        resetSidebarCache();
        await ensureSidebarPage(0);
        const curFn = normHex(state.decompile?.function?.entry);
        const inv = Array.isArray(ev.detail?.invalidatedFuncs)
          ? ev.detail.invalidatedFuncs.map(normHex)
          : [];
        const mutatedAddr = normHex(ev.detail?.address);
        if (curFn && (inv.length === 0 || inv.includes(curFn) || mutatedAddr === curFn)) {
          await loadDecompile(state.activeBinaryId, curFn, { preserveFolds: true });
        }
        if ((state.activeView === 'split' || state.activeView === 'disasm') && state.disasm) {
          await loadDisasm(state.activeBinaryId, state.selectedAsmAddr || state.disasm.startAddr);
        }
      }
      return;
    }

    if (type === 'focus' && actor === 'agent') {
      const idleElapsed = Date.now() - state.lastUserInteractionAt;
      if (state.followAgent && idleElapsed >= FOLLOW_IDLE_MS) {
        const targetAddr = ev.detail?.address;
        const targetBin = evBin || state.activeBinaryId;
        if (targetBin && targetAddr) {
          const btn = $('btn-follow-agent');
          if (btn) {
            btn.classList.remove('following-pulse');
            void btn.offsetWidth;
            btn.classList.add('following-pulse');
          }
          if (targetBin !== state.activeBinaryId) {
            state.activeBinaryId = targetBin;
            await refreshStatus();
            resetSidebarCache();
            await ensureSidebarPage(0);
          }
          await navigateToTarget(targetBin, targetAddr, { source: 'follow_agent' });
        }
      }
      return;
    }

    if (type === 'binary_loaded' || type === 'binary_unloaded' || type === 'daemon_tier_changed') {
      await refreshStatus();
    }
  }

  // ---------- Resizers & Responsive Layout ----------
  function setupResponsiveAndResizers() {
    const appEl = $('app');
    const sidebar = $('sidebar');
    const sidebarResizer = $('sidebar-resizer');
    const splitResizer = $('split-resizer');
    const codeArea = $('code-area');

    const updateBreakpoint = (width) => {
      if (!appEl) return;
      const isNarrow = width < 680;
      appEl.classList.toggle('narrow', isNarrow);
      if (!isNarrow && sidebar) {
        sidebar.classList.remove('open');
      }
    };

    if (appEl && typeof ResizeObserver === 'function') {
      const ro = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
        for (const entry of entries) {
          updateBreakpoint(entry.contentRect.width);
        }
      });
      ro.observe(appEl);
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('resize', () => updateBreakpoint(window.innerWidth));
    }
    updateBreakpoint(appEl?.clientWidth || window.innerWidth);

    if (sidebarResizer && sidebar && appEl) {
      sidebarResizer.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
        if (appEl.classList.contains('narrow')) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        sidebarResizer.classList.add('dragging');
        sidebarResizer.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
        const startX = e.clientX;
        const startW = sidebar.getBoundingClientRect().width || 250;

        const onMove = (ev) => {
          const nextW = Math.max(170, Math.min(460, Math.round(startW + (ev.clientX - startX))));
          appEl.style.setProperty('--sidebar-width', `${nextW}px`);
        };
        const onUp = () => {
          sidebarResizer.classList.remove('dragging');
          sidebarResizer.removeEventListener('pointermove', onMove);
          sidebarResizer.removeEventListener('pointerup', onUp);
          sidebarResizer.removeEventListener('pointercancel', onUp);
        };
        sidebarResizer.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove);
        sidebarResizer.addEventListener('pointerup', onUp);
        sidebarResizer.addEventListener('pointercancel', onUp);
      });
    }

    if (splitResizer && codeArea && appEl) {
      splitResizer.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        splitResizer.classList.add('dragging');
        splitResizer.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
        const rect = codeArea.getBoundingClientRect();
        const isNarrow = appEl.classList.contains('narrow');

        const onMove = (ev) => {
          const pct = isNarrow
            ? ((ev.clientY - rect.top) / Math.max(1, rect.height)) * 100
            : ((ev.clientX - rect.left) / Math.max(1, rect.width)) * 100;
          const clamped = Math.max(20, Math.min(80, pct));
          codeArea.style.setProperty('--split-ratio', `${clamped.toFixed(1)}%`);
        };
        const onUp = () => {
          splitResizer.classList.remove('dragging');
          splitResizer.removeEventListener('pointermove', onMove);
          splitResizer.removeEventListener('pointerup', onUp);
          splitResizer.removeEventListener('pointercancel', onUp);
        };
        splitResizer.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove);
        splitResizer.addEventListener('pointerup', onUp);
        splitResizer.addEventListener('pointercancel', onUp);
      });
    }
  }

  // ---------- Capture-Phase Keyboard Shortcuts (Pre-preload.js) ----------
  function isEditableTarget(target) {
    if (!target || typeof target !== 'object') return false;
    const tag = typeof target.tagName === 'string' ? target.tagName.toUpperCase() : '';
    if (tag === 'TEXTAREA' || tag === 'SELECT') return !target.disabled && !target.readOnly;
    if (tag === 'INPUT') {
      const tType = typeof target.type === 'string' ? target.type.toLowerCase() : 'text';
      const nonText = new Set(['button', 'checkbox', 'color', 'file', 'hidden', 'image', 'radio', 'range', 'reset', 'submit']);
      return !nonText.has(tType) && !target.disabled && !target.readOnly;
    }
    if (target.isContentEditable) return true;
    if (typeof target.closest === 'function') {
      const ce = target.closest('[contenteditable]');
      if (ce && ce.getAttribute('contenteditable') !== 'false') return true;
      const tb = target.closest('[role="textbox"]');
      if (tb && tb.getAttribute('aria-disabled') !== 'true') return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  function isNativeClipboardChord(e, keyLower) {
    return (
      (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) &&
      !e.altKey &&
      ((!e.shiftKey && (keyLower === 'c' || keyLower === 'x')) || keyLower === 'v')
    );
  }

  function onCaptureKeyDown(e) {
    if (e.isComposing || e.keyCode === 229 || typeof e.key !== 'string') return;
    if (e.isTrusted) state.lastUserInteractionAt = Date.now();

    const rawTarget = (typeof e.composedPath === 'function' && e.composedPath()[0]) || e.target;
    const keyLower = e.key.toLowerCase();

    if (isNativeClipboardChord(e, keyLower)) {
      return;
    }

    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      if (closeTopmostOverlay()) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (isEditableTarget(rawTarget) && typeof rawTarget.blur === 'function') {
          rawTarget.blur();
        }
        return;
      }
      if (!isEditableTarget(rawTarget)) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        navigateBack();
      }
      return;
    }

    if (isEditableTarget(rawTarget)) {
      return;
    }

    // History navigation: Alt+ArrowLeft / Alt+ArrowRight (intercept before preload.js!)
    if (e.altKey && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.shiftKey) {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        navigateBack();
        return;
      }
      if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        navigateForward();
        return;
      }
    }

    // Ctrl/Cmd+F and Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && !e.altKey && keyLower === 'f') {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (e.shiftKey) {
        const appEl = $('app');
        const sidebar = $('sidebar');
        if (appEl?.classList.contains('narrow')) {
          sidebar?.classList.add('open');
        } else {
          sidebar?.classList.remove('collapsed');
        }
        switchSidebarTab('code');
        $('sidebar-search-input')?.focus();
      } else {
        openFindBar();
      }
      return;
    }

    // Tab: toggle Decompile <-> Disasm when main pane / body focused and no modal open
    if (e.key === 'Tab' && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.altKey && !e.shiftKey) {
      if (!hasOpenModal() && state.activeBinaryId) {
        const mainPane = $('main-pane');
        if (
          rawTarget === document.body ||
          rawTarget === document.documentElement ||
          (mainPane && mainPane.contains(rawTarget))
        ) {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          toggleDecompileDisasm();
          return;
        }
      }
    }

    if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey || hasOpenModal()) {
      return;
    }

    if (keyLower === 'g') {
      e.preventDefault();
      openGoToModal();
    } else if (keyLower === 'x') {
      e.preventDefault();
      openXrefsModalForFocused();
    } else if (keyLower === 'n') {
      e.preventDefault();
      openRenameModalForFocused();
    } else if (e.key === ';') {
      e.preventDefault();
      openCommentModalForFocused();
    }
  }

  // ---------- Event Delegation & Wire-up ----------
  function wireUiEvents() {
    // Track genuine user interaction timestamp for Follow Agent 3s guard
    const markUserInteraction = (e) => {
      if (e.isTrusted) {
        state.lastUserInteractionAt = Date.now();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('pointerdown', markUserInteraction, { capture: true, passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('wheel', markUserInteraction, { capture: true, passive: true });

    // Capture-phase keyboard shortcuts BEFORE sidecar_sdk/preload.js bubble listener
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onCaptureKeyDown, { capture: true });

    // Mouse Back/Forward side buttons (3 & 4)
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', (e) => {
      if (e.button === 3) {
        e.preventDefault();
        navigateBack();
      } else if (e.button === 4) {
        e.preventDefault();
        navigateForward();
      }
    });

    // Header buttons
    $('btn-sidebar-toggle')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const appEl = $('app');
      const sidebar = $('sidebar');
      if (!appEl || !sidebar) return;
      if (appEl.classList.contains('narrow')) {
        sidebar.classList.toggle('open');
      } else {
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
      }
    });

    $('binary-select')?.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
      const nextId = e.target.value;
      if (nextId && nextId !== state.activeBinaryId) {
        const isLoaded = state.loadedBinaries.some((b) => String(b.binaryId).toLowerCase() === nextId);
        openBinaryFromUi({
          sha256: nextId,
          offlineOnly: !state.daemonRunning && !isLoaded,
        });
      }
    });

    $('btn-open-binary')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      openModal($('open-modal'));
      await refreshStatus();
      scanWorkspace(state.workspaceUris);
    });
    $('btn-empty-open')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      openModal($('open-modal'));
      await refreshStatus();
      scanWorkspace(state.workspaceUris);
    });

    $('btn-nav-back')?.addEventListener('click', navigateBack);
    $('btn-nav-fwd')?.addEventListener('click', navigateForward);
    $('btn-recheck-prereqs')?.addEventListener('click', refreshStatus);

    // Engine popover
    $('btn-engine-pill')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const pop = $('engine-popover');
      if (!pop) return;
      if (isOpen(pop)) {
        closePopover(pop);
      } else {
        await refreshStatus();
        openPopover(pop);
      }
    });
    $('btn-close-engine')?.addEventListener('click', () => closePopover($('engine-popover')));

    async function restoreActiveViewAfterTierSwitch(cfgRes) {
      await refreshStatus();
      if (!cfgRes?.restarted || !state.activeBinaryId) return;

      const binId = state.activeBinaryId;
      const activeView = state.activeView;
      const fnEntry =
        state.decompile?.function?.entry ||
        state.cfg?.functionEntry ||
        state.callgraph?.root ||
        state.focusedTarget?.functionAddr ||
        state.disasm?.functionEntry ||
        null;
      const curAddr =
        state.selectedAsmAddr ||
        state.focusedTarget?.addr ||
        fnEntry ||
        state.disasm?.startAddr ||
        null;
      const decVp = $('decompile-viewport');
      const disVp = $('disasm-viewport');
      const prevDecScroll = decVp ? decVp.scrollTop : 0;
      const prevDisScroll = disVp ? disVp.scrollTop : 0;
      const prevSelectedLine = state.selectedLine;

      resetSidebarCache();
      await ensureSidebarPage(0);

      if ((activeView === 'decompile' || activeView === 'split') && fnEntry) {
        await loadDecompile(binId, fnEntry, { preserveFolds: true });
        if (prevSelectedLine) {
          state.selectedLine = prevSelectedLine;
        }
        if (decVp) decVp.scrollTop = prevDecScroll;
      }
      if ((activeView === 'split' || activeView === 'disasm') && curAddr) {
        await loadDisasm(binId, curAddr, { before: 20, after: 80, scrollAddr: curAddr });
        if (activeView === 'disasm' && disVp) disVp.scrollTop = prevDisScroll;
      } else if (activeView === 'cfg' && fnEntry) {
        await loadCfg(binId, fnEntry);
      } else if (activeView === 'calltree' && fnEntry) {
        await loadCallGraph(binId, fnEntry);
      }
      if (state.inspectorOpen && state.inspectorAddr) {
        await openDataInspector(binId, state.inspectorAddr);
      }
      renderHeaderState();
    }

    for (const btn of document.querySelectorAll('.tier-btn[data-tier]')) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        const nextTier = btn.dataset.tier;
        if (nextTier === 'custom') {
          state.tier = 'custom';
          renderEnginePopover();
          return;
        }
        try {
          if (state.daemonRunning) {
            showBanner(t('toastTierSwitching', { tier: nextTier }, `Applying ${nextTier} tier…`), { progressPct: 50 });
          }
          const cfgRes = await apiPost('/api/engine/config', { tier: nextTier });
          hideBanner();
          await restoreActiveViewAfterTierSwitch(cfgRes);
          showToast(t('toastTierSwitched', { tier: nextTier }, `Switched to ${nextTier} tier.`), 'success');
        } catch (err) {
          hideBanner();
          showErrorToast(err);
        }
      });
    }

    $('custom-ram-slider')?.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
      const valEl = $('custom-ram-value');
      if (valEl) valEl.textContent = `${e.target.value} MB`;
    });
    $('custom-ram-slider')?.addEventListener('change', async (e) => {
      const customRamMb = Number(e.target.value);
      const tierLabel = `custom (${customRamMb} MB)`;
      try {
        if (state.daemonRunning) {
          showBanner(t('toastTierSwitching', { tier: tierLabel }, `Applying ${tierLabel} tier…`), { progressPct: 50 });
        }
        const cfgRes = await apiPost('/api/engine/config', { tier: 'custom', customRamMb });
        hideBanner();
        await restoreActiveViewAfterTierSwitch(cfgRes);
        showToast(t('toastTierSwitched', { tier: tierLabel }, `Switched to ${tierLabel} tier.`), 'success');
      } catch (err) {
        hideBanner();
        showErrorToast(err);
      }
    });

    $('idle-timeout-select')?.addEventListener('change', async (e) => {
      try {
        await apiPost('/api/engine/config', { idleTimeoutMin: Number(e.target.value) });
        await refreshStatus();
      } catch (err) {
        showErrorToast(err);
      }
    });

    $('btn-stop-jvm')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      try {
        await apiPost('/api/engine/stop', { reason: 'user_stop' });
        state.daemonRunning = false;
        state.daemonState = 'stopped';
        await refreshStatus();
        showToast(t('toastDaemonStopped', null, 'Ghidra JVM stopped (0 MB RSS).'), 'success');
      } catch (err) {
        showErrorToast(err);
      }
    });

    $('btn-start-jvm')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      try {
        showBanner(t('startingEngineBanner', { tier: state.tier }, `Starting Ghidra Engine [${state.tier}]…`), { progressPct: 40 });
        await apiPost('/api/engine/start', {});
        hideBanner();
        await refreshStatus();
      } catch (err) {
        hideBanner();
        showErrorToast(err);
      }
    });

    $('btn-unload-active')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      if (!state.activeBinaryId) return;
      try {
        await apiPost('/api/binary/unload', { binaryId: state.activeBinaryId });
        await refreshStatus();
      } catch (err) {
        showErrorToast(err);
      }
    });

    // View tabs & action bar
    for (const tab of document.querySelectorAll('.view-tab[data-view]')) {
      tab.addEventListener('click', () => setView(tab.dataset.view));
    }
    $('btn-follow-agent')?.addEventListener('click', () => setFollowAgent(!state.followAgent));
    $('btn-ask-agent')?.addEventListener('click', openAskAgentBar);

    // Sidebar tabs, search, sort, scroll, click
    for (const tab of document.querySelectorAll('.side-tab[data-tab]')) {
      tab.addEventListener('click', () => switchSidebarTab(tab.dataset.tab));
    }
    $('sidebar-search-input')?.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
      state.sidebarQuery = e.target.value;
      clearTimeout(sidebarSearchTimer);
      sidebarSearchTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        resetSidebarCache();
        ensureSidebarPage(0);
      }, 160);
    });
    $('sidebar-sort')?.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
      state.sidebarSort = e.target.value;
      resetSidebarCache();
      ensureSidebarPage(0);
    });
    $('sidebar-vlist')?.addEventListener('scroll', scheduleSidebarRender, { passive: true });
    $('sidebar-vlist-rows')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const row = e.target.closest('.vrow[data-addr]');
      if (!row || !state.activeBinaryId) return;
      const addr = row.dataset.addr;
      if (!addr) return;
      if ($('app')?.classList.contains('narrow')) {
        $('sidebar')?.classList.remove('open');
      }
      navigateToTarget(state.activeBinaryId, addr, {
        source: 'sidebar',
        preferOffline: !state.daemonRunning && state.sidebarTab !== 'strings',
      });
    });

    // Decompile header buttons & viewport delegation
    $('btn-retype-fn')?.addEventListener('click', () => openRetypeModal(null));
    $('btn-rename-fn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (!state.decompile?.function) return;
      openRenameModal({
        targetKind: 'function',
        address: state.decompile.function.entry,
        oldName: state.decompile.function.name,
      });
    });
    $('btn-refresh-decompile')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      if (!state.activeBinaryId || !state.decompile?.function?.entry) return;
      try {
        await loadDecompile(state.activeBinaryId, state.decompile.function.entry, { refresh: true });
      } catch (err) {
        showErrorToast(err);
      }
    });

    const decVp = $('decompile-viewport');
    decVp?.addEventListener('scroll', scheduleDecompileRender, { passive: true });
    decVp?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const foldBtn = e.target.closest('.fold-btn[data-fold-id], .fold-placeholder[data-fold-id]');
      if (foldBtn) {
        const foldId = foldBtn.dataset.foldId;
        if (state.collapsedFolds.has(foldId)) {
          state.collapsedFolds.delete(foldId);
        } else {
          state.collapsedFolds.add(foldId);
        }
        const prevTop = decVp.scrollTop;
        recomputeVisibleDecompileLines();
        renderDecompileLinesWindow();
        decVp.scrollTop = prevTop;
        return;
      }

      const branchChip = e.target.closest('.branch-chip[data-addr]');
      if (branchChip) {
        syncAsmToAddresses([branchChip.dataset.addr]);
        return;
      }

      const lineEl = e.target.closest('.c-line[data-line]');
      const lineNum = lineEl ? Number(lineEl.dataset.line) : null;
      const lineEntry = lineNum ? state.decompile?.lines?.find((l) => Number(l.line) === lineNum) : null;
      const lineAddrs = lineEntry?.asmAddrs?.length ? lineEntry.asmAddrs : (lineEl?.dataset.addr ? [lineEl.dataset.addr] : []);

      const gutterAddr = e.target.closest('.gutter-addr[data-addr]');
      if (gutterAddr) {
        if (lineNum) state.selectedLine = lineNum;
        const addr = gutterAddr.dataset.addr;
        syncAsmToAddresses(lineAddrs.length ? lineAddrs : [addr]);
        state.focusedTarget = {
          kind: 'address',
          addr: normHex(addr),
          functionAddr: state.decompile?.function?.entry,
        };
        return;
      }

      const tok = e.target.closest('.tok');
      if (tok) {
        if (lineNum) state.selectedLine = lineNum;
        const tokAddr = tok.dataset.addr || '';
        const syncList = tokAddr ? [tokAddr] : lineAddrs;
        if (syncList.length > 0) {
          syncAsmToAddresses(syncList);
        }

        const isVar = tok.classList.contains('tok-local') || tok.classList.contains('tok-param');
        if (isVar && tok.dataset.varId) {
          highlightVariable(tok.dataset.varId, tok.textContent, tokAddr);
          return;
        }

        if (tok.classList.contains('tok-label_ref') && tok.dataset.target) {
          navigateToTarget(state.activeBinaryId, tok.dataset.target, {
            kind: 'label_ref',
            source: 'c_token',
          });
          return;
        }

        if (tok.classList.contains('tok-string_ref')) {
          if (tok.dataset.target) {
            navigateToTarget(state.activeBinaryId, tok.dataset.target, { source: 'c_token' });
          } else {
            resolveAndInspectStringLiteral(tok.textContent || tok.title || '');
          }
          return;
        }

        if (
          tok.classList.contains('tok-func_call') ||
          tok.classList.contains('tok-import_call') ||
          tok.classList.contains('tok-data_ref') ||
          tok.classList.contains('tok-global')
        ) {
          const navTarget = tok.dataset.target || tok.dataset.addr || tok.textContent;
          if (navTarget) {
            navigateToTarget(state.activeBinaryId, navTarget, { source: 'c_token' });
          }
          return;
        }

        if (tok.classList.contains('tok-func_def') && state.decompile?.function) {
          state.focusedTarget = {
            kind: 'function',
            addr: state.decompile.function.entry,
            functionAddr: state.decompile.function.entry,
            name: state.decompile.function.name,
          };
          return;
        }

        if (tokAddr) {
          state.focusedTarget = {
            kind: 'address',
            addr: normHex(tokAddr),
            functionAddr: state.decompile?.function?.entry,
          };
        }
      } else if (lineEl) {
        if (lineNum) state.selectedLine = lineNum;
        if (lineAddrs.length > 0) syncAsmToAddresses(lineAddrs);
      }
    });

    decVp?.addEventListener('dblclick', (e) => {
      const tok = e.target.closest('.tok');
      if (!tok) return;
      if ((tok.classList.contains('tok-local') || tok.classList.contains('tok-param')) && tok.dataset.varId) {
        highlightVariable(tok.dataset.varId, tok.textContent, tok.dataset.addr);
        openRenameModalForFocused();
      } else if (tok.classList.contains('tok-func_def') && state.decompile?.function) {
        openRenameModal({
          targetKind: 'function',
          address: state.decompile.function.entry,
          oldName: state.decompile.function.name,
        });
      }
    });

    // Disasm viewport delegation & pagination
    $('disasm-viewport')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const xBadge = e.target.closest('.asm-xref-badge[data-addr]');
      if (xBadge) {
        openXrefsModal(xBadge.dataset.addr);
        return;
      }
      const refEl = e.target.closest('.asm-operand-ref[data-target]');
      if (refEl) {
        navigateToTarget(state.activeBinaryId, refEl.dataset.target, { source: 'asm_ref' });
        return;
      }
      const row = e.target.closest('.asm-row[data-addr]');
      if (row) {
        const addr = row.dataset.addr;
        syncAsmToAddresses([addr], { scroll: false });
        syncCToAsmAddress(addr);
        state.focusedTarget = {
          kind: 'address',
          addr: normHex(addr),
          functionAddr: state.disasm?.functionEntry || state.decompile?.function?.entry,
        };
      }
    });

    $('btn-disasm-more-before')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      if (!state.activeBinaryId || !state.disasm?.instructions?.length) return;
      try {
        const firstAddr = state.disasm.instructions[0].addr;
        const more = await apiPost('/api/view/disasm', {
          binaryId: state.activeBinaryId,
          addr: firstAddr,
          before: 64,
          after: 0,
          includeBytes: true,
        });
        const existing = new Set(state.disasm.instructions.map((i) => normHex(i.addr)));
        const prepend = (more.instructions || []).filter((i) => !existing.has(normHex(i.addr)));
        state.disasm.instructions = [...prepend, ...state.disasm.instructions];
        state.disasm.hasMoreBefore = more.hasMoreBefore;
        state.disasm.startAddr = more.startAddr || state.disasm.startAddr;
        renderDisasm();
      } catch (err) {
        showErrorToast(err);
      }
    });

    $('btn-disasm-more-after')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      if (!state.activeBinaryId || !state.disasm?.instructions?.length) return;
      try {
        const lastAddr = state.disasm.instructions[state.disasm.instructions.length - 1].addr;
        const more = await apiPost('/api/view/disasm', {
          binaryId: state.activeBinaryId,
          addr: lastAddr,
          before: 0,
          after: 64,
          includeBytes: true,
        });
        const existing = new Set(state.disasm.instructions.map((i) => normHex(i.addr)));
        const append = (more.instructions || []).filter((i) => !existing.has(normHex(i.addr)));
        state.disasm.instructions = [...state.disasm.instructions, ...append];
        state.disasm.hasMoreAfter = more.hasMoreAfter;
        state.disasm.endAddr = more.endAddr || state.disasm.endAddr;
        renderDisasm();
      } catch (err) {
        showErrorToast(err);
      }
    });

    // Data inspector actions
    $('btn-inspector-close')?.addEventListener('click', () => closeInspector());
    $('btn-inspector-xrefs')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (state.inspectorAddr) {
        openXrefsModal(state.inspectorAddr, state.inspectorData?.symbol?.name || '');
      }
    });
    $('btn-inspector-disasm')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      if (!state.activeBinaryId || !state.inspectorAddr) return;
      pushHistory();
      state.activeView = 'disasm';
      updateViewVisibility();
      await loadDisasm(state.activeBinaryId, state.inspectorAddr, { before: 16, after: 64, scrollAddr: state.inspectorAddr });
    });
    $('btn-inspector-retype')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (!state.inspectorAddr) return;
      openRetypeModal({
        targetKind: 'data',
        address: state.inspectorAddr,
        currentDecl: state.inspectorData?.definedDataType || '',
      });
    });

    // Find bar
    $('find-input')?.addEventListener('input', runFindInFunction);
    $('find-input')?.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        stepFindMatch(e.shiftKey ? -1 : 1);
      }
    });
    $('btn-find-prev')?.addEventListener('click', () => stepFindMatch(-1));
    $('btn-find-next')?.addEventListener('click', () => stepFindMatch(1));
    $('btn-find-close')?.addEventListener('click', closeFindBar);

    // Open Modal
    $('btn-close-open')?.addEventListener('click', () => closeModal($('open-modal')));
    $('btn-rescan-workspace')?.addEventListener('click', () => scanWorkspace(state.workspaceUris));
    $('btn-open-path')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const pathVal = $('open-path-input')?.value?.trim();
      if (!pathVal) return;
      closeModal($('open-modal'));
      openBinaryFromUi({
        path: pathVal,
        analysisProfile: $('open-profile-select')?.value || 'default',
      });
    });
    $('open-path-input')?.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        $('btn-open-path')?.click();
      }
    });

    // Go To Modal
    $('btn-close-goto')?.addEventListener('click', () => closeModal($('goto-modal')));
    $('goto-input')?.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
      clearTimeout(gotoSuggestTimer);
      gotoSuggestTimer = setTimeout(() => updateGotoSuggestions(e.target.value), 120);
    });
    $('btn-goto-submit')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const val = $('goto-input')?.value?.trim();
      if (!val || !state.activeBinaryId) return;
      closeModal($('goto-modal'));
      navigateToTarget(state.activeBinaryId, val, { source: 'goto' });
    });
    $('goto-input')?.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        $('btn-goto-submit')?.click();
      }
    });

    // Xrefs Modal
    $('btn-close-xrefs')?.addEventListener('click', () => closeModal($('xrefs-modal')));
    $('xrefs-dir-select')?.addEventListener('change', fetchAndRenderXrefs);
    for (const cb of document.querySelectorAll('#xrefs-type-filters input[type="checkbox"]')) {
      cb.addEventListener('change', fetchAndRenderXrefs);
    }

    // Rename Modal
    $('btn-close-rename')?.addEventListener('click', () => closeModal($('rename-modal')));
    $('btn-rename-submit')?.addEventListener('click', submitRename);
    $('rename-input')?.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        submitRename();
      }
    });

    // Retype Modal
    $('btn-close-retype')?.addEventListener('click', () => closeModal($('retype-modal')));
    $('btn-retype-submit')?.addEventListener('click', submitRetype);
    $('retype-input')?.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        submitRetype();
      }
    });

    // Comment Modal
    $('btn-close-comment')?.addEventListener('click', () => closeModal($('comment-modal')));
    $('btn-comment-submit')?.addEventListener('click', submitComment);

    // Import Popover
    $('btn-close-import')?.addEventListener('click', () => closeModal($('import-popover')));
    $('btn-import-xrefs')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const d = state.importPopoverData;
      closeModal($('import-popover'));
      if (d?.resolved?.address) {
        openXrefsModal(d.resolved.address, d.resolved.symbolName || d.resolved.symbol || '');
      }
    });
    $('btn-import-load-lib')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const d = state.importPopoverData;
      const candidate = d?.resolved?.candidatePaths?.[0];
      if (!candidate) return;
      closeModal($('import-popover'));
      await openBinaryFromUi({
        path: candidate,
        initialTarget: d.resolved.symbolName || d.resolved.symbol,
      });
    });

    // Ask Agent Bar
    $('btn-close-ask')?.addEventListener('click', () => closeModal($('ask-agent-bar')));
    for (const btn of document.querySelectorAll('.ask-template-btn[data-template]')) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const tpl = btn.dataset.template;
        const key = tpl === 'explain'
          ? 'askTplPromptExplain'
          : tpl === 'types'
            ? 'askTplPromptTypes'
            : 'askTplPromptTrace';
        const text = t(key);
        const input = $('ask-agent-input');
        if (input) input.value = text;
        sendAskAgentPrompt(text);
      });
    }
    $('btn-ask-send')?.addEventListener('click', () => sendAskAgentPrompt());

    // Backdrop click closes modals
    for (const id of ['open-modal', 'goto-modal', 'xrefs-modal', 'rename-modal', 'retype-modal', 'comment-modal', 'import-popover', 'ask-agent-bar']) {
      const backdrop = $(id);
      backdrop?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target === backdrop) closeModal(backdrop);
      });
    }
  }

  // ---------- Diagnostic & Verification Surface ----------
  window.__GHIDRA_RE__ = {
    getState: () => ({
      daemonState: state.daemonState,
      daemonRunning: state.daemonRunning,
      daemonPid: state.daemonPid,
      tier: state.tier,
      ramLimitMb: state.ramLimitMb,
      activeBinaryId: state.activeBinaryId,
      activeView: state.activeView,
      sidebarTab: state.sidebarTab,
      sidebarTotal: state.sidebarTotal,
      collapsedFolds: [...state.collapsedFolds],
      visibleDecompileLineCount: state.visibleDecompileLines.length,
      highlightedVarId: state.highlightedVarId,
      selectedLine: state.selectedLine,
      selectedAsmAddr: state.selectedAsmAddr,
      focusedTarget: state.focusedTarget ? { ...state.focusedTarget } : null,
      inspectorOpen: state.inspectorOpen,
      inspectorAddr: state.inspectorAddr,
      followAgent: state.followAgent,
      lastUserInteractionAt: state.lastUserInteractionAt,
      latestSeq: state.latestSeq,
      history: {
        backCount: state.history.backStack.length,
        forwardCount: state.history.forwardStack.length,
      },
      decompile: state.decompile
        ? {
            entry: state.decompile.function?.entry || null,
            name: state.decompile.function?.name || null,
            revision: state.decompile.revision ?? null,
            totalLines: state.decompile.lines?.length || 0,
            source: state.decompileSource,
          }
        : null,
      loadedBinariesCount: state.loadedBinaries.length,
      offlineProjectsCount: state.offlineProjects.length,
      workspaceBinariesCount: state.workspaceBinaries.length,
    }),
    navigateToTarget,
    setLastUserInteractionAt: (ts) => {
      state.lastUserInteractionAt = Number(ts) || 0;
    },
    refreshStatus,
    openFindBar,
    closeFindBar,
    openGoToModal,
    openXrefsModal,
    openRenameModal,
    openRetypeModal,
    openCommentModalForFocused,
    setView,
    navigateBack,
    navigateForward,
    toggleFollowAgent: (val) => setFollowAgent(val === undefined ? !state.followAgent : Boolean(val)),
  };

  // ---------- Boot ----------
  function boot() {
    syncTheme();
    const themeObserver = new MutationObserver(syncTheme);
    themeObserver.observe(document.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style'] });

    window.GhidraI18n?.applyDom?.(document);

    setupResponsiveAndResizers();
    wireUiEvents();
    updateViewVisibility();
    renderHeaderState();

    if (window.sidecar) {
      if (typeof window.sidecar.onWorkspaceChange === 'function') {
        window.sidecar.onWorkspaceChange((uris) => {
          scanWorkspace(uris);
        });
      }
      if (typeof window.sidecar.getWorkspaceUris === 'function') {
        window.sidecar.getWorkspaceUris().then((uris) => scanWorkspace(uris)).catch(() => {});
      }
    }

    refreshStatus();
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  } else {
    boot();
  }
})();

```

`sidecars/workbench/public/cfg.js`:

```js
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const SVG_NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  const WORKER_THRESHOLD = 120;
  const MIN_ZOOM = 0.15;
  const MAX_ZOOM = 2.5;
  const DRAG_THRESHOLD_PX = 4;
  const MINIMAP_W = 140;
  const MINIMAP_H = 90;

  let sharedWorker = null;
  let globalJobId = 0;
  const pendingJobs = new Map();
  const mountStates = new WeakMap();
  let activeWorkerMount = null;

  /**
   * Pure deterministic CFG layout engine (zero DOM access; safe to serialize into a Blob Web Worker).
   * Implements a proper-layered Sugiyama layout with virtual dummy channels, sink rank alignment,
   * multi-pass column X-alignment, dummy-chain straightening, and obstacle-free rounded-orthogonal gutter routing.
   * @param {Array<object>} blocks
   * @param {Array<object>} edges
   * @param {object} [options]
   * @returns {{ nodes: Array<object>, edges: Array<object>, bounds: object, layerCount: number }}
   */
  function computeLayout(blocks, edges, options) {
    const HEADER_H = 24;
    const LINE_H = 16;
    const PAD_Y = 8;
    const PAD_X = 10;
    const CHAR_W = 6.9;
    const MIN_W = 210;
    const MAX_W = 360;
    const MAX_VISIBLE_INSNS = 24;
    const COL_GAP = 38;
    const DUMMY_BLOCK_GAP = 24;
    const DUMMY_GAP = 12;
    const DUMMY_W = 6;
    const ROW_GAP = 48;
    const TRACK_STEP = 11;
    const GUTTER_PAD = 14;
    const MARGIN = 40;
    const CORNER_R = 8;

    const opts = options && typeof options === 'object' ? options : {};
    const overflowTemplate = typeof opts.overflowTemplate === 'string' && opts.overflowTemplate
      ? opts.overflowTemplate
      : '… (+{count} more insns)';

    const rawBlocks = Array.isArray(blocks) ? blocks : [];
    const rawEdges = Array.isArray(edges) ? edges : [];
    const n = rawBlocks.length;

    if (n === 0) {
      return {
        nodes: [],
        edges: [],
        bounds: { minX: 0, minY: 0, maxX: 0, maxY: 0, width: 0, height: 0 },
        layerCount: 0,
      };
    }

    function round2(val) {
      return Math.round(val * 100) / 100;
    }

    function formatOverflow(count) {
      return overflowTemplate.replace(/\{count\}/g, String(count));
    }

    function truncateStr(str, maxLen) {
      if (!str) return '';
      if (maxLen <= 1) return str.slice(0, Math.max(0, maxLen));
      if (str.length <= maxLen) return str;
      return str.slice(0, maxLen - 1) + '…';
    }

    function buildRoundedOrthogonalPath(pts, maxRadius) {
      if (!pts || pts.length === 0) return '';
      const clean = [pts[0]];
      for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {
        const prev = clean[clean.length - 1];
        const cur = pts[i];
        if (Math.hypot(cur.x - prev.x, cur.y - prev.y) < 0.5) continue;
        if (clean.length >= 2) {
          const prev2 = clean[clean.length - 2];
          const sameX = Math.abs(prev2.x - prev.x) < 0.5 && Math.abs(prev.x - cur.x) < 0.5;
          const sameY = Math.abs(prev2.y - prev.y) < 0.5 && Math.abs(prev.y - cur.y) < 0.5;
          if (sameX || sameY) {
            clean[clean.length - 1] = cur;
            continue;
          }
        }
        clean.push(cur);
      }

      if (clean.length === 1) {
        return 'M ' + round2(clean[0].x) + ' ' + round2(clean[0].y);
      }
      if (clean.length === 2) {
        return (
          'M ' + round2(clean[0].x) + ' ' + round2(clean[0].y) +
          ' L ' + round2(clean[1].x) + ' ' + round2(clean[1].y)
        );
      }

      let d = 'M ' + round2(clean[0].x) + ' ' + round2(clean[0].y);
      for (let i = 1; i < clean.length - 1; i++) {
        const p0 = clean[i - 1];
        const p1 = clean[i];
        const p2 = clean[i + 1];
        const vx1 = p1.x - p0.x;
        const vy1 = p1.y - p0.y;
        const len1 = Math.hypot(vx1, vy1);
        const vx2 = p2.x - p1.x;
        const vy2 = p2.y - p1.y;
        const len2 = Math.hypot(vx2, vy2);
        const r = Math.min(maxRadius || CORNER_R, len1 * 0.45, len2 * 0.45);
        if (r < 1.5) {
          d += ' L ' + round2(p1.x) + ' ' + round2(p1.y);
        } else {
          const sx = p1.x - (vx1 / len1) * r;
          const sy = p1.y - (vy1 / len1) * r;
          const ex = p1.x + (vx2 / len2) * r;
          const ey = p1.y + (vy2 / len2) * r;
          d +=
            ' L ' + round2(sx) + ' ' + round2(sy) +
            ' Q ' + round2(p1.x) + ' ' + round2(p1.y) + ', ' + round2(ex) + ' ' + round2(ey);
        }
      }
      const last = clean[clean.length - 1];
      d += ' L ' + round2(last.x) + ' ' + round2(last.y);
      return d;
    }

    const idToIndex = new Map();
    const nodes = new Array(n);
    let entryIdx = -1;

    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const b = rawBlocks[i] || {};
      const id = String(b.id != null ? b.id : (b.start != null ? b.start : i));
      if (!idToIndex.has(id)) {
        idToIndex.set(id, i);
      }
      const isEntry = Boolean(b.isEntry);
      if (isEntry && entryIdx === -1) {
        entryIdx = i;
      }

      const insns = Array.isArray(b.insns) ? b.insns : [];
      const insnCount = Number.isFinite(Number(b.insnCount)) ? Number(b.insnCount) : insns.length;
      const title = String(b.label || b.start || id);
      const metaText = '[' + String(insnCount) + ']';

      let visibleCount = 0;
      const rawRows = [];
      if (insns.length === 0) {
        visibleCount = 1;
        const summary = insnCount > 0 ? '(' + insnCount + ' insns)' : '<empty>';
        rawRows.push({ isSummary: true, isOverflow: false, addr: '', mnemonic: '', operands: '', fullText: summary });
      } else if (insns.length > MAX_VISIBLE_INSNS) {
        for (let k = 0; k < MAX_VISIBLE_INSNS; k++) {
          const ins = insns[k] || {};
          const addr = ins.addr != null ? String(ins.addr) : '';
          const mnem = ins.mnemonic != null ? String(ins.mnemonic) : '';
          const ops = ins.operands != null ? String(ins.operands) : '';
          const fullText = (addr ? addr + ' ' : '') + mnem + (ops ? ' ' + ops : '');
          rawRows.push({ isSummary: false, isOverflow: false, addr: addr, mnemonic: mnem, operands: ops, fullText: fullText });
        }
        const overflowCount = insns.length - MAX_VISIBLE_INSNS;
        const ovText = formatOverflow(overflowCount);
        rawRows.push({ isSummary: false, isOverflow: true, addr: '', mnemonic: '', operands: '', fullText: ovText });
        visibleCount = MAX_VISIBLE_INSNS + 1;
      } else {
        for (let k = 0; k < insns.length; k++) {
          const ins = insns[k] || {};
          const addr = ins.addr != null ? String(ins.addr) : '';
          const mnem = ins.mnemonic != null ? String(ins.mnemonic) : '';
          const ops = ins.operands != null ? String(ins.operands) : '';
          const fullText = (addr ? addr + ' ' : '') + mnem + (ops ? ' ' + ops : '');
          rawRows.push({ isSummary: false, isOverflow: false, addr: addr, mnemonic: mnem, operands: ops, fullText: fullText });
        }
        visibleCount = insns.length;
      }

      const bodyLines = Math.max(1, visibleCount);
      const h = HEADER_H + bodyLines * LINE_H + PAD_Y;

      let maxChars = title.length + metaText.length + 2;
      for (let k = 0; k < rawRows.length; k++) {
        if (rawRows[k].fullText.length > maxChars) {
          maxChars = rawRows[k].fullText.length;
        }
      }
      const rawW = Math.ceil(maxChars * CHAR_W + PAD_X * 2);
      const w = Math.max(MIN_W, Math.min(MAX_W, rawW));

      const maxLineChars = Math.max(8, Math.floor((w - PAD_X * 2) / CHAR_W));
      const maxHdrChars = Math.max(6, maxLineChars - metaText.length - 1);
      const displayTitle = truncateStr(title, maxHdrChars);

      const displayRows = new Array(rawRows.length);
      for (let k = 0; k < rawRows.length; k++) {
        const rr = rawRows[k];
        if (rr.isSummary || rr.isOverflow) {
          displayRows[k] = {
            isSummary: rr.isSummary,
            isOverflow: rr.isOverflow,
            text: truncateStr(rr.fullText, maxLineChars),
          };
        } else {
          let rem = maxLineChars;
          const addrPart = rr.addr ? rr.addr + ' ' : '';
          const addrShown = truncateStr(addrPart, rem);
          rem -= addrShown.length;
          const mnemShown = rem > 0 ? truncateStr(rr.mnemonic, rem) : '';
          rem -= mnemShown.length;
          let opsShown = '';
          if (rr.operands && rem > 1) {
            opsShown = ' ' + truncateStr(rr.operands, rem - 1);
          }
          displayRows[k] = {
            isSummary: false,
            isOverflow: false,
            addrText: addrShown,
            mnemText: mnemShown,
            opsText: opsShown,
          };
        }
      }

      nodes[i] = {
        id: id,
        start: b.start != null ? String(b.start) : id,
        end: b.end != null ? String(b.end) : id,
        label: b.label != null ? String(b.label) : null,
        displayTitle: displayTitle,
        metaText: metaText,
        insnCount: insnCount,
        isEntry: isEntry,
        isExit: Boolean(b.isExit),
        insns: insns,
        displayRows: displayRows,
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
        w: w,
        h: h,
        layer: 0,
        col: 0,
      };
    }

    if (entryIdx === -1) {
      entryIdx = 0;
    }

    // Filter valid edges and normalize kind
    const validEdges = [];
    const selfLoopCount = new Int32Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < rawEdges.length; i++) {
      const e = rawEdges[i];
      if (!e) continue;
      const fromId = String(e.from);
      const toId = String(e.to);
      const u = idToIndex.get(fromId);
      const v = idToIndex.get(toId);
      if (u === undefined || v === undefined) continue;
      if (u === v) {
        selfLoopCount[u]++;
      }
      validEdges.push({
        from: fromId,
        to: toId,
        u: u,
        v: v,
        kind: e.kind ? String(e.kind) : 'UNCONDITIONAL',
      });
    }

    const eCount = validEdges.length;
    const isBack = new Uint8Array(eCount);
    const dfsAdj = new Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) dfsAdj[i] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < eCount; i++) {
      const e = validEdges[i];
      if (e.kind === 'LOOP_BACK' || e.u === e.v) {
        isBack[i] = 1;
      } else {
        dfsAdj[e.u].push(i);
      }
    }

    // Step (a): Iterative DFS cycle breaking starting from entryIdx
    const dfsState = new Uint8Array(n);
    const stackNode = [];
    const stackPos = [];

    function runDfsFrom(startNode) {
      if (dfsState[startNode] !== 0) return;
      dfsState[startNode] = 1;
      stackNode.push(startNode);
      stackPos.push(0);

      while (stackNode.length > 0) {
        const top = stackNode.length - 1;
        const u = stackNode[top];
        const pos = stackPos[top];
        const outList = dfsAdj[u];

        if (pos < outList.length) {
          stackPos[top] = pos + 1;
          const ei = outList[pos];
          if (isBack[ei]) continue;
          const v = validEdges[ei].v;
          if (dfsState[v] === 1) {
            isBack[ei] = 1;
          } else if (dfsState[v] === 0) {
            dfsState[v] = 1;
            stackNode.push(v);
            stackPos.push(0);
          }
        } else {
          dfsState[u] = 2;
          stackNode.pop();
          stackPos.pop();
        }
      }
    }

    runDfsFrom(entryIdx);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      if (dfsState[i] === 0) {
        runDfsFrom(i);
      }
    }

    // Build strict DAG adjacency & in-degree
    const dagOut = new Array(n);
    const dagIn = new Array(n);
    const dagOutEdges = new Array(n);
    const inDeg = new Int32Array(n);
    const dagEdgeIndices = [];
    const backEdgeIndices = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      dagOut[i] = [];
      dagIn[i] = [];
      dagOutEdges[i] = [];
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < eCount; i++) {
      const e = validEdges[i];
      if (isBack[i]) {
        backEdgeIndices.push(i);
      } else {
        dagEdgeIndices.push(i);
        dagOut[e.u].push(e.v);
        dagIn[e.v].push(e.u);
        dagOutEdges[e.u].push(i);
        inDeg[e.v]++;
      }
    }

    // Step (b): Longest-path topological layering via Kahn's algorithm + Sink Rank Tightening
    const layer = new Int32Array(n);
    const topoOrder = [];
    let qHead = 0;

    if (inDeg[entryIdx] === 0) {
      topoOrder.push(entryIdx);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      if (i !== entryIdx && inDeg[i] === 0) {
        topoOrder.push(i);
      }
    }

    while (qHead < topoOrder.length) {
      const u = topoOrder[qHead++];
      const nextLayer = layer[u] + 1;
      const outs = dagOut[u];
      for (let k = 0; k < outs.length; k++) {
        const v = outs[k];
        if (nextLayer > layer[v]) {
          layer[v] = nextLayer;
        }
        inDeg[v]--;
        if (inDeg[v] === 0) {
          topoOrder.push(v);
        }
      }
    }

    let minLayer = layer[0];
    let maxLayer = layer[0];
    for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
      if (layer[i] < minLayer) minLayer = layer[i];
      if (layer[i] > maxLayer) maxLayer = layer[i];
    }
    if (minLayer !== 0) {
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        layer[i] -= minLayer;
      }
      maxLayer -= minLayer;
    }

    // Bottom-up subtree depth & sink detection
    const maxDescLayer = new Int32Array(n);
    const leadsOnlyToSink = new Uint8Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      maxDescLayer[i] = layer[i];
      if (dagOut[i].length === 0) {
        leadsOnlyToSink[i] = 1;
      }
    }
    for (let t = topoOrder.length - 1; t >= 0; t--) {
      const u = topoOrder[t];
      const outs = dagOut[u];
      if (outs.length === 1 && leadsOnlyToSink[outs[0]] && dagOut[outs[0]].length === 0) {
        leadsOnlyToSink[u] = 1;
      }
      for (let k = 0; k < outs.length; k++) {
        const v = outs[k];
        if (maxDescLayer[v] > maxDescLayer[u]) {
          maxDescLayer[u] = maxDescLayer[v];
        }
      }
    }

    // Align shared exit/return sinks to maxLayer and pull pre-sink merge trampolines right above them
    if (maxLayer >= 2) {
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (i === entryIdx) continue;
        if (dagOut[i].length === 0 && dagIn[i].length > 0) {
          if (maxLayer - layer[i] <= 4 && (dagIn[i].length >= 2 || nodes[i].isExit)) {
            layer[i] = maxLayer;
          }
        }
      }
      for (let t = topoOrder.length - 1; t >= 0; t--) {
        const u = topoOrder[t];
        if (u === entryIdx) continue;
        const outs = dagOut[u];
        if (outs.length === 0) continue;
        let minChildL = Infinity;
        for (let k = 0; k < outs.length; k++) {
          if (layer[outs[k]] < minChildL) {
            minChildL = layer[outs[k]];
          }
        }
        if (!Number.isFinite(minChildL) || minChildL - 1 <= layer[u]) continue;
        if (dagIn[u].length === 0) {
          layer[u] = minChildL - 1;
        } else if (outs.length > dagIn[u].length && minChildL - 1 - layer[u] <= 3) {
          layer[u] = minChildL - 1;
        } else if (outs.length === 1 && dagOut[outs[0]].length === 0 && dagIn[u].length >= 2 && minChildL - layer[u] <= 3) {
          layer[u] = minChildL - 1;
        }
      }
    }

    // Compact layers if any rank became empty
    const usedLayerFlags = new Uint8Array(maxLayer + 2);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      usedLayerFlags[layer[i]] = 1;
    }
    const layerRemap = new Int32Array(maxLayer + 2);
    let compactLayerCount = 0;
    for (let l = 0; l <= maxLayer; l++) {
      if (usedLayerFlags[l]) {
        layerRemap[l] = compactLayerCount++;
      }
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      layer[i] = layerRemap[layer[i]];
      nodes[i].layer = layer[i];
    }
    const layerCount = Math.max(1, compactLayerCount);

    // Semantic branch ordering & DFS preorder so main subtrees stay centered/left and early-exit jumps stay on the right rail
    function edgeBranchPriority(ei) {
      const e = validEdges[ei];
      const v = e.v;
      const span = layer[v] - layer[e.u];
      // Early-exit or long jump to a sink/return block goes to the right outer rail (higher priority index)
      if (leadsOnlyToSink[v] && span >= 2) {
        return 10 + span;
      }
      if (leadsOnlyToSink[v] && dagOut[e.u].length > 1) {
        return 8;
      }
      // Among two normal subtree branches, put COND_TRUE on the left and COND_FALSE on the right
      if (e.kind === 'COND_TRUE') return 1;
      if (e.kind === 'COND_FALSE') return 2;
      if (e.kind === 'SWITCH_CASE') return 3;
      return 4;
    }

    for (let u = 0; u < n; u++) {
      dagOutEdges[u].sort(function (a, b) {
        const pa = edgeBranchPriority(a);
        const pb = edgeBranchPriority(b);
        if (pa !== pb) return pa - pb;
        return validEdges[a].v - validEdges[b].v;
      });
    }

    const dfsOrderRank = new Int32Array(n);
    dfsOrderRank.fill(-1);
    let dfsCounter = 0;
    function assignSemanticPreorder(root) {
      if (dfsOrderRank[root] !== -1) return;
      const st = [root];
      while (st.length > 0) {
        const u = st.pop();
        if (dfsOrderRank[u] !== -1) continue;
        dfsOrderRank[u] = dfsCounter++;
        const outs = dagOutEdges[u];
        for (let k = outs.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
          const v = validEdges[outs[k]].v;
          if (dfsOrderRank[v] === -1) {
            st.push(v);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    assignSemanticPreorder(entryIdx);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      if (dfsOrderRank[i] === -1) {
        assignSemanticPreorder(i);
      }
    }

    // Step (c): Build Proper Layered Graph with Sugiyama Virtual Dummy Nodes for long edges (span > 1)
    const vNodes = new Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const extraSelfLoopW = selfLoopCount[i] > 0 ? (28 + selfLoopCount[i] * 16) : 0;
      vNodes[i] = {
        vid: i,
        isDummy: false,
        realIdx: i,
        edgeIdx: -1,
        u: i,
        v: i,
        kind: '',
        layer: layer[i],
        w: nodes[i].w + extraSelfLoopW,
        boxW: nodes[i].w,
        h: nodes[i].h,
        x: 0,
        orderRank: dfsOrderRank[i],
      };
    }

    const edgeChains = new Array(eCount);
    for (let k = 0; k < dagEdgeIndices.length; k++) {
      const ei = dagEdgeIndices[k];
      const e = validEdges[ei];
      const lu = layer[e.u];
      const lv = layer[e.v];
      const chain = [e.u];
      if (lv - lu > 1) {
        const baseRank = dfsOrderRank[e.u] + edgeBranchPriority(ei) * 0.01;
        for (let l = lu + 1; l < lv; l++) {
          const vid = vNodes.length;
          vNodes.push({
            vid: vid,
            isDummy: true,
            realIdx: -1,
            edgeIdx: ei,
            u: e.u,
            v: e.v,
            kind: e.kind,
            layer: l,
            w: DUMMY_W,
            boxW: DUMMY_W,
            h: 0,
            x: 0,
            orderRank: baseRank,
          });
          chain.push(vid);
        }
      }
      chain.push(e.v);
      edgeChains[ei] = chain;
    }

    const totalV = vNodes.length;
    const vLayers = new Array(layerCount);
    for (let l = 0; l < layerCount; l++) {
      vLayers[l] = [];
    }
    for (let vid = 0; vid < totalV; vid++) {
      vLayers[vNodes[vid].layer].push(vid);
    }

    // Proper 1-layer adjacency between consecutive levels
    const pOut = new Array(totalV);
    const pIn = new Array(totalV);
    for (let vid = 0; vid < totalV; vid++) {
      pOut[vid] = [];
      pIn[vid] = [];
    }

    for (let u = 0; u < n; u++) {
      const outs = dagOutEdges[u];
      const count = outs.length;
      for (let idx = 0; idx < count; idx++) {
        const ei = outs[idx];
        const chain = edgeChains[ei];
        const portOffset = count > 1 ? ((idx / (count - 1)) - 0.5) * 0.35 : 0;
        for (let s = 0; s < chain.length - 1; s++) {
          const a = chain[s];
          const b = chain[s + 1];
          const off = s === 0 ? portOffset : 0;
          pOut[a].push({ to: b, edgeIdx: ei, portOffset: off });
          pIn[b].push({ from: a, edgeIdx: ei, portOffset: off });
        }
      }
    }

    // Initial layer sorting: real nodes by semantic DFS preorder, dummy nodes on the side dictated by their branch priority
    for (let l = 0; l < layerCount; l++) {
      vLayers[l].sort(function (a, b) {
        const na = vNodes[a];
        const nb = vNodes[b];
        if (na.isDummy !== nb.isDummy) {
          // Put early-exit dummy rails to the right of real blocks on the same layer by default
          return na.isDummy ? 1 : -1;
        }
        if (na.orderRank !== nb.orderRank) {
          return na.orderRank - nb.orderRank;
        }
        return a - b;
      });
    }

    const posInLayer = new Int32Array(totalV);
    function syncPosInLayer() {
      for (let l = 0; l < layerCount; l++) {
        const arr = vLayers[l];
        for (let c = 0; c < arr.length; c++) {
          posInLayer[arr[c]] = c;
        }
      }
    }
    syncPosInLayer();

    const baryScore = new Float64Array(totalV);

    function sweepLayerTopDown(l) {
      const arr = vLayers[l];
      if (arr.length <= 1) return;
      for (let c = 0; c < arr.length; c++) {
        const vid = arr[c];
        const ins = pIn[vid];
        if (ins.length > 0) {
          let sum = 0;
          let wSum = 0;
          for (let k = 0; k < ins.length; k++) {
            const seg = ins[k];
            const p = seg.from;
            const w = (vNodes[vid].isDummy && vNodes[p].isDummy) ? 4.0 : 1.0;
```
