            sum += (posInLayer[p] + seg.portOffset) * w;
            wSum += w;
          }
          baryScore[vid] = sum / wSum;
        } else {
          baryScore[vid] = posInLayer[vid];
        }
      }
      arr.sort(function (a, b) {
        const diff = baryScore[a] - baryScore[b];
        if (Math.abs(diff) > 1e-6) return diff;
        const na = vNodes[a];
        const nb = vNodes[b];
        if (na.isDummy && nb.isDummy && na.v === nb.v) {
          // Nested jumps to the same target: inner (lower layer) source stays to the inside (left) of outer source
          return layer[ nb.u ] - layer[ na.u ];
        }
        return posInLayer[a] - posInLayer[b];
      });
      for (let c = 0; c < arr.length; c++) {
        posInLayer[arr[c]] = c;
      }
    }

    function sweepLayerBottomUp(l) {
      const arr = vLayers[l];
      if (arr.length <= 1) return;
      for (let c = 0; c < arr.length; c++) {
        const vid = arr[c];
        const vn = vNodes[vid];
        const outs = pOut[vid];
        if (outs.length > 0) {
          let sum = 0;
          let wSum = 0;
          let hasRealChild = false;
          if (!vn.isDummy) {
            for (let k = 0; k < outs.length; k++) {
              if (!vNodes[outs[k].to].isDummy) {
                hasRealChild = true;
                break;
              }
            }
          }
          for (let k = 0; k < outs.length; k++) {
            const seg = outs[k];
            const child = seg.to;
            const childIsDummy = vNodes[child].isDummy;
            if (!vn.isDummy && hasRealChild && childIsDummy) {
              // Do not let an early-exit dummy edge pull a real block out of its real subtree column
              continue;
            }
            const w = (vn.isDummy && childIsDummy) ? 4.0 : 1.0;
            sum += (posInLayer[child] - seg.portOffset) * w;
            wSum += w;
          }
          baryScore[vid] = wSum > 0 ? (sum / wSum) : posInLayer[vid];
        } else {
          baryScore[vid] = posInLayer[vid];
        }
      }
      arr.sort(function (a, b) {
        const diff = baryScore[a] - baryScore[b];
        if (Math.abs(diff) > 1e-6) return diff;
        return posInLayer[a] - posInLayer[b];
      });
      for (let c = 0; c < arr.length; c++) {
        posInLayer[arr[c]] = c;
      }
    }

    for (let sweep = 0; sweep < 8; sweep++) {
      if (sweep % 2 === 0) {
        for (let l = 1; l < layerCount; l++) {
          sweepLayerTopDown(l);
        }
      } else {
        for (let l = layerCount - 2; l >= 0; l--) {
          sweepLayerBottomUp(l);
        }
      }
    }

    for (let l = 0; l < layerCount; l++) {
      const arr = vLayers[l];
      let realCol = 0;
      for (let c = 0; c < arr.length; c++) {
        const vn = vNodes[arr[c]];
        if (!vn.isDummy) {
          nodes[vn.realIdx].col = realCol++;
        }
      }
    }

    // Step (d): Multi-Pass Column-Aligned Coordinate Assignment + Dummy-Chain Straightening
    function pairGap(vidA, vidB) {
      const da = vNodes[vidA].isDummy;
      const db = vNodes[vidB].isDummy;
      if (da && db) return DUMMY_GAP;
      if (da || db) return DUMMY_BLOCK_GAP;
      return COL_GAP;
    }

    const layerMaxH = new Float64Array(layerCount);
    const vLayerWidth = new Float64Array(layerCount);
    let maxLayerWidth = 0;

    for (let l = 0; l < layerCount; l++) {
      const arr = vLayers[l];
      let mh = 0;
      let lw = 0;
      for (let c = 0; c < arr.length; c++) {
        const vn = vNodes[arr[c]];
        if (!vn.isDummy && vn.h > mh) mh = vn.h;
        lw += vn.w;
        if (c > 0) {
          lw += pairGap(arr[c - 1], arr[c]);
        }
      }
      layerMaxH[l] = Math.max(HEADER_H + LINE_H + PAD_Y, mh);
      vLayerWidth[l] = lw;
      if (lw > maxLayerWidth) maxLayerWidth = lw;
    }

    for (let l = 0; l < layerCount; l++) {
      const arr = vLayers[l];
      let curX = MARGIN + (maxLayerWidth - vLayerWidth[l]) * 0.5;
      for (let c = 0; c < arr.length; c++) {
        const vn = vNodes[arr[c]];
        vn.x = curX;
        curX += vn.w + (c + 1 < arr.length ? pairGap(arr[c], arr[c + 1]) : 0);
      }
    }

    function projectLayerNonOverlapping(l, desiredX, forwardFirst) {
      const arr = vLayers[l];
      const len = arr.length;
      if (len === 0) return;

      const xL = new Float64Array(len);
      const xR = new Float64Array(len);
      for (let c = 0; c < len; c++) {
        xL[c] = desiredX[c];
        xR[c] = desiredX[c];
      }

      // Forward pass (left to right)
      for (let c = 1; c < len; c++) {
        const prev = vNodes[arr[c - 1]];
        const minX = xL[c - 1] + prev.w + pairGap(arr[c - 1], arr[c]);
        if (xL[c] < minX) xL[c] = minX;
      }
      for (let c = len - 2; c >= 0; c--) {
        const cur = vNodes[arr[c]];
        const maxX = xL[c + 1] - pairGap(arr[c], arr[c + 1]) - cur.w;
        if (xL[c] > maxX) xL[c] = maxX;
      }

      // Backward pass (right to left)
      for (let c = len - 2; c >= 0; c--) {
        const cur = vNodes[arr[c]];
        const maxX = xR[c + 1] - pairGap(arr[c], arr[c + 1]) - cur.w;
        if (xR[c] > maxX) xR[c] = maxX;
      }
      for (let c = 1; c < len; c++) {
        const prev = vNodes[arr[c - 1]];
        const minX = xR[c - 1] + prev.w + pairGap(arr[c - 1], arr[c]);
        if (xR[c] < minX) xR[c] = minX;
      }

      // Average the two valid projections (convex combination preserves all gap inequalities!)
      for (let c = 0; c < len; c++) {
        vNodes[arr[c]].x = forwardFirst ? (0.55 * xL[c] + 0.45 * xR[c]) : (0.45 * xL[c] + 0.55 * xR[c]);
      }
    }

    for (let iter = 0; iter < 10; iter++) {
      if (iter % 2 === 0) {
        // Top-Down alignment pass
        for (let l = 1; l < layerCount; l++) {
          const arr = vLayers[l];
          const desired = new Float64Array(arr.length);
          for (let c = 0; c < arr.length; c++) {
            const vid = arr[c];
            const vn = vNodes[vid];
            const ins = pIn[vid];
            if (ins.length === 0) {
              desired[c] = vn.x;
              continue;
            }
            if (vn.isDummy) {
              const p = vNodes[ins[0].from];
              const targetCx = p.x + p.boxW * 0.5 + ins[0].portOffset * p.boxW;
              desired[c] = vn.x + (targetCx - vn.w * 0.5 - vn.x) * 0.88;
            } else {
              let hasRealPred = false;
              for (let k = 0; k < ins.length; k++) {
                if (!vNodes[ins[k].from].isDummy) {
                  hasRealPred = true;
                  break;
                }
              }
              let sumCx = 0;
              let wSum = 0;
              for (let k = 0; k < ins.length; k++) {
                const p = vNodes[ins[k].from];
                if (hasRealPred && p.isDummy) continue;
                const w = (!p.isDummy && pOut[p.vid].length === 1) ? 2.5 : 1.0;
                sumCx += (p.x + p.boxW * 0.5) * w;
                wSum += w;
              }
              if (wSum > 0) {
                const targetX = (sumCx / wSum) - vn.boxW * 0.5;
                desired[c] = vn.x + (targetX - vn.x) * 0.82;
              } else {
                desired[c] = vn.x;
              }
            }
          }
          projectLayerNonOverlapping(l, desired, true);
        }
      } else {
        // Bottom-Up alignment pass
        for (let l = layerCount - 2; l >= 0; l--) {
          const arr = vLayers[l];
          const desired = new Float64Array(arr.length);
          for (let c = 0; c < arr.length; c++) {
            const vid = arr[c];
            const vn = vNodes[vid];
            const outs = pOut[vid];
            if (outs.length === 0) {
              desired[c] = vn.x;
              continue;
            }
            if (vn.isDummy) {
              const child = vNodes[outs[0].to];
              const targetCx = child.x + child.boxW * 0.5;
              desired[c] = vn.x + (targetCx - vn.w * 0.5 - vn.x) * 0.88;
            } else {
              let hasRealChild = false;
              for (let k = 0; k < outs.length; k++) {
                if (!vNodes[outs[k].to].isDummy) {
                  hasRealChild = true;
                  break;
                }
              }
              let sumCx = 0;
              let wSum = 0;
              for (let k = 0; k < outs.length; k++) {
                const child = vNodes[outs[k].to];
                if (hasRealChild && child.isDummy) continue;
                const w = !child.isDummy ? 2.0 : 0.5;
                sumCx += (child.x + child.boxW * 0.5) * w;
                wSum += w;
              }
              if (wSum > 0) {
                const targetX = (sumCx / wSum) - vn.boxW * 0.5;
                desired[c] = vn.x + (targetX - vn.x) * 0.82;
              } else {
                desired[c] = vn.x;
              }
            }
          }
          projectLayerNonOverlapping(l, desired, false);
        }
      }
    }

    // Snap 1-to-1 real-block vertical chains to the exact same centerX axis wherever obstacle-free bounds allow
    function realNeighborsOnAdjacentLayer(vid, adjList) {
      const res = [];
      for (let k = 0; k < adjList.length; k++) {
        const nb = adjList[k].to !== undefined ? adjList[k].to : adjList[k].from;
        if (!vNodes[nb].isDummy) {
          res.push(nb);
        }
      }
      return res;
    }

    function clampNodeXInLayer(vid, desiredX) {
      const vn = vNodes[vid];
      const arr = vLayers[vn.layer];
      const c = posInLayer[vid];
      const minB = c > 0
        ? (vNodes[arr[c - 1]].x + vNodes[arr[c - 1]].w + pairGap(arr[c - 1], vid))
        : -1e6;
      const maxB = (c + 1 < arr.length)
        ? (vNodes[arr[c + 1]].x - pairGap(vid, arr[c + 1]) - vn.w)
        : 1e6;
      if (minB > maxB) return vn.x;
      return Math.max(minB, Math.min(maxB, desiredX));
    }

    for (let pass = 0; pass < 4; pass++) {
      // Top-down snap of 1-to-1 real chains and symmetric centering above 2-way diamonds
      for (let l = 1; l < layerCount; l++) {
        const arr = vLayers[l];
        for (let c = 0; c < arr.length; c++) {
          const vid = arr[c];
          const vn = vNodes[vid];
          if (vn.isDummy) continue;
          const realPreds = realNeighborsOnAdjacentLayer(vid, pIn[vid]);
          if (realPreds.length === 1) {
            const p = realPreds[0];
            const pRealSuccs = realNeighborsOnAdjacentLayer(p, pOut[p]);
            if (pRealSuccs.length === 1) {
              const targetX = (vNodes[p].x + vNodes[p].boxW * 0.5) - vn.boxW * 0.5;
              vn.x = clampNodeXInLayer(vid, targetX);
            }
          } else if (realPreds.length >= 2) {
            let minPx = Infinity;
            let maxPx = -Infinity;
            for (let k = 0; k < realPreds.length; k++) {
              const pn = vNodes[realPreds[k]];
              const cx = pn.x + pn.boxW * 0.5;
              if (cx < minPx) minPx = cx;
              if (cx > maxPx) maxPx = cx;
            }
            const midCx = (minPx + maxPx) * 0.5;
            vn.x = clampNodeXInLayer(vid, midCx - vn.boxW * 0.5);
          }
        }
      }
      // Bottom-up snap of 1-to-1 real chains and parent centering over split children
      for (let l = layerCount - 2; l >= 0; l--) {
        const arr = vLayers[l];
        for (let c = 0; c < arr.length; c++) {
          const vid = arr[c];
          const vn = vNodes[vid];
          if (vn.isDummy) continue;
          const realSuccs = realNeighborsOnAdjacentLayer(vid, pOut[vid]);
          if (realSuccs.length === 1) {
            const ch = realSuccs[0];
            const chRealPreds = realNeighborsOnAdjacentLayer(ch, pIn[ch]);
            if (chRealPreds.length === 1) {
              const targetX = (vNodes[ch].x + vNodes[ch].boxW * 0.5) - vn.boxW * 0.5;
              vn.x = clampNodeXInLayer(vid, targetX);
            }
          } else if (realSuccs.length >= 2) {
            let minCx = Infinity;
            let maxCx = -Infinity;
            for (let k = 0; k < realSuccs.length; k++) {
              const cn = vNodes[realSuccs[k]];
              const cx = cn.x + cn.boxW * 0.5;
              if (cx < minCx) minCx = cx;
              if (cx > maxCx) maxCx = cx;
            }
            const midCx = (minCx + maxCx) * 0.5;
            vn.x = clampNodeXInLayer(vid, midCx - vn.boxW * 0.5);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Straighten multi-layer dummy chains into single unbroken vertical lines wherever feasible
    for (let pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
      for (let k = 0; k < dagEdgeIndices.length; k++) {
        const ei = dagEdgeIndices[k];
        const chain = edgeChains[ei];
        if (!chain || chain.length <= 3) continue; // Only chains with >= 2 dummy nodes

        let segStart = 1;
        while (segStart < chain.length - 1) {
          let commonMin = -Infinity;
          let commonMax = Infinity;
          let sumX = 0;
          let count = 0;
          let segEnd = segStart;

          while (segEnd < chain.length - 1) {
            const vid = chain[segEnd];
            const vn = vNodes[vid];
            const l = vn.layer;
            const arr = vLayers[l];
            const c = posInLayer[vid];
            const minBound = c > 0
              ? (vNodes[arr[c - 1]].x + vNodes[arr[c - 1]].w + pairGap(arr[c - 1], vid))
              : -1e6;
            const maxBound = (c + 1 < arr.length)
              ? (vNodes[arr[c + 1]].x - pairGap(vid, arr[c + 1]) - vn.w)
              : 1e6;

            const nextMin = Math.max(commonMin, minBound);
            const nextMax = Math.min(commonMax, maxBound);
            if (nextMin <= nextMax) {
              commonMin = nextMin;
              commonMax = nextMax;
              sumX += vn.x;
              count++;
              segEnd++;
            } else {
              break;
            }
          }

          if (count >= 2) {
            const avgX = sumX / count;
            // Prefer keeping the rail compact (closer to commonMin if on the right edge, commonMax if on the left edge)
            const firstDummy = vNodes[chain[segStart]];
            const firstLayerArr = vLayers[firstDummy.layer];
            const isRightmost = posInLayer[firstDummy.vid] === firstLayerArr.length - 1 ||
              vNodes[firstLayerArr[firstLayerArr.length - 1]].isDummy;
            const preferredX = isRightmost && Number.isFinite(commonMin) && commonMin > -1e5
              ? Math.min(avgX, commonMin + 6)
              : avgX;
            const targetX = Math.max(commonMin, Math.min(commonMax, preferredX));
            for (let m = segStart; m < segEnd; m++) {
              vNodes[chain[m]].x = targetX;
            }
          }
          segStart = Math.max(segStart + 1, segEnd);
        }
      }
    }

    // Copy preliminary X coordinates to real nodes
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      nodes[i].x = vNodes[i].x;
    }

    // Step (e): Port Assignment, Gutter Track Allocation, and Obstacle-Free Rounded-Orthogonal Edge Routing
    const outPorts = new Array(n);
    const inPorts = new Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      outPorts[i] = [];
      inPorts[i] = [];
    }
    for (let k = 0; k < dagEdgeIndices.length; k++) {
      const ei = dagEdgeIndices[k];
      const e = validEdges[ei];
      outPorts[e.u].push(ei);
      inPorts[e.v].push(ei);
    }

    const edgeStartX = new Float64Array(eCount);
    const edgeEndX = new Float64Array(eCount);

    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const nd = nodes[i];
      const outs = outPorts[i];
      if (outs.length > 0) {
        outs.sort(function (a, b) {
          const nextA = vNodes[edgeChains[a][1]];
          const nextB = vNodes[edgeChains[b][1]];
          const cxA = nextA.x + nextA.boxW * 0.5;
          const cxB = nextB.x + nextB.boxW * 0.5;
          if (Math.abs(cxA - cxB) > 0.5) return cxA - cxB;
          return edgeBranchPriority(a) - edgeBranchPriority(b);
        });
        if (outs.length === 1) {
          edgeStartX[outs[0]] = nd.x + nd.w * 0.5;
        } else {
          const margin = Math.min(36, Math.max(20, nd.w * 0.22));
          const span = Math.max(16, nd.w - margin * 2);
          for (let p = 0; p < outs.length; p++) {
            edgeStartX[outs[p]] = nd.x + margin + (span * p) / (outs.length - 1);
          }
        }
      }

      const ins = inPorts[i];
      if (ins.length > 0) {
        ins.sort(function (a, b) {
          const chainA = edgeChains[a];
          const chainB = edgeChains[b];
          const prevA = vNodes[chainA[chainA.length - 2]];
          const prevB = vNodes[chainB[chainB.length - 2]];
          const cxA = prevA.isDummy ? (prevA.x + prevA.w * 0.5) : edgeStartX[a];
          const cxB = prevB.isDummy ? (prevB.x + prevB.w * 0.5) : edgeStartX[b];
          if (Math.abs(cxA - cxB) > 0.5) return cxA - cxB;
          return prevA.layer - prevB.layer;
        });
        if (ins.length === 1) {
          edgeEndX[ins[0]] = nd.x + nd.w * 0.5;
        } else {
          const margin = Math.min(36, Math.max(20, nd.w * 0.22));
          const span = Math.max(16, nd.w - margin * 2);
          for (let p = 0; p < ins.length; p++) {
            edgeEndX[ins[p]] = nd.x + margin + (span * p) / (ins.length - 1);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Snap 1-layer edges to pure vertical lines whenever source & target ports can share an X coordinate
    for (let k = 0; k < dagEdgeIndices.length; k++) {
      const ei = dagEdgeIndices[k];
      const chain = edgeChains[ei];
      if (chain.length === 2) {
        const u = validEdges[ei].u;
        const v = validEdges[ei].v;
        const nu = nodes[u];
        const nv = nodes[v];
        const padU = Math.min(22, nu.w * 0.15);
        const padV = Math.min(22, nv.w * 0.15);
        if (outPorts[u].length === 1 && inPorts[v].length === 1) {
          const minOverlap = Math.max(nu.x + padU, nv.x + padV);
          const maxOverlap = Math.min(nu.x + nu.w - padU, nv.x + nv.w - padV);
          if (minOverlap <= maxOverlap) {
            const mid = Math.max(minOverlap, Math.min(maxOverlap, (edgeStartX[ei] + edgeEndX[ei]) * 0.5));
            edgeStartX[ei] = mid;
            edgeEndX[ei] = mid;
          }
        } else if (inPorts[v].length === 1 && edgeStartX[ei] >= nv.x + padV && edgeStartX[ei] <= nv.x + nv.w - padV) {
          edgeEndX[ei] = edgeStartX[ei];
        } else if (outPorts[u].length === 1 && edgeEndX[ei] >= nu.x + padU && edgeEndX[ei] <= nu.x + nu.w - padU) {
          edgeStartX[ei] = edgeEndX[ei];
        } else if (Math.abs(edgeStartX[ei] - edgeEndX[ei]) <= 12) {
          const avg = (edgeStartX[ei] + edgeEndX[ei]) * 0.5;
          if (avg >= nu.x + 14 && avg <= nu.x + nu.w - 14 && avg >= nv.x + 14 && avg <= nv.x + nv.w - 14) {
            edgeStartX[ei] = avg;
            edgeEndX[ei] = avg;
          }
        }
      } else if (chain.length > 2) {
        // Also align final dummy node with target port X if within obstacle-free bounds
        const lastDummy = vNodes[chain[chain.length - 2]];
        const l = lastDummy.layer;
        const arr = vLayers[l];
        const c = posInLayer[lastDummy.vid];
        const minB = c > 0 ? (vNodes[arr[c - 1]].x + vNodes[arr[c - 1]].w + pairGap(arr[c - 1], lastDummy.vid)) : -1e6;
        const maxB = (c + 1 < arr.length) ? (vNodes[arr[c + 1]].x - pairGap(lastDummy.vid, arr[c + 1]) - lastDummy.w) : 1e6;
        const desiredDummyX = edgeEndX[ei] - lastDummy.w * 0.5;
        if (chain.length === 3 && desiredDummyX >= minB && desiredDummyX <= maxB) {
          lastDummy.x = desiredDummyX;
        }
      }
    }

    // Build per-layer X waypoint sequence for each forward DAG edge and collect horizontal transitions per gap
    const gapSegments = new Array(layerCount);
    for (let l = 0; l < layerCount; l++) {
      gapSegments[l] = [];
    }

    const edgeWaypointsX = new Array(eCount);
    for (let k = 0; k < dagEdgeIndices.length; k++) {
      const ei = dagEdgeIndices[k];
      const chain = edgeChains[ei];
      const wps = new Float64Array(chain.length);
      wps[0] = edgeStartX[ei];
      for (let s = 1; s < chain.length - 1; s++) {
        const dm = vNodes[chain[s]];
        wps[s] = dm.x + dm.w * 0.5;
      }
      wps[chain.length - 1] = edgeEndX[ei];
      edgeWaypointsX[ei] = wps;

      const lu = layer[validEdges[ei].u];
      for (let s = 0; s < wps.length - 1; s++) {
        const x1 = wps[s];
        const x2 = wps[s + 1];
        if (Math.abs(x2 - x1) >= 1.0) {
          gapSegments[lu + s].push({
            edgeIdx: ei,
            stepIdx: s,
            x1: x1,
            x2: x2,
            minX: Math.min(x1, x2),
            maxX: Math.max(x1, x2),
            dir: x2 >= x1 ? 1 : -1,
            track: 0,
          });
        }
      }
    }

    // Assign non-overlapping horizontal tracks in each inter-layer gap using crossing-free nesting order
    const gapTrackCounts = new Int32Array(layerCount);
    for (let l = 0; l < layerCount; l++) {
      const segs = gapSegments[l];
      if (segs.length === 0) {
        gapTrackCounts[l] = 1;
        continue;
      }
      // Concentric elbow ordering: rightward turns with larger X go on upper tracks; leftward turns with smaller X go on upper tracks
      segs.sort(function (a, b) {
        if (a.dir !== b.dir) return a.dir - b.dir;
        if (a.dir > 0) {
          if (Math.abs(b.maxX - a.maxX) > 1.0) return b.maxX - a.maxX;
          return b.minX - a.minX;
        }
        if (Math.abs(a.minX - b.minX) > 1.0) return a.minX - b.minX;
        return a.maxX - b.maxX;
      });

      const tracks = [];
      for (let s = 0; s < segs.length; s++) {
        const seg = segs[s];
        let assigned = -1;
        for (let t = 0; t < tracks.length; t++) {
          const intervals = tracks[t];
          let conflict = false;
          for (let m = 0; m < intervals.length; m++) {
            if (seg.minX - 8 <= intervals[m].maxX && seg.maxX + 8 >= intervals[m].minX) {
              conflict = true;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (!conflict) {
            assigned = t;
            intervals.push(seg);
            break;
          }
        }
        if (assigned === -1) {
          assigned = tracks.length;
          tracks.push([seg]);
        }
        seg.track = assigned;
      }
      gapTrackCounts[l] = Math.max(1, tracks.length);
    }

    // Reserve extra gap tracks for back-edges entering/leaving non-extremal layers
    const backOutTrack = new Int32Array(eCount);
    const backInTrack = new Int32Array(eCount);
    for (let k = 0; k < backEdgeIndices.length; k++) {
      const ei = backEdgeIndices[k];
      const e = validEdges[ei];
      if (e.u === e.v) continue;
      const lu = layer[e.u];
      const lv = layer[e.v];
      if (lu < layerCount - 1) {
        backOutTrack[ei] = gapTrackCounts[lu]++;
      }
      if (lv > 0) {
        backInTrack[ei] = gapTrackCounts[lv - 1]++;
      }
    }

    // Compute final layerY and layerBottom with dynamic gap heights
    const gapHeight = new Float64Array(layerCount);
    const layerY = new Float64Array(layerCount);
    const layerBottom = new Float64Array(layerCount);

    let topBackCount = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < backEdgeIndices.length; k++) {
      const ei = backEdgeIndices[k];
      const e = validEdges[ei];
      if (e.u !== e.v && layer[e.v] === 0) {
        topBackCount++;
      }
    }

    layerY[0] = MARGIN + (topBackCount > 0 ? (14 + topBackCount * TRACK_STEP) : 0);
    for (let l = 0; l < layerCount; l++) {
      layerBottom[l] = layerY[l] + layerMaxH[l];
      gapHeight[l] = Math.max(ROW_GAP, GUTTER_PAD * 2 + Math.max(0, gapTrackCounts[l] - 1) * TRACK_STEP);
      if (l + 1 < layerCount) {
        layerY[l + 1] = layerBottom[l] + gapHeight[l];
      }
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      nodes[i].y = layerY[nodes[i].layer];
    }

    function getGapTrackY(gapLayer, trackIdx) {
      const count = Math.max(1, gapTrackCounts[gapLayer]);
      const avail = gapHeight[gapLayer] - GUTTER_PAD * 2;
      const offset = count === 1 ? avail * 0.5 : (avail * trackIdx) / (count - 1);
      return layerBottom[gapLayer] + GUTTER_PAD + offset;
    }

    // Lookup table for assigned track index of (edgeIdx, stepIdx)
    const forwardStepTrack = new Map();
    for (let l = 0; l < layerCount; l++) {
      const segs = gapSegments[l];
      for (let s = 0; s < segs.length; s++) {
        forwardStepTrack.set(segs[s].edgeIdx + ':' + segs[s].stepIdx, segs[s].track);
      }
    }

    // Precompute back-edge outer vertical lanes so we know if any left back-lanes shift minX
    const layerMinLeft = new Float64Array(layerCount);
    const layerMaxRight = new Float64Array(layerCount);
    for (let l = 0; l < layerCount; l++) {
      layerMinLeft[l] = Infinity;
      layerMaxRight[l] = -Infinity;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const l = nodes[i].layer;
      if (nodes[i].x < layerMinLeft[l]) layerMinLeft[l] = nodes[i].x;
      const rEdge = nodes[i].x + nodes[i].w + (selfLoopCount[i] > 0 ? (28 + selfLoopCount[i] * 16) : 0);
      if (rEdge > layerMaxRight[l]) layerMaxRight[l] = rEdge;
    }
    for (let vid = n; vid < totalV; vid++) {
      const dm = vNodes[vid];
      if (dm.x < layerMinLeft[dm.layer]) layerMinLeft[dm.layer] = dm.x;
      if (dm.x + dm.w > layerMaxRight[dm.layer]) layerMaxRight[dm.layer] = dm.x + dm.w;
    }

    const backLaneX = new Float64Array(eCount);
    let leftBackCount = 0;
    let rightBackCount = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < backEdgeIndices.length; k++) {
      const ei = backEdgeIndices[k];
      const e = validEdges[ei];
      if (e.u === e.v) continue;
      const fromNd = nodes[e.u];
      const toNd = nodes[e.v];
      const minL = Math.min(fromNd.layer, toNd.layer);
      const maxL = Math.max(fromNd.layer, toNd.layer);
      let spanMinLeft = Infinity;
      let spanMaxRight = -Infinity;
      for (let l = minL; l <= maxL; l++) {
        if (layerMinLeft[l] < spanMinLeft) spanMinLeft = layerMinLeft[l];
        if (layerMaxRight[l] > spanMaxRight) spanMaxRight = layerMaxRight[l];
      }
      const fromCx = fromNd.x + fromNd.w * 0.5;
      const toCx = toNd.x + toNd.w * 0.5;
      const distLeft = (fromCx - spanMinLeft) + (toCx - spanMinLeft);
      const distRight = (spanMaxRight - fromCx) + (spanMaxRight - toCx);
      if (distLeft + 20 < distRight) {
        backLaneX[ei] = spanMinLeft - 24 - leftBackCount * 14;
        leftBackCount++;
      } else {
        backLaneX[ei] = spanMaxRight + 24 + rightBackCount * 14;
        rightBackCount++;
      }
    }

    // Shift all X coordinates so minX (including any left back-edge lanes) is exactly MARGIN
    let globalMinX = Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      if (nodes[i].x < globalMinX) globalMinX = nodes[i].x;
    }
    for (let vid = n; vid < totalV; vid++) {
      if (vNodes[vid].x < globalMinX) globalMinX = vNodes[vid].x;
    }
    for (let k = 0; k < backEdgeIndices.length; k++) {
      const ei = backEdgeIndices[k];
      if (validEdges[ei].u !== validEdges[ei].v && backLaneX[ei] < globalMinX) {
        globalMinX = backLaneX[ei];
      }
    }

    const shiftX = Number.isFinite(globalMinX) ? (MARGIN - globalMinX) : 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      nodes[i].x = round2(nodes[i].x + shiftX);
      nodes[i].y = round2(nodes[i].y);
    }
    for (let vid = n; vid < totalV; vid++) {
      vNodes[vid].x += shiftX;
    }
    for (let k = 0; k < dagEdgeIndices.length; k++) {
      const ei = dagEdgeIndices[k];
      edgeStartX[ei] += shiftX;
      edgeEndX[ei] += shiftX;
      const wps = edgeWaypointsX[ei];
      for (let s = 0; s < wps.length; s++) {
        wps[s] += shiftX;
      }
    }
    for (let k = 0; k < backEdgeIndices.length; k++) {
      const ei = backEdgeIndices[k];
      if (validEdges[ei].u !== validEdges[ei].v) {
        backLaneX[ei] += shiftX;
      }
    }

    const routedEdges = new Array(eCount);
    let maxRight = 0;
    let maxBottom = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const rEdge = nodes[i].x + nodes[i].w;
      const bEdge = nodes[i].y + nodes[i].h;
      if (rEdge > maxRight) maxRight = rEdge;
      if (bEdge > maxBottom) maxBottom = bEdge;
    }

    // Build obstacle-free rounded-orthogonal paths for all forward DAG edges
    for (let k = 0; k < dagEdgeIndices.length; k++) {
      const ei = dagEdgeIndices[k];
      const e = validEdges[ei];
      const fromNd = nodes[e.u];
      const toNd = nodes[e.v];
      const lu = fromNd.layer;
      const wps = edgeWaypointsX[ei];

      const sx = round2(wps[0]);
      const sy = round2(fromNd.y + fromNd.h);
      const tx = round2(wps[wps.length - 1]);
      const ty = round2(toNd.y);

      const pts = [{ x: sx, y: sy }];
      for (let s = 0; s < wps.length - 1; s++) {
        const curGapL = lu + s;
        const x1 = wps[s];
        const x2 = wps[s + 1];
        if (Math.abs(x2 - x1) < 1.0) {
          // Pure vertical passage across this gap
          if (s + 1 < wps.length - 1) {
            pts.push({ x: x2, y: layerY[curGapL + 1] });
            pts.push({ x: x2, y: layerBottom[curGapL + 1] });
          }
        } else {
          const tIdx = forwardStepTrack.get(ei + ':' + s) || 0;
          const trackY = getGapTrackY(curGapL, tIdx);
          pts.push({ x: x1, y: trackY });
          pts.push({ x: x2, y: trackY });
          if (s + 1 < wps.length - 1) {
            pts.push({ x: x2, y: layerY[curGapL + 1] });
            pts.push({ x: x2, y: layerBottom[curGapL + 1] });
          }
        }
        if (Math.max(x1, x2) > maxRight) maxRight = Math.max(x1, x2);
      }
      pts.push({ x: tx, y: ty });

      const d = buildRoundedOrthogonalPath(pts, CORNER_R);
      const midIdx = Math.floor(pts.length * 0.5);
      const labelPos = {
        x: round2((pts[Math.max(0, midIdx - 1)].x + pts[midIdx].x) * 0.5),
        y: round2((pts[Math.max(0, midIdx - 1)].y + pts[midIdx].y) * 0.5),
      };

      routedEdges[ei] = {
        from: e.from,
        to: e.to,
        kind: e.kind,
        d: d,
        isBackEdge: false,
        labelPos: labelPos,
      };
    }

    // Build obstacle-free rounded-orthogonal paths for LOOP_BACK and self-loop edges
    const selfLoopSeenByNode = new Map();
    let bottomBackIdx = 0;
    let topBackIdx = 0;

    for (let k = 0; k < backEdgeIndices.length; k++) {
      const ei = backEdgeIndices[k];
      const e = validEdges[ei];
      const fromNd = nodes[e.u];
      const toNd = nodes[e.v];

      let d;
      let labelPos;

      if (e.u === e.v) {
        const sc = selfLoopSeenByNode.get(e.u) || 0;
        selfLoopSeenByNode.set(e.u, sc + 1);
        const sx = round2(fromNd.x + fromNd.w);
        const sy = round2(fromNd.y + Math.max(HEADER_H + 8, fromNd.h - 10));
        const tx = round2(fromNd.x + fromNd.w);
        const ty = round2(fromNd.y + Math.min(fromNd.h * 0.35, HEADER_H + 10));
        const loopX = round2(fromNd.x + fromNd.w + 22 + sc * 14);
        const pts = [
          { x: sx, y: sy },
          { x: loopX, y: sy },
          { x: loopX, y: ty },
          { x: tx, y: ty },
        ];
        d = buildRoundedOrthogonalPath(pts, 8);
        labelPos = {
          x: loopX,
          y: round2((sy + ty) * 0.5),
        };
        if (loopX > maxRight) maxRight = loopX;
      } else {
        const laneX = round2(backLaneX[ei]);
        const isLeftLane = laneX < fromNd.x;
        const sx = round2(isLeftLane ? (fromNd.x + Math.min(26, fromNd.w * 0.2)) : (fromNd.x + fromNd.w - Math.min(26, fromNd.w * 0.2)));
        const sy = round2(fromNd.y + fromNd.h);
        const tx = round2(isLeftLane ? (toNd.x + Math.min(26, toNd.w * 0.2)) : (toNd.x + toNd.w - Math.min(26, toNd.w * 0.2)));
        const ty = round2(toNd.y);

        let yOut;
        if (fromNd.layer < layerCount - 1) {
          yOut = round2(getGapTrackY(fromNd.layer, backOutTrack[ei]));
        } else {
          yOut = round2(layerBottom[fromNd.layer] + 16 + bottomBackIdx * TRACK_STEP);
          bottomBackIdx++;
          if (yOut > maxBottom) maxBottom = yOut;
        }

        let yIn;
        if (toNd.layer > 0) {
          yIn = round2(getGapTrackY(toNd.layer - 1, backInTrack[ei]));
        } else {
          yIn = round2(layerY[0] - 14 - topBackIdx * TRACK_STEP);
          topBackIdx++;
        }

        const pts = [
          { x: sx, y: sy },
          { x: sx, y: yOut },
          { x: laneX, y: yOut },
          { x: laneX, y: yIn },
          { x: tx, y: yIn },
          { x: tx, y: ty },
        ];
        d = buildRoundedOrthogonalPath(pts, 10);
        labelPos = {
          x: laneX,
          y: round2((yOut + yIn) * 0.5),
        };
        if (laneX > maxRight) maxRight = laneX;
      }

      routedEdges[ei] = {
        from: e.from,
        to: e.to,
        kind: e.kind,
        d: d,
        isBackEdge: true,
        labelPos: labelPos,
      };
    }

    const totalW = round2(maxRight + MARGIN);
    const totalH = round2(maxBottom + MARGIN);

    return {
      nodes: nodes,
      edges: routedEdges,
      bounds: {
        minX: 0,
        minY: 0,
        maxX: totalW,
        maxY: totalH,
        width: totalW,
        height: totalH,
      },
      layerCount: layerCount,
    };
  }

  function interpolate(str, vars) {
    if (!vars || typeof str !== 'string') return str || '';
    return str.replace(/\{([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\}/g, function (_, k) {
      return vars[k] !== undefined && vars[k] !== null ? String(vars[k]) : '{' + k + '}';
    });
  }

  function makeTranslator(opts) {
    const fn = opts && typeof opts.t === 'function' ? opts.t : null;
    return function tr(key, vars, fallback) {
      if (fn) {
        const res = fn(key, vars, fallback);
        if (typeof res === 'string' && res.length > 0) return res;
      }
      return interpolate(fallback || key, vars);
    };
  }

  function getOrCreateWorker() {
    if (sharedWorker) return sharedWorker;
    if (typeof Worker !== 'function' || typeof Blob !== 'function' || typeof URL === 'undefined' || typeof URL.createObjectURL !== 'function') {
      return null;
    }
    try {
      const workerSrc = [
        "'use strict';",
        'const computeLayout = ' + computeLayout.toString() + ';',
        'self.onmessage = function(ev) {',
        '  const msg = ev && ev.data ? ev.data : {};',
        '  try {',
        '    const layout = computeLayout(msg.blocks, msg.edges, msg.options);',
        '    self.postMessage({ jobId: msg.jobId, ok: true, layout: layout });',
        '  } catch (err) {',
        '    self.postMessage({ jobId: msg.jobId, ok: false, error: String(err && err.message ? err.message : err) });',
        '  }',
        '};',
      ].join('\n');
      const blob = new Blob([workerSrc], { type: 'application/javascript' });
      const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      let worker;
      try {
        worker = new Worker(blobUrl);
      } finally {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl);
      }
      worker.onmessage = function (ev) {
        const msg = ev && ev.data ? ev.data : {};
        const pending = pendingJobs.get(msg.jobId);
        if (!pending) return;
        pendingJobs.delete(msg.jobId);
        if (msg.ok) {
          pending.resolve(msg.layout);
        } else {
          pending.reject(new Error(msg.error || 'Worker layout failed'));
        }
      };
      worker.onerror = function (err) {
        const failure = err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(err && err.message ? err.message : 'Worker error');
        for (const [jid, pending] of pendingJobs.entries()) {
          pendingJobs.delete(jid);
          pending.reject(failure);
        }
        terminateSharedWorker();
      };
      sharedWorker = worker;
      return sharedWorker;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  function terminateSharedWorker() {
    for (const [jid, pending] of pendingJobs.entries()) {
      pendingJobs.delete(jid);
      pending.reject(new Error('CFG worker terminated'));
    }
    if (sharedWorker) {
      try {
        sharedWorker.terminate();
      } catch {
        // Ignore termination failures.
      }
      sharedWorker = null;
    }
  }

  function runLayoutWithWorkerFallback(blocks, edges, layoutOptions, onCancelRegister) {
    const useWorker = blocks.length > WORKER_THRESHOLD;
    const t0 = typeof performance !== 'undefined' && performance.now ? performance.now() : Date.now();

    if (!useWorker) {
      const layout = computeLayout(blocks, edges, layoutOptions);
      const t1 = typeof performance !== 'undefined' && performance.now ? performance.now() : Date.now();
      return Promise.resolve({ layout: layout, layoutMs: Math.max(0, t1 - t0), usedWorker: false });
    }

    const worker = getOrCreateWorker();
    if (!worker) {
      const layout = computeLayout(blocks, edges, layoutOptions);
      const t1 = typeof performance !== 'undefined' && performance.now ? performance.now() : Date.now();
      return Promise.resolve({ layout: layout, layoutMs: Math.max(0, t1 - t0), usedWorker: false });
    }

    const jobId = ++globalJobId;
    if (typeof onCancelRegister === 'function') {
      onCancelRegister(jobId);
    }

    return new Promise(function (resolve) {
      pendingJobs.set(jobId, {
        resolve: function (layout) {
          const t1 = typeof performance !== 'undefined' && performance.now ? performance.now() : Date.now();
          resolve({ layout: layout, layoutMs: Math.max(0, t1 - t0), usedWorker: true });
        },
        reject: function () {
          // Graceful fallback to synchronous layout if worker fails (unless cancelled externally)
          const tSync0 = typeof performance !== 'undefined' && performance.now ? performance.now() : Date.now();
          const layout = computeLayout(blocks, edges, layoutOptions);
          const tSync1 = typeof performance !== 'undefined' && performance.now ? performance.now() : Date.now();
          resolve({ layout: layout, layoutMs: Math.max(0, tSync1 - tSync0), usedWorker: false });
        },
      });
      try {
        worker.postMessage({ jobId: jobId, blocks: blocks, edges: edges, options: layoutOptions });
      } catch {
        pendingJobs.delete(jobId);
        const layout = computeLayout(blocks, edges, layoutOptions);
        const t1 = typeof performance !== 'undefined' && performance.now ? performance.now() : Date.now();
        resolve({ layout: layout, layoutMs: Math.max(0, t1 - t0), usedWorker: false });
      }
    });
  }

  function svgEl(tag, className) {
    const el = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, tag);
    if (className) el.setAttribute('class', className);
    return el;
  }

  function normalizeAddrCmp(val) {
    if (val === null || val === undefined) return null;
    const s = String(val).trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!s) return null;
    try {
      return BigInt(s.startsWith('0x') ? s : '0x' + s);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  function resolveFocusBlockId(cfgData, focusAddr, nodes) {
    if (cfgData && cfgData.focusBlockId) {
      return String(cfgData.focusBlockId);
    }
    if (!focusAddr || !nodes || nodes.length === 0) return null;
    const targetStr = String(focusAddr).trim().toLowerCase();
    const targetBig = normalizeAddrCmp(targetStr);

    for (let i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
      const nd = nodes[i];
      if (String(nd.id).toLowerCase() === targetStr || String(nd.start).toLowerCase() === targetStr) {
        return nd.id;
      }
      if (targetBig !== null) {
        const sBig = normalizeAddrCmp(nd.start);
        const eBig = normalizeAddrCmp(nd.end);
        if (sBig !== null && eBig !== null && targetBig >= sBig && targetBig <= eBig) {
          return nd.id;
        }
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function cleanupMount(mountEl, keepDom) {
    if (!mountEl) return;
    const st = mountStates.get(mountEl);
    if (st) {
      st.destroyed = true;
      if (st.activeJobId !== null) {
        pendingJobs.delete(st.activeJobId);
        st.activeJobId = null;
      }
      if (st.rafId !== null && typeof cancelAnimationFrame === 'function') {
        cancelAnimationFrame(st.rafId);
        st.rafId = null;
      }
      if (st.resizeObserver) {
        try {
          st.resizeObserver.disconnect();
        } catch {
          // Ignore disconnect errors.
        }
        st.resizeObserver = null;
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < st.cleanups.length; i++) {
        try {
          st.cleanups[i]();
        } catch {
          // Ignore cleanup errors.
        }
      }
      st.cleanups.length = 0;
      if (!keepDom && activeWorkerMount === mountEl) {
        activeWorkerMount = null;
        terminateSharedWorker();
      }
      mountStates.delete(mountEl);
    }
    if (!keepDom && typeof mountEl.replaceChildren === 'function') {
      mountEl.replaceChildren();
    }
  }

  function destroy(mountEl) {
    if (!mountEl) {
      terminateSharedWorker();
      return;
    }
    cleanupMount(mountEl, false);
  }

  function render(mountEl, cfgData, opts) {
    if (!mountEl) return;
    cleanupMount(mountEl, true);

    const options = opts && typeof opts === 'object' ? opts : {};
    const tr = makeTranslator(options);
    const data = cfgData && typeof cfgData === 'object' ? cfgData : {};
    const blocks = Array.isArray(data.blocks) ? data.blocks : [];
    const edges = Array.isArray(data.edges) ? data.edges : [];

    const isTruncated = Boolean(data.truncated);
    const isSubgraphMode = Boolean(data.egoSubgraph || options.focusAddr);

    const st = {
      destroyed: false,
      activeJobId: null,
      rafId: null,
      resizeObserver: null,
      cleanups: [],
    };
    mountStates.set(mountEl, st);

    mountEl.dataset.cfgBlockCount = String(blocks.length);
    mountEl.dataset.cfgTruncated = isTruncated ? 'true' : 'false';
    mountEl.dataset.cfgSubgraph = isSubgraphMode ? 'true' : 'false';

    if (isTruncated && !isSubgraphMode) {
      mountEl.dataset.cfgLayoutMs = '0';
      mountEl.dataset.cfgUsedWorker = 'false';
      renderTruncatedLimitCard(mountEl, data, blocks, edges, options, tr, st);
      return;
    }

    startGraphRender(mountEl, data, blocks, edges, options, tr, st, isTruncated, isSubgraphMode, false);
  }

  function renderTruncatedLimitCard(mountEl, data, blocks, edges, options, tr, st) {
    mountEl.replaceChildren();

    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'cfg-limit-card empty-card';
    card.setAttribute('data-cfg-limit-banner', 'true');

    const title = document.createElement('strong');
    title.textContent = String(data.functionName || data.functionEntry || 'CFG');

    const msg = document.createElement('div');
    msg.className = 'inspector-meta';
    msg.textContent = tr(
      'cfgTooManyBlocksNotice',
      { total: data.totalBlocks != null ? data.totalBlocks : blocks.length, limit: data.blockLimit != null ? data.blockLimit : blocks.length },
      'Function has {total} blocks (tier limit {limit}).',
    );

    const actions = document.createElement('div');
    actions.className = 'cfg-limit-actions';

    const btnSub = document.createElement('button');
    btnSub.type = 'button';
    btnSub.className = 'mini-btn primary';
    btnSub.setAttribute('data-cfg-action', 'subgraph');
    btnSub.textContent = tr('cfgViewLocalBtn', null, 'View Local Subgraph (±3 hops)');
    btnSub.addEventListener('click', function () {
      if (typeof options.onViewSubgraph === 'function') {
        options.onViewSubgraph();
      }
    });

    const btnTier = document.createElement('button');
    btnTier.type = 'button';
    btnTier.className = 'mini-btn';
    btnTier.setAttribute('data-cfg-action', 'tier');
    btnTier.textContent = tr('cfgIncreaseTierBtn', null, 'Increase RAM Tier');
    btnTier.addEventListener('click', function () {
      if (typeof options.onIncreaseTier === 'function') {
        options.onIncreaseTier();
      }
    });

    const btnPreview = document.createElement('button');
    btnPreview.type = 'button';
    btnPreview.className = 'mini-btn';
    btnPreview.setAttribute('data-cfg-action', 'preview');
    const limitNum = data.blockLimit != null ? data.blockLimit : blocks.length;
    btnPreview.textContent = tr(
      'cfgPreviewTruncatedBtn',
      { limit: limitNum },
      'Preview First {limit} Blocks',
    );
    btnPreview.addEventListener('click', function () {
      if (st.destroyed) return;
      startGraphRender(mountEl, data, blocks, edges, options, tr, st, true, false, true);
    });

    actions.append(btnSub, btnTier, btnPreview);
    card.append(title, msg, actions);
    mountEl.appendChild(card);
  }

  function startGraphRender(mountEl, data, blocks, edges, options, tr, st, isTruncated, isSubgraphMode, isPreviewMode) {
    mountEl.replaceChildren();

    const root = document.createElement('div');
    root.className = 'cfg-root';

    let bannerEl = null;
    if (isTruncated && isSubgraphMode) {
      bannerEl = document.createElement('div');
      bannerEl.className = 'cfg-subgraph-banner';
      bannerEl.setAttribute('data-cfg-subgraph-banner', 'true');

      const txt = document.createElement('span');
      txt.className = 'cfg-subgraph-text';
      txt.textContent = tr(
        'cfgSubgraphBanner',
        {
          shown: blocks.length,
          total: data.totalBlocks != null ? data.totalBlocks : blocks.length,
          focus: data.focusBlockId || options.focusAddr || data.functionEntry || '',
        },
        'Ego-subgraph around {focus}: showing {shown} of {total} blocks',
      );

      const bannerActions = document.createElement('div');
      bannerActions.className = 'cfg-banner-actions';

      const btnFocus = document.createElement('button');
      btnFocus.type = 'button';
      btnFocus.className = 'mini-btn';
      btnFocus.setAttribute('data-cfg-action', 'center-focus');
      btnFocus.textContent = tr('cfgCenterFocusBtn', null, 'Focus');

      const btnTier = document.createElement('button');
      btnTier.type = 'button';
      btnTier.className = 'mini-btn';
      btnTier.setAttribute('data-cfg-action', 'tier');
      btnTier.textContent = tr('cfgIncreaseTierBtn', null, 'Increase RAM Tier');
      btnTier.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (typeof options.onIncreaseTier === 'function') {
          options.onIncreaseTier();
        }
      });

      bannerActions.append(btnFocus, btnTier);
      bannerEl.append(txt, bannerActions);
      root.appendChild(bannerEl);
    } else if (isTruncated && isPreviewMode) {
      bannerEl = document.createElement('div');
      bannerEl.className = 'cfg-subgraph-banner';
      bannerEl.setAttribute('data-cfg-limit-banner', 'true');

      const txt = document.createElement('span');
      txt.className = 'cfg-subgraph-text';
      txt.textContent = tr(
        'cfgTooManyBlocksNotice',
        {
          total: data.totalBlocks != null ? data.totalBlocks : blocks.length,
          limit: data.blockLimit != null ? data.blockLimit : blocks.length,
        },
        'Function has {total} blocks (tier limit {limit}).',
      );

      const bannerActions = document.createElement('div');
      bannerActions.className = 'cfg-banner-actions';

      const btnSub = document.createElement('button');
      btnSub.type = 'button';
      btnSub.className = 'mini-btn primary';
      btnSub.setAttribute('data-cfg-action', 'subgraph');
      btnSub.textContent = tr('cfgViewLocalBtn', null, 'View Local Subgraph (±3 hops)');
      btnSub.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (typeof options.onViewSubgraph === 'function') {
          options.onViewSubgraph();
        }
      });

      const btnTier = document.createElement('button');
      btnTier.type = 'button';
      btnTier.className = 'mini-btn';
      btnTier.setAttribute('data-cfg-action', 'tier');
      btnTier.textContent = tr('cfgIncreaseTierBtn', null, 'Increase RAM Tier');
      btnTier.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (typeof options.onIncreaseTier === 'function') {
          options.onIncreaseTier();
        }
      });

      bannerActions.append(btnSub, btnTier);
      bannerEl.append(txt, bannerActions);
      root.appendChild(bannerEl);
    }

    mountEl.appendChild(root);

    const layoutOptions = {
      overflowTemplate: tr('cfgBlocksOverflow', null, '… (+{count} more insns)'),
    };

    if (blocks.length <= WORKER_THRESHOLD) {
      const t0 = typeof performance !== 'undefined' && performance.now ? performance.now() : Date.now();
      const layout = computeLayout(blocks, edges, layoutOptions);
      const t1 = typeof performance !== 'undefined' && performance.now ? performance.now() : Date.now();
      const layoutMs = Math.max(0, t1 - t0);

      mountEl.dataset.cfgLayoutMs = String(Math.round(layoutMs * 100) / 100);
      mountEl.dataset.cfgUsedWorker = 'false';
      mountEl.dataset.cfgBlockCount = String(blocks.length);
      mountEl.dataset.cfgTruncated = isTruncated ? 'true' : 'false';
      mountEl.dataset.cfgSubgraph = isSubgraphMode ? 'true' : 'false';

      buildInteractiveSvg(root, mountEl, data, layout, options, tr, st, isSubgraphMode);
      return;
    }

    const loadingEl = document.createElement('div');
    loadingEl.className = 'cfg-loading';
    loadingEl.textContent = tr('cfgComputingLayout', null, 'Computing CFG layout…');
    root.appendChild(loadingEl);
    activeWorkerMount = mountEl;

    runLayoutWithWorkerFallback(blocks, edges, layoutOptions, function (jobId) {
      st.activeJobId = jobId;
    }).then(function (result) {
      if (st.destroyed || mountStates.get(mountEl) !== st) {
        return;
      }
      st.activeJobId = null;
      if (loadingEl.parentNode) {
        loadingEl.remove();
      }

      mountEl.dataset.cfgLayoutMs = String(Math.round(result.layoutMs * 100) / 100);
      mountEl.dataset.cfgUsedWorker = result.usedWorker ? 'true' : 'false';
      mountEl.dataset.cfgBlockCount = String(blocks.length);
      mountEl.dataset.cfgTruncated = isTruncated ? 'true' : 'false';
      mountEl.dataset.cfgSubgraph = isSubgraphMode ? 'true' : 'false';

      buildInteractiveSvg(root, mountEl, data, result.layout, options, tr, st, isSubgraphMode);
    }).catch(function () {
      if (st.destroyed || mountStates.get(mountEl) !== st) {
        return;
      }
      st.activeJobId = null;
      if (loadingEl.parentNode) {
        loadingEl.remove();
      }
    });
  }

  function buildInteractiveSvg(root, mountEl, data, layout, options, tr, st, isSubgraphMode) {
    const nodes = layout.nodes || [];
    const edges = layout.edges || [];
    const bounds = layout.bounds || { width: 400, height: 300 };
    const graphW = Math.max(1, bounds.width || 400);
    const graphH = Math.max(1, bounds.height || 300);

    const focusBlockId = resolveFocusBlockId(data, options.focusAddr, nodes);
    let entryNode = null;
    let focusNode = null;
    for (let i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
      if (nodes[i].isEntry && !entryNode) entryNode = nodes[i];
      if (focusBlockId && (nodes[i].id === focusBlockId || nodes[i].start === focusBlockId)) {
        focusNode = nodes[i];
      }
    }
    if (!entryNode && nodes.length > 0) entryNode = nodes[0];

    // Toolbar
    const toolbar = document.createElement('div');
    toolbar.className = 'cfg-toolbar';

    const controlsGroup = document.createElement('div');
    controlsGroup.className = 'cfg-toolbar-controls';

    const btnZoomOut = document.createElement('button');
    btnZoomOut.type = 'button';
    btnZoomOut.className = 'mini-btn';
    btnZoomOut.setAttribute('data-cfg-action', 'zoom-out');
    btnZoomOut.title = tr('cfgZoomOutTitle', null, 'Zoom out');
    btnZoomOut.textContent = '−';

    const zoomReadout = document.createElement('span');
    zoomReadout.className = 'cfg-zoom-readout';
    zoomReadout.textContent = '100%';

    const btnZoomIn = document.createElement('button');
    btnZoomIn.type = 'button';
    btnZoomIn.className = 'mini-btn';
    btnZoomIn.setAttribute('data-cfg-action', 'zoom-in');
    btnZoomIn.title = tr('cfgZoomInTitle', null, 'Zoom in');
    btnZoomIn.textContent = '+';

    const btnFit = document.createElement('button');
    btnFit.type = 'button';
    btnFit.className = 'mini-btn';
    btnFit.setAttribute('data-cfg-action', 'fit');
    btnFit.textContent = tr('cfgFitBtn', null, 'Fit');

    const btnEntry = document.createElement('button');
    btnEntry.type = 'button';
    btnEntry.className = 'mini-btn';
    btnEntry.setAttribute('data-cfg-action', 'center-entry');
    btnEntry.title = tr('cfgCenterEntryTitle', null, 'Center on entry block');
    btnEntry.textContent = tr('cfgCenterEntryBtn', null, 'Entry');

    controlsGroup.append(btnZoomOut, zoomReadout, btnZoomIn, btnFit, btnEntry);

    let btnFocusToolbar = null;
    if (focusNode) {
      btnFocusToolbar = document.createElement('button');
      btnFocusToolbar.type = 'button';
      btnFocusToolbar.className = 'mini-btn';
      btnFocusToolbar.setAttribute('data-cfg-action', 'center-focus');
      btnFocusToolbar.title = tr('cfgCenterFocusTitle', null, 'Center on focus block');
      btnFocusToolbar.textContent = tr('cfgCenterFocusBtn', null, 'Focus');
      controlsGroup.appendChild(btnFocusToolbar);
    }

    // Legend
    const legend = document.createElement('div');
    legend.className = 'cfg-legend';
    const legendItems = [
      { kind: 'COND_TRUE', color: 'var(--re-edge-true)', key: 'cfgLegendTrue', fallback: 'True' },
      { kind: 'COND_FALSE', color: 'var(--re-edge-false)', key: 'cfgLegendFalse', fallback: 'False' },
      { kind: 'UNCONDITIONAL', color: 'var(--re-edge-uncond)', key: 'cfgLegendUncond', fallback: 'Uncond' },
      { kind: 'LOOP_BACK', color: 'var(--re-edge-loop)', key: 'cfgLegendLoop', fallback: 'Loop', dashed: true },
      { kind: 'SWITCH_CASE', color: 'var(--re-edge-switch, var(--wb-purple))', key: 'cfgLegendSwitch', fallback: 'Switch' },
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < legendItems.length; i++) {
      const li = legendItems[i];
      const chip = document.createElement('span');
      chip.className = 'cfg-legend-chip';
      const swatch = document.createElement('span');
      swatch.className = 'cfg-legend-swatch' + (li.dashed ? ' is-dashed' : '');
      swatch.style.setProperty('--swatch-color', li.color);
      const lbl = document.createElement('span');
      lbl.textContent = tr(li.key, null, li.fallback);
      chip.append(swatch, lbl);
      legend.appendChild(chip);
    }

    toolbar.append(controlsGroup, legend);
    root.appendChild(toolbar);

    // Stage & SVG
    const stage = document.createElement('div');
    stage.className = 'cfg-stage';

    const svg = svgEl('svg', 'cfg-svg');
    svg.setAttribute('width', '100%');
    svg.setAttribute('height', '100%');

    const defs = svgEl('defs');
    const markerDefs = [
      { kind: 'COND_TRUE', color: 'var(--re-edge-true)' },
      { kind: 'COND_FALSE', color: 'var(--re-edge-false)' },
      { kind: 'UNCONDITIONAL', color: 'var(--re-edge-uncond)' },
      { kind: 'LOOP_BACK', color: 'var(--re-edge-loop)' },
      { kind: 'SWITCH_CASE', color: 'var(--re-edge-switch, var(--wb-purple))' },
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < markerDefs.length; i++) {
      const md = markerDefs[i];
      const marker = svgEl('marker');
      marker.setAttribute('id', 'cfg-arrow-' + md.kind);
      marker.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 8 6');
      marker.setAttribute('markerWidth', '8');
      marker.setAttribute('markerHeight', '6');
      marker.setAttribute('refX', '7');
      marker.setAttribute('refY', '3');
      marker.setAttribute('orient', 'auto');
      marker.setAttribute('markerUnits', 'strokeWidth');
      const arrowPath = svgEl('path');
      arrowPath.setAttribute('d', 'M 0 0.5 L 7.5 3 L 0 5.5 z');
      arrowPath.setAttribute('fill', md.color);
      marker.appendChild(arrowPath);
      defs.appendChild(marker);
    }
    svg.appendChild(defs);

    const viewportG = svgEl('g', 'cfg-viewport-g');
    viewportG.style.transformOrigin = '0 0';
    viewportG.style.willChange = 'transform';

    const edgesLayer = svgEl('g', 'cfg-edges-layer');
    for (let i = 0; i < edges.length; i++) {
      const e = edges[i];
      const kind = e.kind || 'UNCONDITIONAL';
      const path = svgEl('path', 'cfg-edge kind-' + kind);
      path.setAttribute('d', e.d);
      path.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
      path.setAttribute('marker-end', 'url(#cfg-arrow-' + kind + ')');
      if (kind === 'LOOP_BACK' || e.isBackEdge) {
        path.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray', '6 4');
      }
      edgesLayer.appendChild(path);
    }

    const blocksLayer = svgEl('g', 'cfg-blocks-layer');
    const blockElsById = new Map();
    const minimapBlksById = new Map();
    const nodeById = new Map();

    for (let i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
      const nd = nodes[i];
      nodeById.set(nd.id, nd);

      const g = svgEl('g', 'cfg-block');
      if (nd.isEntry) g.classList.add('is-entry');
      if (nd.isExit) g.classList.add('is-exit');
      if (focusBlockId && (nd.id === focusBlockId || nd.start === focusBlockId)) {
        g.classList.add('is-focus');
      }
      g.setAttribute('data-block-id', nd.id);
      g.setAttribute('data-block-start', nd.start);
      g.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + nd.x + ', ' + nd.y + ')');

      const rect = svgEl('rect', 'cfg-block-rect');
      rect.setAttribute('x', '0');
      rect.setAttribute('y', '0');
      rect.setAttribute('width', String(nd.w));
      rect.setAttribute('height', String(nd.h));
      rect.setAttribute('rx', '6');
      rect.setAttribute('ry', '6');

      const hdrBg = svgEl('rect', 'cfg-block-hdr-bg');
      hdrBg.setAttribute('x', '0');
      hdrBg.setAttribute('y', '0');
      hdrBg.setAttribute('width', String(nd.w));
      hdrBg.setAttribute('height', '24');
      hdrBg.setAttribute('rx', '6');
      hdrBg.setAttribute('ry', '6');

      const hdrText = svgEl('text', 'cfg-block-hdr');
      hdrText.setAttribute('x', '10');
      hdrText.setAttribute('y', '16');
      hdrText.textContent = nd.displayTitle;

      const metaText = svgEl('text', 'cfg-block-meta');
      metaText.setAttribute('x', String(nd.w - 10));
      metaText.setAttribute('y', '16');
      metaText.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'end');
      metaText.textContent = nd.metaText;

      g.append(rect, hdrBg, hdrText, metaText);

      const rows = nd.displayRows || [];
      for (let r = 0; r < rows.length; r++) {
        const row = rows[r];
        const yPos = 24 + 15 + r * 16;
        if (row.isSummary || row.isOverflow) {
          const tMore = svgEl('text', 'cfg-insn-more');
          tMore.setAttribute('x', '10');
          tMore.setAttribute('y', String(yPos));
          tMore.textContent = row.text;
          g.appendChild(tMore);
        } else {
          const tLine = svgEl('text', 'cfg-insn-line');
          tLine.setAttribute('x', '10');
          tLine.setAttribute('y', String(yPos));

          if (row.addrText) {
            const spAddr = svgEl('tspan', 'cfg-insn-addr');
            spAddr.textContent = row.addrText;
            tLine.appendChild(spAddr);
          }
          if (row.mnemText) {
            const spMnem = svgEl('tspan', 'cfg-insn-mnem');
            spMnem.textContent = row.mnemText;
            tLine.appendChild(spMnem);
          }
          if (row.opsText) {
            const spOps = svgEl('tspan', 'cfg-insn-ops');
            spOps.textContent = row.opsText;
            tLine.appendChild(spOps);
          }
          g.appendChild(tLine);
        }
      }

      blockElsById.set(nd.id, g);
      blocksLayer.appendChild(g);
    }

    viewportG.append(edgesLayer, blocksLayer);
    svg.appendChild(viewportG);
    stage.appendChild(svg);

    // 140x90 Minimap overlay
    const minimap = document.createElement('div');
    minimap.className = 'cfg-minimap';
    minimap.setAttribute('aria-label', tr('cfgMinimapAria', null, 'CFG minimap'));

    const minimapSvg = svgEl('svg', 'cfg-minimap-svg');
    minimapSvg.setAttribute('width', String(MINIMAP_W));
    minimapSvg.setAttribute('height', String(MINIMAP_H));
    minimapSvg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 ' + graphW + ' ' + graphH);
    minimapSvg.setAttribute('preserveAspectRatio', 'xMidYMid meet');

    for (let i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
      const nd = nodes[i];
      const mBlk = svgEl('rect', 'cfg-minimap-blk');
      if (nd.isEntry) mBlk.classList.add('is-entry');
      if (focusBlockId && (nd.id === focusBlockId || nd.start === focusBlockId)) {
        mBlk.classList.add('is-focus');
      }
      mBlk.setAttribute('x', String(nd.x));
      mBlk.setAttribute('y', String(nd.y));
      mBlk.setAttribute('width', String(nd.w));
      mBlk.setAttribute('height', String(nd.h));
      mBlk.setAttribute('data-block-id', nd.id);
      minimapBlksById.set(nd.id, mBlk);
      minimapSvg.appendChild(mBlk);
    }

    const minimapVp = svgEl('rect', 'cfg-minimap-vp');
    minimapVp.setAttribute('x', '0');
    minimapVp.setAttribute('y', '0');
    minimapVp.setAttribute('width', String(graphW));
    minimapVp.setAttribute('height', String(graphH));
    minimapSvg.appendChild(minimapVp);

    minimap.appendChild(minimapSvg);
    stage.appendChild(minimap);
    root.appendChild(stage);

    // Viewport state & GPU transform scheduler
    let scale = 1;
    let tx = 0;
    let ty = 0;
    let userInteracted = false;
    let selectedBlockId = null;
    let cachedStageSize = null;

    function refreshStageSize() {
      cachedStageSize = {
        w: stage.clientWidth || mountEl.clientWidth || 800,
        h: stage.clientHeight || mountEl.clientHeight || 500,
      };
      return cachedStageSize;
    }

    function getStageSize() {
      return cachedStageSize || refreshStageSize();
    }

    function applyTransformNow() {
      st.rafId = null;
      if (st.destroyed) return;
      const sz = getStageSize();
      const vpX = -tx / scale;
      const vpY = -ty / scale;
      const vpW = Math.max(10, sz.w / scale);
      const vpH = Math.max(10, sz.h / scale);

      viewportG.style.transform = 'translate3d(' + tx + 'px, ' + ty + 'px, 0) scale(' + scale + ')';
      zoomReadout.textContent = Math.round(scale * 100) + '%';
      minimapVp.setAttribute('x', String(Math.round(vpX * 10) / 10));
      minimapVp.setAttribute('y', String(Math.round(vpY * 10) / 10));
      minimapVp.setAttribute('width', String(Math.round(vpW * 10) / 10));
      minimapVp.setAttribute('height', String(Math.round(vpH * 10) / 10));
    }

    function scheduleRender() {
      if (st.destroyed) return;
      if (st.rafId !== null) return;
      if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === 'function') {
        st.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(applyTransformNow);
      } else {
        applyTransformNow();
      }
    }

    function clampScale(s) {
      return Math.max(MIN_ZOOM, Math.min(MAX_ZOOM, s));
    }

    function fitToStage() {
      const sz = getStageSize();
      const padX = 24;
      const padTop = 14;
      const padBottom = 46;
      const availW = Math.max(80, sz.w - padX * 2);
      const availH = Math.max(80, sz.h - padTop - padBottom);
      const fitScale = clampScale(Math.min(availW / graphW, availH / graphH, 1.05));
      scale = fitScale;
      tx = (sz.w - graphW * scale) * 0.5;
      ty = Math.max(padTop, padTop + (availH - graphH * scale) * 0.5);
      // If bottom-right of fitted graph overlaps the 140x90 minimap, nudge tx left slightly if room exists on the left
      const rightEdge = tx + graphW * scale;
      const bottomEdge = ty + graphH * scale;
      const minimapLeft = sz.w - MINIMAP_W - 18;
      const minimapTop = sz.h - MINIMAP_H - 18;
      if (rightEdge > minimapLeft && bottomEdge > minimapTop && tx > 24) {
        const shiftLeft = Math.min(tx - 16, rightEdge - minimapLeft);
        tx -= shiftLeft;
      }
      scheduleRender();
    }

    function centerOnNode(nd, desiredScale) {
      if (!nd) {
        fitToStage();
        return;
      }
      const sz = getStageSize();
      if (desiredScale !== undefined) {
        scale = clampScale(desiredScale);
      }
      const cx = nd.x + nd.w * 0.5;
      const cy = nd.y + nd.h * 0.5;
      tx = sz.w * 0.5 - cx * scale;
      ty = sz.h * 0.5 - cy * scale;
      scheduleRender();
    }

    function zoomAtStagePoint(nextScale, stageX, stageY) {
      const clamped = clampScale(nextScale);
      if (clamped === scale) return;
      const gx = (stageX - tx) / scale;
      const gy = (stageY - ty) / scale;
      scale = clamped;
      tx = stageX - gx * scale;
      ty = stageY - gy * scale;
      scheduleRender();
    }

    function selectBlock(blockId) {
      if (selectedBlockId && blockElsById.has(selectedBlockId)) {
        blockElsById.get(selectedBlockId).classList.remove('selected');
        const oldM = minimapBlksById.get(selectedBlockId);
        if (oldM) oldM.classList.remove('selected');
      }
      selectedBlockId = blockId;
      if (blockId && blockElsById.has(blockId)) {
        blockElsById.get(blockId).classList.add('selected');
        const newM = minimapBlksById.get(blockId);
        if (newM) newM.classList.add('selected');
      }
    }

    // Toolbar actions
    btnZoomOut.addEventListener('click', function () {
      userInteracted = true;
      const sz = getStageSize();
      zoomAtStagePoint(scale / 1.2, sz.w * 0.5, sz.h * 0.5);
    });
    btnZoomIn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      userInteracted = true;
      const sz = getStageSize();
      zoomAtStagePoint(scale * 1.2, sz.w * 0.5, sz.h * 0.5);
    });
    btnFit.addEventListener('click', function () {
      userInteracted = true;
      fitToStage();
    });
    btnEntry.addEventListener('click', function () {
      userInteracted = true;
      centerOnNode(entryNode, Math.max(scale, 0.85));
    });
    if (btnFocusToolbar && focusNode) {
      btnFocusToolbar.addEventListener('click', function () {
        userInteracted = true;
        centerOnNode(focusNode, Math.max(scale, 0.95));
      });
    }
    const bannerCenterFocusBtn = root.querySelector('[data-cfg-action="center-focus"]');
    if (bannerCenterFocusBtn && bannerCenterFocusBtn !== btnFocusToolbar) {
      bannerCenterFocusBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        userInteracted = true;
        centerOnNode(focusNode || entryNode, Math.max(scale, 0.95));
      });
    }

    // Wheel zoom centered under pointer cursor
    function onWheel(ev) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      userInteracted = true;
      const rect = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
      const px = ev.clientX - rect.left;
      const py = ev.clientY - rect.top;
      const factor = ev.deltaY < 0 ? 1.12 : 1 / 1.12;
      zoomAtStagePoint(scale * factor, px, py);
    }
    stage.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: false });

    // Pointer drag pan (> 4px threshold so clicks/dblclicks on blocks are preserved)
    let panState = null;
    let suppressNextClick = false;
    function onStagePointerDown(ev) {
      if (ev.button !== 0) return;
      if (ev.target && ev.target.closest && ev.target.closest('.cfg-minimap')) return;
      suppressNextClick = false;
      panState = {
        pointerId: ev.pointerId,
        startX: ev.clientX,
        startY: ev.clientY,
        origTx: tx,
        origTy: ty,
        moved: false,
      };
    }

    function onWindowPointerMove(ev) {
      if (panState && ev.pointerId === panState.pointerId) {
        const dx = ev.clientX - panState.startX;
        const dy = ev.clientY - panState.startY;
        if (!panState.moved && Math.hypot(dx, dy) > DRAG_THRESHOLD_PX) {
          panState.moved = true;
          stage.classList.add('is-panning', 'dragging');
          userInteracted = true;
        }
        if (panState.moved) {
          tx = panState.origTx + dx;
          ty = panState.origTy + dy;
          scheduleRender();
        }
      }
      if (minimapDrag && ev.pointerId === minimapDrag.pointerId) {
        panToMinimapClientPoint(ev.clientX, ev.clientY);
      }
    }

    function onWindowPointerUp(ev) {
      if (panState && ev.pointerId === panState.pointerId) {
        if (panState.moved) {
          stage.classList.remove('is-panning', 'dragging');
          suppressNextClick = true;
          setTimeout(function () {
            suppressNextClick = false;
          }, 0);
        }
        panState = null;
      }
      if (minimapDrag && ev.pointerId === minimapDrag.pointerId) {
        minimapDrag = null;
      }
    }

    stage.addEventListener('pointerdown', onStagePointerDown);
    window.addEventListener('pointermove', onWindowPointerMove);
    window.addEventListener('pointerup', onWindowPointerUp);
    window.addEventListener('pointercancel', onWindowPointerUp);

    st.cleanups.push(function () {
      stage.removeEventListener('wheel', onWheel);
      stage.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onStagePointerDown);
      window.removeEventListener('pointermove', onWindowPointerMove);
      window.removeEventListener('pointerup', onWindowPointerUp);
      window.removeEventListener('pointercancel', onWindowPointerUp);
    });

    // Block click & double-click delegation
    blocksLayer.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
      if (suppressNextClick) {
        suppressNextClick = false;
        return;
      }
      const blkEl = ev.target && ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest('.cfg-block') : null;
      if (!blkEl) return;
      const blkId = blkEl.getAttribute('data-block-id');
      const nd = nodeById.get(blkId);
      if (!nd) return;
      selectBlock(blkId);
      if (typeof options.onBlockClick === 'function') {
        options.onBlockClick(nd);
      }
    });

    blocksLayer.addEventListener('dblclick', function (ev) {
      const blkEl = ev.target && ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest('.cfg-block') : null;
      if (!blkEl) return;
      const blkId = blkEl.getAttribute('data-block-id');
      const nd = nodeById.get(blkId);
      if (!nd) return;
      if (typeof options.onBlockDoubleClick === 'function') {
        options.onBlockDoubleClick(nd);
      }
    });

    // Minimap click & drag pan
    let minimapDrag = null;
    function panToMinimapClientPoint(clientX, clientY) {
      const rect = minimapSvg.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0) return;
      // Account for preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"
      const uniformScale = Math.min(rect.width / graphW, rect.height / graphH);
      const renderedW = graphW * uniformScale;
      const renderedH = graphH * uniformScale;
      const offsetX = rect.left + (rect.width - renderedW) * 0.5;
      const offsetY = rect.top + (rect.height - renderedH) * 0.5;

      const gx = Math.max(0, Math.min(graphW, (clientX - offsetX) / uniformScale));
      const gy = Math.max(0, Math.min(graphH, (clientY - offsetY) / uniformScale));
      const sz = getStageSize();
      userInteracted = true;
      tx = sz.w * 0.5 - gx * scale;
      ty = sz.h * 0.5 - gy * scale;
      scheduleRender();
    }

    function onMinimapPointerDown(ev) {
      if (ev.button !== 0) return;
      ev.stopPropagation();
      ev.preventDefault();
      minimapDrag = { pointerId: ev.pointerId };
      panToMinimapClientPoint(ev.clientX, ev.clientY);
    }
    minimapSvg.addEventListener('pointerdown', onMinimapPointerDown);
    st.cleanups.push(function () {
      minimapSvg.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onMinimapPointerDown);
    });

    // ResizeObserver keeps viewport/minimap synchronized
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'function') {
      const ro = new ResizeObserver(function () {
        if (st.destroyed) return;
        refreshStageSize();
        if (!userInteracted) {
          if (isSubgraphMode && focusNode) {
            centerOnNode(focusNode, 0.95);
          } else {
            fitToStage();
          }
        } else {
          scheduleRender();
        }
      });
      ro.observe(stage);
      st.resizeObserver = ro;
    }

    // Initial positioning
    refreshStageSize();
    if (isSubgraphMode && focusNode) {
      selectBlock(focusNode.id);
      centerOnNode(focusNode, 0.95);
    } else {
      if (focusNode) selectBlock(focusNode.id);
      fitToStage();
    }
  }

  window.GhidraCfg = {
    render: render,
    destroy: destroy,
    computeLayout: computeLayout,
    WORKER_THRESHOLD: WORKER_THRESHOLD,
  };
})();

```

(() => {
  'use strict';

  function normalizeLangTag(raw) {
    return /^ru(?:[_-\b]|$)/i.test(String(raw || '').trim()) ? 'ru' : 'en';
  }

  function hasExplicitUrlLang() {
    try {
      if (typeof location !== 'undefined' && location.search) {
        const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
        const explicit = params.get('lang') || params.get('locale') || '';
        return explicit.trim().length > 0;
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore URL parse errors
    }
    return false;
  }

  function detectInitialLang() {
    let explicit = '';
    try {
      if (typeof location !== 'undefined' && location.search) {
        const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
        explicit = params.get('lang') || params.get('locale') || '';
      }
    } catch {
      explicit = '';
    }
    if (explicit.trim()) {
      return normalizeLangTag(explicit);
    }
    if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.documentElement?.dataset?.hostLang) {
      return normalizeLangTag(document.documentElement.dataset.hostLang);
    }
    const navLang =
      (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && (navigator.language || navigator.languages?.[0])) || 'en';
    return normalizeLangTag(navLang);
  }

  let currentLang = detectInitialLang();
  if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.documentElement) {
    document.documentElement.lang = currentLang;
  }

  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.addEventListener === 'function') {
    window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
      const msg = event?.data;
      if (!msg || typeof msg !== 'object') return;
      if (msg.type === 'locale-change' || msg.type === 'language-change' || msg.type === 'theme-change') {
        const hostLoc = msg.payload?.locale || msg.payload?.lang || msg.locale || msg.lang || '';
        if (hostLoc && !hasExplicitUrlLang()) {
          setLang(hostLoc);
        }
      }
    });
  }

      engineStateSummary: '{state} · PID {pid}',
      engineRamBreakdown: 'JVM {jvm} МБ + Декомпилятор {decomp} МБ / Лимит {limit} МБ (Sidecar {sidecar} МБ)',
      workerLineStatus: 'Воркеры: {busy}/{total} занято (UI-слот: {uiSlot})',
      workerIdle: 'простаивает',

      toastTierSwitching: 'Переключение на режим {tier}…',

      ariaViewTabs: 'Режимы просмотра',

      toastErrorPrefix: 'Ошибка: {msg}',
      toastPromptSent: 'Запрос отправлен агенту.',
    },
  };

  const PLURAL_FORMS = {
    en: {
      function: ['function', 'functions'],
      string: ['string', 'strings'],
      xref: ['xref', 'xrefs'],
      block: ['block', 'blocks'],
      line: ['line', 'lines'],
      import: ['import', 'imports'],
      export: ['export', 'exports'],
      edge: ['edge', 'edges'],
      node: ['node', 'nodes'],
    },
    ru: {
      function: ['функция', 'функции', 'функций'],
      string: ['строка', 'строки', 'строк'],
      xref: ['ссылка', 'ссылки', 'ссылок'],
      block: ['блок', 'блока', 'блоков'],
      line: ['строка', 'строки', 'строк'],
      import: ['импорт', 'импорта', 'импортов'],
      export: ['экспорт', 'экспорта', 'экспортов'],
      edge: ['ребро', 'ребра', 'рёбер'],
      node: ['узел', 'узла', 'узлов'],
    },
  };

  function getLang() {
    return currentLang;
  }

  function setLang(lang) {
    currentLang = normalizeLangTag(lang);
    if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.documentElement) {
      document.documentElement.lang = currentLang;
      applyDom(document);
    }
    return currentLang;
  }

  function t(key, vars) {
    const table = DICT[currentLang] || DICT.en;
    let str = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(table, key)
      ? table[key]
      : (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(DICT.en, key) ? DICT.en[key] : String(key));
    if (vars && typeof vars === 'object') {
      str = str.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, k) =>
        Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(vars, k) && vars[k] !== undefined && vars[k] !== null
          ? String(vars[k])
          : ''
      );
    }
    return str;
  }

  function ruPluralCategory(n) {
    const abs = Math.abs(Math.trunc(Number(n) || 0));
    const mod100 = abs % 100;
    const mod10 = abs % 10;
    if (mod10 === 1 && mod100 !== 11) return 0;
    if (mod10 >= 2 && mod10 <= 4 && !(mod100 >= 12 && mod100 <= 14)) return 1;
    return 2;
  }

  function plural(unit, n) {
    const num = Math.abs(Math.trunc(Number(n) || 0));
    const forms = (PLURAL_FORMS[currentLang] && PLURAL_FORMS[currentLang][unit]) ||
      PLURAL_FORMS.en[unit];
    if (!forms) {
      return String(unit || '');
    }
    if (currentLang === 'ru') {
      return forms[ruPluralCategory(num)];
    }
    return num === 1 ? forms[0] : forms[1];
  }

  function formatCount(unit, n) {
    const rawNum = Number(n);
    const val = Number.isFinite(rawNum) ? rawNum : 0;
    const fmt = new Intl.NumberFormat(currentLang === 'ru' ? 'ru-RU' : 'en-US').format(val);
    return `${fmt} ${plural(unit, val)}`;
  }

  function applyDom(root) {
    const scope = root || (typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document : null);
    if (!scope) return;
    for (const el of scope.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]')) {
      const key = el.dataset.i18n;
      if (key) el.textContent = t(key);
    }
    for (const el of scope.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-placeholder]')) {
      const key = el.dataset.i18nPlaceholder;
      if (key) el.setAttribute('placeholder', t(key));
    }
    for (const el of scope.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-title]')) {
      const key = el.dataset.i18nTitle;
      if (key) el.setAttribute('title', t(key));
    }
    for (const el of scope.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-aria]')) {
      const key = el.dataset.i18nAria;
      if (key) el.setAttribute('aria-label', t(key));
    }
    for (const el of scope.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-aria-label]')) {
      const key = el.dataset.i18nAriaLabel;
      if (key) el.setAttribute('aria-label', t(key));
    }
  }

  const api = { getLang, setLang, hasExplicitUrlLang, t, plural, formatCount, applyDom };
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.GhidraI18n = api;
  } else if (typeof globalThis !== 'undefined') {
    globalThis.GhidraI18n = api;
  }
})();

```

`skills/ghidra-re/SKILL.md`:

```md
---
name: ghidra-re
description: Perform token-efficient static reverse engineering, binary comprehension, and artifact analysis using the local headless Ghidra RE MCP server and Aux Pane workbench.
---

# Ghidra RE — Agent Reverse Engineering Workflow

## 1. Opening & Surfacing the UI
- Check existing binaries with `ghidra_status` / `ghidra_list_binaries` first; never re-import a binary whose SHA-256 is already indexed.
- When starting interactive binary analysis, surface the Aux Pane toggle pill once:
  `[Ghidra RE](sidecar://ghidra-re/workbench/)` (do not repeat if already open).
- Remember: `ghidra_search_symbols`, `ghidra_search_strings`, `ghidra_callgraph`, and `ghidra_search_pseudocode` work offline (0 MB JVM RAM) when a binary is already indexed—use them before triggering heavy decompilations.

## 2. Token-Efficient Triage Loop (Cheap -> Deep)
1. **Fingerprint (`ghidra_open_binary`):** Inspect architecture, format, sections, imports, exports, and entrypoints (plus packer/entropy warnings).
2. **Orient via Offline Indexes:** Run targeted `ghidra_search_strings` (error messages, URLs, format strings, protocol tags) and `ghidra_search_symbols` (`kind="import"` / `kind="export"`). Always keep `limit <= 50`.
3. **Trace Entry -> Target (`ghidra_xrefs` & `ghidra_callgraph`):** Pivot from interesting strings/imports via incoming `xrefs` and call graphs to locate key functions before decompiling anything.
4. **Targeted Decompilation (`ghidra_decompile`):** Decompile one key function at a time (`maxLines=200`). If `truncated: true`, page only the lines needed (`startLine=...`) instead of dumping thousands of lines.
5. **Low-Level Verification (`ghidra_disasm`, `ghidra_inspect_data`, `ghidra_cfg`):** Drop to disassembly, CFG structure, or data/pointer inspection only when decompiled C is ambiguous (inline assembly, crypto tables, vtables, packed dispatch loops).

## 3. Keeping the Workbench Live & Annotated
- As soon as you confirm a function's purpose, variable roles, or struct/parameter types, persist your findings using `ghidra_batch_annotate` (preferred over calling `ghidra_rename`, `ghidra_retype`, or `ghidra_set_comment` one by one).
- Use clear, descriptive `snake_case` names and concise `PLATE`/`EOL` comments; annotations immediately propagate to the user's Aux Pane UI and persist across sessions in `.gpr` + `index.sqlite`.

## 4. Memory Hygiene
- When an analysis task is complete and no further live decompilation is needed, use `ghidra_unload_binary` (with `stopDaemonIfEmpty=true` when appropriate) or remind the user—and call `ghidra_stop_daemon` if asked—that stopping the daemon reclaims all JVM + native decompiler RAM while keeping offline search intact.

```
